koap-ube272680e3f87fe41b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Section I. GENERAL PROVISIONS

koap-u8321f4859afc872f7b-1.text: Chapter 1. Objectives and principles of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u8321f4859afc872f7b-1.locator: Chapter 1. Objectives and principles of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u2786734fa2e41c77f5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 1. OBJECTIVES AND PRINCIPLES OF LEGISLATION ON ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES
koap-u2786734fa2e41c77f5-1.locator: Chapter 1. Objectives and principles of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uddcdadfab8c91afc76-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.1. Legislation on administrative offences

koap-u7e615e68961173fc1f-1.text: 1. Legislation on administrative offences consists of this Code and the laws on administrative offences adopted by constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with it.

koap-ufec6304640b3dd48ee-1.text: 2. This Code is based on the Constitution of the Russian Federation, universally recognised principles and norms of international law, and international treaties of the Russian Federation. If an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules other than those provided for by legislation on administrative offences, the rules of the international treaty shall apply.

koap-uf8640593ace06c8d3b-1.text: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
koap-uf8640593ace06c8d3b-1.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u69708d7685d69b6979-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u69708d7685d69b6979-1.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u69b34f4dcf5a5a3513-1.text: The objectives of legislation on administrative offences are to protect the individual, human and civil rights and freedoms, the health of citizens, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, public morals, the environment, the established procedure for the exercise of state power, public order and public safety, property, and the lawful economic interests of individuals and legal entities, society and the state against administrative offences, and to prevent administrative offences.
koap-u69b34f4dcf5a5a3513-1.locator: Article 1.2. Objectives of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ud04fe415c935a47c54-1.text: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
koap-ud04fe415c935a47c54-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u94833e84a8f125a93d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u94833e84a8f125a93d-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u713e4ec45bb4841e1c-1.text: 1. The jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences includes establishing:
koap-u713e4ec45bb4841e1c-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u360a37bb61284db53f-1.text: 1) the general provisions and principles of legislation on administrative offences;
koap-u360a37bb61284db53f-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ub990bdc8a766a1ab33-1.text: 2) the list of types of administrative penalties and the rules for their application;
koap-ub990bdc8a766a1ab33-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ud3eaf7185870391d70-1.text: 3) administrative liability in matters of federal significance, including administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation;
koap-ud3eaf7185870391d70-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u05e5629a2da1057642-1.text: 3.1) administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory that establish specific arrangements for regulating particular relations within the federal territory in fields defined by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, or provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory adopted in the exercise of powers transferred to them by the Russian Federation;
koap-u05e5629a2da1057642-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u926a31883a651bd7aa-1.text: 4) the procedure for proceedings in administrative offence cases, including the establishment of measures to secure proceedings in administrative offence cases;
koap-u926a31883a651bd7aa-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u96a7d961aadcc68913-1.text: 5) the procedure for enforcing rulings imposing administrative penalties.
koap-u96a7d961aadcc68913-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uf171a18b1e684b48f7-1.text: 2. In accordance with legislation on the judicial system, this Code determines the jurisdiction of courts over administrative offence cases.
koap-uf171a18b1e684b48f7-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u436eb25b22a4f9f577-1.text: 3. In accordance with legislation on the protection of the rights of minors, this Code determines the jurisdiction of commissions for minors' affairs and the protection of their rights over administrative offence cases.
koap-u436eb25b22a4f9f577-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ub191f8f2b7d916c4b0-1.text: 4. In accordance with the established structure of federal executive bodies, this Code determines the jurisdiction of federal executive bodies over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
koap-ub191f8f2b7d916c4b0-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u42e92a15128429c104-1.text: 5. In accordance with the objectives and functions assigned by federal laws to the state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, this Code determines the jurisdiction of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
koap-u42e92a15128429c104-1.locator: Article 1.3. Matters within the jurisdiction of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u820d3362b14ceef5b8-1.text: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u820d3362b14ceef5b8-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u490d4c374279d8ee6d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u490d4c374279d8ee6d-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uc5ed02d26f4450d55f-1.text: 1. The jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences includes:
koap-uc5ed02d26f4450d55f-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uaeb16d7e40f2d62d27-1.text: 1) establishing, by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, administrative liability for violations of laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts of local self-government bodies;
koap-uaeb16d7e40f2d62d27-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-udcc247e9ffa057b88d-1.text: 1.1) establishing, by the laws of the Donetsk People's Republic, the Lugansk People's Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast and Kherson Oblast on administrative offences, administrative liability for exceeding prices (tariffs) for goods and (or) maximum levels of such prices (tariffs) established by regulatory legal acts of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, with account taken of the specific arrangements provided for by federal constitutional laws;
koap-udcc247e9ffa057b88d-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uf86a4af8aba1146643-1.text: 1.2) establishing, by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, administrative liability for breaches of rules and standards provided for by regulatory legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory, except in the cases provided for by point 3.1 of part 1 of Article 1.3 of this Code;
koap-uf86a4af8aba1146643-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u80f9536aa4a465f542-1.text: 2) organising proceedings in cases concerning administrative offences provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
koap-u80f9536aa4a465f542-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-udb1bf35248a7dc498f-1.text: 3) determining jurisdiction over cases concerning administrative offences provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, in accordance with part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code;
koap-udb1bf35248a7dc498f-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u06a0100aaacde9e1c9-1.text: 4) establishing commissions for minors' affairs and the protection of their rights;
koap-u06a0100aaacde9e1c9-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u1e307f219fe7502275-1.text: 5) establishing administrative commissions and other collegiate bodies for the purpose of imposing administrative liability provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
koap-u1e307f219fe7502275-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ua7235f07dd58d7515b-1.text: 6) determining the list of officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
koap-ua7235f07dd58d7515b-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u3bd7d20502641cc76c-1.text: 6.1) determining lists of officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code, in the cases provided for by Article 28.3 of this Code;
koap-u3bd7d20502641cc76c-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u786e0d2a3493614078-1.text: 7) regulating other matters by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in accordance with this Code.
koap-u786e0d2a3493614078-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u9e6f306cf9463a6e60-1.text: 2. Laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may vest local self-government bodies with certain powers of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation to resolve the matters specified in points 4 - 6 of part 1 of this Article, with the transfer of the material and financial resources necessary for their exercise. Where a local self-government body is vested with those powers, its officials may draw up administrative offence records provided for by the laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u9e6f306cf9463a6e60-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u7f7a56e4a1cb23a04e-1.text: 3. In the cases provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, officials of local self-government bodies may draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code or by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation when local self-government bodies exercise control (supervision) powers delegated by the Russian Federation or by constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and when exercising municipal control.
koap-u7f7a56e4a1cb23a04e-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u65fda33cde75e651c0-1.text: 4. Executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are authorised, within the competence established by Chapter 23 of this Code, to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code.
koap-u65fda33cde75e651c0-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ub766379f0cbf703984-1.text: 5. Officials of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are authorised, within the competence of the respective executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to draw up administrative offence records provided for by this Code in the cases specified in Article 28.3 of this Code.
koap-ub766379f0cbf703984-1.locator: Article 1.3.1. Matters within the jurisdiction of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u4d334c146b2eb1fa63-1.text: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
koap-u4d334c146b2eb1fa63-1.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law

koap-u33f81c5a94d5f7f36b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law
koap-u33f81c5a94d5f7f36b-1.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law

koap-u2ef328eff90c6a3f41-1.text: 1. Persons who have committed administrative offences are equal before the law. Individuals are subject to administrative liability irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, language, origin, property status or official position, place of residence, attitude to religion, convictions, membership of public associations or other circumstances. Legal entities are subject to administrative liability irrespective of their location, organisational and legal forms, subordination or other circumstances.
koap-u2ef328eff90c6a3f41-1.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law

koap-u3c00ffb92c3b2e42fe-1.text: 2. Special conditions for the application of measures to secure proceedings in an administrative offence case and for imposing administrative liability on officials performing certain state functions (deputies, judges, prosecutors, employees of the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation and other persons) are established by the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws.
koap-u3c00ffb92c3b2e42fe-1.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law

koap-ub63ddc7577c99a7c01-1.text: 3. Special conditions for the application of administrative liability measures in respect of non-profit organisations, as well as persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity and legal entities that are small and medium-sized enterprises, and the managers and other employees of those legal entities who have committed administrative offences in connection with the performance of organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions (hereinafter referred to as their employees), are established by this Code.
koap-ub63ddc7577c99a7c01-1.locator: Article 1.4. Principle of equality before the law

koap-u8d6de0e2b3e3486a48-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.5. Presumption of innocence

koap-u4dbd4585a51947ca69-1.text: 1. A person is subject to administrative liability only for administrative offences in respect of which that person's guilt has been established.

koap-u2bd3d7c7904ebfe46f-1.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted is presumed innocent until that person's guilt has been proved in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code and established by a ruling that has entered into legal force, issued by the judge, body or official that heard the case.

koap-u00ecdc3d4cf0ae4811-1.text: 3. A person being held administratively liable is not obliged to prove their innocence, except in the cases provided for by the note to this Article.

koap-u292724dbc8e64a5fbd-1.text: 4. Irremovable doubts as to the guilt of a person being held administratively liable shall be interpreted in that person's favour.

koap-u7462e5001b74a8cec9-1.text: Note. The provision of part 3 of this Article does not apply to administrative offences provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 and Chapter 12 of this Code, or to administrative offences in the field of territorial improvement and administrative offences consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for paying for the passage of a vehicle along toll public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, private public motor roads, toll sections of public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, and toll sections of private public motor roads, as provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, committed with the use of vehicles or by the owner or possessor of a land plot or other immovable property, where those administrative offences are recorded by special technical devices operating in automatic mode and having photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment; nor does it apply to administrative offences provided for by parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code where those administrative offences are recorded using the state information system for monitoring the circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification.

koap-u7ade42abdda51383e0-1.text: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence
koap-u7ade42abdda51383e0-1.locator: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence

koap-u4e79176862e49873b5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence
koap-u4e79176862e49873b5-1.locator: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence

koap-u1c5a3cffe731a7a267-1.text: 1. A person being held administratively liable may not be subjected to an administrative penalty or measures to secure proceedings in an administrative offence case except on the grounds and in accordance with the procedure established by law.
koap-u1c5a3cffe731a7a267-1.locator: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence

koap-ue077f1441fbc904463-1.text: 2. An administrative penalty and measures to secure proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be applied in connection with an administrative offence by a body or official authorised to do so, within the competence of that body or official and in accordance with the law.
koap-ue077f1441fbc904463-1.locator: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence

koap-ucc692a8ab334e1045f-1.text: 3. When applying measures of administrative coercion, decisions and actions (inaction) that degrade human dignity are prohibited.
koap-ucc692a8ab334e1045f-1.locator: Article 1.6. Ensuring legality when applying measures of administrative coercion in connection with an administrative offence

koap-ubf4655e01617e93ec0-1.text: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time
koap-ubf4655e01617e93ec0-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u908653b599799d8eed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time
koap-u908653b599799d8eed-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u17404a88f60fba6de4-1.text: 1. A person who has committed an administrative offence is subject to liability under the law in force at the time the administrative offence was committed.
koap-u17404a88f60fba6de4-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u3143dfe43ab40ba5c2-1.text: 2. A law that mitigates or abolishes administrative liability for an administrative offence or otherwise improves the position of the person who committed the administrative offence has retroactive effect, that is, it also applies to a person who committed an administrative offence before that law entered into force and in respect of whom the ruling imposing an administrative penalty has not been enforced. A law that establishes or increases administrative liability for an administrative offence or otherwise worsens the person's position has no retroactive effect.
koap-u3143dfe43ab40ba5c2-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u83b73dc7d7d77f91b4-1.text: 2.1. Where provisions of a law abolishing administrative liability for an act and establishing criminal liability for the same act enter into force simultaneously, the person is subject to administrative liability under the law in force at the time the administrative offence was committed.
koap-u83b73dc7d7d77f91b4-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u1cfd8a410d61ad00ae-1.text: 3. Proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be conducted under the law in force at the time of the proceedings in that case.
koap-u1cfd8a410d61ad00ae-1.locator: Article 1.7. Operation of legislation on administrative offences in time

koap-u52a4a8bc5e8d80c04d-1.text: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences
koap-u52a4a8bc5e8d80c04d-1.locator: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences

koap-uffa1a840d4138ca14f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences
koap-uffa1a840d4138ca14f-1.locator: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u9e14e44d11d6e9e035-1.text: 1. A person who has committed an administrative offence within the territory of the Russian Federation is subject to administrative liability in accordance with this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, except in the cases provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation.
koap-u9e14e44d11d6e9e035-1.locator: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ucaff138b2b5bb3b7ae-1.text: 2. A person who has committed an administrative offence outside the Russian Federation is subject to administrative liability in accordance with this Code in the cases provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation and in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article.
koap-ucaff138b2b5bb3b7ae-1.locator: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences

koap-ua1deef765134839316-1.text: 3. A legal entity that has committed outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code, and a person who has committed outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, are subject to administrative liability in accordance with this Code where those administrative offences are directed against the interests of the Russian Federation, and in the cases provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation, provided that those persons have not been held criminally or administratively liable for the corresponding acts in a foreign state.
koap-ua1deef765134839316-1.locator: Article 1.8. Territorial operation of legislation on administrative offences

koap-u691da6c925d186504b-1.text: Chapter 2. Administrative offences and administrative liability
koap-u691da6c925d186504b-1.locator: Chapter 2. Administrative offences and administrative liability

koap-uef6c59d883d852e58f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 2. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES AND ADMINISTRATIVE LIABILITY
koap-uef6c59d883d852e58f-1.locator: Chapter 2. Administrative offences and administrative liability

koap-uc59ba5a3a7de8b7616-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.1. Administrative offence

koap-ue815670d2655689c48-1.text: 1. An administrative offence is an unlawful, culpable act (omission) of an individual or a legal entity for which administrative liability is established by this Code or by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.

koap-ub20e07bd2e9ab7d5d4-1.text: 2. A legal entity is found guilty of committing an administrative offence if it is established that it had the opportunity to comply with the rules and standards for the breach of which administrative liability is provided for by this Code or the laws of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, but that entity did not take all measures within its power to comply with them.

koap-u92e32883db95bdad62-1.text: 3. The imposition of an administrative penalty on a legal entity does not release the guilty individual from administrative liability for the offence, just as holding an individual administratively or criminally liable does not release the legal entity from administrative liability for the offence, except in the cases provided for by parts 4 and 5 of this Article.

koap-ue1665b96258ba0c8a3-1.text: 4. A legal entity is not subject to administrative liability for an administrative offence for which an official or another employee of that legal entity has been held administratively liable, or its sole executive body having the status of a legal entity has been held administratively liable, if that legal entity took all measures provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation to comply with the rules and standards for the breach of which administrative liability is provided for, except in the cases provided for by part 5 of this Article.

koap-ub48743b2f67fc98fbd-1.text: 5. If a legal entity has been given an administrative penalty for an administrative offence in the form of an administrative fine determined in accordance with point 3 or 5 of part 1 of Article 3.5 of this Code, an official or another employee of that legal entity, or its sole executive body having the status of a legal entity, is not subject to administrative liability.

koap-u0df14950d0a61d3625-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.2. Forms of fault

koap-ue507d7f65fc906384d-1.text: 1. An administrative offence is deemed to have been committed intentionally if the person who committed it was aware of the unlawful nature of their act (omission), foresaw its harmful consequences and desired those consequences, or consciously allowed them to occur, or was indifferent to them.

koap-u60461f909b6f39079e-1.text: 2. An administrative offence is deemed to have been committed through negligence if the person who committed it foresaw the possibility of harmful consequences of their act (omission), but presumptuously relied, without sufficient grounds, on preventing those consequences, or did not foresee the possibility of those consequences although they should and could have foreseen them.

koap-uce9bb1372cd745617e-1.text: Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises
koap-uce9bb1372cd745617e-1.locator: Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises

koap-ub1f61212107ffc41fc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises
koap-ub1f61212107ffc41fc-1.locator: Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises

koap-ue763d22a9fe4551295-1.text: 1. A person who has reached the age of sixteen years at the time of committing an administrative offence is subject to administrative liability.
koap-ue763d22a9fe4551295-1.locator: Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises

koap-ua14a27575545bb6386-1.text: 2. Having regard to the specific circumstances of the case and information about the person who committed an administrative offence between the ages of sixteen and eighteen years, the commission for minors' affairs and the protection of their rights may release that person from administrative liability and apply to that person a corrective measure provided for by federal legislation on the protection of the rights of minors.
koap-ua14a27575545bb6386-1.locator: Article 2.3. Age at which administrative liability arises

koap-u4af91c5f367c8dec2b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.4. Administrative liability of officials

koap-u20d62f603f49bd50bf-1.text: An official is subject to administrative liability where that official commits an administrative offence in connection with failure to perform, or improper performance of, their official duties.

koap-uc7493671c108cb7d95-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Code, an official means a person who permanently, temporarily or under special authority performs the functions of a representative of public authority, that is, is vested, in accordance with the procedure established by law, with directive powers over persons who are not subordinate to them in an official capacity, as well as a person performing organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions in state bodies, bodies of state extra-budgetary funds of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, state and municipal organisations, and also in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, other troops and military formations of the Russian Federation. Managers and other employees of other organisations and insolvency practitioners who have committed administrative offences in connection with the performance of organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions, as well as members of boards of directors (supervisory boards), collegiate executive bodies (management boards, directorates), counting commissions, audit commissions (auditors), liquidation commissions of legal entities, managers of organisations exercising the powers of the sole executive bodies of other organisations, individuals who are founders (members) of legal entities, and managers of organisations exercising the powers of the sole executive bodies of organisations that are founders of legal entities, who have committed administrative offences provided for by parts 5 - 7, 11 and 16 of Article 7.30.3, Articles 9.22, 13.25, 14.24, 14.25, 14.56, part 3 of Article 14.57, Articles 14.61, 14.63, 14.64, 15.17 - 15.22, 15.23.1, 15.24.1, 15.25, 15.26.1, 15.26.2, 15.29 - 15.31, 15.37.1, 15.38, 15.49, parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 19.5 and Articles 19.7.3 and 19.7.12 of this Code, bear administrative liability as officials. Persons performing the functions of a member of a commission for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, contract managers and employees of a contract service who have committed administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.30.1 - 7.30.3, parts 7 and 7.1 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.7.2 of this Code bear administrative liability as officials. Persons performing functions related to organising and conducting procurement in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities, including members of a procurement commission, who have committed administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.4 and part 7.2 of Article 19.5 of this Code bear administrative liability as officials. Persons performing the functions of a member of a licensing commission who have committed an administrative offence provided for by Article 19.6.2 of this Code bear administrative liability as officials. Persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity who have committed administrative offences bear administrative liability as officials unless this Code provides otherwise. Persons performing functions related to organising and conducting tendering procedures that are mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation, including members of a tender commission or an auction commission, who have committed administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.5 of this Code bear administrative liability as officials. Persons carrying out activities in the field of fire risk assessment (fire safety auditing) who have committed administrative violations provided for by part 9 of Article 20.4 of this Code bear administrative liability as officials. Persons carrying out activities involving the design of fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been commissioned, who have committed administrative offences provided for by parts 10 and 11 of Article 20.4 of this Code, bear administrative liability as officials. Individuals carrying out expert examination activities in the field of the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, who have committed an administrative offence provided for by Article 7.32.6 of this Code, bear administrative liability as officials.

koap-ub8776973147b2e12af-1.text: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks
koap-ub8776973147b2e12af-1.locator: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks

koap-uc3bbf5a735e07ce5c2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks
koap-uc3bbf5a735e07ce5c2-1.locator: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks

koap-u0dda10dedf6c4176cd-1.text: 1. For administrative offences other than those provided for by part 2 of this Article, military personnel, citizens called up for military training, and employees holding special ranks in the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, internal affairs bodies, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system, compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service and customs authorities bear disciplinary liability in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation governing their military service (service) and status.
koap-u0dda10dedf6c4176cd-1.locator: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks

koap-u66e0f7aa53afbbde28-1.text: 2. For administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.1, 5.3 - 5.26, 5.45 - 5.50, 5.52, 5.56, 6.3, 7.30.1 - 7.30.3, Chapter 8, Article 11.16 (in respect of breaches of fire safety requirements outside the place of military service (service) or military training), Chapter 12, Article 14.9, part 7 of Article 14.32, Chapters 15 and 16, Articles 17.3, 17.7 - 17.9, parts 1 and 3 of Article 17.14, Articles 17.15, 18.1 - 18.4, parts 2.1, 2.6 and 7 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.2, part 5 of Article 19.8, Article 19.12, Article 20.4 (in respect of breaches of fire safety requirements outside the place of military service (service) or military training) and part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code, the persons specified in part 1 of this Article bear administrative liability on general grounds, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article.
koap-u66e0f7aa53afbbde28-1.locator: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks

koap-u9fdde4f3232e32bc50-1.text: 3. For administrative offences provided for by part 2 of this Article consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements, assessment of compliance with which is the subject of state control (supervision) whose organisation and conduct are regulated in accordance with part 6 of Article 2 of Federal Law No. 248-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation', the persons specified in part 1 of this Article bear disciplinary liability if they committed those administrative offences at facilities subject to the corresponding types of state control (supervision) and supervised by the federal executive bodies in which those persons perform military service (service) or military training.
koap-u9fdde4f3232e32bc50-1.locator: Article 2.5. Administrative liability of military personnel, citizens called up for military training and persons holding special ranks

koap-ucbdba140a36e307282-1.text: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities
koap-ucbdba140a36e307282-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-u48bd3bb4f10aff09f0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities
koap-u48bd3bb4f10aff09f0-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-ua6e96d215cee1a4084-1.text: 1. Foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities that have committed administrative offences within the territory of the Russian Federation are subject to administrative liability on general grounds.
koap-ua6e96d215cee1a4084-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-u162459ba10ba8d205b-1.text: 2. Foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities that have committed administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 8.16, Articles 8.17 - 8.20 and 11.7.1 and part 2 of Article 19.4 of this Code on the continental shelf or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation are subject to administrative liability on general grounds.
koap-u162459ba10ba8d205b-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-u2b104c0ca8868b6550-1.text: 2.1. A foreign legal entity that has committed outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code and directed against the interests of the Russian Federation, or a foreign citizen, stateless person or foreign legal entity that has committed outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code and directed against the interests of the Russian Federation, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, is subject to administrative liability on general grounds.
koap-u2b104c0ca8868b6550-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-u40d4ebb10ceda03915-1.text: 3. The question of administrative liability of a foreign citizen who enjoys immunity from the administrative jurisdiction of the Russian Federation under federal laws and international treaties of the Russian Federation and who has committed an administrative offence within the territory of the Russian Federation shall be resolved in accordance with the rules of international law.
koap-u40d4ebb10ceda03915-1.locator: Article 2.6. Administrative liability of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign legal entities

koap-u518051e57f904da97d-1.text: Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles
koap-u518051e57f904da97d-1.locator: Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles

koap-u97b8d642b8b4efe26c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles
koap-u97b8d642b8b4efe26c-1.locator: Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles

koap-u018f653cc8ac2a7d97-1.text: 1. Owners (possessors) of vehicles shall be held administratively liable for administrative offences in the field of environmental protection and the use of natural resources (in respect of the administrative offences provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 of this Code), administrative offences in the field of road traffic, and administrative offences in the field of territorial improvement, and administrative offences consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for paying for the passage of a vehicle along toll public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, private public motor roads, toll sections of public motor roads of regional, intermunicipal and local significance, and toll sections of private public motor roads, as provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, committed with the use of vehicles, where those administrative offences are recorded by special technical devices operating in automatic mode and having photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment.
koap-u018f653cc8ac2a7d97-1.locator: Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles

koap-u4f754618ff07be7f52-1.text: 2. The owner (possessor) of a vehicle shall be released from administrative liability if, when an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued in accordance with part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code is considered, the information contained in the appeal is confirmed that, at the time the administrative offence was recorded, the vehicle was in the possession or use of another person or had by that time ceased to be in the owner's (possessor's) possession as a result of unlawful acts of other persons.
koap-u4f754618ff07be7f52-1.locator: Article 2.6.1. Administrative liability of owners (possessors) of vehicles

koap-u7b86e493dc7dcb26f5-1.text: Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property
koap-u7b86e493dc7dcb26f5-1.locator: Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property

koap-u8cd8d0bb0d5c1fba16-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property
koap-u8cd8d0bb0d5c1fba16-1.locator: Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property

koap-u8e745e835ad33e8598-1.text: 1. Owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property shall be held administratively liable for administrative offences in the field of territorial improvement provided for by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, in respect of the maintenance, operation, relocation, conversion or destruction of territorial improvement facilities, where those administrative offences are recorded by special technical devices operating in automatic mode and having photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment.
koap-u8e745e835ad33e8598-1.locator: Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property

koap-u559984fd03c8a2d131-1.text: 2. The owner or other possessor of a land plot or other immovable property shall be released from administrative liability if, when an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued in accordance with part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code is considered, the information contained in the appeal is confirmed that, at the time the administrative offence was recorded, the land plot or other immovable property was in the possession or use of another person, or that the administrative offence was committed as a result of unlawful acts of other persons and the owner or other possessor of the land plot or other immovable property had no opportunity to prevent the administrative offence or had taken all measures within their power to prevent it.
koap-u559984fd03c8a2d131-1.locator: Article 2.6.2. Administrative liability of owners or other possessors of land plots or other immovable property

koap-u743292b0194f24fb63-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.7. Extreme necessity

koap-u04f8c96f7f9756ec6c-1.text: The causing of harm by a person to interests protected by law in a state of extreme necessity does not constitute an administrative offence, that is, where the harm is caused to eliminate a danger directly threatening that person or their rights, other persons or their rights, or the interests of society or the state protected by law, if the danger could not be eliminated by other means and the harm caused is less significant than the harm prevented.

koap-u0e16cbf473c5319c34-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.8. Mental incapacity

koap-uc5a1e5c75c69f0191d-1.text: An individual who, at the time of committing unlawful acts (omissions), was in a state of mental incapacity, that is, was unable to understand the factual nature and unlawfulness of their acts (omissions) or to control them because of a chronic mental disorder, a temporary mental disorder, dementia or another pathological mental condition, is not subject to administrative liability.

koap-u939e88855e8e08ca63-1.text: Article 2.9. Possibility of release from administrative liability where an administrative offence is of minor significance
koap-u939e88855e8e08ca63-1.locator: Article 2.9. Possibility of release from administrative liability where an administrative offence is of minor significance

koap-u340c85af9fe91f617c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.9. Possibility of release from administrative liability where an administrative offence is of minor significance
koap-u340c85af9fe91f617c-1.locator: Article 2.9. Possibility of release from administrative liability where an administrative offence is of minor significance

koap-u76edf30dadba02bebb-1.text: Where an administrative offence committed is of minor significance, the judge, body or official authorised to decide the administrative offence case may release the person who committed it from administrative liability and limit the response to an oral admonition.
koap-u76edf30dadba02bebb-1.locator: Article 2.9. Possibility of release from administrative liability where an administrative offence is of minor significance

koap-u7e4f5c803a789096e8-1.text: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
koap-u7e4f5c803a789096e8-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-u53bdad17595fb9ec18-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted
koap-u53bdad17595fb9ec18-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-ue1f7c7dbc04b6a12ca-1.text: 1. A person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements, assessment of compliance with which is the subject of state control (supervision) or municipal control in accordance with Federal Law No. 248-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation', or a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with requirements, assessment of compliance with which is carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 85-FZ of 9 April 2026 'On the Organisation of Control and Supervisory Activities in Respect of Local Self-Government Bodies and Local Self-Government Officials and on Amendments to the Federal Law "On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Unified System of Public Authority"', shall be released from administrative liability if that person fulfils an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body that imposes on that person an obligation to remedy their violations of legislative requirements (hereinafter in this Article referred to as the agreement).
koap-ue1f7c7dbc04b6a12ca-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-u8fcb577d5950294253-1.text: 2. The provisions of part 1 of this Article apply only to agreements for which the grounds and procedure for conclusion and for recognition as fulfilled or unfulfilled are provided for by Federal Law No. 248-FZ of 31 July 2020 'On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation' or Federal Law No. 85-FZ of 9 April 2026 'On the Organisation of Control and Supervisory Activities in Respect of Local Self-Government Bodies and Local Self-Government Officials and on Amendments to the Federal Law "On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Unified System of Public Authority"' and by Resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with those laws.
koap-u8fcb577d5950294253-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-u20633a1ee333472161-1.text: 3. The provisions of part 1 of this Article do not apply where an application to conclude an agreement is submitted after the day on which the administrative offence case materials are forwarded to the judge, body or official authorised to hear the administrative offence case, or where an analogous administrative offence is committed by a person who previously failed to fulfil an agreement, or by a person whose agreement was previously terminated before the expiry of the period for its fulfilment because that person failed to comply with its terms, including in respect of implementing a programme to remedy identified violations of mandatory requirements.
koap-u20633a1ee333472161-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-u88ef217205f5bb0ddd-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, an analogous administrative offence is an administrative offence provided for by the same part of the same article (the same article) of this Code as the administrative offence consisting in failure to fulfil (improper fulfilment of) the same mandatory requirement (obligation) the breach of which constituted the grounds for concluding the agreement.
koap-u88ef217205f5bb0ddd-1.locator: Article 2.9.1. Release from administrative liability subject to fulfilment of an agreement concluded with a control (supervisory) body by a person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted

koap-ue536e62b10479a0746-1.text: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
koap-ue536e62b10479a0746-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u315bcb0469459afecc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities
koap-u315bcb0469459afecc-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-uf30151beee5994814d-1.text: 1. Legal entities are subject to administrative liability for administrative offences in the cases provided for by the articles of Section II of this Code or by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
koap-uf30151beee5994814d-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u303815e01eea61d3ab-1.text: 2. Where the articles of Sections I, III, IV and V of this Code do not specify that the rules established by those articles apply only to an individual or only to a legal entity, those rules apply equally to individuals and legal entities, except where, by their meaning, those rules relate to and can be applied only to an individual.
koap-u303815e01eea61d3ab-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u0117fcf57cdec7c73b-1.text: 3. Where several legal entities merge, the newly formed legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
koap-u0117fcf57cdec7c73b-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u90b2c707ab0817ee29-1.text: 4. Where a legal entity is absorbed into another legal entity, the absorbing legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
koap-u90b2c707ab0817ee29-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-uffd2e5ede980675e65-1.text: 5. Where a legal entity is divided, or one or more legal entities are separated from a legal entity, administrative liability for an administrative offence shall be imposed on the legal entity to which, under the separation balance sheet, the rights and obligations relating to concluded transactions or property in connection with which the administrative offence was committed have passed.
koap-uffd2e5ede980675e65-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u690da693a830575ac7-1.text: 6. Where a legal entity of one type is converted into a legal entity of another type, the newly formed legal entity shall be held administratively liable for an administrative offence.
koap-u690da693a830575ac7-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-ua714d0aa733ae912e6-1.text: 7. In the cases specified in parts 3 - 6 of this Article, administrative liability for an administrative offence arises irrespective of whether the legal entity being held administratively liable knew of the administrative offence before completion of the reorganisation.
koap-ua714d0aa733ae912e6-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u10daa4520bdcb2c81f-1.text: 8. Administrative penalties imposed on a legal entity for an administrative offence before completion of its reorganisation in accordance with points 2 - 4 of part 1 of Article 3.2 of this Code shall be applied subject to the provisions of parts 3 - 6 of this Article.
koap-u10daa4520bdcb2c81f-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-ubf806fae05f1b4db3a-1.text: 9. Where an administrative offence is committed by the sole executive body of a legal entity and that body itself has the status of a legal entity, an administrative penalty shall be imposed on it within the sanction prescribed for legal entities.
koap-ubf806fae05f1b4db3a-1.locator: Article 2.10. Administrative liability of legal entities

koap-u32f796c8e836b35738-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 3. ADMINISTRATIVE PENALTIES

koap-u5495004a0c2e6cd164-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.1. Purposes of administrative penalties

koap-u37a3cbecc073ee1b32-1.text: 1. An administrative penalty is a measure of liability established by the state for the commission of an administrative offence and is applied to prevent the commission of further offences both by the offender and by other persons.

koap-ue5c1710e399f577a68-1.text: 2. An administrative penalty may not have as its purpose the degradation of the human dignity of an individual who has committed an administrative offence, the infliction of physical suffering on that individual, or harm to the business reputation of a legal entity.

koap-u26efd277978049b6de-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.2. Types of administrative penalties

koap-u149e708407d1807c76-1.text: 1. The following administrative penalties may be established and applied for the commission of administrative offences:

koap-uf01ac18699e1e3bdc4-1.text: 4) confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence;

koap-u4581a60ed6ebf26c9d-1.text: 5) deprivation of a special right granted to an individual;

koap-ub213ebc092ba2e6b9f-1.text: 7) administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation;

koap-u10776b502069aea564-1.text: 11) an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held.

koap-u7b5f223455d929f60f-1.text: 2. The administrative penalties listed in points 1 - 4 and 9 of part 1 of this Article may be applied to a legal entity.

koap-u233856bcc4e00b3db1-1.text: 3. The administrative penalties listed in points 3 - 11 of part 1 of this Article are established exclusively by this Code.

koap-u974bc099b0b78f6f57-1.text: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
koap-u974bc099b0b78f6f57-1.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties

koap-u1026ae16eaa5094877-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties
koap-u1026ae16eaa5094877-1.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties

koap-u0c56d4ce81f6fb4c50-1.text: 1. A warning, an administrative fine, deprivation of a special right granted to an individual other than the right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type, administrative arrest, disqualification, administrative suspension of activities and compulsory work may be established and applied only as principal administrative penalties.
koap-u0c56d4ce81f6fb4c50-1.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties

koap-u7a881097900eca495d-1.text: 2. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence, deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type, administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, and an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held may be established and applied as either principal or additional administrative penalties. Deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type is applied as an additional administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 11.7.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.8, part 1 of Article 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code.
koap-u7a881097900eca495d-1.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties

koap-u2fb89e7061419ab10d-1.text: 3. For one administrative offence, a principal administrative penalty, or a principal and an additional administrative penalty, may be imposed from among the penalties specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative liability. If the sanction of the applicable article requires the imposition of both a principal and an additional administrative penalty, but one of them cannot be imposed on the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted, only the administrative penalty that can be imposed on that person shall be imposed.
koap-u2fb89e7061419ab10d-1.locator: Article 3.3. Principal and additional administrative penalties

koap-u5bf9c81ca30e23fddd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.4. Warning

koap-u60246bcc0988748dfd-1.text: 1. A warning is an administrative penalty expressed in the official censure of an individual or a legal entity. A warning shall be issued in writing.

koap-ud2ef9570b805bf7a86-1.text: 2. A warning is established for administrative offences committed for the first time where there is no harm, or threat of harm, to human life and health, fauna and flora, the environment, cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or state security, no threat of natural or man-made emergencies, and no property damage.

koap-ua94a0437f28a976761-1.text: 3. Where the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for the imposition of an administrative penalty in the form of a warning, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be replaced with a warning in accordance with Article 4.1.1 of this Code.
