koap-u9376ce5faca873efa9-1.text: 3) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, or the amount of the offender's expenditure on acquiring the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of the goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year;

koap-u7459c5cd4e0da3e8f1-1.text: 3.1) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year;

koap-u888f825c3901702b8f-1.text: 3.2) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of fuel for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale of fuel in the preceding calendar year;

koap-u77ae74fca1de80da41-1.text: 3.3) the amount of the offender's proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at a coal mine for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not extract coal (oil shale) at that coal mine in the preceding calendar year;

koap-uc0ef7e622c9c1d5997-1.text: 4) the amount of the offender's proceeds obtained from the sale of goods (works, services) as a result of unlawfully inflating state-regulated prices (tariffs, charges, rates and the like) over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year;

koap-uaa7c6eb20df389eedd-1.text: 5) the initial (maximum) price of a civil-law agreement for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services (including the acquisition of immovable property or the lease of property) concluded on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a municipal formation, or by a budgetary institution or another legal entity in accordance with parts 1 and 4 - 6 of Article 15 of Federal Law No. 44-FZ of 5 April 2013 'On the Contract System for the Procurement of Goods, Works and Services to Meet State and Municipal Needs' (hereinafter referred to as a contract), or the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider);

koap-uc4cc82e7f89d0841f5-1.text: 6) the amount of excess income or the amount of losses that a person avoided as a result of the unlawful use of inside information and (or) market manipulation;

koap-u380cfcae8fb51230ac-1.text: 7) the undeclared amount of cash and (or) the value of monetary instruments;

koap-ucdf81334a5b44d2562-1.text: 8) the amount of funds received from a budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation and used for purposes other than those designated, or the amount of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of the fee for the use of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of a budget loan received, or the amount of a budget investment received, or the amount of a subsidy received, or the amount of funds to be credited to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of funds involved in unlawfully conducted transactions;

koap-u41b11bbd74801ebcc2-1.text: 9) the difference between the amount of the administrative fine that would have been imposed for the administrative offence had accurate details (information) necessary to calculate the administrative fine been provided and the amount of the administrative fine imposed;

koap-u1440676c63ef1b3114-1.text: 10) the cadastral value of a land plot;

koap-u8a13e5f836106d1215-1.text: 11) the value of unperformed obligations provided for by a contract for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services;

koap-uce2b9f512195bb2043-1.text: 12) the price of a transaction concluded by a state (municipal) unitary enterprise or a state (municipal) institution;

koap-u1eb4641bf56c2f51b3-1.text: 13) the amount of funds received by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher, information about the receipt of which must be provided in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the mass media;

koap-ua6ccfa9ff90ca3fe9f-1.text: 14) the amount of a previously imposed administrative fine;

koap-uf857db1d7526e69a29-1.text: 15) the amount of the environmental levy;

koap-uacea394739b1ae3a3e-1.text: 16) the amount of a payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited;

koap-u091664114c9e1a3b8b-1.text: 17) the amount of a credit institution's own funds (capital);

koap-u112a6601e66399956f-1.text: 18) the amount of funds subject to blocking or unblocking in the bank account of a participant in procurement or a participant in mandatory tendering procedures;

koap-ueb822773d9084b11da-1.text: 19) the amount of funds deposited as security for an application or as security for performance of a contract;

koap-u33d9e63f60dc89a780-1.text: 20) the price of a state (municipal) contract, an agreement (arrangement), or a contract (agreement);

koap-u808cb446d6bccb0ac0-1.text: 21) the product of the amount of the administrative fine and the number of units of goods sold whose shelf life has expired.

koap-uadb21ea107e3ac1ce0-1.text: 2. The amount of an administrative fine may not be less than one hundred roubles, or, for an administrative offence in the field of road traffic, less than five hundred roubles, except in the case provided for by part 1.3 of Article 32.2 of this Code.

koap-ude6b44fc3f39e8527f-1.text: 3. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the value of the object of the administrative offence, or on the basis of the amount of unpaid taxes, levies or customs duties, or the amount of an unlawful foreign exchange transaction, or the amount of funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, or the amount of funds credited during the reporting period to an electronic means of payment provided by a foreign payment service provider, or the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed period to accounts with authorised banks, or the amount of funds calculated as a multiple of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, or the amount of funds not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed period, or the amount of funds due to a resident from a non-resident, or the amount of funds, the value of securities or other property, or the value of services of a proprietary nature unlawfully transferred or provided on behalf of a legal entity, or the amount of funds received from a budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation and used for purposes other than those designated, or the amount of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of the fee for the use of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of a budget loan received, or the amount of a budget investment received, or the amount of a subsidy received, or the amount of funds to be credited to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of funds involved in unlawfully conducted transactions, or the undeclared amount of cash and (or) the value of monetary instruments, or the amount of a settlement made without the use of cash register equipment, or the amount of the environmental levy, may not exceed three times the value of the object of the administrative offence or the corresponding amount or value; in the cases provided for by Articles 7.27 and 7.27.1 of this Code, it may not exceed five times the value of the stolen property; in the cases provided for by parts 1 - 2 of Article 14.4.3, part 2 of Article 14.10, parts 1 and 2 of Article 15.44 and part 1 of Article 15.45 of this Code, it may not exceed five times the value of the object of the administrative offence; in the case provided for by Article 14.15.2 of this Code, it may not exceed, for citizens, twenty-five times the value of the admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, or the value of an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match specified in the document entitling its holder to obtain an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, and, for officials, thirty times the value of the admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, or the value of an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match specified in the document entitling its holder to obtain an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence; in the cases provided for by Articles 7.1 and 8.8 of this Code, it may not exceed one hundred thousand roubles for citizens, three hundred thousand roubles for officials and seven hundred thousand roubles for legal entities; and, in the case provided for by Article 19.28 of this Code, one hundred times the amount of funds or the value of securities, other property, services of a proprietary nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of a legal entity.

koap-u6ccfb650ff5dd61057-1.text: 4. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, or on the basis of the offender's expenditure on acquiring the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, may not exceed one twenty-fifth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year.

koap-u365af2920cf351476b-1.text: 4.1. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds obtained from the sale of goods (works, services) as a result of unlawfully inflating state-regulated prices (tariffs, charges, rates and the like) may not exceed twice the excess proceeds obtained over the entire period of regulation during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year.

koap-u0934e75512066be18b-1.text: 4.2. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the difference between the amount of the administrative fine that would have been imposed for the administrative offence had accurate details (information) necessary to calculate the administrative fine been provided and the amount of the administrative fine imposed may not exceed ten times the amount of the administrative fine imposed.

koap-ub53bed287900d77e81-1.text: 4.3. The amount of an administrative fine calculated as a multiple of the amount of a previously imposed administrative fine may not exceed twice the amount of the administrative fine imposed.

koap-uac10e91c9f0406fecb-1.text: 4.4. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) may not exceed one fifth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year preceding the date of detection of the administrative offence, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year.

koap-u7da7fddd50abce8dfe-1.text: 4.5. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of fuel may not exceed 3 percent of the proceeds from the sale of fuel for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale of fuel in the preceding calendar year.

koap-uf019e17f878b4524d1-1.text: 4.6. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the amount of a payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited may not exceed 40 percent of the amount of the payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited.

koap-uf906cbb5256572edbb-1.text: 4.7. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at a coal mine may not exceed one tenth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at that coal mine for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not extract coal (oil shale) at that coal mine in the preceding calendar year.

koap-u6785620d515404ddc2-1.text: 4.8. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the amount of a credit institution's own funds (capital) may not exceed 3 percent of the amount of that credit institution's own funds (capital).

koap-uf247471d94cf0a826e-1.text: 5. The amount of an administrative fine shall be credited to the budget in full in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.

koap-u832ddb3fc31ab6380f-1.text: 6. An administrative fine may not be applied to sergeants, petty officers, soldiers and sailors performing military service by conscription, or to cadets of military vocational educational organisations and military higher educational organisations before a contract for military service has been concluded with them.

koap-uc9b4086467a8d7a9d7-1.text: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
koap-uc9b4086467a8d7a9d7-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u47cb74849cc9975a7b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
koap-u47cb74849cc9975a7b-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-ucb06d16e416cb7a900-1.text: 1. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence means the compulsory transfer, without compensation, of things not withdrawn from circulation into federal ownership or into the ownership of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Confiscation shall be imposed by a judge.
koap-ucb06d16e416cb7a900-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u144df13692d82b72a2-1.text: 2. Confiscation of hunting weapons, ammunition and other permitted hunting or fishing implements may not be applied to persons for whom hunting or fishing is the principal lawful source of their livelihood.
koap-u144df13692d82b72a2-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-ua585684a8bd682f522-1.text: 3. The seizure from the unlawful possession of a person who has committed an administrative offence of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, the administrative offence does not constitute confiscation where those items:
koap-ua585684a8bd682f522-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u72b8a1eab1e8b7a18c-1.text: are subject to return to their lawful owner in accordance with federal law;
koap-u72b8a1eab1e8b7a18c-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-uc4c13db46caeca2fa8-1.text: have been withdrawn from circulation or were unlawfully possessed by the person who committed the administrative offence for other reasons, and on that ground are subject to transfer into state ownership or destruction.
koap-uc4c13db46caeca2fa8-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u1ccf613265d1e17f89-1.text: 4. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence owned by a person who has not been held administratively liable for that administrative offence and has not been found guilty of committing it by a court shall not be applied, except for administrative offences in the field of customs affairs (violations of customs rules) provided for by Chapter 16 of this Code.
koap-u1ccf613265d1e17f89-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u38e2c1162044368f94-1.text: 4.1. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by part 1, 2, 2.1, 3, 4, 4.1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 10.1, 10.2, 11 or 12 of Article 13.15, part 4 of Article 19.34 or Article 20.29 of this Code and that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.
koap-u38e2c1162044368f94-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u51660c5e0402855b3f-1.text: 5. If property obtained as a result of an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.3 of this Code has been combined with lawfully acquired property, the portion of the property corresponding to the value of the property so combined shall be subject to confiscation.
koap-u51660c5e0402855b3f-1.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence

koap-u2dfa7016e45d1e5011-1.text: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
koap-u2dfa7016e45d1e5011-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-u08ee0774a35cb65228-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
koap-u08ee0774a35cb65228-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-u89bc3c8869a7262a77-1.text: 1. Deprivation of a previously granted special right of an individual who has committed an administrative offence is established for a gross or systematic breach of the rules governing the exercise of that right in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code. Deprivation of a previously granted special right of an individual is also established for evasion of the enforcement of another administrative penalty imposed for a breach of the rules governing the exercise of that right, in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code, and for breach of a temporary restriction on the exercise of a special right imposed in accordance with legislation on enforcement proceedings. Deprivation of a special right shall be imposed by a judge.
koap-u89bc3c8869a7262a77-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-u1191ff5f254f962365-1.text: 2. The period of deprivation of a special right may not be less than one month or more than three years.
koap-u1191ff5f254f962365-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-ud6fe5fe6cc05949e6e-1.text: 3. Deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle may not be applied to a person who uses a vehicle in connection with a disability, except where administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.8, part 7 of Article 12.9, part 3 of Article 12.10, part 5 of Article 12.15, part 3.1 of Article 12.16, Article 12.24, part 1 of Article 12.26 and parts 2 and 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code have been committed.
koap-ud6fe5fe6cc05949e6e-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-u44d1b8b8d66f6cdd17-1.text: 4. Deprivation of the special right to hunt may not be applied to persons for whom hunting is the principal lawful source of their livelihood, except in the cases provided for by part 1.2 of Article 8.37 of this Code.
koap-u44d1b8b8d66f6cdd17-1.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right

koap-u6762ab1f8b78d56b9a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.9. Administrative arrest

koap-u7f10555d66db5022a3-1.text: 1. Administrative arrest consists in holding an offender in isolation from society and is established for a period of up to fifteen days, or up to thirty days for a violation of the established procedure for organising or holding an assembly, rally, demonstration, procession or picketing, or for organising the simultaneous mass presence or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order, for a violation of the requirements of a state of emergency, martial law or the legal regime of a counter-terrorist operation, or for the commission of administrative offences under legislation on narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors. Administrative arrest shall be imposed by a judge.

koap-u5c9f75d5c7664c3b9e-1.text: 2. Administrative arrest is established and imposed only in exceptional cases for particular types of administrative offences and may not be applied to pregnant women; women with children under the age of fourteen and (or) children with disabilities, or women who are adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; men who are single parents with children under the age of fourteen and (or) children with disabilities, or who are the sole adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; persons under the age of eighteen; persons with disabilities of groups I and II; military personnel; citizens called up for military training; or employees holding special ranks in the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, internal affairs bodies, bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system, compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service and customs authorities. Administrative arrest shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.48, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, if that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.

koap-u81bb9e2c688871352b-1.text: 3. The period of administrative detention shall count towards the period of administrative arrest.

koap-ue3b7f507c777b98e60-1.text: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
koap-ue3b7f507c777b98e60-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-u56f5b12f741765c0a6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
koap-u56f5b12f741765c0a6-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-u87f64e757eddb61d5a-1.text: 1. Administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation consists in the compulsory and supervised movement of those citizens and persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation to a place outside the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation), or, in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, in the supervised independent departure of foreign citizens and stateless persons from the Russian Federation.
koap-u87f64e757eddb61d5a-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-u57999e87497ed4d035-1.text: 2. Administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation as an administrative penalty is established in respect of foreign citizens or stateless persons and shall be imposed by a judge or by a body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code.
koap-u57999e87497ed4d035-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-uf969625427b24b33a7-1.text: 3. Administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation may not be applied to military personnel who are foreign citizens or stateless persons.
koap-uf969625427b24b33a7-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-ucdf6e878b3875b55cc-1.text: 4. When imposing an administrative penalty in the form of administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code shall decide on that person's compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation or supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation, taking into account the length of that foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying taxes provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for admission to citizenship of the Russian Federation and other circumstances.
koap-ucdf6e878b3875b55cc-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-u712d828a6c746a5513-1.text: 5. For the purpose of enforcing an administrative penalty imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person in the form of compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code may place such persons in a special institution provided for by Federal Law No. 115-FZ of 25 July 2002 'On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation'.
koap-u712d828a6c746a5513-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-ud2c3cfade816c35212-1.text: 6. An administrative penalty in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation may be imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person where administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation is carried out at the expense of that foreign citizen or stateless person, or at the expense of the inviting body, the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the foreign state of which the expelled foreign citizen is a citizen, an international organisation or its representative office, or an individual or legal entity specified in Article 16 of Federal Law No. 115-FZ of 25 July 2002 'On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation'.
koap-ud2c3cfade816c35212-1.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation

koap-u54329f24bc5f3b200a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.11. Disqualification

koap-u480268154dda859757-1.text: 1. Disqualification consists in depriving an individual of the right to hold positions in the federal state civil service, positions in the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or positions in the municipal service; to hold positions in the executive management body of a legal entity; to serve on a board of directors (supervisory board); to carry on business activities involving the management of a legal entity; to manage a legal entity in other cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation; or to carry out activities involving the provision of state and municipal services (assistance in exercising certain powers in the provision of such services), activities in the field of training athletes (including their medical care) and organising and holding sporting events, activities in the field of industrial safety expert examinations, activities in the field of vehicle technical inspections, activities in the field of independent fire risk assessment (fire safety auditing), activities involving the design of fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been commissioned, expert examination activities in the field of the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, medical or pharmaceutical activities, or activities in the field of managing apartment buildings. An administrative penalty in the form of disqualification shall be imposed by a judge.

koap-udb7ac8ee705abb847a-1.text: 2. Disqualification is established for a period of six months to three years.

koap-u0d609dd1799f1fabf2-1.text: 3. Disqualification may be applied to persons holding positions in the federal state civil service, positions in the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or positions in the municipal service; persons performing organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions in a body of a legal entity; members of a board of directors (supervisory board); persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity; persons engaged in private practice; persons employed by multifunctional centres for the provision of state and municipal services (hereinafter referred to as a multifunctional centre), by other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, or by a public-law company providing state services in the field of state cadastral registration and state registration of rights; or employees of a federal state unitary enterprise authorised by and subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, or of an organisation authorised by the federal city of Moscow, which, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, assist in exercising certain powers in providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration (hereinafter referred to as a subordinate enterprise or authorised organisation); or coaches, sports medicine specialists or other specialists in the field of physical culture and sport holding positions included in a list approved in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation; or experts in the field of industrial safety; or experts in the field of fire risk assessment; or persons carrying out activities involving the design of fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been commissioned; or persons carrying out expert examination activities in the field of the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs; medical workers; pharmaceutical workers; or persons carrying out activities in the field of managing apartment buildings; or technical experts in the field of vehicle technical inspections.

koap-u2738a9005be1f3bd37-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities

koap-u98025466332bd0b379-1.text: 1. Administrative suspension of activities consists in the temporary cessation of the activities of persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity, legal entities, their branches, representative offices, structural divisions and production sites, and of the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular types of activities (works), or the provision of services. Administrative suspension of activities is applied where there is a threat to human life or health, an epidemic, an epizootic, infestation (contamination) of regulated articles with quarantine pests, a radiation accident or a man-made disaster, significant harm to the condition or quality of the environment, or where an administrative offence is committed in the field of the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors; in the field of combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, financing of terrorism and extremist activities, and financing of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction; in the field of investment activities (in respect of the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.56.1 of this Code); in the field of restrictions on carrying out particular types of activities imposed under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations; in the field of rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment; in the field of administrative order; in the field of public order and public safety; in the field of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products; in the field of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for the production of such products; in the field of the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids; in the field of urban development; in the field of transport security; in the field of the protection of property; in the field of the provision of consumer credits (loans), including those under which the borrower's obligations are secured by a mortgage; in the field of the use of cash register equipment; in the field of the sale of admission tickets to UEFA 2020 European Football Championship matches or documents entitling their holders to obtain admission tickets to UEFA 2020 European Football Championship matches; or where an administrative offence is committed that infringes upon health, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population and public morals.

koap-u69f91732e0b746e71c-1.text: Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed only in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code if a less severe type of administrative penalty cannot ensure that the purpose of the administrative penalty is achieved.

koap-u498570f9584e29b31a-1.text: Administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed by a judge. For administrative offences provided for by part 3 (in respect of a gross violation of industrial safety requirements) and part 3.1 of Article 9.1 of this Code, administrative suspension of activities shall be imposed by the officials specified in points 1 and 4 of part 2 of Article 23.31 of this Code.

koap-u2524ea6c63bc019892-1.text: 2. Administrative suspension of activities is established for a period of up to ninety days. The period of administrative suspension of activities shall run from the moment of the actual suspension of the activities of persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity, legal entities, their branches, representative offices, structural divisions and production sites, and of the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular types of activities (works), or the provision of services.

koap-u93e7ec9422f2934788-1.text: 3. The judge, body or official that imposed an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activities shall, on the application of the person carrying on business without forming a legal entity or of the legal entity, terminate enforcement of that administrative penalty early if it is established that the circumstances specified in part 1 of this Article that constituted the grounds for imposing that administrative penalty have been eliminated.

koap-udb7d9b20c316e26f00-1.text: 4. Administrative suspension of activities shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by part 5 of Article 13.15, part 2 of Article 13.48 or Article 20.29 of this Code and that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.

koap-u0a9cf9d33841dab8dd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.13. Compulsory work

koap-u5d25c3ddcad9ec5b44-1.text: 1. Compulsory work consists in the performance by an individual who has committed an administrative offence of unpaid work for the public benefit during time free from their main employment, service or studies. Compulsory work shall be imposed by a judge.

koap-uf467b28e09c93e8e0f-1.text: 2. Compulsory work is established for a period of twenty to two hundred hours and shall be performed for no more than four hours a day. The maximum daily duration of compulsory work may be increased to eight hours in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 10 of Article 32.13 of this Code.

koap-uda220908f74ef65a89-1.text: 3. Compulsory work shall not be applied to pregnant women; women with children under the age of three and (or) children with disabilities, or women who are adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; men who are single parents with children under the age of three and (or) children with disabilities, or who are the sole adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; persons with disabilities of groups I and II; military personnel; citizens called up for military training; or employees holding special ranks in the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, internal affairs bodies, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system, compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service and customs authorities. Compulsory work shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 20.3.1 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, if that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.

koap-u36f9a0ae549f832492-1.text: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
koap-u36f9a0ae549f832492-1.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held

koap-u6032ee3e94aacc077d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held
koap-u6032ee3e94aacc077d-1.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held

koap-u307525fee22cbbccc7-1.text: 1. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held consists in a temporary prohibition on a citizen attending those venues on the days of official sporting competitions and is established for a violation of spectator conduct rules during official sporting competitions. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held shall be imposed by a judge.
koap-u307525fee22cbbccc7-1.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held

koap-ud4bad4b3ee43b6deed-1.text: 2. An administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held is established for a period of six months to seven years.
koap-ud4bad4b3ee43b6deed-1.locator: Article 3.14. Administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held

koap-uf5c253d4f903468482-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 4. IMPOSITION OF ADMINISTRATIVE PENALTIES

koap-u55bcf98b3eeb1650f8-1.text: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
koap-u55bcf98b3eeb1650f8-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u0e6c0d84de3e69c243-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties
koap-u0e6c0d84de3e69c243-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u8c36e7a93b49918b3f-1.text: 1. An administrative penalty for an administrative offence shall be imposed within the limits established by the law providing for liability for that administrative offence, in accordance with this Code.
koap-u8c36e7a93b49918b3f-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-ucc3526244730813837-1.text: 2. When an administrative penalty is imposed on an individual, account shall be taken of the nature of the administrative offence committed, the offender's personal characteristics and financial circumstances, circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability.
koap-ucc3526244730813837-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-ua1e5024a0e452952c6-1.text: 2.1. When imposing an administrative penalty for administrative offences under legislation on narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors on a person recognised as suffering from drug addiction or consuming narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances, the judge may oblige that person to undergo diagnostic procedures, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and (or) medical and (or) social rehabilitation in connection with the consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances. Compliance with that obligation shall be monitored by authorised federal executive bodies in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-ua1e5024a0e452952c6-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-uf87980a88aecc9edcd-1.text: 2.2. Where exceptional circumstances exist relating to the nature and consequences of the administrative offence committed and the personal characteristics and financial circumstances of the individual being held administratively liable, the judge, body or official hearing administrative offence cases or appeals or protests against rulings and (or) decisions in administrative offence cases may impose an administrative fine below the minimum amount provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code, if the minimum administrative fine is at least ten thousand roubles for citizens or at least fifty thousand roubles for officials, or below the minimum administrative fine provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, if the minimum administrative fine is at least four thousand roubles for citizens or at least forty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-uf87980a88aecc9edcd-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-uf82c83dbb8601581d6-1.text: 2.3. When an administrative penalty is imposed in accordance with part 2.2 of this Article, the administrative fine may not be less than half the minimum administrative fine provided for citizens or officials by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
koap-uf82c83dbb8601581d6-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u37a62a586af99558f5-1.text: 3. When an administrative penalty is imposed on a legal entity, account shall be taken of the nature of the administrative offence committed, the legal entity's property and financial position, circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability.
koap-u37a62a586af99558f5-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u580ad38e88ab7ac831-1.text: 3.1. In the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, the administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine. The fine imposed must be the lowest amount within the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code; where the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code provides for an administrative penalty in the form of deprivation of the right to operate vehicles or administrative arrest and does not provide for an administrative fine, the administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of five thousand roubles.
koap-u580ad38e88ab7ac831-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u85ed27af9184463048-1.text: 3.2. Where exceptional circumstances exist relating to the nature and consequences of the administrative offence committed and the property and financial position of the legal entity being held administratively liable, the judge, body or official hearing administrative offence cases or appeals or protests against rulings and (or) decisions in administrative offence cases may impose an administrative fine below the minimum amount provided for by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, if the minimum administrative fine for legal entities is at least one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u85ed27af9184463048-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-uf5a8e9367a90fc07aa-1.text: 3.3. When an administrative penalty is imposed in accordance with part 3.2 of this Article, the administrative fine may not be less than half the minimum administrative fine provided for legal entities by the relevant article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or by the relevant article or part of an article of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
koap-uf5a8e9367a90fc07aa-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u2c9070a079c7330420-1.text: 3.4. In the cases provided for by part 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be imposed in an amount equal to one third of the minimum administrative fine provided for by parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code.
koap-u2c9070a079c7330420-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u178479b8e8c7645dba-1.text: 3.4-1. When an administrative fine is imposed for an administrative offence detected in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, if the administrative fine prescribed by the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences has lower and upper limits, and the circumstances provided for by points 5 and 6 of part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code exist, the administrative fine shall be imposed at the minimum amount established for the corresponding administrative offence, except in the cases provided for by parts 2.2 and 3.2 of this Article and Article 4.1.1 of this Code.
koap-u178479b8e8c7645dba-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u986f1aa38faad50d54-1.text: 3.4-2. For administrative offences provided for by parts 15 and 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine shall be imposed in an amount equal to one tenth of the minimum administrative fine provided for the corresponding administrative offence, but no less than fifteen million roubles and no more than fifty million roubles, if the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted meets all of the following conditions before the ruling imposing the administrative fine is issued:
koap-u986f1aa38faad50d54-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u82653ef8a754ffe02a-1.text: 1) during the three calendar years preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, the operator's annual expenditure on information security measures carried out by organisations holding a licence provided for by point 1 or 5 of part 1 of Article 12 of Federal Law No. 99-FZ of 4 May 2011 'On the Licensing of Certain Types of Activities', or carried out independently provided that the operator holds such a licence, amounted to at least one tenth of a percent of the annual aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) or of the amount of the credit institution's own funds (capital);
koap-u82653ef8a754ffe02a-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u5d14217d40163bd3ce-1.text: 2) the operator complied with the requirements for the protection of personal data when processing them in personal data information systems, provided that this fact was documented within the twelve months preceding detection of the administrative offence;
koap-u5d14217d40163bd3ce-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-ub700d7906e2bf292d3-1.text: 3) the circumstances aggravating administrative liability provided for by note 5 to Article 13.11 of this Code were absent.
koap-ub700d7906e2bf292d3-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u01a8d6db65b3f5fcb4-1.text: 3.5. An administrative penalty in the form of a warning shall be imposed, where it is provided for by the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences, for administrative offences committed for the first time where there is no harm, or threat of harm, to human life and health, fauna and flora, the environment, cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or state security, no threat of natural or man-made emergencies, and no property damage.
koap-u01a8d6db65b3f5fcb4-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u8f63400ecbfd3c1c30-1.text: 3.6. If, when imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code (except in the cases provided for by part 3.9 of this Article), the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code, taking into account the length of the foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying Russian taxes, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for Russian citizenship and other circumstances, concludes that administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation would constitute an excessive restriction of the right to respect for private life and would be disproportionate to the purposes of the administrative penalty, an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions on the days when they are held for a period of one year to seven years.
koap-u8f63400ecbfd3c1c30-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-uc92a33ffa3835b69bb-1.text: 3.7. For an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code, an administrative penalty in the form of administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation may be imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person if that administrative offence was committed during official international sporting competitions.
koap-uc92a33ffa3835b69bb-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u475e6188feaf45e5ec-1.text: 3.8. If, when imposing an administrative penalty in a case where the sanction of the applicable article requires the imposition of administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation (except in the cases provided for by parts 3.6, 3.7 and 3.9 of this Article and for administrative offences provided for by parts 5 - 8 of Article 6.21, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.1, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.2 and part 3 of Article 20.25 of this Code), the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code, acting within the powers provided for by this Code and taking into account the length of the foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying taxes provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for admission to citizenship of the Russian Federation and other circumstances, concludes that administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation would constitute an excessive restriction of the right to respect for private life and would be disproportionate to the purposes of the administrative penalty, or if there is no state willing to admit a stateless person to its territory, an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or compulsory work for a period of one hundred and fifty to two hundred hours.
koap-u475e6188feaf45e5ec-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u8f759762de9b513e56-1.text: 3.9. If, when imposing an administrative penalty in a case where the sanction of the applicable article of this Code provides for administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, it is established that the foreign citizen or stateless person served under contract in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or military formations of the Russian Federation and participated in combat operations as a member of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or military formations of the Russian Federation, administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation shall not be applied, and an administrative penalty shall be imposed in the form of an administrative fine within the sanction of the applicable article or part of an article of Section II of this Code or compulsory work for a period of one hundred to two hundred hours. When imposing an administrative penalty on persons specified in this part for an administrative offence provided for by part 4 or 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code, an administrative prohibition on attending the venues of official sporting competitions for a period of one year to seven years may also be imposed on those persons.
koap-u8f759762de9b513e56-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u204676df57bbc1c130-1.text: 4. The imposition of an administrative penalty does not release a person from performing the obligation for non-performance of which the administrative penalty was imposed.
koap-u204676df57bbc1c130-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u84952d045d28bec2cd-1.text: 5. No one may be held administratively liable twice for the same administrative offence.
koap-u84952d045d28bec2cd-1.locator: Article 4.1. General rules for imposing administrative penalties

koap-u21c81147c1be1f9177-1.text: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
koap-u21c81147c1be1f9177-1.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning

koap-u9349dc57d0bb0c2aba-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning
koap-u9349dc57d0bb0c2aba-1.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning

koap-uf52de2165adf249058-1.text: 1. For an administrative offence committed for the first time and detected in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, where the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning, an administrative fine shall be replaced with a warning if the circumstances provided for by part 2 of Article 3.4 of this Code exist, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article.
koap-uf52de2165adf249058-1.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning

koap-u093b54e5a21ec69930-1.text: 2. An administrative fine shall not be replaced with a warning where an administrative offence provided for by Articles 13.15, 13.37, 14.31 - 14.33, part 1 of Article 14.39, Articles 14.56, 15.21, 15.27.3, 15.30, 19.3, 19.4.3, 19.5, 19.5.1, 19.6, 19.8 - 19.8.2, 19.23, parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.27, Articles 19.28, 19.29, 19.30, 19.33, 19.34, 20.3 or part 2 of Article 20.28 of this Code has been committed.
koap-u093b54e5a21ec69930-1.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning

koap-ubbb6ae15878768ab3d-1.text: 3. Where an administrative fine is replaced with a warning, the additional administrative penalty provided for by the relevant article of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences shall not be applied.
koap-ubbb6ae15878768ab3d-1.locator: Article 4.1.1. Replacement of an administrative fine with a warning

koap-u90728efeb4a90b61a4-1.text: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
koap-u90728efeb4a90b61a4-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-uc6c64a4d76bd45f428-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises
koap-uc6c64a4d76bd45f428-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-u4bb6a62cabc14920dd-1.text: 1. When an administrative fine is imposed on socially oriented non-profit organisations included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the register of socially oriented non-profit organisations receiving support, or on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises, and included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the unified register of small and medium-sized business entities, the administrative fine shall be imposed in the amount prescribed for a person carrying on business without forming a legal entity by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code, except for administrative offences provided for by parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code, or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
koap-u4bb6a62cabc14920dd-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-u4ae483b93c0cf123d8-1.text: 2. If the sanction of an article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences does not provide for an administrative fine for a person carrying on business without forming a legal entity, an administrative fine imposed on socially oriented non-profit organisations included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the register of socially oriented non-profit organisations receiving support, or on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises, and included, at the time of the administrative offence, in the unified register of small and medium-sized business entities, shall range from half the minimum amount (minimum value) to half the maximum amount (maximum value) of the administrative fine prescribed for a legal entity by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article), or shall equal half the administrative fine prescribed for a legal entity by that sanction if it provides for an administrative fine of a fixed amount.
koap-u4ae483b93c0cf123d8-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-u11cf654d62f8e817cf-1.text: 3. An administrative fine imposed in accordance with part 2 of this Article may not be less than the minimum administrative fine prescribed for an official by the sanction of the relevant article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.
koap-u11cf654d62f8e817cf-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-u786000b1ed84bf65bf-1.text: 4. The rules of this Article do not apply when imposing administrative fines for administrative offences for which persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity bear administrative liability as legal entities in accordance with the articles of Section II of this Code.
koap-u786000b1ed84bf65bf-1.locator: Article 4.1.2. Special rules for imposing administrative fines on socially oriented non-profit organisations and on legal entities that are small and medium-sized business entities classified as small enterprises, including microenterprises

koap-uafbd55610d3ceb6f2d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.2. Circumstances mitigating administrative liability

koap-u8d8507963f99fe46a7-1.text: 1. The following are recognised as circumstances mitigating administrative liability:

koap-uba3953cbbdd10be0a8-1.text: 1) remorse on the part of the person who committed the administrative offence;

koap-uef0341223cd316e12a-1.text: 2) voluntary cessation of the unlawful conduct by the person who committed the administrative offence;

koap-uef61e32abd68a35860-1.text: 3) voluntary reporting of the administrative offence by the person who committed it to the body authorised to conduct the administrative offence proceedings;

koap-u1722f931b30a4eb1f4-1.text: 4) assistance by the person who committed the administrative offence to the body authorised to conduct the administrative offence proceedings in establishing the circumstances to be established in the administrative offence case;

koap-uc157ce908414b5dae3-1.text: 5) prevention of the harmful consequences of the administrative offence by the person who committed it;

koap-ud805c207f3ec7d220a-1.text: 6) voluntary compensation by the person who committed the administrative offence for the damage caused, or voluntary remediation of the harm caused;

koap-ud188decbdad8d17927-1.text: 7) voluntary compliance, before the ruling in the administrative offence case is issued, by the person who committed the administrative offence with a direction to remedy the violation issued to that person by a body exercising state control (supervision) and municipal control;

koap-ue812f16b66a6a82af5-1.text: 8) commission of the administrative offence in a state of intense emotional agitation (affect) or under a combination of difficult personal or family circumstances;

koap-ub9b88c9c57f322b7b5-1.text: 9) commission of the administrative offence by a minor;

koap-uaad612ccb683af7efa-1.text: 10) commission of the administrative offence by a pregnant woman or a woman with a young child.

koap-u41a08bb5bbd39ed5d4-1.text: 2. The judge, body or official hearing an administrative offence case may recognise as mitigating circumstances not specified in this Code or in the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences.

koap-u2ee622488f48851cd4-1.text: 3. This Code may provide for other circumstances mitigating administrative liability for particular administrative offences and for special rules on taking circumstances mitigating administrative liability into account when imposing administrative penalties for particular administrative offences.

koap-u5d41c5cc71b6fe5894-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.3. Circumstances aggravating administrative liability

koap-u35536dc8b9e6aa5500-1.text: 1. The following are recognised as circumstances aggravating administrative liability:

koap-u7f9d3905e4e9642233-1.text: 1) continuation of unlawful conduct despite a demand by persons authorised to do so that it cease;

koap-uacdff34a71b0c0059a-1.text: 2) repeated commission of an administrative offence of the same kind, that is, commission of an administrative offence during the period when the person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty under Article 4.6 of this Code for an administrative offence of the same kind;

koap-uc2abd9b5200bd7b160-1.text: 3) involving a minor in the commission of an administrative offence;

koap-u5902f7948ac3616e60-1.text: 4) commission of an administrative offence by a group of persons;

koap-u058e7475e46f3672fb-1.text: 5) commission of an administrative offence during a natural disaster or in other emergency circumstances;

koap-u3e2052292734b6e6ee-1.text: 6) commission of an administrative offence in a state of intoxication, or refusal to undergo a medical examination for intoxication where there are sufficient grounds to believe that the person who committed the administrative offence is intoxicated.

koap-uc63953533749805e5c-1.text: Depending on the nature of the administrative offence committed, the judge, body or official imposing the administrative penalty may decline to recognise this circumstance as aggravating.

koap-u92647d3d6d0d39b3bd-1.text: 2. The circumstances provided for by part 1 of this Article may not be taken into account as aggravating if those circumstances are provided for as a qualifying element of the administrative offence by the relevant rules on administrative liability for that administrative offence.

koap-u9577988f44c2207372-1.text: 3. This Code may provide for other circumstances aggravating administrative liability for particular administrative offences and for special rules on taking circumstances aggravating administrative liability into account when imposing administrative penalties for particular administrative offences.

koap-u6bcd5d5f740856aec9-1.text: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences
koap-u6bcd5d5f740856aec9-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-ud4dbaea715bdd75e8c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences
koap-ud4dbaea715bdd75e8c-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-uc896c283140a9bc194-1.text: 1. Where a person commits two or more administrative offences, an administrative penalty shall be imposed for each administrative offence committed, except in the cases provided for by parts 5 and 6 of this Article.
koap-uc896c283140a9bc194-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-u710ba17b83debf5f00-1.text: 2. Where a person commits a single act (omission) containing the constituent elements of administrative offences for which liability is provided for by two or more articles (parts of articles) of this Code and the cases concerning those offences fall within the jurisdiction of the same judge, body or official, an administrative penalty shall be imposed within the sanction that provides for the imposition of the more severe administrative penalty on the person who committed that act (omission).
koap-u710ba17b83debf5f00-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-u7bccbf73ebe3ac9169-1.text: 3. In the case provided for by part 2 of this Article, the administrative penalty shall be imposed:
koap-u7bccbf73ebe3ac9169-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-uc9abeb2636c263d303-1.text: 1) within the sanction that does not provide for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning, if one of the sanctions in question provides for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning;
koap-uc9abeb2636c263d303-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-u0e43731a5ec309654b-1.text: 2) within the sanction under which the highest administrative fine in monetary terms may be imposed, if the sanctions in question provide for an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine;
koap-u0e43731a5ec309654b-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-u88de1ef0550ad1a248-1.text: 3) within the sanction that does not provide for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine, if one of the sanctions in question does not provide for an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine.
koap-u88de1ef0550ad1a248-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-ub90b8e857bc40905f2-1.text: 4. When an administrative penalty is imposed in accordance with parts 2 and 3 of this Article, additional administrative penalties provided for by each of the corresponding sanctions may be imposed.
koap-ub90b8e857bc40905f2-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-ub3fa9d48acab1d9de4-1.text: 5. If two or more administrative offences for which liability is provided for by the same article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences are detected during a single control (supervisory) measure in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, the person who committed them shall be given an administrative penalty as for the commission of a single administrative offence. This Code may provide for cases where, if two or more administrative offences for which liability is provided for by the same article (part of an article) of Section II of this Code are detected during a single control (supervisory) measure conducted as part of state control (supervision) or municipal control, the person who committed them shall be given an administrative penalty for each such administrative offence.
koap-ub3fa9d48acab1d9de4-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-uadda788f90750064b9-1.text: 6. If two or more administrative offences for which liability is provided for by two or more articles (parts of an article) of Section II of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences are detected during a single control (supervisory) measure in the course of state control (supervision) or municipal control, the rules for imposing administrative penalties provided for by parts 2 - 4 of this Article shall apply when administrative penalties are imposed for those administrative offences.
koap-uadda788f90750064b9-1.locator: Article 4.4. Imposition of administrative penalties for the commission of several administrative offences

koap-u9fd8d8fec1b1903318-1.text: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability
koap-u9fd8d8fec1b1903318-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u3b8139f748cb324c7f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability
koap-u3b8139f748cb324c7f-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-ud8d1d6a53e272bcb61-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case may not be issued after sixty calendar days (or, in an administrative offence case heard by a judge, after ninety calendar days) from the date the administrative offence was committed; for a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the field of the platform economy (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 14.69 of this Code), after ninety calendar days from the date the administrative offence was committed; for violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation on export control, in the field of personal data, on internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf and the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, on geodesy and cartography, on the names of geographical features, of patent and antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on environmental protection and the use of natural resources, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on limiting greenhouse gas emissions, of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the protection of citizens' health, on the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, on the protection of children from information harmful to their health and (or) development, on road traffic safety (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 12.8, 12.21.1, 12.21.3, 12.21.5, 12.24, 12.26, part 3 of Article 12.27 and part 2 of Article 12.30 of this Code), of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the field of communications (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.2.1, 13.4, 13.29, 13.29.3, 13.29.4 and parts 6 and 7 of Article 19.7.10 of this Code), of legislation on ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.12.1, 13.12.2 and 19.7.15 of this Code), on the mass media (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 13.15 of this Code), on information, information technologies and information protection (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.11.2, 13.12, 13.41, 13.51, 13.52 and 19.7.10-3 of this Code), on copyright and related rights, on trademarks, service marks and appellations of origin of goods, on the use of atomic energy, on taxes and levies, on consumer rights protection, on investment activities, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on organising and exercising state control (supervision) and municipal control and on protecting the rights of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs during state control (supervision)
