and municipal control, on consumer credit (loans), on credit histories, on state regulation of prices (tariffs), on natural monopolies, on the principles of tariff regulation for utility-sector organisations, on advertising, on the electric power industry, on heat supply, in the field of water supply and wastewater disposal, on gas supply, on lotteries, of legislation on physical culture and sport (in respect of violations of the requirements applicable to rules (regulations) for official sporting competitions), on state regulation of activities involving the organisation and conduct of gambling (in respect of violations of requirements applicable to organisers of gambling in bookmakers' offices and totalisators when accepting bets on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling), on elections and referendums, on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and (or) other immovable property, on combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism (except for administrative offences provided for by part 4 of Article 15.27 and Article 15.27.3 of this Code), on joint-stock companies, on limited liability companies, on the securities market, of insurance legislation, of legislation on clearing activities, on organised trading, on investment funds, on non-state pension funds (except for administrative offences provided for by parts 10.1 and 10.2 of Article 15.29 of this Code), of the legislation of the Russian Federation on credit cooperatives, on agricultural cooperatives, on microfinance activities and microfinance organisations, on pawnshops, of legislation on combating the unlawful use of inside information and market manipulation, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the national payment system, on the opening of accounts and covered (deposited) letters of credit, on the conclusion of bank account agreements and bank deposit agreements (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 15.39 of this Code); and for violations of labour legislation, immigration rules, rules governing the stay (residence) of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation, rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons (including foreign workers) in employment in the Russian Federation, the procedure for tendering that is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.5 and Article 7.30.6 (in respect of violations of requirements applicable to the procedure for conducting tendering that is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation and to the procedure and time limits for blocking and unblocking funds in a mandatory tendering participant's bank account) of this Code), of the legislation of the Russian Federation on foreign agents, of legislation in the field of the state defence order (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.30.3 and 19.4.2, part 7.1 of Article 19.5 and part 2 of Article 19.7.2 of this Code), on the contract system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.30.1 and 7.30.2, Article 7.30.6 (in respect of violations of requirements applicable to procurement procedures provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contract system for the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, and to the procedure and time limits for blocking and unblocking funds in the bank account of a participant in such procurement), part 7 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.7.2 of this Code), of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.4, Article 7.30.6 (in respect of violations of requirements applicable to procurement procedures conducted by certain types of legal entities and to the procedure and time limits for blocking and unblocking funds in the bank account of a participant in such procurement), and part 7.2 of Article 19.5 of this Code), on organising activities involving the sale of goods (performance of works, provision of services) at retail markets, on the principles of state regulation of trading activities, in the field of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products, in the field of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for the production of such products, in the field of the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids, on fire safety, on industrial safety, on the safety of hydraulic structures, on urban development, on technical regulation, on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, processions and picketing, on the use of cash register equipment, on weapons, on the protection of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, on state support for cinematography in the Russian Federation (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 14.58 of this Code), on enforcement proceedings, on foreign investment in the Russian Federation, on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs, on combating extremist activities (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 20.3.1 and 20.3.2 of this Code), and on the enforcement of administrative penalties (in respect of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code); and for administrative offences against administrative order (in respect of failure to submit, or late submission of, details (information) necessary to calculate an administrative fine to the federal antimonopoly body or its territorial body at their request, or submission of knowingly inaccurate details (information) necessary to calculate an administrative fine to the federal antimonopoly body or its territorial body, or failure to submit, or late submission of, a statistical form for recording the movement of goods to a customs authority, or submission to a customs authority of such a statistical form containing inaccurate information; and in respect of failure by a film exhibitor charging for screenings in a cinema auditorium to provide information, or provision of incomplete information, to the unified federal automated information system containing information on film screenings in cinema auditoriums, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information; and in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 19.7.5-1 of this Code), in the field of the protection of property (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.1, 7.3 - 7.6, 7.9, parts 4 and 5 of Article 7.13 and Articles 7.14 - 7.15 of this Code), for violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation on precious metals and precious stones, of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for regulating corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations, for the administrative offence provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code, and for violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation governing the activities of self-regulatory organisations of appraisers (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 14.71 of this Code), after one year from the date the administrative offence was committed; for violations of the customs legislation of the Customs Union within the EurAsEC (hereinafter referred to as the Customs Union) and (or) the legislation of the Russian Federation on customs affairs, for violations of the budget legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts governing budgetary legal relations, for administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.35.1 and 6.1.1 of this Code, for violations of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation authorities, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accounting, of legislation on state regulation of activities involving the organisation and conduct of gambling (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Article 14.1.1 of this Code), for violations of legislation on non-state pension funds (in respect of administrative offences provided for by parts 10.1 and 10.2 of Article 15.29 of this Code), and on participation in the activities of a foreign or international organisation whose activities have been declared undesirable within the Russian Federation in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation (in respect of the administrative offence provided for by Article 20.33 of this Code), after two years from the date the administrative offence was committed; for violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation on political parties (in respect of administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.64 - 5.68 of this Code), on insolvency (bankruptcy), on accreditation within the national accreditation system, for violations in the field of environmental protection and the use of natural resources (in respect of the administrative offence provided for by Article 8.28.2 of this Code), for violations in the field of military registration, for violations of legislation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism (in respect of administrative offences provided for by part 4 of Article 15.27 and Article 15.27.3 of this Code), and for the administrative offence provided for by Article 15.37.1 of this Code, after three years from the date the administrative offence was committed; and for violations of the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating terrorism, of the legislation of the Russian Federation on special economic measures and coercive measures (in respect of the administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.1 of this Code), and of the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, after six years from the date the administrative offence was committed.
koap-ud8d1d6a53e272bcb61-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-ud97468b7a29cb19fba-1.text: 1.1. The limitation period for imposing administrative liability shall run from the date the administrative offence was committed.
koap-ud97468b7a29cb19fba-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u02a04b0de9f1355d69-1.text: 2. For a continuing administrative offence, the periods provided for by part 1 of this Article shall begin to run from the date the administrative offence is detected.
koap-u02a04b0de9f1355d69-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u4aec6f1f8e4d825bbb-1.text: 3. Unless part 1 of this Article provides for a longer limitation period for imposing administrative liability, for administrative offences entailing an administrative penalty in the form of disqualification (except for the administrative offences provided for by part 6 of this Article), a person may be held administratively liable no later than one year from the date the administrative offence was committed; for the administrative offences provided for by part 6 of this Article, from the date of the decision specified in part 6 of this Article; and for a continuing administrative offence, no later than one year from the date it was detected.
koap-u4aec6f1f8e4d825bbb-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u85cb6e153dd79c74e5-1.text: 4. Where the initiation of criminal proceedings is refused or criminal proceedings are terminated, but the person's acts show signs of an administrative offence, the periods provided for by part 1 of this Article shall begin to run from the date the administrative offence was committed (or, for a continuing administrative offence, from the date it was detected).
koap-u85cb6e153dd79c74e5-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u64ea907fc9e54504eb-1.text: 5. Where an application by the person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted to have the case heard at that person's place of residence is granted, the limitation period for imposing administrative liability shall be suspended from the moment that application is granted until the case materials are received by the judge, body or official authorised to hear the case at the place of residence of the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted.
koap-u64ea907fc9e54504eb-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u887d03f3b550d8ad01-1.text: 5.1. The limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Article 6.18 of this Code, in respect of the use of a prohibited substance and (or) a prohibited method, shall begin to run from the date on which the all-Russian anti-doping organisation receives a report from a laboratory accredited by the World Anti-Doping Agency confirming that an athlete has used a prohibited substance and (or) a prohibited method.
koap-u887d03f3b550d8ad01-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u1ff9130c6b1e916598-1.text: 5.2. The running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, where the sanction of the applicable article provides for deprivation of the right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type or other types of machinery, shall be suspended from the date on which the administrative offence proceedings are suspended in accordance with part 3 of Article 28.10 of this Code. The running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, where the sanction of the applicable article provides for deprivation of the right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type or other types of machinery, shall resume on the day following the day on which the ruling in the case concerning a new administrative offence provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code enters into legal force, where the sanction of the applicable article provides for deprivation of the right to operate a vehicle of the corresponding type or other types of machinery, in the cases specified in part 4 of Article 28.10 of this Code.
koap-u1ff9130c6b1e916598-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-ua30e029c98e91c1b9d-1.text: 6. The limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.9, 14.9.1, 14.31, 14.32, 14.33 and 14.40 of this Code shall begin to run from the date on which the decision of the antimonopoly body's commission establishing a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation enters into force.
koap-ua30e029c98e91c1b9d-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u210acad41a6ad8fc97-1.text: 6.1. The limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by parts 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.3 of this Code shall begin to run from the date on which the decision of the commission of the federal executive body exercising state control (supervision) functions in the field of the state defence order, establishing a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the field of the state defence order, enters into force.
koap-u210acad41a6ad8fc97-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u9db776db8c6c84c264-1.text: 7. The limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences committed in Antarctica shall begin to run from the date on which the case materials are received by the body or official authorised to draw up administrative offence records.
koap-u9db776db8c6c84c264-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u1a129a29b13af0b43b-1.text: 8. The running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code shall be suspended from the date on which the administrative offence proceedings are suspended because the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code enters into force. If the person who concluded that agreement with the Bank of Russia fails to fulfil the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code, the running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code shall resume on the day following the day on which the Bank of Russia decides, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, to recognise that agreement with the Bank of Russia as unfulfilled.
koap-u1a129a29b13af0b43b-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u48b5cf1ef1081de70e-1.text: 9. Where administrative offence case materials are requested in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code, the running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for the administrative offence whose case materials are requested shall be suspended from the date the procedural order requesting those materials is issued until the ruling provided for by point 3, 4 or 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code enters into legal force; the running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code shall be suspended from the date the procedural order requesting the administrative offence case materials is issued until the requested materials are received by the judge who issued that order.
koap-u48b5cf1ef1081de70e-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-uc10bca41559f1926be-1.text: 10. The running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for the administrative offence specified in point 1 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code shall be suspended from the date the administrative offence record specified in the first paragraph of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code is drawn up until the ruling provided for by point 3, 4 or 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code enters into legal force.
koap-uc10bca41559f1926be-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-uf37fcadac3f0b1527d-1.text: 11. The provisions of part 10 of this Article do not apply where the procedural order provided for by point 4 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code is issued.
koap-uf37fcadac3f0b1527d-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u8b9904f445a90a803c-1.text: 12. The running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences shall be suspended from the date on which the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code enters into force. If the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code is not fulfilled, the running of the limitation period for imposing administrative liability for administrative offences shall resume on the day following the day on which the decision to recognise that agreement as unfulfilled is adopted.
koap-u8b9904f445a90a803c-1.locator: Article 4.5. Limitation periods for imposing administrative liability

koap-u35da438f1f20d332d2-1.text: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty
koap-u35da438f1f20d332d2-1.locator: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty

koap-ue968f7fe18b1669705-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty
koap-ue968f7fe18b1669705-1.locator: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty

koap-ud35ddf3a1e98e2fce2-1.text: 1. A person on whom an administrative penalty has been imposed for an administrative offence is deemed to be subject to that penalty from the date the ruling imposing the administrative penalty enters into legal force until one year has elapsed from the date enforcement of that ruling is completed, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article.
koap-ud35ddf3a1e98e2fce2-1.locator: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty

koap-ubb62428005a74f8e8b-1.text: 2. A person on whom an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine has been imposed for an administrative offence and who paid that fine before the date the corresponding ruling imposing the administrative penalty entered into legal force is deemed to be subject to that penalty from the date that ruling enters into legal force until one year has elapsed from the date the administrative fine was paid.
koap-ubb62428005a74f8e8b-1.locator: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty

koap-u6b0a0ea16062a6aa7e-1.text: 3. A person specified in part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code is deemed not to be subject to an administrative penalty.
koap-u6b0a0ea16062a6aa7e-1.locator: Article 4.6. Period during which a person is deemed to be subject to an administrative penalty

koap-u927e9ef24860711bc5-1.text: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence
koap-u927e9ef24860711bc5-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u58963e2e7ed9647ecc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence
koap-u58963e2e7ed9647ecc-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u7f73d0fe27f7d007a9-1.text: 1. When hearing an administrative offence case, a judge may, where there is no dispute concerning compensation for property damage, decide the issue of compensation for property damage at the same time as imposing the administrative penalty.
koap-u7f73d0fe27f7d007a9-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u9f65729b25e937ee6d-1.text: Disputes concerning compensation for property damage shall be resolved by a court in civil proceedings.
koap-u9f65729b25e937ee6d-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u5e52568ddff239ef5d-1.text: 2. In an administrative offence case heard by another authorised body or official, a dispute concerning compensation for property damage shall be resolved by a court in civil proceedings.
koap-u5e52568ddff239ef5d-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u7f0a0fb904aab0c5e2-1.text: 3. Disputes concerning compensation for non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence shall be heard by a court in civil proceedings.
koap-u7f0a0fb904aab0c5e2-1.locator: Article 4.7. Compensation for property damage and non-pecuniary harm caused by an administrative offence

koap-u9411803647600bb038-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 4.8. Calculation of time limits

koap-u2eb4895639099d8f8c-1.text: 1. The time limits provided for by this Code shall be calculated in hours, twenty-four-hour days, days, months or years.

koap-u177453f1d0d91b548c-1.text: 1.1. A time limit defined by a period shall begin to run on the day following the calendar date or occurrence of the event that determines the beginning of the time limit.

koap-u223ff65fbfb89f485b-1.text: 2. A time limit calculated in twenty-four-hour days expires at 24 hours on its final day. A time limit calculated in months expires on the corresponding date of the final month; if that month has no corresponding date, the time limit expires on the final day of that month. A time limit calculated in years expires in the corresponding month and on the corresponding date of the final year.

koap-ud6571fdd2a1432168f-1.text: 3. A time limit calculated in days expires on the final day of the prescribed period.

koap-u73107553a2fea02ef2-1.text: 3.1. If a time limit calculated in days ends on a non-working day, the first working day following it shall be deemed the final day of the time limit.

koap-u6fcb1a70d1a8b04385-1.text: 4. If an application, appeal, other documents or funds have been handed over to a communications organisation or a credit institution, or declared, delivered or submitted to a court, body or person authorised to receive them before 24 hours on the final day of the time limit, the time limit shall not be deemed to have been missed.

koap-u8e5e26a5cc2f21b828-1.text: 1. The provisions of this Article do not apply where other articles of this Code establish a different procedure for calculating time limits, or when calculating the durations of administrative penalties.

koap-u798f52e41582d2dfa3-1.text: 2. The provisions of parts 1.1 and 3.1 of this Article do not apply when calculating limitation periods for imposing administrative liability.

koap-u1cde242a6ef8486378-1.text: 1. Violation by the editor-in-chief or editorial office of a mass media outlet, a television and (or) radio broadcasting organisation, or another organisation producing or distributing a mass media outlet, of the procedure for publishing (making public) materials relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums, including campaign materials, or violation during an election campaign or referendum campaign of the procedure for publishing (making public) those materials in information and telecommunications networks access to which is not restricted to a specified group of persons —

koap-u961947ea8288cfac30-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, one thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, and thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.

koap-u80fb25996be5fcb0f3-1.text: 2. koap-udcbc741daefeb4bc68-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to four thousand roubles for officials and twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-udcbc741daefeb4bc68-1.locator: Article 5.5. Violation of the procedure for participation by the mass media in providing information for elections, referendums and all-Russian voting
