koap-u485d74771a007bca07-1.text: Failure, before the election campaigning period expires, to provide an opportunity to make public (publish) a rebuttal or other explanation in defence of a registered candidate's honour, dignity or business reputation or an electoral association's business reputation, where materials capable of damaging the registered candidate's honour, dignity or business reputation or the electoral association's business reputation have been made public (published) in the mass media and federal law requires that such an opportunity be provided —
koap-u485d74771a007bca07-1.locator: Article 5.13. Failure to provide an opportunity to make public a rebuttal or other explanation in defence of honour, dignity or business reputation

koap-u2f329905e5982afec2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials and ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u2f329905e5982afec2-1.locator: Article 5.13. Failure to provide an opportunity to make public a rebuttal or other explanation in defence of honour, dignity or business reputation

koap-ua45e016dab1c3d8f31-1.text: Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting
koap-ua45e016dab1c3d8f31-1.locator: Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting

koap-u41b872f9f85c147fb0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting
koap-u41b872f9f85c147fb0-1.locator: Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting

koap-u5ba14d02ee994e3c84-1.text: Intentional destruction of or damage to information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or campaign materials, placed in accordance with law and displayed on a building, structure or other object during an election campaign, referendum campaign or the preparation and conduct of all-Russian voting, or placing inscriptions or images on such materials —
koap-u5ba14d02ee994e3c84-1.locator: Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-1.locator: Article 5.14. Intentional destruction of or damage to campaign materials or information materials relating to an election, referendum or all-Russian voting

koap-ufbb4e91075c9edd42d-1.text: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants
koap-ufbb4e91075c9edd42d-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-u96dc41911fe78331ba-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants
koap-u96dc41911fe78331ba-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-u6164d403158b6f7d98-1.text: 1. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission that a registered candidate, electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants has been provided, for meetings with voters or referendum participants, with premises owned by the state or a municipality, or by an organisation in whose charter (pooled) capital the share (contribution) of the Russian Federation, constituent entities of the Russian Federation and (or) municipal entities exceeds 30 per cent on the day of official publication (publication) of the decision calling the election or official publication of the decision calling the referendum; of the terms on which the premises were provided; and of when those premises may be provided during the campaigning period to other registered candidates, electoral associations, the referendum initiative group or other groups of referendum participants —
koap-u6164d403158b6f7d98-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-ua8dce592dff240fa01-1.text: 2. Violation of the right established by legislation on elections and referendums of a registered candidate, electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants to be provided, for meetings with voters or referendum participants, with premises owned by the state or a municipality, or by an organisation in whose charter (pooled) capital the share (contribution) of the Russian Federation, constituent entities of the Russian Federation and (or) municipal entities exceeds 30 per cent on the day of official publication (publication) of the decision calling the election or official publication of the decision calling the referendum, or violation of equal conditions for providing such premises —
koap-ua8dce592dff240fa01-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-ud048b20ac965dc821d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for officials.
koap-ud048b20ac965dc821d-1.locator: Article 5.15. Violation of the procedure and time limits prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums for notifying an election commission of the provision of premises, and violation of the right to be provided with premises for meetings with voters or referendum participants

koap-u481d9fca54a647f422-1.text: Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums
koap-u481d9fca54a647f422-1.locator: Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums

koap-u2db472738993690538-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums
koap-u2db472738993690538-1.locator: Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums

koap-u1a1b11db10c0b4ad22-1.text: Bribery of voters or referendum participants, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act, or carrying out charitable activities in breach of legislation on elections and referendums —
koap-u1a1b11db10c0b4ad22-1.locator: Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums

koap-u1107446cc582773423-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for citizens, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials, and three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u1107446cc582773423-1.locator: Article 5.16. Bribery of voters or referendum participants, or carrying out charitable activities during an election campaign or referendum campaign in breach of legislation on elections and referendums

koap-u1b0175865e2c6c605b-1.text: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum
koap-u1b0175865e2c6c605b-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-ua6d15f4f34dbf20403-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum
koap-ua6d15f4f34dbf20403-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-u12500cd4d3abec7887-1.text: 1. Failure by a candidate, a person who was a candidate, a person elected as a deputy or to another elective office, an electoral association, a referendum initiative group, another group of referendum participants or a credit institution to submit, within the period prescribed by law, a report or information on the sources and amounts of funds transferred to an electoral fund or referendum fund and on all expenditure incurred in conducting the election campaign or referendum campaign; incomplete submission of such information as required by law; or submission of an inaccurate report or inaccurate information —
koap-u12500cd4d3abec7887-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-u1ece880c9b58d2c43e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for a candidate, a person who was a candidate, a person elected as a deputy or to another elective office, an authorised financial representative of an electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, or an official of a credit institution.
koap-u1ece880c9b58d2c43e-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-u83c669c565207e87ba-1.text: 2. Failure by the chairperson of an election commission or referendum commission to post on the Internet information and telecommunications network information on the receipt and expenditure of electoral funds or referendum funds, or the financial reports of candidates, registered candidates or electoral associations; incomplete posting of such information or reports where not provided for by law; or their late posting —
koap-u83c669c565207e87ba-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-1.locator: Article 5.17. Failure to submit or post a report or information on the receipt and expenditure of funds allocated for the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum

koap-uab0960b79e4580c692-1.text: Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants
koap-uab0960b79e4580c692-1.locator: Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants

koap-u68bfe56a47e42ac5f4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants
koap-u68bfe56a47e42ac5f4-1.locator: Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants

koap-ub7696877449f53573e-1.text: Use by a candidate, electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, in financing its election campaign or referendum campaign, of money not transferred to the electoral fund or referendum fund, or money received by the electoral fund or referendum fund in breach of legislation on elections and referendums, as well as expenditure by other persons, for the purpose of achieving a particular result in an election or referendum, of money not transferred to the electoral fund or referendum fund, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act; or exceeding the statutory maximum amounts of expenditure from an electoral fund or referendum fund; or expenditure of money from an electoral fund or referendum fund for purposes not provided for by legislation on elections and referendums —
koap-ub7696877449f53573e-1.locator: Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants

koap-u14c960437abfb393af-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for citizens, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials, and three hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u14c960437abfb393af-1.locator: Article 5.18. Unlawful use of money to finance the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants

koap-u711e320c1407151b20-1.text: Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-u711e320c1407151b20-1.locator: Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-uca82bd6286d3498d29-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-uca82bd6286d3498d29-1.locator: Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u252c448606b4d6bb0f-1.text: Use, during an election campaign or the preparation and conduct of a referendum, for the purpose of achieving a particular result in the election or referendum, of material support provided by citizens, legal entities, their branches, representative offices or other subdivisions of legal entities without compensation from the relevant electoral fund or referendum fund, except for the use by an electoral association that has nominated a list of candidates, without payment from the electoral fund, of immovable and movable property (other than securities, printed products and consumables) in its use on the day of official publication (publication) of the decision calling the election, as well as use of anonymous material support, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u252c448606b4d6bb0f-1.locator: Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-uffd7cacfc5ab4ce02c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; and one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-uffd7cacfc5ab4ce02c-1.locator: Article 5.19. Use of unlawful material support to finance an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u3eb1af94055a3f8a48-1.text: Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates
koap-u3eb1af94055a3f8a48-1.locator: Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates

koap-u5e8bfa1164778bec34-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates
koap-u5e8bfa1164778bec34-1.locator: Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates

koap-ua9eb5dd7a431dced19-1.text: Provision of financial support to the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants outside their electoral funds or referendum funds; or performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods by legal entities, their branches, representative offices or other subdivisions free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates, where connected with the conduct of an election or referendum and aimed at achieving a particular result in an election, putting forward an initiative to hold a referendum or achieving a particular result in a referendum; or performance of paid work, sale of goods or provision of paid services aimed at achieving a particular result in an election, putting forward an initiative to hold a referendum or achieving a particular result in a referendum without the documented consent of the candidate or the candidate's authorised financial representative, or the authorised financial representative of the electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, and without payment from the relevant electoral fund or referendum fund; or making donations to an electoral fund or referendum fund through straw persons; or providing a candidate, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, for the conduct of the relevant election campaign or referendum campaign, with material support aimed at achieving a particular result in the election or referendum without compensation from the relevant electoral fund or referendum fund, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ua9eb5dd7a431dced19-1.locator: Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates

koap-ufcdf1c34d5d81f9303-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ufcdf1c34d5d81f9303-1.locator: Article 5.20. Unlawful financing of the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or of a referendum campaign, provision of material support prohibited by law, and performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods connected with an election or referendum free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates

koap-u8354b1f265dcea1ce6-1.text: Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants
koap-u8354b1f265dcea1ce6-1.locator: Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants

koap-u4e52dcdcb7043abf5e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants
koap-u4e52dcdcb7043abf5e-1.locator: Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants

koap-u8ef71a63f01fc3bb17-1.text: Failure to transfer funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants, as well as transfer of such funds in an incomplete amount or in breach of the statutory time limits, by an executive authority or local self-government body vested with the relevant powers to transfer funds, a credit institution or a post office —
koap-u8ef71a63f01fc3bb17-1.locator: Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants

koap-u8e319909cbcbbdb71c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u8e319909cbcbbdb71c-1.locator: Article 5.21. Late transfer of funds to election commissions, referendum commissions, candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants

koap-u7b0d71b75a806877e5-1.text: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot
koap-u7b0d71b75a806877e5-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-u862805a0f18289c785-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot
koap-u862805a0f18289c785-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-u83a1b5dac2a3925115-1.text: 1. Issuance by a member of an election commission or referendum commission to a citizen of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot to enable that citizen to vote in place of a voter, referendum participant or all-Russian voting participant, including in place of another voter, referendum participant or all-Russian voting participant, or to vote more than once in the same vote, or issuance to a citizen of a completed election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u83a1b5dac2a3925115-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-ue43f8ca852565a0ba0-1.text: 2. Receipt at an election commission or referendum commission of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot for voting in place of a voter, referendum participant or all-Russian voting participant, including in place of another voter, referendum participant or all-Russian voting participant, or for voting more than once in the same vote, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ue43f8ca852565a0ba0-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-2.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-ufe7b1db658241076df-1.text: 3. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 2 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ufe7b1db658241076df-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-1.locator: Article 5.22. Unlawful issuance and receipt of an election ballot, referendum ballot or all-Russian voting ballot

koap-ucf9407456adfaac358-1.text: Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots
koap-ucf9407456adfaac358-1.locator: Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots

koap-ud87829491235242d33-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots
koap-ud87829491235242d33-1.locator: Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots

koap-ud89643f96da1981db6-1.text: Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots —
koap-ud89643f96da1981db6-1.locator: Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots

koap-ud7ced148b4fae30c1f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, three thousand to four thousand roubles for officials, and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ud7ced148b4fae30c1f-1.locator: Article 5.23. Concealment of surplus printed election ballots or referendum ballots

koap-uefb6438d6cb76a6e97-1.text: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”
koap-uefb6438d6cb76a6e97-1.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-u43a938988a08ef0288-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”
koap-u43a938988a08ef0288-1.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-u9aaef9980a09662bfe-1.text: 1. Violation by the chairperson or a member of an election commission or referendum commission of the statutory procedure for counting votes, or of the statutory procedure for processing voting totals or determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting —
koap-u9aaef9980a09662bfe-1.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-uae75a23604025382c6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-uae75a23604025382c6-1.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-ub77931eb2fdf4c27f6-1.text: 2. Violation by the chairperson or a member of an election commission or referendum commission of the procedure prescribed by federal law for drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount” —
koap-ub77931eb2fdf4c27f6-1.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-u8f9cf6d2bd852143c5-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles.
koap-u8f9cf6d2bd852143c5-3.locator: Article 5.24. Violation of the statutory procedure for counting votes, determining the results of an election, referendum or all-Russian voting, or drawing up a protocol on voting totals marked “Repeat” or “Vote recount”

koap-ue2696c2710457a7561-1.text: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results
koap-ue2696c2710457a7561-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u1694bd2b637c2bab9b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results
koap-u1694bd2b637c2bab9b-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u560f71d399fd9e44d0-1.text: 1. Failure or late provision by the chairperson of a precinct election commission or referendum commission of information on voting totals for inspection by voters, referendum participants, all-Russian voting participants, registered candidates, electoral associations, observers, foreign (international) observers or representatives of the mass media —
koap-u560f71d399fd9e44d0-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-2.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-uf38b441c01aec9ffcd-1.text: 2. The same violation committed by the chairperson of a territorial election commission or referendum commission, as well as that chairperson's failure to meet the time limits for sending information, or incomplete provision of information on voting totals in an election, referendum or all-Russian voting to the mass media for publication —
koap-uf38b441c01aec9ffcd-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u6430e95fb72e403526-1.text: 3. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article committed by the chairperson of a district election commission or referendum commission, as well as that chairperson's failure to meet the time limits for sending information, or incomplete provision of information on voting totals or election results to the mass media for publication —
koap-u6430e95fb72e403526-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-ue2938ee5fd5c87af5a-1.text: 4. The violation provided for by part 3 of this Article committed by the chairperson of an election commission or referendum commission of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation —
koap-ue2938ee5fd5c87af5a-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u7198b0e63cfa33f49a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to four thousand roubles.
koap-u7198b0e63cfa33f49a-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u286d1147f6516083cd-1.text: 5. The violation provided for by part 3 of this Article committed by the Chairperson of the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation —
koap-u286d1147f6516083cd-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-1.locator: Article 5.25. Failure to provide information on voting totals or election results

koap-u0987ad4dceb8c38db9-1.text: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations
koap-u0987ad4dceb8c38db9-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u4bfbdfb1b6d5d221ed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations
koap-u4bfbdfb1b6d5d221ed-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u352428531ef4f69d8f-1.text: 1. Obstruction of the exercise of the right to freedom of conscience and freedom of religion, including adopting or renouncing religious or other beliefs, or joining or leaving a religious association —
koap-u352428531ef4f69d8f-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u7ea14507b56e21ca2d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles for citizens, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u7ea14507b56e21ca2d-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u91d4216908c010a680-1.text: 2. Intentional public desecration of religious or liturgical literature, objects of religious veneration, or signs or emblems constituting the symbols and attributes of a worldview, or damage to or destruction of such items —
koap-u91d4216908c010a680-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u61df43751efb3865d9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to one hundred and twenty hours for citizens, and an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u61df43751efb3865d9-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u24326f91d7cc0afe1b-1.text: 3. Conduct of activities by a religious organisation without indicating its full official name, including the production or distribution, as part of missionary activity, of literature, printed materials or audio or video materials without marking bearing that name, or with incomplete or knowingly false marking —
koap-u24326f91d7cc0afe1b-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u14b8ea5797ecce84d9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the literature, printed materials and audio and video materials.
koap-u14b8ea5797ecce84d9-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u9a575ef133586e41f5-1.text: 4. Conduct of missionary activity in breach of the requirements of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations —
koap-u9a575ef133586e41f5-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u3e865d9f6b6c12acfa-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to fifty thousand roubles for citizens and one hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u3e865d9f6b6c12acfa-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-ub09fbda793b8172146-1.text: 5. The violation provided for by part 4 of this Article committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-ub09fbda793b8172146-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-u41a2366599a0ceb75e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u41a2366599a0ceb75e-1.locator: Article 5.26. Violation of legislation on freedom of conscience, freedom of religion and religious associations

koap-ub5b9d476dceff30e7f-1.text: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules
koap-ub5b9d476dceff30e7f-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u989def89e378fdb494-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules
koap-u989def89e378fdb494-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u059417f40c9ddf6067-1.text: 1. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules, unless otherwise provided for by parts 3, 4 and 6 of this Article and Article 5.27.1 of this Code —
koap-u059417f40c9ddf6067-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-ua09442315e6bd34464-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, one thousand to five thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ua09442315e6bd34464-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-uaeb948ff09b1c15512-1.text: 2. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-uaeb948ff09b1c15512-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u184f6b52619b6fe22c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years for officials, an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u184f6b52619b6fe22c-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-ua9e7f1906423000aa5-1.text: 3. Actual admission of a person to work by a person not authorised to do so by the employer, where the employer or its duly authorised representative refuses to recognise the relationship that has arisen between the person actually admitted to work and that employer as an employment relationship (does not conclude an employment contract with the person actually admitted to work) —
koap-ua9e7f1906423000aa5-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u9f1ec1f8e5e712514b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens and ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u9f1ec1f8e5e712514b-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u43c4b367e167f9258e-1.text: 4. Evasion of the formalisation of an employment contract, improper formalisation of an employment contract, or conclusion of a civil-law contract that in fact governs an employment relationship between an employee and an employer —
koap-u43c4b367e167f9258e-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-uc57bdffdfab974f566-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-uc57bdffdfab974f566-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-ud536cff2d1ec0f33f3-1.text: 5. Commission of the administrative offences provided for by part 3 or 4 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-ud536cff2d1ec0f33f3-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-uf814f4a48e36a4b379-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand roubles for citizens; disqualification for one to three years for officials; an administrative fine of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-uf814f4a48e36a4b379-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-ud0de51d6e2362403e9-1.text: 6. Failure to pay, or incomplete payment within the prescribed period of, wages or other payments made within an employment relationship, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act; or obstruction by an employer of an employee's exercise of the right to change the credit institution to which wages are to be transferred; or setting wages below the amount provided for by labour legislation —
koap-ud0de51d6e2362403e9-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u885e80905da8ab18dd-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, one thousand to five thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u885e80905da8ab18dd-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-uf6fd54d5efc7f11cbc-1.text: 7. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 6 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous offence, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uf6fd54d5efc7f11cbc-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u42aa19ee834e30775f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years for officials, an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u42aa19ee834e30775f-1.locator: Article 5.27. Violation of labour legislation and other normative legal acts containing labour-law rules

koap-u71f9853dbff97700f1-1.text: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation
koap-u71f9853dbff97700f1-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-uc6d357be6bdb4656fe-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation
koap-uc6d357be6bdb4656fe-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u96fc0c6b3689815304-1.text: 1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by parts 2–4 of this Article and part 3 of Article 11.23 of this Code —
koap-u96fc0c6b3689815304-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ufc24fb17fcd456db48-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, two thousand to five thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ufc24fb17fcd456db48-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ufd89c40b51f2bd7d21-1.text: 2. Violation by an employer of the established procedure for conducting a special assessment of working conditions at workplaces, or failure to conduct such an assessment —
koap-ufd89c40b51f2bd7d21-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-uf890ff9d79191f97d3-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-uf890ff9d79191f97d3-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ua9ea679107486d8ac3-1.text: 3. Allowing an employee to perform employment duties without having undergone, in the prescribed manner, training and testing of knowledge of occupational safety requirements, as well as mandatory preliminary medical examinations (upon taking up employment) and periodic medical examinations (during employment), mandatory medical examinations at the beginning of the working day (shift) and mandatory psychiatric assessments, or in the presence of medical contraindications —
koap-ua9ea679107486d8ac3-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u24d23f385ce9f1b6ff-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and one hundred and ten thousand to one hundred and thirty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u24d23f385ce9f1b6ff-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ub54966da2f7abb9736-1.text: 4. Failure to provide employees with personal protective equipment —
koap-ub54966da2f7abb9736-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ufaf415c891f6bb7fec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and one hundred and thirty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ufaf415c891f6bb7fec-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ubf78dc74c5565e813f-1.text: 5. Commission of the administrative offences provided for by parts 1–4 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-ubf78dc74c5565e813f-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u8cb07d53591d6c26da-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years for officials; an administrative fine of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u8cb07d53591d6c26da-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u1eb3dd15a338200498-1.text: Note. For the purposes of part 4 of this Article, personal protective equipment means personal protective equipment assigned to class 2 by the Customs Union Technical Regulation “On the Safety of Personal Protective Equipment”, according to the degree of risk of harm to the employee.
koap-u1eb3dd15a338200498-1.locator: Article 5.27.1. Violation of state regulatory occupational safety requirements contained in federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u4f608ac3265f85842f-1.text: Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state
koap-u4f608ac3265f85842f-1.locator: Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state

koap-u21308d3f985e2b5958-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state
koap-u21308d3f985e2b5958-1.locator: Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state

koap-u85bdc46aa50f9b1e64-1.text: Carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state in breach of the requirements prescribed by Russian Federation legislation for such activities —
koap-u85bdc46aa50f9b1e64-1.locator: Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state

koap-u9fda1ddb31ce248e97-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand roubles for citizens, thirty-five thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials, and four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u9fda1ddb31ce248e97-1.locator: Article 5.27.2. Violation of the requirements of Russian Federation legislation in carrying out activities to place Russian Federation citizens in employment outside the Russian Federation on vessels flying the flag of a foreign state

koap-u6717caee3a030c3979-1.text: Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion
koap-u6717caee3a030c3979-1.locator: Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion

koap-u0e9faa31aa730b772b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion
koap-u0e9faa31aa730b772b-1.locator: Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion

koap-u14213f13eaefd9eccb-1.text: Evasion by an employer or a person representing the employer of participation in negotiations on concluding, amending or supplementing a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the statutory time limit for conducting negotiations, as well as failure to ensure the operation of the commission for concluding a collective contract or agreement within the periods determined by the parties —
koap-u14213f13eaefd9eccb-1.locator: Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion

koap-u9bd28efaee56153926-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u9bd28efaee56153926-1.locator: Article 5.28. Evasion of participation in negotiations on concluding a collective contract or agreement, or violation of the prescribed time limit for their conclusion

koap-u1034ac54c480854e3b-1.text: Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement
koap-u1034ac54c480854e3b-1.locator: Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement

koap-ucac0ed2869ae22612b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement
koap-ucac0ed2869ae22612b-1.locator: Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement

koap-u0a9add9cffa14a3ca2-1.text: Failure by an employer or a person representing the employer to provide, within the statutory period, information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement —
koap-u0a9add9cffa14a3ca2-1.locator: Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement

koap-u9bd28efaee56153926-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u9bd28efaee56153926-2.locator: Article 5.29. Failure to provide information necessary for collective bargaining and monitoring compliance with a collective contract or agreement

koap-u8b861f5550eecaf34a-1.text: Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement
koap-u8b861f5550eecaf34a-1.locator: Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement

koap-ucd98b96af7bbcfe8e3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement
koap-ucd98b96af7bbcfe8e3-1.locator: Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement

koap-u4d0ea8b4f756107105-1.text: Unjustified refusal by an employer or a person representing the employer to conclude a collective contract or agreement —
koap-u4d0ea8b4f756107105-1.locator: Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement

koap-u21eb64394680759750-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u21eb64394680759750-1.locator: Article 5.30. Unjustified refusal to conclude a collective contract or agreement

koap-ud03cfac82a181d510f-1.text: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement
koap-ud03cfac82a181d510f-1.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-ufa43ee6f0f83a3f8bd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement
koap-ufa43ee6f0f83a3f8bd-1.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-u2aa617d35af18e92c1-1.text: 1. Breach or non-performance by an employer or a person representing the employer of obligations under a collective contract or agreement, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article —
koap-u2aa617d35af18e92c1-1.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-u21eb64394680759750-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u21eb64394680759750-2.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-u9100d1a26414a9b7e8-1.text: 2. Breach or non-performance by an employer or a person representing the employer of obligations under a collective contract or agreement concerning occupational safety for employees engaged in work involving harmful and (or) hazardous working conditions, including underground work —
koap-u9100d1a26414a9b7e8-1.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-u9d801cd9e12ddeead3-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of six thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u9d801cd9e12ddeead3-1.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

koap-u56abe4ea38d1e1192e-1.text: Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures
koap-u56abe4ea38d1e1192e-1.locator: Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures

koap-u7f0203f4fc1bdf49f1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures
koap-u7f0203f4fc1bdf49f1-1.locator: Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures

koap-ua7d5eb727e0d8eaf0e-1.text: Evasion by an employer or its representative of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures, including failure to provide premises for an employees' meeting (conference) to put forward demands, or obstruction of such a meeting (conference) —
koap-ua7d5eb727e0d8eaf0e-1.locator: Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures

koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-1.locator: Article 5.32. Evasion of receipt of employees' demands and participation in conciliation procedures

koap-u7a4b3e858db70d0dc1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.33. Non-performance of an agreement

koap-uf41dcab45ebe0f4d6c-1.text: Non-performance by an employer or its representative of obligations under an agreement reached as a result of a conciliation procedure —

koap-ue404feaf9bbd51aa6b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand roubles.
