koap-u4d37a26ebc0d2284a0-1.locator: Article 5.34. Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike

koap-u593d050e09bb592722-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.34. Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike
koap-u593d050e09bb592722-1.locator: Article 5.34. Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike

koap-u360dcc380ddf9b55aa-1.text: Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike —
koap-u360dcc380ddf9b55aa-1.locator: Article 5.34. Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike

koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-2.locator: Article 5.34. Dismissal of employees in connection with a collective labour dispute and the declaration of a strike

koap-u72152de1cb40e2d517-1.text: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors
koap-u72152de1cb40e2d517-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-u8fd03ebfe5b702dab3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors
koap-u8fd03ebfe5b702dab3-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-ub19c42a73037617a90-1.text: 1. Non-performance or improper performance by parents or other legal representatives of minors of duties concerning the maintenance, upbringing and education of minors and the protection of their rights and interests —
koap-ub19c42a73037617a90-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-uae32387239675beb7f-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of five hundred to two thousand roubles.
koap-uae32387239675beb7f-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-uc52eb743695c35a18e-1.text: 2. Violation by parents or other legal representatives of minors of the rights and interests of minors, consisting of depriving them of the right to communicate with their parents or close relatives where such communication does not conflict with the children's interests; deliberately concealing the children's whereabouts against their will; failing to comply with a court decision determining the children's place of residence, including a court decision determining their place of residence for the period before a court decision determining their place of residence takes legal effect; failing to comply with a court decision on the manner of exercising parental rights or on the manner of exercising parental rights for the period before the court decision takes legal effect; or otherwise obstructing parents' exercise of their rights to raise and educate their children and to protect their children's rights and interests —
koap-uc52eb743695c35a18e-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-2.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-1.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-u715e477a13dd1af2c2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to five days.
koap-u715e477a13dd1af2c2-1.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

koap-u4f7cf6c2c6fd5ff3e7-1.text: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work
koap-u4f7cf6c2c6fd5ff3e7-1.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-u8b55e0e673952e0f99-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work
koap-u8b55e0e673952e0f99-1.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-u440e68bc1fd3997ed3-1.text: 1. Failure by a parent, without valid reasons and in breach of a court decision or a notarised agreement, to pay maintenance in the amount established in accordance with that court decision or notarised agreement for minor children or children incapable of work who have reached eighteen years of age, for two or more months from the commencement of enforcement proceedings, where such actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u440e68bc1fd3997ed3-1.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-ud0f518dd4c25333601-1.text: shall entail compulsory work for up to one hundred and fifty hours or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or an administrative fine of twenty thousand roubles for persons to whom compulsory work or administrative arrest cannot be applied under this Code.
koap-ud0f518dd4c25333601-1.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-u4a90427ed192170800-1.text: 2. Failure by adult children capable of work, without valid reasons and in breach of a court decision or a notarised agreement, to pay maintenance in the amount established in accordance with that court decision or notarised agreement for parents incapable of work, for two or more months from the commencement of enforcement proceedings, where such actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u4a90427ed192170800-1.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-ud0f518dd4c25333601-2.text: shall entail compulsory work for up to one hundred and fifty hours or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or an administrative fine of twenty thousand roubles for persons to whom compulsory work or administrative arrest cannot be applied under this Code.
koap-ud0f518dd4c25333601-2.locator: Article 5.35.1. Failure to pay maintenance for children or parents incapable of work

koap-uf69eabfc7eb8e3b9e4-1.text: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care
koap-uf69eabfc7eb8e3b9e4-1.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-u6dbe0bf89da9d78adb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care
koap-u6dbe0bf89da9d78adb-1.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-u2edc49850ab6d7acb3-1.text: 1. Violation by the head of an institution accommodating children left without parental care, or by an official of an executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body, of the procedure or time limits for providing information on a minor requiring placement with a family (for adoption, under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family) or in an institution for orphans or children left without parental care, as well as provision of knowingly inaccurate information about such a minor —
koap-u2edc49850ab6d7acb3-1.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-2.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-ue798466e27660e9aa8-1.text: 2. Actions by the head of an institution accommodating children left without parental care, or by an official of an executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body, aimed at concealing a minor to prevent placement with a family (for adoption, under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family) or in an institution for orphans or children left without parental care —
koap-ue798466e27660e9aa8-1.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-3.locator: Article 5.36. Violation of the procedure or time limits for providing information on minors requiring placement with a family or in institutions for orphans or children left without parental care

koap-u0e1768c3acdd30659b-1.text: Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family
koap-u0e1768c3acdd30659b-1.locator: Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family

koap-u4cc5f3973666f9f80a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family
koap-u4cc5f3973666f9f80a-1.locator: Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family

koap-ua65305b3db2430a5cc-1.text: Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family —
koap-ua65305b3db2430a5cc-1.locator: Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family

koap-u8cf46b1ce64dd43d74-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, four thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8cf46b1ce64dd43d74-1.locator: Article 5.37. Unlawful actions concerning adoption of a child or placement of a child under guardianship (curatorship) or with a foster family

koap-u5a48f7b5b38ba2cf92-1.text: Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing
koap-u5a48f7b5b38ba2cf92-1.locator: Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing

koap-udf73d125883a975abb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing
koap-udf73d125883a975abb-1.locator: Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing

koap-uccacacd13562684900-1.text: Obstruction of the organisation or conduct of, or participation in, an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picketing held in accordance with Russian Federation legislation, as well as coercion to participate in such events —
koap-uccacacd13562684900-1.locator: Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing

koap-ud7f466c83919269c19-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for citizens and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-ud7f466c83919269c19-1.locator: Article 5.38. Violation of legislation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing

koap-u3c7ad775147fb0127d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.39. Refusal to provide information

koap-u8f61cee923de4538c1-1.text: Unlawful refusal to provide a citizen, including an advocate in connection with an advocate's request received from that advocate, and (or) an organisation with information whose provision is required by federal laws, late provision of such information, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information —

koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials.

koap-u9747f251d8e594c0d6-1.text: Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike
koap-u9747f251d8e594c0d6-1.locator: Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike

koap-uf046f10dc3ca2916b8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike
koap-uf046f10dc3ca2916b8-1.locator: Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike

koap-u041a6bb0c65d9d967a-1.text: Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike through violence or threats of violence, or by exploiting the dependent position of the person subjected to coercion —
koap-u041a6bb0c65d9d967a-1.locator: Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike

koap-u00376d28e7fea4edae-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles for citizens and one thousand to two thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u00376d28e7fea4edae-2.locator: Article 5.40. Coercion to participate in or refrain from participating in a strike

koap-ueb84a874af5670fa8e-1.text: Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance
koap-ueb84a874af5670fa8e-1.locator: Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance

koap-u572128fd5929cc8e60-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance
koap-u572128fd5929cc8e60-1.locator: Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance

koap-uc88ce09fc0bc803649-1.text: Failure to provide free of charge the services included in the guaranteed list of burial services, as well as failure to pay the social burial allowance to the spouse, close relatives, other relatives, the deceased's legal representative or another person who has undertaken the duty to arrange the deceased's burial —
koap-uc88ce09fc0bc803649-1.locator: Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance

koap-u901ce1d828b00978c3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u901ce1d828b00978c3-1.locator: Article 5.41. Failure to provide burial services free of charge or to pay the social burial allowance

koap-u35892999ec101bc55a-1.text: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment
koap-u35892999ec101bc55a-1.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-u75fd66cbf4ecd3656f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment
koap-u75fd66cbf4ecd3656f-1.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-u5b352cc51220b824ed-1.text: 1. Failure by an employer to fulfil the duty to meet the quota for employing persons with disabilities, except where the employer is exempt from meeting the established quota, or an employer's refusal to employ a person with a disability within the established quota —
koap-u5b352cc51220b824ed-1.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-u66093b74460c8e5704-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for individual entrepreneurs, and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u66093b74460c8e5704-1.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-ucae83d6c4083d6a5ff-1.text: 2. Unjustified refusal to register a person with a disability as unemployed —
koap-ucae83d6c4083d6a5ff-1.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-2.locator: Article 5.42. Violation of the rights of persons with disabilities in job placement and employment

koap-u88f2c1b1b3cb06b1bc-1.text: Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities
koap-u88f2c1b1b3cb06b1bc-1.locator: Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities

koap-u32851f14a8a0484ca6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities
koap-u32851f14a8a0484ca6-1.locator: Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities

koap-u289fabc31ef0b4f482-1.text: Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities —
koap-u289fabc31ef0b4f482-1.locator: Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities

koap-u39cf929452150cddac-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for officials and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u39cf929452150cddac-1.locator: Article 5.43. Violation of legislative requirements to allocate parking (stopping) spaces for special motor vehicles of persons with disabilities

koap-u1a7c3cbad0046a76ec-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.44. Repealed
koap-u1a7c3cbad0046a76ec-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.44. Repealed

koap-u80245f893643f009e6-1.text: Article 5.44. Repealed from 1 January 2010. — Federal Law No. 213-FZ of 24.07.2009.
koap-u80245f893643f009e6-1.locator: Article 5.44. Repealed from 1 January 2010. — Federal Law No. 213-FZ of 24.07.2009.

koap-uf1ec0f94a3848d8ec0-1.text: Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-uf1ec0f94a3848d8ec0-1.locator: Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-uc1de45c879e3c57872-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-uc1de45c879e3c57872-1.locator: Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-ud2372d2c5dc5eed0dc-1.text: Use by a person holding a state or municipal office, serving in state or municipal service, or being a member of a governing body of an organisation irrespective of its form of ownership (in an organisation whose supreme governing body is an assembly, a member of the body directing that organisation's activities), other than a political party, of the advantages of that person's official or service position for the purpose of nominating and (or) electing a candidate or list of candidates, putting forward and (or) supporting an initiative to hold a referendum, or obtaining a particular answer to the question (questions) put to a referendum —
koap-ud2372d2c5dc5eed0dc-1.locator: Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-1.locator: Article 5.45. Use of the advantages of official or service position during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u68a4ed9931b5895ffc-1.text: Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures
koap-u68a4ed9931b5895ffc-1.locator: Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures

koap-ue18be9904e024f0013-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures
koap-ue18be9904e024f0013-1.locator: Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures

koap-u829e14a3cf48bd61e8-1.text: Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures collected in support of the nomination of a candidate or list of candidates or an initiative to hold a referendum, as well as certification of signatures (signature sheets) known to be forged by a person collecting voters' signatures or by an authorised person, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u829e14a3cf48bd61e8-1.locator: Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures

koap-ubf4db0098f80f79286-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-ubf4db0098f80f79286-1.locator: Article 5.46. Forgery of voters' or referendum participants' signatures

koap-u2c4587f953c4ae00ff-1.text: Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it
koap-u2c4587f953c4ae00ff-1.locator: Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it

koap-ufafb1ce4736cbad674-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it
koap-ufafb1ce4736cbad674-1.locator: Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it

koap-u612364535db3602731-1.text: Participation by state authorities, local self-government bodies, governing bodies of organisations irrespective of their form of ownership, institutions, or voting members of election commissions in collecting voters' signatures in support of the nomination of a candidate or list of candidates or referendum participants' signatures in support of an initiative to hold a referendum, as well as collection of signatures at workplaces, during and at the places of payment of wages, pensions, allowances or other social payments, and when providing charitable assistance —
koap-u612364535db3602731-1.locator: Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it

koap-u55c604faa249a8b8ec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles for citizens, two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials, and ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u55c604faa249a8b8ec-1.locator: Article 5.47. Collection of voters' or referendum participants' signatures in prohibited places, and collection of signatures by persons prohibited by federal law from participating in it

koap-u3ec69a1e509a630a30-1.text: Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials
koap-u3ec69a1e509a630a30-1.locator: Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials

koap-u6e7abe9f278c67b6f9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials
koap-u6e7abe9f278c67b6f9-1.locator: Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials

koap-ucf9ce16e64cb7b8dc2-1.text: Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants to place campaign materials on an object owned by the state or a municipality, or by an organisation in whose charter (pooled) capital the share (contribution) of the Russian Federation, constituent entities of the Russian Federation and (or) municipal entities exceeds 30 per cent on the day of official publication (publication) of the decision calling the election or registration of the referendum initiative group, as well as violation by organisations providing advertising services of the conditions for placing campaign materials —
koap-ucf9ce16e64cb7b8dc2-1.locator: Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials

koap-u686c2c7e087910a3bc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles for officials and twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u686c2c7e087910a3bc-1.locator: Article 5.48. Violation of the rights of registered candidates, electoral associations, referendum initiative groups or other groups of referendum participants when allocating space for campaign materials

koap-uf9d937096769d12469-1.text: Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-uf9d937096769d12469-1.locator: Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u41124713b5fd1f315e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign
koap-u41124713b5fd1f315e-1.locator: Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-uf4ea257c3f7c75f835-1.text: Violation of the prohibition on holding, during an election campaign or referendum campaign, lotteries or other risk-based games in which winning prizes or participating in prize draws depends on voting totals or the results of an election or referendum, or which are otherwise connected with an election or referendum —
koap-uf4ea257c3f7c75f835-1.locator: Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-ufda67db86f7fb83e08-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, three thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, and thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ufda67db86f7fb83e08-1.locator: Article 5.49. Violation of the prohibition on holding lotteries and other risk-based games connected with an election or referendum during an election campaign or referendum campaign

koap-u270020832b30a6e26b-1.text: Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund
koap-u270020832b30a6e26b-1.locator: Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund

koap-u7c1c785b90612b27e9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund
koap-u7c1c785b90612b27e9-1.locator: Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund

koap-u49099670f8d14717a1-1.text: Failure to return to the donor, within the period prescribed by legislation on elections and referendums, donations (or portions thereof) transferred to an electoral fund or referendum fund in breach of the requirements of that legislation, or failure to transfer donations made by anonymous donors to the revenue of the relevant budget within that period —
koap-u49099670f8d14717a1-1.locator: Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund

koap-u4d203ca3c6899047d4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for a candidate, a person who was a candidate, a person elected as a deputy, or an authorised financial representative of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, and one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for an electoral association.
koap-u4d203ca3c6899047d4-1.locator: Article 5.50. Violation of the rules for transferring funds contributed to an electoral fund or referendum fund

koap-uc755ec7a820e50d940-2.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 93-FZ of 21.07.2005.

koap-u53c2a948c43513f7e6-1.text: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums
koap-u53c2a948c43513f7e6-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-u9ab637a63c6b2c9f9b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums
koap-u9ab637a63c6b2c9f9b-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-u5f8788b1bd0ac3f79e-1.text: 1. Failure by the chairperson, deputy chairperson or secretary of an election commission or referendum commission to submit documents relating to the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum to a higher election commission or referendum commission, or submission of such documents in breach of the statutory time limits —
koap-u5f8788b1bd0ac3f79e-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-uc28621cd57b2b2a887-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uc28621cd57b2b2a887-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-ucd2e38a73e871a4a33-1.text: 2. Destruction of documents relating to the preparation and conduct of an election or referendum before their retention periods expire, as well as violation of the established procedure for destroying such documents —
koap-ucd2e38a73e871a4a33-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-u6638d42a0f76070ea0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles for citizens and two thousand to five thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u6638d42a0f76070ea0-1.locator: Article 5.56. Violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting and storing documents relating to the preparation and conduct of elections or referendums

koap-u8ae32c0a3242e0858c-1.text: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation
koap-u8ae32c0a3242e0858c-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-ua0b18aad5d772080a1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation
koap-ua0b18aad5d772080a1-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-ud4cf50898687218faa-1.text: 1. Violation or unlawful restriction of the right to education, consisting of violation or restriction of the right to receive universally accessible and free education, as well as unlawful refusal of admission to an educational organisation or unlawful dismissal (expulsion) from an educational organisation —
koap-ud4cf50898687218faa-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-u5cc9c3985ef495e86d-1.text: 2. Violation or unlawful restriction of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation, or violation of the established procedure for exercising those rights and freedoms —
koap-u5cc9c3985ef495e86d-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-uc177a3b9f395f5667d-1.text: 3. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article by an official previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-uc177a3b9f395f5667d-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation

koap-u23b3125e2a6282111f-1.text: shall entail disqualification for one to two years.
koap-u23b3125e2a6282111f-1.locator: Article 5.57. Violation of the right to education and of the rights and freedoms of students of educational organisations provided for by education legislation
