koap-ubed77a855589ca8d31-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.61. Insult

koap-uf1865222f52f793a00-1.text: 1. Insult, that is, humiliation of another person's honour and dignity expressed in an indecent form or another form contrary to generally accepted standards of morals and ethics —

koap-u79a7a411c24d9e73ec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.

koap-uc4e7c01bb45fbc3859-1.text: 2. Insult contained in a public speech, a publicly displayed work or the mass media, or committed publicly using information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, or directed at several persons, including persons not individually identified —

koap-u12e870b45e8b71f181-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for citizens, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.

koap-uf0e09414b9a54e4760-1.text: 3. Failure to take measures to prevent insult in a publicly displayed work, the mass media or information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet —

koap-u563f93f532b4e5234f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.

koap-uf4f56dc9bb74ecf707-1.text: 4. Insult committed by a person holding a state or municipal office or a position in the state civil service or municipal service in connection with the exercise of that person's powers (official duties) —

koap-ud1cbe1939ec5e0fde4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year.

koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-1.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 4 of this Article —

koap-u5b2eb5abe35422356a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to two years.

koap-ue1def646b18b422457-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.61.1. Defamation

koap-u3086620cace4b60d46-1.text: Defamation, that is, dissemination of knowingly false information that discredits another person's honour and dignity or undermines that person's reputation —

koap-udef80692b51df042d1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred thousand to three million roubles for legal entities.

koap-uc9fdb8dd0b02f09b87-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.62. Discrimination

koap-u5d84ab57f0a1bdef23-1.text: Discrimination, that is, violation of the rights, freedoms and legitimate interests of a person and citizen on the grounds of sex, race, skin colour, ethnicity, language, origin, property status, family status, social or official position, age, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, or membership or non-membership of public associations or any social groups —

koap-u5364e64468cfbac513-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles for citizens and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.

koap-u951ca8d9fc7b9c8648-1.text: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services
koap-u951ca8d9fc7b9c8648-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-ubf6c1a65bbcc47ca23-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services
koap-ubf6c1a65bbcc47ca23-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-ue6bf27d52605f7bc83-1.text: 1. Violation by an official of a federal executive authority or a body of a state extra-budgetary fund of the Russian Federation, an employee of a multifunctional centre, an employee of another organisation performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, or an employee of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights, of the procedure for providing a state service supplied by a federal executive authority or a state extra-budgetary fund of the Russian Federation, resulting in failure to provide the state service to the applicant or provision of that service to the applicant in breach of the prescribed time limits, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 2.1 of this Article, where such actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ue6bf27d52605f7bc83-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-uaa8d083081adefa0d2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for officials of federal executive authorities or bodies of state extra-budgetary funds of the Russian Federation, and one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles for employees of multifunctional centres, employees of other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, and employees of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights.
koap-uaa8d083081adefa0d2-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-uaf693519f3683bc466-1.text: 1.1. Violation by an official of an executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body exercising executive and administrative powers of the procedure for providing a state service, where relations arising in connection with the provision of that state service are regulated by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, resulting in failure to provide the state service to the applicant or provision of that service to the applicant in breach of the prescribed time limits, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 2.1 of this Article, where such actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uaf693519f3683bc466-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u14c0ce74b5aa29a0e8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or local self-government bodies exercising executive and administrative powers.
koap-u14c0ce74b5aa29a0e8-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u07d685be0ff46e2e18-1.text: 2. A demand by the persons specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article for documents and (or) payment for the provision of state services that are not provided for by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, where such actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u07d685be0ff46e2e18-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u397e9f96f8184fdc68-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials of federal executive authorities, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies exercising executive and administrative powers, or bodies of state extra-budgetary funds of the Russian Federation, and one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles for employees of multifunctional centres, employees of other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, and employees of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights.
koap-u397e9f96f8184fdc68-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u05b422d99cf5d7affe-1.text: 2.1. Refusal by an official of a state authority, local self-government body or body of a state extra-budgetary fund of the Russian Federation, an employee of a multifunctional centre, an employee of another organisation performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, or an employee of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights, to provide a state or municipal service or to perform a state or municipal function because the applicant refuses to undergo identification and (or) authentication using the applicant's biometric personal data —
koap-u05b422d99cf5d7affe-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u057f9ffa61eeb25448-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for officials of state authorities, local self-government bodies or bodies of state extra-budgetary funds of the Russian Federation, and an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for employees of multifunctional centres, employees of other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, and employees of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights.
koap-u057f9ffa61eeb25448-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u1fd6b10cd9ee32677d-1.text: 3. Violation by an official authorised to consider complaints concerning a breach of the procedure for providing a state or municipal service of the procedure or time limits for considering a complaint, or unlawful refusal or evasion by that official to accept it for consideration —
koap-u1fd6b10cd9ee32677d-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u394811978ee7c8cc54-1.text: 4. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1, 1.1 or 2 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u394811978ee7c8cc54-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u5e33baabf0a584cc1c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for officials of federal executive authorities, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies exercising executive and administrative powers, or bodies of state extra-budgetary funds of the Russian Federation, and an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for employees of multifunctional centres, employees of other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre under Russian Federation legislation, and employees of a public-law company providing state services in state cadastral recording and state registration of rights.
koap-u5e33baabf0a584cc1c-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u7e095b0478655c8929-1.text: 5. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u7e095b0478655c8929-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u9cc5f18d10ff63b9d3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year.
koap-u9cc5f18d10ff63b9d3-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-ue3486504f1b83db40f-1.text: Note. The provisions of this Article do not apply to the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.9.1 of this Code.
koap-ue3486504f1b83db40f-1.locator: Article 5.63. Violation of legislation on organising the provision of state and municipal services

koap-u9e5023b26a2ecce82e-1.text: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads
koap-u9e5023b26a2ecce82e-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-u7405247911f36f5969-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads
koap-u7405247911f36f5969-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-uaf739995c62984426a-1.text: 1. Violation of the prescribed time limits for approving routes for a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle or for issuing a special permit for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads, or unjustified refusal to approve routes for a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle or to issue a special permit for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads —
koap-uaf739995c62984426a-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-u964055cd5375122c7c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials and one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u964055cd5375122c7c-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-u91e00569a2484dc107-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and two hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u91e00569a2484dc107-1.locator: Article 5.63.1. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the issue of special permits for the movement of a heavy and (or) oversized vehicle on motor roads

koap-u37236eb358fa1ddbd3-1.text: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration
koap-u37236eb358fa1ddbd3-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-u89c6ee9685f898e044-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration
koap-u89c6ee9685f898e044-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-ua098cad289d7ce17cc-1.text: 1. Violation by an employee of a subordinate enterprise or authorised organisation of the requirements established by federal laws or normative legal acts adopted in accordance with them for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration, consisting of actions (inaction) that result in failure or delay by the federal executive authority responsible for internal affairs or its territorial body in providing a state service to the applicant, or failure or delay by that authority or its territorial body in performing a state function, where those actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ua098cad289d7ce17cc-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-u7198b0e63cfa33f49a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to four thousand roubles.
koap-u7198b0e63cfa33f49a-2.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-ucc8eb6d298b63b7f45-1.text: 2. Violation by an official or another employee of a subordinate enterprise or authorised organisation of the procedure by which that enterprise or organisation assists the federal executive authority responsible for internal affairs or its territorial body in exercising certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration, where those actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ucc8eb6d298b63b7f45-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-u971b4ed520279b064d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials and two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for other employees.
koap-u971b4ed520279b064d-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-u452fb22810afdc6583-1.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 or 2 of this Article —
koap-u452fb22810afdc6583-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-uc5a95924b24a8ef825-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for officials, and an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles or disqualification for six months for other employees.
koap-uc5a95924b24a8ef825-1.locator: Article 5.63.2. Violation of the procedure for assisting in the exercise of certain powers when providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration

koap-ud269768cec1d4cc6d6-1.text: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report
koap-ud269768cec1d4cc6d6-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u04e1ece6f676f6bd64-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report
koap-u04e1ece6f676f6bd64-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u26a2c604d8f6bc9138-1.text: 1. Violation by a political party, its regional branch or another registered structural subdivision of the time limit established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for submitting information on the political party's receipts and expenditure; submission of that information in a lesser scope than required by that legislation or in breach of the prescribed form; or submission of knowingly inaccurate information —
koap-u26a2c604d8f6bc9138-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u8ea60349195f83182e-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for the political party, its regional branch or another registered structural subdivision.
koap-u8ea60349195f83182e-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u12a62942966e59ef22-1.text: 2. Repeated commission within a year of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u12a62942966e59ef22-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u9200736f239cd50f77-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials and one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for the political party, its regional branch or another registered structural subdivision.
koap-u9200736f239cd50f77-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u795af0d10f21761c90-1.text: 3. Violation by a political party of the time limit established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for submitting the political party's consolidated financial report; submission of that report in a lesser scope than required by that legislation or in breach of the prescribed form; or inclusion of knowingly inaccurate information in that report —
koap-u795af0d10f21761c90-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u1c9f4e43e159e7faa9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for the political party.
koap-u1c9f4e43e159e7faa9-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u4df0fc50c0e9ddf98a-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article during the next reporting period established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties —
koap-u4df0fc50c0e9ddf98a-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-ua78a49afe38b15b1ca-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials and two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for the political party.
koap-ua78a49afe38b15b1ca-1.locator: Article 5.64. Violation of the procedure or time limit for submitting information on a political party's receipts and expenditure or a political party's consolidated financial report

koap-u3bbf2d1c2b2dca5f0a-1.text: Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums
koap-u3bbf2d1c2b2dca5f0a-1.locator: Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-ua6ca22bea3e1ec6a67-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums
koap-ua6ca22bea3e1ec6a67-1.locator: Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-ua440f30ec662789190-1.text: Use by a political party or its regional branch, to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums, of money or other property received as donations from an individual, legal entity or other entity prohibited by Russian Federation legislation on political parties from making donations, received in an amount exceeding the maximum amount of the corresponding donation, or transferred (delivered) in breach of the procedure established by that legislation —
koap-ua440f30ec662789190-1.locator: Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u5c4d22eb814b3e3138-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for the political party or its regional branch.
koap-u5c4d22eb814b3e3138-1.locator: Article 5.65. Unlawful use by a political party of money and other property to finance its activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u9e1f2bebf9b15bee1e-1.text: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums
koap-u9e1f2bebf9b15bee1e-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u64a26389fb4b5b5c4c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums
koap-u64a26389fb4b5b5c4c-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u30d34f342a659f9bb6-1.text: 1. Making a donation to a political party or its regional branch by an individual, legal entity or other entity prohibited by Russian Federation legislation on political parties from making donations, or making a donation in breach of the procedure established by that legislation for transferring (delivering) it to a political party or its regional branch —
koap-u30d34f342a659f9bb6-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-uee9c5e51b54e9c072d-1.text: 2. Transfer (delivery) of money and (or) other property to an individual or legal entity for that person or entity to make a donation to a political party or its regional branch, collection of money and (or) other property for those purposes, or assistance in such collection —
koap-uee9c5e51b54e9c072d-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-2.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u3fcdbf04f42972c4ce-1.text: 3. Making a donation to a political party or its regional branch by an individual or legal entity that received money and (or) other property from another person for the purpose of making the donation —
koap-u3fcdbf04f42972c4ce-1.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u91fa8c13154879422a-3.locator: Article 5.66. Unlawful financing of political parties' activities unrelated to participation in elections and referendums

koap-u9675e1ab14d854444e-1.text: Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation
koap-u9675e1ab14d854444e-1.locator: Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation

koap-u45446530a4781d55b9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation
koap-u45446530a4781d55b9-1.locator: Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation

koap-u79f63b0fa26c4062c5-1.text: Violation of the time limit established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for returning to the donor (or, where return is impossible, transferring (delivering) to the revenue of the Russian Federation) a donation (or part thereof) transferred (delivered) to a political party or its regional branch in breach of the procedure established by that legislation —
koap-u79f63b0fa26c4062c5-1.locator: Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation

koap-u65bc29199d76750e4e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u65bc29199d76750e4e-1.locator: Article 5.67. Violation of the time limit for returning donations to a political party to the donor or transferring (delivering) them to the revenue of the Russian Federation

koap-ud03b82e45edeff718b-1.text: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties
koap-ud03b82e45edeff718b-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-u03d59e043b3d125e58-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties
koap-u03d59e043b3d125e58-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-u9405d4525d06703cf3-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for a mandatory audit of a political party's annual accounting (financial) statements and consolidated financial report —
koap-u9405d4525d06703cf3-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-ud2c6b92bd452456054-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials and five hundred thousand to one million roubles for the political party.
koap-ud2c6b92bd452456054-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-u7d4eba0a9e193258d3-1.text: 2. Violation by a political party of the time limit established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for conducting a mandatory audit of all the political party's regional branches and other registered structural subdivisions —
koap-u7d4eba0a9e193258d3-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-ue403fc5265e063d50e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials and two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for the political party.
koap-ue403fc5265e063d50e-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-u0e3d1fd8e416f939a8-1.text: 3. Violation by a political party of the time limit established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties for submitting a copy of the auditor's opinion —
koap-u0e3d1fd8e416f939a8-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-uefebe6dbc99a40cf94-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for the political party.
koap-uefebe6dbc99a40cf94-1.locator: Article 5.68. Violation of mandatory audit requirements established by Russian Federation legislation on political parties

koap-ud7c440880f33515990-1.text: Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants
koap-ud7c440880f33515990-1.locator: Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants

koap-u0691527e41ba934dbd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants
koap-u0691527e41ba934dbd-1.locator: Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants

koap-u0295f5efd31d2fc9fb-1.text: Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, resulting in a violation of the procedure for the election commission's work established by that legislation, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u0295f5efd31d2fc9fb-1.locator: Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants

koap-u65ed01b00cde8f3c24-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens and twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u65ed01b00cde8f3c24-1.locator: Article 5.69. Interference with the exercise by an election commission or referendum commission of powers established by legislation on elections and referendums, or obstruction of voting by voters, referendum participants or all-Russian voting participants

koap-u126005aa22c0797bce-1.text: Chapter 6. Administrative offences infringing upon health, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, and public morality
koap-u126005aa22c0797bce-1.locator: Chapter 6. Administrative offences infringing upon health, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, and public morality

koap-u53dffb00a1d09026f3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 6. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES INFRINGING UPON HEALTH, THE SANITARY AND EPIDEMIOLOGICAL WELL-BEING OF THE POPULATION, AND PUBLIC MORALITY
koap-u53dffb00a1d09026f3-1.locator: Chapter 6. Administrative offences infringing upon health, the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, and public morality

koap-u30f5d11c6a4b5b79cb-1.text: Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection
koap-u30f5d11c6a4b5b79cb-1.locator: Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection

koap-u485db51ef486a4f163-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection
koap-u485db51ef486a4f163-1.locator: Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection

koap-u3cb7bdac4a8be34301-1.text: Concealment by a person with HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease of the source of infection, as well as of persons who have had contact with that person creating a risk of infection with those diseases —
koap-u3cb7bdac4a8be34301-1.locator: Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-3.locator: Article 6.1. Concealment of the source of HIV infection or a sexually transmitted disease and of contacts creating a risk of infection

koap-u37027174c380edb92f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.1.1. Battery

koap-u11919e0a47bd84646a-1.text: Infliction of blows or commission of other violent acts causing physical pain but not resulting in the consequences specified in Article 115 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-ue27d408fc10132b081-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to thirty thousand roubles, administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or compulsory work for sixty to one hundred and twenty hours.

koap-u156fb1f18900e764ae-1.text: Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine
koap-u156fb1f18900e764ae-1.locator: Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine

koap-u13add878053c04bc25-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine
koap-u13add878053c04bc25-1.locator: Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine

koap-u8c2f8bf66dc95360c4-1.text: Practising traditional medicine without obtaining the authorisation required by law —
koap-u8c2f8bf66dc95360c4-1.locator: Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine

koap-ue404feaf9bbd51aa6b-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand roubles.
koap-ue404feaf9bbd51aa6b-2.locator: Article 6.2. Unlawful practice of traditional medicine

koap-u14240415baddd33760-1.text: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population
koap-u14240415baddd33760-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u220b8ed4ade5a4dac6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population
koap-u220b8ed4ade5a4dac6-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u65cda4e737ee887d03-1.text: 1. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population, consisting of a breach of applicable sanitary rules and hygiene standards or failure to carry out sanitary, hygienic and anti-epidemic measures —
koap-u65cda4e737ee887d03-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u9c5010780137d95896-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one hundred to five hundred roubles for citizens; five hundred to one thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u9c5010780137d95896-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u1154c3a579225d74b0-1.text: 2. The same actions (inaction) committed during an emergency situation regime, when a threat arises of the spread of a disease posing a danger to others, or while restrictive measures (quarantine) are being implemented in the relevant territory; or failure to comply within the prescribed period with a lawful directive (resolution) or requirement issued during those periods by a body (official) exercising federal state sanitary and epidemiological supervision concerning the implementation of sanitary and anti-epidemic (preventive) measures —
koap-u1154c3a579225d74b0-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u511f8a4a45378248b4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to forty thousand roubles for citizens; fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u511f8a4a45378248b4-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u93898408ba38de103c-1.text: 3. The actions (inaction) provided for by part 2 of this Article resulting in harm to human health or a person's death, where those actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u93898408ba38de103c-1.locator: Article 6.3. Violation of legislation on ensuring the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of the population

koap-u6f945f2cb9edf7d7eb-1.locator: Article 6.9. Consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription, or of new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances

koap-u0304747404ff556bfe-1.text: 2. The same act committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u0304747404ff556bfe-1.locator: Article 6.9. Consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription, or of new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances

koap-u30af646972c48482ba-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u30af646972c48482ba-1.locator: Article 6.9. Consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription, or of new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances

koap-u7a0f08b04732dd17ee-1.text: Note. A person who voluntarily applies to a medical organisation for treatment in connection with the consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription shall be exempt from administrative liability for this offence. A person recognised in the prescribed manner as suffering from drug addiction may, with that person's consent, be referred for medical and (or) social rehabilitation and shall in that connection be exempt from administrative liability for offences related to the consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances. This note also applies to the administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 20.20 of this Code.

koap-u095fa951a618e2cfca-1.locator: Article 6.9.1. koap-u4ed3d12c4736ea7b5b-1.text: Note. koap-u21aecd9676fb3bbcd5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to thirty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the products that constituted the object of the administrative offence and administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u21aecd9676fb3bbcd5-1.locator: Article 6.13. Dissemination of information about narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and analogues of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in breach of requirements established by Russian Federation legislation

koap-u33aeea624895839175-1.text: 1. For the purposes of applying parts 2–4 of this Article, promotion of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, their analogues or precursors, or plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors means dissemination of information and (or) materials whose dissemination is prohibited by paragraph 1 of Article 46 of Federal Law No. 3-FZ of 8 January 1998 “On Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances” and Article 4 of Law of the Russian Federation No. 2124-I of 27 December 1991 “On the Mass Media”.
koap-u33aeea624895839175-1.locator: Article 6.13. Dissemination of information about narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and analogues of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in breach of requirements established by Russian Federation legislation

koap-u7fb7486d4f2aad1a6e-1.text: 2. The provisions of parts 2–4 of this Article do not apply to the cases provided for by subparagraphs 1–4 of paragraph 2 of Article 46 of Federal Law No. 3-FZ of 8 January 1998 “On Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances”.
koap-u7fb7486d4f2aad1a6e-1.locator: Article 6.13. Dissemination of information about narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and analogues of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances in breach of requirements established by Russian Federation legislation

koap-u1469a2256f965179e4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.13.1. Promotion of nitrous oxide

koap-uc0fb32ad1fe5f507a5-1.text: Promotion, including through the Internet information and telecommunications network, of the use (consumption) of nitrous oxide, or dissemination of information on the sale (supply) of nitrous oxide for purposes other than the production of food products, food commodities or foodstuffs, or other than medical, industrial or technical use —

koap-uadeb9b67b4a7c641e0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles for citizens; ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days for legal entities.

koap-ub585bf02a6ee7b20bd-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for producing, manufacturing, processing, storing, recording, dispensing, selling, distributing, transporting, acquiring, using, importing, exporting or destroying narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances included in Schedule I and Table I of Schedule IV of the List of Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Their Precursors Subject to Control in the Russian Federation; or of the rules for storing, recording, selling, transporting, acquiring, using, importing, exporting or destroying plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors; or failure to submit to a state body the reports required by law on activities connected with their circulation, late submission of such reports, or submission of incomplete or distorted reports —
koap-ub585bf02a6ee7b20bd-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-u45721d46568a110a24-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with or without confiscation of the narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances or their precursors, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with or without confiscation of the narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances or their precursors.
koap-u45721d46568a110a24-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-ue2b55f4df6e8577e05-1.text: 2. The same actions committed in relation to precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances included in Table II of Schedule IV of the List of Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Their Precursors Subject to Control in the Russian Federation —
koap-ue2b55f4df6e8577e05-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-udd1ae89dd8b4774c62-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with or without confiscation of the precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with or without confiscation of the precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances.
koap-udd1ae89dd8b4774c62-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-ue7bff62f7066997c40-1.text: 3. The same actions committed in relation to precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances included in Table III of Schedule IV of the List of Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Their Precursors Subject to Control in the Russian Federation —
koap-ue7bff62f7066997c40-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-uc84ba334bae02baf23-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with or without confiscation of the precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances.
koap-uc84ba334bae02baf23-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-uee13a0f26bbaeaa489-1.text: Note. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, insofar as they concern violation of the rules governing the circulation of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances included in Schedule IV of the List of Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Their Precursors Subject to Control in the Russian Federation, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-uee13a0f26bbaeaa489-1.locator: Article 6.16. Violation of the rules governing the circulation of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, or the storage, recording, sale, transport, acquisition, use, import, export or destruction of plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors, and parts of such plants containing narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances or their precursors

koap-ue24e6557ffefad6829-1.text: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances
koap-ue24e6557ffefad6829-1.locator: Article 6.16.1. koap-ucaae84ba843798d95a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.16.1. koap-ucaae84ba843798d95a-1.locator: Article 6.16.1. koap-uc9de8486ac77ee21bb-1.text: 1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uc9de8486ac77ee21bb-1.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-uc47e563e9cb996b782-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-uc47e563e9cb996b782-2.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-2.text: 2. The same actions committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-2.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u6c1da9087f81749eec-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u6c1da9087f81749eec-2.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-3.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u89226598bb05605daa-1.text: 1. A person who has committed the administrative offence provided for by this Article and voluntarily surrenders the acquired precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances shall be exempt from administrative liability for that administrative offence. Seizure of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances after an administrative offence case has been initiated may not be regarded as their voluntary surrender.
koap-u89226598bb05605daa-1.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u8b2ffa9713bfbe73a6-1.text: 2. This Article applies to the circulation of precursors included in Schedule I and Table I of Schedule IV of the List of Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Their Precursors Subject to Control in the Russian Federation, approved by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u8b2ffa9713bfbe73a6-1.locator: Article 6.16.1. Unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, production, supply or sending of precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, and unlawful acquisition, storage, transport, supply or sending of plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances, or parts of such plants containing precursors of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances

koap-u2ffd7d3b1d05690e7d-1.text: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development
koap-u2ffd7d3b1d05690e7d-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u0f8f78596c2e4e18dc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development
koap-u0f8f78596c2e4e18dc-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-ucd95468f97d0594b2a-1.text: 1. Violation of the established requirements for distributing among children information products containing information harmful to their health and (or) development (except in the cases provided for by Articles 6.20, 6.21, 6.21.1 and 6.21.2, part 3 of Article 13.15, part 2 of Article 13.21 and Article 13.36 of this Code), where the act does not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ucd95468f97d0594b2a-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u3f44a82a14ecf76a14-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u3f44a82a14ecf76a14-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u324092873d22dacdcb-1.text: 2. Failure by a person organising access in places accessible to children to information disseminated through information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), other than communications operators providing those communications services under written communications service contracts, to apply administrative and organisational measures or technical and hardware-and-software means to protect children from information harmful to their health and (or) development —
koap-u324092873d22dacdcb-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-ucb673e667995098876-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity and twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ucb673e667995098876-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u76489a08f7b31a5884-1.text: 3. Placement in information products for children, including information products posted in information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), of an announcement recruiting children to participate in the creation of information products harmful to their health and (or) development —
koap-u76489a08f7b31a5884-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u8f9777181b9f9e6bf3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials, and twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8f9777181b9f9e6bf3-1.locator: Article 6.17. Violation of Russian Federation legislation on protecting children from information harmful to their health and (or) development

koap-u2199be49f9dc5eadb1-1.text: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport
koap-u2199be49f9dc5eadb1-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-u4632f3c5c3d9f363e8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport
koap-u4632f3c5c3d9f363e8-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-u653c7d6d983df06813-1.text: 1. Intentional violation by an athlete of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport, consisting of the athlete's use or attempted use of a prohibited substance and (or) a prohibited method (except where such actions do not constitute a violation of anti-doping rules under legislation on physical culture and sport, and except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article and Articles 6.9, 20.20 and 20.22 of this Code) —
koap-u653c7d6d983df06813-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-uea64900189bf7b58f6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uea64900189bf7b58f6-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-uedef5a478dae7148c6-1.text: 2. Distribution of a prohibited substance and (or) prohibited method by an athlete, coach, sports medicine specialist or other specialist in physical culture and sport (except where such actions do not constitute a violation of anti-doping rules under legislation on physical culture and sport, and except in the cases provided for by Articles 6.8, 6.16 and 6.16.1 of this Code), where those actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uedef5a478dae7148c6-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-u5c44199d3db788d8d7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to eighty thousand roubles.
koap-u5c44199d3db788d8d7-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-u4faa1d925d97153a14-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, a prohibited substance and (or) prohibited method means a substance and (or) method included in the lists of substances and (or) methods prohibited for use in sport, approved by the federal executive authority responsible for implementing state policy, normative legal regulation, provision of state services and management of state property in the field of physical culture and sport.
koap-u4faa1d925d97153a14-1.locator: Article 6.18. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for preventing and combating doping in sport

koap-u7f9a2fe5f4ca50f3d9-1.text: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation
koap-u7f9a2fe5f4ca50f3d9-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-u137f1189ff38a6c015-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation
koap-u137f1189ff38a6c015-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-u1f58f99400d4375898-1.text: Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation, consisting of provision of premises, vehicles or other material resources; creation of living conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation; provision of services facilitating child trafficking and (or) child exploitation; or financing child trafficking and (or) child exploitation —
koap-u1f58f99400d4375898-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-u6366e26c96735a0cd3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one million to five million roubles for legal entities or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u6366e26c96735a0cd3-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-4.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-ue9576354c376bc3728-1.text: 1. A legal entity shall bear liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article where the offence is committed on behalf of or in the interests of the legal entity by a person performing managerial functions in that organisation.
koap-ue9576354c376bc3728-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-ub9aec43e775e38ab70-1.text: 2. For the purposes of this Article, a person performing managerial functions in an organisation means a person performing the functions of its sole executive body, a member of its board of directors or another collective executive body, as well as a person performing organisational and administrative or administrative and economic functions in that organisation permanently, temporarily or under special authority.
koap-ub9aec43e775e38ab70-1.locator: Article 6.19. Creation by a legal entity of conditions for child trafficking and (or) child exploitation

koap-u1759e915bcec1e7749-1.text: Production, acquisition, storage, transport, distribution, public display or advertising by a legal entity of materials or objects containing pornographic depictions of minors —

koap-ua90ae2afe087961e15-1.locator: Article 6.20. Production by a legal entity of materials or objects containing pornographic depictions of minors and circulation of such materials or objects

koap-ue9576354c376bc3728-2.text: 1. A legal entity shall bear liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article where the offence is committed on behalf of or in the interests of the legal entity by a person performing managerial functions in that organisation.

koap-ufd3613fbb8a6f319d1-1.text: Failure by the organiser of an official sports competition that is not a sports federation to include in the rules (regulations) of that competition requirements prohibiting unlawful influence on the outcome of an official sports competition and prohibiting athletes, sports referees, coaches, heads of sports teams and other participants in an official sports competition from participating in gambling at bookmakers and totalisators by placing bets on an official sports competition —
koap-ufd3613fbb8a6f319d1-1.locator: Article 6.22. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for the rules (regulations) of official sports competitions

koap-u8ebb33755b6c655e1e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for citizens, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for officials, and eight hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8ebb33755b6c655e1e-1.locator: Article 6.22. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for the rules (regulations) of official sports competitions

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-6.locator: Article 6.22. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for the rules (regulations) of official sports competitions

koap-u7e3d144b5eb8bf8b61-1.text: 1. The organiser of an official sports competition shall bear liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article where instances of unlawful influence on the outcome of that competition have been established.
koap-u7e3d144b5eb8bf8b61-1.locator: Article 6.22. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for the rules (regulations) of official sports competitions

koap-u345c95303e5bd5cefc-1.text: 2. The requirement prohibiting participation in gambling at bookmakers and totalisators by placing bets on official sports competitions applies: to athletes, in respect of official competitions in the sport or sports in which they participate in the relevant official sports competitions; to sports referees, in respect of official competitions in the sport or sports for which they ensure compliance with the rules of the sport or sports and the rules (regulations) of the relevant official sports competitions; to coaches, in respect of official competitions in the sport or sports in which they conduct training activities and direct the competitive activities of athletes participating in the relevant official sports competitions; to heads of sports teams, in respect of official competitions in the sport or sports in which the sports teams they lead participate in the relevant official sports competitions; and to other participants in official sports competitions, in respect of official competitions in the sport or sports in which they participate in the relevant official sports competitions.
koap-u345c95303e5bd5cefc-1.locator: Article 6.22. Violation of requirements established by legislation on physical culture and sport for the rules (regulations) of official sports competitions

koap-u6c67b5de40a862fd84-1.text: 1. Organisation of a public performance of a work of literature, art or folk creativity containing obscene language by holding a theatrical, cultural and educational, or entertainment event —
koap-u6c67b5de40a862fd84-1.locator: Article 6.26. Organisation of a public performance of a work of literature, art or folk creativity containing obscene language by holding a theatrical, cultural and educational, or entertainment event

koap-ucca9c0ea3c4901a9b9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, four thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, and forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ucca9c0ea3c4901a9b9-1.locator: Article 6.26. Organisation of a public performance of a work of literature, art or folk creativity containing obscene language by holding a theatrical, cultural and educational, or entertainment event

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-3.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
