koap-u17683e638804a9734d-1.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-u74bc49fb3a5441b77e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning
koap-u74bc49fb3a5441b77e-1.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-u0da41299288968d13d-1.text: 1. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products (other than mass media products), containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning consisting of the words “contains obscene language” —
koap-u0da41299288968d13d-1.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-ucca9c0ea3c4901a9b9-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, four thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, and forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ucca9c0ea3c4901a9b9-2.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-4.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-4.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-u3176bb7e07bd87fe55-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles for citizens; an administrative fine of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year for officials; an administrative fine of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u3176bb7e07bd87fe55-2.locator: Article 6.27. Distribution of copies of audiovisual products and phonograms on any media, or copies of printed products, containing obscene language without special packaging and a written warning

koap-ub35fe91e14af448272-1.locator: Article 6.28. Violation of established rules governing the circulation of medical devices

koap-u1abf32f51077e7513e-1.text: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities
koap-u1abf32f51077e7513e-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-ud6eeb61d98206831d9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities
koap-ud6eeb61d98206831d9-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u1570bdaa55f46cbcbf-1.text: 1. Failure by a medical professional to provide information on the occurrence of a conflict of interest to the head of the medical organisation where that professional works, or by a pharmaceutical professional to provide information on the occurrence of a conflict of interest to the head of the pharmacy organisation where that professional works —
koap-u1570bdaa55f46cbcbf-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-3.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-ue8651fcef76e748075-1.text: 2. Failure or delay by the head of a medical organisation in submitting notification of the occurrence of a medical professional's conflict of interest, or by the head of a pharmacy organisation in submitting notification of the occurrence of a pharmaceutical professional's conflict of interest, to the authorised federal executive authority —
koap-ue8651fcef76e748075-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-2.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u85eac4c762390042fc-1.text: 3. Failure by an individual entrepreneur carrying on medical or pharmaceutical activities to provide information on the occurrence of a conflict of interest to the authorised federal executive authority —
koap-u85eac4c762390042fc-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-4.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-u7b3c61372304869767-1.text: 4. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by parts 1, 2 and 3 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u7b3c61372304869767-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-ud9718d08c2e86ec55e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months.
koap-ud9718d08c2e86ec55e-1.locator: Article 6.29. Failure to fulfil duties to provide information on a conflict of interest in medical and pharmaceutical activities

koap-ub70c253667f6e313fa-1.text: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens
koap-ub70c253667f6e313fa-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-uc33877bf14cae0b5b6-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-uea1181dfef2857f34b-1.text: 1. Failure by a medical organisation to fulfil its duty to inform citizens of the possibility of obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens —
koap-uea1181dfef2857f34b-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-ua353fec1b48b94f853-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles for officials and ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ua353fec1b48b94f853-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-ue21e6656cf444f8623-1.text: 2. Failure by a medical organisation participating in the implementation of the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens to fulfil its duty to provide patients with information on the procedure, scope and conditions for providing medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens —
koap-ue21e6656cf444f8623-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-ue72882b6400893a80b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for officials and twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ue72882b6400893a80b-1.locator: Article 6.30. Failure to fulfil duties to inform citizens about obtaining medical care under the programme of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens and territorial programmes of state guarantees of free medical care for citizens

koap-u13bd9a95047f846513-1.text: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components
koap-u13bd9a95047f846513-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u4772caff4776c29a41-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components
koap-u4772caff4776c29a41-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u27b3adb651e34ab5b6-1.text: 1. Failure by entities involved in the circulation of donated blood and (or) its components to comply with the rules established by the Government of the Russian Federation for the collection, storage, transport and clinical use of donated blood and its components —
koap-u27b3adb651e34ab5b6-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u14a5cd7a415bcbdfac-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials, and an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u14a5cd7a415bcbdfac-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u1b80ba23a22f4b299a-1.text: 2. Failure to report, or concealment of, information on reactions and complications arising in recipients in connection with transfusion of donated blood and (or) its components by entities involved in the circulation of donated blood and (or) its components that carry out their clinical use —
koap-u1b80ba23a22f4b299a-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u048f5ca36e9b87906e-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for officials and thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u048f5ca36e9b87906e-1.locator: Article 6.31. Violation of legislation on the donation of blood and its components

koap-u2be82c30b0cf89aa98-1.text: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy
koap-u2be82c30b0cf89aa98-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-uef152fc23823b790d3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy
koap-uef152fc23823b790d3-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-ua36abdb7179dc3521b-1.text: 1. Violation of health protection legislation requirements concerning the obtaining of informed voluntary consent —
koap-ua36abdb7179dc3521b-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-u25001d258a0e4a488b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles for citizens, five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials, and forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u25001d258a0e4a488b-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-u746a2f5101e9bb75da-1.text: 2. Violation of the time limits established by health protection legislation for performing an induced termination of pregnancy, including where medical or social indications exist and taking account of the periods elapsed since the woman applied to a medical organisation for an induced termination of pregnancy —
koap-u746a2f5101e9bb75da-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-ubfb7175c7f63539465-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ubfb7175c7f63539465-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-uc43469a293bfed2193-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, citizens means medical professionals who are not officials.
koap-uc43469a293bfed2193-1.locator: Article 6.32. Violation of health protection legislation requirements when performing an induced termination of pregnancy

koap-u002f799c14c1cfb369-1.text: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements
koap-u002f799c14c1cfb369-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u46e21bc510d1711cef-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements
koap-u46e21bc510d1711cef-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-udfb02b73ed59d28cfd-1.text: 1. Production, sale or import into the Russian Federation of falsified medicines; production, sale or import into the Russian Federation of falsified medical devices; sale or import into the Russian Federation of counterfeit medicines; sale or import into the Russian Federation of counterfeit medical devices; or circulation of falsified biologically active supplements, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-udfb02b73ed59d28cfd-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u4691b279a247fa4c31-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for citizens; one hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for individual entrepreneurs; and an administrative fine of one million to five million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u4691b279a247fa4c31-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u53e772add6652c864e-1.text: 2. Sale or import into the Russian Federation of substandard medicines; sale or import into the Russian Federation of substandard medical devices; or unlawful production, sale or import into the Russian Federation of unregistered medicines, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u53e772add6652c864e-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u4691b279a247fa4c31-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for citizens; one hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for individual entrepreneurs; and an administrative fine of one million to five million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u4691b279a247fa4c31-2.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u20c3db56ef829d1123-1.text: 3. Sale of falsified, counterfeit, substandard or unregistered medicines or falsified biologically active supplements, or sale of falsified, counterfeit or substandard medical devices, using the mass media or information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u20c3db56ef829d1123-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-uc0cbc869dfceadeb00-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of seventy-five thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for citizens; one hundred and fifty thousand to six hundred thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of one hundred and fifty thousand to six hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for individual entrepreneurs; and an administrative fine of two million to six million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-uc0cbc869dfceadeb00-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-uc204a76b0c6b8536f3-1.text: Note. The actions provided for by part 2 or 3 of this Article shall not constitute an administrative offence where the sale and (or) import of unregistered medicines or medical devices is permitted under legislation on the circulation of medicines and health protection legislation, and (or) those medicines or medical devices are not produced in the Russian Federation, and (or) those medicines or medical devices are recommended for use by the World Health Organization.
koap-uc204a76b0c6b8536f3-1.locator: Article 6.33. Circulation of falsified, counterfeit, substandard and unregistered medicines and medical devices, and circulation of falsified biologically active supplements

koap-u240c0d3bfe46870f3e-1.text: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use
koap-u240c0d3bfe46870f3e-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-uc168bb1886e94d20ec-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.34. koap-uc168bb1886e94d20ec-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-u158ab2c6ca58f7253c-1.text: 1. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without the identification markings required by Russian Federation legislation, or in breach of the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation for applying them, where such identification markings are mandatory and those actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u158ab2c6ca58f7253c-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-u24185c481104818ca0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the objects of the administrative offence, and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the objects of the administrative offence.
koap-u24185c481104818ca0-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-ud2617fbe04acceb610-1.text: 2. Late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use —
koap-ud2617fbe04acceb610-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-u4363332d5a59da3a8e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u4363332d5a59da3a8e-1.locator: Article 6.34. Production or sale of medicinal products for medical use without identification markings or in breach of the established procedure for applying them, or late entry of data or entry of inaccurate data into the system for monitoring the movement of medicinal products for medical use

koap-u2e04047b3da30cdc55-1.text: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste
koap-u2e04047b3da30cdc55-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-uc8650fee7b1268fc62-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste
koap-uc8650fee7b1268fc62-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-uc67cec7f43bbb04812-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements for the collection, accumulation, transport, processing, recovery or neutralisation of production and consumption waste, except in the cases provided for by part 7 of this Article —
koap-uc67cec7f43bbb04812-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u0f075d52db2a38ff85-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles for citizens; thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of fifty thousand to sixty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of two hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u0f075d52db2a38ff85-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u12a62942966e59ef22-2.text: 2. Repeated commission within a year of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u12a62942966e59ef22-2.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u10d15e5a7dd9f4f457-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to four thousand roubles for citizens; forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of seventy thousand to eighty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of four hundred thousand to five hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u10d15e5a7dd9f4f457-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u98105244e09f76d675-1.text: 3. The actions (inaction) provided for by part 1 of this Article resulting in harm to human health or the environment or the outbreak of an epidemic or epizootic, where those actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u98105244e09f76d675-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u96a0d41e16060f5f0e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens; fifty thousand to sixty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of eighty thousand to ninety thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of five hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-u96a0d41e16060f5f0e-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u41a342f4f7d1d015df-1.text: 4. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements for the placement of production and consumption waste, except in the cases provided for by part 10 of this Article —
koap-u41a342f4f7d1d015df-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u6a1c1fb2c5d0ad3b3d-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-ub9e41419ac29382b9a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles for citizens; fifty thousand to sixty thousand roubles for officials; an administrative fine of seventy thousand to eighty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity; and an administrative fine of four hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days for legal entities.
koap-ub9e41419ac29382b9a-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-u4c9da06dbf3c83e2c4-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-uc249fa6940716072c9-1.locator: Article 6.35. Failure to comply with sanitary and epidemiological requirements when handling production and consumption waste

koap-uc3d033fbd9cdc710f1-1.text: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot
koap-uc3d033fbd9cdc710f1-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-u01f32b90ef9e68a143-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot
koap-u01f32b90ef9e68a143-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-u13c7255af35ae30afb-1.text: Unauthorised occupation of a land plot or part of a land plot, including use of a land plot by a person who does not hold the rights to that plot provided for by Russian Federation legislation —
koap-u13c7255af35ae30afb-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-u716f60c02d64530267-1.text: shall entail, where the cadastral value of the land plot has been determined, an administrative fine of 1 to 1.5 per cent of that value, but not less than five thousand roubles, for citizens; 1.5 to 2 per cent of that value, but not less than twenty thousand roubles, for officials; and 2 to 3 per cent of that value, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles, for legal entities; and, where the cadastral value of the land plot has not been determined, an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u716f60c02d64530267-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-7.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-1.text: 1. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-uf4877ee1a4caae6a29-1.text: 2. Where part of a land plot has been occupied without authorisation, the administrative fine calculated on the basis of the cadastral value of the land plot shall be calculated in proportion to the area of the part occupied without authorisation.
koap-uf4877ee1a4caae6a29-1.locator: Article 7.1. Unauthorised occupation of a land plot

koap-ua9d1ca436de3685575-1.text: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers
koap-ua9d1ca436de3685575-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-uc9f8c0cc403728ca74-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers
koap-uc9f8c0cc403728ca74-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-ud29953f4acfdf82c2a-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-u582ddcb740b0eefda4-1.text: 2. Destruction of or damage to wells of the state reference observation network, monitoring cross-sections on water bodies, mine-surveying markers, or special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of water bodies, including coastal strips of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation; signs informing citizens of restrictions on water use in public water bodies; signs marking the boundaries of sanitary protection zones and other zones with special conditions for the use of territories; special signs marking the boundaries of fishing areas and indicating the user to whom they are assigned; markers of sanitary (mining-sanitary) zones and districts, therapeutic and health-improving localities and resorts, specially protected natural areas, or forest planning or forest management markers; or markers installed by wildlife users, authorised state bodies responsible for protecting, controlling and regulating the use of wildlife and its habitat, or state bodies exercising control and supervision in fisheries and the conservation of aquatic biological resources and their habitat; as well as destruction of or damage to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and bodies —
koap-u582ddcb740b0eefda4-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-uc89f7f769a1a3e4054-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens, five thousand to ten thousand roubles for officials, and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-uc89f7f769a1a3e4054-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-ubb65c6ef22a3cfb402-1.text: 3. Destruction, damage or demolition of points of state geodetic networks, points of special-purpose geodetic networks, or stationary environmental condition and pollution observation stations forming part of the state observation network, or violation of the regime of a protection zone of stationary environmental condition and pollution observation stations —
koap-ubb65c6ef22a3cfb402-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-ue2e6973338dd503171-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles for citizens, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials, and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-ue2e6973338dd503171-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-u7e43ff45fc43fd7c4a-1.text: 4. Failure by the owner, possessor or user of a land plot, building or structure on which the points listed in part 3 of this Article are located to notify the federal executive authority responsible for geodesy and cartography, hydrometeorology and related fields, or its territorial (regional) body, of the destruction, damage or demolition of those points, as well as refusal to allow vehicular or pedestrian access to those points for observations and other work —
koap-u7e43ff45fc43fd7c4a-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-u1a01cbc488c30091ea-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u1a01cbc488c30091ea-1.locator: Article 7.2. Destruction of or damage to special markers

koap-u68832aaf82e98bbd8a-1.text: Unauthorised extraction of amber, nephrite or other semi-precious stones; transport or storage for the purpose of sale of unlawfully extracted amber, nephrite or other semi-precious stones in natural or processed form; or sale of unlawfully extracted amber, nephrite or other semi-precious stones in natural or processed form, where those actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-uad2b375a786143ad21-1.locator: Article 7.11. Use of wildlife and aquatic biological resources without a permit

koap-u72199eed19d8e5d6dd-1.text: 1. Use of wildlife or aquatic biological resources without a permit where a permit is mandatory, or in breach of the conditions laid down in a permit, as well as unauthorised assignment of the right to use wildlife or the right to harvest (catch) aquatic biological resources, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article and part 2 of Article 8.17 of this Code —
koap-u72199eed19d8e5d6dd-1.locator: Article 7.11. Use of wildlife and aquatic biological resources without a permit

koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles for citizens, one thousand to two thousand roubles for officials, and ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-2.locator: Article 7.11. Use of wildlife and aquatic biological resources without a permit

koap-u117cc61f1d0102756b-1.text: 2. Taking of ungulates or bears classified as game resources without a permit where a permit is mandatory, or in breach of the conditions laid down in a permit —
koap-u117cc61f1d0102756b-1.locator: Article 7.11. Use of wildlife and aquatic biological resources without a permit

koap-u98e6d57c302c773dc1-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to hunt for one to three years.
koap-u98e6d57c302c773dc1-1.locator: Article 7.11. Use of wildlife and aquatic biological resources without a permit

koap-uc5842ee510ef3a4b15-1.text: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
koap-uc5842ee510ef3a4b15-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-ub2e12f784d9b08cfcb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights
koap-ub2e12f784d9b08cfcb-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-u43a486f75f79e89e20-1.text: 1. Import, sale, rental or other unlawful use of copies of works or phonograms for the purpose of deriving income where those copies are counterfeit under Russian Federation legislation on copyright and related rights, or where the copies bear false information about their manufacturers, places of production or holders of copyright and related rights, as well as other infringement of copyright and related rights for the purpose of deriving income, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code —
koap-u43a486f75f79e89e20-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-uc2d7cc0066ae7739a4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; and thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of counterfeit copies of works and phonograms, the materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-uc2d7cc0066ae7739a4-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-ud013cfe06f521f9351-1.text: 2. Unlawful use of an invention, utility model or industrial design, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code; disclosure of the substance of an invention, utility model or industrial design without the consent of the creator or applicant before information about it is officially published; appropriation of authorship; or coercion into co-authorship —
koap-ud013cfe06f521f9351-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-u16e40b0eb56198aad8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles for citizens, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials, and thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u16e40b0eb56198aad8-1.locator: Article 7.12. Infringement of copyright and related rights, inventors' rights and patent rights

koap-u02a0fd35e9ad6db389-1.text: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation
koap-u02a0fd35e9ad6db389-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u56c1b666a515562aa6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation
koap-u56c1b666a515562aa6-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u73479699c62e9a91a6-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, violation of the land-use regime within the territories of cultural heritage objects, or failure to comply with restrictions established within their protection zones, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article —
koap-u73479699c62e9a91a6-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u8a86e7e78a7ada20b1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to five million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8a86e7e78a7ada20b1-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u5d0da69c73dc7fa2a4-1.text: 2. The actions (inaction) provided for by part 1 of this Article committed in relation to particular cultural heritage objects of federal significance whose list is established by the Government of the Russian Federation, especially valuable cultural heritage objects of the peoples of the Russian Federation, or cultural heritage objects included in the World Heritage List; or within the territories or protection zones of those objects, or within the territories or protection zones of heritage sites or historical and cultural reserves (museum-reserves) —
koap-u5d0da69c73dc7fa2a4-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u8b3101084d2773c96c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for citizens, fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles for officials, and one million to twenty million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8b3101084d2773c96c-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u49c9623fa78c9dd2ae-1.text: 3. The actions (inaction) provided for by part 1 of this Article committed in relation to identified cultural heritage objects or within their territories —
koap-u49c9623fa78c9dd2ae-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-ud517d91cbf0391082a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-ud517d91cbf0391082a-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u0ae218224307bec43a-1.text: 4. Failure or improper performance by an official of the official duties assigned to that person, resulting in damage to or destruction of a cultural heritage object, including an identified cultural heritage object, where those actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u0ae218224307bec43a-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-uecb3f7119bf2b38c09-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uecb3f7119bf2b38c09-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u86e78c0a1a7181e7a0-1.text: 5. Violation of requirements for the architectural design of a capital construction object established by town-planning regulations within the territory of a historic settlement —
koap-u86e78c0a1a7181e7a0-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-u7c0ecec086a42a900c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u7c0ecec086a42a900c-1.locator: Article 7.13. Violation of requirements of legislation on the protection of cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation

koap-ubcd9817df08031577b-1.text: Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects
koap-ubcd9817df08031577b-1.locator: Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects

koap-ud12d3f7396f3a2754b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects
koap-ud12d3f7396f3a2754b-1.locator: Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects

koap-u8e14a79ad6c6aba17c-1.text: Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction, land-reclamation, economic or other work without permission from the state cultural heritage protection body where such permission is mandatory —
koap-u8e14a79ad6c6aba17c-1.locator: Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects

koap-u7c0ecec086a42a900c-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for officials, and one hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u7c0ecec086a42a900c-2.locator: Article 7.14. Organisation or performance of earthworks, construction or other work without permission from the body exercising state supervision over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage objects

koap-u39411a7868f0e89f2f-1.text: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement
koap-u39411a7868f0e89f2f-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u58baa7498bd0208e1b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement
koap-u58baa7498bd0208e1b-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-ua0defda8afbf0ba1b2-1.text: 1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, including identified cultural heritage objects —
koap-ua0defda8afbf0ba1b2-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u4ef0f922a1cdaf6020-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred thousand to twenty million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u4ef0f922a1cdaf6020-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u58dd3519d4656bef52-1.text: 2. The actions (inaction) provided for by part 1 of this Article committed in relation to especially valuable cultural heritage objects of the peoples of the Russian Federation or cultural heritage objects included in the World Heritage List —
koap-u58dd3519d4656bef52-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u1a4a022da685aa187a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one million to sixty million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u1a4a022da685aa187a-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u6300ead46e1ec5e326-1.text: 3. Destruction of or damage to objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement —
koap-u6300ead46e1ec5e326-1.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-u8a86e7e78a7ada20b1-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to five million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8a86e7e78a7ada20b1-2.locator: Article 7.14.1. Destruction of or damage to cultural heritage objects (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation or objects constituting the protected features of a historic settlement

koap-uf161c4129400305834-1.text: Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation
koap-uf161c4129400305834-1.locator: Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation

koap-u4c352991c81f10e4b8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation
koap-u4c352991c81f10e4b8-1.locator: Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation

koap-uf40417dfe030343e83-1.text: Failure by the client and (or) the person carrying out earthworks, construction, road works or other work to fulfil the duty to suspend that work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object under cultural heritage protection legislation, including an archaeological heritage object, or to suspend work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation, after receiving a written directive from the state cultural heritage protection body —
koap-uf40417dfe030343e83-1.locator: Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation

koap-u31fb5bb57a2ef02680-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for citizens, twenty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for officials, and two hundred thousand to five million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u31fb5bb57a2ef02680-1.locator: Article 7.14.2. Failure to fulfil the duty to suspend work upon discovery of an object displaying the characteristics of a cultural heritage object, or work that may worsen the condition of a cultural heritage object or impair its integrity and preservation

koap-u9c0813ab22b75e2319-1.text: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit
koap-u9c0813ab22b75e2319-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-uc5957f79da6b02c4cc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit
koap-uc5957f79da6b02c4cc-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-u3329070937a589c0c5-1.text: 1. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit (open sheet) obtained in the prescribed manner, where those actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act, or in breach of the conditions laid down in the permit (open sheet) —
koap-u3329070937a589c0c5-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-ud66e2fc1675577fffc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; four thousand to five thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; and forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork.
koap-ud66e2fc1675577fffc-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-u86dd70a76c180afaac-1.text: 2. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article resulting through negligence in damage to or destruction of an archaeological heritage object or an identified archaeological heritage object —
koap-u86dd70a76c180afaac-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-u53b9408aac4e97f0dc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; fifty thousand to six hundred thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork; and one million to ten million roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork and the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork.
koap-u53b9408aac4e97f0dc-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-u7ec36a7119f891ff8c-1.text: 3. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article committed using special technical search devices and (or) earthmoving machinery —
koap-u7ec36a7119f891ff8c-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-ua7057abf6156d9247e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork, the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork, and the special technical search devices and (or) earthmoving machinery; four thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork, the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork, and the special technical search devices and (or) earthmoving machinery; and fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the objects obtained through the archaeological fieldwork, the tools and equipment used for that fieldwork, and the special technical search devices and (or) earthmoving machinery.
koap-ua7057abf6156d9247e-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-u4fa20b3712ed9f8934-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, special technical search devices means metal detectors, radars, magnetic instruments and other technical devices capable of detecting the presence of archaeological objects at their place of deposition.
koap-u4fa20b3712ed9f8934-1.locator: Article 7.15. Conducting archaeological fieldwork without a permit

koap-uad4b780fb3b664b6a4-1.text: Article 7.15.1. Illicit circulation of archaeological objects
koap-uad4b780fb3b664b6a4-1.locator: Article 7.15.1. Illicit circulation of archaeological objects

koap-u9d9b19be3477db69cd-1.locator: Article 7.15.1. Illicit circulation of archaeological objects

koap-u39301a4c60098a0b85-1.text: Transactions involving archaeological objects in breach of requirements established by Russian Federation legislation —
koap-u39301a4c60098a0b85-1.locator: Article 7.15.1. Illicit circulation of archaeological objects

koap-ub4565040ad0b49b1da-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles for citizens, with confiscation of the archaeological objects; twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials, with confiscation of the archaeological objects; and three hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles for legal entities, with confiscation of the archaeological objects.
koap-ub4565040ad0b49b1da-1.locator: Article 7.15.1. Illicit circulation of archaeological objects

koap-u96b2249bbb39241c49-1.locator: Article 7.16. Unlawful alteration of the legal regime of land plots classified as land for historical and cultural purposes

koap-u4b3a408d0519b04dab-1.text: Article 7.17. Destruction of or damage to another person's property

koap-u7dcec1b2794bb8656f-1.locator: Article 7.17. Destruction of or damage to another person's property

koap-ua6ca21e66ef037b1d2-1.text: Intentional destruction of or damage to another person's property where those actions have not caused significant loss —
koap-ua6ca21e66ef037b1d2-1.locator: Article 7.17. Destruction of or damage to another person's property

koap-uf1fb5935bd6db36a91-1.text: Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products
koap-uf1fb5935bd6db36a91-1.locator: Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products

koap-u5336613028e85a9033-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products
koap-u5336613028e85a9033-1.locator: Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products

koap-u4f2c4b501bc4abb122-1.text: Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products, except where such rules are contained in technical regulations —
koap-u4f2c4b501bc4abb122-1.locator: Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products

koap-u1bd3e6357165af657d-1.locator: Article 7.18. Violation of rules for the storage, procurement or rational use of grain and grain products, or rules for the production of grain products

koap-ufa69cb009d45b312c4-1.text: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas
koap-ufa69cb009d45b312c4-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-ubb805a86e06b4a1ca2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas
koap-ubb805a86e06b4a1ca2-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u1a3bb54f1a0e8450f5-1.text: 1. Unauthorised connection to electricity networks, heat networks, oil pipelines, petroleum product pipelines or gas pipelines, or unauthorised (unmetered) use of electricity, thermal energy, oil, gas or petroleum products, where those actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u1a3bb54f1a0e8450f5-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u86eb9b3ace3d922609-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles for citizens; an administrative fine of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to two years for officials; and an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u86eb9b3ace3d922609-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u69eeb3787607b672b9-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article, consisting of unauthorised connection to electricity networks or heat networks, or unauthorised (unmetered) use of electricity, thermal energy, oil, gas or petroleum products —
koap-u69eeb3787607b672b9-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-uea10dfc70672b3537b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles for citizens; an administrative fine of eighty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years for officials; and an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-uea10dfc70672b3537b-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u7ed7e19ccd2dd5ecdf-1.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article, consisting of unauthorised connection to oil pipelines, petroleum product pipelines or gas pipelines —
koap-u7ed7e19ccd2dd5ecdf-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u1e41cd65677d922adc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u1e41cd65677d922adc-1.locator: Article 7.19. Unauthorised connection and use of electricity, thermal energy, oil or gas

koap-u2f0af893c1395463bc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 7.27. Petty misappropriation

koap-u7f6f0629ef5dc3cc11-1.text: 1. Petty misappropriation of another person's property worth no more than one thousand roubles by theft, fraud, appropriation or embezzlement, in the absence of the elements of the offences provided for by parts two, three and four of Article 158, Article 158.1, parts two, three and four of Article 159, parts two, three and four of Article 159.1, parts two, three and four of Article 159.2, parts two, three and four of Article 159.3, parts two, three and four of Article 159.5, parts two, three and four of Article 159.6, and parts two and three of Article 160 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Articles 7.20 and 14.15.3 of this Code —

koap-u382c606acb9c9c4551-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of up to five times the value of the misappropriated property, but not less than one thousand roubles, administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, or compulsory work for up to fifty hours.

koap-u5b2beff19927fe41a4-1.text: 2. Petty misappropriation of another person's property worth more than one thousand roubles but no more than two thousand five hundred roubles by theft, fraud, appropriation or embezzlement, in the absence of the elements of the offences provided for by parts two, three and four of Article 158, Article 158.1, parts two, three and four of Article 159, parts two, three and four of Article 159.1, parts two, three and four of Article 159.2, parts two, three and four of Article 159.3, parts two, three and four of Article 159.5, parts two, three and four of Article 159.6, and parts two and three of Article 160 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Articles 7.20 and 14.15.3 of this Code —

koap-ua34f255033a009ce07-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of up to five times the value of the misappropriated property, but not less than three thousand roubles, administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or compulsory work for up to one hundred and twenty hours.

koap-ueb798dc2f213950f6e-1.text: 3. Petty misappropriation of another person's property worth no more than two thousand five hundred roubles, committed by fraud using a charitable donation collection box by a person not entitled to carry on that activity, in the absence of the elements of the offences provided for by parts two, three and four of Article 158 and parts two, three and four of Article 159 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation; or installation and (or) use of a charitable donation collection box by an individual or legal entity not entitled to carry on that activity —

koap-u92126b78a5ec760836-1.text: shall entail, for citizens, an administrative fine of up to five times the value of the misappropriated property, but not less than three thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence and (or) its object; administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence and (or) its object; or compulsory work for up to one hundred and twenty hours, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence and (or) its object; and, for legal entities, an administrative fine of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence and (or) its object.

koap-u50edc511c68c98d79b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of 1 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price, the price of a contract concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider), the initial unit price of a good, work or service, or the initial sum of unit prices of goods, works or services, but not less than ten thousand and not more than fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u50edc511c68c98d79b-1.locator: Article 7.30.1. koap-u6f44e4c2701763a5d4-1.locator: Article 7.30.1. koap-uf8a9247252e35f10ee-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u480214cdefed76f30d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of 1 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price, but not less than five thousand and not more than thirty thousand roubles; and for legal entities, 1 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price, but not less than fifty thousand and not more than two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u480214cdefed76f30d-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-ua4990cd0b3fbe0a0f0-1.text: 2. Violation of requirements established by Russian Federation legislation and other normative legal acts on the procurement contractual system for sending or posting a draft contract, considering a statement of disagreements, concluding a contract, or the time limits for those actions —
koap-ua4990cd0b3fbe0a0f0-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u4931b5d7f649646817-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u6cf2fef1f56fae8940-1.text: 3. Amendment of contract conditions where the possibility of amending those conditions is not provided for by Russian Federation legislation and other normative legal acts on the procurement contractual system —
koap-u6cf2fef1f56fae8940-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u8bd46c9f662a61745d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles for legal entities.
koap-u8bd46c9f662a61745d-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u77b5e7276742b27b4f-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u59730f38889606688f-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u86d9ac6e54389f3c47-1.text: 6. koap-u86d9ac6e54389f3c47-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u30637eb14d14819e83-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles for officials.
koap-u30637eb14d14819e83-2.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-uc6064ad33cae78eac9-1.text: 7. koap-uc6064ad33cae78eac9-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u69eb6fb8255753c88b-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u1ae2cc856a3066b0c7-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-uda870fe448f766db57-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u4d7c31b479cd0495ab-1.text: 10. Repeated commission by an official of the administrative offence provided for by part 4, 7 or 8 of this Article —
koap-u4d7c31b479cd0495ab-1.locator: Article 7.30.2. Violation of the procedure for concluding, performing, amending and terminating a contract

koap-u6e5886cfabb9844a04-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u46c0da05438a57f533-1.text: 1. Violation of the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation and other normative legal acts on the procurement contractual system for determining the initial (maximum) price of a state contract when placing a state defence order through competitive supplier (service provider, contractor) selection methods, or the state contract price when placing a state defence order with a sole supplier (service provider, contractor) —
koap-u46c0da05438a57f533-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

Refusal or evasion by a supplier of Russian armaments and military equipment having no Russian equivalents, or by a sole supplier (service provider, contractor) designated by legislative acts of the Russian Federation, acts of the President of the Russian Federation or acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, to conclude a state contract under the state defence order where conclusion of such a state contract is mandatory for those persons, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, where those actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-uc30ee71964f8f867b6-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u981b983c2f54e9781b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and three hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u981b983c2f54e9781b-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u3568583f911bdfc3a5-1.text: 3. Refusal or evasion by a supplier (service provider, contractor) holding a dominant position under Russian Federation legislation on the state defence order to conclude an agreement necessary to fulfil the state defence order, where conclusion of such an agreement is mandatory for that person and those actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u3568583f911bdfc3a5-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u981b983c2f54e9781b-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles for officials and three hundred thousand to one million roubles for legal entities.
koap-u981b983c2f54e9781b-2.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-ueb572867f3e4165acb-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u0ed9d6262444649138-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u2a1e2df3c70552e7f7-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-uea64900189bf7b58f6-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

koap-ucdd05c17b251bdf8eb-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u2b12096636e25a02f4-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u6dcb698b478a027a8c-1.text: 8. koap-u6dcb698b478a027a8c-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-ucb8b76e57fddacdd46-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u24971b2d0f4b0ac099-1.text: 9. koap-u24971b2d0f4b0ac099-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-ub5dac894cdc38098d9-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u368df18520a4dae007-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u2803e62286ef64132c-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u94be9e7c0a045aa442-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u9aeeb9de1257e5e278-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-ue497c1b0821602bb65-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to one million roubles for officials.
koap-ue497c1b0821602bb65-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-ufb9159d48cb3095ec6-1.locator: Article 7.30.3. Violation of the procedure for drawing up, placing and fulfilling the state defence order

koap-u9e260c4d061570d883-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of three thousand to six thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twice the amount of the environmental levy, but no less than one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, twice the amount of the environmental levy, but no less than two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9e260c4d061570d883-1.locator: Article 8.5.1.
