koap-u1ddc5a7644db9e080f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.6. Damage to land

koap-ude67808b6726107758-1.text: 1. Unauthorised removal or relocation of the fertile soil layer —

koap-u1bf7a8303318668033-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

koap-ud861709f87ddecd97c-1.text: 2. Destruction of the fertile soil layer, as well as damage to land resulting from violation of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals or other substances and production and consumption waste hazardous to human health and the environment, or of the requirements for handling livestock by-products when using livestock by-products —

koap-uc6d493e578c5d25dd0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, forty thousand to eighty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.

koap-u48ed525fcb93bb4dac-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article and Article 10.8.1 of this Code, livestock by-products shall mean substances under Article 2 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 248-FZ ‘On Livestock By-products and Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.

koap-ud472acf3a220727d1d-1.text: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection
koap-ud472acf3a220727d1d-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-ud913f791eb16108af6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection
koap-ud913f791eb16108af6-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-u55cdae278bd1db68d3-1.text: 1. Failure or delay in fulfilling duties to reclaim land when developing mineral deposits, including commonly occurring minerals, carrying out construction, land improvement, survey or other works, including works for internal economic or own needs, or after completion of construction, reconstruction and/or operation of facilities unrelated to the creation of forest infrastructure, or demolition of forest infrastructure facilities —
koap-u55cdae278bd1db68d3-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-ue4789b33a43e86cb2a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue4789b33a43e86cb2a-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-uc99cfea022ef686541-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with established requirements or carry out mandatory measures for improving and protecting land, protecting soil against wind and water erosion, and preventing other processes and other negative environmental impacts that degrade the quality of land —
koap-uc99cfea022ef686541-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-ue4789b33a43e86cb2a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue4789b33a43e86cb2a-2.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-u6f1a9b7c68143ed95a-1.text: 3. Failure to fulfil the duty to monitor the condition of a production and consumption waste placement facility and its environmental impact, or to carry out work to restore (reclaim or conserve) disturbed land after the end of operation of a production and consumption waste placement facility —
koap-u6f1a9b7c68143ed95a-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-ud020bab69a1f538fc9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, seventy thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud020bab69a1f538fc9-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-u3ad1d9b5c04ec9296f-1.text: 4. Use of municipal solid waste to reclaim land and quarries —

koap-u6837dfaca8a12deff6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u6837dfaca8a12deff6-1.locator: Article 8.7. Failure to fulfil duties to reclaim land or carry out mandatory measures for land improvement and soil protection

koap-ube10cc2e3239318d01-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u7c09bd7425d8ea9a14-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose
koap-u7c09bd7425d8ea9a14-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u54b6c2723d03483d84-1.text: 1. Use of a land plot other than for its designated purpose in accordance with its classification in a particular category of land and/or its permitted use, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2, 2.1 and 3 of this Article —
koap-u54b6c2723d03483d84-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-ua742c4886a689eae5f-1.text: shall entail, where the cadastral value of the land plot has been determined, an administrative fine on citizens of 0.5 to 1 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than ten thousand roubles; on officials, 1 to 1.5 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1.5 to 2 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than one hundred thousand roubles; and, where the cadastral value of the land plot has not been determined, on citizens, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua742c4886a689eae5f-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u4839544a3526378e7a-1.text: 2. Failure to use an agricultural land plot whose circulation is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ ‘On the Circulation of Agricultural Land’ for agricultural production or other activities related to agricultural production within the period established by that Federal Law, except in the case provided for by Part 2.1 of this Article —
koap-u4839544a3526378e7a-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u4de0dce537f11d966f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of 0.3 to 0.5 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than three thousand roubles; on officials, 0.5 to 1.5 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 2 to 10 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4de0dce537f11d966f-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-uc93641557f09cf9d1a-1.text: 2.1. Failure to use an agricultural land plot whose circulation is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ ‘On the Circulation of Agricultural Land’ for its designated purpose within one year of acquiring ownership, where the land plot was acquired following a public auction on the basis of a court decision withdrawing it owing to failure to use it for its designated purpose or use in violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation, and/or where the authorised executive body exercising state land supervision has information that the land plot has not been used for its designated purpose or has been used in violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the period specified in Paragraph 3 of Article 6 of Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ ‘On the Circulation of Agricultural Land’ —
koap-uc93641557f09cf9d1a-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-ubbe06177d79da603ef-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens and individual entrepreneurs of 0.1 to 0.3 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than two thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1 to 6 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ubbe06177d79da603ef-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-ub6af289b6699ae1739-1.text: 3. Failure to use a land plot intended for housing or other construction, gardening or vegetable gardening for those purposes where federal law provides for a duty to use such a land plot within an established period —
koap-ub6af289b6699ae1739-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-uab3a4a4304417ca0f9-1.text: shall entail, where the cadastral value of the land plot has been determined, an administrative fine on citizens of 1 to 1.5 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than twenty thousand roubles; on officials, 1.5 to 2 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 3 to 5 per cent of the cadastral value of the land plot, but no less than four hundred thousand roubles; and, where the cadastral value of the land plot has not been determined, on citizens, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab3a4a4304417ca0f9-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u00b56d406cf15c9f1b-1.text: 4. Failure or delay in fulfilling duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose —
koap-u00b56d406cf15c9f1b-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u7ecbb6e35a76a45bcf-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7ecbb6e35a76a45bcf-1.locator: Article 8.8. Use of land plots other than for their designated purpose; failure to fulfil duties to bring land into a condition fit for use for its designated purpose

koap-u9465577ba3be21a334-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-uaa2ffa2f4da921b846-1.text: 1. Violation of the water protection regime in the catchment areas of water bodies that may result in pollution of those water bodies or other harmful phenomena —
koap-uaa2ffa2f4da921b846-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u44c05e0d469e886b23-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u44c05e0d469e886b23-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-uecd5a623b3dd2d301a-1.text: 2. Failure or delay in fulfilling duties to bring water bodies, their water protection zones and coastal protective strips into a condition fit for use —
koap-uecd5a623b3dd2d301a-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-uf8e75d18de4b46813f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-uf8e75d18de4b46813f-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u62975262e90fe77388-1.text: 3. Unlawful extraction of sand, gravel, clay or other commonly occurring minerals, peat or sapropel in water bodies, loose-log floating, or violation of the established procedure for clearing water bodies of sunken timber and sediment —
koap-u62975262e90fe77388-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u6873c72a393d0aca16-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u6873c72a393d0aca16-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u9a36aef8603e2de724-1.text: 4. Violation of requirements for the protection of water bodies that may result in their pollution, littering and/or depletion, except in the cases provided for by Article 8.45 of this Code —
koap-u9a36aef8603e2de724-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-ua93ffab0dc6afb0e35-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua93ffab0dc6afb0e35-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u1b85337b0abb884bc1-1.text: 5. Pollution of glaciers, snowfields or the ice cover of water bodies, or pollution of water bodies containing natural therapeutic resources or classified as specially protected water bodies or places for tourism, sport and mass recreation, by production and consumption waste and/or harmful substances, as well as burial of harmful substances (materials) in water bodies, except in the cases provided for by Parts 3.1–3.4 of Article 8.2 of this Code —
koap-u1b85337b0abb884bc1-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u902857da7f93f14b27-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u902857da7f93f14b27-1.locator: Article 8.13. Violation of the rules for the protection of water bodies

koap-u858270a21ca32395d0-1.text: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules
koap-u858270a21ca32395d0-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-u876b163af8a80d116c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules
koap-u876b163af8a80d116c-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-uebc14256e9bf11c008-1.text: 1. Violation of water use rules when abstracting water, using water without withdrawal, or discharging wastewater into water bodies —
koap-uebc14256e9bf11c008-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-ub8061ce20c31acf735-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ub8061ce20c31acf735-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-uf82bc815943aa9ad7d-1.text: 2. Violation of water use rules when extracting minerals, peat or sapropel in water bodies, or when constructing or operating underwater or above-water structures, fishing, navigating, laying or operating oil pipelines or other product pipelines, carrying out dredging, blasting or other works, or constructing or operating dams, port facilities or other structures —
koap-uf82bc815943aa9ad7d-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-uf32cf7b09e7415190a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred and twenty thousand roubles.
koap-uf32cf7b09e7415190a-1.locator: Article 8.14. Violation of water use rules

koap-u154dc6ba2475601797-1.text: Article 8.15. Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment
koap-u154dc6ba2475601797-1.locator: Article 8.15. Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment

koap-uf7ab4c784d0dbfd74d-1.locator: Article 8.15. Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment

koap-ud64098acba18581177-1.text: Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment —
koap-ud64098acba18581177-1.locator: Article 8.15. Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment

koap-uf48ed518e68e7fe901-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred and twenty thousand roubles.
koap-uf48ed518e68e7fe901-1.locator: Article 8.15. Violation of the operating rules for water management or water protection structures and equipment

koap-uad0ca0ff98a3362c42-1.text: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
koap-uad0ca0ff98a3362c42-1.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-u87ee3a0119aed9e3dc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents
koap-u87ee3a0119aed9e3dc-1.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-ud1d39a750fbce77f50-1.text: 1. Failure by the master of a seagoing vessel, an inland waterway vessel or another floating craft to comply with the rules for recording in the ship's documents operations involving substances harmful to human health or the living resources of the sea or other water bodies, or mixtures containing such substances above established limits, as well as making incorrect entries concerning those operations in the ship's documents —
koap-ud1d39a750fbce77f50-1.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-2.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-uac57159133c6696015-1.text: 2. Failure by the master of a vessel harvesting (catching) aquatic biological (living) resources in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation to fulfil the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to keep a fishing logbook, as well as entering distorted information therein —
koap-uac57159133c6696015-1.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-4.locator: Article 8.16. Failure to comply with the rules for keeping ship's documents

koap-ud3cc1ffdef200cff91-1.text: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas
koap-ud3cc1ffdef200cff91-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-ub01537c4e20250e1c4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas
koap-ub01537c4e20250e1c4-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-ua6617abed9b24e9e27-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for the safe conduct of prospecting, exploration or development of mineral resources or drilling operations, of the conditions of a licence for water use, regional geological study, prospecting, exploration or development, of the conditions of water use agreements or decisions granting a water body for use, or of requirements for the use or protection of mineral resources in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-ua6617abed9b24e9e27-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-ue18b3643dbfcf761fd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-ue18b3643dbfcf761fd-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-ue9cb17aa83519218f3-1.text: 2. Violation of rules and requirements governing fishing in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas —
koap-ue9cb17aa83519218f3-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-u7a9ed0b29c4dee2eb2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one-half to the full value of the aquatic biological resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence; on officials, one to one and a half times the value of the aquatic biological resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence; on legal entities, twice to three times the value of the aquatic biological resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-u7a9ed0b29c4dee2eb2-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-u35d0620c7ad69689d3-1.text: 3. Unauthorised laying of underwater cables, pipelines or tunnels or bringing them onto the territory of the Russian Federation, as well as violation of the rules for their laying, bringing them onto the territory of the Russian Federation or operation in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-u35d0620c7ad69689d3-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-uad6b13d1e9cdab1dd6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-uad6b13d1e9cdab1dd6-1.locator: Article 8.17. Violation of requirements or licence conditions governing activities in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation or on the high seas

koap-uc882df565b016c9aec-1.locator: Article 8.18. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u8d09cfc83834ea2d16-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research provided for by a permit in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-u8d09cfc83834ea2d16-1.locator: Article 8.18. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-ucda24e7ba585d110c0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel, aircraft and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-ucda24e7ba585d110c0-1.locator: Article 8.18. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u14084ec40c77a1d473-1.text: 2. Unauthorised alteration of a resource research or marine scientific research programme in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-u14084ec40c77a1d473-1.locator: Article 8.18. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-ue1eab08eda980b58b1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the vessel, aircraft and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-ue1eab08eda980b58b1-1.locator: Article 8.18. Violation of the rules for conducting resource research or marine scientific research in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u97cef080bf1df770e2-1.locator: Article 8.19. Violation of the rules for dumping waste and other materials in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-uce8949b80cb30bf2c0-1.locator: Article 8.19. Violation of the rules for dumping waste and other materials in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u8ab7d5c5b034a93452-1.text: Unauthorised dumping, or dumping in violation of the rules, of waste and other materials from vessels or other floating craft, aircraft, artificial islands, installations or structures in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-u8ab7d5c5b034a93452-1.locator: Article 8.19. Violation of the rules for dumping waste and other materials in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u7b70602855746a87e5-1.locator: Article 8.19. Violation of the rules for dumping waste and other materials in the internal sea waters, territorial sea, continental shelf and/or exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-uc94fcee9c43d260bfd-1.text: Article 8.20. Unlawful transfer of mineral and/or living resources on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation
koap-uc94fcee9c43d260bfd-1.locator: Article 8.20. Unlawful transfer of mineral and/or living resources on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-uc870b6388dee2cc632-1.locator: Article 8.20. Unlawful transfer of mineral and/or living resources on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-u0f7fe1af8058982b8d-1.text: Loading, unloading or transshipment on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation of extracted mineral and/or living resources without a permit where such a permit is mandatory —

koap-u16fa6b8e14e325c1ae-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one-half to the full value of the mineral and/or living resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel, aircraft and other instruments of the administrative offence; on officials, one to one and a half times the value of the mineral and/or living resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel, aircraft and other instruments of the administrative offence; on legal entities, twice to three times the value of the mineral and/or living resources that were the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the vessel, aircraft and other instruments of the administrative offence.
koap-u16fa6b8e14e325c1ae-1.locator: Article 8.20. Unlawful transfer of mineral and/or living resources on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation

koap-ua87fa3eeb762a2ead2-1.text: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-u0da1c53512eb9da8a8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air
koap-u0da1c53512eb9da8a8-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-ue7e68870dcb8b4243a-1.text: 1. Emission of harmful substances into atmospheric air or harmful physical impact on it without a special permit —
koap-ue7e68870dcb8b4243a-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-ua63467c54f1cb13eb7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, one hundred and eighty thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ua63467c54f1cb13eb7-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-u9c875b0de9e2d62a46-1.text: 2. Violation of the conditions of a special permit for the emission of harmful substances into atmospheric air or for harmful physical impact on it —
koap-u9c875b0de9e2d62a46-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-uab9363fc9a1685b689-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab9363fc9a1685b689-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-u9fd280edce93d91597-1.text: 3. Violation of the operating rules for, or failure to use, structures, equipment or apparatus for gas cleaning and monitoring emissions of harmful substances into atmospheric air that may lead to air pollution, or use of such structures, equipment or apparatus when defective, except in the cases provided for by Article 8.51 of this Code —
koap-u9fd280edce93d91597-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-ua8ca7c8489c4bc3ac6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one thousand to two thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ua8ca7c8489c4bc3ac6-1.locator: Article 8.21. Violation of the rules for the protection of atmospheric air

koap-u3506246a7de18971fb-1.locator: Article 8.22. Releasing mechanically propelled vehicles into operation with pollutant concentrations in emissions or noise levels exceeding prescribed standards

koap-ub923d05d185690b4bd-1.text: 2. koap-ub923d05d185690b4bd-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-ue20c834a456578d51f-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-u2b2eac1944e9110a04-1.text: 4. Violation of forest legislation requirements concerning mandatory timber marking —

koap-u2192ed71477b05e0c3-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-ue03cf51a58b3ec9303-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-u258e16eeb620a5bb50-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

Transportation of timber and/or products of its processing by road vehicles not equipped with technical monitoring devices that provide prompt receipt of information generated in unalterable form using signals from the global navigation satellite system of the Russian Federation, enabling the location coordinates and movement paths of those vehicles to be established, use software integrated with the federal state information system of the forest sector and transmit information to it in real time; or failure to transmit information on the movements of such road vehicles to the federal state information system of the forest sector —
koap-u18cff9035ba1cc3194-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-u2192ed71477b05e0c3-2.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-u258e16eeb620a5bb50-2.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-u62c655e67df3543798-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-ua54668bea2eecd332e-1.locator: Article 8.28.1. Violation of forest legislation requirements on accounting for timber and transactions in timber

koap-udd90f10a3bb4566c5e-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, seven thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ua0131d10ba0615b61b-1.text: 1. koap-u43495f237338606104-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u43495f237338606104-1.locator: Article 8.50. Violation of requirements for preventing and responding to spills of oil and petroleum products

koap-u2443c64266497a5628-1.text: 3. Failure to notify the authorised body of a spill of oil and petroleum products; notifying the authorised body of such a spill without providing the necessary information; or providing the authorised body with knowingly inaccurate information concerning a spill of oil and petroleum products —
koap-u2443c64266497a5628-1.locator: Article 8.50. Violation of requirements for preventing and responding to spills of oil and petroleum products

koap-u5999e8d0e6340edd20-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5999e8d0e6340edd20-1.locator: Article 8.50. Violation of requirements for preventing and responding to spills of oil and petroleum products

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 3 of this Article —
koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-1.locator: Article 8.50. Violation of requirements for preventing and responding to spills of oil and petroleum products

koap-u554848fa179f3165ed-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u554848fa179f3165ed-1.locator: Article 8.50. Violation of requirements for preventing and responding to spills of oil and petroleum products

koap-uf0014734956e8d9551-1.text: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation
koap-uf0014734956e8d9551-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u61efd55d47af05ba17-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation
koap-u61efd55d47af05ba17-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-ue2cc68789796e83d69-1.text: 1. Failure or delay in complying with requirements to equip stationary sources of pollutant emissions and pollutant discharges with automatic monitoring systems in accordance with environmental protection legislation —
koap-ue2cc68789796e83d69-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u03ed21218bce11558e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u03ed21218bce11558e-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u01da6c1bd60c5ec0a5-1.text: 2. Equipping stationary sources of pollutant emissions and pollutant discharges with automatic monitoring systems in violation of requirements for automatic instruments for measuring and recording pollutant emission and/or discharge indicators, or requirements for technical means of recording and transmitting information on pollutant emission and/or discharge indicators to the state register of facilities having a negative environmental impact —
koap-u01da6c1bd60c5ec0a5-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u43e979639c100b25cd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43e979639c100b25cd-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-3.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-3.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u9a18d890b2b92c2e78-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9a18d890b2b92c2e78-1.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-ue25a83b81c9672fcac-3.text: Note. A person conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as a legal entity for the administrative offence provided for by this Article.
koap-ue25a83b81c9672fcac-3.locator: Article 8.51. Violation of environmental protection legislation

koap-u645f1f2c53c16992b5-1.text: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals
koap-u645f1f2c53c16992b5-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-ucce385d6918644ba36-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals
koap-ucce385d6918644ba36-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-ubd9404450c12e9954d-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with general requirements for keeping animals or requirements for keeping domestic animals, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2 and 3 of this Article and Articles 8.53 and 8.54 of this Code —
koap-ubd9404450c12e9954d-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-uee3a45b76dc9557cf8-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; on officials, five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uee3a45b76dc9557cf8-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-u97f7e0ee0b9cd8ef51-1.text: 2. Cruel treatment of animals, where these acts do not have the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u97f7e0ee0b9cd8ef51-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-u9d10662b7f98a6fe89-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9d10662b7f98a6fe89-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-u52b77425be6f7e4733-1.text: 3. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the treatment of animals resulting in harm to citizens' life or health or to property, where these acts do not have the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u52b77425be6f7e4733-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-u6450a89ce1a732a1e9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6450a89ce1a732a1e9-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-ucddf96fad1370462fe-1.text: Note. The administrative liability provided for by Parts 1 and 3 of this Article shall not apply to an animal's owner where the violation results from the acts (omissions) of another person exercising, or required on the owner's instructions to exercise, direct supervision over the animal, or where the animal ceased to be in the person's possession as a result of unlawful acts of other persons.
koap-ucddf96fad1370462fe-1.locator: Article 8.52. Failure to comply with requirements for keeping animals

koap-u4b34b677e685b9599d-1.locator: Article 8.53. Failure to comply with requirements for the use of animals for cultural and entertainment purposes and for their keeping

koap-u10f73720b1cea07a26-1.locator: Article 8.53. Failure to comply with requirements for the use of animals for cultural and entertainment purposes and for their keeping

koap-u426c02287623201c79-1.locator: Article 8.53. Failure to comply with requirements for the use of animals for cultural and entertainment purposes and for their keeping

koap-u1bc8eca7dc5d7c0db4-1.locator: Article 8.53. Failure to comply with requirements for the use of animals for cultural and entertainment purposes and for their keeping

koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-2.locator: Article 8.53. Failure to comply with requirements for the use of animals for cultural and entertainment purposes and for their keeping

koap-u23ca7f9919fff0c7b2-1.text: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals
koap-u23ca7f9919fff0c7b2-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u408eb1261f592c2db0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals
koap-u408eb1261f592c2db0-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u6a4eef1fa8ecc56f27-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters —
koap-u6a4eef1fa8ecc56f27-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u1d4920e92dc269b761-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u1d4920e92dc269b761-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-uc3837c4809e35232ec-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with requirements for activities involving ownerless animals —
koap-uc3837c4809e35232ec-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u4662f66cd9a1e051c8-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u4662f66cd9a1e051c8-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u9953d8a92bd4c75b86-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, owners of animal shelters mean persons defined as such by Federal Law of 27 December 2018 No. 498-FZ ‘On Responsible Treatment of Animals and Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation’.
koap-u9953d8a92bd4c75b86-1.locator: Article 8.54. Failure to comply with requirements for animal-handling activities by owners of animal shelters and for activities involving ownerless animals

koap-u9c114dc8e4f9a28327-1.text: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities
koap-u9c114dc8e4f9a28327-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u5bdf29deb869983fd5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities
koap-u5bdf29deb869983fd5-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u7c6ff31552d5fb9cf8-1.text: 1. Failure to submit or late submission to the federal executive body authorised to exercise federal state environmental control (supervision) of information on the classification of hazardous production facilities as certain hazardous production facilities —
koap-u7c6ff31552d5fb9cf8-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-uf7b04af4cf7b2fe159-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf7b04af4cf7b2fe159-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-uee8462bd8b913852d1-1.text: 2. Failure to submit or late submission to the federal executive body authorised to exercise federal state environmental control (supervision) of information on the operating life of buildings and structures that constitute certain hazardous production facilities and/or house certain hazardous production facilities, information on the period of use of a subsoil plot and the period of development of mineral deposits (in relation to coal mines), or information on the operating life of hazard class I and II waste placement facilities, or submission of inaccurate information —
koap-uee8462bd8b913852d1-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-uf7b04af4cf7b2fe159-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf7b04af4cf7b2fe159-2.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u7a56978ea68fa8ea1f-1.text: 3. Failure, when decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) a certain production facility, to carry out measures to prevent and eliminate environmental pollution resulting from its operation, or implementation of such measures in violation of environmental protection requirements —
koap-u7a56978ea68fa8ea1f-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u596a05ff88b4293e6f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u596a05ff88b4293e6f-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-2.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 3 of this Article —
koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-2.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u1d66b04d918735886b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to three years; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1d66b04d918735886b-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-9.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-ua85c173e8faacfe47b-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Article, certain production facilities and certain hazardous production facilities mean facilities defined as such by Federal Law of 10 January 2002 No. 7-FZ ‘On Environmental Protection’.
koap-ua85c173e8faacfe47b-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u1853658ed7bb4aca53-1.text: 2. The administrative liability provided for by Part 2 of this Article shall not apply to certain hazardous production facilities commissioned before 1 September 2023.
koap-u1853658ed7bb4aca53-1.locator: Article 8.55. Violation of environmental protection requirements when operating and decommissioning (conserving or liquidating) certain production facilities

koap-u9ec9cde2c7ac033bfa-1.locator: Chapter 9. Administrative offences in industry, construction and energy

koap-uc543b02b74ebc2b528-1.text: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities
koap-uc543b02b74ebc2b528-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u267f3ae4505c637eed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities
koap-u267f3ae4505c637eed-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u47ef1e34c93a52c46d-1.text: 1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities —
koap-u47ef1e34c93a52c46d-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u669147d1d9dff9e472-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u669147d1d9dff9e472-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u77018b9eb18c176ba5-1.text: 2. Violation of industrial safety requirements for the receipt, use, processing, storage, transportation, destruction and accounting of explosives at hazardous production facilities —
koap-u77018b9eb18c176ba5-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-ua7d6f2bba56d0f9d19-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to one and a half years; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ua7d6f2bba56d0f9d19-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u80cdd83f4755ddfd59-1.text: 3. Gross violation of industrial safety requirements or gross violation of the conditions of a licence for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities, except in the cases provided for by Part 3.1 of this Article —
koap-u80cdd83f4755ddfd59-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-uacea596730d0faa8a1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to two years; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-uacea596730d0faa8a1-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-ub6b180bc70a4eee951-1.text: 3.1. Violation of mandatory industrial safety requirements for preventing sudden outbursts of coal (rock and gas), mandatory requirements for degassing, gas clearance and ventilation of mine workings, monitoring mine air and gases, driving and supporting mine workings, or requirements for emergency protection in mine workings when extracting coal (oil shale) by underground mining —
koap-ub6b180bc70a4eee951-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-ud55b0fa182050ea84c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one million to five million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ud55b0fa182050ea84c-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-uf2e36ddbd695661252-1.text: 3.2. The violation referred to in Part 3.1 of this Article that leads to an accident at a hazardous production facility resulting in the death of a person or grievous harm to the health of two or more persons —
koap-uf2e36ddbd695661252-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u59b226d86c630ad340-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on controlling persons of organisations operating coal mines of five million to ten million roubles.
koap-u59b226d86c630ad340-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u604f9d816360e19720-1.text: 3.3. The violation referred to in Part 3.1 of this Article that leads to an accident at a hazardous production facility resulting in the death of two or more persons —
koap-u604f9d816360e19720-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u74e8537f58b7c39ba8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on controlling persons of organisations operating coal mines of one-hundredth to one-tenth of the organisation's total revenue from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at the coal mine where the accident occurred, for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of detection if the offender did not extract coal (oil shale) at that coal mine during the preceding calendar year, but no less than fifteen million roubles.
koap-u74e8537f58b7c39ba8-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u7d2e601ece960e172b-1.text: 4. Giving a knowingly false industrial safety expert opinion, where this act does not have the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u7d2e601ece960e172b-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-uc34980a085afe7a9ad-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to two years; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc34980a085afe7a9ad-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-10.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u877cdbcd987d2d1016-1.text: 1. A gross violation of industrial safety requirements for hazardous production facilities means a violation of industrial safety requirements resulting in an immediate threat to human life or health. The meaning of a gross violation of the conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation for each particular licensed activity.
koap-u877cdbcd987d2d1016-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u24df8a1a0309c5a5aa-1.text: 2. For the purposes of this Article, officials in organisations other than state authorities, other state bodies, local self-government bodies, or state and municipal organisations mean a person exercising the powers of the organisation's sole executive body and a person performing organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions in the organisation. Where the powers of the organisation's sole executive body are exercised by a legal entity (a management organisation), an official means the person whose official duties cover technical policy and industrial safety. If there is no such person in the management organisation, an official means the person exercising the powers of the management organisation's sole executive body.
koap-u24df8a1a0309c5a5aa-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u9d435f90d98c380ecb-1.text: 2.1. For the purposes of this Article, a controlling person of an organisation operating coal mines means a legal entity entitled, directly or indirectly (through persons under its control), by virtue of participation in that organisation and/or under agreements for trust management of property, and/or simple partnership agreements, and/or agency agreements, and/or a shareholders' agreement, and/or another agreement concerning the exercise of rights certified by shares (participatory interests) in that organisation, to dispose of more than 50 per cent of the votes in the organisation's supreme governing body, or entitled to appoint (elect) its sole executive body and/or more than 50 per cent of the members of its collegial governing body.
koap-u9d435f90d98c380ecb-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u3e302de08eae26ff6a-1.text: 3. Persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.
koap-u3e302de08eae26ff6a-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u76cace67daf89d1c88-1.text: 4. Industrial safety experts who commit administrative offences provided for by this Article when conducting an industrial safety expert examination shall bear administrative liability as officials.
koap-u76cace67daf89d1c88-1.locator: Article 9.1. Violation of industrial safety requirements or conditions of licences for activities concerning the industrial safety of hazardous production facilities

koap-u9c4e24d40a274aee5e-1.text: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems
koap-u9c4e24d40a274aee5e-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-u8e6f937d1e7f18f7d6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems
koap-u8e6f937d1e7f18f7d6-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-ua2b5671247b0285d9f-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ua2b5671247b0285d9f-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-ubb8e91c81b0d8919f7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-ubb8e91c81b0d8919f7-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-u765d7d4c029241d36a-1.text: 2. Violation of requirements for ensuring the safety of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems, creating a threat of harm to citizens' life or health or of an accident —
koap-u765d7d4c029241d36a-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-u11768cdfe68344dcbd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to one and a half years; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to three hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u11768cdfe68344dcbd-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-u53e539ebfc346b15ba-1.text: Note. For the purposes of the second paragraph of Part 2 of this Article, citizens mean individuals performing installation, dismantling or maintenance, including emergency technical maintenance, of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems; maintenance of dispatch (operator) control systems; or repair, technical certification and inspection of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems.
koap-u53e539ebfc346b15ba-1.locator: Article 9.1.1. Violation of requirements for organising the safe use and maintenance of lifts, lifting platforms for persons with disabilities, passenger conveyors (moving walkways) and escalators, excluding escalators in underground railway systems

koap-u6b8006e165db16f8a2-1.locator: Article 9.2. Violation of requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation for ensuring the safety of hydraulic structures

koap-u361d104bae160433b3-2.locator: Article 9.2. Violation of requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation for ensuring the safety of hydraulic structures

koap-u0521d558b358069f38-1.locator: Article 9.3. Violation of rules or standards for the operation of tractors, self-propelled, road-construction and other machines and equipment
