koap-u6ef3c85f4b0c71b075-1.text: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)
koap-u6ef3c85f4b0c71b075-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-uf6fc54d15be3fea873-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)
koap-uf6fc54d15be3fea873-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-ud0c2694b9bbe898611-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements of technical regulations or design documentation, mandatory requirements of standardisation documents or requirements of special technical specifications, or violation of mandatory requirements for buildings and structures established by an authorised federal executive body before technical regulations entered into force, in the design, construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, including the use of construction materials (products) —
koap-ud0c2694b9bbe898611-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-u97334add2bad5bb82c-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u97334add2bad5bb82c-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-u35804545a383a67ffc-1.text: 2. The acts provided for by Part 1 of this Article that result in departures from the design values of building and structure parameters, affect structural or other characteristics of the reliability and safety of capital construction facilities and/or their parts, or the safety of building structures or sections of engineering utility networks; or that result in harm to citizens' life or health, the property of individuals or legal entities, state or municipal property, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants; or that create a threat of harm to citizens' life or health, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants —
koap-u35804545a383a67ffc-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-u2b56a7663eee3660dc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to thirty-five thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, thirty-five thousand to forty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to sixty days; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to sixty days.
koap-u2b56a7663eee3660dc-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-4.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-4.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-u381c6a09a09ab9d594-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to forty-five thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u381c6a09a09ab9d594-1.locator: Article 9.4. Violation of mandatory requirements in construction and the use of construction materials (products)

koap-uda1284b17543286483-1.text: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility
koap-uda1284b17543286483-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-uaa7f8055dbb0445a52-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility
koap-uaa7f8055dbb0445a52-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-uc7f672b9a13129f11b-1.text: 1. Construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities without a construction permit where obtaining a construction permit is required for such construction or reconstruction —
koap-uc7f672b9a13129f11b-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u71b643c30c38e80bf4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of their activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of their activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u71b643c30c38e80bf4-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-uda36d63c8f030f2960-1.text: 2. Violation of the time limits for sending notice of the commencement of construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities to the federal executive body, the State Atomic Energy Corporation ‘Rosatom’ or the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise state construction supervision, or failure to notify those authorised bodies or the State Atomic Energy Corporation ‘Rosatom’ of the completion dates of work subject to inspection —
koap-uda36d63c8f030f2960-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-ud0bfdc30de41c5418b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud0bfdc30de41c5418b-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u32f1e5197c71c83530-1.text: 3. Continuing work before reports have been drawn up confirming the elimination of deficiencies in the construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities identified by the federal executive body, the State Atomic Energy Corporation ‘Rosatom’ or executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise state construction supervision —
koap-u32f1e5197c71c83530-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u51aefa3bc942ea688f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to forty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of their activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of their activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u51aefa3bc942ea688f-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u7bbce366485be35fba-1.text: 4. Issuing a permit to commission a facility in the absence of conclusions from the federal executive body, the State Atomic Energy Corporation ‘Rosatom’ or the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise state construction supervision, where the legislation of the Russian Federation on urban development provides for state construction supervision during the construction or reconstruction of the capital construction facility —
koap-u7bbce366485be35fba-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-uf36ef525548b4ffa8b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uf36ef525548b4ffa8b-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u676615fdad71775c13-1.text: 5. Operation of a capital construction facility without a permit to commission it, except where a construction permit is not required for the construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities —
koap-u676615fdad71775c13-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u94f470e1ed2c369026-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u94f470e1ed2c369026-1.locator: Article 9.5. Violation of the established procedure for constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs to, or commissioning a capital construction facility

koap-u2b6308094b35f6df65-1.text: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods
koap-u2b6308094b35f6df65-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u3330cd0d4b61f3cf8e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods
koap-u3330cd0d4b61f3cf8e-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. koap-u1d5eb3673105563556-1.text: 1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, where membership of such a self-regulatory organisation is mandatory for the performance of such work —
koap-u1d5eb3673105563556-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u29c2ae507d8b4b2506-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u29c2ae507d8b4b2506-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u4114e72ae215c72165-1.text: 2. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform engineering surveys, prepare design documentation or carry out construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities under contracts for engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities concluded using competitive methods for selecting suppliers (contractors, service providers) in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contractual system in procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, or the legislation of the Russian Federation on procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities, or otherwise following tendering (competitions or auctions), where the legislation of the Russian Federation requires tendering (competitions or auctions) for concluding the relevant contracts —
koap-u4114e72ae215c72165-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u000f8deaa239570587-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-u000f8deaa239570587-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-5.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-5.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u3eeb54bfbe8fa3c0b1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u3eeb54bfbe8fa3c0b1-1.locator: Article 9.5.1. Performance of engineering surveys, preparation of design documentation, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities by a person who is not a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, or in violation of requirements established by urban development legislation for persons entitled to perform such work under a relevant contract concluded using competitive contracting methods

koap-u6510373e2cb0eb6068-1.text: Article 9.5.2. Violation of the time limits for forwarding documents, materials or information about them for inclusion in state information systems supporting urban development activities
koap-u6510373e2cb0eb6068-1.locator: Article 9.5.2. Violation of the time limits for forwarding documents, materials or information about them for inclusion in state information systems supporting urban development activities

koap-u5034f4e313c9e7e3ea-1.locator: Article 9.5.2. Violation of the time limits for forwarding documents, materials or information about them for inclusion in state information systems supporting urban development activities

koap-uee3a7f834ff8acea9a-1.text: Violation by state authorities, local self-government bodies or organisations that have adopted, approved and issued documents or materials which, or information about which, must be included under the Urban Development Code of the Russian Federation in state information systems supporting urban development activities, of the time limits for forwarding the relevant documents, materials or information about them to the local self-government bodies of urban districts, local self-government bodies of municipal districts, or executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (state budgetary institutions subordinate to them) authorised to maintain such state information systems, in relation to whose territories those documents or materials are adopted, approved or issued —

koap-u4014a5b4b34f0ef18d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4014a5b4b34f0ef18d-1.locator: Article 9.5.2. Violation of the time limits for forwarding documents, materials or information about them for inclusion in state information systems supporting urban development activities

koap-u0e2932058c9e017f63-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances
koap-u0e2932058c9e017f63-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-ue0e2f46c1d0b78316a-1.text: 1. Violation of standards and rules in the use of atomic energy —
koap-ue0e2f46c1d0b78316a-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-ue02cb762c51a53d39f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue02cb762c51a53d39f-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-u6e121a837c9efe49af-1.text: 2. Violation of the established procedure for accounting for nuclear materials or radioactive substances, or failure to ensure control over compliance with the rules for their storage and use —
koap-u6e121a837c9efe49af-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-u04807fd33273a75425-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to one and a half years; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u04807fd33273a75425-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-ub7c4eca4c5b35f47bf-1.text: 3. Gross violation of standards and rules in the use of atomic energy —

koap-u8b99955fa5fe1d28dd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to two years; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.

koap-ubf55cb796a94650653-1.text: 1. A gross violation of standards and rules in the use of atomic energy means a violation resulting in an immediate threat to human life or health and to the environment.

koap-ub6f389d9d95d239cd3-1.text: 2. Administrative liability for violations that do not constitute gross violations of standards and rules in the use of atomic energy shall not apply in the territory of Zaporizhzhia Oblast until 1 January 2028.
koap-ub6f389d9d95d239cd3-1.locator: Article 9.6. Violation of rules for the use of atomic energy and accounting for nuclear materials and radioactive substances

koap-ub5705d1393532992a5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.7. Damage to electricity networks

koap-ud15250f0be36843671-1.text: 1. Damage to electricity networks with a voltage of up to 1000 volts (overhead, underground and underwater cable power lines, incoming and distribution devices) —

koap-u11ecd1d2d14f0626d2-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.

koap-ua2eb4c4370d20b548e-1.text: 2. Damage to electricity networks with a voltage exceeding 1000 volts —

koap-ud8aa8e00058bc8e5ca-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.

koap-uc089c8205926da334a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency
koap-uc089c8205926da334a-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-ubf28e42454a4cf838b-1.text: 1. Release of goods by a manufacturer or importation of goods into the Russian Federation by an importer without including information on their energy efficiency class or other mandatory energy efficiency information in the technical documentation accompanying the goods, their marking or their label, or violation of the established rules for including that information —
koap-ubf28e42454a4cf838b-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-uef4674e35e5f0854ed-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods that were the subject matter of the administrative offence; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods that were the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-uef4674e35e5f0854ed-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u4351e4b62e05894526-1.text: 2. Sale of goods without information on their energy efficiency class or other mandatory energy efficiency information in the technical documentation accompanying the goods, their marking or their labels, where such information is mandatory —
koap-u4351e4b62e05894526-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-uef4674e35e5f0854ed-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods that were the subject matter of the administrative offence; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods that were the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-uef4674e35e5f0854ed-2.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u86c19a30c608118370-1.text: 3. Failure, in the design, construction, reconstruction or major repair of buildings, structures or installations, to comply with energy efficiency requirements or requirements to equip them with meters for the energy resources used —
koap-u86c19a30c608118370-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-ube38a2037e820856e5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ube38a2037e820856e5-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-ud54d9bf10fa0918bfa-1.text: 4. Failure by persons responsible for the maintenance of apartment buildings to comply with energy efficiency requirements applicable to apartment buildings, requirements to equip them with meters for the energy resources used, or requirements to carry out mandatory energy conservation and energy efficiency improvement measures concerning the common property of owners of premises in apartment buildings —
koap-ud54d9bf10fa0918bfa-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u87bcbda60c186a1355-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u87bcbda60c186a1355-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u1aeff36f8dd83c25dd-1.text: 5. Failure by persons responsible for the maintenance of apartment buildings to comply with requirements to develop proposals for energy conservation and energy efficiency improvement measures in apartment buildings and communicate them to the owners of premises in those buildings —
koap-u1aeff36f8dd83c25dd-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u87bcbda60c186a1355-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u87bcbda60c186a1355-2.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u1a2100ad713af708a2-1.text: 6. Failure by organisations obliged to install, replace and operate meters for the energy resources they supply or transmit to comply with the requirement to provide owners of residential houses or garden houses, persons representing their interests, owners of premises in apartment buildings or persons responsible for the maintenance of apartment buildings with proposals to equip them with meters for the energy resources used, where providing such proposals to those persons is mandatory —
koap-u1a2100ad713af708a2-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-uc088e16424c36a6028-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uc088e16424c36a6028-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-uce9def14b95ad10913-1.text: 7. Failure by owners of non-residential buildings, structures or installations, in the course of their operation, to comply with the energy efficiency requirements applicable to such buildings, structures or installations, or requirements to equip them with meters for the energy resources used —
koap-uce9def14b95ad10913-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u8da2fe4cac98393bbe-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to thirty-five thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8da2fe4cac98393bbe-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-ub82796026f6eea5119-1.text: 8. Failure to submit a declaration of energy resource consumption, failure to comply with requirements for the form of that declaration, or violation of the procedure for submitting it —
koap-ub82796026f6eea5119-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-uc0c2d031846b234644-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c2d031846b234644-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u4c33997d69bd0beb90-1.text: 9. Failure to comply with the rules for submitting to the federal executive body authorised to establish and ensure the functioning of the state information system for energy conservation and energy efficiency improvement the information necessary for inclusion in that system, except in the cases provided for by Part 8 of this Article —
koap-u4c33997d69bd0beb90-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u59276f001496c39339-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand roubles; on legal entities, ten thousand roubles.
koap-u59276f001496c39339-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u4f02ae82275721c94d-1.text: 10. Failure by organisations with state or municipal participation, or organisations engaged in regulated activities, to comply with the requirement to adopt programmes for energy conservation and energy efficiency improvement —
koap-u4f02ae82275721c94d-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u563f93f532b4e5234f-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u563f93f532b4e5234f-4.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-udf744a06ef85a0a883-1.text: 11. Procurement of goods, works or services to meet state and municipal needs that do not comply with energy efficiency requirements applicable to them —
koap-udf744a06ef85a0a883-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u0612071fa787f55444-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u0612071fa787f55444-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-ucae398e47db159adf3-1.text: 12. Unjustified refusal or evasion, by an organisation obliged to install, replace and operate meters for the energy resources it supplies or transmits, to conclude and/or perform the relevant contract, violation of the established procedure for concluding it, or failure by that organisation to comply with requirements imposed on it as mandatory for the installation, replacement and operation of meters for the energy resources used, excluding electricity meters —
koap-ucae398e47db159adf3-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u1060e0e8f49168226d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1060e0e8f49168226d-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-udd5bb6ef8b4ed8d810-1.text: 13. Failure by electricity suppliers of last resort or grid organisations to fulfil the duty to acquire, install, replace and authorise the commissioning of electricity meters in the cases provided for by legislation on the electricity sector —
koap-udd5bb6ef8b4ed8d810-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u61459d88d8cfdfb910-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u61459d88d8cfdfb910-1.locator: Article 9.16. Violation of legislation on energy conservation and improving energy efficiency

koap-u04c52db335f5684a47-1.text: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses
koap-u04c52db335f5684a47-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-u0dbf38aadce65450d0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses
koap-u0dbf38aadce65450d0-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-u700ba4a3a2a4dd43e3-1.text: Violation by owners or other lawful possessors of thermal power plants producing electricity and/or heat for consumers or boiler houses producing heat for consumers, or by their officials, of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses —
koap-u700ba4a3a2a4dd43e3-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-u992ea20e0d7c3ea194-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for eighteen months to three years; on legal entities, a fine equal to the value of the subject matter of the administrative offence at the time the administrative offence ended or was stopped.
koap-u992ea20e0d7c3ea194-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-u0eb0ceb8bd6f2b790c-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, the value of the subject matter of the administrative offence means the value of the quantity of fuel by which reserves fall short of the prescribed fuel reserve standard. That value shall be determined using the price of such fuel taken into account by the federal executive body or executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation responsible for state price (tariff) regulation when setting prices (tariffs) for electricity (capacity) and/or thermal energy.
koap-u0eb0ceb8bd6f2b790c-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-ud4037db2b6cdcd879f-1.text: Where those prices (tariffs) are not subject to state regulation, the fuel price shall be established on the basis of the market price of that type of fuel, determined in accordance with official sources of information on market prices and/or exchange quotations.
koap-ud4037db2b6cdcd879f-1.locator: Article 9.17. Violation of fuel reserve standards or the procedure for creating and using fuel reserves at thermal power plants and boiler houses

koap-ud76cfd238537f2907c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building
koap-ud76cfd238537f2907c-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-u928234c0826ac43085-1.text: 1. Violation by a natural monopoly entity of the established procedure for connection (technological connection) to trunk oil and/or petroleum-product pipelines, trunk gas pipelines, electricity networks, heating networks, gas distribution networks, or centralised hot water supply, cold water supply or wastewater disposal systems; violation of the rules of non-discriminatory access to goods or to infrastructure facilities used by natural monopoly entities directly to provide services in natural monopoly sectors; violation by an owner or other lawful possessor of an electricity grid facility of the rules of non-discriminatory access to electricity transmission services; obstruction by an owner or other lawful possessor of water supply and/or sewerage networks of the transportation of water through its water supply networks and/or wastewater through its sewerage networks; or obstruction by an owner or other lawful possessor of heating networks of the transmission of thermal energy through its heating networks —
koap-u928234c0826ac43085-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-ud0847c8ca09071b4e2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud0847c8ca09071b4e2-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-u08633c033f9aa35a3c-1.text: 1.1. Violation by a person managing an apartment building of the established rules governing interaction between a communications operator and the person managing the apartment building during installation, operation and dismantling of communications networks on common property in the apartment building —
koap-u08633c033f9aa35a3c-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-ud0847c8ca09071b4e2-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud0847c8ca09071b4e2-2.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-ufe4117b5af138a0b9c-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 or 1.1 of this Article —
koap-ufe4117b5af138a0b9c-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-u4078ab584444bb07dc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u4078ab584444bb07dc-1.locator: Article 9.21. Violation of the connection (technological connection) procedure, non-discriminatory access rules, or rules governing interaction between a communications operator and a person managing an apartment building

koap-uedfe9d713beb6eba2f-1.text: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater
koap-uedfe9d713beb6eba2f-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u61c1ac039284f7f063-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater
koap-u61c1ac039284f7f063-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u7741b0bf506920f917-1.text: 1. Violation by an electricity consumer of a complete or partial restriction of electricity consumption imposed on that consumer while the circumstances forming the basis for the restriction persist; failure by an electricity consumer to comply with a requirement to restrict its electricity consumption itself, issued in accordance with the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption established by electricity-sector legislation; or failure by an electricity consumer, in the cases provided for by that procedure, to provide representatives of a grid organisation or another person obliged to take action to introduce the restriction of electricity consumption with access to the consumer's electricity-receiving devices —
koap-u7741b0bf506920f917-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uf0df18d803079fbb86-1.text: 2. Failure by a grid organisation or another person obliged to take action to restrict or restore an electricity consumer's electricity consumption to comply with requirements to impose such a restriction (other than requirements to restrict electricity consumption to prevent or eliminate an electricity system emergency), or requirements to carry out organisational and technical measures necessary to restore the consumer's electricity supply, issued in accordance with the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption established by electricity-sector legislation, in the absence of circumstances provided for by that procedure that prevent the introduction of such a restriction or restoration of electricity consumption —
koap-uf0df18d803079fbb86-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-2.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u1e76398a9c76f20f52-1.text: 3. Failure by an electricity consumer whose electricity consumption restriction may have economic, environmental or social consequences to carry out measures determined under the procedure established by electricity-sector legislation to ensure the consumer's readiness for a complete restriction of its electricity consumption and to prevent economic, environmental or social consequences resulting from the introduction of such a restriction —
koap-u1e76398a9c76f20f52-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-3.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-ud8b3919f666d495771-1.text: 4. Violation by an electricity consumer or electricity-sector entity of requirements established by electricity-sector legislation to draw up agreements on technological and/or emergency minimum protected supply levels and send them for signature to the grid organisation or another person to whose electricity grid facilities (power installations) the electricity-receiving devices or electricity facilities of that consumer or electricity-sector entity are being (have been) technologically connected; or violation by the grid organisation or another person to whose electricity grid facilities (power installations) the technological connection is being (has been) made of the time limits and procedure for agreeing technological and/or emergency minimum protected supply levels —
koap-ud8b3919f666d495771-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u071e2b6ff0de66ddfc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u071e2b6ff0de66ddfc-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-ufd1495a000434766db-1.text: 5. Violation by a heat consumer of a complete or partial restriction of consumption of thermal energy (capacity) and/or heat-transfer medium imposed on that consumer while the circumstances forming the basis for the restriction persist; failure by a heat consumer to comply with a requirement to restrict its consumption of thermal energy (capacity) and/or heat-transfer medium itself, issued in accordance with the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply established by heat-supply legislation; or failure by a heat consumer, in the cases provided for by that procedure, to provide representatives of a heating network organisation or another person obliged to take action to restrict or terminate supply of thermal energy (capacity) and/or heat-transfer medium with access to the consumer's heat-consuming installations —
koap-ufd1495a000434766db-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-4.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u86ec3cefddae511a90-1.text: 6. Failure by a heating network organisation or another person obliged to take action to restrict, terminate or restore supply of thermal energy (capacity) and/or heat-transfer medium to comply with requirements to take such action, issued in accordance with the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply established by heat-supply legislation, in the absence of circumstances provided for by that procedure that prevent such action —
koap-u86ec3cefddae511a90-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-5.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u6cc2a633e91879adc6-1.text: 7. Failure by a gas consumer to take action to restrict gas offtake completely or partially in the cases provided for by gas-supply legislation, or obstruction of measures by a supplier and/or gas distribution organisation to restrict gas supply (delivery) completely or partially while the circumstances forming the basis for the restriction persist —
koap-u6cc2a633e91879adc6-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-6.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u51274f617e44c13b12-1.text: 8. Violation by a subscriber of an organisation providing hot water supply, cold water supply and/or wastewater disposal of a temporary termination or restriction of water supply and/or wastewater disposal imposed on that subscriber while the circumstances forming the basis for the termination or restriction persist; or failure by that subscriber, or a person to whose water supply and/or sewerage networks the subscriber's water supply and/or wastewater disposal facilities are connected, to comply with a requirement to disconnect those facilities from the centralised water supply and/or wastewater disposal system, issued to that subscriber or person in accordance with the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater established by water supply and wastewater disposal legislation —
koap-u51274f617e44c13b12-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-7.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-u1ca614bebf15cf10d8-1.text: 9. Violation by an organisation providing hot water supply, cold water supply and/or wastewater disposal, or by a transit organisation, of the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater established by water supply and wastewater disposal legislation —
koap-u1ca614bebf15cf10d8-1.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for two to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc0c84bf43199399d24-8.locator: Article 9.22. Violation of the procedure for complete and/or partial restriction of electricity consumption, the procedure for restricting and terminating heat supply, the rules for restricting gas supply (delivery) and offtake, or the procedure for temporarily terminating or restricting water supply, wastewater disposal, or transportation of water and/or wastewater

koap-ue0ced04df0ebc74c24-1.text: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments
koap-ue0ced04df0ebc74c24-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u1604ec324ab7e6674b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments
koap-u1604ec324ab7e6674b-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u6aaefa71c1cabea061-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for the quality (time limit or frequency) of work (services) for the maintenance and repair of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments, or failure to perform work (provide services) for the maintenance and repair of such gas equipment included in the list provided for by the rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments —
koap-u6aaefa71c1cabea061-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u58ee88ec7701d65793-1.text: 1.1. Performance of work (provision of services) for the maintenance and repair of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments, or technical diagnostic work on gas pipelines forming part of such equipment, by an organisation that does not meet the requirements of gas-supply legislation, by a person who is not an employee of an organisation meeting those requirements, or by an employee of such an organisation who has not been certified (recertified) under the procedure established by gas-supply legislation —
koap-u58ee88ec7701d65793-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u6a9d3501a6abb481b3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6a9d3501a6abb481b3-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u48d1a964460f74a357-1.text: 2. Evasion of concluding a contract for the maintenance and repair of gas equipment within an apartment building, a contract for the maintenance of gas equipment within an apartment in an apartment building, a contract for the maintenance of gas equipment within a residential house (household property), or a contract for technical diagnostics of gas pipelines forming part of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments, where concluding such contracts is mandatory —
koap-u48d1a964460f74a357-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-2.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u3b79fa43d64a72338a-1.text: 3. Refusal to admit, under the procedure and in the cases established by legislation, a representative of a specialised organisation to perform work (provide services) for the maintenance and repair of gas equipment within an apartment building, for the maintenance of gas equipment within an apartment in an apartment building or within a residential house (household property), or to suspend gas supply —
koap-u3b79fa43d64a72338a-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-3.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u97bce384325d78c10f-1.text: 4. Evasion of replacement of equipment forming part of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments where such replacement is mandatory under the rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments, or unauthorised replacement of that equipment without engaging a specialised organisation —
koap-u97bce384325d78c10f-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uab82b7e942d26a136c-4.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u4d83c2e0734174041a-1.text: 5. The acts (omissions) provided for by Parts 1–4 of this Article that result in an accident or an immediate threat of harm to human life or health —
koap-u4d83c2e0734174041a-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-ue56bb8b4532f5cd030-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to three years; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to two million roubles.
koap-ue56bb8b4532f5cd030-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u471ea2acc71704f944-1.text: 6. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Parts 1–4 of this Article —
koap-u471ea2acc71704f944-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u7c385d0eaf2a830663-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to three years; on legal entities, five hundred and fifty thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u7c385d0eaf2a830663-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-u8672d46d06a70b572a-1.text: Note. For administrative offences provided for by Part 1.1 of this Article, individuals who are not employees of a specialised organisation performing work (providing services) for the maintenance and repair of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments and meeting the requirements of gas-supply legislation, or of an organisation performing work (providing services) for technical diagnostics of gas pipelines forming part of gas equipment within buildings and/or apartments and meeting the requirements of gas-supply legislation, as well as employees of such organisations who have not been certified (recertified), shall bear administrative liability as officials.
koap-u8672d46d06a70b572a-1.locator: Article 9.23. Violation of rules ensuring the safe use and maintenance of gas equipment within buildings and apartments

koap-uefde3686f4865ccb5e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 9.24. Violation of heat-supply legislation

koap-u4ab67a844c6f1e1bb9-1.text: 1. Failure by an authorised official of a local self-government body of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, or of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or by an authorised official of an executive body of a city of federal significance, to send, within the time limit established by heat-supply legislation, a draft heat-supply scheme or a draft updated heat-supply scheme for such a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or a city of federal significance, to the federal executive body authorised to implement state policy on heat supply for approval —

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-ude4e653cc1366be832-1.text: 2. Failure, within the established time limits, to post information on the venue of public hearings on a draft heat-supply scheme or draft updated heat-supply scheme for a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or a city of federal significance, or to post the final document (minutes) of such public hearings, by an authorised official of the local self-government body of such a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of five hundred thousand or more, of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district classified as a heat-supply pricing zone, or of the executive body of a city of federal significance, authorised to hold the public hearings —

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-3.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-u627da54fc5e11e542a-1.text: 3. Failure by an official of a local self-government body of a settlement, municipal okrug or urban district with a population of fewer than five hundred thousand, or an official of the local self-government body of a municipal district in whose territory a rural settlement is located, to implement within the established time limit a decision made by the federal executive body authorised to implement state policy on heat supply following consideration of disagreements arising among executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, organisations conducting regulated activities in heat supply, and consumers during the development, approval or updating of heat-supply schemes —

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-4.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-u9ccb7e24251c334031-1.text: 4. Violation by an official of an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the procedure for monitoring the development, approval and updating of heat-supply schemes for settlements, municipal okrugs and urban districts with a population of fewer than five hundred thousand, excluding those settlements and districts classified as heat-supply pricing zones —

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-5.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-uc34ff1848f5946062d-1.text: 5. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1, 2, 3 or 4 of this Article —

koap-u201b8f7cb8479e9ca5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one year to two years.

koap-u4f58f3410bd0d14a7f-1.text: 6. Failure by the persons specified in Point 1 of Part 1 of Article 20 of Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 190-FZ ‘On Heat Supply’ to remedy, within the established time limits, the identified violations listed in a report assessing readiness for the heating period —

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-6.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-u97aaeb2e2492c2a2b0-1.text: 7. Failure by the persons specified in Points 2 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 20 of Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 190-FZ ‘On Heat Supply’ to remedy, within the established time limits, the identified violations listed in a report assessing readiness for the heating period —

koap-udd2f68903cf1a436d6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles.

koap-u9442b1d80fc3b3229f-1.text: 8. Failure by the persons specified in Points 3–5 of Part 1 of Article 20 of Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 190-FZ ‘On Heat Supply’ to remedy, within the established time limits, the identified violations listed in a report assessing readiness for the heating period —

koap-u7a51a6805cea0afc7c-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred roubles; on officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles.

koap-ud3d3ae0589bae51b33-1.text: Note. koap-u96df37088c7154ed5a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
koap-u96df37088c7154ed5a-1.locator: Article 10.10. Violation of rules for the operation of land reclamation systems or separately located hydraulic structures. Damage to land reclamation systems

koap-uca392294b58f2b3664-1.text: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding
koap-uca392294b58f2b3664-1.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-u979d7d94a30c8b095e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding
koap-u979d7d94a30c8b095e-1.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-u8aedb468aca57cab8a-1.text: 1. Sale or use for reproduction of breeding products (material) in violation of requirements established by legislation on pedigree livestock breeding —
koap-u8aedb468aca57cab8a-1.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-u63457d7b6fe905ef48-3.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-u63457d7b6fe905ef48-3.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-ua6c1346c7778221f63-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for state registration of breeding animals and breeding herds —
koap-ua6c1346c7778221f63-1.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-u38159d93d7b90b07bc-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred rubles; on officials, five hundred to one thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-u38159d93d7b90b07bc-4.locator: Article 10.11. Violation of standards and rules for pedigree livestock breeding

koap-u05f712897cac78a205-1.text: Article 10.12. Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants
koap-u05f712897cac78a205-1.locator: Article 10.12. Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u5e57e479f167a68aa1-1.locator: Article 10.12. Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u0e8927c903c3262613-1.text: Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants —
koap-u0e8927c903c3262613-1.locator: Article 10.12. Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants

koap-ue82bce713a6097a6eb-2.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred rubles; on officials, five hundred to one thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-ue82bce713a6097a6eb-2.locator: Article 10.12. Violation of rules for the production, procurement, treatment, storage, sale, transport and use of seeds of agricultural plants
