koap-uc9872196fc08ec31d2-1.locator: Article 10.13. Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u2ce0208887c1e863ec-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 10.13. Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants
koap-u2ce0208887c1e863ec-1.locator: Article 10.13. Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u5072fb72b21e4ee412-1.text: Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants or entry therein of inaccurate information on the varietal and sowing qualities of seeds —
koap-u5072fb72b21e4ee412-1.locator: Article 10.13. Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u537d30b214b8162642-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred rubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, three thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u537d30b214b8162642-1.locator: Article 10.13. Violation of rules for maintaining documentation on seeds of agricultural plants

koap-u5184ad9f5091f8633c-1.text: Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u5184ad9f5091f8633c-1.locator: Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u93ffb30b8ed7dc1fb1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u93ffb30b8ed7dc1fb1-1.locator: Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u777188b4bb54dee1fd-1.text: Import into the territory of the Russian Federation of seed lots that do not meet the requirements of state standards without documents certifying their varietal and sowing qualities, of unpackaged (bulk) seed lots treated with chemical and biological preparations, or of seed lots authorized for use whose varieties are not included in the State Register of Breeding Achievements, except for seed lots intended for scientific research, state trials or the production of seeds for export from the Russian Federation —
koap-u777188b4bb54dee1fd-1.locator: Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand rubles.
koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-1.locator: Article 10.14. Violation of the procedure for importing seeds of agricultural plants into the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u524fbb6888c499f4e3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation Chapter 11. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES IN TRANSPORT

koap-uc0859a5a4851ccb9db-1.text: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro
koap-uc0859a5a4851ccb9db-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ub9960bac39da22fa82-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro
koap-ub9960bac39da22fa82-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u9fb2e0b81463126af8-1.text: 1. Damage to railway tracks, signalling or communication structures and devices or other railway or metro infrastructure facilities (including track facilities), throwing objects onto railway tracks or leaving objects on them, where these acts may disrupt train traffic and do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u9fb2e0b81463126af8-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u1577ffccd1fec618b0-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; and on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u1577ffccd1fec618b0-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u106b549bf0ab0949b4-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with established clearance dimensions when loading and unloading cargo —
koap-u106b549bf0ab0949b4-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand rubles.
koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-2.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ua2d01811b1251091c2-1.text: 3. Damage to protective forest plantations, snow protection barriers or fences along railway tracks, where these acts do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-ua2d01811b1251091c2-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u4b462a051b0a2fcdc1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand rubles; and on officials, five thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-u4b462a051b0a2fcdc1-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ue3a0f3b8db7484ce2b-1.text: 3.1. A violation provided for in part 3 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-ue3a0f3b8db7484ce2b-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ua4cb770f95cc45443a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ua4cb770f95cc45443a-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-uecdfecef97450d9570-1.text: 4. Violation of rules for the passage of animal-drawn vehicles and the driving of livestock across railway tracks, as well as violation of rules for grazing livestock near railway tracks —
koap-uecdfecef97450d9570-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ue4d8db43b5315f5cee-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ue4d8db43b5315f5cee-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u82a53baf48b7bf2f77-1.text: 5. Walking on railway tracks in unauthorized places, as well as crossing railway tracks at a pedestrian crossing or railway level crossing when the traffic signal prohibits crossing —
koap-u82a53baf48b7bf2f77-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-2.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-2.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u2e2459d802a807d2fc-1.text: 5.1. A violation provided for in part 5 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-u2e2459d802a807d2fc-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-u1a8a7fad126cab4a05-1.text: 6. Violation of rules for traffic safety and railway operation on public railway tracks, non-public railway tracks or at railway level crossings, except in the cases provided for in parts 1 - 5.1 of this Article, where these acts do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u1a8a7fad126cab4a05-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand rubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-3.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-uc3e664c47e28444168-1.text: Note. A person who commits an administrative offence provided for in part 5 or 5.1 of this Article consisting in crossing railway tracks at an unauthorized place shall be held administratively liable if, within one kilometre of the place where the crossing occurred, there was a pedestrian crossing, tunnel, bridge or other place specially equipped or designated for crossing and marked with an information sign.
koap-uc3e664c47e28444168-1.locator: Article 11.1. Acts endangering traffic safety on railways and the metro

koap-ufacfa18bdbd5794507-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation Article 11.2. Repealed
koap-ufacfa18bdbd5794507-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation Article 11.2. Repealed

koap-u8fdb2fc6c7cdc4087d-1.text: Article 11.2. Repealed. — Federal Law of 28.12.2009 No. 380-FZ.
koap-u8fdb2fc6c7cdc4087d-1.locator: Article 11.2. Repealed. — Federal Law of 28.12.2009 No. 380-FZ.

koap-uf9459e53a119f24000-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.3. Acts endangering flight safety

koap-ua41a6fea556fb60adf-1.text: 1. Placement in the vicinity of an aerodrome, heliport or landing site of signs and devices resembling the marking signs and devices used to identify aerodromes, heliports or landing sites —

koap-ub6b211f88630ac64e4-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.

koap-ucb8c0f9c234797c1d7-1.text: 2. Use of pyrotechnic articles on the territory of an airport, aerodrome, heliport or landing site or in an approach zone to an aerodrome, heliport or landing site without permission from the administration of the airport, aerodrome, heliport or landing site —

koap-uc9b69768a647dc58a5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence.

koap-u6fb71c351ebd22a619-1.text: 3. Damage to the equipment of an aerodrome, heliport or landing site, to aerodrome signs or to an aircraft —

koap-u530b7a94978b892067-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles.

koap-u1b66ebe17eadd9e031-1.text: 4. Walking or driving without permission on the territory of an airport (except the passenger terminal) or aerodrome or a facility providing radio or lighting support for flights —

koap-u445522dc2bf6232cf6-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand rubles.

koap-ub6904b7837fd0fe7c3-1.text: 5. Violation of the procedure for organizing the movement of special-purpose vehicles and mechanization equipment at an aerodrome —

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.

koap-u9925f31e0070bc5b6e-1.text: 6. Failure to comply with rules for placing daytime and nighttime marking signs and devices on buildings, structures, communication lines, power transmission lines, radio equipment or other facilities for the purpose of ensuring aircraft flight safety —

koap-ub6b211f88630ac64e4-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand rubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.

koap-ub36e52b2ec53d402f0-1.text: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
koap-ub36e52b2ec53d402f0-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u946dc6b6a10e61f469-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements
koap-u946dc6b6a10e61f469-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u3611a2b2a5139f685d-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with or violation of aviation security standards, rules or procedures, except in the cases provided for in parts 2 - 4 of this Article —
koap-u3611a2b2a5139f685d-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u48b3cb56d8255a370c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, two thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u48b3cb56d8255a370c-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-ue39ee0a440947a1441-1.text: 2. Failure to take measures to maintain the fences of a controlled territory or restricted-access zone or the ground structures of an airport, aerodrome or heliport —
koap-ue39ee0a440947a1441-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u683c49977de67faa20-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, four thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-u683c49977de67faa20-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u72c50b6b36d121ffe0-1.text: 3. Failure to take measures to prevent persons, hand luggage or baggage, cargo, mail or aircraft supplies that have not undergone screening, or objects or substances prohibited from carriage by aircraft, from being brought on board an aircraft —
koap-u72c50b6b36d121ffe0-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-ub36d4c9c1979478842-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ub36d4c9c1979478842-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u41a7851a148922081f-1.text: 4. Bringing or assisting in bringing on board an aircraft persons, hand luggage or baggage, cargo, mail or aircraft supplies that have not undergone screening, or objects or substances prohibited from carriage by aircraft —
koap-u41a7851a148922081f-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u90b408d74fbff73044-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand rubles; and on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-u90b408d74fbff73044-1.locator: Article 11.3.1. Violation of aviation security requirements

koap-u9cb64cbf27b8b265cf-1.text: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules
koap-u9cb64cbf27b8b265cf-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-uc53efc7b647f1f7d01-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules
koap-uc53efc7b647f1f7d01-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-u3b7e855cbf13c76580-1.text: 1. Violation by an airspace user of federal airspace use rules, where this act does not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u3b7e855cbf13c76580-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-u6c29eccc11a3e622da-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u6c29eccc11a3e622da-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-u62f8b17c99946aa649-1.text: 2. Violation of airspace use rules by persons who have not been granted, in the prescribed manner, the right to engage in activities involving the use of airspace, where this act does not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u62f8b17c99946aa649-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-ua3f42e82a3271f1ead-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ua3f42e82a3271f1ead-1.locator: Article 11.4. Violation of airspace use rules

koap-u9945ba1dcdf35f2798-1.text: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
koap-u9945ba1dcdf35f2798-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u327cf347ce080269f3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules
koap-u327cf347ce080269f3-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u6bb02ac024467098f5-1.text: 1. Violation of the procedure for authorizing aircraft to fly or of rules for flight preparation and performance, except in the cases provided for in parts 3 - 9 of this Article, where these acts negligently cause minor harm to the victim's health —
koap-u6bb02ac024467098f5-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-ub3f9e6c6b8d8d99263-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for three to six months; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to eighty thousand rubles.
koap-ub3f9e6c6b8d8d99263-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u86edf7bd8fb6607ed1-1.text: 2. The same acts negligently causing harm of moderate severity to the victim's health —
koap-u86edf7bd8fb6607ed1-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u34fb71719177be9d99-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u34fb71719177be9d99-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u18c7796b11fbeed714-1.text: 3. Taking off in an aircraft with defects that prohibit commencement of a flight without permission from an authorized body, or in violation of passenger (cargo) capacity standards or aircraft flight weight or centre-of-gravity limits —
koap-u18c7796b11fbeed714-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u25b6a007151035f88e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the pilot-in-command of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year.
koap-u25b6a007151035f88e-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-ua407bdefc21a176719-1.text: 4. Operation of an aircraft by a person who does not have the right to operate it —
koap-ua407bdefc21a176719-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-ubf4db0098f80f79286-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ubf4db0098f80f79286-2.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u5e0da4c3c2af75674a-1.text: 5. Operation of an aircraft that has not undergone state registration or has not been entered in state records, or does not bear nationality and registration marks or a record identification mark, or bears knowingly false nationality and registration marks or a knowingly false record identification mark —
koap-u5e0da4c3c2af75674a-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u25b6a007151035f88e-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the pilot-in-command of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for up to one year.
koap-u25b6a007151035f88e-2.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u62a6d4561019e3df9a-1.text: 6. Operation of an aircraft without the aircraft and flight documentation required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on board, or operation of an aircraft by a flight crew member who does not carry documents authorizing the operation of that type of aircraft —
koap-u62a6d4561019e3df9a-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand rubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-4.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-uf56efcd05082ce3af1-1.text: 7. Operation of an aircraft by an intoxicated person, or evasion by the person operating an aircraft of a medical examination for intoxication in accordance with the established procedure, or transfer of control of an aircraft to an intoxicated person —
koap-uf56efcd05082ce3af1-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-ueac01447a7019215c6-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to operate an aircraft for two to three years.
koap-ueac01447a7019215c6-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-uf77a4b0f577869e732-1.text: 8. Authorizing a flight by an aircraft that has not undergone state registration, or has not been entered in state records, or does not bear nationality and registration marks or a record identification mark, or bears knowingly false nationality and registration marks or a knowingly false record identification mark, or does not have on board the aircraft and flight documentation required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or does not have a full flight or cabin crew, or has defects that prohibit its operation without permission issued by an authorized body, or violates passenger (cargo) capacity standards or aircraft flight weight or centre-of-gravity limits, as well as allowing a person who does not have the right to do so or is intoxicated to operate or service an aircraft, or servicing an aircraft by a person who does not have the right to do so or is intoxicated —
koap-uf77a4b0f577869e732-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u97d4162b95826a32b5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on officials, ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles.
koap-u97d4162b95826a32b5-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u3448aebd91d2d951e3-1.text: 9. Conducting flights by aircraft that do not have on board the search and emergency rescue equipment required by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u3448aebd91d2d951e3-1.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand rubles.
koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-2.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-12.locator: Article 11.5. Violation of aircraft operational safety rules

koap-u153a4f1d3d89a8c553-1.text: 1. Causing minor harm to health shall mean a short-term health disorder or a slight permanent loss of general capacity for work.

koap-u9139f8f751c517eb60-1.text: 2. Causing harm of moderate severity to health shall mean a prolonged health disorder that is not life-threatening or a significant permanent loss of general capacity for work of less than one third.

koap-u1ead6e15f25877b25a-1.text: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport
koap-u1ead6e15f25877b25a-1.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-uf7203f8542a9b87a8f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport
koap-uf7203f8542a9b87a8f-1.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-ud4cf60b359533f5815-1.text: 1. Violation of the procedure for installing and constructing log booms and timber harbours, installation of fish weirs and other devices for harvesting (catching) aquatic biological resources in places not designated for that purpose without agreement, in accordance with the established procedure, with the administration of waterway and hydraulic structure districts, as well as carrying out diving work in port waters without the proper permit or failure to comply with signalling rules during such work —
koap-ud4cf60b359533f5815-1.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-u1522645f43f6074ba6-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred rubles; and on officials, five hundred to one thousand rubles.
koap-u1522645f43f6074ba6-2.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-u64c94f92f6c1594345-1.text: 2. Destruction of or damage to communication and signalling structures and devices on sea-going vessels or inland waterway vessels, floating and shore-based navigation aids or technical equipment and markers for shipping and navigation, or communication and signalling equipment, as well as damage to port and hydraulic structures, removal or installation without the proper permit (approval) of signs, structures or sources of sound and light signals that interfere with the identification of navigational signs and signals —
koap-u64c94f92f6c1594345-1.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-u00376d28e7fea4edae-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand rubles; and on officials, one thousand to two thousand rubles.
koap-u00376d28e7fea4edae-3.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-ued6b1aa067c153d986-1.text: 3. Violation of maintenance rules and the established operating regime for navigation equipment on bridges, dams and other hydraulic structures —
koap-ued6b1aa067c153d986-1.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-ueded8f97db89ab1109-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of five hundred to one thousand rubles.
koap-ueded8f97db89ab1109-2.locator: Article 11.6. Acts endangering navigation safety in water transport

koap-u556dbc8bcd71a3c5d5-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. koap-u1878c6698f21c1dddf-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. koap-u7984ad7d36196d3228-1.text: 1. Violation by a ship's master or shipowner of the requirement to report sunken property to the harbour master of a seaport, or failure by the owner of sunken property to meet deadlines for notifying the harbour master of a seaport of the intention to begin removing the sunken property where such removal is mandatory, or deadlines for preparing documentation for its removal specified in the harbour master's executive order on the conditions for removal of the sunken property, or failure by the owner of sunken property, at whose request the removal documentation was approved, to meet deadlines for commencing removal of the sunken property —
koap-u7984ad7d36196d3228-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. Failure to comply with the requirement to report sunken property to the harbour master of a seaport, and failure by the owner of sunken property to meet deadlines for notifying the harbour master of a seaport of the intention to begin removing the sunken property, deadlines for preparing documentation for its removal and deadlines for commencing its removal

koap-u1e005222f61087b43c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u1e005222f61087b43c-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. Failure to comply with the requirement to report sunken property to the harbour master of a seaport, and failure by the owner of sunken property to meet deadlines for notifying the harbour master of a seaport of the intention to begin removing the sunken property, deadlines for preparing documentation for its removal and deadlines for commencing its removal

koap-uebd3d1d4b0642a8389-1.text: 2. Violation by the owner of sunken property, at whose request the removal documentation was approved, of the conditions for removing the sunken property specified in that documentation —
koap-uebd3d1d4b0642a8389-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. Failure to comply with the requirement to report sunken property to the harbour master of a seaport, and failure by the owner of sunken property to meet deadlines for notifying the harbour master of a seaport of the intention to begin removing the sunken property, deadlines for preparing documentation for its removal and deadlines for commencing its removal

koap-ub7cbfd9952687f5ede-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to one million rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three hundred thousand to one million rubles; and on legal entities, three million to five million rubles.
koap-ub7cbfd9952687f5ede-1.locator: Article 11.6.1. Failure to comply with the requirement to report sunken property to the harbour master of a seaport, and failure by the owner of sunken property to meet deadlines for notifying the harbour master of a seaport of the intention to begin removing the sunken property, deadlines for preparing documentation for its removal and deadlines for commencing its removal

koap-u0498c6c742ec68213a-1.text: Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel
koap-u0498c6c742ec68213a-1.locator: Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel

koap-u64c71667bf8ca66184-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel
koap-u64c71667bf8ca66184-1.locator: Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel

koap-u0fd871d072e508307a-1.text: Disposal (deliberate destruction) or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel within the internal sea waters or territorial sea of the Russian Federation, on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation, on sea routes or inland waterways of the Russian Federation, or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, including the waters of the Northern Sea Route —
koap-u0fd871d072e508307a-1.locator: Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel

koap-ub51b437864e14a25bb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three million to five million rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three million to five million rubles; and on legal entities, fifteen million to twenty million rubles.
koap-ub51b437864e14a25bb-1.locator: Article 11.6.2. Disposal or intentional sinking of a sea-going vessel or inland waterway vessel

koap-u0830ff4d29b50fe6f9-1.text: Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel
koap-u0830ff4d29b50fe6f9-1.locator: Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel

koap-u27f8911ed914ac2b9f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel
koap-u27f8911ed914ac2b9f-1.locator: Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel

koap-u45a17e270acadfe5e2-1.text: Operation of a sea-going vessel of gross tonnage 300 or more without a certificate of insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel in accordance with an international treaty of the Russian Federation on the removal of sunken vessels —
koap-u45a17e270acadfe5e2-1.locator: Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel

koap-uc13fd4d302c12d131d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
koap-uc13fd4d302c12d131d-1.locator: Article 11.6.3. Failure to comply with the requirement for insurance or other financial security for liability for removal of a sunken vessel

koap-u645838cb7d3ab1c2d7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.7. Violation of navigation rules

koap-u05ada24d1d0f94a824-1.text: 1. Violation by a navigator or other person operating a vessel (other than a small craft) in maritime or inland water transport of rules for navigation and mooring of vessels, entry into and departure from a port, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of this Article, towing of convoys and rafts, giving sound and light signals, or displaying ship lights and shapes —

koap-u79f08c5919904b4ca1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for six months to one year.

koap-u7d61a2c3350d9fa306-2.text: 1.1. Repeated commission within one year of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —

koap-u312ffd8d84b20c1fea-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for one to two years.

koap-u7a4d1900b835f6ffd6-1.text: 2. Exceeding the established speed limit by a navigator or other person operating a small craft, failure to comply with the requirements of navigational signs, intentional stopping or mooring of a vessel in prohibited places, or violation of rules for manoeuvring, giving sound signals or displaying sidelights and shapes —

koap-ua8445eb6e66b500550-1.text: shall entail a warning, or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand rubles, or deprivation of the right to operate a small craft for up to six months.

koap-u8796e42b959a7b6180-1.text: 3. Navigation by a ship's master without a pilot in areas of compulsory pilotage, except where the vessel belongs to a category exempt from compulsory pilotage or the harbour master of the seaport has granted the ship's master the right to navigate without a pilot in accordance with the established procedure —

koap-ubc698f2e62446b7ad6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for up to three months.

koap-u95245bf3c5f029b48a-1.text: 4. Failure by a ship's master to report, or incorrect reporting to a pilot of, information on the draught, length, breadth and tonnage of the vessel and other information about the vessel necessary for the pilot to carry out pilotage —

koap-uc43c946577cb698133-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for up to three months.

koap-u0666e95a3b15158ff8-1.text: Note. A small craft in this Code shall mean a vessel whose length must not exceed twenty metres and whose total number of persons on board must not exceed twelve.

koap-u487f396c8f4ec609f0-1.text: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation
koap-u487f396c8f4ec609f0-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-ua2ac3f573b2d18e7b6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.7.1. koap-ua2ac3f573b2d18e7b6-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-ubc0b2cd4bb7df08303-1.text: 1. Failure by a navigator or other person operating a vessel (including a small craft) in maritime transport, or by a shipowner, to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation —
koap-ubc0b2cd4bb7df08303-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-u7ed4441af14647bad4-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles with deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for up to three years; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-u7ed4441af14647bad4-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-u5cb7d37e7c15d8d9a6-1.text: 2. The same acts involving unlawful obstruction of the movement of sea transport vessels and/or production activities and/or blocking of transport communications in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation —
koap-u5cb7d37e7c15d8d9a6-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-u1ff213dd05783ae59b-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for up to three years with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; on officials, five hundred thousand to one million rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence; and on legal entities, three million to five million rubles with confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-u1ff213dd05783ae59b-1.locator: Article 11.7.1. Failure to comply with measures to ensure navigation safety in safety zones established around artificial islands, installations and structures located on the continental shelf of the Russian Federation

koap-u3565ea2e64a2f1cdf5-1.text: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it
koap-u3565ea2e64a2f1cdf5-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-u5cc5267f815fd1d5f9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it
koap-u5cc5267f815fd1d5f9-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-u5b3580d2f1fe1b1636-1.text: 1. Operation of a vessel (including a small craft subject to state registration) that has not undergone technical inspection (survey), or does not bear side numbers or markings, or has been converted without the appropriate permit, or operation in violation of passenger capacity standards or restrictions on the navigation area and conditions, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u5b3580d2f1fe1b1636-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-6.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-6.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-u43debc8f162feccbbb-1.text: 2. Operation of a vessel by a person who does not have the right to operate that vessel, or transfer of control of a vessel to a person who does not have the right to operate it —
koap-u43debc8f162feccbbb-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-uc96a8f69924a1fdc70-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles.
koap-uc96a8f69924a1fdc70-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-u7858c501475dceee1a-1.text: 3. Operation of a vessel (including a small craft subject to state registration) that is not registered in the prescribed manner or has defects that prohibit its operation —
koap-u7858c501475dceee1a-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-1.locator: Article 11.8. Violation of rules for operating vessels, and operation of a vessel by a person without the right to operate it

koap-ue8b7a950af36d43388-1.text: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft
koap-ue8b7a950af36d43388-1.locator: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft

koap-u57d88cc8b5d3aa4d7d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft
koap-u57d88cc8b5d3aa4d7d-1.locator: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft

koap-uf17a9a5edb6c5e8a0c-1.text: 1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry a certificate authorizing the operation of a small craft, the small craft's registration certificate or a copy thereof certified in the prescribed manner, as well as documents confirming the right to possess, use or dispose of the vessel being operated in the absence of its owner —
koap-uf17a9a5edb6c5e8a0c-1.locator: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft

koap-ud137b16fe0b86428af-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundred rubles.
koap-ud137b16fe0b86428af-1.locator: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft

koap-u92c2db9f3cc79e90d2-1.text: 2. Transfer of control of a small craft to a person who does not carry a certificate authorizing the operation of a small craft —
koap-u92c2db9f3cc79e90d2-1.locator: Article 11.8.1. Operation of a small craft by a navigator who does not carry the documents required for authorization to operate a small craft

koap-ud137b16fe0b86428af-2.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundred rubles.

koap-u2911c19ace0e292116-1.text: 1. Operation of a vessel (including a small craft) by an intoxicated navigator or other person, as well as transfer of control of a vessel to an intoxicated person —

koap-u19859473883761aaba-1.text: 2. Evasion by a navigator or other person operating a vessel of a medical examination for intoxication in accordance with the established procedure —
koap-u19859473883761aaba-1.locator: Article 11.9. Operation of a vessel by an intoxicated navigator or other person

koap-uc643284788b29f4e70-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to operate a vessel for one to two years.
koap-uc643284788b29f4e70-1.locator: Article 11.9. Operation of a vessel by an intoxicated navigator or other person

koap-u13f50304064959bdda-1.locator: Article 11.10. Violation of rules for ensuring passenger safety on water transport vessels and small craft

koap-uccbd774fca72ad9679-1.locator: Article 11.11. Violation of rules for loading and unloading vessels

koap-u6d3024b827004418c2-1.text: Violation of rules for loading and unloading vessels, including small craft —

koap-u38159d93d7b90b07bc-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred rubles; on officials, five hundred to one thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand rubles.

koap-ua8386f2ac7a0ab6abb-1.locator: Article 11.12. Violation of rules for the use of bases (facilities) for mooring small craft

koap-ue119800bb0b499fc07-1.text: Operation of bases (facilities) for mooring small craft without permission from the state inspectorate for small craft, or violation of standards for basing small craft, conditions and technical requirements for the safe operation of bases (facilities), as well as keeping small craft that are not registered in the prescribed manner at such bases (facilities) —
koap-ue119800bb0b499fc07-1.locator: Article 11.12. Violation of rules for the use of bases (facilities) for mooring small craft

koap-u8800c2b6308c3f7a18-1.locator: Article 11.12. Violation of rules for the use of bases (facilities) for mooring small craft

koap-u2827bae465653da738-1.text: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel
koap-u2827bae465653da738-1.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-u75dcb1366692bc99b5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel
koap-u75dcb1366692bc99b5-1.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-u5863f7aeb24f8411f1-1.text: 1. Release (dispatch) of a vessel (other than a small craft) to sail by the person responsible for its operation without documents certifying the vessel's ownership and seaworthiness, or with an incomplete crew, or where the vessel's technical condition does not correspond to its documents, or in violation of established loading rules, passenger capacity standards or restrictions on the navigation area and conditions, as well as allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate the vessel or its machinery and equipment —
koap-u5863f7aeb24f8411f1-1.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand rubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-5.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-ua09f5e45f94a6ccfdc-1.text: 2. Release to sail of a small craft that is subject to state registration but has not been registered in the prescribed manner, or has not undergone technical inspection (survey), or has defects that prohibit its operation, or is not fitted with the required equipment, or has been converted without the appropriate permit, as well as allowing persons who do not have the right to operate that small craft or are intoxicated to operate it —
koap-ua09f5e45f94a6ccfdc-1.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-uf2ecf7c3dc1cc1810b-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand rubles on officials responsible for operating small craft.
koap-uf2ecf7c3dc1cc1810b-1.locator: Article 11.13. Violation of rules for releasing a vessel to sail or allowing persons without the appropriate diploma (certificate, licence) or intoxicated persons to operate a vessel

koap-u2350904f9810b2396e-1.locator: Article 11.14. Violation of rules for the carriage of hazardous substances, oversized or heavy cargo

koap-u92755adab9575fde7b-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for the carriage of hazardous substances, oversized or heavy cargo by maritime and inland water transport —

koap-u38159d93d7b90b07bc-6.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred rubles; on officials, five hundred to one thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-u38159d93d7b90b07bc-6.locator: Article 11.14. Violation of rules for the carriage of hazardous substances, oversized or heavy cargo

koap-u227b2fa4f1e866d0c2-1.text: 3. Violation of rules for the carriage of hazardous substances, oversized or heavy cargo by rail —

koap-u26454176279620f3cb-2.locator: Article 11.14. Violation of rules for the carriage of hazardous substances, oversized or heavy cargo

koap-u90bc0f6b510d821db2-1.text: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi
koap-u90bc0f6b510d821db2-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-u699ca0a09bce2cf55a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi
koap-u699ca0a09bce2cf55a-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-uf90b562d42837ffd3d-1.text: 1. Absence in the passenger compartment of a passenger taxi of information required by the Rules for the Carriage of Passengers and Baggage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport —
koap-uf90b562d42837ffd3d-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-ue14ba80747c533baa8-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of one thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand rubles.
koap-ue14ba80747c533baa8-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-u9f0437a7087b2f513c-1.text: 2. Failure to issue a passenger a cash register receipt or a receipt in the form of a strictly accountable form, as provided for by the Rules for the Carriage of Passengers and Baggage by Road Transport and Urban Surface Electric Transport, confirming payment for use of a passenger taxi —
koap-u9f0437a7087b2f513c-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-ue14ba80747c533baa8-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of one thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand rubles.
koap-ue14ba80747c533baa8-2.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-uec219881bdb0f2c277-1.text: 3. Absence on a vehicle used to provide passenger and baggage carriage services of the passenger taxi colour and graphic markings and/or an identification lamp on the roof of that vehicle —
koap-uec219881bdb0f2c277-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-u5dc5415f09ed80b053-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of three thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u5dc5415f09ed80b053-1.locator: Article 11.14.1. Violation of rules for the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi

koap-ufbb910ea09e869ba1f-1.text: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage
koap-ufbb910ea09e869ba1f-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-ua556d1f6b7eb0345f5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage
koap-ua556d1f6b7eb0345f5-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u331c373befc7313c0b-1.text: 1. Refusal by a driver to present a charter contract or a copy thereof, or a work order for providing a vehicle for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage where the charter contract is concluded in the form of a work order, to officials authorized to check that drivers possess those documents —
koap-u331c373befc7313c0b-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles.
koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u19aa3110e95a59ccd0-1.text: 2. Charter carriage of passengers and baggage without conclusion of a written vehicle charter contract —
koap-u19aa3110e95a59ccd0-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u9769d44b0a43e97fa6-1.text: 3. Charter carriage of passengers and baggage on terms providing for granting an indefinite group of persons the right to travel in the vehicle for a fee, or dissemination of information on the charter carriage of passengers and baggage on those terms —
koap-u9769d44b0a43e97fa6-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-ub5207d3fa7493c12e4-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, thirty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ub5207d3fa7493c12e4-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u9835a0caeb95a74ebb-1.text: 4. Boarding passengers onto a vehicle provided for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage without the passengers presenting documents certifying their right to travel in that vehicle, or in the absence of a passenger list where presentation of such documents or possession of such a passenger list is mandatory —
koap-u9835a0caeb95a74ebb-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-2.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u83c311436980d511f8-1.text: 5. Conclusion of a separate charter contract with each passenger when carrying out charter carriage of passengers and baggage —
koap-u83c311436980d511f8-1.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-3.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-8.text: Note. For administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-8.locator: Article 11.14.2. Violation of rules for the charter carriage of passengers and baggage

koap-u1837aa7403a3e6f020-1.text: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities
koap-u1837aa7403a3e6f020-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u45774759f87b546b81-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities
koap-u45774759f87b546b81-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u69d70871bb8b90dbd1-1.text: 1. Violation by a freight forwarder of the duties to verify the reliability of the necessary documents and information (data) provided by the client, information on the properties of the cargo, the conditions of its carriage and other information necessary for performing the duties provided for in the freight forwarding contract —
koap-u69d70871bb8b90dbd1-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u602ea925799e54be2a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u602ea925799e54be2a-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-9.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-9.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ufccf02a45f92e4ab7a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand rubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifty thousand to seventy thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ufccf02a45f92e4ab7a-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ud50e6309f1df3cab13-1.text: 3. Conducting freight forwarding activities by a person whose details are absent from the register of notifications of freight forwarding activities, where such acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-ud50e6309f1df3cab13-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u9d5c462b7fac2fd43e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u9d5c462b7fac2fd43e-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-4.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-4.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u1a4371d03b07462a51-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-u1a4371d03b07462a51-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ud74c5eecd9cbd7ccee-1.text: 5. Failure by a freight forwarder to perform the duty established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to retain and/or provide to authorized state bodies carrying out operational investigative activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation information on concluded freight forwarding contracts, the parties to those contracts, persons engaged to perform those contracts, the properties of cargo, instances of receipt, handling, loading, storage, unloading, transfer and delivery of cargo, routes, the modes of transport carrying it, or other information placed in information systems used in the provision of freight forwarding services —
koap-ud74c5eecd9cbd7ccee-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs and legal entities of one thousandth to three thousandths of the revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, but not less than five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ue03cf51a58b3ec9303-2.text: 6. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 5 of this Article —
koap-ue03cf51a58b3ec9303-2.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u36cf9d434990de6edd-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs and legal entities of one hundredth to three hundredths of the revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million rubles.
koap-u36cf9d434990de6edd-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u11c03cb5d04e361706-1.text: 7. Failure by a freight forwarder to perform the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for equipment and software and hardware used in the information systems it operates, so that authorized state bodies carrying out operational investigative activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation may, in cases established by federal laws, conduct measures to fulfil the tasks assigned to them, and to take measures to prevent disclosure of the organizational and tactical methods of conducting those measures —
koap-u11c03cb5d04e361706-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs and legal entities of one thousandth to three thousandths of the revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, but not less than five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-2.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ubd312eefdae24263c8-1.text: 8. Failure by a freight forwarder to perform the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to hand over cargo in its possession, at their request, to authorized state bodies conducting operational investigative measures for inspection and/or seizure, to ensure that premises (where available) are provided to those bodies for conducting operational investigative measures, or to ensure the receipt, transfer and preservation of information on freight forwarding services using databases and technical facilities located in the territory of the Russian Federation —
koap-ubd312eefdae24263c8-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs and legal entities of one thousandth to three thousandths of the revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, but not less than five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u0c3559bba1248657cb-3.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u053de56c09238111e0-1.text: 9. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 7 or 8 of this Article —
koap-u053de56c09238111e0-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u36cf9d434990de6edd-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs and legal entities of one hundredth to three hundredths of the revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million rubles.
koap-u36cf9d434990de6edd-2.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u45c3503dff1e87c8ea-1.text: 10. Failure by a client to perform, or timely perform, the duty established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to provide the freight forwarder with information that the cargo contains objects and substances withdrawn from civil circulation or subject to restrictions on circulation —
koap-u45c3503dff1e87c8ea-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u8bb531b28b37056f1d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u8bb531b28b37056f1d-1.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-9.text: Note. For administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-9.locator: Article 11.14.3. Failure to perform duties provided for by legislation on freight forwarding activities

koap-u675b0fa2eb92e2d0d9-1.text: Article 11.15. Damage to property on public transport vehicles, freight wagons or other equipment intended for the carriage and storage of cargo in transport
koap-u675b0fa2eb92e2d0d9-1.locator: Article 11.15. Damage to property on public transport vehicles, freight wagons or other equipment intended for the carriage and storage of cargo in transport

koap-u9631fe8638d90aa5f1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.15. Damage to property on public transport vehicles, freight wagons or other equipment intended for the carriage and storage of cargo in transport
koap-u9631fe8638d90aa5f1-1.locator: Article 11.15. Damage to property on public transport vehicles, freight wagons or other equipment intended for the carriage and storage of cargo in transport

koap-u633f5a2f5bb141fed9-1.text: 1. Damage to property on public transport vehicles where the property damage caused does not exceed one hundred rubles, as well as damage to freight wagons, watercraft and other vehicles, containers or other equipment intended for the carriage and storage of cargo in transport —

koap-u99b6a41b5f03a1792b-1.locator: Article 11.15.1. Violation of transport security requirements

koap-u602ea925799e54be2a-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.

koap-uc4c182b680d002305f-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifty thousand to seventy thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-uc4c182b680d002305f-1.locator: Article 11.15.1. Violation of transport security requirements

koap-u4edb066ec184cc77c7-1.text: 3. An act (omission) provided for in part 1 of this Article committed intentionally —

koap-u98d205ffb1aa1f2c37-1.locator: Article 11.15.1. Violation of transport security requirements

koap-u82e5e7056adad79a32-1.locator: Article 11.15.2. Violation of established procedures and rules for ensuring transport security

koap-u38a155bfcb5267a88c-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-u14734400f4e67896ac-1.text: 1. Boarding or alighting from a moving train, or riding on footboards, carriage roofs or in other places not adapted for passenger travel, as well as unauthorized stopping of a train without necessity or unauthorized travel on a freight train —
koap-u14734400f4e67896ac-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-ue404feaf9bbd51aa6b-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand rubles.
koap-ue404feaf9bbd51aa6b-3.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-ua9c59e54294cfc5ac3-1.text: 2. Throwing rubbish or other objects onto railway tracks and platforms or overboard from a maritime or inland water transport vessel —
koap-ua9c59e54294cfc5ac3-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-ud137b16fe0b86428af-3.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundred rubles.
koap-ud137b16fe0b86428af-3.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-u1dca4aa57d040d93f9-1.text: 3. Repealed with effect from 15 November 2013. — Federal Law of 21.10.2013 No. 274-FZ.

koap-u76ee2e67e1e61bfeb9-1.text: 4. Violation of rules for photography, video recording and filming or for using radio communications equipment from on board an aircraft —

koap-u0e7711226ca0deb348-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundred rubles with confiscation of the film.
koap-u0e7711226ca0deb348-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-ub58994daf31208e69b-1.text: 5. Failure by persons on board a maritime or inland water transport vessel to comply with the lawful orders of the ship's master —
koap-ub58994daf31208e69b-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-uc28621cd57b2b2a887-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-uc28621cd57b2b2a887-2.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-u218ed3b636582bdd44-1.text: 6. Failure by persons on board an aircraft to comply with the lawful orders of the pilot-in-command —
koap-u218ed3b636582bdd44-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport

koap-u7828325086df2d16d4-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand rubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-u7828325086df2d16d4-1.locator: Article 11.17. Violation of rules of conduct for citizens on rail, air or water transport
