koap-ucdf0daa26949033094-1.text: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips
koap-ucdf0daa26949033094-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-u6633994b50c1d7a6f6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips
koap-u6633994b50c1d7a6f6-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-uacbd2aa62dd3a7f709-1.text: 1. Pollution of road rights-of-way and roadside strips, ploughing land, mowing grass, felling and damaging forest plantations and other perennial plantings, removing turf and excavating soil, except for works to maintain road rights-of-way or repair roads or sections thereof, grazing animals and driving them across roads outside specially designated places agreed with the road owners —
koap-uacbd2aa62dd3a7f709-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-ud129a26e65bd441259-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of up to three hundred rubles.
koap-ud129a26e65bd441259-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-uf04b9bf682e8ad4eca-1.text: 2. Use of road drainage structures for the flow or discharge of water; carrying out works within a road right-of-way, including on the carriageway, involving the use of combustible substances or substances that may reduce the adhesion of vehicle wheels to the road surface; carrying out works within a road right-of-way unrelated to road construction, reconstruction, major repairs, repairs and maintenance or the placement of roadside service facilities; placing within a road right-of-way buildings, structures, installations and other facilities that are not intended for servicing the road, its construction, reconstruction, major repairs, repairs or maintenance and are not roadside service facilities; installing within a road right-of-way advertising structures that do not comply with technical regulations and/or regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation on road traffic safety, or information boards and signs unrelated to ensuring road traffic safety or carrying out road activities, laying, relocating, modifying or operating utility lines within a road right-of-way without concluding a contract with the road owner, in violation of such a contract or without obtaining the road owner's approval of the planned location of those utility lines; constructing, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs or repairing intersections of roads with other roads and junctions of roads with other roads, reconstructing, carrying out major repairs or repairing connections of roadside service facilities to roads, laying, relocating, modifying or operating utility lines within roadside strips, constructing or reconstructing capital construction facilities, facilities intended for road activities or roadside service facilities, or installing advertising structures, information boards or signs within roadside strips without the road owner's approval or in violation of mandatory technical requirements and conditions —
koap-uf04b9bf682e8ad4eca-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-u883ac17171ec139a37-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to eighty thousand rubles.
koap-u883ac17171ec139a37-1.locator: Article 11.21. Violation of rules for the use of road rights-of-way and roadside strips

koap-u26454176279620f3cb-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred rubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, three thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u26454176279620f3cb-3.locator: Article 11.22. Violation by land users of rules for protecting roads or road structures

koap-ufcea6ff607d0f09ee5-1.text: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules
koap-ufcea6ff607d0f09ee5-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u4e992588990314d8e0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules
koap-u4e992588990314d8e0-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u6f0080ae145fa1a4da-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle without a tachograph where its installation in the vehicle is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or in violation of requirements for the use of a tachograph established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, except where the tachograph breaks down after the vehicle has been dispatched, or driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier without keeping daily work and rest record sheets used in cases prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u6f0080ae145fa1a4da-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u355a717845a92ed4ca-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of three thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u355a717845a92ed4ca-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-ucc620eef973193f467-1.text: 2. Dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph where its installation in the vehicle is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or in violation of requirements for the use of a tachograph established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, except where the tachograph breaks down after the vehicle has been dispatched —
koap-ucc620eef973193f467-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-uf09c279525741ad9ae-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of seven thousand to ten thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-uf09c279525741ad9ae-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u039ce4dd2f81c25ff2-1.text: 3. Failure to comply with driving and rest time standards established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules established by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation in respect of driving time and rest time —
koap-u039ce4dd2f81c25ff2-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-uafacbc216a6d372a2e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; on officials, seven thousand to ten thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-uafacbc216a6d372a2e-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u165e332ffa9913494f-1.text: Note. Legal entities and officials shall be liable for the administrative offence provided for in part 3 of this Article where that offence results from their actually setting drivers' driving and rest times in a manner that does not comply with the requirements of regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation.
koap-u165e332ffa9913494f-1.locator: Article 11.23. Driving or dispatching a vehicle without a tachograph, failure to comply with driving and rest time standards, or violation of drivers' working and rest schedules

koap-u9aaaeb43f6aefed600-1.text: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations
koap-u9aaaeb43f6aefed600-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-ufe3cc099037784fe3d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations
koap-ufe3cc099037784fe3d-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-udae52213a6d3e5293c-1.text: 1. Carrying out cabotage road transport, except for cabotage road carriage of goods performed by foreign carriers registered in the territory of a member state of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-udae52213a6d3e5293c-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-u7edc2c1ace67e3a7cf-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u7edc2c1ace67e3a7cf-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-u243edad38a45d95355-1.text: 2. Violation by foreign carriers registered in the territory of a member state of the Eurasian Economic Union of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation governing cabotage road carriage of goods or of the conditions for carrying out cabotage road carriage of goods —
koap-u243edad38a45d95355-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-ubf6981ee9cab28cd9d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the goods vehicle driver of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ubf6981ee9cab28cd9d-1.locator: Article 11.26. Unlawful cabotage road transport operations

koap-u9f52e5c59db4df9090-1.text: Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport
koap-u9f52e5c59db4df9090-1.locator: Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport

koap-u37760c5b3dba826b48-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport
koap-u37760c5b3dba826b48-1.locator: Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport

koap-uae619e10948c043001-1.text: Driving a vehicle during international road transport without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, as well as without the appropriate transport document for the cargo carried or, in prescribed cases, without passenger lists for a bus performing non-scheduled carriage —
koap-uae619e10948c043001-1.locator: Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport

koap-uc9ed2764158a768797-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of two hundred to five hundred rubles.
koap-uc9ed2764158a768797-1.locator: Article 11.27. Driving a vehicle without the distinguishing sign of the vehicle's (trailer's) state of registration on the vehicle and/or its trailers, and violation of other vehicle operation rules during international road transport

koap-u747e4532218a6e8f0b-1.text: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied
koap-u747e4532218a6e8f0b-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-uce4fc3f1ced78e9f3e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied
koap-uce4fc3f1ced78e9f3e-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-u6044e73c8945f9e2f9-1.text: 1. Carrying out international road transport with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without permits where such permits are mandatory, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of this Article, or without a registration voucher issued by bodies exercising state control (supervision) over international road transport —
koap-u6044e73c8945f9e2f9-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-u2eac8983b21175024a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u2eac8983b21175024a-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-ua3efea0f3a04260844-1.text: 2. Carrying out international road carriage of goods and/or passengers from the territory of the Russian Federation to the territory of a third state or from the territory of a third state to the territory of the Russian Federation with an uncompleted permit or a permit completed in violation of established rules, or without a permit —
koap-ua3efea0f3a04260844-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-u7edc2c1ace67e3a7cf-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u7edc2c1ace67e3a7cf-2.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-u45ae08bb2fd4ac4903-1.text: 3. Carrying out international road transport with a notification issued in prescribed cases by an authorized transport control (supervision) body of a member state of the Customs Union, without an endorsement by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that the violation has been remedied —
koap-u45ae08bb2fd4ac4903-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-u368346018de92bf5f8-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of twenty-five thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-u368346018de92bf5f8-1.locator: Article 11.29. International road transport without permits, or with uncompleted permits, permits completed in violation of established rules or permits that do not correspond to the type of carriage, or without a registration voucher, or without an endorsement in the notification by an official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision confirming that a violation has been remedied

koap-ufc04b50ef3aab502fb-1.text: Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident
koap-ufc04b50ef3aab502fb-1.locator: Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident

koap-u8c8bff48b5a6aaea3e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident
koap-u8c8bff48b5a6aaea3e-1.locator: Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident

koap-u8d596d10243d4e084a-1.text: Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident or information about it, or distortion of information, or damage to or destruction of airborne or ground-based objective recording equipment or other evidentiary materials related to an aviation accident or incident —
koap-u8d596d10243d4e084a-1.locator: Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident

koap-ubb2431b9da69e7fa1d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand rubles; on officials, four thousand to ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ubb2431b9da69e7fa1d-1.locator: Article 11.30. Intentional concealment of an aviation accident or incident

koap-u7442314cf837c187cb-1.text: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property
koap-u7442314cf837c187cb-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-ua16d9278fa06fccae2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property
koap-ua16d9278fa06fccae2-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-u2623986c8df753b988-1.text: 1. Carriage of passengers by a carrier whose risk of civil liability for harm caused during carriage to passengers' lives, health or property is not insured in accordance with the requirements established by federal law, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u2623986c8df753b988-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-u89c66d4b404c29f435-1.text: 2. Failure by a carrier to provide passengers, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal law, with information on the insurer and the compulsory insurance contract covering the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property —
koap-u89c66d4b404c29f435-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-ubde42a20ddc0b24674-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-ubde42a20ddc0b24674-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-udcaf52527840bdf36e-1.text: 3. Carriage of passengers and baggage by a passenger taxi carrier whose risk of civil liability for harm caused during carriage to passengers' lives, health or property is not insured in accordance with the requirements established by federal law —
koap-udcaf52527840bdf36e-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-u41fa9a5c21718879ce-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, twenty-five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, forty thousand rubles.
koap-u41fa9a5c21718879ce-1.locator: Article 11.31. Failure by a carrier to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on compulsory insurance of the carrier's civil liability for harm to passengers' lives, health or property

koap-u444e76e429d1d9f876-1.locator: Article 11.32. Violation of the established procedure for mandatory medical certification of vehicle drivers (applicants for a driving licence) or mandatory preliminary, periodic, pre-trip or post-trip medical examinations

koap-u2e8817c74bf9f71627-1.locator: Article 11.32. Violation of the established procedure for mandatory medical certification of vehicle drivers (applicants for a driving licence) or mandatory preliminary, periodic, pre-trip or post-trip medical examinations

koap-u29991df52f4b736041-1.locator: Article 11.32. Violation of the established procedure for mandatory medical certification of vehicle drivers (applicants for a driving licence) or mandatory preliminary, periodic, pre-trip or post-trip medical examinations

koap-ubf0adc9a2728e2d395-1.text: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus
koap-ubf0adc9a2728e2d395-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-uffeb8903336c5bab23-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus
koap-uffeb8903336c5bab23-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u50593879d62d86318f-1.text: 1. Boarding or alighting passengers from a bus, tram or trolleybus at unauthorized places —
koap-u50593879d62d86318f-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u8653c41b23a9036441-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of three thousand rubles.
koap-u8653c41b23a9036441-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-12.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-12.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles.
koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-2.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-ud6ed0c13ef4abb7fa3-1.text: 2.1. Forcibly removing from a bus, tram or trolleybus a minor under sixteen years of age travelling without an accompanying adult or a person with a Group I disability travelling without an accompanying person, who have not confirmed payment of the fare where their travel is subject to payment, or their entitlement to free or reduced-fare travel, where these acts do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-ud6ed0c13ef4abb7fa3-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u21bfa53237ef9b002b-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; and on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-u21bfa53237ef9b002b-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u7ec9f5eeb24dc8eb69-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u3bc9d48b181ce9a4db-1.text: 4. Use of a bus, tram or trolleybus for regular passenger services without a regular service route card where such a card is mandatory —
koap-u3bc9d48b181ce9a4db-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-ucd883caefe5af6d9ec-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ucd883caefe5af6d9ec-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u4e5570a5a141717ed6-1.text: 5. Use of a bus, tram or trolleybus with characteristics other than those specified in the regular service route card —
koap-u4e5570a5a141717ed6-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-uf4240e78b12c6ea833-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand rubles.
koap-uf4240e78b12c6ea833-1.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-13.text: Note. For administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-13.locator: Article 11.33. Violation of the procedure for using a bus, tram or trolleybus

koap-u24d767b149e3726eec-1.locator: Chapter 12. Administrative offences in road traffic

koap-u2e1958e8108db80d07-1.text: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner
koap-u2e1958e8108db80d07-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u8c69446dd2bacef731-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner
koap-u8c69446dd2bacef731-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u64201dd1b019d6aa49-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner —
koap-u64201dd1b019d6aa49-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-ud73bb4d8dc38bad62d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to eight hundred rubles.
koap-ud73bb4d8dc38bad62d-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-2.text: 1.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-2.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u9643e45cd25f38fe9c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one to three months.
koap-u9643e45cd25f38fe9c-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u3faae92945e2cacb64-1.text: 2. Repealed with effect from 1 March 2022. — Federal Law of 26.07.2019 No. 219-FZ.
koap-u3faae92945e2cacb64-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u4f38d7e39dabf455a9-1.text: The notes have been repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ.
koap-u4f38d7e39dabf455a9-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-ud8099dcdb099197105-1.text: Note. A vehicle in this Article shall mean a motor vehicle with an internal combustion engine displacement exceeding 50 cubic centimetres or a maximum electric motor power exceeding 4 kilowatts and a maximum design speed exceeding 50 kilometres per hour, as well as trailers for such vehicles that are subject to state registration; in other Articles of this Chapter, it shall also include tractors, self-propelled road construction machinery and other self-propelled machinery, and vehicles for the operation of which a special right is granted in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on road traffic safety.
koap-ud8099dcdb099197105-1.locator: Article 12.1. Driving a vehicle that is not registered in the prescribed manner

koap-u1a53a2db1c2bdcf1fe-1.text: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates
koap-u1a53a2db1c2bdcf1fe-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u82dff2f8962558de24-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates
koap-u82dff2f8962558de24-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u28b2b6d451b61e2772-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle with state registration plates that are illegible, non-standard or fitted in violation of state standard requirements, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-u28b2b6d451b61e2772-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-3.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-3.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-ue3986572cd0160ab55-1.text: 2. Driving a vehicle without state registration plates, as well as driving a vehicle without state registration plates fitted in the places designated for them, or driving a vehicle with state registration plates that have been altered or fitted with materials that prevent identification of the state registration plates or allow them to be altered or concealed —
koap-ue3986572cd0160ab55-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u9643e45cd25f38fe9c-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one to three months.
koap-u9643e45cd25f38fe9c-2.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-uc89750eb8dc7329423-1.text: 2.1. Driving a vehicle with state registration plates fitted with devices that prevent identification of the state registration plates or allow them to be altered or concealed —
koap-uc89750eb8dc7329423-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-ub3ebaa2162412794ee-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years, with confiscation of those devices.
koap-ub3ebaa2162412794ee-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u8c9d8bb58d808897e8-1.text: 3. Fitting knowingly false state registration plates to a vehicle —
koap-u8c9d8bb58d808897e8-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u2663a21d0363feefc6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand five hundred rubles; on officials responsible for vehicle operation, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u2663a21d0363feefc6-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u085844b26350efcbe1-1.text: 4. Driving a vehicle with knowingly false state registration plates —
koap-u085844b26350efcbe1-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-uc9b1c808192e4b78ce-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for six months to one year.
koap-uc9b1c808192e4b78ce-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u990a43c2cfd34fdad0-1.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-u990a43c2cfd34fdad0-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-uaf8ff580090a91d163-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years.
koap-uaf8ff580090a91d163-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u273bb4aed41cfcf8c4-1.text: Note. A state registration plate shall be considered non-standard if it does not meet the requirements established in accordance with legislation on technical regulation, and illegible if, from a distance of 20 metres, at least one letter or digit of the rear state registration plate cannot be read at night, or at least one letter or digit of the front or rear state registration plate cannot be read during daylight hours.
koap-u273bb4aed41cfcf8c4-1.locator: Article 12.2. Driving a vehicle in violation of rules for fitting state registration plates

koap-u9a0dfac2955d2c852f-1.text: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules
koap-u9a0dfac2955d2c852f-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-ua857b12aa8c10201ab-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules
koap-ua857b12aa8c10201ab-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u00a940148cc595dde7-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle without carrying the vehicle registration documents or, in prescribed cases, the documents provided for by the customs legislation of the Customs Union bearing customs authorities' endorsements confirming temporary importation of the vehicle —
koap-u00a940148cc595dde7-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-4.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-4.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u5b1d10252d94e6562d-1.text: 2. Driving a vehicle without carrying documents authorizing its operation, a compulsory motor vehicle owners' civil liability insurance policy, except in the cases provided for in parts 2 and 3 of Article 12.37 of this Code, or, in cases provided for by legislation, a trip sheet or goods transport documents —
koap-u5b1d10252d94e6562d-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-5.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-5.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u30a08a0750f5c315b5-1.text: 2.1. Carriage of passengers and baggage in a passenger motor vehicle used to provide passenger and baggage carriage services by a driver who does not carry a permit to engage in the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi —
