koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles.
koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-3.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u90ca9029f085371b76-1.text: 3. Transfer of control of a vehicle to a person who does not carry documents authorizing its operation —
koap-u90ca9029f085371b76-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-u365d37e0ad9c5a89b9-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand rubles.
koap-u365d37e0ad9c5a89b9-1.locator: Article 12.3. Driving a vehicle without carrying the documents required by the Road Traffic Rules

koap-uc16ced20eca2f7893a-1.text: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign
koap-uc16ced20eca2f7893a-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ud7d65ace4b7ce3e343-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign
koap-ud7d65ace4b7ce3e343-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ua06cfbf5739819de62-1.text: 1. Fitting lighting devices with red lights or red retroreflectors to the front of a vehicle, as well as lighting devices whose light colour and operating mode do not comply with the Basic Provisions on the Authorization of Vehicles for Operation and the Duties of Officials to Ensure Road Traffic Safety —
koap-ua06cfbf5739819de62-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u28e847e1c5144508f6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand rubles with confiscation of those devices and reflectors; on officials responsible for vehicle operation, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles with confiscation of those devices and reflectors; and on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles with confiscation of those devices and reflectors.
koap-u28e847e1c5144508f6-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u0def398b5c1e330419-1.text: 2. Fitting a vehicle without the appropriate permit with devices for special light or sound signals (except security alarms), or unlawfully fitting a vehicle with a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign —
koap-u0def398b5c1e330419-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ue56d6e9cb115ac1a41-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand rubles with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials responsible for vehicle operation, twenty thousand rubles with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand rubles with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ue56d6e9cb115ac1a41-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u0d76d486efabb8bfd9-1.text: 3. Unlawful application to a vehicle's exterior surfaces of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings —
koap-u0d76d486efabb8bfd9-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u47311ef8e6bfe254de-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand rubles; on officials responsible for vehicle operation, twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u47311ef8e6bfe254de-1.locator: Article 12.4. Violation of rules for fitting vehicles with devices for special light or sound signals, unlawful application of special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles or passenger taxi colour and graphic markings, or unlawful fitting of a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u8c4fdc41e330f0bc56-1.text: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign
koap-u8c4fdc41e330f0bc56-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u21050705883e7a0748-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign
koap-u21050705883e7a0748-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u3816cdebdf513a661e-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit its operation under the Basic Provisions on the Authorization of Vehicles for Operation and the Duties of Officials to Ensure Road Traffic Safety, except for the defects and conditions specified in parts 1.1 - 7 of this Article —
koap-u3816cdebdf513a661e-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-6.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-6.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ua86e5a35df9dd2b813-1.text: 1.1. Driving a vehicle for which a diagnostic card confirming authorization of the vehicle to participate in road traffic has not been issued in the prescribed manner —
koap-ua86e5a35df9dd2b813-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand rubles.
koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ub1176975a685f9a398-1.text: 2. Driving a vehicle with a knowingly defective braking system (except the parking brake), steering system or coupling device (in a vehicle combination) —
koap-ub1176975a685f9a398-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-udf14926016e0deedb4-1.text: 3. Driving a vehicle whose front is fitted with lighting devices with red lights or red retroreflectors, as well as lighting devices whose light colour and operating mode do not comply with the Basic Provisions on the Authorization of Vehicles for Operation and the Duties of Officials to Ensure Road Traffic Safety —
koap-udf14926016e0deedb4-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u2b6e15481a61ac3581-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for six months to one year, with confiscation of those devices and reflectors.
koap-u2b6e15481a61ac3581-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u99032a0230c1a26cc9-1.text: 3.1. Driving a vehicle fitted with glazing (including glazing covered with transparent coloured films) whose light transmission does not comply with the Basic Provisions on the Authorization of Vehicles for Operation and the Duties of Officials to Ensure Road Traffic Safety —
koap-u99032a0230c1a26cc9-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-2.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u49683a441ef982faa4-1.text: 4. Driving a vehicle fitted without the appropriate permit with devices for special light or sound signals (except security alarms) —
koap-u49683a441ef982faa4-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ub3ebaa2162412794ee-2.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years, with confiscation of those devices.
koap-ub3ebaa2162412794ee-2.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u36d8cfa7303b05bb71-1.text: 4.1. Driving a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a passenger taxi identification lamp or a Disabled Person identification sign —
koap-u36d8cfa7303b05bb71-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u55cba157bde3fa4c46-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u55cba157bde3fa4c46-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u26b0145a2a108a5979-1.text: 5. Using devices for special light or sound signals (except security alarms) fitted without the appropriate permit while a vehicle is moving —
koap-u26b0145a2a108a5979-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ubccc21911052fa2392-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years, with confiscation of those devices.
koap-ubccc21911052fa2392-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u219ee6e37d6d0729d6-1.text: 6. Driving a vehicle whose exterior surfaces unlawfully bear special colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles —
koap-u219ee6e37d6d0729d6-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-uaf8ff580090a91d163-2.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years.
koap-uaf8ff580090a91d163-2.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-ucf26fb9b37d788f13f-1.text: 7. Driving a vehicle unlawfully bearing passenger taxi colour and graphic markings —
koap-ucf26fb9b37d788f13f-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles.
koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-4.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u8df39a758b64ef4f15-1.text: Note. A person who commits the administrative offence provided for in part 1.1 of this Article shall not be held administratively liable for the second and subsequent detections of such an administrative offence within twenty-four hours of its first detection.
koap-u8df39a758b64ef4f15-1.locator: Article 12.5. Driving a vehicle with defects or conditions that prohibit vehicle operation, or a vehicle unlawfully fitted with a Disabled Person identification sign

koap-u7af9f69a07168c91af-1.text: Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets
koap-u7af9f69a07168c91af-1.locator: Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets

koap-u79c7224e574b901be5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets
koap-u79c7224e574b901be5-1.locator: Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets

koap-u0ef398c6d23d6e2dce-1.text: Driving a vehicle without the driver wearing a fastened seat belt, carrying passengers without fastened seat belts where the vehicle is designed to have seat belts, as well as riding a motorcycle or moped or carrying passengers on a motorcycle without motorcycle helmets or with unfastened motorcycle helmets —
koap-u0ef398c6d23d6e2dce-1.locator: Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets

koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-2.locator: Article 12.6. Violation of rules for the use of seat belts or motorcycle helmets

koap-u86a7d3f4281c8c4afb-1.text: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle
koap-u86a7d3f4281c8c4afb-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-uccaf4fa22a7b0a53c3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle
koap-uccaf4fa22a7b0a53c3-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-ub185b5aa119694d368-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle (except during driving instruction) —
koap-ub185b5aa119694d368-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-u9299c59b1c23d541d3-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to fifteen thousand rubles.
koap-u9299c59b1c23d541d3-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-u9547c9962f618b5d70-1.text: 2. Driving a vehicle by a driver who has been deprived of the right to drive vehicles —
koap-u9547c9962f618b5d70-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-u6b12db82a48f58802f-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of thirty thousand rubles, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, or compulsory work for one hundred to two hundred hours.
koap-u6b12db82a48f58802f-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-ud901c8ab99c1f89215-1.text: 3. Transfer of control of a vehicle to a person known to lack the right to drive a vehicle (except during driving instruction) or to have been deprived of that right —
koap-ud901c8ab99c1f89215-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of thirty thousand rubles.
koap-uac84c6988fd379e7b7-3.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-uab55ad7be06229c616-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 2 of this Article, where the act does not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-uab55ad7be06229c616-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-u9a3fa5e04089512a55-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles or compulsory work for one hundred and fifty to two hundred hours.
koap-u9a3fa5e04089512a55-1.locator: Article 12.7. Driving a vehicle by a driver who does not have the right to drive a vehicle

koap-ua15d85dc56b50ac7da-1.text: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person
koap-ua15d85dc56b50ac7da-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-ufd0f48ca24b80e1276-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person
koap-ufd0f48ca24b80e1276-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u82ca745765bb936e1f-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, where such acts do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u82ca745765bb936e1f-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles with deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years.
koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-ub46562f12fd46c67e3-1.text: 2. Transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person —
koap-ub46562f12fd46c67e3-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles with deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years.
koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-2.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u43d939b7ce3bf19655-1.text: 3. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver who does not have the right to drive vehicles or has been deprived of the right to drive vehicles, where such acts do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u43d939b7ce3bf19655-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u616c86344c48a8f618-1.text: shall entail administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days or, for persons to whom administrative arrest may not be applied under this Code, an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles.
koap-u616c86344c48a8f618-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-u0e50f407f88d95f64e-1.text: 4. Repealed with effect from 1 July 2015. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 528-FZ.
koap-u0e50f407f88d95f64e-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-uff165a9250d66b7d0f-1.text: Note. Consumption of substances causing alcohol or drug intoxication, or of psychotropic or other intoxicating substances, is prohibited. Administrative liability provided for in this Article and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code shall arise where consumption of substances causing alcohol intoxication is established by the presence of absolute ethyl alcohol at a concentration exceeding the possible aggregate measurement error, namely 0.16 milligrams per litre of exhaled air, or by the presence of absolute ethyl alcohol at a concentration of 0.3 grams or more per litre of blood, or where narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances are present in the human body.
koap-uff165a9250d66b7d0f-1.locator: Article 12.8. Driving a vehicle by an intoxicated driver, or transfer of control of a vehicle to an intoxicated person

koap-ud019bda512893eb0e1-1.text: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit
koap-ud019bda512893eb0e1-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-uce2c72f55596473a83-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit
koap-uce2c72f55596473a83-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u575a71d61f19183387-1.text: 1. Repealed with effect from 1 September 2013. — Federal Law of 23.07.2013 No. 196-FZ.
koap-u575a71d61f19183387-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u344eade72a9b1e3590-1.text: 2. Exceeding the established vehicle speed limit by more than 20 but not more than 40 kilometres per hour —
koap-u344eade72a9b1e3590-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u859d1bc79fdc4dc52b-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-u859d1bc79fdc4dc52b-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u154e16c68d9cfa9884-1.text: 3. Exceeding the established vehicle speed limit by more than 40 but not more than 60 kilometres per hour —
koap-u154e16c68d9cfa9884-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u6e46cb6a14daed3428-1.text: 4. Exceeding the established vehicle speed limit by more than 60 but not more than 80 kilometres per hour —
koap-u6e46cb6a14daed3428-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u34570c0ed88ac94e14-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to three thousand seven hundred and fifty rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months.
koap-u34570c0ed88ac94e14-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-ua8590ab93812a8c0d8-1.text: 5. Exceeding the established vehicle speed limit by more than 80 kilometres per hour —
koap-ua8590ab93812a8c0d8-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u194128a04a252985c5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for six months.
koap-u194128a04a252985c5-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u67dcd64441d9c7f535-1.text: 6. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u67dcd64441d9c7f535-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u3e9c9361416211d34e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to three thousand seven hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-u3e9c9361416211d34e-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-uec9ab550e9d40ac941-1.text: 7. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in parts 4 and 5 of this Article —
koap-uec9ab550e9d40ac941-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-u743b2451d7a95f2a9e-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year or, where the administrative offence is recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u743b2451d7a95f2a9e-1.locator: Article 12.9. Exceeding the established speed limit

koap-ud25f66b082d99d4a73-1.text: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks
koap-ud25f66b082d99d4a73-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-u0362e2d84826392521-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks
koap-u0362e2d84826392521-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-ud6d5eeb3b385a29ee6-1.text: 1. Crossing a railway track outside a railway level crossing, entering a railway level crossing when the barrier is closed or closing or when a traffic light or crossing attendant gives a prohibiting signal, stopping or parking at a railway level crossing, or passing through an uncontrolled railway level crossing when a train (locomotive or railcar) is approaching the crossing within sight —
koap-ud6d5eeb3b385a29ee6-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-uafad5d488911c7658d-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for three to six months.
koap-uafad5d488911c7658d-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-u3df20e777f166e6866-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for passing through railway level crossings, except in the cases provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u3df20e777f166e6866-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-u97604b57b643888040-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles.
koap-u97604b57b643888040-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-ubdce729c754c5ba035-1.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-ubdce729c754c5ba035-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-ueacfa67ab2994c485d-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year.
koap-ueacfa67ab2994c485d-1.locator: Article 12.10. Violation of rules for crossing railway tracks

koap-u54c333b086faada7aa-1.text: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules
koap-u54c333b086faada7aa-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-u81ec895f82096b9aa1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules
koap-u81ec895f82096b9aa1-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-ub04a2016f2d3434e14-1.text: 1. Driving on a motorway in a vehicle whose speed, according to its technical characteristics or condition, is less than 40 kilometres per hour, as well as stopping a vehicle on a motorway outside designated parking areas —
koap-ub04a2016f2d3434e14-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-2.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-ubf1a32cb9075d023cf-1.text: 2. Driving a goods vehicle with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes on a motorway beyond the second lane, as well as driving instruction on a motorway —
koap-ubf1a32cb9075d023cf-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-3.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-uc11eef11d5cdb54a35-1.text: 3. Making a U-turn or driving a vehicle into maintenance gaps in the central reservation of a motorway, or reversing on a motorway —
koap-uc11eef11d5cdb54a35-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-ud741e4d74ab98152cb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ud741e4d74ab98152cb-1.locator: Article 12.11. Violation of motorway traffic rules

koap-ud4c2f63c7db8643602-1.text: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture
koap-ud4c2f63c7db8643602-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-ubf57b52731dcad1f8b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture
koap-ubf57b52731dcad1f8b-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-u1a699f281ad9937be5-1.text: 1. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture, except in the cases provided for in part 1 of Article 12.10 of this Code and part 2 of this Article —
koap-u1a699f281ad9937be5-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-3.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-uddd1160212769da4b1-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or carriageway markings when a traffic light signal or traffic controller's gesture prohibits movement —
koap-uddd1160212769da4b1-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-u900771e008875eabe6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of eight hundred rubles.
koap-u900771e008875eabe6-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-ubdce729c754c5ba035-2.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-ubdce729c754c5ba035-2.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months.
koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-1.locator: Article 12.12. Proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or a prohibiting traffic controller's gesture

koap-u32257d22cf102f4d5b-1.text: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections
koap-u32257d22cf102f4d5b-1.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-ub3962fc0d089d86924-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections
koap-ub3962fc0d089d86924-1.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-u7b5594b53bc59f2aa0-1.text: 1. Entering an intersection or carriageway crossing when congestion has formed that forces the driver to stop, obstructing the movement of vehicles in the transverse direction —
koap-u7b5594b53bc59f2aa0-1.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-4.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-u76c7a237c7cf934cf9-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to give way to a vehicle having priority when passing through intersections —
koap-u76c7a237c7cf934cf9-1.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-5.locator: Article 12.13. Violation of rules for passing through intersections

koap-uaf057b5a743a79714c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.14. Violation of manoeuvring rules

koap-ub22e703fe895e98b4d-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to give a signal before starting, changing lanes, turning, making a U-turn or stopping —

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-7.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.

koap-u28105f253fc0ebfc2b-1.text: 1.1. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules, except in the prescribed cases, to take the appropriate outermost position on the carriageway intended for travel in the relevant direction in good time before turning right, turning left or making a U-turn —

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-8.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.

koap-u31eaeecc08d8a11039-1.text: 2. Making a U-turn or reversing in places where such manoeuvres are prohibited, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of Article 12.11 and part 2 of Article 12.16 of this Code —

koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.

koap-u528163cb5d615ca3ff-1.text: 3. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to give way to a vehicle having priority of movement, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of Article 12.13 and Article 12.17 of this Code —

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-9.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.

koap-u84491ac6da0f02f3dc-1.text: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking
koap-u84491ac6da0f02f3dc-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u1f39e1a683505606d6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking
koap-u1f39e1a683505606d6-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-ua6d12e1b40be010953-1.text: 1. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway or passing oncoming traffic, as well as driving on the road shoulder, crossing an organized vehicle convoy or pedestrian column, or taking a place within such a convoy or column —
koap-ua6d12e1b40be010953-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-ub68140a56238d0a6c5-1.text: 1.1. Failure outside populated localities by the driver of a slow-moving vehicle, a vehicle carrying oversized cargo or a vehicle moving at a speed not exceeding 30 kilometres per hour to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to allow following vehicles to pass for overtaking or moving ahead —
koap-ub68140a56238d0a6c5-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-5.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u75bb509c55829c0bdb-1.text: 2. Driving on cycle paths, pedestrian paths or pavements in violation of the Road Traffic Rules —
koap-u75bb509c55829c0bdb-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand rubles.
koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-2.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u3d2ceb5bcb0b93e143-1.text: 3. Entering a lane intended for oncoming traffic or oncoming tram tracks in violation of the Road Traffic Rules when going around an obstacle —
koap-u3d2ceb5bcb0b93e143-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-2.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u622260964d83fe0c07-1.text: 4. Entering a lane intended for oncoming traffic or oncoming tram tracks in violation of the Road Traffic Rules, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u622260964d83fe0c07-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months.
koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-2.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-2.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 4 of this Article —
koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-2.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u4657c565340ab88e26-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year or, where the administrative offence is recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, or by photographic, film or video recording equipment, an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u4657c565340ab88e26-1.locator: Article 12.15. Violation of rules on vehicle positioning on the carriageway, passing oncoming traffic or overtaking

koap-u3145e2348092b85271-1.text: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings
koap-u3145e2348092b85271-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-uc5a6efcb6048175348-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings
koap-uc5a6efcb6048175348-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u31dc1d5b41729a7b34-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings, except in the cases provided for in parts 2 - 8 of this Article and other Articles of this Chapter —
koap-u31dc1d5b41729a7b34-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-ubb8d37a28fd184914c-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of seven hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-ubb8d37a28fd184914c-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-ue9444adccb2373bdee-1.text: 2. Turning left or making a U-turn in violation of requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings —
koap-ue9444adccb2373bdee-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-ub4b5b6e6501f93bce0-3.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u0598fb819aec5ec235-1.text: 3. Driving in the opposite direction on a one-way road —
koap-u0598fb819aec5ec235-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months.
koap-u44c5ae4dc6e9b466c5-3.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u8bd6639ada3bfe68c2-1.text: 3.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 3 of this Article —
koap-u8bd6639ada3bfe68c2-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u4657c565340ab88e26-2.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year or, where the administrative offence is recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, or by photographic, film or video recording equipment, an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u4657c565340ab88e26-2.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u915b7420213008d5d4-1.text: 4. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings prohibiting stopping or parking of vehicles, except in the case provided for in part 5 of this Article —
koap-u915b7420213008d5d4-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-2.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u991ce4cbaa202e923d-1.text: 5. A violation provided for in part 4 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-u991ce4cbaa202e923d-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u08b609a4997bfb8eba-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of four thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u08b609a4997bfb8eba-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u5593ad232b20bc7f74-1.text: 6. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs prohibiting the movement of goods vehicles, except in the case provided for in part 7 of this Article —
koap-u5593ad232b20bc7f74-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u97604b57b643888040-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles.
koap-u97604b57b643888040-2.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u3b7c7394b9b122d2a8-1.text: 7. A violation provided for in part 6 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-u3b7c7394b9b122d2a8-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-ua581983ac019343a14-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ua581983ac019343a14-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-uf85beff0b35d5effcf-1.text: 8. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 6 or 7 of this Article —
koap-uf85beff0b35d5effcf-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u671a3c6a2f0e0ffb37-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of ten thousand rubles.
koap-u671a3c6a2f0e0ffb37-1.locator: Article 12.16. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings

koap-u674cde5e2e818fa550-1.text: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals
koap-u674cde5e2e818fa550-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u467a52097b72b990e1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals
koap-u467a52097b72b990e1-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u64dd0b8c7005927831-1.text: 1. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle, as well as to a vehicle with its blue flashing beacon and special sound signal activated simultaneously —
koap-u64dd0b8c7005927831-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-10.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-10.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-ufc0bcdf03ab974b25b-1.text: 1.1. Driving vehicles in a lane for scheduled public transport vehicles or stopping in that lane in violation of the Road Traffic Rules, except in the cases provided for in parts 3 - 5 of Article 12.15 of this Code and the case provided for in part 1.2 of this Article —
koap-ufc0bcdf03ab974b25b-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles.
koap-u9f282f6aba9c93a27c-3.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u72877f43168a865a91-1.text: 1.2. A violation provided for in part 1.1 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-u72877f43168a865a91-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u08b609a4997bfb8eba-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of four thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u08b609a4997bfb8eba-2.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-uea4b1053bb6f9ddd45-1.text: 2. Failure to give priority to a vehicle bearing special colour and graphic markings, inscriptions and designations on its exterior surfaces, with a blue flashing beacon or blue and red flashing beacons and a special sound signal activated simultaneously —
koap-uea4b1053bb6f9ddd45-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u8f2dd3096ac9a8b1ca-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred to ten thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for six months to one year.
koap-u8f2dd3096ac9a8b1ca-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-ub429d1bc7f0dd0248c-1.text: 3. Failure to give priority to a vehicle that does not bear special colour and graphic markings, inscriptions and designations on its exterior surfaces, with blue and red flashing beacons and a special sound signal activated simultaneously, or to a vehicle escorted by it —
koap-ub429d1bc7f0dd0248c-1.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u8f2dd3096ac9a8b1ca-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred to ten thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for six months to one year.
koap-u8f2dd3096ac9a8b1ca-2.locator: Article 12.17. Failure to give priority to a scheduled public transport vehicle or a vehicle with activated special light and sound signals

koap-u6ce08574eefb838dee-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation Article 12.17.1. Repealed
koap-u6ce08574eefb838dee-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation Article 12.17.1. Repealed

koap-u0e6bb4338840731b2c-1.locator: Article 12.17.1. Repealed. — Federal Law of 21.07.2014 No. 210-FZ.

koap-u3da48af4912d2b1f31-1.text: Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users
koap-u3da48af4912d2b1f31-1.locator: Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users

koap-u1aaeb8d58736ee558f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users
koap-u1aaeb8d58736ee558f-1.locator: Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users

koap-u6aabf453b4ba392e5e-1.text: Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules to give way to pedestrians, cyclists or other road users (except vehicle drivers) having priority of movement —
koap-u6aabf453b4ba392e5e-1.locator: Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users

koap-u34cdafd97b7e8281c8-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-u34cdafd97b7e8281c8-1.locator: Article 12.18. Failure to give priority to pedestrians or other road users

koap-u1773640d1c8b19ff73-1.text: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles
koap-u1773640d1c8b19ff73-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u3142fa4ceca69d41c7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles
koap-u3142fa4ceca69d41c7-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u9fb39567df19668338-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles, except in the cases provided for in part 1 of Article 12.10 of this Code and parts 2 - 6 of this Article —
koap-u9fb39567df19668338-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-11.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-11.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u48e2ed29dc74a6cc77-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles in places designated for stopping or parking vehicles of persons with disabilities —
koap-u48e2ed29dc74a6cc77-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles.
koap-u8f161b865bca41e7d0-5.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-ufd0e24483312163179-1.text: 3. Stopping or parking vehicles on a pedestrian crossing or less than 5 metres before it, except for an emergency stop and the case provided for in part 6 of this Article, or violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles on a pavement, except in the case provided for in part 6 of this Article —
koap-ufd0e24483312163179-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-6.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-6.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u41f6a6809ccd55c9e5-1.text: 3.1. Stopping or parking vehicles at scheduled public transport stops or passenger taxi ranks, or less than 15 metres from scheduled public transport stops or passenger taxi ranks, except for stops to pick up or set down passengers, emergency stops and the cases provided for in parts 4 and 6 of this Article —
koap-u41f6a6809ccd55c9e5-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-7.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-7.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u5ff7c17396d0726591-1.text: 3.2. Stopping or parking vehicles on tram tracks, or stopping or parking vehicles beyond the first row from the edge of the carriageway, except for emergency stops and the cases provided for in parts 4 and 6 of this Article —
koap-u5ff7c17396d0726591-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-4.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u0ba8c8e9f81b72816a-1.text: 4. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles on the carriageway that obstructs the movement of other vehicles, as well as stopping or parking a vehicle in a tunnel, except in the case provided for in part 6 of this Article —
koap-u0ba8c8e9f81b72816a-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand rubles.
koap-u13e56d814c2adcc16c-3.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-udc6580eb525ad78ea4-1.text: 5. A violation provided for in part 1 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-udc6580eb525ad78ea4-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-ud741e4d74ab98152cb-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ud741e4d74ab98152cb-2.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u90fb212cdc88fa5821-1.text: 6. Violations provided for in parts 3 - 4 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-u90fb212cdc88fa5821-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-uadf90e99d9fc575984-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand rubles.
koap-uadf90e99d9fc575984-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles

koap-u0db3b5c024e9a5991d-1.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 24.07.2007 No. 210-FZ.
koap-u0db3b5c024e9a5991d-1.locator: Article 12.19. Violation of rules for stopping or parking vehicles
