koap-u831441efbf19968397-1.locator: Article 12.20. Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle

koap-u81708049002acb39cd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.20. Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle
koap-u81708049002acb39cd-1.locator: Article 12.20. Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle

koap-u4887236ae4453cb76b-1.text: Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle —
koap-u4887236ae4453cb76b-1.locator: Article 12.20. Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-12.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-12.locator: Article 12.20. Violation of rules for the use of external lights, sound signals, hazard warning lights or a warning triangle

koap-u4fdce38cb3c5665cfa-1.text: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing
koap-u4fdce38cb3c5665cfa-1.locator: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing

koap-u85c7f652ec81cf5921-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing
koap-u85c7f652ec81cf5921-1.locator: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing

koap-u0c7f631e34b98225b6-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods, as well as towing rules —
koap-u0c7f631e34b98225b6-1.locator: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-13.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-13.locator: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing

koap-u7aaf144fbf1765da3a-1.locator: Article 12.21. Violation of rules for the carriage of goods or towing

koap-u8036affe535a271686-1.text: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle
koap-u8036affe535a271686-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u82eb99b48ae127b8a2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle
koap-u82eb99b48ae127b8a2-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u15c6a7296a1d5b17ee-1.text: 1. Movement of an oversized vehicle exceeding the permissible vehicle dimensions by not more than 10 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeding the dimensions specified in a special permit by not more than 10 centimetres, except in the cases provided for in part 1 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code —
koap-u15c6a7296a1d5b17ee-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ubae2488d8798abc281-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of one hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-ubae2488d8798abc281-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-uef3b92e6cfb263c311-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u4c9b7f61dbba5d1579-1.text: 4. Movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle exceeding the permissible vehicle dimensions by more than 10 but not more than 20 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeding the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 10 but not more than 20 centimetres, or exceeding the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 10 but not more than 20 percent without a special permit, or exceeding the vehicle mass or vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 10 but not more than 20 percent, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code —
koap-u4c9b7f61dbba5d1579-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u2e1665eca465e22fe5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u2e1665eca465e22fe5-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u91b49efc4892b6974d-1.text: 5. Movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle exceeding the permissible vehicle dimensions by more than 20 but not more than 50 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeding the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 20 but not more than 50 centimetres, or exceeding the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 20 but not more than 50 percent without a special permit, or exceeding the vehicle mass or vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 20 but not more than 50 percent, except in the cases provided for in part 3 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code —
koap-u91b49efc4892b6974d-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u1b5c6c21d15d7efde1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of four hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u1b5c6c21d15d7efde1-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u0d30954afea1a45352-1.text: 6. Movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle exceeding the permissible dimensions by more than 50 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeding the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 50 centimetres, or exceeding the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 50 percent without a special permit, or exceeding the vehicle mass or vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 50 percent, except in the cases provided for in part 4 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code —
koap-u0d30954afea1a45352-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u7661f85d432d4c6a14-1.text: 7. Violation of rules for the movement of heavy and/or oversized vehicles, except in the cases provided for in parts 1 - 6 of this Article —
koap-u7661f85d432d4c6a14-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u12e8aaebf6a4513326-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of one thousand five hundred to two thousand two hundred and fifty rubles; on officials responsible for the carriage, seven thousand five hundred to fifteen thousand rubles; and on legal entities, seventy-five thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u12e8aaebf6a4513326-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ub0ebfe1a6053db339f-1.text: 8. Provision by a consignor, in documents for cargo carried by a heavy and/or oversized vehicle, of inaccurate information on the mass or dimensions of that cargo, or failure to indicate in the consignment note the number, date or validity period of the special permit or the route for carriage of such cargo, where this results in a violation provided for in part 1 or 4 of this Article —
koap-ub0ebfe1a6053db339f-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-uf78bb0318727cc990b-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand two hundred and fifty to three thousand rubles; on officials, twenty-two thousand five hundred to thirty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to four hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-uf78bb0318727cc990b-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ub299f318333024f8f3-1.text: 9. Provision by a consignor, in documents for cargo carried by a heavy and/or oversized vehicle, of inaccurate information on the mass or dimensions of that cargo, or failure to indicate in the consignment note the number, date or validity period of the special permit or the route for carriage of such cargo, where this results in a violation provided for in part 5 or 6 of this Article —
koap-ub299f318333024f8f3-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u22455727c947863871-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of seven thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, thirty-seven thousand five hundred to fifty-two thousand five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred and twenty-five thousand to six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u22455727c947863871-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ua4eb0e4b30511f5183-1.text: 10. Exceeding the permissible vehicle mass and/or permissible vehicle axle load, or the vehicle mass and/or vehicle axle load specified in a special permit, or the permissible vehicle dimensions, or the dimensions specified in a special permit, by legal entities or individual entrepreneurs that loaded cargo onto the vehicle —
koap-ua4eb0e4b30511f5183-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ubccc0b4d73e5f5cf5c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs of one hundred and twenty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred and seventy-five thousand to six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ubccc0b4d73e5f5cf5c-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u5f21a1146056236213-1.text: 11. Failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs prohibiting the movement of vehicles whose actual total mass or axle load exceeds that indicated on the road sign, where those vehicles are moving without a special permit —
koap-u5f21a1146056236213-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ua581983ac019343a14-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ua581983ac019343a14-2.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u95a3957e697aa266e2-1.text: 12. Failure to comply with a lawful demand by an authorized official to undergo vehicle weight and dimension control, including a demand to stop the vehicle at a transport control point, or refusal or evasion of compliance with that demand —
koap-u95a3957e697aa266e2-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-2.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u51295aa9067adc4de4-1.text: 13. Movement of a vehicle with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes in violation of the Rules for the Movement of Heavy and/or Oversized Vehicles in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone, or failure to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone, except in the cases provided for in part 5 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code —
koap-u51295aa9067adc4de4-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the owner (possessor) of the vehicle of six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ue40194fb058a1470fd-3.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-13.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-2.text: 1. For administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-2.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-ua462cd3a6de40c94fb-1.text: 2. Administrative liability provided for in part 1 of this Article shall not arise where the administrative offence is recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, or by photographic, film or video recording equipment.
koap-ua462cd3a6de40c94fb-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u790f1cb6680b4c36b0-1.text: 3. Administrative liability provided for in part 13 of this Article for failure to maintain the minimum distance from the vehicle ahead in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone shall arise where an excess of the permissible vehicle mass and/or permissible vehicle axle load and/or permissible vehicle dimensions is detected.
koap-u790f1cb6680b4c36b0-1.locator: Article 12.21.1. Violation of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle

koap-u545f4a88581abbb7c6-1.text: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods
koap-u545f4a88581abbb7c6-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-u9f244ff602f6cc024c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods
koap-u9f244ff602f6cc024c-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-ue5659e2ad1f2215d8e-1.text: 1. Carriage of dangerous goods by a driver who does not have the driver training certificate for vehicles carrying dangerous goods, the certificate approving the vehicle for the carriage of dangerous goods, the special permit or the hazard information system emergency card required by the rules for the carriage of dangerous goods, as well as carriage of dangerous goods in a vehicle whose design does not comply with those rules or which lacks elements of the hazard information system or equipment or means used to deal with the consequences of an incident during the carriage of dangerous goods, or failure to comply with the conditions for the carriage of dangerous goods prescribed by those rules —
koap-ue5659e2ad1f2215d8e-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-u827b1bcef417f8e5a7-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of two thousand to two thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months; on officials responsible for the carriage, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u827b1bcef417f8e5a7-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-uc9dbbcc8146fbdd4e9-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods, except in the cases provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-uc9dbbcc8146fbdd4e9-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-uce3d22d69c8dc64dc1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials responsible for the carriage, five thousand to ten thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-uce3d22d69c8dc64dc1-1.locator: Article 12.21.2. Violation of rules for the carriage of dangerous goods

koap-u3633b87faa0b4e66c7-1.text: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes
koap-u3633b87faa0b4e66c7-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u69a0007e152b9544f0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes
koap-u69a0007e152b9544f0-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u2408ffaceca74dc2a5-1.text: 1. Movement of a vehicle with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes on federal public roads without payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by that vehicle, where such payment is mandatory —
koap-u2408ffaceca74dc2a5-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u2adc0cad0df649b844-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles on drivers of vehicles belonging to foreign carriers and on owners (possessors) of vehicles other than vehicles belonging to foreign carriers.
koap-u2adc0cad0df649b844-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-13.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-13.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u69a9df065ed79e5b35-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of ten thousand rubles on drivers of vehicles belonging to foreign carriers and on owners (possessors) of vehicles other than vehicles belonging to foreign carriers.
koap-u69a9df065ed79e5b35-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-14.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u6791dce6e80346d9bd-1.text: 1. A person who commits an administrative offence provided for in part 1 or 2 of this Article upon entering the territory of the Russian Federation shall be exempt from administrative liability if, at the time the case concerning that administrative offence is considered, the distance actually travelled by the vehicle without payment after crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation is not more than fifty kilometres and the payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by that vehicle has been made in the prescribed manner.
koap-u6791dce6e80346d9bd-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-uab5d30363905c4c575-1.text: 2. The owner (possessor) of a vehicle specified in part 1 of this Article shall not be held administratively liable for the second and subsequent occurrences during the day on which such an administrative offence was recorded if an administrative offence provided for in part 1 or 2 of this Article was recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, or by photographic, film or video recording equipment, two or more times within a day for each vehicle after the first recording of such an administrative offence.
koap-uab5d30363905c4c575-1.locator: Article 12.21.3. Failure to comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on payment to compensate for damage caused to federal public roads by vehicles with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 12 tonnes

koap-u338828454b810d7b2f-1.text: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads
koap-u338828454b810d7b2f-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u3abef8a60bd881388f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads
koap-u3abef8a60bd881388f-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-uda376ef97ba814af69-1.text: 1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-uda376ef97ba814af69-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u14f7a86c61f6a0cb62-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles;
koap-u14f7a86c61f6a0cb62-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u0515aa5780b772db85-1.text: 2. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for a goods vehicle or bus to travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads —
koap-u0515aa5780b772db85-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u97604b57b643888040-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand rubles.
koap-u97604b57b643888040-3.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-15.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-uac8f4fd5c78fa76503-1.text: 1. A person held administratively liable under this Article who fulfils the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads no later than twenty days from the date of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be exempt from administrative liability, and proceedings in that administrative offence case shall be terminated. Where a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty sent to the person held administratively liable by registered post arrives at that person's address after twenty days have elapsed from the date of that ruling, the specified period shall be restored in accordance with the procedure provided for in part 1.3 of Article 32.2 of this Code.
koap-uac8f4fd5c78fa76503-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u80288eee84a268b53e-1.text: 2. The owner (possessor) of a vehicle shall not be held administratively liable for the second and subsequent occurrences during the day on which such an administrative offence was recorded if an administrative offence provided for in part 1 or 2 of this Article was recorded by special technical equipment operating automatically with photographic, film or video recording functions, or by photographic, film or video recording equipment, two or more times within a day for each vehicle after the first recording of such an administrative offence.
koap-u80288eee84a268b53e-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-uaf854fbcb2e65f9c4e-1.text: 3. The provisions of notes 1 and 2 shall apply to administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on administrative offences consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for payment for vehicle travel on public toll roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public-use roads, or toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public-use roads.
koap-uaf854fbcb2e65f9c4e-1.locator: Article 12.21.4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to pay for vehicle travel on federal public toll roads or toll sections of federal public roads

koap-u1f7c32ed57f35f15e1-1.text: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier
koap-u1f7c32ed57f35f15e1-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u1bf6e1c23c86fac2a9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier
koap-u1bf6e1c23c86fac2a9-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u2d85923275f8e780f6-1.text: 1. Driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier that exceeds the permissible vehicle dimensions by not more than 10 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeds the dimensions specified in a special permit by not more than 10 centimetres —
koap-u2d85923275f8e780f6-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u2e2970bc3a27a99b52-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of one hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u2e2970bc3a27a99b52-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u6d977a5ea3233d7d16-1.text: 2. Driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier that exceeds the permissible vehicle dimensions by more than 10 but not more than 20 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeds the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 10 but not more than 20 centimetres, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 10 but not more than 20 percent without a special permit, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 10 but not more than 20 percent —
koap-u6d977a5ea3233d7d16-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u832614ca206ae60ed1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u832614ca206ae60ed1-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-ubc650e1f01554f01b2-1.text: 3. Driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier that exceeds the permissible vehicle dimensions by more than 20 but not more than 50 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeds the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 20 but not more than 50 centimetres, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 20 but not more than 50 percent without a special permit, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 20 but not more than 50 percent —
koap-ubc650e1f01554f01b2-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u05c3ef0bc115a85709-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of four hundred and fifty thousand rubles.
koap-u05c3ef0bc115a85709-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u0375fa41bf516bd911-1.text: 4. Driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier that exceeds the permissible vehicle dimensions by more than 50 centimetres without a special permit, or exceeds the dimensions specified in a special permit by more than 50 centimetres, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load by more than 50 percent without a special permit, or exceeds the permissible vehicle mass or permissible vehicle axle load specified in a special permit by more than 50 percent —
koap-u0375fa41bf516bd911-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u5119659dae5b6fe56c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u5119659dae5b6fe56c-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u7353b3debcf5f5ebd0-1.text: 5. Driving a vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier with a permitted maximum mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes in violation of the Rules for the Movement of Heavy and/or Oversized Vehicles in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone, or failure by the driver of such a vehicle to comply with requirements prescribed by road signs or carriageway markings in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone —
koap-u7353b3debcf5f5ebd0-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-uaabd4b11efa4ad0464-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the vehicle driver of six hundred thousand rubles.
koap-uaabd4b11efa4ad0464-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-uccf1fec92b55eadea1-1.text: Note. Administrative liability provided for in part 5 of this Article for failure to maintain the minimum distance from the vehicle ahead in an automated vehicle weight and dimension control zone shall arise where an excess of the permissible vehicle mass and/or permissible vehicle axle load and/or permissible vehicle dimensions is detected.
koap-uccf1fec92b55eadea1-1.locator: Article 12.21.5. Violation by a driver of rules for the movement of a heavy and/or oversized vehicle belonging to a foreign carrier

koap-u3a6e024c1dfb1388fd-1.text: Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules
koap-u3a6e024c1dfb1388fd-1.locator: Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules

koap-u31714a805307782f8f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules
koap-u31714a805307782f8f-1.locator: Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules

koap-u84947fa8a3183f9116-1.text: Violation of driving instruction rules by a driver teaching another person to drive a vehicle —
koap-u84947fa8a3183f9116-1.locator: Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-14.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u753b638193c43fe933-14.locator: Article 12.22. Violation of driving instruction rules

koap-u658b8712c11836e29b-1.text: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons
koap-u658b8712c11836e29b-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u7bd2995e20f6c995b0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons
koap-u7bd2995e20f6c995b0-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u1058a388813487720f-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for transporting persons, except in the cases provided for in parts 2 - 6 of this Article —
koap-u1058a388813487720f-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-4.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u440abb2d799e2eb8a0-1.text: 2. Transporting persons outside the cab of a motor vehicle (except in cases permitted by the Road Traffic Rules), tractor or other self-propelled machinery, on a goods trailer, in a caravan, in the body of a cargo motorcycle or outside seating positions provided for by the motorcycle's design —
koap-u440abb2d799e2eb8a0-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-8.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-8.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u3cf98c5ffbddae1f61-1.text: 3. Violation of requirements for transporting children established by the Road Traffic Rules —
koap-u3cf98c5ffbddae1f61-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u426ffaa768eec0e521-4.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u2d49e8e7fe7009abea-1.text: 4. Organized carriage of a group of children by buses that do not meet the requirements of the Rules for the Organized Carriage of Groups of Children by Bus, or by a driver who does not meet the requirements of those Rules, or without a charter contract where those Rules require such a document, or without a route programme, a list of children or a list of designated accompanying persons required by those Rules —
koap-u2d49e8e7fe7009abea-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u828c0dcc122da9e146-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of three thousand rubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u828c0dcc122da9e146-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-uf0b9b346c59f1ae8ad-1.text: 5. Violation of requirements for transporting children at night established by the Rules for the Organized Carriage of Groups of Children by Bus —
koap-uf0b9b346c59f1ae8ad-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u8fa9904e48442530dd-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on the driver of five thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months; on officials, fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, two hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u8fa9904e48442530dd-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u7507fe5e58eaf7c5ff-1.text: 6. Violation of requirements for transporting children established by the Rules for the Organized Carriage of Groups of Children by Bus, except in the cases provided for in parts 4 and 5 of this Article —
koap-u7507fe5e58eaf7c5ff-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-ucb86b911325358a867-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty-five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ucb86b911325358a867-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-16.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-3.text: 1. For administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-3.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u66d8ec729009f08fd3-1.text: 2. Individuals applying the special tax regime Tax on Professional Income who commit the administrative offence provided for in part 3 of this Article shall bear administrative liability as officials where the offence is committed in the course of activities involving the carriage of passengers and baggage by passenger taxi.
koap-u66d8ec729009f08fd3-1.locator: Article 12.23. Violation of rules for transporting persons

koap-u36f6b4cd36f0efaa46-1.text: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health
koap-u36f6b4cd36f0efaa46-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u23f8b257c054c95f11-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health
koap-u23f8b257c054c95f11-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u0752f75a43e5950cdb-1.text: 1. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor harm to the victim's health —
koap-u0752f75a43e5950cdb-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-ud9b9363d8fd345d605-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand seven hundred and fifty to seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years.
koap-ud9b9363d8fd345d605-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u13536d2d2e1c4bdf56-1.text: 2. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing harm of moderate severity to the victim's health —
koap-u13536d2d2e1c4bdf56-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u84b83bdfaab966bb12-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to thirty-seven thousand five hundred rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years.
koap-u84b83bdfaab966bb12-1.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-17.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u153a4f1d3d89a8c553-2.text: 1. Causing minor harm to health shall mean a short-term health disorder or a slight permanent loss of general capacity for work.
koap-u153a4f1d3d89a8c553-2.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u9139f8f751c517eb60-2.text: 2. Causing harm of moderate severity to health shall mean a prolonged health disorder that is not life-threatening or a significant permanent loss of general capacity for work of less than one third.
koap-u9139f8f751c517eb60-2.locator: Article 12.24. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules causing minor or moderately severe harm to the victim's health

koap-u86b76cec1661b6837a-1.text: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle
koap-u86b76cec1661b6837a-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u265b3ee21b96ee7feb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle
koap-u265b3ee21b96ee7feb-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u0b6104c547b6cc3b56-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available to police officers or other persons who are granted the right to use vehicles in cases provided for by legislation —
koap-u0b6104c547b6cc3b56-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.
koap-u6de97fcf316b4b03e1-5.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u0b3b62d199f320a8bd-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with a lawful demand to stop a vehicle by a police officer, customs official or official of the federal executive body responsible for transport control and supervision, except in the cases provided for in part 12 of Article 12.21.1 of this Code —
koap-u0b3b62d199f320a8bd-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-ue5ba6648b1a83cab66-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand to ten thousand rubles.
koap-ue5ba6648b1a83cab66-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u6e83a73496ce70feb0-1.text: 3. Failure to comply with a lawful demand by an official of the military automobile inspectorate to stop a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation or the rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorized to carry out tasks in the field of civil defence —
koap-u6e83a73496ce70feb0-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-ud73bb4d8dc38bad62d-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to eight hundred rubles.
koap-ud73bb4d8dc38bad62d-2.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u18cc056c3fa003301d-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-u18cc056c3fa003301d-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-ue320703b8e8d766fff-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of ten thousand rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for four to six months.
koap-ue320703b8e8d766fff-1.locator: Article 12.25. Failure to comply with a demand to make a vehicle available or to stop a vehicle

koap-u01d31208cecf84c8ff-1.text: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication
koap-u01d31208cecf84c8ff-1.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-u827fe0f3d51531ccd4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication
koap-u827fe0f3d51531ccd4-1.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-u3981edf4f031c635f2-1.text: 1. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a lawful demand by an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication, where such acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u3981edf4f031c635f2-1.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles with deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years.
koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-3.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-uf397b5c170b1b63b49-1.text: 2. Failure by a vehicle driver who does not have the right to drive vehicles or has been deprived of that right to comply with a lawful demand by an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication, where such acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-uf397b5c170b1b63b49-1.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-u616c86344c48a8f618-2.text: shall entail administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days or, for persons to whom administrative arrest may not be applied under this Code, an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles.
koap-u616c86344c48a8f618-2.locator: Article 12.26. Failure by a vehicle driver to comply with a demand to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

koap-u3e43442530c71257c1-1.text: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident
koap-u3e43442530c71257c1-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-uc735051f40130a0e79-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident
koap-uc735051f40130a0e79-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-ua6f573e5038ceaf368-1.text: 1. Failure by a driver to fulfil duties provided for by the Road Traffic Rules in connection with a road traffic accident in which the driver is involved, except in the cases provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-ua6f573e5038ceaf368-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-9.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand rubles.
koap-u8bd9eda64d80d733c1-9.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u7d2e170187278ee257-1.text: 2. A driver's leaving, in violation of the Road Traffic Rules, the scene of a road traffic accident in which the driver was involved, in the absence of elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u7d2e170187278ee257-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u3c57592127f9434b5e-1.text: shall entail deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one year to one and a half years or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-u3c57592127f9434b5e-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u61e93cfe55a3c4c420-1.text: 3. Failure to comply with the requirement of the Road Traffic Rules prohibiting a driver from consuming alcoholic beverages, narcotic or psychotropic substances after a road traffic accident in which the driver is involved, or after the vehicle has been stopped at the demand of a police officer, until an authorized official has conducted an examination to establish intoxication or has decided to dispense with such an examination —
koap-u61e93cfe55a3c4c420-1.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-4.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of forty-five thousand rubles with deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for one and a half to two years.
koap-u1f727ac52f965a7394-4.locator: Article 12.27. Failure to fulfil duties in connection with a road traffic accident

koap-u31e8edac5d49a62c38-1.text: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones
koap-u31e8edac5d49a62c38-1.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-u9c39287587c6498c3d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones
koap-u9c39287587c6498c3d-1.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-u0de708547841b18af6-1.text: 1. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones, except in the case provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-u0de708547841b18af6-1.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred rubles.
koap-ue1e49bea8d69744db2-5.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-1.text: 2. A violation provided for in part 1 of this Article committed in the federal city of Moscow or Saint Petersburg —
koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-1.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-u365d37e0ad9c5a89b9-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand rubles.
koap-u365d37e0ad9c5a89b9-2.locator: Article 12.28. Violation of rules governing vehicle movement in residential zones

koap-u1ed3784a74ac2d92ee-1.text: Article 12.29. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or another person participating in road traffic
koap-u1ed3784a74ac2d92ee-1.locator: Article 12.29. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or another person participating in road traffic

koap-ueb64ff139f0d26876e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 12.29. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or another person participating in road traffic
koap-ueb64ff139f0d26876e-1.locator: Article 12.29. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or another person participating in road traffic

koap-u4dc320998cd2ef4fb4-1.text: 1. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or vehicle passenger —
koap-u4dc320998cd2ef4fb4-1.locator: Article 12.29. Violation of the Road Traffic Rules by a pedestrian or another person participating in road traffic

koap-u753b638193c43fe933-15.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred rubles.

Failure to comply with requirements for ensuring road traffic safety during the construction, reconstruction, repair and maintenance of roads, railway level crossings or other road structures, or failure to take measures to remove traffic obstructions in a timely manner or temporarily restrict or suspend vehicle traffic on individual road sections where use of those sections endangers road traffic safety —

koap-u3ab06b549283eb0513-1.text: 2. Failure by a vehicle owner to fulfil the duty established by federal law to insure their civil liability, as well as driving a vehicle when such compulsory insurance is known to be absent —
koap-u3ab06b549283eb0513-1.locator: Article 12.37. Failure to comply with requirements for compulsory insurance of motor vehicle owners' civil liability

koap-u900771e008875eabe6-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of eight hundred rubles.
koap-u900771e008875eabe6-3.locator: Article 12.37. Failure to comply with requirements for compulsory insurance of motor vehicle owners' civil liability

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-7.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 2 of this Article —

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-5.locator: Article 12.37. Failure to comply with requirements for compulsory insurance of motor vehicle owners' civil liability

koap-u4d5c6a468332125691-1.text: Note. A person who commits an administrative offence provided for in this Article shall not be held administratively liable for the second and subsequent detections of such an administrative offence within twenty-four hours of its first detection.
koap-u4d5c6a468332125691-1.locator: Article 12.37. Failure to comply with requirements for compulsory insurance of motor vehicle owners' civil liability

koap-u7e9c7a3c4bbb07482b-1.locator: Article 13.2. Unauthorized connection of terminal equipment to a telecommunications network

koap-u76732064c42e3cb08f-1.locator: Article 13.2.1. Failure by a communications operator to perform duties concerning transmission of a subscriber number and/or unique identification code, termination of communications services and/or traffic transmission services, and connection to the system for ensuring operators' compliance with requirements when providing communications services and traffic transmission services in the public communications network

Failure by a communications operator to perform duties concerning transmission of a subscriber number and/or unique identification code, termination of communications services and/or traffic transmission services, and connection to the system for ensuring operators' compliance with requirements when providing communications services and traffic transmission services in the public communications network

koap-udbc787ebc061e32703-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-udbc787ebc061e32703-1.locator: Article 13.2.1. Failure by a communications operator to perform the duty to connect to the system for ensuring operators' compliance with requirements when providing communications services and traffic transmission services in the public communications network, or the duty to send to that system and/or receive from it the information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation in the field of communications —

koap-udbc787ebc061e32703-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-udbc787ebc061e32703-2.locator: Article 13.2.1. Failure by a communications operator to perform duties concerning transmission of a subscriber number and/or unique identification code, termination of communications services and/or traffic transmission services, and connection to the system for ensuring operators' compliance with requirements when providing communications services and traffic transmission services in the public communications network

koap-udef97e1bc240842f5a-1.locator: Article 13.3. Manufacture or installation of radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices without a special permit (licence)

koap-u98ed30af7fdb4dfca7-1.locator: Article 13.3. Manufacture or installation of radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices without a special permit (licence)

koap-ua8372804ff49c80082-1.locator: Article 13.3. Manufacture or installation of radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices without a special permit (licence)

koap-u92e7716a41ca1ddd62-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to three thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; on officials, three thousand to six thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to sixty thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices.
koap-u92e7716a41ca1ddd62-1.locator: Article 13.3. Manufacture or installation of radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices without a special permit (licence)

koap-u28133a2f8504055f0a-1.text: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters
koap-u28133a2f8504055f0a-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u89347519bb20cc9d04-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters
koap-u89347519bb20cc9d04-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-ua972674e832e1d5a0c-1.text: 1. Failure to install radio electronic equipment and/or a high-frequency device at the location specified when that equipment and/or device was registered, or installation of radio electronic equipment and/or a high-frequency device outside the location specified at registration —
koap-ua972674e832e1d5a0c-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-ua09e48ff47f076a1ac-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of nine hundred to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, one thousand five hundred to three thousand rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, one thousand five hundred to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand rubles.
koap-ua09e48ff47f076a1ac-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-ub37043149129188428-1.text: 2. Use without registration of radio electronic equipment and/or a high-frequency device subject to registration —
koap-ub37043149129188428-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-udf67edfbee803bed32-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to three thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; on officials, three thousand to seven thousand five hundred rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three thousand to six thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to sixty thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices.
koap-udf67edfbee803bed32-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u422e7c7186ea182998-1.text: 3. Violation of conditions for use of the radio frequency spectrum established by a decision allocating a radio frequency band and/or a permit to use radio frequencies or radio frequency channels (including failure to meet the deadline for registering radio electronic equipment and/or a high-frequency device), violation of radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters —
koap-u422e7c7186ea182998-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u4f09ef04975aab258a-1.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to four thousand five hundred rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; on officials, four thousand five hundred to nine thousand rubles; on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, four thousand five hundred to nine thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices; and on legal entities, forty-five thousand to ninety thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices.
koap-u4f09ef04975aab258a-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-19.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-ucbcd9f8309d2e5a08c-1.text: 1. When imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article, the installation location of radio electronic equipment and/or a high-frequency device shall be determined by the geographical coordinates specified when the equipment and/or device was registered. Failure to install the equipment and/or device is confirmed by a second finding, within three months of the first finding, that the radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency device is absent from the location specified at registration.
koap-ucbcd9f8309d2e5a08c-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u92825beb4a0d264331-1.text: 2. When imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 13.7 of this Code, the following circumstances aggravating administrative liability shall be taken into account:
koap-u92825beb4a0d264331-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u922a8e56f9a88e9684-1.text: 1) commission of a continuing administrative offence lasting more than three months;
koap-u922a8e56f9a88e9684-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u51c726f83b3cf65fda-1.text: 2) causing, as a result of the administrative offence, radio interference to the radio electronic equipment of other users of the radio frequency spectrum.
koap-u51c726f83b3cf65fda-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-ub23dfaa06e4def02b6-1.text: 3. Use of radio electronic equipment and/or high-frequency devices intended for individual reception of television and radio broadcasts, or for use of consumer electronics products that do not contain radio transmitting devices, shall not entail administrative liability.
koap-ub23dfaa06e4def02b6-1.locator: Article 13.4. Violation of requirements for use of the radio frequency spectrum, radio communication rules or rules for use of radio frequencies, or failure to comply with radio emission standards or parameters

koap-u1feaa834c7d7a5c3d1-1.text: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities
koap-u1feaa834c7d7a5c3d1-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-uf0b0d1dc2c3c5f1399-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities
koap-uf0b0d1dc2c3c5f1399-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-uff2d7010604c9dade9-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities where the violation has not caused a communications outage —
koap-uff2d7010604c9dade9-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u537d30b214b8162642-2.text: shall entail a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred rubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, three thousand to five thousand rubles.
koap-u537d30b214b8162642-2.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u04083730761e7fd458-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities where the violation has caused a communications outage —
koap-u04083730761e7fd458-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-6.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand rubles; on officials, one thousand to two thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-6.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u0683c84d29835d8f80-1.text: 3. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities where the violation has caused damage to communications lines or facilities serving state authorities, defence, security or law enforcement needs —
koap-u0683c84d29835d8f80-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-3.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand rubles.
koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-3.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-uf1d6fcd01b7da437f6-1.text: 4. Failure by officials to comply with requirements of regulatory documents on ensuring uninterrupted operation of transmission lines, circuits and channels provided for the needs of state authorities, defence, security and law enforcement —
koap-uf1d6fcd01b7da437f6-1.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-5.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand rubles.
koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-5.locator: Article 13.5. Violation of rules for protecting communications lines or facilities

koap-u324be9119de8611c52-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-ua8c1e525bfe64f6f74-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements
koap-ua8c1e525bfe64f6f74-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-u7bb0832aed6d47a297-1.text: 1. Use in communications networks of uncertified communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment when transmitting messages over the Internet information and telecommunications network, where legislation requires mandatory certification of such equipment —
koap-u7bb0832aed6d47a297-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-udaaa6935b293566efb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified communications equipment; on officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified communications equipment; and on legal entities, sixty thousand to three hundred thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified communications equipment.
koap-udaaa6935b293566efb-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-u77854415d3137c6612-1.text: 2. Use in communications networks of communications equipment without a declaration of conformity where legislation does not require its mandatory certification —
koap-u77854415d3137c6612-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-udf4b9d4b9e3ad024d6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the undeclared communications equipment; and on legal entities, sixty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the undeclared communications equipment.
koap-udf4b9d4b9e3ad024d6-1.locator: Article 13.6. Use of communications equipment or uncertified coding (encryption) equipment that has not undergone the procedure for confirming conformity with established requirements

koap-uef7e62842469654df6-1.locator: Article 13.7. Failure to comply with established rules and standards governing the design, construction and operation of communications networks and facilities

koap-u31073ff5e3f4e28d93-1.locator: Article 13.8. Manufacture, sale or operation of technical equipment that does not comply with standards or norms governing permissible levels of industrial radio interference

koap-u208cf600407fda41b9-1.locator: Article 13.8. Manufacture, sale or operation of technical equipment that does not comply with standards or norms governing permissible levels of industrial radio interference

koap-u5d2ddc46f69027fa2f-1.locator: Article 13.8. Manufacture, sale or operation of technical equipment that does not comply with standards or norms governing permissible levels of industrial radio interference
