koap-u192444ef91074e2478-1.text: 1. Manufacture for sale or sale of knowingly counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons —
koap-u192444ef91074e2478-1.locator: Article 13.10. Manufacture for sale or sale of knowingly counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons, or use of knowingly counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements

koap-ub2cd30b48d9fb11f36-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons; on officials, three thousand to four thousand rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons.
koap-ub2cd30b48d9fb11f36-1.locator: Article 13.10. Manufacture for sale or sale of knowingly counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons, or use of knowingly counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements

koap-u4a6a0e5ee8179ba101-1.text: 2. Use of knowingly counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements —
koap-u4a6a0e5ee8179ba101-1.locator: Article 13.10. Manufacture for sale or sale of knowingly counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons, or use of knowingly counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements

koap-uccc70655da0ccc32e9-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements; on officials, two thousand to three thousand rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles with confiscation of the means used to manufacture counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements.
koap-uccc70655da0ccc32e9-1.locator: Article 13.10. Manufacture for sale or sale of knowingly counterfeit state postage indicia or international reply coupons, or use of knowingly counterfeit franking machine dies, postal date stamps or other postal identification implements

koap-ud81e2611bcd31af39b-1.text: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data
koap-ud81e2611bcd31af39b-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uef787a38a0a3b61c4b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data
koap-uef787a38a0a3b61c4b-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uebceccb3613fe53344-1.text: 1. Processing personal data in cases not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, or processing personal data in a manner incompatible with the purposes for which the personal data were collected, except in the cases provided for in parts 2, 11 - 18 of this Article and Article 17.13 of this Code, where these acts do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-uebceccb3613fe53344-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u5cc92db5fc78df6e6c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u5cc92db5fc78df6e6c-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-3.text: 1.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 1 of this Article —
koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-3.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u0460e87168a6f67670-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand rubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u0460e87168a6f67670-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u40b41020ec042caeeb-1.text: 2. Processing personal data without the data subject's written consent to the processing of their personal data where such consent must be obtained under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, except in the cases provided for in Article 17.13 of this Code, where these acts do not constitute a criminal offence, or processing personal data in violation of requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data concerning the information to be included in the data subject's written consent to the processing of their personal data —
koap-u40b41020ec042caeeb-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u75f756864b0481a588-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u75f756864b0481a588-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u5c02577b3b70e403c5-1.text: 2.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 2 of this Article —
koap-u5c02577b3b70e403c5-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u58f72a4c5716957725-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand rubles; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, five hundred thousand to one million rubles; and on legal entities, one million to one million five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u58f72a4c5716957725-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u321cda3a8c7b31fe96-1.text: 3. Failure by an operator to perform the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to publish or otherwise provide unrestricted access to a document defining the operator's policy on personal data processing or to information on the personal data protection requirements being implemented —
koap-u321cda3a8c7b31fe96-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uad9b2c30d60539361c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to three thousand rubles; on officials, six thousand to twelve thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, thirty thousand to sixty thousand rubles.
koap-uad9b2c30d60539361c-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uf8ee526e7b3a119836-1.text: 4. Failure by an operator to perform the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to provide the data subject with information concerning the processing of their personal data —
koap-uf8ee526e7b3a119836-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uf3cfa069be7ed87fc1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand rubles; on officials, eight thousand to twelve thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, forty thousand to eighty thousand rubles.
koap-uf3cfa069be7ed87fc1-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u4ed2b1c4a505a8787d-1.text: 5. Failure by an operator, within the periods established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, to comply with a demand by a data subject or their representative or by the authorized body for the protection of data subjects' rights to rectify, block or destroy personal data where the personal data are incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, unlawfully obtained or unnecessary for the stated purpose of processing —
koap-u4ed2b1c4a505a8787d-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u9f15f2d7ef6f115ad5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand rubles; on officials, eight thousand to twenty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, twenty thousand to forty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to ninety thousand rubles.
koap-u9f15f2d7ef6f115ad5-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-udf78c7c76fe5342854-1.text: 5.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 5 of this Article —
koap-udf78c7c76fe5342854-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ua19720da5242d7fcba-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to thirty thousand rubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ua19720da5242d7fcba-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u0b3c74130da069ea59-1.text: 6. Failure by an operator, when processing personal data without automated means, to comply with the duty to observe conditions that, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, ensure the security of personal data during storage of physical personal data media and exclude unauthorized access to them, where this results in unlawful or accidental access to personal data, their destruction, alteration, blocking, copying, provision or dissemination, or other unlawful actions involving personal data, in the absence of elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u0b3c74130da069ea59-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u645222047ffa02b762-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to four thousand rubles; on officials, eight thousand to twenty thousand rubles; on individual entrepreneurs, twenty thousand to forty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u645222047ffa02b762-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u784001fb69ffed1536-1.text: 7. Failure by an operator that is a state or municipal body to perform the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to depersonalize personal data, or failure to comply with established requirements or methods for depersonalizing personal data —
koap-u784001fb69ffed1536-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ue963dac5792667f23a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of six thousand to twelve thousand rubles.
koap-ue963dac5792667f23a-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u92a99fda299c3eb33c-1.text: 8. Failure by an operator, when collecting personal data, including through the Internet information and telecommunications network, to perform the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to ensure the recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, rectification (updating, alteration) or retrieval of personal data of citizens of the Russian Federation using databases located in the territory of the Russian Federation —
koap-u92a99fda299c3eb33c-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u3d92fcff14064f5a60-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one million to six million rubles.
koap-u3d92fcff14064f5a60-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ue4aaaacafafa17186d-1.text: 9. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in part 8 of this Article —
koap-ue4aaaacafafa17186d-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u0e16455baca7a4d85a-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; on officials, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, six million to eighteen million rubles.
koap-u0e16455baca7a4d85a-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u2e2a94f87db648f5a0-1.text: 10. Failure or delay by an operator in performing the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to notify the authorized body for the protection of data subjects' rights of an intention to process personal data —
koap-u2e2a94f87db648f5a0-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u194b02800fa342d0e6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u194b02800fa342d0e6-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u3565fafa9dcb3051da-1.text: 11. Failure or delay by an operator in performing the duty under the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data to notify the authorized body for the protection of data subjects' rights where an unlawful or accidental transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of personal data resulting in a violation of data subjects' rights has been established —
koap-u3565fafa9dcb3051da-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ue6e0dde9e3217ef014-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles; on officials, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one million to three million rubles.
koap-ue6e0dde9e3217ef014-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u7e82c2855547ceaf3a-1.text: 12. Acts (omissions) of an operator resulting in unlawful transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of information containing the personal data of one thousand to ten thousand data subjects and/or ten thousand to one hundred thousand identifiers, where these acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u7e82c2855547ceaf3a-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u26bd13a20004a99c4f-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand rubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, three million to five million rubles.
koap-u26bd13a20004a99c4f-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ube6f135c40d7f85186-1.text: 13. Acts (omissions) of an operator resulting in unlawful transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of information containing the personal data of ten thousand to one hundred thousand data subjects and/or one hundred thousand to one million identifiers, where these acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-ube6f135c40d7f85186-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u2807c2d55b0ef55643-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five million to ten million rubles.
koap-u2807c2d55b0ef55643-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u7768ba92970ffca549-1.text: 14. Acts (omissions) of an operator resulting in unlawful transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of information containing the personal data of more than one hundred thousand data subjects and/or more than one million identifiers, where these acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u7768ba92970ffca549-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u63d536f0a0a30b3ae1-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand rubles; on officials, four hundred thousand to six hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten million to fifteen million rubles.
koap-u63d536f0a0a30b3ae1-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uef8dc1998ff4a2da55-1.text: 15. Commission of an administrative offence provided for in parts 12 - 14 of this Article by a person who has been subjected to an administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for in parts 12 - 14, 16 - 18 of this Article and this part —
koap-uef8dc1998ff4a2da55-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u76b62a95335cd68bc2-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of four hundred thousand to six hundred thousand rubles; on officials, eight hundred thousand to one million two hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, 1 to 3 percent of the aggregate revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, or of the credit institution's own funds (capital) on the date of the administrative offence, but not less than twenty million rubles and not more than five hundred million rubles.
koap-u76b62a95335cd68bc2-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ud427fe3ba870fbdb07-1.text: 16. Acts (omissions) of an operator resulting in unlawful transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of information containing a special category of personal data —
koap-ud427fe3ba870fbdb07-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u88caeca2c11ddd0b26-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand rubles; on officials, one million to one million three hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten million to fifteen million rubles.
koap-u88caeca2c11ddd0b26-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uded42b223c7bcf1836-1.text: 17. Acts (omissions) of an operator resulting in unlawful transfer (provision, dissemination, access) of information containing biometric personal data, except in the cases provided for in Article 13.11.3 of this Code —
koap-uded42b223c7bcf1836-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uf5cff1afa00c7403bf-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; on officials, one million three hundred thousand to one million five hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifteen million to twenty million rubles.
koap-uf5cff1afa00c7403bf-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u43777c39b18508a5d8-1.text: 18. Commission of an administrative offence provided for in part 16 or 17 of this Article by a person who has been subjected to an administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for in parts 12 - 17 of this Article and this part —
koap-u43777c39b18508a5d8-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u9e32f1de55d582024e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand rubles; on officials, one million five hundred thousand to two million rubles; and on legal entities, 1 to 3 percent of the aggregate revenue received from the sale of all goods (works, services) during the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or during the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in the sale of goods (works, services) during the preceding calendar year, or of the credit institution's own funds (capital) on the date of the administrative offence, but not less than twenty-five million rubles and not more than five hundred million rubles.
koap-u9e32f1de55d582024e-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-20.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u5da6ce0313723dd902-1.text: 1. For administrative offences provided for in parts 1.1, 8 - 18 of this Article and Articles 13.31, 13.35 - 13.37, 13.39, 13.40 and 13.46 of this Code, individual entrepreneurs shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-u5da6ce0313723dd902-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-uac80fc498379c291f4-1.text: 2. In parts 10 - 18 of this Article, an official means an official of a state or municipal body or a non-profit organization.
koap-uac80fc498379c291f4-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u574f9521a526c67943-1.text: 3. In parts 10 - 18 of this Article, a legal entity means an operator that is a legal entity other than a state or municipal body or a non-profit organization.
koap-u574f9521a526c67943-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u9025d5cf250045c1d2-1.text: 4. For the purposes of this Article, an identifier means a unique designation of information about an individual contained in the operator's personal data information system and relating to that individual.
koap-u9025d5cf250045c1d2-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-u1d1ab8b3a17a68ea43-1.text: 5. When imposing an administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for in parts 15 and 18 of this Article, the circumstance aggravating administrative liability provided for in point 1 of part 1 of Article 4.3 of this Code shall be taken into account, as well as the following aggravating circumstance: at the time of commission of the administrative offence (at the time of the ruling in the administrative offence case), the person committing the offence was (is) considered to have been subjected to an administrative penalty for administrative offences provided for in parts 1 - 11 of this Article and/or Articles 13.6 and 13.12 of this Code.
koap-u1d1ab8b3a17a68ea43-1.locator: Article 13.11. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data

koap-ucd8001f8447ee41ddc-1.locator: Article 13.11.1. Dissemination of information on job openings or vacant positions containing discriminatory restrictions

koap-ua291bdd821e635b50f-1.locator: Article 13.11.1. Dissemination of information on job openings or vacant positions containing discriminatory restrictions

koap-u7de5269246c786cbe5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand rubles; on officials, three thousand to five thousand rubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to fifteen thousand rubles.
koap-u7de5269246c786cbe5-1.locator: Article 13.11.1. Dissemination of information on job openings or vacant positions containing discriminatory restrictions

koap-u5f5879b9606457cb19-1.text: Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens
koap-u5f5879b9606457cb19-1.locator: Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens

koap-u85d32519ca848da84c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens
koap-u85d32519ca848da84c-1.locator: Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens

koap-uc04fb5411cd8bd5750-1.text: Unlawful use, in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens that are intended and/or used to exchange electronic messages exclusively between users of those information systems and/or computer programs, where the sender of an electronic message determines its recipient or recipients and no provision is made for Internet users to post publicly accessible information on the Internet, or connection of other information systems to those information systems and/or computer programs in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection —
koap-uc04fb5411cd8bd5750-1.locator: Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens

koap-uc1ebbcbd0abb2859d6-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand rubles.
koap-uc1ebbcbd0abb2859d6-1.locator: Article 13.11.2. Unlawful use of information systems and/or computer programs belonging to foreign legal entities and/or foreign citizens

koap-u9a688b51d02ea4aa0c-1.text: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data
koap-u9a688b51d02ea4aa0c-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-ufb2353456009f8eaca-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data
koap-ufb2353456009f8eaca-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-u78c25843de601e5cc0-1.text: 1. Placement and updating by banks, multifunctional centres for the provision of state and municipal services and other organizations, in cases specified by federal laws, of a data subject's biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data (hereinafter, the unified biometric system) in violation of requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u78c25843de601e5cc0-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-udee2a801c7fea8ae3c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-udee2a801c7fea8ae3c-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-ub115d56bb7d2b38fe2-1.text: 2. Violation of the procedure for processing biometric personal data in the unified biometric system, the procedure for processing biometric personal data and unified biometric system vectors in the information systems of state bodies, the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and accredited organizations carrying out authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data, or requirements for information technologies and technical means intended for processing biometric personal data and unified biometric system vectors for identification and/or authentication —
koap-ub115d56bb7d2b38fe2-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-ue85945b89d2c6793e8-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million rubles.
koap-ue85945b89d2c6793e8-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-u15fe9196b1dbf8bd6e-1.text: 3. Failure to take organizational and technical measures to ensure the security of biometric personal data when they are processed in the unified biometric system or during its interaction with other information systems, or failure to take organizational and technical measures to ensure the security of biometric personal data when they are processed in other information systems providing authentication using individuals' biometric personal data, including information systems of accredited state bodies —
koap-u15fe9196b1dbf8bd6e-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-u445816413d1acbad20-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one million to one million five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u445816413d1acbad20-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-u94b3828402978b9c47-1.text: 4. Processing biometric personal data or unified biometric system vectors for authentication of individuals in the information systems of state bodies or organizations or the information system of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation without accreditation, or where accreditation has been suspended or terminated —
koap-u94b3828402978b9c47-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-u905e6bfe38774e14ac-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of five hundred thousand to one million rubles; and on legal entities, one million to two million rubles.
koap-u905e6bfe38774e14ac-1.locator: Article 13.11.3. Violation of requirements for placing and processing biometric personal data in the state information system Unified System for Identification and Authentication of Individuals Using Biometric Personal Data and other information systems providing authentication based on individuals' biometric personal data

koap-ub33593231aa59c15ad-1.text: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
koap-ub33593231aa59c15ad-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u58b3687592562f93d5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules
koap-u58b3687592562f93d5-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-uebc264be4db8f6a98f-1.text: 1. Violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) —
koap-uebc264be4db8f6a98f-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-uee28f6ffa50a50a5d4-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred rubles; on officials, one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred rubles; and on legal entities, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand rubles.
koap-uee28f6ffa50a50a5d4-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u1a6ae7c0b1f6d89f64-1.text: 2. Use of uncertified information systems, databases and data banks, or uncertified information protection tools, where they are subject to mandatory certification (except tools for protecting information constituting a state secret) —
koap-u1a6ae7c0b1f6d89f64-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-ucb92b09af54e6fb15c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified information protection tools; on officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified information protection tools.
koap-ucb92b09af54e6fb15c-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u62298f1183c2fffe51-1.text: 3. Violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out work involving the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, creation of tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret, implementation of measures and/or provision of services to protect information constituting a state secret —
koap-u62298f1183c2fffe51-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u0c40d6dbbffd390e10-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles.
koap-u0c40d6dbbffd390e10-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u644177a877c6c7895a-1.text: 4. Use of uncertified tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret —
koap-u644177a877c6c7895a-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-ue214745dd87613ae1e-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles with or without confiscation of the uncertified tools intended to protect information constituting a state secret.
koap-ue214745dd87613ae1e-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-uf28137a424908f2e95-1.text: 5. Gross violation of conditions stipulated in a licence to carry out activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) —
koap-uf28137a424908f2e95-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-ud153597a49bc879feb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on persons engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity of two thousand to three thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on officials, two thousand to three thousand rubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand rubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ud153597a49bc879feb-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u584ea9d6f4927ddba4-1.text: 6. Violation of requirements for protecting information (except information constituting a state secret) established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, except in the cases provided for in parts 1, 2 and 5 of this Article —
koap-u584ea9d6f4927ddba4-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u677fb68584877f8d4c-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u677fb68584877f8d4c-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u85e1955c6ceb96fcb1-1.text: 7. Violation of requirements for protecting information constituting a state secret established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, except in the cases provided for in parts 3 and 4 of this Article, where such acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminal offence —
koap-u85e1955c6ceb96fcb1-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-u00b2f9ae23faf07c91-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand rubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u00b2f9ae23faf07c91-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-ud9edec47f4676a3476-1.text: Note. The concept of a gross violation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation for the specific licensed type of activity.
koap-ud9edec47f4676a3476-1.locator: Article 13.12. Violation of information protection rules

koap-uaa72014d42efe5b320-1.text: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-uaa72014d42efe5b320-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u2241e22d685f5ca21c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-u2241e22d685f5ca21c-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u0ff14fab4dce90e14b-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for creating security systems for significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation and ensuring their operation, or requirements for ensuring the security of significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them, where such acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u0ff14fab4dce90e14b-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ue27867931466f4b6c0-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ue27867931466f4b6c0-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ud6a7379016e9e50a9a-1.text: 2. Violation of the procedure for reporting computer incidents, responding to them and taking measures to eliminate the consequences of computer attacks against significant facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them —
koap-ud6a7379016e9e50a9a-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ua7ad76e7ac10dbdf58-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ua7ad76e7ac10dbdf58-2.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-uf2504dc7d18fa8b44e-1.text: 3. Violation of the procedure for exchanging information on computer incidents between entities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, or between such entities and authorized bodies of foreign states, international organizations, international non-governmental organizations and foreign organizations engaged in responding to computer incidents —
koap-uf2504dc7d18fa8b44e-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ub591020b252def8a22-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-ub591020b252def8a22-1.locator: Article 13.12.1. Violation of requirements for ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u1ed600068ce60b9387-1.text: Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-u1ed600068ce60b9387-1.locator: Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u100a301f37e9195e41-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-u100a301f37e9195e41-1.locator: Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u4f86f3f10218b37220-1.text: Violation of rules for operating means of storing, processing or transmitting protected computer information contained in the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, or information systems, information and telecommunications networks, automated control systems or telecommunications networks forming part of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, or rules for access to that information, those information systems, information and telecommunications networks, automated control systems or telecommunications networks, except in the cases provided for in Article 13.12.1 of this Code, where such acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminal offence —
koap-u4f86f3f10218b37220-1.locator: Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u7f621b9dbfffa89523-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand rubles; on officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand rubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand rubles.
koap-u7f621b9dbfffa89523-1.locator: Article 13.12.2. Violation of rules for operating facilities of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ufb7ad432046e026199-1.text: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
koap-ufb7ad432046e026199-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-ue7d8f7b31420ce5bca-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection
koap-ue7d8f7b31420ce5bca-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-u1d5ff37eb39d71ea62-1.text: 1. Engaging in types of activities in the field of information protection (except information constituting a state secret) without obtaining, in the prescribed manner, a special permit (licence), where such permit (licence) is mandatory under federal law, —
koap-u1d5ff37eb39d71ea62-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-u80ec5c8153ba043390-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means; on officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means; on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of information protection means.
koap-u80ec5c8153ba043390-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-uadd089b7577a6470b6-1.text: 2. Engaging, without a licence, in types of activities associated with the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, the creation of means intended to protect information constituting a state secret, or the implementation of measures and (or) provision of services to protect information constituting a state secret —
koap-uadd089b7577a6470b6-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-u7e2de05d8fef1299cb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of means for protecting information constituting a state secret created without a licence.
koap-u7e2de05d8fef1299cb-1.locator: Article 13.13. Unlawful activities in the field of information protection

koap-ua044bee1461205ab4e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.14. Disclosure of restricted-access information

koap-ubd0749306d76aa1209-1.text: Disclosure of information to which access is restricted by federal law (except where disclosure of such information entails criminal liability) by a person who obtained access to that information in connection with the performance of official or professional duties, except in the cases provided for in Part 1 of Article 14.33 and Article 17.13 of this Code, —

koap-ub683121660a2e60526-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ud2dc55d74d2a2b4b49-1.text: Note. Advocates who commit the administrative offence provided for in this Article shall bear administrative liability as officials.

koap-u46e0f00232134a9547-1.text: Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information
koap-u46e0f00232134a9547-1.locator: Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information

koap-u6894a67e718229bf21-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information
koap-u6894a67e718229bf21-1.locator: Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information

koap-u1c27f399bcedfa2b4e-1.text: Obtaining, by any unlawful means, information to which access is restricted by federal law, except in the cases provided for in Article 5.53, Parts 1 and 2 of Article 13.11, Article 14.29, Part 5 of Article 15.19 and Part 2 of Article 17.13 of this Code, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-u1c27f399bcedfa2b4e-1.locator: Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information

koap-ub683121660a2e60526-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub683121660a2e60526-2.locator: Article 13.14.1. Unlawful acquisition of restricted-access information

koap-ue44d8e7881fecd8985-1.text: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
koap-ue44d8e7881fecd8985-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u058de97b8d136ac124-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information
koap-u058de97b8d136ac124-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-uc7857406b005d6318c-1.text: 1. Production and (or) dissemination of television, video or cinema programmes, documentary and feature films, as well as information computer files and information-text processing programs belonging to special mass media, containing concealed inserts that affect people's subconscious and (or) adversely affect their health, —
koap-uc7857406b005d6318c-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ufa239c7b4036fe7c25-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ufa239c7b4036fe7c25-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-udcf73dc4702185f14d-1.text: 2. Dissemination of information about an organisation included in the published list of organisations recognised as extremist under the legislation of the Russian Federation, or about an organisation included in the published single federal list of organisations, including foreign and international organisations, recognised as terrorist under the legislation of the Russian Federation, without indicating that the organisation concerned has been liquidated or its activities prohibited, —
koap-udcf73dc4702185f14d-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ufa239c7b4036fe7c25-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ufa239c7b4036fe7c25-2.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u53e142b1dd74d0f97c-1.text: 2.1. Dissemination, in mass media and in mass-media messages and materials in information and telecommunications networks, of information about foreign agents (except information placed in unified state registers and state information systems provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation), or of materials produced by them, without indicating foreign-agent status —
koap-u53e142b1dd74d0f97c-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u09f8dbe8a6c2ee1d41-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u09f8dbe8a6c2ee1d41-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u286a70e327f804c43b-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ufde71eac0f2ca3b31a-1.text: 3. Unlawful dissemination of information about a minor who has suffered as a result of unlawful actions (inaction), or violation of the requirements for dissemination of such information established by federal laws, where these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act, —
koap-ufde71eac0f2ca3b31a-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ue0b4ccb82a11035f5a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ue0b4ccb82a11035f5a-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ufa0d848f76dd44b5e1-1.text: 4. Public dissemination of information expressing manifest disrespect for society about days of military glory and commemorative dates of Russia associated with the defence of the Fatherland, as well as public desecration of symbols of Russia's military glory, public insult to the memory of defenders of the Fatherland or public humiliation of the honour and dignity of a veteran of the Great Patriotic War, including where committed using mass media or information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), —
koap-ufa0d848f76dd44b5e1-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three million to five million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u97ecd1df09319b7cee-1.text: 4.1. Public dissemination of information denying facts established by the judgment of the International Military Tribunal for the trial and punishment of the major war criminals of the European Axis countries, or approving crimes established by that judgment, as well as public dissemination of knowingly false information about the activities of the USSR during the Second World War or about veterans of the Great Patriotic War, including where committed using mass media or information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet), —
koap-u97ecd1df09319b7cee-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three million to five million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-2.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-udd63db7292d8922082-1.text: 5. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, of information containing instructions for the homemade manufacture of explosives and explosive devices, unlawful manufacture or alteration of weapons or main parts of firearms, as well as unlawful manufacture of ammunition, except information about ways and methods of independently loading cartridges for civilian long-barrelled firearms, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-udd63db7292d8922082-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u95fb71c071f227638f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments or object of the administrative offence; on officials, forty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments or object of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with confiscation of the instruments or object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the instruments or object of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with confiscation of the instruments or object of the administrative offence.
koap-u95fb71c071f227638f-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u209c20b8d2cb2500b8-1.text: 6. Production or release of mass-media products containing public calls to engage in terrorist activity, materials publicly justifying terrorism, or other materials calling for extremist activity or substantiating or justifying the necessity of engaging in such activity, except in the cases provided for in Articles 20.3, 20.3.1 and 20.3.2 of this Code, —
koap-u209c20b8d2cb2500b8-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u0fde4e36d1618a2227-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of one hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u0fde4e36d1618a2227-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ua56d47e2b7b4e41da7-1.text: 7. Use of mass media as well as information and telecommunications networks to disclose information constituting a state secret or another secret specially protected by law, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-ua56d47e2b7b4e41da7-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-uf86ba7df66fe15b745-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uf86ba7df66fe15b745-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u3282247154e1e3ca1e-1.text: 8. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, of information containing offers for distance retail sale of alcoholic products, and (or) alcohol-containing food products, and (or) ethyl alcohol, and (or) alcohol-containing non-food products whose retail sale is restricted or prohibited by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products and on restriction of consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products, —
koap-u3282247154e1e3ca1e-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u123d82d75068d1c238-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u123d82d75068d1c238-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u34af9e6c0248b5afa2-1.text: 9. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, of knowingly unreliable information of public significance presented as reliable reports, creating a threat of harm to the life and (or) health of citizens or to property, a threat of mass disturbance of public order and (or) public safety, or a threat of interference with or cessation of the operation of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure, credit organisations, energy, industrial or communications facilities, where these actions of the person disseminating the information do not constitute a criminally punishable act, —
koap-u34af9e6c0248b5afa2-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-udd02b41df3399762ea-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, sixty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-udd02b41df3399762ea-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u5d56fe6e4abd5c5d7d-1.text: 10. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, of knowingly unreliable information of public significance presented as reliable reports, resulting in interference with the operation of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure, credit organisations, energy, industrial or communications facilities, where these actions of the person disseminating the information do not constitute a criminally punishable act, or repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 9 of this Article, —
koap-u5d56fe6e4abd5c5d7d-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u74fb319a85f848f773-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, three hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u74fb319a85f848f773-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u364f5b7fc0c289d71d-1.text: 10.1. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, under the guise of reliable reports, of knowingly unreliable information about circumstances posing a threat to citizens' lives and safety, and (or) about measures being taken to ensure the safety of the population and territories, and techniques and methods of protection against those circumstances —
koap-u364f5b7fc0c289d71d-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u5b9c1e97ca1d99e872-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of one million five hundred thousand to three million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u5b9c1e97ca1d99e872-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-uca358d13f18059ba8d-1.text: 10.2. Dissemination, in mass media as well as in information and telecommunications networks, of knowingly unreliable information of public significance presented as reliable reports, resulting in the death of a person, harm to human health or property, mass disturbance of public order and (or) public safety, or cessation of the operation of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure, credit organisations, energy, industrial or communications facilities, —
koap-uca358d13f18059ba8d-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three million to five million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ub60bf15b7bd96edc98-3.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ubb34d6cd57f0276358-1.text: 11. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 10, 10.1 or 10.2 of this Article —
koap-ubb34d6cd57f0276358-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u608b9ac3066d63f724-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, six hundred thousand to nine hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five million to ten million roubles, with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u608b9ac3066d63f724-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u974cab0f37bb22f8cf-1.text: 12. Dissemination in information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, of information insulting human dignity and public morality, expressing manifest disrespect for society, depicting actions bearing signs of unlawfulness, including violence, and disseminated out of hooligan, mercenary or other base motives, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-u974cab0f37bb22f8cf-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-uc285d1ff044eee8b42-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the equipment used to produce such materials; on officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the equipment used to produce such materials; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the equipment used to produce such materials.
koap-uc285d1ff044eee8b42-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-21.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u25e4ae5d6b2e1a62da-1.text: 1. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation shall be notified within twenty-four hours of every instance of initiation of proceedings in cases concerning administrative offences provided for in Parts 9 - 11 of this Article.
koap-u25e4ae5d6b2e1a62da-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-u290591b9d2d32dccdd-1.text: 2. Circumstances posing a threat to citizens' lives and safety referred to in Part 10.1 of this Article shall mean natural and technological emergencies, environmental emergencies, including epidemics, epizootics and other circumstances arising from accidents, hazardous natural phenomena, catastrophes, natural and other disasters, which have caused (may cause) loss of human life, damage to human health and the natural environment, significant material losses and disruption of the living conditions of the population.
koap-u290591b9d2d32dccdd-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ud1a88c506aa4b46d96-1.text: 3. The provisions of Part 12 of this Article shall not apply to works of science, literature or art having historical, artistic or cultural value, materials of registered mass media, or photographic or video materials intended for use for scientific or medical purposes or the study of which is provided for by federal state educational standards and federal educational programmes.
koap-ud1a88c506aa4b46d96-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ub283981a11107ee9cb-1.text: 4. For the purposes of this Article, hooligan motives shall mean commission, for the purpose of disturbing public order, of an offence expressing manifest disrespect for society.
koap-ub283981a11107ee9cb-1.locator: Article 13.15. Abuse of freedom of mass information

koap-ub794f51c4d535e3141-1.locator: Article 13.15.1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media

koap-u663549afc9c793c91d-1.text: 1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media —
koap-u663549afc9c793c91d-1.locator: Article 13.15.1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media

koap-u27cf1666bbdddb1685-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one to two times the amount of funds received by the editorial office of the mass-media outlet, the broadcaster or the publisher, information on the receipt of which must be provided under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media.
koap-u27cf1666bbdddb1685-1.locator: Article 13.15.1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-14.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-14.locator: Article 13.15.1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media

koap-u1d5809f133b06d03d7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three to four times the amount of funds received by the editorial office of the mass-media outlet, the broadcaster or the publisher, information on the receipt of which must be provided under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media.
koap-u1d5809f133b06d03d7-1.locator: Article 13.15.1. Failure or delay by the editorial office of a mass-media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher in providing information about receipt of funds required under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media

koap-u99f33541e0d2e2d724-1.locator: Article 13.18. Obstruction of reliable reception of radio and television programmes and operation of Internet websites
