koap-u3dc32c7f4cece94cdd-1.locator: Article 13.18. Obstruction of reliable reception of radio and television programmes and operation of Internet websites

koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, one thousand to two thousand roubles; on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-8.locator: Article 13.18. Obstruction of reliable reception of radio and television programmes and operation of Internet websites

koap-u898efb87d795e69079-1.text: 2. Obstruction of the operation of Internet websites, including official websites of state authorities or local self-government bodies, except where access to Internet websites is restricted on the basis of a court decision or a decision of an authorised federal executive body, or actions aimed at knowingly unlawful restriction of access to such websites, —
koap-u898efb87d795e69079-1.locator: Article 13.18. Obstruction of reliable reception of radio and television programmes and operation of Internet websites

koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-9.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, one thousand to two thousand roubles; on legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u87f01074ab4822f9f3-9.locator: Article 13.18. Obstruction of reliable reception of radio and television programmes and operation of Internet websites

koap-uc80d262b1e898f0826-1.text: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data
koap-uc80d262b1e898f0826-1.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u284c6596a898c9f7d7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data
koap-u284c6596a898c9f7d7-1.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u0a765c7d691299f607-1.text: 1. Failure by respondents to provide primary statistical data to entities responsible for official statistical accounting in the prescribed manner, delay in providing such data, or provision of unreliable primary statistical data —
koap-u0a765c7d691299f607-1.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u7464a35835b7311725-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to seventy thousand roubles.
koap-u7464a35835b7311725-1.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-15.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-15.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u19f3b9f05c7c1bbc06-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u19f3b9f05c7c1bbc06-1.locator: Article 13.19. Failure to provide primary statistical data

koap-u276efd2ce04b08141e-1.text: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities
koap-u276efd2ce04b08141e-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-uc91dc1ea2a2c042450-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities
koap-uc91dc1ea2a2c042450-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u38b5748a925061d877-1.text: 1. Failure to post information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities in accordance with legislation on that System by an official of a federal executive body, an official of a state extra-budgetary fund, an official of an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, an official of a state housing supervision authority, an official of a body opening and maintaining personal accounts in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, an official of an authorised body or organisation conducting state accounting of the housing stock, an official of a specialised non-profit organisation engaged in activities aimed at ensuring major repairs of common property in apartment buildings, a bank or another credit organisation, including those making electronic settlements, or another organisation through which payments for residential premises and utilities are made, except persons supplying resources necessary for the provision of utility services, providing utility services and (or) managing apartment buildings, or violation of the procedure, methods and (or) deadlines for posting information established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or posting incomplete or unreliable information, —
koap-u38b5748a925061d877-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u8eded0dd72c4a52714-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8eded0dd72c4a52714-2.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u09c2197a30f8c60d2e-1.text: 2. Violation by the operator of the State Information System for Housing and Utilities of the procedure for access to that System and the information posted in it, the time limits for registering information providers and information users, or the requirements for technological, software, linguistic, legal and organisational means of ensuring use of that System (except where its operator fails to take measures necessary to restore the operability of the System in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation), or an unjustified refusal by the operator of the State Information System for Housing and Utilities to grant an information-system operator rights of access to the State Information System for Housing and Utilities, or violation of the procedure for granting such rights, or its failure to post information subject to mandatory posting in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities, or violation of the deadlines for posting that information, —
koap-u09c2197a30f8c60d2e-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-2.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ua02d8b11e2a632ec99-1.text: 2.1. Failure by the operator of the State Information System for Housing and Utilities to take measures necessary to restore the operability of the State Information System for Housing and Utilities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-ua02d8b11e2a632ec99-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u14bc7c65ff1516e8a2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u14bc7c65ff1516e8a2-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-uc30861a0c8efff7faa-1.text: 3. Violation of the procedure for interaction with the State Information System for Housing and Utilities by an official of a state authority, local self-government body or organisation operating a state or municipal information system that interacts with the State Information System for Housing and Utilities for the purpose of posting information provided for by legislation on the State Information System for Housing and Utilities —
koap-uc30861a0c8efff7faa-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-7.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-7.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ua00b993aea448dca39-1.text: 4. Commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 or 3 of this Article by an official previously subjected to administrative punishment for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-ua00b993aea448dca39-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-2.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-22.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-4.text: 1. For the administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-4.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u242dd5abca37fdf815-1.text: 2. The administrative liability provided for in this Article and Article 13.19.2 of this Code shall not apply to officials of organisations, state authorities and local self-government bodies, or to organisations, that have transferred their powers to post information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities to other persons in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u242dd5abca37fdf815-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ufce7a7529174ab0671-1.text: 3. In the event of violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities, failure to post information, or posting incomplete or unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities, the administrative liability provided for in Parts 1 and 4 of this Article and Article 13.19.2 of this Code shall arise for the commission of those actions in relation to all types of information taken together that must be posted in respect of consumers of that person's goods (services) in the territory of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation within the time limit established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the State Information System for Housing and Utilities.
koap-ufce7a7529174ab0671-1.locator: Article 13.19.1. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ucdaceb468d551cc5c0-1.text: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities
koap-ucdaceb468d551cc5c0-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u81e6861947e3f742b0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities
koap-u81e6861947e3f742b0-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u0e684b53f5673d5549-1.text: 1. Failure by a person serving as the administrator of a general meeting to post information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, or violation of the procedure, methods and (or) deadlines for posting information established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or posting incomplete or unreliable information, —
koap-u0e684b53f5673d5549-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u240a2459f6f8f36ad4-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on natural persons of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u240a2459f6f8f36ad4-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u8895afbd154f4c2042-1.text: 2. Failure to post information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, or violation of the procedure, methods and (or) deadlines for posting information established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or posting incomplete or unreliable information, by local self-government bodies, persons supplying resources necessary for the provision of utility services, providing utility services and (or) managing apartment buildings, or other organisations required by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation to post information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities, —
koap-u8895afbd154f4c2042-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-8.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-ubc3e82dc23e53b5560-8.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-u9ece07534c517dc3c7-1.text: 3. Commission of the administrative offence provided for in Parts 1 and 2 of this Article by an official previously subjected to administrative punishment for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u9ece07534c517dc3c7-1.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ue89e44048dcebb0a80-3.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-17.text: Note. For the administrative offences provided for in this Article, persons engaged in entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-17.locator: Article 13.19.2. Failure to post information, posting incomplete information or posting unreliable information in the State Information System for Housing and Utilities

koap-uc7300a0af2ad6f0774-1.text: Article 13.19.3. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System
koap-uc7300a0af2ad6f0774-1.locator: Article 13.19.3. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System

koap-u642015f75d46151f06-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.19.3. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System
koap-u642015f75d46151f06-1.locator: Article 13.19.3. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System

koap-u983f6c53060776e2c1-1.text: 1. Failure to post information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation by an official of an executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in whose territory the relevant apartment building and (or) other immovable property is being constructed (created), an official of a state authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise state construction supervision, an official of a federal executive body, executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or local self-government body authorised to issue construction permits under the Town Planning Code of the Russian Federation, an official of the federal executive body responsible for state cadastral registration, state registration of rights, maintenance of the Unified State Register of Immovable Property and provision of information contained in that Register, or of its territorial body, an official of the federal executive body responsible for developing state policy and legal regulation in the field of official statistical accounting, a developer, the public-law company "Fund for the Protection of the Rights of Citizens Participating in Shared Construction", or another person required by federal laws to post information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System, or their officials, or violation of the procedure, methods, deadlines and (or) frequency of posting information established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or posting incomplete or knowingly distorted information, —
koap-u983f6c53060776e2c1-1.locator: Article 13.19.3. Violation of the procedure for posting information in the Unified Housing Construction Information System

koap-u22cec5e52afb626800-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u0c2c07464bb7e0d55c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products
koap-u0c2c07464bb7e0d55c-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-u0e7cdb63edae65bc7b-1.text: 1. Production or distribution of products of an unregistered mass-media outlet, or products of a mass-media outlet whose registration record has not been amended to reflect a change of founder, changes in the composition of co-founders, name (title), language (languages), general subject matter and (or) specialisation of the mass-media outlet, territory of distribution of its products, domain name of its website in the Internet information and telecommunications network (for an online publication), or the form and (or) type of periodic dissemination of mass information, or distribution of products of a foreign periodical printed publication without permission for their distribution in the territory of the Russian Federation, or production or distribution of such products after a decision, made in accordance with the prescribed procedure, to terminate or suspend publication of the mass-media outlet, —
koap-u0e7cdb63edae65bc7b-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-ud74e7823dfeecea2c4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-ud74e7823dfeecea2c4-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-u5f31934af5336ae967-1.text: 2. Violation of the prescribed procedure for distributing among children mass-media products containing information harmful to their health and (or) development, except in the cases provided for in Part 2.1 of this Article and Part 3 of Article 13.15 of this Code, —
koap-u5f31934af5336ae967-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-u4cd80ceb551dd1cbf7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, twenty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u4cd80ceb551dd1cbf7-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-u38147980978c936042-1.text: 2.1. Publication in mass media of television and (or) radio programme schedules, lists and (or) catalogues of information products without an information-product classification mark or with a classification mark that does not correspond to the category of the information product —
koap-u38147980978c936042-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-uf252b1a8965ccd75f1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, three thousand to seven thousand roubles; on legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uf252b1a8965ccd75f1-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-uf1b2d7563113967950-1.text: 3. Production or distribution of mass-media products containing obscene language, except in the cases provided for in Part 2 of this Article, —
koap-uf1b2d7563113967950-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-u4cd80ceb551dd1cbf7-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, twenty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u4cd80ceb551dd1cbf7-2.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-ude5852882e1d5151af-1.text: Note. Where, under a civil-law contract between the producer or distributor of mass-media products and the person who supplied a television and (or) radio programme schedule, list and (or) catalogue of information products for publication, the obligation to provide the information-product classification mark is assigned to that person, administrative liability for the administrative offences provided for in Part 2.1 of this Article shall be borne by the person who supplied the television and (or) radio programme schedule, list and (or) catalogue of information products for publication without the classification mark or with a classification mark that does not correspond to the category of the information product.
koap-ude5852882e1d5151af-1.locator: Article 13.21. Violation of the procedure for producing or distributing mass-media products

koap-ud53e163f983e4d05c7-1.text: 1. Failure by a joint-stock company, a professional securities-market participant, a management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or a specialised depositary of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, to fulfil the obligation to retain documents provided for by legislation on joint-stock companies, the securities market and investment funds and regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant thereto, where retention of those documents is mandatory, or violation of the prescribed procedure and time limits for retaining such documents, —
koap-ud53e163f983e4d05c7-1.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u4318236d8cbaa5455e-1.text: 2. koap-u4318236d8cbaa5455e-1.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u0a001e42e36deeb5f2-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ue0ff386c90df0b6f6f-1.text: 3. koap-ue0ff386c90df0b6f6f-1.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u9bdc0572551054dbda-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9bdc0572551054dbda-1.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u37c22db3c2ad7f7903-1.text: 4. Failure by a credit cooperative to fulfil the obligation to retain documents whose retention is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation on credit cooperation and legislation on agricultural cooperation, or violation of the prescribed procedure and (or) time limits for retaining such documents, —
koap-u37c22db3c2ad7f7903-1.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u8eded0dd72c4a52714-3.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8eded0dd72c4a52714-3.locator: Article 13.25. Violation of legislative requirements for the storage of documents and information contained in information systems

koap-u76903bbc31fab0cfe9-1.text: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services
koap-u76903bbc31fab0cfe9-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u8bc574fe877e14ccf0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services
koap-u8bc574fe877e14ccf0-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-uc0f9e351dbe9336178-1.text: 1. Conclusion by a communications operator or a person acting on its behalf of a contract for communications services via the Internet information and telecommunications network by a method not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications —
koap-uc0f9e351dbe9336178-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u8417f798a178d4992f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8417f798a178d4992f-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u758c2e87495a6542c0-1.text: 2. Provision by a communications operator of mobile radiotelephone services to a user of the communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, where the federal state information system "Unified System of Identification and Authentication within the Infrastructure Ensuring Information and Technological Interaction of Information Systems Used to Provide State and Municipal Services in Electronic Form" (hereinafter, the unified identification and authentication system) lacks information whose entry in that system is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications, or where the operator has identified that such information is unreliable in relation to the information sent by that subscriber to the communications operator in accordance with the rules for providing communications services (where the corresponding obligation exists), —
koap-u758c2e87495a6542c0-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u8865276674e8ee6c59-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million to two million roubles.
koap-u8865276674e8ee6c59-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-ua7c5a6b5d6931f49d1-1.text: 3. Provision by a communications operator of mobile radiotelephone services to a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur for the purpose of ensuring the functioning of user equipment (terminal equipment) using an identification module, where the unified identification and authentication system lacks information enabling identification of the subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur or of their user equipment (terminal equipment), and entry of that information in the unified identification and authentication system is mandatory for that subscriber under the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications, —
koap-ua7c5a6b5d6931f49d1-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u8865276674e8ee6c59-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million to two million roubles.
koap-u8865276674e8ee6c59-2.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-ubb14cbce82009f53a7-1.text: 4. Conclusion on behalf of a communications operator of a contract for mobile radiotelephone services by a person not authorised by the operator to conclude such a contract, or failure by a communications operator or a person acting on its behalf to comply with requirements to include in such a contract the subscriber information prescribed by the rules for providing communications services or the requirement to include in such a contract information about the identifier of the user equipment (terminal equipment) in which the identification module will be used, where that requirement is provided for by Federal Law of 7 July 2003 No. 126-FZ "On Communications", or inclusion by a communications operator or a person acting on its behalf of unreliable information in such a contract, or failure or delay by a person acting on behalf of a communications operator in providing the operator with a copy of the contract concluded with the subscriber, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-ubb14cbce82009f53a7-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u8417f798a178d4992f-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8417f798a178d4992f-2.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-uaa9b17a30e3b12f8db-1.text: 5. Failure by a communications operator to verify the reliability of information about a subscriber or about users of communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, information about the number of subscriber numbers allocated or provided for use to the subscriber by the communications operator, or information about a prohibition imposed by the subscriber on concluding contracts for mobile radiotelephone services, or failure by a communications operator to comply with the prescribed procedure and (or) methods for such verification, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-uaa9b17a30e3b12f8db-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-2.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u02e982f5b4f2dd94eb-1.text: 6. Provision by a communications operator of communications services to a subscriber or to a user of communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, where the reliability of information about the subscriber or about the user of communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur has not been confirmed, or where the number of subscriber numbers allocated or provided for use to the subscriber exceeds the number established by Federal Law of 7 July 2003 No. 126-FZ "On Communications", or where the subscriber has imposed a prohibition on concluding contracts for mobile radiotelephone services, or where an identification module is used in user equipment (terminal equipment) whose identifier information is not included in the contract for communications services, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-u02e982f5b4f2dd94eb-1.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-3.locator: Article 13.29. Violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications when concluding contracts for communications services and providing communications services

koap-ua2ef284c24b20ac818-1.text: 1. Unlawful transfer to another person, by a subscriber who is a natural person or by a user of communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, of a subscriber number allocated to that subscriber or user under a contract for mobile radiotelephone services or provided for use within that contract, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —

koap-u4c8f99c6bf7d3c4d49-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u4c8f99c6bf7d3c4d49-1.locator: Article 13.29.1. Transfer of a subscriber number or provision of the ability to use mobile radiotelephone services in violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications

koap-uda8ad1ce71d6ede540-1.text: 2. Unlawful provision, by a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur having concluded a contract for mobile radiotelephone services, of the ability to use mobile radiotelephone services under that contract to persons not working under an employment contract or a contract for consideration governed by civil law concluded with that legal entity or individual entrepreneur, or failure by that legal entity or individual entrepreneur to fulfil the obligation to provide the communications operator with information about users of communications services in accordance with the rules for providing communications services, where these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-uda8ad1ce71d6ede540-1.locator: Article 13.29.1. Transfer of a subscriber number or provision of the ability to use mobile radiotelephone services in violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications

koap-ue4978a59e73f9d147c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue4978a59e73f9d147c-1.locator: Article 13.29.1. Transfer of a subscriber number or provision of the ability to use mobile radiotelephone services in violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications

koap-ufff548bde2829f4270-1.text: Note. A gratuitous, short-term transfer by a subscriber who is a natural person or by a user of communications services of a subscriber that is a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of a subscriber number allocated to that subscriber or user under a contract for mobile radiotelephone services or provided for use within that contract to another person for that person's receipt of communications services for personal purposes shall not constitute an administrative offence.
koap-ufff548bde2829f4270-1.locator: Article 13.29.1. Transfer of a subscriber number or provision of the ability to use mobile radiotelephone services in violation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on communications

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-4.locator: Article 13.29.4. Violation of legislative requirements for submitting information to the state information system monitoring communications operators' fulfilment of obligations when providing communications services

koap-u59dd6dfa20e6558b88-1.text: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations
koap-u59dd6dfa20e6558b88-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u6344ea2ba9be43d1a3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations
koap-u6344ea2ba9be43d1a3-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u31047401989eb4e0ff-1.text: 1. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil the obligation to notify the authorised federal executive body of the commencement of activities to ensure the functioning of information systems and (or) computer programs intended and (or) used for receiving, transmitting, delivering and (or) processing electronic messages of Internet users —
koap-u31047401989eb4e0ff-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u9a0683f8f5f4b2ed01-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9a0683f8f5f4b2ed01-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-4.text: 1.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-4.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u0db5fb684511c5254d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u0db5fb684511c5254d-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u3bc86ee7617bd3055d-1.text: 2. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil the obligation established by federal law to store and (or) provide to authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation information about the facts of receipt, transmission, delivery and (or) processing of voice information, written text, images, sounds or other electronic messages of Internet users, and information about such users, —
koap-u3bc86ee7617bd3055d-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-udafaea379e690414e0-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-udafaea379e690414e0-3.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-ufce1892e242bef6c4a-1.text: 2.1. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil the obligation to provide the federal executive body responsible for ensuring security with information necessary to decode electronic messages received, transmitted, delivered and (or) processed —
koap-ufce1892e242bef6c4a-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-udafaea379e690414e0-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-udafaea379e690414e0-4.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-uba8e8b3a47775a2e9e-1.text: 2.2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2 or 2.1 of this Article —
koap-uba8e8b3a47775a2e9e-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-ued9ef8709373c3b137-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two million to six million roubles.
koap-ued9ef8709373c3b137-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u73b45d17f66961e1d9-1.text: 2.3. Violation by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet of the rules for interaction with authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation when developing an action plan for introducing equipment and software and technical facilities, or failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil the obligation to take measures to prevent disclosure of organisational and tactical techniques for conducting measures for operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u73b45d17f66961e1d9-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to five million roubles.
koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-ubbeb6460b8da978a2f-1.text: 3. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for equipment and software and technical facilities used by that organiser in the information systems it operates, for authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct measures for those types of activities in cases established by federal laws, —
koap-ubbeb6460b8da978a2f-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one thousandth to three thousandths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million roubles.
koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u532097ccab1fe280d8-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2.3 or 3 of this Article —
koap-u532097ccab1fe280d8-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundredth to three hundredths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than ten million roubles.
koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-ub920c0e7d2f5e5ecc6-1.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 02.12.2019 No. 405-FZ.
koap-ub920c0e7d2f5e5ecc6-1.locator: Article 13.31. Failure by an organiser of information dissemination on the Internet to fulfil obligations

koap-uaf839a049c365f0cb7-1.text: Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations
koap-uaf839a049c365f0cb7-1.locator: Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations

koap-u188f079570817dc108-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations
koap-u188f079570817dc108-1.locator: Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations

koap-ub937f99d8bfd6a9b27-1.text: Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil the obligation established by federal law to retain for six months the news information it has disseminated, information about the source from which it was obtained and information about the periods of its dissemination, and (or) the obligation to ensure that the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications has access to that information through the system for interaction between that executive body and the owner of the news aggregator —
koap-ub937f99d8bfd6a9b27-1.locator: Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations

koap-ub65b62a54917cc46c2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub65b62a54917cc46c2-1.locator: Article 13.32. Failure by the owner of a news aggregator to fulfil obligations

koap-ub4c66f07ff279b144b-1.text: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures
koap-ub4c66f07ff279b144b-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u8678f192b368ec537c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures
koap-u8678f192b368ec537c-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u77a520e35e60304817-1.text: 1. Violation by an accredited certification authority of the procedure for issuing a qualified certificate of an electronic-signature verification key (hereinafter, a qualified certificate) —
koap-u77a520e35e60304817-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-ueb86683c2555923d00-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-ueb86683c2555923d00-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u563598b6b386cc5f32-1.text: 2. Issuance by an accredited certification authority of a qualified certificate containing knowingly unreliable information about its holder —
koap-u563598b6b386cc5f32-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-ue9be5471608427ae9f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of two hundred thousand to two hundred fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ue9be5471608427ae9f-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u0084f7afbeed1972b1-1.text: 3. Failure by an accredited certification authority to ensure free access, using information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, to its register of qualified certificates at any time during its period of operation, unless otherwise established by federal laws or regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant thereto, —
koap-u0084f7afbeed1972b1-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u0fa5a4a7bbce5af5ba-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u0fa5a4a7bbce5af5ba-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u4037a25a50d7535ffe-1.text: 4. Commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 3 of this Article resulting in failure to provide a state service or provision of a state service in violation of the prescribed time limits —
koap-u4037a25a50d7535ffe-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u409f9d62294e26a6cd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u409f9d62294e26a6cd-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u5eca0304ad1cb2d1d4-1.text: 5. Violation by an accredited certification authority of the procedure for forming and maintaining registers of qualified certificates, including violation of the time limits for entering information on termination of the validity or annulment of a qualified certificate in the register, or of the procedure for providing information from such a register, —
koap-u5eca0304ad1cb2d1d4-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u61810837c480c15b11-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u61810837c480c15b11-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u469423cbb61b4329e9-1.text: 6. Violation by an accredited certification authority of the confidentiality of electronic-signature keys created by it, or of requirements to protect information contained in the register of qualified certificates from unlawful access, destruction, modification, blocking or other unlawful actions, —
koap-u469423cbb61b4329e9-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u2dd584ef2c1b07a711-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u2dd584ef2c1b07a711-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-uf87839e0f727276319-1.text: 7. Violation by an accredited certification authority of requirements for the content of a qualified certificate —
koap-uf87839e0f727276319-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u9edf25dc7535f81b1c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of fifty thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9edf25dc7535f81b1c-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-uef76779765855ecca8-1.text: 8. Failure by the head of an accredited certification authority to fulfil the obligation to transfer, in the prescribed manner, information subject to storage at that authority to the federal executive body authorised in the field of electronic-signature use for safekeeping, where a decision has been made to terminate the activities of that accredited certification authority, —
koap-uef76779765855ecca8-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u8e319909cbcbbdb71c-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8e319909cbcbbdb71c-5.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u52560b47e424eeb10f-1.text: 9. Commission of the administrative offences provided for in Parts 1 - 7 of this Article by a legal entity previously subjected to administrative punishment for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u52560b47e424eeb10f-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-uee94fd433d2ec69df4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twice the amount of the administrative fine previously imposed.
koap-uee94fd433d2ec69df4-1.locator: Article 13.33. Violation of obligations provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on electronic signatures

koap-u9ea3d995a721c4ca9d-1.text: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system
koap-u9ea3d995a721c4ca9d-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u0a6ca65a22472d4d5a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system
koap-u0a6ca65a22472d4d5a-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u64567ebcd7a526d6b6-1.text: 1. Breach of the confidentiality of a simple electronic-signature key, when using the unified identification and authentication system, by a body or organisation entitled to create (replace) and issue such a key (hereinafter, a key-issuing operator) —
koap-u64567ebcd7a526d6b6-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ufe9cc2df00f4d65219-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of seven thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufe9cc2df00f4d65219-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ufea4d9f52debfdc2c7-1.text: 2. Failure by a key-issuing operator to comply with the requirement to establish the applicant's identity when issuing a simple electronic-signature key, or issuance of such a key without receiving an application for its issuance from the applicant, —
koap-ufea4d9f52debfdc2c7-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ufe9cc2df00f4d65219-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of seven thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufe9cc2df00f4d65219-2.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u22e75166b2b3d41749-1.text: 3. Entry by a key-issuing operator in the unified identification and authentication system of data that do not correspond to the citizen's application —
koap-u22e75166b2b3d41749-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u1020444b38da1329d5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1020444b38da1329d5-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ua393370ca8d1848634-1.text: 4. Charging by a key-issuing operator of a fee for creation (replacement) and (or) issuance of a simple electronic-signature key —
koap-ua393370ca8d1848634-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ua73a47d1ce343c25b1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua73a47d1ce343c25b1-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u7ee3b816c70840e29a-1.text: 5. Creation (replacement) and (or) issuance of a key by a person of the key-issuing operator who is not authorised to do so, or a demand by a key-issuing operator, when creating (replacing) and (or) issuing a simple electronic-signature key, for information about the applicant that is not mandatory for creation (replacement) and (or) issuance of such a key, —
koap-u7ee3b816c70840e29a-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u84dc8db6f63b4d52c4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u84dc8db6f63b4d52c4-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u12a8d92a7ae88c81b8-1.text: 6. Violation by an official of a federal executive body, state extra-budgetary fund, executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body, state or municipal institution, multifunctional centre for provision of state and municipal services, or another organisation (hereinafter, participants in information interaction), in cases provided for by federal laws, acts of the President of the Russian Federation and acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, of the rules for ensuring users' access to information posted in the relevant state or municipal information system using the unified identification and authentication system —
koap-u12a8d92a7ae88c81b8-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u4d51d7f7d2d9159f7b-1.text: 7. Actions by an official of participants in information interaction aimed at disrupting the functioning of the unified identification and authentication system or information systems connected to it —
koap-u4d51d7f7d2d9159f7b-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-2.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-u3885d32899a4e0f07e-1.text: 8. Commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 6 or 7 of this Article by an official previously subjected to administrative punishment for an analogous administrative offence —
koap-u3885d32899a4e0f07e-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system

koap-ud506c2339748aa74c3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud506c2339748aa74c3-1.locator: Article 13.33.1. Violation of the prescribed rules for creation (replacement) and issuance of a simple electronic-signature key and rules for use of the unified identification and authentication system
