koap-udc1007170553ad28db-1.text: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations
koap-udc1007170553ad28db-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-ub0a7731188ef914fee-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations
koap-ub0a7731188ef914fee-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-uc741d63e55e8b01ad3-1.text: 1. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil the obligation to connect to the federal state information system of information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted in the territory of the Russian Federation under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection —
koap-uc741d63e55e8b01ad3-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u9cc926e4afae7b487a-1.text: 2. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil the obligation to cease, in the territory of the Russian Federation, returning in response to queries by users of that search engine information about information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted in the territory of the Russian Federation under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection —
koap-u9cc926e4afae7b487a-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-2.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u7617d6c5c277e19948-1.text: 2.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 or 2 of this Article —
koap-u7617d6c5c277e19948-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million five hundred thousand to five million roubles.
koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u7a360423ea7739d022-1.text: 3. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil the obligation to cease, in the territory of the Russian Federation, returning in response to queries by users of that search engine information about the domain name and page addresses of Internet websites to which access is restricted on the basis of the relevant decision of the Moscow City Court, or of copies of blocked websites, —
koap-u7a360423ea7739d022-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u45374ce5f6282de731-3.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-5.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 3 of this Article —
koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-5.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u250933e2edeca801b3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million five hundred thousand to three million roubles.
koap-u250933e2edeca801b3-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-uafdefd672d3d2dc562-1.text: 5. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil the obligation to inform users of that search engine, when returning in response to their queries information about an information resource of a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person operating in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, in respect of whom the body exercising control and supervision in the fields of communications, information technologies and mass communications has decided to apply the corresponding coercive measure, of that foreign person's violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-uafdefd672d3d2dc562-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million five hundred thousand to five million roubles.
koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-2.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-u8796de000b00e16856-1.text: 6. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil the obligation to cease, in the territory of the Russian Federation, returning in response to queries by users of that search engine information about an information resource of a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person operating in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, in respect of whom the body exercising control and supervision in the fields of communications, information technologies and mass communications has decided to apply the corresponding coercive measure, —
koap-u8796de000b00e16856-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million five hundred thousand to five million roubles.
koap-udb48cb874782b72e17-3.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-ufc009098b649e630bb-1.text: 7. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 5 or 6 of this Article —
koap-ufc009098b649e630bb-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-ud5b9c562f254ec156f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on officials, three hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to ten million roubles.
koap-ud5b9c562f254ec156f-1.locator: Article 13.40. Failure by a search engine operator to fulfil obligations

koap-ud46855bbe6a5fac19e-1.text: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations
koap-ud46855bbe6a5fac19e-1.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-u2f7e094a68559d6227-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations
koap-u2f7e094a68559d6227-1.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-ubb16f9bfb2865c619c-1.text: 1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations to install the computer program intended for audience measurement and used by the authorised audience-measurement organisation, and (or) to provide that organisation with data necessary and sufficient to conduct the measurement, or failure by the owner of that information resource to comply with the procedure for providing the authorised audience-measurement organisation with data for such measurement, —
koap-ubb16f9bfb2865c619c-1.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-udd6f7c756675f1b1ec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-udd6f7c756675f1b1ec-1.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-20.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-20.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-uf8fcab4ec7975c621b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uf8fcab4ec7975c621b-1.locator: Article 13.40.1. Failure by the owner of an information resource whose audience size is subject to measurement to fulfil obligations

koap-u4424c9cf69dc320fe7-1.text: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information
koap-u4424c9cf69dc320fe7-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-uab3b3a6ee0fce04a3d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information
koap-uab3b3a6ee0fce04a3d-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-ub4a5e99be6c63a40d2-1.text: 1. Failure by a hosting provider or another person ensuring the hosting of an information resource in information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, to take measures to restrict access to information, an information resource or an Internet website where the obligation to take such measures is provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, except in the cases provided for in Part 3 of this Article, —
koap-ub4a5e99be6c63a40d2-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to four million roubles.
koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u60e915e1774bc39746-1.text: 2. Failure by the owner of a website or an information resource in the Internet information and telecommunications network to remove information or an Internet page where the obligation to remove such information or page is provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, except in the cases provided for in Part 4 of this Article, —
koap-u60e915e1774bc39746-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to four million roubles.
koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-2.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u8e185d217f5efa0568-1.text: 3. Failure by a hosting provider or another person ensuring the hosting of an information resource in information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, to take measures to restrict access to an information resource or Internet website hosting information containing calls for extremist activity, materials with pornographic images of minors and (or) advertisements recruiting minors as performers for participation in pornographic entertainment events, information about ways and methods of developing, producing and using narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, places where they may be acquired, or methods and places for cultivation of narcotic-containing plants, where the obligation to take such measures is provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, —
koap-u8e185d217f5efa0568-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u9c8df03e93e0c75b3d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on officials, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to eight million roubles.
koap-u9c8df03e93e0c75b3d-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-ue56f0b657a9c4b2948-1.text: 4. Failure by the owner of a website or an information resource in the Internet information and telecommunications network to remove information or an Internet page containing calls for extremist activity, materials with pornographic images of minors and (or) advertisements recruiting minors as performers for participation in pornographic entertainment events, information about ways and methods of developing, producing and using narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, places where they may be acquired, or methods and places for cultivation of narcotic-containing plants, where the obligation to remove such information or page is provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, —
koap-ue56f0b657a9c4b2948-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u9c8df03e93e0c75b3d-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on officials, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to eight million roubles.
koap-u9c8df03e93e0c75b3d-2.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u106a14b73df9446026-1.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 or 2 of this Article —
koap-u106a14b73df9446026-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-uf4bd2a046cc5b3016f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on officials, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one twentieth to one tenth of the aggregate amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of the detected administrative offence if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than four million roubles.
koap-uf4bd2a046cc5b3016f-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-ue356fc020f4c7401ed-1.text: 6. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 3 or 4 of this Article —
koap-ue356fc020f4c7401ed-1.locator: Article 13.41. Violation of the procedure for restricting access to information or information resources to which access must be restricted under the legislation of the Russian Federation on information, information technologies and information protection, and (or) of the procedure for removing such information

koap-u5920c9ee044cbd9298-2.locator: Article 13.44. koap-u0f39295377674a92ca-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-ua46074b98387038f79-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-u0f54b974e4e009f7cf-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-u4a767a8eff8f09dc53-1.text: 2. koap-u4a767a8eff8f09dc53-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-u2553c2aae8c5b7d82b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, three thousand to five thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, sixty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2553c2aae8c5b7d82b-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-u6bfc2e541bcba41e8e-1.text: 3. Violation by persons participating in centralised management of the public communications network of the prescribed rules for routing telecommunications messages —

koap-u0057595e2e5e60338a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, two thousand to eight thousand roubles; on individual entrepreneurs, five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to sixty thousand roubles.
koap-u0057595e2e5e60338a-1.locator: Article 13.45. Violation of legislative requirements on centralised management of the public communications network

koap-u7116d63df6813a5f74-1.text: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation
koap-uf7a7006a16170c90aa-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u8c3e04683af69a7908-1.text: 1. Failure by the owner or other holder of a technological communications network having a unique identifier for the aggregate of communications facilities and other technical means in the Internet information and telecommunications network to fulfil the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for communications networks and facilities used by authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures for those types of activities —
koap-u8c3e04683af69a7908-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one thousandth to three thousandths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million roubles.
koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-2.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u09386ae42de23d0cd3-1.text: 1.1. Violation by the owner or other holder of a technological communications network having a unique identifier for the aggregate of communications facilities and other technical means in the Internet information and telecommunications network of the rules for interaction with authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation when developing an action plan for introducing technical means, or failure by that owner or holder to fulfil the obligation to take measures to prevent disclosure of organisational and tactical techniques for conducting measures for operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u09386ae42de23d0cd3-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to five million roubles.
koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-2.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ufe4117b5af138a0b9c-2.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 or 1.1 of this Article —
koap-ufe4117b5af138a0b9c-2.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundredth to three hundredths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than ten million roubles.
koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-2.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u76ac0ddb1f1298f7d2-1.text: 2.1. Violation, by a communications operator holding a licence to provide communications services whose requirements establish the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for communications networks and facilities used by authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures to perform the tasks assigned to those bodies, of the rules for interaction with those bodies when developing an action plan for introducing technical means, or failure by a communications operator to fulfil the obligation to take measures to prevent disclosure of organisational and tactical techniques for conducting measures for operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u76ac0ddb1f1298f7d2-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ubbb61c9eec3cd4e589-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of three million to five million roubles.
koap-ubbb61c9eec3cd4e589-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ub1f11b18a4d18f35b0-1.text: 3. Failure by a communications operator to fulfil the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for communications networks and facilities used by authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures to perform the tasks assigned to those bodies —
koap-ub1f11b18a4d18f35b0-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ufcc09e7f153ed304e7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of one thousandth to three thousandths of the amount of revenue from sales of the good (work, service) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of that good (work, service) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million roubles.
koap-ufcc09e7f153ed304e7-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ua1a631e9b8c3906c01-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2.1 or 3 of this Article —
koap-ua1a631e9b8c3906c01-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u1489c18612e25bae07-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on legal entities of one hundredth to three hundredths of the amount of revenue from sales of the good (work, service) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of that good (work, service) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than ten million roubles.
koap-u1489c18612e25bae07-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-24.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u18ee15384790b48c34-1.text: 1. In this Article, failure by a communications operator to fulfil the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for communications networks and facilities used by authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures to perform the tasks assigned to those bodies means the provision by a communications operator of a communications service in the territory of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation under a licence whose licensing requirements establish that obligation and which specifies the relevant territory for provision of the communications service, in the absence of the following, provided for by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant thereto: a commissioning certificate for technical means issued by the authorised federal executive body (bodies), permitting commissioning of technical means for such measures, or confirmation that the communications operator has fulfilled the action plan for introducing technical means for operational-search measures approved in agreement with the territorial body of the Federal Security Service.
koap-u18ee15384790b48c34-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-u2d3752164f0d7edb12-1.text: 2. For the purposes of applying Parts 3 and 4 of this Article, revenue from sales of the good (work, service) shall be determined on the basis of the amount of income from providing communications services under licences whose requirements establish the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for communications networks and facilities used by authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures to perform the tasks assigned to those bodies.
koap-u2d3752164f0d7edb12-1.locator: Article 13.46. Failure to fulfil the obligation to implement requirements for communications networks and facilities used for measures conducted by authorised state bodies carrying out operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation

koap-ue18dcc46eaee3a113a-1.text: Failure by a Russian communications operator using a foreign satellite system to fulfil obligations to form a Russian segment of that system comprising a gateway station interfacing with the public communications network, to ensure control of that segment from the territory of the Russian Federation, and (or) to route traffic generated by subscriber stations (terminals) in the territory of the Russian Federation through a gateway station of the Russian communications operator located in the territory of the Russian Federation —

koap-uebc36118b9cb332011-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.

koap-uec1a64498dec528400-1.text: Article 13.48. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on publicly equating the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries during the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe
koap-uec1a64498dec528400-1.locator: Article 13.48. koap-u0cbd0eedee835dcf65-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.48. koap-u0cbd0eedee835dcf65-1.locator: Article 13.48. koap-ua31a6dd1190c2d01f3-1.text: 1. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on equating, in a public speech, a publicly displayed work, mass media or information posted using information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries established by the judgment of the International Military Tribunal for the trial and punishment of the major war criminals of the European Axis countries (the Nuremberg Tribunal), or by judgments of national, military or occupation tribunals based on the judgment of the International Military Tribunal for the trial and punishment of the major war criminals of the European Axis countries (the Nuremberg Tribunal) or delivered during the Great Patriotic War or the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe —
koap-ua31a6dd1190c2d01f3-1.locator: Article 13.48. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on publicly equating the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries during the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe

koap-u5aa30098e99099bd1b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; on officials, two thousand to four thousand roubles; on legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u5aa30098e99099bd1b-1.locator: Article 13.48. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on publicly equating the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries during the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-22.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-22.locator: Article 13.48. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on publicly equating the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries during the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe

koap-u0d82d65cfa46129c07-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; on officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u0d82d65cfa46129c07-1.locator: Article 13.48. Violation of the prohibition established by federal law on publicly equating the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership, command and service personnel of the USSR with the aims, decisions and actions of the leadership of Nazi Germany and the command and service personnel of Nazi Germany and the European Axis countries during the Second World War, and on denying the decisive role of the Soviet people in defeating Nazi Germany and the humanitarian mission of the USSR in liberating the countries of Europe

koap-uc1d3bd53c6264b18df-1.text: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-uc1d3bd53c6264b18df-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ub20f4aab5712723389-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-ub20f4aab5712723389-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u07114e3f68765cd958-1.text: 1. Conduct of activities in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person without installing a computer program intended to determine the number of users of an information resource in the Internet information and telecommunications network —
koap-u07114e3f68765cd958-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ue35212cb69ab1bf7cb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-ue35212cb69ab1bf7cb-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u2fc1f37f5423e35e9a-1.text: 2. Conduct of activities in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person without placing on that foreign person's information resource an electronic form for submitting applications from Russian citizens and organisations, without registering a personal account on the official website of the body exercising control and supervision in the fields of communications, information technologies and mass communications, or without creating a branch, opening a representative office or establishing a Russian legal entity and without ensuring their functioning in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with requirements provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u2fc1f37f5423e35e9a-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-uf38931a63aebf77c50-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on officials, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one fifteenth to one tenth of the aggregate amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of the detected administrative offence if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than six million roubles.
koap-uf38931a63aebf77c50-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-8.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-8.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ua7f678a5b073e1342a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on officials, five hundred thousand to one million roubles; on legal entities, one tenth to one fifth of the aggregate amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of the detected administrative offence if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than ten million roubles.
koap-ua7f678a5b073e1342a-1.locator: Article 13.49. Failure to fulfil obligations provided for by legislation on the activities of foreign persons in the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-uedb826a84818c15c72-1.text: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations
koap-uedb826a84818c15c72-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-u95fcb1fb1a00af6945-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations
koap-u95fcb1fb1a00af6945-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-ubbf72bcb1ecac2fe7e-1.text: 1. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil the obligation to publish annually a report on the results of considering submissions made using the electronic form for reporting information disseminated in violation of the law and on the results of monitoring the social network, and (or) to post in the social network a document establishing its rules of use, and (or) failure to fulfil the obligation to inform social-network users of amendments to those rules, and (or) to post in the social network an electronic form for reporting information disseminated in violation of the law in accordance with requirements established by the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications, and (or) the obligation to post in the social network the owner's surname and initials (for a natural person) or name (for a legal entity) and (or) email address, where the obligation to post such information is provided for by Federal Law of 27 July 2006 No. 149-FZ "On Information, Information Technologies and Information Protection", or posting by the social-network owner of incomplete or unreliable particulars, —
koap-ubbf72bcb1ecac2fe7e-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-u6644a2ca40f61c388c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u6644a2ca40f61c388c-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-ue5bebaa1797baef22f-1.text: 2. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil the obligation to monitor the social network and (or) to take measures to restrict access to information specified in Clause 5 of Part 1 of Article 10.6 of Federal Law of 27 July 2006 No. 149-FZ "On Information, Information Technologies and Information Protection", or failure by the owner of a social network to comply with a requirement of the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications to revoke measures restricting access to a user's information taken by the owner of the social network, —
koap-ue5bebaa1797baef22f-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to four million roubles.
koap-u2de81fc8a3b3104881-3.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-9.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-9.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations

koap-ud8d8e6837a95bff662-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on officials, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four million to eight million roubles.
koap-ud8d8e6837a95bff662-1.locator: Article 13.50. Failure by the owner of a social network to fulfil obligations
