koap-u04765d8da0f85a74a3-1.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-u82918f8396e0cf6c89-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare
koap-u82918f8396e0cf6c89-1.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-u93c99cf90b96af1e66-1.text: 1. Violation by an official of an authorised executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the procedure and time limits for submitting to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare information provided for in Clauses 2 and 3 of Part 3 of Article 91.1 of Federal Law of 21 November 2011 No. 323-FZ "On the Fundamentals of Protection of Citizens' Health in the Russian Federation" (including as regards the completeness, reliability and currency of the information entered) —
koap-u93c99cf90b96af1e66-1.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-u734784989b89bcb0ba-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles.
koap-u734784989b89bcb0ba-1.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-23.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-23.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-ud2136c5278d71cbd12-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year.
koap-ud2136c5278d71cbd12-1.locator: Article 13.51. Violation of the procedure for submitting information to the Unified State Information System in Healthcare

koap-ub108d7e64ac9555a0f-1.text: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted
koap-ub108d7e64ac9555a0f-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-ua8986385bca2a0d0b8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted
koap-ua8986385bca2a0d0b8-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-ucd15013394593f2cb6-1.text: 1. Failure by the holder of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted to comply with the prescribed procedure for interaction with the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications —
koap-ucd15013394593f2cb6-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on officials, eighty thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-2.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-uf05566b405ee3f2a1e-1.text: 2. Failure by the holder of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted to comply with a requirement of the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications to connect to the federal state information system of information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted —
koap-uf05566b405ee3f2a1e-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on officials, eighty thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-3.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u64c25a508d4f5620ab-1.text: 3. Failure by the holder of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted to fulfil the obligation to ensure compliance with the prohibition on providing access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted in the territory of the Russian Federation —
koap-u64c25a508d4f5620ab-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on officials, eighty thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-4.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u52ecc1e0d015310939-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1, 2 or 3 of this Article —
koap-u52ecc1e0d015310939-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-uf97c2765142d2e9156-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uf97c2765142d2e9156-1.locator: Article 13.52. Violation of the procedure for use in the territory of the Russian Federation of software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-ud911101d150831f51e-1.text: Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted
koap-ud911101d150831f51e-1.locator: Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u2e7c712fa50b9ce334-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted
koap-u2e7c712fa50b9ce334-1.locator: Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-ue0af34112b974d7e89-1.text: Intentional searching in the Internet information and telecommunications network for materials known to be extremist that are included in the published federal list of extremist materials or specified in Clause 3 of Article 1 of Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 114-FZ "On Countering Extremist Activity", and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted, —
koap-ue0af34112b974d7e89-1.locator: Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-uf038dc32c8b6987a94-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uf038dc32c8b6987a94-1.locator: Article 13.53. Searching for materials known to be extremist and gaining access to them, including through software and hardware means of access to information resources and information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted

koap-u669117eb4f0ee2c5c6-1.text: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network
koap-u669117eb4f0ee2c5c6-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u1c65066f8866c8c25b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network
koap-u1c65066f8866c8c25b-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u1850dc2185ac39ef0a-1.text: 1. Provision of computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network by a hosting provider whose details are not included in the register of hosting providers —
koap-u1850dc2185ac39ef0a-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u5e6feb5c4dbd9f9068-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u5e6feb5c4dbd9f9068-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-ue8bb6486156fee594b-1.text: 2. Violation by a hosting provider of the rules for interaction with authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation when developing an action plan for introducing technical means, or failure by a hosting provider to fulfil the obligation to take measures to prevent disclosure of organisational and tactical techniques for conducting measures for operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, —
koap-ue8bb6486156fee594b-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three million to five million roubles.
koap-uec0af3f0450ad0ce62-3.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u36fe7a300e4d36d42f-1.text: 3. Failure by a hosting provider to fulfil the obligation to ensure implementation of requirements established in accordance with federal law for the computing capacity used by the hosting provider, for authorised state bodies conducting operational-search activities or ensuring the security of the Russian Federation to conduct, in cases established by federal laws, measures for those types of activities —
koap-u36fe7a300e4d36d42f-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one thousandth to three thousandths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than one million roubles.
koap-u6ee6b26e405899d44c-3.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u4e58b9bcdb0095f7bb-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 2 or 3 of this Article —
koap-u4e58b9bcdb0095f7bb-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, two hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundredth to three hundredths of the amount of revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than ten million roubles.
koap-u13653234cd74f096c1-3.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u4cd48e6aefba496841-1.text: 5. Use, by the operator of a state or municipal information system or an information system of state and municipal unitary enterprises or state and municipal institutions, in operating that system, of computing capacity supplied for hosting information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network by a hosting provider whose details are not included in the list of hosting providers approved by the Government of the Russian Federation —
koap-u4cd48e6aefba496841-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-u5af2b5aff1e75a57d3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u5af2b5aff1e75a57d3-1.locator: Article 13.54. Violation of legislative requirements when providing and using computing capacity to host information in an information system permanently connected to the Internet information and telecommunications network

koap-uedc92156bb576a749b-1.text: Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information
koap-uedc92156bb576a749b-1.locator: Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information

koap-u3f7b5afdf271edfec4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information
koap-u3f7b5afdf271edfec4-1.locator: Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information

koap-ucd08a85552984611cc-1.text: Failure by the owner of an Internet website and (or) a page of such a website, and (or) an information system, and (or) a computer program, operating on the Internet in the territory of the Russian Federation, where access to information placed on its website and (or) website page, and (or) in its information system, and (or) computer program is provided to Internet users who have undergone authorisation, to fulfil the obligation to carry out such authorisation for Internet users located in the territory of the Russian Federation by one of the methods provided for by Federal Law of 27 July 2006 No. 149-FZ "On Information, Information Technologies and Information Protection", where that Federal Law provides for such an obligation, —
koap-ucd08a85552984611cc-1.locator: Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information

koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-1.locator: Article 13.55. Failure to fulfil the obligation to authorise Internet users when providing access to information

koap-ue1836df9e6fbd8d233-1.text: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies
koap-ue1836df9e6fbd8d233-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ub12b004117d239f35f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies
koap-ub12b004117d239f35f-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-u07ff807b410eafc1a0-1.text: 1. Use, by the owner of an Internet website and (or) website page, and (or) information system, and (or) computer program that uses information technologies for providing information on the basis of collecting, systematising and analysing data relating to the preferences of Internet users located in the territory of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies), of information technologies for providing information on the basis of collecting, systematising and analysing data relating to the preferences of Internet users located in the territory of the Russian Federation (hereinafter, recommendation technologies) that violate the rights and legitimate interests of citizens and organisations, or use of recommendation technologies to provide information in violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u07ff807b410eafc1a0-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-2.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-u1331c68fa24df8b4b9-1.text: 2. Provision of information using recommendation technologies by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies without informing Internet users that recommendation technologies are used on that Internet website and (or) website page, and (or) in that information system, and (or) computer program —
koap-u1331c68fa24df8b4b9-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-3.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-uae50205ed3ec5d2b7b-1.text: 3. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to post on that information resource a document establishing rules for use of recommendation technologies and (or) an email address for sending legally significant communications to the owner and the owner's surname and initials (for a natural person) or name (for a legal entity) —
koap-uae50205ed3ec5d2b7b-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud56aea5fbfa62268a3-4.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-u52ecc1e0d015310939-2.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1, 2 or 3 of this Article —
koap-u52ecc1e0d015310939-2.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-uda2911e74ccab7a37f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on officials, sixty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million to one million four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uda2911e74ccab7a37f-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-u2efe3559d18d3565d1-1.text: 5. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with a requirement of the federal executive body exercising control and supervision in the fields of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications to cease providing information using recommendation technologies —
koap-u2efe3559d18d3565d1-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-uda2911e74ccab7a37f-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on officials, sixty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million to one million four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uda2911e74ccab7a37f-2.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ue03cf51a58b3ec9303-3.text: 6. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 5 of this Article —
koap-ue03cf51a58b3ec9303-3.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-uca0e4264a8ca57fe23-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of forty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred twenty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, one million four hundred thousand to two million eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uca0e4264a8ca57fe23-1.locator: Article 13.56. Failure by the owner of an information resource using recommendation technologies to comply with requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation for the use of recommendation technologies

koap-ubec3ceb5cc46eebc7a-1.text: Chapter 14. Administrative offences concerning entrepreneurial activity and the activities of self-regulatory organisations
koap-ubec3ceb5cc46eebc7a-1.locator: Chapter 14. Administrative offences concerning entrepreneurial activity and the activities of self-regulatory organisations

koap-u0f7309ac399e1d4c3b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. CHAPTER 14. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES CONCERNING ENTREPRENEURIAL ACTIVITY AND THE ACTIVITIES OF SELF-REGULATORY ORGANISATIONS
koap-u0f7309ac399e1d4c3b-1.locator: Chapter 14. Administrative offences concerning entrepreneurial activity and the activities of self-regulatory organisations

koap-ue396f063e91d496093-1.text: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)
koap-ue396f063e91d496093-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u15c9a9bba5f684cab0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)
koap-u15c9a9bba5f684cab0-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u6aa966ee89534743c5-1.text: 1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration as an individual entrepreneur or without state registration as a legal entity, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 14.17.1 of this Code, —
koap-u6aa966ee89534743c5-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ued2418b5d7bccf18a2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to two thousand roubles.
koap-ued2418b5d7bccf18a2-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ubf1c767ac3020abb92-1.text: 2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without a special permit (licence), where such a permit (licence) is mandatory, —
koap-ubf1c767ac3020abb92-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ua3cac0cba5f1600cb6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the products manufactured, means of production and raw materials; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products manufactured, means of production and raw materials; for legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products manufactured, means of production and raw materials.
koap-ua3cac0cba5f1600cb6-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u4e849895cb6bd0bc6e-1.text: 3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in violation of the requirements and conditions laid down in a special permit (licence), except in the cases provided for by Part 1.1 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code, —
koap-u4e849895cb6bd0bc6e-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ud7bf832410d351c7f7-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; for officials, three thousand to four thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-ud7bf832410d351c7f7-2.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u55cce869e0bc254245-1.text: 4. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in gross violation of the requirements and conditions laid down in a special permit (licence), except in the cases provided for by Part 1.1 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code, —
koap-u55cce869e0bc254245-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ueee03d33b2029a59f0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity of four thousand to eight thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-ueee03d33b2029a59f0-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u67f753e3c8552c49f0-1.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 08.06.2015 No. 140-FZ.
koap-u67f753e3c8552c49f0-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-25.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u466764cbd6a05a3cd1-1.text: 1. The concept of a gross violation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation for each specific licensed type of activity.
koap-u466764cbd6a05a3cd1-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u79ce61c523701dfad8-1.text: 2. A person shall be exempt from administrative liability upon discovery that they have committed acts (omissions) containing the elements of an administrative offence under this Article or Articles 15.1, 15.3, 15.4, 15.6, 15.11 or 15.25 of this Code, provided that the person is a declarant or a person whose information is contained in a special declaration filed in accordance with Federal Law of 8 June 2015 No. 140-FZ “On the Voluntary Declaration by Individuals of Assets and Accounts (Deposits) in Banks and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation”, and that those acts (omissions) relate to the acquisition (formation of sources of acquisition), use or disposal of property and/or controlled foreign companies and/or the performance of foreign-exchange transactions and/or the crediting of funds to accounts (deposits), information about which is contained in the special declaration.
koap-u79ce61c523701dfad8-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-u819794f965b2219bde-1.text: 3. Note 2 shall also apply to a person who is a declarant or whose information is contained in a special declaration filed during the third and/or fourth stages of declaration in accordance with Federal Law of 8 June 2015 No. 140-FZ “On the Voluntary Declaration by Individuals of Assets and Accounts (Deposits) in Banks and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation”.
koap-u819794f965b2219bde-1.locator: Article 14.1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity without state registration or without a special permit (licence)

koap-ub802789ed92c0b461b-1.text: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling
koap-ub802789ed92c0b461b-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-udaf6c52ca65c4ed9ef-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling
koap-udaf6c52ca65c4ed9ef-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u36d4ac411aef38e312-1.text: 1. Organising and/or conducting gambling using gambling equipment outside a gambling zone, or without a licence obtained in the prescribed manner for organising and conducting gambling in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators outside a gambling zone, or without a permit obtained in the prescribed manner for organising and conducting gambling in a gambling zone, or using information and telecommunications networks (including the Internet) or means of communication (including mobile communications), except where gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and/or totalisators accept interactive bets, —
koap-u36d4ac411aef38e312-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u809423bf1507b9735b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of eight hundred thousand to one million five hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the gambling equipment.
koap-u809423bf1507b9735b-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u59295f839bbbf93a73-1.text: 1.1. Providing premises for the unlawful organisation and/or conduct of gambling —
koap-u59295f839bbbf93a73-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u029e652fada26af3c3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of eight hundred thousand to one million five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u029e652fada26af3c3-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u3804c89c9bfc519971-1.text: 1.2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1.1 of this Article —
koap-u3804c89c9bfc519971-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u1213436c451b0d9284-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one million five hundred thousand to two million roubles.
koap-u1213436c451b0d9284-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-ubd61d890dac3984fbe-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-ubb103025c2d7657bf1-1.text: 3. Organising and conducting gambling in a gambling zone in violation of the conditions laid down in the permit for organising and conducting gambling in a gambling zone, or organising and conducting gambling in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators in violation of the conditions laid down in the licence, —
koap-ubb103025c2d7657bf1-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u4ee538a604cff99322-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4ee538a604cff99322-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-ufd0ab01a6b483cae2e-1.text: 4. Organising and conducting gambling in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators in gross violation of the conditions laid down in the licence —
koap-ufd0ab01a6b483cae2e-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u4bdb2ee1330a3c7c0c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of five hundred thousand to one million roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u4bdb2ee1330a3c7c0c-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-ud9557063975f40de9a-1.text: 5. The presence of persons under eighteen years of age in a gambling establishment, or their engagement by a gambling organiser to work in a gambling establishment, —
koap-ud9557063975f40de9a-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-5.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u17d608f123c18cbe75-1.text: 6. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of the requirements of Clauses 1, 2 and 5–7 of Part 14, and Clause 2 of Part 16 of Article 5.2 of Federal Law of 29 December 2006 No. 244-FZ “On State Regulation of Activities Involving the Organisation and Conduct of Gambling and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation” —
koap-u17d608f123c18cbe75-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-6.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u45c9fcf149b4d1f842-1.text: 7. Violation by gambling organisers in casinos and gaming-machine halls of the requirements of Clauses 4–7 of Part 14, and Parts 15, 24, 25 and 27 of Article 5.2 of Federal Law of 29 December 2006 No. 244-FZ “On State Regulation of Activities Involving the Organisation and Conduct of Gambling and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation” —
koap-u45c9fcf149b4d1f842-1.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-7.locator: Article 14.1.1. Unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling

koap-u020faf6068b4071e80-1.text: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling
koap-u020faf6068b4071e80-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u738a94183c56815eb8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling
koap-u738a94183c56815eb8-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u637dad12a9cc8c3114-1.text: 1. Acceptance by a gambling organiser in a bookmakers’ office and/or totalisator of bets or interactive bets, including on official sporting competitions, and payment of winnings by the gambling organiser without the gambling participant presenting an identity document or another method of identifying the participant being used as provided for by Federal Law of 7 August 2001 No. 115-FZ “On Counteracting the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism” and ensuring that the age of that gambling participant is established, —
koap-u637dad12a9cc8c3114-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-ub3cf977de03289127e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub3cf977de03289127e-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-ufa5a707fb0de0781f6-1.text: 2. Violation by a gambling organiser in a bookmakers’ office and totalisator of the prescribed procedure for informing the all-Russian sports federation for the relevant sport and the authorised federal executive body exercising state supervision over the organisation and conduct of gambling about winnings paid or payable on bets placed on an official sporting competition that ended with the least likely result or outcome —
koap-ufa5a707fb0de0781f6-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u7b0c6f00b147e21cc7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; for legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u7b0c6f00b147e21cc7-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u5358186ea24487cd0c-1.text: 3. Violation by a gambling organiser in a bookmakers’ office and totalisator of the prescribed procedure for keeping records of gambling participants from whom bets or interactive bets on official sporting competitions are accepted —
koap-u5358186ea24487cd0c-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u3090fc12ef4669ac87-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u3090fc12ef4669ac87-1.locator: Article 14.1.1-1. Violation by gambling organisers in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators of requirements for betting on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling

koap-u39e4bf29625aa65998-1.text: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence
koap-u39e4bf29625aa65998-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u8681299876bbe7d785-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence
koap-u8681299876bbe7d785-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u6f1c84da8d5e706e33-1.text: 1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence —
koap-u6f1c84da8d5e706e33-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u021dbe71ad73ebae3c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens and officials of fifty thousand roubles; for individual entrepreneurs, one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u021dbe71ad73ebae3c-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-24.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-24.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u88fdeb0aa7efa43ca0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the vehicle; for officials, fifty thousand roubles; for individual entrepreneurs, one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the vehicle; for legal entities, four hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the vehicle, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u88fdeb0aa7efa43ca0-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u032bfd140337987e06-1.text: 3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector in violation of the conditions laid down in the licence, except in the cases provided for by Articles 11.23, 11.31, 11.32, 12.31.1, 12.32.1 and 19.7.9 of this Code, —
koap-u032bfd140337987e06-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u94d4824ceb03b9e3a4-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u94d4824ceb03b9e3a4-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u4196ff411a01add626-1.text: 4. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector in gross violation of the conditions laid down in the licence, except in the cases provided for by Articles 11.23, 11.32, 12.31.1, 12.32.1 and 19.7.9 of this Code, —
koap-u4196ff411a01add626-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u4b724d53c072bd3b73-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of seventy-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u4b724d53c072bd3b73-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u7807fddd6e2bb95e71-1.text: 5. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation involving the carriage of passengers and baggage or goods by road transport or urban surface electric transport, or disseminating information about such entrepreneurial activity not provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation involving the carriage of passengers and baggage or goods by road transport or urban surface electric transport, —
koap-u7807fddd6e2bb95e71-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-ub570806e9f8761e67f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens and officials of fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub570806e9f8761e67f-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-26.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-6.text: 1. Persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-6.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u5c28fc6faabbe9e891-1.text: 2. The concept of a gross violation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation for each specific licensed type of activity.
koap-u5c28fc6faabbe9e891-1.locator: Article 14.1.2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity in the transport sector without a licence

koap-u05d2af91a0f0b3d876-1.text: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence
koap-u05d2af91a0f0b3d876-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u8ca843afce392b61b4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence
koap-u8ca843afce392b61b4-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u0ab4960d3624907a7a-1.text: 1. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence to carry out that activity, where such a licence is mandatory, —
koap-u0ab4960d3624907a7a-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u30e919657143e8f109-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u30e919657143e8f109-2.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u63131df966fd68c119-1.text: 2. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings in violation of licensing requirements, except in the cases provided for by Article 13.19.2 of this Code, —
koap-u63131df966fd68c119-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u5932054313b7808ed0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5932054313b7808ed0-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-uafeb56280b25dd3eae-1.text: 3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings in gross violation of licensing requirements —
koap-uafeb56280b25dd3eae-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u5e36391e72d3318eca-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to three hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u5e36391e72d3318eca-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-27.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-7.text: 1. Persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-7.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-uddd0d77ff7e5a26f3b-1.text: 2. The list of gross violations of licensing requirements shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-uddd0d77ff7e5a26f3b-1.locator: Article 14.1.3. Engaging in entrepreneurial activity involving the management of apartment buildings without a licence

koap-ub96ec7f940fa8cf3c9-1.text: Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted
koap-ub96ec7f940fa8cf3c9-1.locator: Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted

koap-u7e8aec33fd6495e81a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted
koap-u7e8aec33fd6495e81a-1.locator: Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted

koap-u4f8e4c5a012cd76e7a-1.text: The unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted by legislation, except in the cases provided for by Part 1 of Article 14.17.1 of this Code, —
koap-u4f8e4c5a012cd76e7a-1.locator: Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted

koap-u9c5b3941019af10e85-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-u9c5b3941019af10e85-1.locator: Article 14.2. Unlawful sale of goods (other things) whose unrestricted sale is prohibited or restricted

koap-u6a56f071dc58af9dcc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.3. Violation of advertising legislation

koap-u2dac4586f4eb93b4f2-1.text: 1. Violation of advertising legislation by an advertiser, advertising producer or advertising distributor, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2–17 of this Article, Part 4 of Article 14.3.1, or Articles 14.37, 14.38 or 19.31 of this Code, —

koap-ue8c5a63d731733c92f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, four thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u8aa0de435fb8f3f042-1.text: 2. Violation of the procedure for interrupting a television or radio programme or broadcast with advertising, or combining advertising with a television programme; exceeding the volume of advertising permitted by advertising legislation in television or radio programmes; or disseminating advertising in television or radio programmes on days of mourning declared in the Russian Federation —

koap-u0976311d88d3fabb99-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u910c408c1ca6a2fd3b-1.text: 3. Exceeding the volume of advertising permitted by advertising legislation in periodical printed publications —

koap-u0c546ab7fd082f8e6f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of four thousand to seven thousand roubles; for legal entities, forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u1a27017857ef07c60d-1.text: 4. Interrupting the screening of a film with advertising in cinema and video services, or combining advertising with the screening of a film, a religious television broadcast, a television broadcast of less than fifteen minutes, or the broadcasting of campaign materials disseminated in television programmes and broadcasts in accordance with election and referendum legislation, by means of a scrolling text line or any other form of overlay on a frame of the film, television programme or broadcast being shown, —

koap-u0976311d88d3fabb99-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u1bfaff801ab3a5bab1-1.text: 4.1. Violation of the requirements established by advertising legislation for advertising disseminated through telecommunications networks —

koap-u007d010e17464fdad9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to one million roubles.

koap-u0ab1f79aa96ac70a52-1.text: 5. Violation of the requirements established by advertising legislation for advertising medicinal products, medical devices and medical services, including treatment methods, as well as biologically active supplements —

koap-u15f313224ab936348f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u2bea1f29e84caff701-1.text: 6. Dissemination by a credit institution or microfinance organisation of advertising for services relating to the provision, use and repayment of a credit or loan in violation of the requirements specified in Part 3 of Article 28 of Federal Law of 13 March 2006 No. 38-FZ “On Advertising” —

koap-u4d730d9bb4f8005b90-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million six hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u4481589556003cc2de-1.text: 7. Dissemination of advertising promoting a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation and/or that foreign person’s information resource as the object of advertising, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of such advertising and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation”, except in the cases provided for by Part 8 of this Article, —

koap-ua991f56c34d373ce67-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to three million roubles.

koap-u6edb94603c803f7c58-1.text: 8. Dissemination by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation of advertising promoting that foreign person and/or their information resource as the object of advertising, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of such advertising and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation” —

koap-uab4e56218c115460cf-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three million to six million roubles.

koap-udf9e347471ccd3199f-1.text: 9. Dissemination of advertising on an information resource of a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of advertising on that information resource and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation”, except in the cases provided for by Part 10 of this Article, —

koap-ua991f56c34d373ce67-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to three million roubles.

koap-u98a55479977ef4d3b7-1.text: 10. Dissemination by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation without legal personality, a foreign citizen or a stateless person carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation of advertising on that foreign person’s information resource, aimed at attracting the attention of advertising consumers located in the territory of the Russian Federation, where the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications has decided to prohibit dissemination of advertising on that information resource and information about that decision has been entered in the list of foreign persons carrying out activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with Federal Law of 1 July 2021 No. 236-FZ “On the Activities of Foreign Persons on the Internet Information and Telecommunications Network in the Territory of the Russian Federation” —

koap-uab4e56218c115460cf-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three million to six million roubles.

koap-u5e446fc4b5ccd7d51a-1.text: 11. Failure by an advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to send the social advertising operator information on the volume, methods, forms and means of advertising distribution on information resources owned by the advertising distributor and/or forecast volumes of social advertising distribution on the Internet information and telecommunications network, or sending such information and/or forecasts in breach of the established requirements for them or the deadlines and procedure for their submission, —

koap-u8bb6c81f0ed822127f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u69eb90ab349daf69ef-1.text: 12. Failure by an advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to enter into an agreement with the social advertising operator for the distribution of social advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network, or to distribute free of charge on that network the social advertising supplied for distribution by the social advertising operator under that agreement, or to refrain from imposing any form of restriction on the social advertising operator when distributing social advertising in accordance with advertising legislation, except as provided for by that agreement with the social advertising operator, —

koap-u8bb6c81f0ed822127f-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u8960e62cf5e9030aa7-1.text: 13. Failure by an advertising distributor to fulfil the obligation to notify the social advertising operator that an advertising system operator has been given the ability, under an agreement for the distribution of social advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network, to distribute advertising on an information resource owned by that advertising distributor —

koap-u8bb6c81f0ed822127f-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u748ea1ccc3052f443e-1.text: 14. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 11, 12 or 13 of this Article —

koap-uf8fcab4ec7975c621b-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.

koap-udd45cfe268f3644f3a-1.text: 15. Failure by an advertiser, advertising distributor or advertising system operator to fulfil the obligation to provide, or ensure the provision of, information about advertising disseminated on the Internet information and telecommunications network to the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications in accordance with advertising legislation; breach of the prescribed deadlines for fulfilling those obligations; or provision to that body, in fulfilment of those obligations, of incomplete, inaccurate or out-of-date information —

koap-u8bb6c81f0ed822127f-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ud1a91dd710c03d2bf0-1.text: 16. Dissemination of advertising on the Internet information and telecommunications network without an advertising identifier assigned to that advertising by an advertising data operator, or violation of the requirements for placement of that identifier when distributing advertising on that network, —

koap-u2159df099cc17ebefa-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u348afaeb50642112ab-1.text: 17. Failure by an advertising data operator to fulfil the obligation to transmit to the federal executive body exercising control and supervision over mass media, mass communications, information technology and communications information supplied to it in accordance with advertising legislation about advertising disseminated on the Internet information and telecommunications network; failure by an advertising data operator to comply with the established procedure for interaction with that body; provision by an advertising data operator of incomplete, inaccurate or out-of-date information to that body; or violation by an advertising data operator of the established requirements for an advertising identifier, its content, or the procedure and deadlines for assigning, storing and submitting it to that body —

koap-u049f4f9dec0a7cde06-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u00770cd3b0d4e5bca9-1.text: 18. Dissemination of advertising for software and hardware tools for accessing information resources or information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted —

koap-u1509f8a56b2529de77-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
