koap-u609c284182329a8c2a-1.text: 1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products, or promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs and/or the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2, 3 and 6–8 of this Article, —
koap-u609c284182329a8c2a-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-uc31986aac326727cde-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uc31986aac326727cde-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u67bed71eaf60de1a18-1.text: 2. Depicting tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, smoking accessories, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs, or the process of consuming tobacco or nicotine-containing products in newly created audiovisual works intended for adults, including television and video films, in theatrical and entertainment performances, or in radio, television, video or newsreel programmes; or publicly performing, broadcasting over the air or by cable, or otherwise using those works, performances or programmes in which tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, smoking accessories, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs, or the process of consuming tobacco or nicotine-containing products are depicted, except where such depiction is an integral part of the artistic conception, —
koap-u67bed71eaf60de1a18-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-uaa0ed6685d8afa045d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and seventy thousand roubles.
koap-uaa0ed6685d8afa045d-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u866be082b35b3273ec-1.text: 3. Depicting tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, smoking accessories, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs, or the process of consuming tobacco or nicotine-containing products in newly created audiovisual works intended for children, including television and video films, in theatrical and entertainment performances, or in radio, television, video or newsreel programmes; or publicly performing, broadcasting over the air or by cable, or otherwise using those works, performances or programmes in which tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, smoking accessories, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs, or the process of consuming tobacco or nicotine-containing products are depicted —
koap-u866be082b35b3273ec-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-udb365e35a969af021b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-udb365e35a969af021b-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u67290d762c79f97d91-1.text: 4. Violation by an advertiser, advertising producer or advertising distributor of the ban on advertising tobacco, tobacco products, tobacco articles, nicotine-containing products, smoking accessories, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs —
koap-u67290d762c79f97d91-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-uf7cd53b0d8c594b6ac-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to four thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to six hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf7cd53b0d8c594b6ac-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u46faa606adbcd9249f-1.text: 5. Failure to fulfil the obligation to broadcast social advertising about the harm caused by the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products when showing audiovisual works, including television and video films, or television, video and newsreel programmes depicting tobacco products, nicotine-containing products or the process of consuming tobacco or nicotine-containing products —
koap-u46faa606adbcd9249f-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-ua7a7dc9cdb237f4a6f-1.text: 6. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling tobacco products and/or nicotine-containing products subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling tobacco products below the maximum retail price for tobacco products and/or nicotine-containing products below the minimum price for nicotine-containing products, after receiving information that the ban has been introduced from the state information system for monitoring the circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means (hereinafter, the monitoring information system), where that failure is committed by selling no more than 100 units of the relevant products at one retail outlet during one calendar day, —
koap-ua7a7dc9cdb237f4a6f-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u97604b57b643888040-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand roubles.
koap-u97604b57b643888040-4.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-u47935487fc75f713b2-1.text: 7. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling tobacco products and/or nicotine-containing products subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling tobacco products below the maximum retail price for tobacco products and/or nicotine-containing products below the minimum price for nicotine-containing products, after receiving information that the ban has been introduced from the monitoring information system, where that failure is committed by selling more than 100 but no more than 1000 units of the relevant products at one retail outlet during one calendar day, —
koap-u47935487fc75f713b2-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand roubles.

koap-u41b5aa9a44b9e0a245-1.locator: Article 14.3.1. Sponsorship of tobacco or nicotine-containing products; advertising and promotion of the sale of tobacco, tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, devices for consuming nicotine-containing products or hookahs; promotion of the consumption of tobacco or nicotine-containing products

koap-uf31295fdbecab3d5ad-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-uc6ad94afb13227920a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uc6ad94afb13227920a-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u3e5a9f038c1ca797b6-1.text: 1.1. Violation of the established rules for dispensing medicinal products subject to itemised quantitative accounting, consisting in dispensing those medicinal products without a prescription, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-u3e5a9f038c1ca797b6-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u2b596dbf9bc960d7e8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2b596dbf9bc960d7e8-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u31c9d0a065eaf3286b-1.text: 2–3. Repealed with effect from 23 January 2015. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 532-FZ.
koap-u31c9d0a065eaf3286b-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u058192a1aad00b8602-1.text: 4. Selling or dispensing medicinal products in violation of the requirements of legislation on the circulation of medicines concerning the establishment of maximum wholesale mark-ups on the actual ex-works prices set by manufacturers for those medicinal products, or maximum retail mark-ups on those actual ex-works prices, —
koap-u058192a1aad00b8602-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-uecced41de418e0e75e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twice the excess revenue from sales of medicinal products resulting from the unlawful overstatement of state-regulated prices over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year; for legal entities, twice the excess revenue from sales of medicinal products resulting from the unlawful overstatement of state-regulated prices over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year.
koap-uecced41de418e0e75e-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u780f5ff4cb6fdc1350-1.text: Note. Pharmaceutical workers who commit the administrative offence provided for by Part 1.1 of this Article shall bear administrative liability as officials.
koap-u780f5ff4cb6fdc1350-1.locator: Article 14.4.2. Violation of legislation on the circulation of medicines

koap-u1049711142b691635a-1.text: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums
koap-u1049711142b691635a-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-u6e9158f1172b0c5cbe-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums
koap-u6e9158f1172b0c5cbe-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-uf13630e83cdaa93f5c-1.text: 1. Selling tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums by persons other than those specified in the fourth and fifth parts of Article 52.1 of Law of the Russian Federation of 9 October 1992 No. 3612-1 “Fundamentals of the Legislation of the Russian Federation on Culture” (except for a one-off sale by a citizen of a ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher purchased for personal use at a price not exceeding the price indicated on that ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher) —
koap-uf13630e83cdaa93f5c-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-ubd420ea4d99cddfcc0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one and a half to twice the price indicated on the ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, twice to three times that price; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three to five times that price; for legal entities, three to five times that price.
koap-ubd420ea4d99cddfcc0-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-u91c605a017e423e320-1.text: 2. Selling tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums at a price exceeding the price indicated on the ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher —
koap-u91c605a017e423e320-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-ubd420ea4d99cddfcc0-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one and a half to twice the price indicated on the ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, twice to three times that price; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, three to five times that price; for legal entities, three to five times that price.
koap-ubd420ea4d99cddfcc0-2.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-u649160dc2d624e8007-1.text: 3. Selling tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by state and municipal performing arts organisations and museums while providing the purchaser with ancillary services whose total cost is 10 percent or more of the price indicated on the purchased ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher —
koap-u649160dc2d624e8007-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-u59b3e0b646af69d799-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one and a half to twice the price indicated on the ticket, season ticket or excursion voucher constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twice to three times that price; for legal entities, twice to three times that price.
koap-u59b3e0b646af69d799-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-ue6e39842091274714e-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, the terms “performing arts organisations”, “entertainment events” and “ancillary services” shall have the same meanings as in Article 36.2 of Law of the Russian Federation of 9 October 1992 No. 3612-1 “Fundamentals of the Legislation of the Russian Federation on Culture”.
koap-ue6e39842091274714e-1.locator: Article 14.4.3. Unlawful sale of tickets, season tickets and excursion vouchers for entertainment events held by performing arts organisations and museums

koap-u630da430611e16b8fa-1.text: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws
koap-u630da430611e16b8fa-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u03a510b32182c30cd5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws
koap-u03a510b32182c30cd5-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uc9ddc9df919668d305-1.text: 1. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services by an organisation or by a citizen registered as an individual entrepreneur without the prescribed information about the manufacturer (contractor, seller) or other information whose provision is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-uc9ddc9df919668d305-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ud7bf832410d351c7f7-3.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; for officials, three thousand to four thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-ud7bf832410d351c7f7-3.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u6c18390e48c028e11c-1.text: 2. Failure to use cash-register equipment in cases required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment —
koap-u6c18390e48c028e11c-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u8d5304d34960342a84-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one quarter to one half of the amount of the payment transaction conducted without cash-register equipment, but not less than ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, three quarters to the full amount of that payment transaction, but not less than thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u8d5304d34960342a84-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u069522dbae174ab972-1.text: 3. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article where payment transactions conducted without cash-register equipment amount, including in aggregate, to one million roubles or more —
koap-u069522dbae174ab972-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u447bd39fa5e65b3c2d-1.text: shall entail disqualification for officials for one to two years; for individual entrepreneurs and legal entities, administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u447bd39fa5e65b3c2d-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u1bae38dc494e4f5c9a-1.text: 4. Use of cash-register equipment that does not meet the established requirements, or use of cash-register equipment in violation of the procedure for its registration, the procedure, deadlines and conditions for its re-registration, or the procedure and conditions for its use, as established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, —
koap-u1bae38dc494e4f5c9a-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u7c4db2cc834c129b90-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, a warning or an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u7c4db2cc834c129b90-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u181d0a14836298a684-1.text: 5. Failure by an organisation or individual entrepreneur to submit information and documents requested by tax authorities, or submission of such information and documents in breach of the deadlines established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, —
koap-u181d0a14836298a684-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u7c4db2cc834c129b90-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, a warning or an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u7c4db2cc834c129b90-2.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ufddbb19ee45d1759d4-1.text: 6. Failure by an organisation or individual entrepreneur using cash-register equipment to send the purchaser (customer) a cash-register receipt or strict-accountability form in electronic form, or to give the purchaser (customer) those documents on paper upon request in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, —
koap-ufddbb19ee45d1759d4-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u0a8817e4c955997538-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of two thousand roubles; for legal entities, a warning or an administrative fine of ten thousand roubles.
koap-u0a8817e4c955997538-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uc40b437fc639e16334-1.text: 7. Violation by a fiscal data operator of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, consisting in a breach of the obligation to process and transmit fiscal data or to ensure the confidentiality and protection of fiscal data, —
koap-uc40b437fc639e16334-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-2.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uce4ff8c522ab475c39-1.text: 8. Failure by a fiscal data operator to fulfil the obligations established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment when its permission to process fiscal data is revoked —
koap-uce4ff8c522ab475c39-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u12a730c753c70e0fe7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u12a730c753c70e0fe7-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u25e1fa1c48831a7f39-1.text: 9. Submission by an organisation of inaccurate information when applying for permission to process fiscal data —
koap-u25e1fa1c48831a7f39-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u3195a523a550a1bd2e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3195a523a550a1bd2e-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u9098d142ba8a69ba45-1.text: 10. Failure by a fiscal data operator to notify the tax authority of the conclusion of an agreement with a user for processing fiscal data, of changes to information submitted in that notification, or of termination of that agreement, or submission of such notifications in breach of the deadline established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, —
koap-u9098d142ba8a69ba45-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-2.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u44d1197a9724d8fe9c-1.text: 11. Failure by a fiscal data operator to notify the tax authority of changes to information submitted when applying for permission to process fiscal data, or submission of such notification in breach of the deadline established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment, —
koap-u44d1197a9724d8fe9c-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-3.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ud0f19f9f0932e3f01c-1.text: 12. Any other violation by a fiscal data operator of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment —
koap-ud0f19f9f0932e3f01c-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u4363332d5a59da3a8e-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4363332d5a59da3a8e-2.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u9fe7b93411856582f9-1.text: 13. Sale by a manufacturer of cash-register equipment and/or fiscal storage devices of cash-register equipment and/or a fiscal storage device that has not been included in the register of cash-register equipment and/or the register of fiscal storage devices —
koap-u9fe7b93411856582f9-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-4.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u6e000bce29c993ab92-1.text: 14. Issuance of a knowingly false opinion by an expert organisation examining models of cash-register equipment and/or the technical facilities of a fiscal data operator (an applicant for permission to process fiscal data) for compliance with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment —
koap-u6e000bce29c993ab92-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-ua28c7d2bfd81ecfb36-3.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u3b0b271786e261e523-1.text: 15. Failure by an expert organisation examining models of cash-register equipment and/or the technical facilities of a fiscal data operator (an applicant for permission to process fiscal data) for compliance with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment to submit to the tax authority, or late submission to that authority of, the opinion it issued on whether the cash-register equipment or the technical facilities of the fiscal data operator (applicant for permission to process fiscal data) comply with the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment —
koap-u3b0b271786e261e523-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf088ef0f2ca6bfe17d-5.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u9da9ad8c24acbfe222-1.text: 16. Failure by a market management company to comply with the procedure for providing a trading space within a retail market, consisting in providing a trading space for an activity for which the legislation of the Russian Federation on the use of cash-register equipment requires payments using such equipment to a person who has not submitted a copy of its registration card; or failing to check, on the official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network of the federal executive body authorised to exercise control and supervision over taxes and levies, including through the cash-register equipment account, that the person receiving the trading space has registered (re-registered) cash-register equipment; or failing to send the person with whom an agreement to provide a trading space has been concluded a notification requiring correction of the violation identified by the company, namely the absence of cash-register equipment registered (re-registered) at the market’s address; or allowing that person to conduct at the trading space an activity requiring payments using cash-register equipment under that legislation before the equipment is duly registered (re-registered); or failure by the market management company to fulfil the obligation to unilaterally withdraw from the agreement to provide a trading space in the cases provided for by legislation on retail markets —
koap-u9da9ad8c24acbfe222-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u0c11e1600d89b1d573-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, a warning or an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u0c11e1600d89b1d573-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-uf91d4c24a549f5a447-1.text: 17. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 16 of this Article —
koap-uf91d4c24a549f5a447-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u698aeb8137aab3bab7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u698aeb8137aab3bab7-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ubaeb478ac73d31c979-1.text: Note. A person who voluntarily reports in writing to the tax authority that they have failed to use cash-register equipment in cases required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on its use, or have used equipment that does not meet the established requirements, or have used equipment in violation of the registration procedure, the procedure, deadlines and conditions for re-registration or the procedure for its use established by that legislation, and who voluntarily fulfils, before a ruling is issued in the administrative offence case, the obligation for whose non-fulfilment or improper fulfilment they are being held administratively liable, as well as a person who sends the tax authority a corrective cash-register receipt (corrective strict-accountability form), shall be exempt from administrative liability for the offence provided for by Part 2, 4 or 6 of this Article if all of the following conditions are met:
koap-ubaeb478ac73d31c979-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ud8c11b51d5da77731d-1.text: at the time the person submits the report to the tax authority or sends it a corrective cash-register receipt (corrective strict-accountability form), the tax authority did not possess the relevant information and documents about the administrative offence committed;
koap-ud8c11b51d5da77731d-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-u6da8ecbb855fe8a1e0-1.text: the submitted information and documents or the corrective cash-register receipt (corrective strict-accountability form) are sufficient to establish that the administrative offence occurred.
koap-u6da8ecbb855fe8a1e0-1.locator: Article 14.5. Sale of goods, performance of work or provision of services without prescribed information, or failure to use cash-register equipment where required by federal laws

koap-ufa9ac6910f13176bb0-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u15baac89b9bf4dd366-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u704b9fa30dba1dc285-1.text: 1. Overcharging state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) for products, goods or services, or maximum prices (tariffs, rates, charges, fees and the like); exceeding established price mark-ups (margins) on prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); or, for tobacco articles or nicotine-containing products, exceeding the maximum retail price indicated by the manufacturer on each consumer package (pack), except in the cases provided for by Part 4 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code, —
koap-u704b9fa30dba1dc285-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u777b2c447f7a796e17-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, twice the excess revenue from sales of goods (work or services) resulting from the unlawful overstatement of state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) over the entire period during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year.
koap-u777b2c447f7a796e17-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u54247303ca255ea8f8-1.text: 2. Undercharging state-regulated prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like) for products, goods or services, or maximum prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); reducing established price mark-ups (margins) on prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); violating the established procedure for regulating prices (tariffs, rates, charges and the like); or any other violation of the established pricing procedure —
koap-u54247303ca255ea8f8-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u262014879b4c31a4b6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u262014879b4c31a4b6-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u6bc33a817646fc3735-1.text: 3. Liability for violations of this Article by retail enterprises or individual entrepreneurs may not be imposed on the manufacturer or supplier of tobacco articles or nicotine-containing products.
koap-u6bc33a817646fc3735-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-uae18a1749431e4408e-1.text: 4. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling tobacco products subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling tobacco products above the maximum retail price for tobacco products, after receiving information from the monitoring information system that the ban has been introduced, where that failure is committed by selling no more than 100 units of those products at one retail outlet during one calendar day, —
koap-uae18a1749431e4408e-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u97604b57b643888040-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand roubles.
koap-u97604b57b643888040-5.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-uf2e9a14b2df174cbb4-1.text: 5. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling tobacco products subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling tobacco products above the maximum retail price for tobacco products, after receiving information from the monitoring information system that the ban has been introduced, where that failure is committed by selling more than 100 but no more than 1000 units of those products at one retail outlet during one calendar day, —
koap-uf2e9a14b2df174cbb4-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-3.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u2ac5c4b6ea1e7a1c86-1.text: 6. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling tobacco products subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling tobacco products above the maximum retail price for tobacco products, after receiving information from the monitoring information system that the ban has been introduced, where that failure is committed by selling more than 1000 units of those products at one retail outlet during one calendar day, —
koap-u2ac5c4b6ea1e7a1c86-1.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u209380a18936eedc85-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u209380a18936eedc85-2.locator: Article 14.6. Violation of the pricing procedure

koap-u5a2d91a4bcd7ee2a10-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.6.1. Repealed
koap-u5a2d91a4bcd7ee2a10-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.6.1. Repealed

koap-u1cbe903c9d2cc40dd2-1.text: Article 14.6.1. Repealed with effect from 1 March 2025. — Federal Law of 28.12.2024 No. 500-FZ.
koap-u1cbe903c9d2cc40dd2-1.locator: Article 14.6.1. Repealed with effect from 1 March 2025. — Federal Law of 28.12.2024 No. 500-FZ.

koap-uf341468acc86115f78-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.7. Deception of consumers

koap-u3704be0843e4f52b41-1.text: 1. Giving consumers short measure or short weight, overcharging them when selling goods (work or services), or otherwise deceiving consumers, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of this Article, —

koap-u18a23c21ffd1fc7bd1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

koap-u5984d5d0f69a311d00-1.text: 2. Misleading consumers as to the consumer properties or quality of goods (work or services) when producing goods for sale or selling goods (work or services), except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 14.10, Part 1 of Article 14.33 or Article 14.39 of this Code, —

koap-u1f6379410a20d0464b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, twelve thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u7154dc90d4ffbcccb7-1.text: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
koap-u7154dc90d4ffbcccb7-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-ue902098358ee3b7b68-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights
koap-ue902098358ee3b7b68-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u2624b7698e794f7a17-1.text: 1. Violation of the consumer’s right to receive necessary and accurate information about the goods (work or services) being sold, the manufacturer, seller and provider, and their business hours —
koap-u2624b7698e794f7a17-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u049aac20fa0fea8bb9-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of five hundred to one thousand roubles; for legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u049aac20fa0fea8bb9-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u06ccf51dd20557d0f6-1.text: 2. Inclusion in an agreement of terms infringing consumer rights established by consumer protection legislation, except in the cases provided for by Part 2.1 of this Article, —
koap-u06ccf51dd20557d0f6-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-ua591ddbe10cfdbd3b7-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ua591ddbe10cfdbd3b7-3.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-ub4c13c823b8711586a-1.text: 2.1. Imposing additional goods (work or services) on a consumer for a separate fee by proposing, before the agreement for the principal goods (work or services) is concluded, that the consumer purchase additional goods (work or services) or enter into other agreements whose purchase or conclusion is made mandatory when purchasing the principal goods (work or services), unless otherwise provided by law; or by including in the agreement terms making the purchase of the principal goods (work or services) conditional on the mandatory purchase of additional goods (work or services), including mandatory conclusion of other agreements, unless otherwise provided by law, —
koap-ub4c13c823b8711586a-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-uef42f8adefea9e3a16-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uef42f8adefea9e3a16-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u9dac34d959a0a08605-1.text: 3. Failure to provide a consumer with benefits and advantages established by law —
koap-u9dac34d959a0a08605-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-udf63dc5068c70e2bfe-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five hundred to one thousand roubles; for legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-udf63dc5068c70e2bfe-3.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u8c676528e78bba1590-1.text: 4. Failure to fulfil the obligation to ensure that, at the consumer’s choice, goods (work or services) can be paid for in cash or using national payment instruments within the national payment card system, where federal law requires that this option be provided, or violation of other legally established consumer rights relating to payment for goods (work or services), —
koap-u8c676528e78bba1590-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u9f6fff25dd68710a64-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9f6fff25dd68710a64-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u55eb606a996f2556d0-1.text: 4.1. Unjustified refusal to consider a consumer’s claims relating to a violation of their rights, or evasion of the consideration of such claims in the procedure established by law, —
koap-u55eb606a996f2556d0-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u2e800b1e87c4ac4451-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2e800b1e87c4ac4451-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u17342e6f32f96f03db-1.text: 5. Refusal to supply a consumer with goods (perform work or provide services) or to give them access to goods (work or services) for reasons relating to their health, limitations on their daily functioning or their age, except in cases established by law, —
koap-u17342e6f32f96f03db-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-8.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u6ca86a192e51e3c160-1.text: 6. Sale of certain types of technically complex goods with preinstalled computer programs in violation of the requirement established by consumer protection legislation to ensure the ability to use those types of technically complex goods with preinstalled computer programs originating in the Russian Federation or other member states of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-u6ca86a192e51e3c160-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-ud08492c1a43532f1b1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud08492c1a43532f1b1-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-uf84e35d92d74a53901-1.text: 7. Refusal to conclude, perform, amend or terminate an agreement with a consumer because the consumer refuses to provide personal data, except where providing personal data is mandatory under federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted in accordance with them or is directly related to performance of the agreement with the consumer, and except in the cases provided for by Part 8 of this Article, —
koap-uf84e35d92d74a53901-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-ue5d9c5e141223ee39c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ue5d9c5e141223ee39c-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u7fa54dc8603cf75b7f-1.text: 8. Refusal to conclude, perform, amend or terminate an agreement with a consumer because the consumer refuses to undergo identification and/or authentication using their biometric personal data —
koap-u7fa54dc8603cf75b7f-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u80471608716a6a92a3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u80471608716a6a92a3-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u9f196bb3fffcffa0f1-1.text: Note. Where two or more consumers are simultaneously refused the supply of goods (performance of work or provision of services) or access to goods (work or services) for reasons relating to their health, limitations on their daily functioning or age, or where one consumer, or two or more consumers simultaneously, are repeatedly refused on those grounds, the administrative liability provided for by Part 5 of this Article shall arise for the refusal to each consumer and for each instance of refusal separately.
koap-u9f196bb3fffcffa0f1-1.locator: Article 14.8. Violation of other consumer rights

koap-u99963d379b0855b3ac-1.text: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
koap-u99963d379b0855b3ac-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-ua246feb31e6c04e19f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies
koap-ua246feb31e6c04e19f-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-u94acaa3b05a3e02c1f-1.text: 1. Acts (omissions) by officials of federal executive bodies, executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, other bodies or organisations performing their functions, state extra-budgetary funds, or organisations participating in the provision of state or municipal services, which are prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, or restriction of the free movement of goods (work or services) or freedom of economic activity, except in the cases provided for by Part 7 of Article 14.32 of this Code, —
koap-u94acaa3b05a3e02c1f-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-uce7ba47576047b6795-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uce7ba47576047b6795-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-u7fff98917aaf59c4fc-1.text: 2. Acts by the officials specified in Part 1 of this Article which are prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, or restriction of the free movement of goods (work or services) or freedom of economic activity, where those officials have previously been subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence, —
koap-u7fff98917aaf59c4fc-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-ub083f91a44796a5140-1.text: shall entail disqualification for up to three years.
koap-ub083f91a44796a5140-1.locator: Article 14.9. Restriction of competition by public authorities or local self-government bodies

koap-u00b0c9233556046fe6-1.text: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
koap-u00b0c9233556046fe6-1.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-u10b540f4396c31898a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project
koap-u10b540f4396c31898a-1.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-uec9dd573602c85b27a-1.text: 1. Acts (omissions) by officials of federal executive bodies, public authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies, other bodies or organisations performing the functions of those bodies, or organisations participating in the provision of state or municipal services, when carrying out, in relation to legal entities and individual entrepreneurs who are participants in urban planning relations, measures and/or procedures provided for by urban planning legislation in implementing a capital construction project (hereinafter, measures in implementing a construction project), which are subject to appeal under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation and consist in: breach of established deadlines for measures in implementing a construction project; requiring measures and/or procedures not provided for by urban planning legislation or requiring documents, information, materials or approvals not included in the register of documents, information, materials and approvals necessary for implementing a construction project provided for by the urban planning legislation of the Russian Federation; unlawful refusal to accept documents or applications; or imposing on the complainant, documents or information requirements not established by federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation or normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation when carrying out measures in implementing a construction project, except in the cases provided for by Article 5.63 of this Code, —
koap-uec9dd573602c85b27a-1.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-u456bc4914fe7ca6f62-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u456bc4914fe7ca6f62-1.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-26.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-26.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-ufad6bbd3712ffaf161-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to two years.
koap-ufad6bbd3712ffaf161-1.locator: Article 14.9.1. Violation of the procedure for measures and/or procedures in implementing a capital construction project

koap-uae707f5874861f0a5d-1.text: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
koap-uae707f5874861f0a5d-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-u85f65f479f4c15a012-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)
koap-u85f65f479f4c15a012-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-u11d1a796bb4f396e41-1.text: 1. Unlawful use of another person’s trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, or designations similar to them for goods of the same kind, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of this Article, —
koap-u11d1a796bb4f396e41-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-uc79bdf45e21921acc0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-uc79bdf45e21921acc0-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-ufc9abd4a6d58411a81-1.text: 2. Producing for sale or selling goods bearing an unlawful reproduction of another person’s trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, or designations similar to them for goods of the same kind, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 14.33 of this Code, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-ufc9abd4a6d58411a81-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-u581e0cc71412a05fc3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for officials, three times the value of those goods, but not less than fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence; for legal entities, five times the value of those goods, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of items bearing an unlawful reproduction of the trademark, service mark or appellation of origin, as well as materials and equipment used to manufacture them and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-u581e0cc71412a05fc3-1.locator: Article 14.10. Unlawful use of means of individualising goods (work or services)

koap-u52681c0aeeadde41e6-1.text: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
koap-u52681c0aeeadde41e6-1.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan

koap-uad4f09f70efa313b9b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan
koap-uad4f09f70efa313b9b-1.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan

koap-u75f2cdb3f0250e6859-1.text: Obtaining a credit or loan or preferential lending terms by providing a bank or other creditor with knowingly false information about one’s business circumstances or financial position —
koap-u75f2cdb3f0250e6859-1.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan

koap-u2373a722b602d20961-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u2373a722b602d20961-1.locator: Article 14.11. Unlawful obtaining of a credit or loan

koap-ufc36dd840044df26e1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.12. Fictitious or deliberate bankruptcy

koap-u938f45f6c782dd4331-1.text: 1. Fictitious bankruptcy, that is, a knowingly false public declaration by the head or founder (member) of a legal entity that the legal entity is insolvent, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen that they are insolvent, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —

koap-uf6ff634598e640c557-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.

koap-u07cc5015b9d64283aa-1.text: 2. Deliberate bankruptcy, that is, acts (omissions) by the head or founder (member) of a legal entity, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen, which knowingly cause the legal entity, individual entrepreneur or citizen to become unable to satisfy in full creditors’ claims relating to monetary obligations and/or fulfil the obligation to make mandatory payments, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —

koap-u07b7fbc8f1dd0fc6d3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years.

koap-u4b0cece45f0d0da278-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.13. Unlawful acts in bankruptcy

koap-uf389c0419b9e27ca9b-1.text: 1. Concealing property, property rights or property obligations, information about property, its amount or location, or other information about property, property rights or property obligations; transferring property into the possession of other persons, disposing of or destroying property; or concealing, destroying or falsifying accounting and other records reflecting the economic activity of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, where those acts are committed when there are signs of bankruptcy of the legal entity or signs of inability to pay of the individual entrepreneur or citizen and do not constitute criminal offences, —

koap-ue3c10a69402d342c76-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.

koap-ud947685d49a2ed79fb-1.text: 2. Unlawfully satisfying the property claims of individual creditors from the property of a debtor legal entity by the head or founder (member) of that legal entity, or by an individual entrepreneur or citizen, knowingly to the detriment of other creditors; or acceptance of such satisfaction by creditors aware that they have been given preference to the detriment of other creditors, where those acts are committed when there are signs of bankruptcy and do not constitute criminal offences, —

koap-ue3c10a69402d342c76-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to three years.

koap-ud664c7dbcdf2f9d932-1.text: 3. Failure by an insolvency practitioner, registrar, auction organiser, electronic platform operator or head of the temporary administration of a credit or other financial organisation to fulfil obligations established by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation, where that act (omission) does not constitute a criminal offence, —

koap-u3dad620f9c68113b45-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.

koap-ubfad03930b9d257a84-1.text: 3.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 3 of this Article, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —

koap-u652b090555ba8bbdb5-1.text: shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to three years; an administrative fine for legal entities of three hundred and fifty thousand to one million roubles.

koap-u8e83de500f76cd6395-1.text: 4. Unlawfully obstructing the activities of an insolvency practitioner, a bankruptcy liquidation administrator or the temporary administration of a credit or other financial organisation, including delayed provision, evasion or refusal to hand over to them information and/or documents necessary to fulfil their duties and/or property belonging to a legal entity, including a credit or other financial organisation, where the functions of the head of that legal entity, including the credit or other financial organisation, have been assigned respectively to the insolvency practitioner, bankruptcy liquidation administrator or head of the temporary administration of the credit or other financial organisation, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —

koap-u7a349926d47fc7f694-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year.

koap-u9c843f62d439374216-1.text: 4.1. Acts (omissions) provided for by Part 4 of this Article, or concealment of documents and other information media, directed against representatives of the Bank of Russia or the state corporation “Deposit Insurance Agency” in connection with their exercise of powers when analysing a bank’s financial position in accordance with Federal Law of 26 October 2002 No. 127-FZ “On Insolvency (Bankruptcy)” —

koap-uea31686f9dcd860998-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year.

koap-u63ed0c25d9e10309de-1.text: 5. Failure by the head of a legal entity, an individual entrepreneur or a citizen to fulfil the obligation to apply to an arbitrazh court for a declaration of bankruptcy of the legal entity, individual entrepreneur or citizen respectively in the cases provided for by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation —

koap-u4b462a051b0a2fcdc1-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.

koap-udf78c7c76fe5342854-2.text: 5.1. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 5 of this Article —

koap-u1a326b22d22ad597c2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, disqualification for six months to three years.

koap-ubcc523e8227a09038d-1.text: 6. Failure by the head of a legal entity, within the period established by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation, to send the owner of the property of a debtor unitary enterprise and persons entitled to initiate the convening of an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (members) information on the existence of signs of bankruptcy, as well as a copy of the debtor’s application when filed with an arbitrazh court and of the debtor’s response to an application for a declaration of the debtor’s bankruptcy, —

koap-ufb91dc5d040f5ba0da-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to two years.

koap-u290306028fd41d4ea7-1.text: 7. Unlawful obstruction by an individual entrepreneur or citizen of the activities of an insolvency practitioner approved by an arbitrazh court in the bankruptcy case of that individual entrepreneur or citizen, including evasion or refusal to provide information in cases provided for by insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation or to hand over documents necessary for the insolvency practitioner to fulfil their duties, where those acts (omissions) do not constitute criminal offences, —

koap-u2541504d1393f29bff-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to two years.

koap-u28840352c49c5bd8eb-1.text: 8. Failure to comply with an effective judicial act imposing subsidiary liability on persons controlling a debtor for the obligations of that debtor declared bankrupt, provided that the act does not constitute a criminal offence, except where that judicial act has been appealed to a court of cassation and the court of cassation has not issued a judicial act on it, or where the period for appealing the judicial act imposing subsidiary liability to a court of cassation has not expired, —

koap-u32068fe039487aa5fd-1.text: shall entail disqualification of officials for six months to three years.
