koap-u202ae55d721010faf7-1.text: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them
koap-u202ae55d721010faf7-1.locator: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them

koap-u15b789bde202d4ef08-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them
koap-u15b789bde202d4ef08-1.locator: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them

koap-ue70c6a8ec47a1f273b-1.text: Distribution (sale, resale, allocation, dissemination, exchange or other use, whether or not for profit) of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them without an appropriate agreement with UEFA or organisations authorised by UEFA, and/or changing, when distributing admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them, the established price of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship —
koap-ue70c6a8ec47a1f273b-1.locator: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them

koap-ue74118bfa62b987ea5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty to twenty-five times the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship stated in the document entitling its holder to receive an admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship and constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than fifty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty-five to thirty times the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship stated in the document entitling its holder to receive an admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship and constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twenty-five to thirty times the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship stated in the document entitling its holder to receive an admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship and constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-ue74118bfa62b987ea5-1.locator: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them

koap-u258f24bf0511246f65-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Article, the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or the value of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship stated in the document entitling its holder to receive an admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship and constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence means the price of the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship established by UEFA and stated on the admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or in the document entitling its holder to receive an admission ticket for a match of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship.
koap-u258f24bf0511246f65-1.locator: Article 14.15.2. Unlawful distribution of admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or documents entitling their holders to receive them

koap-u51bac393fa7f996546-1.text: Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship
koap-u51bac393fa7f996546-1.locator: Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship

koap-u07bd7e4bb8bce9c484-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship
koap-u07bd7e4bb8bce9c484-1.locator: Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship

koap-u0da2bfc8c6cba35432-1.text: Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u0da2bfc8c6cba35432-1.locator: Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship

koap-u30d1f3229677e29819-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days; for legal entities, one million to one million five hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u30d1f3229677e29819-1.locator: Article 14.15.3. Distribution of counterfeit admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship or counterfeit documents entitling their holders to receive admission tickets for matches of the UEFA 2020 European Football Championship

koap-ue104ac9acf99d9e690-1.text: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products
koap-ue104ac9acf99d9e690-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u9d19cde6b6dec196a1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products
koap-u9d19cde6b6dec196a1-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u893ad7f2d5ba8722ea-1.text: 1. Retail sale of ethyl alcohol, including the pharmaceutical substance ethyl alcohol (ethanol), or alcohol-containing flavouring biologically active food additives, or wine materials, —
koap-u893ad7f2d5ba8722ea-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u5059de9f8b80211745-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with confiscation of ethyl alcohol and alcohol-containing products; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of ethyl alcohol and alcohol-containing products.
koap-u5059de9f8b80211745-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u452c8a49f5b7529107-1.text: 2. Circulation of ethyl alcohol (except retail sale), alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products without the accompanying documents prescribed by federal law certifying the legality of their production and circulation —
koap-u452c8a49f5b7529107-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-ueab1cf6ca956d98e8d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles, with confiscation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-ueab1cf6ca956d98e8d-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u3b31fcca5af0fbef46-1.text: 2.1. Retail sale of alcoholic products to a minor, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u3b31fcca5af0fbef46-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u3e1d9a6df5a6b6e4fb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3e1d9a6df5a6b6e4fb-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u2ef116f5c3ba68d40c-1.text: 2.2. Retail sale of alcoholic products in polymer consumer containers (consumer containers or packaging made entirely from polyethylene, polystyrene, polyethylene terephthalate or another polymer material) with a capacity exceeding 1500 millilitres —
koap-u2ef116f5c3ba68d40c-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u0d966ddc9effe71884-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-u0d966ddc9effe71884-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u351575c36fc029b918-1.text: 3. Violation of special requirements and rules for the retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 14.17.1 of this Code, —
koap-u351575c36fc029b918-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u909caba3d6aef24f96-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-u909caba3d6aef24f96-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u7c5ed1ba5b538c923b-1.locator: Article 14.16. Violation of rules for selling ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u5ba4db97f9d4f6d064-1.text: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products
koap-u5ba4db97f9d4f6d064-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u11eacc5a7fe7da7622-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products
koap-u11eacc5a7fe7da7622-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-ub67c2467898397b3f2-1.text: 1. Production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products in violation of licensing requirements provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products —
koap-ub67c2467898397b3f2-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-ud7e133de29feb522be-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-ud7e133de29feb522be-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u65713753a6586fa4fd-1.text: 2. Production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products in gross violation of licensing requirements provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products —
koap-u65713753a6586fa4fd-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u7bffdf91798c2f6dac-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days, with or without confiscation of the products manufactured, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-u7bffdf91798c2f6dac-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-uf5bb309111a9b07153-1.text: 3. Production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products without the appropriate licence —
koap-uf5bb309111a9b07153-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u09dd3e81a2ac008c8d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five hundred thousand to one million roubles, or disqualification for two to three years; for legal entities, a fine not exceeding one fifth of total revenue from sales of all goods (work or services) in the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or in the part of the calendar year before the date of detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (work or services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than three million roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products, or administrative suspension of activity for sixty to ninety days, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-u09dd3e81a2ac008c8d-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u69083fdfe710bbd137-1.text: 4. Production, purchase, supply, storage and/or transportation of alcoholic products in polymer consumer containers (consumer containers or packaging made entirely from polyethylene, polystyrene, polyethylene terephthalate or another polymer material) with a capacity exceeding 1500 millilitres, except the production, purchase, supply, storage and/or transportation of beer and beer-based drinks in polymer consumer containers with a capacity exceeding 1500 millilitres for export from the Russian Federation, —
koap-u69083fdfe710bbd137-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u0d966ddc9effe71884-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-u0d966ddc9effe71884-2.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u101f92e92a062542d4-1.text: 5. Use and/or possession of principal technological equipment for producing ethyl alcohol that has not been registered in the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u101f92e92a062542d4-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u012f790e06d40f1946-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the principal technological equipment; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of that equipment; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of that equipment.
koap-u012f790e06d40f1946-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u6f4b7b50e710250e6c-1.text: 6. Use and/or possession of principal technological equipment for producing ethyl alcohol that has been registered but not placed in conservation in the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, without a licence to produce, store and supply the ethyl alcohol produced, including denatured alcohol, —
koap-u6f4b7b50e710250e6c-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u82ec088d6070c10049-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the principal technological equipment.
koap-u82ec088d6070c10049-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u60e4800cd28902f296-1.text: 7. Use of principal technological equipment for producing ethyl alcohol that has been registered and placed in conservation in the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, without a licence to produce, store and supply the ethyl alcohol produced, including denatured alcohol, —
koap-u60e4800cd28902f296-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u82ec088d6070c10049-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the principal technological equipment.
koap-u82ec088d6070c10049-2.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-uaec8102185a06338a6-1.text: Note. For the purposes of Part 2 of this Article, a gross violation of licensing requirements provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products means:
koap-uaec8102185a06338a6-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u7418102593844bb074-1.text: use of principal technological equipment intended for producing ethyl alcohol from food raw materials and/or alcoholic products and/or storing them to produce and/or store non-food products on that same equipment, except waste from the principal production process;
koap-u7418102593844bb074-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u0782b451da9fc2c5cf-1.text: supply of ethyl alcohol, including denatured alcohol, to an organisation that does not have the appropriate licence, whose licence has been suspended, or that does not have a notification;
koap-u0782b451da9fc2c5cf-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u91a7611f59b79aa41e-1.text: supply of alcoholic and/or alcohol-containing food products to an organisation that does not have the appropriate licence or whose licence has been suspended;
koap-u91a7611f59b79aa41e-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u3d2d670743b2bc671b-1.text: production of ethyl alcohol by a process that generates stillage (the principal waste product of alcohol production) without its full processing and/or disposal at treatment facilities;
koap-u3d2d670743b2bc671b-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u2747295100a48d6b37-1.text: production of ethyl alcohol, including denatured alcohol, from raw materials not included in the list of food and non-food raw materials used to produce ethyl alcohol, including denatured alcohol, approved in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
koap-u2747295100a48d6b37-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u908bfa31ff3847a12d-1.text: production and circulation of alcohol-containing non-food products (except those intended for retail sale) whose labels do not contain information about the danger to citizens’ life or health of consuming those products as food;
koap-u908bfa31ff3847a12d-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u1015e6a435d1a76742-1.text: supply of denatured alcohol or denatured alcohol-containing products whose denaturants do not comply with the list and concentrations of denaturants or mixtures thereof established by law, or in violation of the procedure for using denatured alcohol or denatured alcohol-containing products;
koap-u1015e6a435d1a76742-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u12f9cec81cfe3e12d3-1.text: sale of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products containing ethyl alcohol produced from non-food raw materials or containing denaturing additives, except alcohol-containing non-food products;

koap-ue2b8be4a706270db6b-1.text: performing any technological processes or operations to treat denatured ethyl alcohol or denatured alcohol-containing products in order to remove denaturants.
koap-ue2b8be4a706270db6b-1.locator: Article 14.17. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u0106cda86675f84ef0-1.text: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals
koap-u0106cda86675f84ef0-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-u3105d3a2319d70a158-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals
koap-u3105d3a2319d70a158-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-u8f0db35673f9ae03c6-1.text: 1. Retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by an individual (except an individual employed by an organisation licensed to retail alcoholic products, an organisation not licensed to retail alcoholic products, a person engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity (individual entrepreneur) who retails beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry or mead, or an agricultural producer (individual entrepreneur or peasant (farm) enterprise) recognised as such under Federal Law of 29 December 2006 No. 264-FZ “On the Development of Agriculture” who retails wine or sparkling wine (champagne) they have produced, and who directly sells alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products under a retail sale agreement), where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u8f0db35673f9ae03c6-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-u20f2417101c6442c20-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-u20f2417101c6442c20-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-u42ee654afd81466779-1.text: 2. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by a person engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity (individual entrepreneur) or by an agricultural producer (individual entrepreneur or peasant (farm) enterprise) recognised as such under Federal Law of 29 December 2006 No. 264-FZ “On the Development of Agriculture” (except retail sale of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry or mead by an individual entrepreneur, or retail sale of wine or sparkling wine (champagne) produced by the agricultural producer), where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u42ee654afd81466779-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-uf502a10705a8ba9697-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products.
koap-uf502a10705a8ba9697-1.locator: Article 14.17.1. Unlawful retail sale of alcoholic products and alcohol-containing food products by individuals

koap-ub106265e7778162395-1.text: Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals
koap-ub106265e7778162395-1.locator: Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals

koap-u64f2f7de6bd14600a5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals
koap-u64f2f7de6bd14600a5-1.locator: Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals

koap-u61fc99c114ac09e6ea-1.text: Moving within the territory of the Russian Federation alcoholic products not marked in accordance with legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products, including products having the status of goods of the Eurasian Economic Union, except movement of those alcoholic products within the territory of the Russian Federation by individuals in quantities not exceeding 10 litres per person, —
koap-u61fc99c114ac09e6ea-1.locator: Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals

koap-ue3d84feacd26db566f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the products constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-ue3d84feacd26db566f-1.locator: Article 14.17.2. Unlawful movement of alcoholic products by individuals

koap-ubcffd3e3e9a7f43fad-1.text: Article 14.17.3. Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products
koap-ubcffd3e3e9a7f43fad-1.locator: Article 14.17.3. Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products

koap-ud5bdc8f257b5e658b1-1.locator: Article 14.17.3. Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products

koap-ua125557fe3862f0925-1.text: Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products —
koap-ua125557fe3862f0925-1.locator: Article 14.17.3. Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products

koap-ud17713538d132a3f63-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the item constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of that item; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of that item.
koap-ud17713538d132a3f63-1.locator: Article 14.17.3. Production and/or circulation of powdered alcohol-containing products

koap-u94bbfd675045b9cac8-1.text: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead
koap-u94bbfd675045b9cac8-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u20957c170a356c6083-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead
koap-u20957c170a356c6083-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-uff0412bb264f3b8e22-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products, except in the cases provided for by Parts 2 and 3 of this Article, Parts 2 and 3 of Article 14.16, Part 4 of Article 14.17, Article 14.19, Parts 3 and 4 of Article 15.12 or Article 15.12.1 of this Code, —
koap-uff0412bb264f3b8e22-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u05d7165f8760d03df2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead.
koap-u05d7165f8760d03df2-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u38c5208f368184817f-1.text: 2. Gross violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products —
koap-u38c5208f368184817f-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u60dcaaa52bd6c37ac7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead, or administrative suspension of activity for up to thirty days, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead.
koap-u60dcaaa52bd6c37ac7-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u8bd07e1d360ca78fbc-1.text: 3. Production of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead without being included in the prescribed manner in the register of producers of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead, or without amendments being made to that register, —
koap-u8bd07e1d360ca78fbc-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u0ced9b72fbfde2fd94-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for producing beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days, with or without confiscation of the products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products, vehicles or other items used for producing beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead.
koap-u0ced9b72fbfde2fd94-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u7a0109097f057c075e-1.text: Note. For the purposes of Part 2 of this Article, a gross violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead provided for by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and on restricting the consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products means:
koap-u7a0109097f057c075e-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u268abe618f46221576-1.text: production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead with added ethyl alcohol;
koap-u268abe618f46221576-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u3a12a5e1eced31b98a-1.text: production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead using principal technological equipment without using automatic finished-product volume measuring instruments and/or technical facilities for recording and transmitting information on the volume of production and circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead to the unified state automated information system, installed on that equipment in the prescribed manner;
koap-u3a12a5e1eced31b98a-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-u2ebeeabe63076433b5-1.text: the presence, in warehouse and/or production premises at a place of activity of a producer entered in the register of producers of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead, of principal technological equipment for producing those products that does not belong to that producer by right of ownership, economic management or operational management.
koap-u2ebeeabe63076433b5-1.locator: Article 14.17.4. Violation of requirements for the production and/or circulation of beer and beer-based drinks, cider, perry and mead

koap-uf6b651d7867435d205-1.locator: Article 14.19. Violation of state accounting requirements for the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products

koap-u1d04221fcf8a5cb933-1.text: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation
koap-u1d04221fcf8a5cb933-1.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-ue92706bba631ca7d2e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation
koap-ue92706bba631ca7d2e-1.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-u2279ac76a919b10d24-1.text: 1. Conducting foreign economic operations involving goods, information, work, services or results of intellectual activity (rights thereto) that may be used to create weapons of mass destruction, their delivery systems, other weapons and military equipment, or to prepare and/or carry out terrorist acts, and that are subject to export controls, without a special permit (licence) where one is mandatory, or in breach of the requirements (conditions or restrictions) laid down in the permit (licence); or using an unlawfully obtained permit (licence), or submitting documents containing inaccurate information, except in the cases provided for by Articles 16.1, 16.3 and 16.19 of this Code, —
koap-u2279ac76a919b10d24-1.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-ufd66a7e6bb23fa70f9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens, officials and legal entities equal to the value of the goods, information, work, services or results of intellectual activity constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-ufd66a7e6bb23fa70f9-1.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-u76ef7b7a69a92a4a2b-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with the established procedure for keeping records of foreign economic transactions involving goods, information, work, services or results of intellectual activity for export control purposes, or breach of the established periods for retaining the relevant accounting documents, —
koap-u76ef7b7a69a92a4a2b-1.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-ua591ddbe10cfdbd3b7-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ua591ddbe10cfdbd3b7-4.locator: Article 14.20. Violation of export control legislation

koap-u88b7a62b64559eb942-1.text: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading
koap-u88b7a62b64559eb942-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u16faaf34b5218a8bd4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading
koap-u16faaf34b5218a8bd4-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-ub4d052a90d42f0d54d-1.text: 1. Violation by a person who is a member (founder) of a trading organiser, or a member of its governing body, of the requirements and restrictions imposed on those persons by legislation on organised trading —
koap-ub4d052a90d42f0d54d-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u236f06b0789456b57d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u236f06b0789456b57d-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u4ae4a80a40d2ad5822-1.text: 2. Unlawful use by a legal entity in its name and/or advertising of the words “exchange”, “trading system” or “trading organiser”, or words derived from them or combinations containing them, —
koap-u4ae4a80a40d2ad5822-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u4dd17b0865bc01488f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4dd17b0865bc01488f-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u1884b56f59fa62e2af-1.text: 3. Violation by a trading organiser of the information disclosure procedure established by legislation on organised trading —
koap-u1884b56f59fa62e2af-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to two years; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u07866a5dad618a9a5b-1.text: 4. Obstruction by a trading organiser of inspections conducted by the Bank of Russia, or evasion of such inspections, —
koap-u07866a5dad618a9a5b-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to two years; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-2.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u92bf58fb51d00077b5-1.text: 5. Violation of restrictions established by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them on combining the conduct of organised trading with other types of activity —
koap-u92bf58fb51d00077b5-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to two years; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-3.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u211650242d8f5ccd63-1.text: 6. Violation by a party to an agreement concluded outside organised trading of the procedure and/or deadlines established by normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation for providing information about that agreement, including provision of incomplete and/or inaccurate information, or failure to provide that information, —
koap-u211650242d8f5ccd63-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u3794fed5d4c1f34300-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3794fed5d4c1f34300-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u3dd6e06428d407c039-1.text: 7. Violation by a trading organiser of organised trading rules registered in the procedure established by legislation on organised trading —
koap-u3dd6e06428d407c039-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-ud3d41939b0de9bd5c7-1.text: 8. Violation by an exchange of the procedure established by legislation on organised trading for forming an exchange council (exchange section) —
koap-ud3d41939b0de9bd5c7-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-2.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-ud8092ce6e066d00e1a-1.text: 9. Failure by a trading organiser to fulfil the obligation to exercise control over organised trading participants, goods and securities admitted to organised trading and their issuers, and transactions carried out in organised trading —
koap-ud8092ce6e066d00e1a-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u6c37659ed03bca73ef-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u6c37659ed03bca73ef-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u71975c5c48c209b96b-1.text: 10. Violation of the requirement established by forest legislation to sell timber through organised trading —
koap-u71975c5c48c209b96b-1.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-9.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2bf95bcc40e52eda82-9.locator: Article 14.24. Violation of legislation on organised trading

koap-u6c1dbbc77dee5eccb5-1.text: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs
koap-u6c1dbbc77dee5eccb5-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-udec685ba121293b03d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs
koap-udec685ba121293b03d-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u059a831c97e686671a-1.text: 1. Late or inaccurate entry of records about a legal entity in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities or about an individual entrepreneur in the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs —
koap-u059a831c97e686671a-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-ua4e24189c2eb9d1d30-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of bodies conducting state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-ua4e24189c2eb9d1d30-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u473eca137bc1d68e60-1.text: 2. Unlawful refusal to provide, or late provision of, information and/or documents contained in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities or Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs, or other documents provided for by legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs, to persons interested in obtaining that information and/or those documents, except in the cases provided for by Parts 1 and 2 of Article 5.63 of this Code, —
koap-u473eca137bc1d68e60-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-ua4e24189c2eb9d1d30-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of bodies conducting state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-ua4e24189c2eb9d1d30-2.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u5bb445253598aa8eae-1.text: 3. Late submission of information about a legal entity or individual entrepreneur to the body conducting state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs, where such submission is required by law, —
koap-u5bb445253598aa8eae-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u0bda2f2f4cece8deda-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of five thousand roubles.
koap-u0bda2f2f4cece8deda-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u56021b2beeaeeef5c5-1.text: 4. Failure to submit, or submission of inaccurate, information about a legal entity or individual entrepreneur to the body conducting state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs, where such submission is required by law, —
koap-u56021b2beeaeeef5c5-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-3.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u96e0546f8317a57c0c-1.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 4 of this Article, or submission to the body conducting state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs of documents containing knowingly false information, where that act does not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u96e0546f8317a57c0c-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u69c999d2f86fc2bf92-1.text: shall entail disqualification of officials for one to three years.
koap-u69c999d2f86fc2bf92-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-uc88ec50ddf762477e9-1.text: 6. Late submission of information about a legal entity or individual entrepreneur to the Unified Federal Register of Information on Facts of the Activities of Legal Entities, where such submission is required by law, —
koap-uc88ec50ddf762477e9-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u9feb8fabcc67ff5dfe-1.text: shall entail a warning for officials or an administrative fine for officials of five thousand roubles.
koap-u9feb8fabcc67ff5dfe-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-uebf0275e77bd7e3033-1.text: 7. Failure to submit, or submission of inaccurate, information about a legal entity or individual entrepreneur to the Unified Federal Register of Information on Facts of the Activities of Legal Entities, where such entry is required by law, —
koap-uebf0275e77bd7e3033-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-4.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-u8942836667f96070b6-1.text: 8. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 7 of this Article, or entry of knowingly false information in the Unified Federal Register of Information on Facts of the Activities of Legal Entities, —
koap-u8942836667f96070b6-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-uec7ebcd05ccfb6277f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years.
koap-uec7ebcd05ccfb6277f-1.locator: Article 14.25. Violation of legislation on state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs

koap-ud158e7d0f9a5ab675b-1.text: Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners
koap-ud158e7d0f9a5ab675b-1.locator: Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners

koap-u8ba082b6474507af80-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners
koap-u8ba082b6474507af80-1.locator: Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners

koap-u21fa29a56d34269012-1.text: Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify, update, retain and provide information on its beneficial owners, or on measures taken to establish the information about its beneficial owners specified by the legislation of the Russian Federation, at the request of the authorised body or tax authorities, —
koap-u21fa29a56d34269012-1.locator: Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners

koap-ue4fca90dee115b4c8e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue4fca90dee115b4c8e-1.locator: Article 14.25.1. Failure by a legal entity to fulfil obligations to identify and provide information on its beneficial owners

koap-u1d2726ecb23f41fc01-1.text: Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals
koap-u1d2726ecb23f41fc01-1.locator: Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals

koap-ua285d6eee1c1d55bd5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals
koap-ua285d6eee1c1d55bd5-1.locator: Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals

koap-u00ad55fd3d1a4252d4-1.text: Violation of rules for handling scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals (acceptance, accounting, storage and transportation), except in the cases provided for by Parts 1–10 of Article 8.2, Part 2 of Article 8.6 or Part 2 of Article 8.31 of this Code, or rules for their disposal by transfer —
koap-u00ad55fd3d1a4252d4-1.locator: Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals

koap-u4d973b9c0aae725ec3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-u4d973b9c0aae725ec3-1.locator: Article 14.26. Violation of rules for handling and disposing of scrap and waste of non-ferrous and ferrous metals

koap-u19197cd0f0f0c30db6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.27. Violation of lottery legislation

koap-u2610a5c95815e13fa2-1.text: 1. Conducting a lottery without a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation authorising it, without a contract with the lottery organiser to conduct the lottery, or after expiry of the prescribed lottery period; or distributing (selling or issuing) lottery tickets, lottery receipts or electronic lottery tickets, or accepting lottery stakes from participants, without an agreement concluded in accordance with lottery legislation —

koap-u132b4af2f7cfc7b0b5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to four thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence, including lottery equipment and lottery terminals; for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence, including lottery equipment and lottery terminals; for legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence, including lottery equipment and lottery terminals.

koap-u968f18418f4b6e8d21-1.text: 2. Late transfer of earmarked contributions from a lottery —

koap-u5bc849204b6c1e8cd2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u581cef360b095e172c-1.text: 3. Refusal to pay, transfer or provide winnings, or violation of the procedure and/or deadlines for paying, transferring or providing winnings laid down in the lottery terms, —

koap-u2feeb445521c50c85a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u9079b599b84480c365-1.text: 4. Failure to publish the annual report on the conduct of a lottery, or non-compliance with requirements for lottery tickets or electronic lottery tickets, —

koap-udceb0d324086483fa6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles.

koap-ua3584d1507bf1c72cb-1.text: 5. Violation of requirements for locations where lottery tickets or electronic lottery tickets are distributed or lottery terminals are installed —

koap-u9eb0d3e66205913fe3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

koap-uebab42f72ee6ff1b9d-1.text: 6. Distribution (sale or issuance) of lottery tickets, lottery receipts or electronic lottery tickets to persons under eighteen years of age, acceptance of lottery stakes from such persons, or payment, transfer or provision of winnings to them, —

koap-uefdd901565f1c52677-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles.

koap-uef1bbead18f77bd60e-1.text: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate
koap-uef1bbead18f77bd60e-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u7c238d81317d328a8a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate
koap-u7c238d81317d328a8a-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u0608df55d10844e524-1.text: 1. Raising a citizen’s funds in connection with the citizen acquiring ownership of residential premises in an apartment building that has not, at the time those funds are raised, been commissioned in the procedure established by urban planning legislation, by a person not entitled to do so under legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate and/or raising citizens’ funds in violation of the requirements established by that legislation, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u0608df55d10844e524-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u24b16dfd3018d5c4d4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u24b16dfd3018d5c4d4-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u7b902989e31a9d0101-1.text: 2. Publication in the mass media and/or posting on public information and telecommunications networks by a developer of a project declaration (including amendments thereto) containing incomplete and/or inaccurate information; provision by a developer of incomplete and/or inaccurate information whose publication, posting or provision is required by legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate; or breach of deadlines for publication and/or posting of a project declaration or amendments thereto —
koap-u7b902989e31a9d0101-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u47c87443a2a87f3276-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u47c87443a2a87f3276-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-ud34a94030fe4ff80c0-1.text: 3. Failure to submit reports within the prescribed period to the body exercising regional state control (supervision) over shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate in cases provided for by legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate, submission of reports containing inaccurate information, or submission of incomplete reports, —
koap-ud34a94030fe4ff80c0-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u07baf357d65c8ff69a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u07baf357d65c8ff69a-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-ua12c94da4b137b23d4-1.text: 4. Failure by a person whose activity involves raising funds from citizens and legal entities to construct (create) apartment buildings and/or other real estate to submit, within the prescribed period, to the body exercising regional state control (supervision) over shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate information and/or documents necessary for that regional state control (supervision) and included in a list established by public authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation; or submission of incomplete information and/or documents or inaccurate information —
koap-ua12c94da4b137b23d4-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u3338ee1e5db1370fdc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3338ee1e5db1370fdc-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u908128754fce57950f-1.text: 5. Failure by a person securing, in accordance with legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate, performance of a developer’s obligation to transfer residential premises under a shared-equity construction participation agreement, to submit within the prescribed period to the body conducting state registration of rights to real estate and transactions therewith information on termination or early termination of an insurance agreement and/or early termination of a suretyship —
koap-u908128754fce57950f-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u07baf357d65c8ff69a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u07baf357d65c8ff69a-2.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-ube93e43c0ab3d6b45d-1.text: 6. An unjustified decision by the body exercising regional state control (supervision) over shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate to issue, or refuse to issue, an opinion that the developer and project declaration comply with the requirements established by legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-ube93e43c0ab3d6b45d-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-ud11c8c702e0e1e9ce2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud11c8c702e0e1e9ce2-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-u801f39a41638642f6f-1.text: Note. Where a person violates the requirements for raising a citizen’s funds in connection with the citizen acquiring ownership of residential premises in an apartment building not commissioned, at the time those funds are raised, in the procedure established by urban planning legislation, the administrative liability established by Part 1 of this Article shall arise for each instance of unlawfully raising a citizen’s funds separately.
koap-u801f39a41638642f6f-1.locator: Article 14.28. Violation of requirements of legislation on participation in shared-equity construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate

koap-uf7912157c799371d0d-1.text: Article 14.28.1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to maintain a register of members of a housing construction cooperative building an apartment building
koap-uf7912157c799371d0d-1.locator: Article 14.28.1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to maintain a register of members of a housing construction cooperative building an apartment building

koap-u960868fa8b3f69236f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.28.1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to maintain a register of members of a housing construction cooperative building an apartment building
koap-u960868fa8b3f69236f-1.locator: Article 14.28.1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to maintain a register of members of a housing construction cooperative building an apartment building
