koap-ue9e09ac6ce992a0e59-1.locator: Article 14.28.1. Failure to fulfil the obligation to maintain a register of members of a housing construction cooperative building an apartment building

koap-ud77daf55ac1db8113d-1.text: Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report
koap-ud77daf55ac1db8113d-1.locator: Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report

koap-u11bd500dad1a1cc9b3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report
koap-u11bd500dad1a1cc9b3-1.locator: Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report

koap-ufe0a18ee40a19ac32d-1.text: Unlawful acts to obtain or provide a credit report or information forming a credit history and included in a credit report, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-ufe0a18ee40a19ac32d-1.locator: Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report

koap-ue585f10a642b893c4a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ue585f10a642b893c4a-2.locator: Article 14.29. Unlawful obtaining or provision of a credit report

koap-uf21769a0cf14fbb149-1.text: Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history
koap-uf21769a0cf14fbb149-1.locator: Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history

koap-u681e0a40cbe4df2b71-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history
koap-u681e0a40cbe4df2b71-1.locator: Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history

koap-u47d70f1a70482457e5-1.text: Violation by a credit history bureau of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history —
koap-u47d70f1a70482457e5-1.locator: Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history

koap-u1321b5d7a204467d90-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u1321b5d7a204467d90-1.locator: Article 14.30. Violation of the established procedure for collecting, storing, protecting and processing information constituting a credit history

koap-u0ad0ce1a881869a195-1.text: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market
koap-u0ad0ce1a881869a195-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-ud2ef9ba526ed9535fe-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market
koap-ud2ef9ba526ed9535fe-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u981cb23f950bcb1a12-1.text: 1. Acts by an economic entity holding a dominant position in a product market, other than a natural monopoly entity, that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, where those acts harm or may harm the interests of other persons but do not and cannot result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition, except in the cases provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code, —
koap-u981cb23f950bcb1a12-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u5bd4151a6cb9db0b3c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u5bd4151a6cb9db0b3c-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u26c49685aed7b79b94-1.text: 2. Acts by an economic entity holding a dominant position in a product market that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, where those acts result or may result in the prevention, restriction or elimination of competition; or acts by a natural monopoly entity that constitute abuse of a dominant position and are prohibited by the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code, —
koap-u26c49685aed7b79b94-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u4fb3aa4a512983c70b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundredth to fifteen hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or of the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not more than one fiftieth of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) and not less than one hundred thousand roubles; where the revenue from selling those goods (work or services), or expenditure on purchasing them, exceeds 75 percent of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services), or where the offence was committed in a market for goods (work or services) sold at prices (tariffs) regulated under the legislation of the Russian Federation, the fine shall be three thousandths to three hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, or of the expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not more than one fiftieth of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) and not less than one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4fb3aa4a512983c70b-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-29.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-ueb0eaa64f9e77062c8-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Chapter, revenue from sales of goods (work or services) shall be determined in accordance with Articles 248 and 249 of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation, and expenditure on purchasing goods (work or services) shall be determined in accordance with Articles 254 and 268 of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-ueb0eaa64f9e77062c8-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u62d2b31ae7a8bd6f02-1.text: 2. When imposing an administrative penalty on a legal entity for an administrative offence under this Article or Article 14.31.2 or 14.33 of this Code, the mitigating circumstances provided for by Clauses 2–7 of Part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code shall be taken into account.
koap-u62d2b31ae7a8bd6f02-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-ubdf2accd961ef7e3fc-1.text: 3. When imposing an administrative penalty on a legal entity for an administrative offence under this Article or Article 14.31.2 or 14.33 of this Code, the aggravating circumstances provided for by Clauses 1 and 2 of Part 1 of Article 4.3 of this Code, as well as the following aggravating circumstances, shall be taken into account:
koap-ubdf2accd961ef7e3fc-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-ucbaee164fdb4876013-1.text: 1) commission of a continuing administrative offence lasting more than one year;
koap-ucbaee164fdb4876013-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-udc4d5095b3324ac826-1.text: 2) causing damage to citizens, organisations or the state exceeding one million roubles as a result of the administrative offence, or obtaining income exceeding five million roubles as a result of the administrative offence;
koap-udc4d5095b3324ac826-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-uc97a2caa865a6809f2-1.text: 3) commission of an administrative offence under Part 7 of Article 19.8 of this Code, where the person has already been subjected to an administrative penalty for that offence and the period provided for by Article 4.6 of this Code has not expired. This circumstance may be applied only to the administrative offence in whose proceedings the information necessary to calculate the administrative fine was requested.
koap-uc97a2caa865a6809f2-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u8b20c51d15e8afa878-1.text: 4. For an administrative offence under this Article or Article 14.31.2, 14.32 or 14.33 of this Code, where there are no mitigating or aggravating circumstances, the administrative fine imposed on a legal entity shall be the sum of the minimum fine provided for that offence and half the difference between the maximum and minimum fines provided for that offence. Where the circumstances provided for by Clauses 5 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code are present, the fine imposed on a legal entity shall be the minimum fine provided for that offence. For each mitigating circumstance other than those provided for by Clauses 5 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code, the fine imposed on a legal entity shall be reduced by one eighth of the difference between the maximum and minimum fines provided for that offence. For each aggravating circumstance, the fine imposed on a legal entity shall be increased by one eighth of the difference between the maximum and minimum fines provided for that offence.
koap-u8b20c51d15e8afa878-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-ubaa0e4a788a8ecad6b-1.text: 5. A person issued with an order to transfer to the federal budget income obtained from monopolistic activity or unfair competition may not be held administratively liable under this Article or Articles 14.32 and 14.33 of this Code if that order has been complied with.
koap-ubaa0e4a788a8ecad6b-1.locator: Article 14.31. Abuse of a dominant position in a product market

koap-u1ab20bcdd513693144-1.text: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets
koap-u1ab20bcdd513693144-1.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-uf930b234d9090d522e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets
koap-uf930b234d9090d522e-1.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-uf0f17d2ab4a794742c-1.text: 1. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets by participants in those wholesale and/or retail markets that do not hold a dominant position in the relevant electricity (capacity) markets —
koap-uf0f17d2ab4a794742c-1.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-u24b16dfd3018d5c4d4-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u24b16dfd3018d5c4d4-2.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-uedcf261bfb6e6875ab-2.text: 2. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article by an official previously subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence —
koap-uedcf261bfb6e6875ab-2.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-u349c460c2e11b4471d-2.text: shall entail disqualification for one to three years.
koap-u349c460c2e11b4471d-2.locator: Article 14.31.2. Price manipulation in wholesale and/or retail electricity (capacity) markets

koap-ud4b2dbe21df48a2901-1.text: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity
koap-ud4b2dbe21df48a2901-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uf30423bd5bbd6ee7b2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity
koap-uf30423bd5bbd6ee7b2-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uaedf6053ed3747d8a7-1.text: 1. Conclusion by an economic entity of an agreement recognised as a cartel under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of this Article, or participation in such an agreement, —
koap-uaedf6053ed3747d8a7-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u06352971460c2d293f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, three hundredths to fifteen hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u06352971460c2d293f-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u17d8272436469f5f78-1.text: 2. Conclusion by an economic entity of an agreement prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation where it results or may result in the raising, lowering or maintenance of prices in bidding procedures; or conclusion of an agreement prohibited under that legislation between bidding organisers and/or customers and participants in those bidding procedures, where the agreement aims at, results in or may result in restriction of competition and/or creation of preferential conditions for any participants; or participation in such agreements —
koap-u17d8272436469f5f78-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u876d50df8f1569d5d0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one tenth to one half of the initial value of the subject matter of the bidding procedure, but not more than one twenty-fifth of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) and not less than one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u876d50df8f1569d5d0-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u5abdb2279bdd336cca-1.text: 3. Conclusion by an economic entity of a “vertical” agreement prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, or participation in it, —
koap-u5abdb2279bdd336cca-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u3ad828460a79991a42-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, one hundredth to five hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles; where the revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, or expenditure on purchasing those goods (work or services), exceeds 75 percent of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services), or where the offence was committed in a market for goods (work or services) sold at prices (tariffs) regulated under the legislation of the Russian Federation, the fine shall be two thousandths to two hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, but not less than fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u3ad828460a79991a42-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uaf791e57788d29aaf7-1.text: 4. Conclusion by an economic entity of an agreement prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation, or participation in it, except in the cases provided for by Parts 1–3 of this Article, —
koap-uaf791e57788d29aaf7-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-ud80dd43218d057f8f4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundredth to five hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles; where the revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, or expenditure on purchasing those goods (work or services), exceeds 75 percent of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services), or where the offence was committed in a market for goods (work or services) sold at prices (tariffs) regulated under the legislation of the Russian Federation, the fine shall be two thousandths to two hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, but not less than fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud80dd43218d057f8f4-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u2ea51b6bd0cf9adeab-1.text: 5. Coordination of the economic activities of economic entities prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u2ea51b6bd0cf9adeab-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u4b82b4df018a60efb3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u4b82b4df018a60efb3-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u1b47c9bebf6d3785f7-1.text: 6. Concerted practices by an economic entity prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u1b47c9bebf6d3785f7-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-ud9aae09905371043f3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundredth to three hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, or the offender’s expenditure on purchasing the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not less than fifty thousand roubles; where the revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, or expenditure on purchasing those goods (work or services), exceeds 75 percent of the offender’s total revenue from selling all goods (work or services), or where the offence was committed in a market for goods (work or services) sold at prices (tariffs) regulated under the legislation of the Russian Federation, the fine shall be one thousandth to one hundredth of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the administrative offence was committed, but not less than fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud9aae09905371043f3-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u3e2346e792d3152d84-1.text: 7. Conclusion of an agreement prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation by a federal executive body, an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a local self-government body, another body or organisation performing the functions of those bodies, or a state extra-budgetary fund; or concerted practices prohibited under that legislation by those bodies or organisations —
koap-u3e2346e792d3152d84-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uba921fd1c87805793d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years.
koap-uba921fd1c87805793d-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-30.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u53163293224832fe69-1.text: 1. A person (or a group of persons defined in accordance with the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation) who voluntarily reports to the federal antimonopoly body or its territorial body that they have concluded an agreement or engaged in concerted practices prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation shall be exempt from administrative liability for the offences provided for by Parts 1–4, 6 and 7 of this Article if all of the following conditions are met:
koap-u53163293224832fe69-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u0f368aec45313fd123-1.text: at the time the person submits the report, the antimonopoly body did not possess the relevant information and documents about the administrative offence committed;
koap-u0f368aec45313fd123-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u7e36d4ced2517ce9f8-1.text: the person has renounced participation or further participation in the agreement, or the conduct or further conduct of the concerted practices;
koap-u7e36d4ced2517ce9f8-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u79466530870f2426df-1.text: the information and documents provided are sufficient to establish that the administrative offence occurred.
koap-u79466530870f2426df-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uafef84b724b53fd717-1.text: Exemption from administrative liability shall apply to the person who is first to fulfil all the conditions provided for by this Note.
koap-uafef84b724b53fd717-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uc029293d239c5919c5-1.text: 2. A report submitted simultaneously on behalf of several persons who concluded an agreement or engaged in concerted practices prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation shall not be considered.
koap-uc029293d239c5919c5-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-uc4514b1310b231ee7e-1.text: 3. When imposing an administrative penalty on a legal entity for an administrative offence under this Article, the mitigating circumstances provided for by Clauses 2–7 of Part 1 of Article 4.2 of this Code, as well as the following mitigating circumstances, shall be taken into account:
koap-uc4514b1310b231ee7e-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u6a61886f9bb4060987-1.text: 1) the person committing the administrative offence is not an organiser of the agreement or concerted practices restricting competition and/or received binding instructions to participate in them;
koap-u6a61886f9bb4060987-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u81faf77e079f617549-1.text: 2) the person committing the administrative offence has not begun to perform the agreement restricting competition that they concluded.
koap-u81faf77e079f617549-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-ubccfa903021a24c9a6-1.text: 4. When imposing an administrative penalty on a legal entity for an administrative offence under this Article, the aggravating circumstances provided for by Clauses 1 and 2 of Part 1 of Article 4.3 and Clauses 1, 2 and 3 of Note 3 to Article 14.31 of this Code, as well as the following aggravating circumstances, shall be taken into account:
koap-ubccfa903021a24c9a6-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u1037f6d5d4b3eca201-1.text: 1) organisation by the person committing the administrative offence of the agreement or concerted practices restricting competition;
koap-u1037f6d5d4b3eca201-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u4f98733010d9b5c631-1.text: 2) coercion by the person committing the administrative offence of other persons to commit the administrative offence or continue participating in the agreement or concerted practices restricting competition;
koap-u4f98733010d9b5c631-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u61d5f6d565486471ff-1.text: 3) use by the person committing the administrative offence, for the purpose of performing an agreement restricting competition whose conclusion is punishable under Parts 1 and 2 of this Article, of a computer program allowing decisions to be taken (acts to be performed) to implement that agreement automatically (without human participation).
koap-u61d5f6d565486471ff-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u1941c86dc85236db18-1.text: 5. For an administrative offence provided for by Parts 1–4, 6 and 7 of this Article, an administrative fine equal to the minimum fine provided for that offence shall be imposed on a legal entity if that legal entity (or a group of persons defined under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation) voluntarily reported to the federal antimonopoly body or its territorial body that it concluded an agreement or engaged in concerted practices prohibited under that legislation and fulfilled all of the following conditions:
koap-u1941c86dc85236db18-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u39ee18c3d9a4d3d1de-1.text: the person has admitted committing the administrative offence;
koap-u39ee18c3d9a4d3d1de-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u6ed22ba729507cb7ec-1.text: the person has renounced participation or further participation in the agreement or concerted practices;
koap-u6ed22ba729507cb7ec-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u79466530870f2426df-2.text: the information and documents provided are sufficient to establish that the administrative offence occurred.
koap-u79466530870f2426df-2.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u728c38b7f71bb416c2-1.text: The fine in the amount provided for by this Note shall be imposed on the legal entities that are second and third to fulfil the conditions of this Note. This Note shall not apply to a legal entity that organised the agreement prohibited under the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u728c38b7f71bb416c2-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-ua60e8ec29ad326abf9-1.text: 6. When determining under this Article an administrative fine calculated from the initial value of the subject matter of a bidding procedure held to conclude an agreement (contract) whose performance period exceeds one year, the initial value of the subject matter of that bidding procedure shall be determined in proportion to its value for one year.
koap-ua60e8ec29ad326abf9-1.locator: Article 14.32. Concluding an agreement restricting competition, engaging in concerted practices restricting competition, or coordinating economic activity

koap-u5db6cc832375cfcd2b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.33. Unfair competition

koap-u638aff90f1ed42c630-1.text: 1. Unfair competition, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.3 of this Code and Part 2 of this Article, —

koap-uc71a793a104bcfbff4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twelve thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u603295491a34d36237-1.text: 2. Unfair competition consisting in introducing goods into circulation with the unlawful use of results of intellectual activity or equivalent means of individualising a legal entity, or means of individualising products, work or services, —

koap-u687474ce4fde8deada-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, one hundredth to fifteen hundredths of the offender’s revenue from selling the goods (work or services) in whose market the offence was committed, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u913a6acbbe5fdafc7f-1.text: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets
koap-u913a6acbbe5fdafc7f-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ue4aa22d3908328575a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets
koap-ue4aa22d3908328575a-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u055e6cb5f75e872e89-1.text: 1. Drawing up and approving a plan for the layout of trading spaces at a retail market without approval from the bodies authorised to exercise federal state fire supervision, federal state sanitary and epidemiological supervision, federal state supervision over consumer rights protection, and control over the maintenance of public order —
koap-u055e6cb5f75e872e89-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u743953cead51a63de8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u743953cead51a63de8-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u1b4c760c45858f2ec5-1.text: 2. Organising and providing trading spaces at a retail market that are not included in its layout plan, in the absence of that plan, or without agreements for providing trading spaces; or providing trading spaces for a period exceeding that established by federal law —
koap-u1b4c760c45858f2ec5-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ue905fd622248f9334b-1.text: 3. Unlawful refusal or evasion of providing trading spaces at a retail market where federal law makes their provision mandatory in the relevant case —
koap-ue905fd622248f9334b-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-2.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-uadb8d23457ee1f201a-1.text: 4. Providing producers at an agricultural market, or members of an agricultural consumer cooperative at an agricultural cooperative market, with fewer trading spaces than required by federal law; or providing a trading space at an agricultural market or agricultural cooperative market on the basis of a collective request without meeting the conditions established by federal law —
koap-uadb8d23457ee1f201a-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-3.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u3be8dbec068e851445-1.text: 5. Organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at a retail market without a security passport, or violation of the established requirements for drawing up or approving the retail market’s security passport, —
koap-u3be8dbec068e851445-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ud172cb1bc5cc9f3665-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud172cb1bc5cc9f3665-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u7f36ca6e502f45014a-1.text: 6. Evasion of maintaining a register of sellers or a register of agreements for providing trading spaces —
koap-u7f36ca6e502f45014a-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-4.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u7a714fcd1851676a9c-1.text: 7. Late or inaccurate entry of records in the register of sellers or register of agreements for providing trading spaces; or keeping or maintaining those registers in places accessible to unauthorised persons or under conditions that do not ensure prevention of the loss, distortion or falsification of information contained in those registers —
koap-u7a714fcd1851676a9c-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u71f5a2db1603bc009b-5.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ub7dd9055cc68dad45f-1.text: 8. Organising and conducting the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at a retail market without drawing up and/or issuing a seller’s card, or without complying with requirements for drawing it up, —
koap-ub7dd9055cc68dad45f-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-u3923af50bf8af37588-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3923af50bf8af37588-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ubc840403ed2167d3ca-1.text: Note. The administrative liability established by this Article shall not apply to violations in organising the sale of energy resources at retail markets, or the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at temporary fairs held outside retail markets, or to violations of the simplified procedure for providing trading spaces at a retail market established by a public authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-ubc840403ed2167d3ca-1.locator: Article 14.34. Violation of rules for organising the sale of goods (performance of work or provision of services) at retail markets

koap-ud5b633fed99163f00a-1.text: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities
koap-ud5b633fed99163f00a-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u2e2291138ead6f28d0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities
koap-u2e2291138ead6f28d0-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-ubc4268e4a5ae9e0635-1.text: 1. Late or inaccurate entry of information about real estate in the state real estate cadastre by officials of the body conducting state cadastral registration of real estate and maintaining the state real estate cadastre, or of state institutions subordinate to that body, —
koap-ubc4268e4a5ae9e0635-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u99fcee4416624cd1b4-1.text: 2. Unlawful refusal by the officials specified in Part 1 of this Article to provide information entered in the state real estate cadastre, or late provision of that information, —
koap-u99fcee4416624cd1b4-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-2.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u708ec70c51af86a05c-1.text: 3. Violation of the statutory procedure for information exchange when maintaining the state real estate cadastre by an official responsible for submitting the relevant document under that procedure, or submission under that procedure of a document containing inaccurate information, —
koap-u708ec70c51af86a05c-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-ueed6f03a0d83937c6a-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-ueed6f03a0d83937c6a-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u04f702d092848cb993-1.text: 4. Entry by a cadastral engineer of knowingly false information in a boundary survey plan, technical plan, inspection report, land subdivision plan for a land plot or land plots, or territorial map-plan; or forgery of documents used to prepare a boundary survey plan, technical plan, inspection report, land subdivision plan for a land plot or land plots, or territorial map-plan, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u04f702d092848cb993-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u2ecc0cfefda21cccee-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years.
koap-u2ecc0cfefda21cccee-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-ubc52cd58024bf94de4-1.text: 5. Violation by public authorities, local self-government bodies or other persons of requirements to submit within the prescribed period to the body conducting state cadastral registration of real estate and maintaining the state real estate cadastre an application for cadastral registration in connection with the allocation of a land plot for territorial development to construct and operate a social-use rental apartment building or a commercial-use rental apartment building, or with the adoption of an act or decision or conclusion of an agreement providing for the construction of a social-use or commercial-use rental apartment building on the land plot, —
koap-ubc52cd58024bf94de4-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-ueb858d611eeecbdc5d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one hundred thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ueb858d611eeecbdc5d-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u9055abccbec90594f1-1.text: 6. Provision for payment to third parties by officials of public authorities or local self-government bodies, organisations or citizens of information they obtained from the Unified State Register of Real Estate; or creation of websites on the Internet information and telecommunications network or computer programs, including mobile applications, through which access is provided to information resources and the possibility is ensured of providing information contained in the Unified State Register of Real Estate; or use of such websites, programs and applications by the citizens, organisations or other persons who created them to provide, including to organise and/or ensure the provision of, that information to interested persons, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-u9055abccbec90594f1-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-ufe012b8ef6ff758088-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred and fifty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufe012b8ef6ff758088-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u31c93be8af67a8a8b1-1.text: 7. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 6 of this Article —
koap-u31c93be8af67a8a8b1-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-uc4045dec742038b0da-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc4045dec742038b0da-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-uf3d61160869cbfd028-1.text: Note. Parts 6 and 7 of this Article shall not apply to the cases provided for by Parts 27–27.2 of Article 62 of Federal Law of 13 July 2015 No. 218-FZ “On State Registration of Real Estate”.
koap-uf3d61160869cbfd028-1.locator: Article 14.35. Violation of legislation on state cadastral registration of real estate and cadastral activities

koap-u860042154399896702-1.text: Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity
koap-u860042154399896702-1.locator: Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity

koap-u5437cf78e9502b94c5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity
koap-u5437cf78e9502b94c5-1.locator: Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity

koap-u0b142bd31fcf440097-1.text: Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity to its members (shareholders, members or founders), where provision of those documents is required by law, —
koap-u0b142bd31fcf440097-1.locator: Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity

koap-u85b306a4867c39dae6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two thousand to five thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u85b306a4867c39dae6-1.locator: Article 14.36. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents concerning a dispute relating to the establishment, management of or participation in a legal entity

koap-ub3f99154aa27db82c6-1.text: Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure
koap-ub3f99154aa27db82c6-1.locator: Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure

koap-uf82a59e39bdab29cc1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure
koap-uf82a59e39bdab29cc1-1.locator: Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure

koap-ub8f8c80c0a53641fd3-1.text: Installation and/or operation of an advertising structure without the statutory permit for its installation and operation, or installation and/or operation of an advertising structure in violation of technical regulation requirements, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 11.21 of this Code, —
koap-ub8f8c80c0a53641fd3-1.locator: Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure

koap-u24af7197512883be1b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, three thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u24af7197512883be1b-1.locator: Article 14.37. Violation of requirements for installing and/or operating an advertising structure

koap-uabafc1e95e3f1cc3e7-1.text: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles
koap-uabafc1e95e3f1cc3e7-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u3494f7cd32e82e2c0d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles
koap-u3494f7cd32e82e2c0d-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u885ba0908c2f824f6a-1.text: 1. Placing advertising resembling road signs, or placing advertising on a road sign, its support or any other device intended to regulate road traffic, —
koap-u885ba0908c2f824f6a-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u774d8b3394f8f22ef3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u774d8b3394f8f22ef3-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-udffe017bd6b01f3f9d-1.text: 2. Using a vehicle exclusively or predominantly as a mobile advertising structure, including modifying a vehicle to disseminate advertising so that it wholly or partly loses the functions for which it was designed, or modifying the vehicle’s body to give it the appearance of a particular product, —
koap-udffe017bd6b01f3f9d-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-uf0cf9c0cc1f20831e0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uf0cf9c0cc1f20831e0-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u779db89d6492680415-1.text: 3. Placing advertising on a vehicle bearing the special external colour and graphic markings of emergency service vehicles, a vehicle equipped with special light and sound signalling devices, a federal postal service vehicle bearing diagonal white stripes on a blue background on its sides, or a vehicle intended to carry dangerous goods, —
koap-u779db89d6492680415-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-ubab0f3cf62906680ec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ubab0f3cf62906680ec-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-uaf19c21870d62c773b-1.text: 4. Placing advertising on a vehicle that threatens road safety, including advertising that restricts the view of the driver or other road users, —
koap-uaf19c21870d62c773b-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u15f313224ab936348f-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u15f313224ab936348f-2.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-u851b9d7d0be7f1a096-1.text: 5. Dissemination of audio advertising using vehicles, or audio accompaniment to advertising disseminated using vehicles, —
koap-u851b9d7d0be7f1a096-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-uad8c4de3298d2aadc3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, four thousand to seven thousand roubles; for legal entities, forty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uad8c4de3298d2aadc3-1.locator: Article 14.38. Placing advertising on road signs and vehicles

koap-ue599ef2cde89026c7b-1.text: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services
koap-ue599ef2cde89026c7b-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-uee4c3ab5f786b51ae4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services
koap-uee4c3ab5f786b51ae4-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u9d574d642c76b9817e-1.text: 1. Providing accommodation establishment services without information about the establishment being included in the register of classified accommodation establishments, or providing services at an establishment whose classification has ceased to have effect, —
koap-u9d574d642c76b9817e-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u81fe8fbf14af69f608-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to four hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u81fe8fbf14af69f608-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u47d51336aa021978f9-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order of the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry to remedy that violation of legislation, —
koap-u47d51336aa021978f9-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-ufae33456797fc5ac8d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, one fortieth to one twenty-fifth of total revenue from selling all goods (work or services) in the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or in the part of the calendar year preceding the date of detection if the offender did not engage in sales of goods (work or services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufae33456797fc5ac8d-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u9f98b381fe6fae1dcb-1.text: 3. Providing services at an accommodation establishment that does not meet the requirements for the type of accommodation establishment specified in the register of classified accommodation establishments, or concluding an agreement to provide accommodation establishment services or hotel services while the establishment’s classification is suspended, —
koap-u9f98b381fe6fae1dcb-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u49837eff996e43a0ac-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and seventy thousand roubles.
koap-u49837eff996e43a0ac-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-ua6c0777a5a91103c36-1.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 3 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order of the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry to remedy that violation of legislation, —
koap-ua6c0777a5a91103c36-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u9f4d4757d997d3cb1d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9f4d4757d997d3cb1d-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-uf151736c974c4e78af-1.text: 5. Using, in advertising, in an accommodation establishment’s name or in activity involving the establishment, a type and/or category that does not correspond to the establishment’s type and/or category specified in the register of classified accommodation establishments —
koap-uf151736c974c4e78af-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u5583b335b7ddf73af8-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u5583b335b7ddf73af8-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-uda3ce4086c6023c345-1.text: 6. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 5 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order of the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry to remedy that violation of legislation, —
koap-uda3ce4086c6023c345-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-ubbc5fc0fab37f879a7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ubbc5fc0fab37f879a7-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u3cf730b772562e2051-1.text: 7. Posting by the owner of an accommodation establishment of information about its services (including on the Internet information and telecommunications network) without the establishment’s identification number assigned in the register of classified accommodation establishments and/or a link on the Internet information and telecommunications network to the register entry containing information about the establishment —
koap-u3cf730b772562e2051-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u81f70388639e5e999b-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u81f70388639e5e999b-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u889aa102dd56186730-1.text: 8. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 7 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order of the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry to remedy that violation of legislation, —
koap-u889aa102dd56186730-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u563f93f532b4e5234f-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u563f93f532b4e5234f-5.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-31.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-9.text: 1. Persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-9.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u5cc5812c142075e344-1.text: 2. For the purposes of this Article, revenue from sales of goods (work or services) shall be determined in accordance with Article 249 of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-u5cc5812c142075e344-1.locator: Article 14.39. Violation of requirements of legislation on accommodation establishment services

koap-u9134443750a2ec579e-1.text: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities
koap-u9134443750a2ec579e-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u8e27f6f63f0c25599a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities
koap-u8e27f6f63f0c25599a-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u21bc4dfe003f9dfddf-1.text: 1. Creation by an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain, or an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains of discriminatory conditions as defined by Federal Law of 26 July 2006 No. 135-FZ “On Protection of Competition”, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u21bc4dfe003f9dfddf-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two million to five million roubles.
koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u1b5741e1a1569553eb-1.text: 2. Creation by an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain, or an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains of obstacles to other economic entities entering or leaving a product market, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u1b5741e1a1569553eb-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two million to five million roubles.
koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-2.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-udc99bfd74771f8edda-1.text: 3. Violation by an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain, or an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains of the pricing procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.6 of this Code, —
koap-udc99bfd74771f8edda-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two million to five million roubles.
koap-u9f6f3c42175f18eb58-3.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u71cebc235c3e1b943c-1.text: 4. Imposition by an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain, or an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains on a counterparty of terms prohibited by federal law, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u71cebc235c3e1b943c-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u5100cc499e5f473e8c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, two million five hundred thousand to five million roubles.
koap-u5100cc499e5f473e8c-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-ub404b10962e609b412-1.text: 5. Conclusion between an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain and an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains of an agreement for trading activities under which goods are transferred to a third party for sale without ownership of the goods passing to that party, including a commission agreement, mandate agreement, agency agreement or mixed agreement containing elements of one or all of those agreements, except agreements concluded within a single group of persons defined under Federal Law of 26 July 2006 No. 135-FZ “On Protection of Competition” and/or agreements between economic entities forming a retail chain; or performance (implementation) of such agreements —
koap-ub404b10962e609b412-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u443cf67636916a283b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million five hundred thousand to four million five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u443cf67636916a283b-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u17f605f55f07b03e7e-1.text: 6. Repeated commission within a year of an administrative offence provided for by Parts 1–5 of this Article —
koap-u17f605f55f07b03e7e-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u4b7a78c5b7491bddf3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, three million to five million roubles.
koap-u4b7a78c5b7491bddf3-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u236ef6c122590859af-1.text: Note. The administrative liability provided for by Part 5 of this Article shall be determined according to the degree of fault of the economic entity selling food products through a retail chain and the economic entity supplying food products to retail chains.
koap-u236ef6c122590859af-1.locator: Article 14.40. Violation of antimonopoly rules established by federal law in conducting trading activities

koap-u3d8faaf09d3d864669-1.text: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities
koap-u3d8faaf09d3d864669-1.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u452f8467a37162b80d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities
koap-u452f8467a37162b80d-1.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-uae3978d799e0fb21cf-1.text: 1. Failure by an economic entity conducting trading activities through a retail chain to provide, at a counterparty’s request, information about the criteria for selecting a counterparty to conclude a food supply agreement and the essential terms of that agreement —
koap-uae3978d799e0fb21cf-1.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u7bd8484f548ae96401-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7bd8484f548ae96401-1.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u2e3e560af99ac11aee-1.text: 2. Failure by an economic entity supplying food products to provide, at a counterparty’s request, information about the criteria for selecting a counterparty to conclude a food supply agreement, the essential terms of that agreement, and the quality and safety of the food products supplied —
koap-u2e3e560af99ac11aee-1.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u7bd8484f548ae96401-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7bd8484f548ae96401-2.locator: Article 14.41. Violation of federal-law requirements to provide information about terms for concluding food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-uebbe468fb327502911-1.text: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities
koap-uebbe468fb327502911-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u953e098fec534c61c9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities
koap-u953e098fec534c61c9-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u732b0d42a520924490-1.text: 1. A total amount of remuneration paid to an economic entity conducting trading activities for purchasing a certain quantity of food products from an economic entity supplying them, together with fees for product promotion services, logistics services, preparation, processing and packaging of those goods and similar services, exceeding 5 percent of the price of the food products purchased; or payment of that remuneration for the purchase by an economic entity conducting trading activities of certain socially significant food products included in the list established by the Government of the Russian Federation —
koap-u732b0d42a520924490-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-ubb52c45aaa9bb77aa1-1.text: 2. Inclusion by an economic entity conducting trading activities and/or an economic entity supplying food products in the price of a food supply agreement of types of remuneration not provided for by federal law, or performance (implementation) of that agreement in the relevant part, —
koap-ubb52c45aaa9bb77aa1-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-2.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-udef522762991f5ed2f-1.text: 3. Setting by an economic entity conducting trading activities and/or an economic entity supplying food products in a food supply agreement of payment periods exceeding those established by federal law, or performance (implementation) of that agreement in the relevant part, —
koap-udef522762991f5ed2f-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-3.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-ud85b0fb4dfc5585e3c-1.text: 4. Setting by an economic entity conducting trading activities and/or an economic entity supplying food products in a food supply agreement of a prohibition on substitution of persons in an obligation under that agreement by assignment of a claim; or imposing civil liability for breach of that prohibition by the parties; or performance (implementation) of that agreement in the relevant part —
koap-ud85b0fb4dfc5585e3c-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-4.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u79d249ec48a8bc0b69-1.text: 5. Inclusion by an economic entity conducting trading activities and/or an economic entity supplying food products in a food supply agreement of terms requiring the trading entity to perform, in relation to the food products supplied, acts involving product promotion services, preparation, processing and packaging of those goods or similar services, or performance (implementation) of that agreement in the relevant part, —
koap-u79d249ec48a8bc0b69-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
koap-u63c8581a286bbee49d-5.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u8728d4ccf25106609c-1.text: 6. Compulsion by an economic entity conducting trading activities or an economic entity supplying food products to conclude and/or perform a paid services agreement (including with third parties) for product promotion services, preparation, processing and packaging of those goods or similar services, or other agreements, when concluding and/or performing (implementing) a supply agreement, —
koap-u8728d4ccf25106609c-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u023d0daebb29b90b8a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three million to five million roubles.
koap-u023d0daebb29b90b8a-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-ud7f72cd0ffc8e1be98-1.text: 7. Acts prohibited by federal law involving the collection or payment of fees or reimbursement of expenses by an economic entity selling food products through a retail chain and/or an economic entity supplying food products to retail chains —
koap-ud7f72cd0ffc8e1be98-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-ubbf15d99e5d71d6e5b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to five million roubles.
