koap-ubbf15d99e5d71d6e5b-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-32.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u60eb0179cb70a4f353-1.text: 1. For the purposes of Part 6 of this Article, compulsion means acts by a person aimed at making the conclusion of a food supply agreement conditional on conclusion of another agreement.
koap-u60eb0179cb70a4f353-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u2d01d6cb495d233569-1.text: 2. The provisions of this Article establishing administrative liability for an economic entity conducting trading activities and an economic entity supplying food products shall also apply to persons in the same group as those entities under Federal Law of 26 July 2006 No. 135-FZ “On Protection of Competition”.
koap-u2d01d6cb495d233569-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u63d2654af0a7ae8f11-1.text: 3. Articles 14.40 and 14.41 of this Chapter and this Article shall apply to legal relations governed by Federal Law of 28 December 2009 No. 381-FZ “On the Fundamentals of State Regulation of Trading Activities in the Russian Federation”.
koap-u63d2654af0a7ae8f11-1.locator: Article 14.42. Violation of federal-law requirements for terms of food supply agreements in trading activities

koap-u54d73a27cfab426afd-1.text: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements
koap-u54d73a27cfab426afd-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u4a64b21c25d29b484e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements
koap-u4a64b21c25d29b484e-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u9f5064a4c7bdc1e2b6-1.text: 1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements or mandatory requirements applicable until the corresponding technical regulations enter into force for products, or products and the related processes of design (including surveys), production, construction, installation, commissioning, operation, storage, transportation, sale and disposal that are connected with product requirements, or release into circulation of products not complying with those requirements, except in the cases provided for by Part 4 of this Article and Articles 6.31, 9.4, 10.3, 10.6 and 10.8, Part 2 of Article 11.21, and Articles 14.37, 14.43.1, 14.44, 14.46, 14.46.1 and 20.4 of this Code, —
koap-u9f5064a4c7bdc1e2b6-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u509dfde4f3f1b3a1a0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u509dfde4f3f1b3a1a0-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u5797a4d9ccaa9a30aa-1.text: 2. Acts provided for by Part 1 of this Article that caused harm to citizens’ life or health, property of individuals or legal entities, state or municipal property, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants, or created a risk of harm to citizens’ life or health, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants —
koap-u5797a4d9ccaa9a30aa-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-ubdb3968242272dd55c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-ubdb3968242272dd55c-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-10.text: 3. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub3e21dfb875f13fb43-10.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-uec4ab3c58c31394bb3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of those items, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days with confiscation of those items; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles with confiscation of those items, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days with confiscation of those items.
koap-uec4ab3c58c31394bb3-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u1cfcef8ed72993d623-1.text: 4. Failure by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur selling goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means to comply with the established ban on selling goods whose expiry date has passed, after receiving information from the monitoring information system that the ban has been introduced, —
koap-u1cfcef8ed72993d623-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u69825140748607fb2b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of ten thousand roubles for each unit of expired goods sold; for legal entities, twenty thousand roubles for each unit of expired goods sold.
koap-u69825140748607fb2b-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u9f6771bb557936ee8f-1.text: Note. In this Article and Articles 14.46.2 and 14.47 of this Code, mandatory requirements applicable until the corresponding technical regulations enter into force mean mandatory requirements for products, or products and the related processes of design (including surveys), production, construction, installation, commissioning, operation, storage, transportation, sale and disposal that are connected with product requirements established by normative legal acts applicable in accordance with the Treaty on the Eurasian Economic Union of 29 May 2014, as well as requirements, not contrary to those acts, of normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and normative legal acts of federal executive bodies that must be complied with under Clauses 1–2 and 6.2 of Article 46 of Federal Law of 27 December 2002 No. 184-FZ “On Technical Regulation”.
koap-u9f6771bb557936ee8f-1.locator: Article 14.43. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of technical regulation requirements

koap-u3207140e4c2ab68695-1.text: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil
koap-u3207140e4c2ab68695-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u0bc4d4cd158bbe37d7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil
koap-u0bc4d4cd158bbe37d7-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-uc9b27b67022ab82768-1.text: 1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil, except in the case provided for by Part 2 of this Article, —
koap-uc9b27b67022ab82768-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u456bcdbfc783c9b581-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u456bcdbfc783c9b581-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-uf5d13da205b89cb4f3-1.text: 2. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil consisting in non-compliance of the characteristics of motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil with those requirements —
koap-uf5d13da205b89cb4f3-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u43ab3a7350c0ed1685-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of 1 percent of revenue from fuel sales in the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or in the part of the calendar year preceding the date of detection if the offender did not engage in fuel sales in the preceding calendar year, but not less than five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u43ab3a7350c0ed1685-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u65fb50a576af315731-1.text: 3. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article by a person previously subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence —
koap-u65fb50a576af315731-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-uc0646149a092ef301f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of 3 percent of revenue from fuel sales in the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or in the part of the calendar year preceding the date of detection if the offender did not engage in fuel sales in the preceding calendar year, but not less than two million roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days with confiscation of those items.
koap-uc0646149a092ef301f-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-33.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-10.text: 1. Persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-10.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-uf2c38dc4b008e1e5a7-1.text: 2. For the purposes of Part 2 of this Article, characteristics of motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil mean the indicators (requirements) specified in Clauses 4.1–4.12 of Article 4 of the Customs Union Technical Regulation “On Requirements for Motor and Aviation Petrol, Diesel and Marine Fuel, Jet Fuel and Fuel Oil” and its Appendices 2–7.
koap-uf2c38dc4b008e1e5a7-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u6941455f82923cb009-1.text: 3. To calculate the administrative fine provided for by the sanction in Part 2 or 3 of this Article, the offender’s revenue from sales of fuel subject to the Customs Union Technical Regulation “On Requirements for Motor and Aviation Petrol, Diesel and Marine Fuel, Jet Fuel and Fuel Oil” at the specific site where the administrative offence was established shall be used.
koap-u6941455f82923cb009-1.locator: Article 14.43.1. Violation by a manufacturer, contractor (a person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) or seller of the technical regulation on requirements for motor and aviation petrol, diesel and marine fuel, jet fuel and fuel oil

koap-u78e8e5b6bdcf9234ca-1.text: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity
koap-u78e8e5b6bdcf9234ca-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u51fcf60a7efd170306-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity
koap-u51fcf60a7efd170306-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-ua6a7bd8ef021a7c4d1-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u5fdff7f6367fc10ed1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5fdff7f6367fc10ed1-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-uc6214e37f83c665d4e-1.text: 2. Inaccurate declaration of conformity of products first released into circulation that belong to a kind or type of product subject to mandatory certification, or inaccurate declaration of those products on the basis of one’s own evidence where standardisation documents whose application ensures compliance with technical regulation requirements are absent or cannot be applied, —
koap-uc6214e37f83c665d4e-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u7d9790f9ac54375a65-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty-five thousand to thirty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7d9790f9ac54375a65-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u0d4deef44b67d16b21-1.text: 3. Acts provided for by Parts 1 and 2 of this Article that caused harm to citizens’ life or health, property of individuals or legal entities, state or municipal property, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants, or created a risk of harm to citizens’ life or health, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants —
koap-u0d4deef44b67d16b21-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u01d33b3b0438b5fc08-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u01d33b3b0438b5fc08-1.locator: Article 14.44. Inaccurate declaration of product conformity

koap-u61c8b191147ee16380-1.text: Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment
koap-u61c8b191147ee16380-1.locator: Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-udf2e52bd96e16d2618-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment
koap-udf2e52bd96e16d2618-1.locator: Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u9d6383b399cfc769ec-1.text: Selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment without information about the certificate of conformity or declaration of conformity in the accompanying documentation —
koap-u9d6383b399cfc769ec-1.locator: Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u2e42ea4634c5686320-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2e42ea4634c5686320-1.locator: Article 14.45. Violation of the procedure for selling products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u5488005ce9d9f892d1-1.text: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment
koap-u5488005ce9d9f892d1-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-ub889769cb08fe3da46-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment
koap-ub889769cb08fe3da46-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-udf808ad784cf341caa-1.text: 1. Marking products with a market circulation mark when their conformity with technical regulation requirements has not been confirmed in the procedure prescribed by technical regulation legislation, or marking products with a conformity mark when their conformity with technical regulation requirements has not been confirmed in that procedure, —
koap-udf808ad784cf341caa-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u2d5b13fbbd591101e2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2d5b13fbbd591101e2-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u5797a4d9ccaa9a30aa-2.text: 2. Acts provided for by Part 1 of this Article that caused harm to citizens’ life or health, property of individuals or legal entities, state or municipal property, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants, or created a risk of harm to citizens’ life or health, the environment, or the life or health of animals and plants —
koap-u5797a4d9ccaa9a30aa-2.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u753f660b46f9ec0dc7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u753f660b46f9ec0dc7-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-u4e701301ffdb87509b-1.text: Note. In this Article and other Articles of this Code, a product market circulation mark means a circulation mark for the market of the Russian Federation, a unified product circulation mark for the markets of Customs Union member states, and a unified product circulation mark for the markets of EurAsEC member states.
koap-u4e701301ffdb87509b-1.locator: Article 14.46. Violation of the procedure for marking products subject to mandatory conformity assessment

koap-ub605fd8a84bbec718b-1.locator: Article 14.46.1. Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms

koap-u96183069e57025c748-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.46.1. Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms
koap-u96183069e57025c748-1.locator: Article 14.46.1. Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms

koap-u48327c94872c8be749-1.text: Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms, concerning information about the presence in the food of components derived from genetically modified organisms or produced using such organisms, —
koap-u48327c94872c8be749-1.locator: Article 14.46.1. Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms

koap-ud4e25d901cfeabc0e5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of those items.
koap-ud4e25d901cfeabc0e5-1.locator: Article 14.46.1. Violation of mandatory labelling requirements for food products produced using genetically modified organisms or containing such organisms

koap-ue92c0897b7c6831120-1.text: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements
koap-ue92c0897b7c6831120-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u6df5f270d9817fa46e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements
koap-u6df5f270d9817fa46e-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-ue78cf1f1e6b80a6066-1.text: 1. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) who becomes aware that products it released into circulation do not comply with technical regulation requirements or mandatory product requirements applicable until the corresponding technical regulations enter into force to fulfil the obligation to inform a federal executive body or an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised under the legislation of the Russian Federation to exercise state control (supervision) over compliance with technical regulation requirements of the products’ non-compliance with those requirements —
koap-ue78cf1f1e6b80a6066-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u86a79f2db1a6a61f02-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u86a79f2db1a6a61f02-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u436cb76d0923c36200-1.text: 2. Failure by a manufacturer (seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to fulfil the obligation to verify the accuracy of information received about products’ non-compliance with technical regulation requirements or mandatory product requirements applicable until the corresponding technical regulations enter into force, or failure by a manufacturer (seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to comply with a demand of a federal executive body or an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation authorised under the legislation of the Russian Federation to exercise state control (supervision) over compliance with technical regulation requirements to submit the materials of that verification to the relevant body, —
koap-u436cb76d0923c36200-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u911dee95ff4b885b01-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-u911dee95ff4b885b01-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u762c09633f7499be49-1.text: 3. Failure by a manufacturer (seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to carry out measures specified in a harm-prevention programme developed in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on technical regulation —
koap-u762c09633f7499be49-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-ue66bc8138836f37292-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue66bc8138836f37292-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u2922cd1871e98b476d-1.text: 4. Failure by a manufacturer (seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to fulfil the obligation to suspend production and sale of products not complying with technical regulation requirements or mandatory product requirements applicable until the corresponding technical regulations enter into force, or to recall those products if the risk of harm cannot be eliminated by carrying out the measures specified in a harm-prevention programme developed in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on technical regulation, —
koap-u2922cd1871e98b476d-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-u51ce8cf05871b9f3fd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u51ce8cf05871b9f3fd-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-3.text: 5. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 4 of this Article —
koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-3.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-uac16c157a7d5cc9375-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for individual entrepreneurs of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days with confiscation of those items; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles with confiscation of those items, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days with confiscation of those items.
koap-uac16c157a7d5cc9375-1.locator: Article 14.46.2. Failure by a manufacturer (contractor, seller or person performing the functions of a foreign manufacturer) to take measures to prevent harm from the circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements

koap-uad3f7c280f9c40521a-1.text: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work
koap-uad3f7c280f9c40521a-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u78d221942c0fd8052c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work
koap-u78d221942c0fd8052c-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u9c6071300fa48431ef-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for performing certification work, or issuance of a certificate of conformity in violation of requirements of technical regulation legislation, —
koap-u9c6071300fa48431ef-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-ud551d406062ae4fdbf-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud551d406062ae4fdbf-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u70751b1056dfe392db-1.text: 2. Acts provided for by Part 1 of this Article resulting in the release into circulation of products not complying with technical regulation requirements or mandatory requirements applicable before the corresponding technical regulations enter into force —
koap-u70751b1056dfe392db-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u3f75baea7acc303676-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, six hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u3f75baea7acc303676-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u30877bb77d61f28beb-1.text: 3. Unjustified issuance by a certification body of, or refusal to issue, a certificate of conformity, or unjustified suspension or termination of a certificate of conformity, —
koap-u30877bb77d61f28beb-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u6bb15c0687a30483b2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6bb15c0687a30483b2-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-ufb0d59148ca242d9dd-1.text: 4. Violation by a certification body of the prescribed form of a certificate of conformity or of the rules established by Customs Union legislation for completing that form, where this does not result in unjustified issuance of a certificate of conformity by the certification body, —
koap-ufb0d59148ca242d9dd-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-uea158ac1959af48a59-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-uea158ac1959af48a59-1.locator: Article 14.47. Violation of rules for performing certification work

koap-u9ae50842e02d789fe0-1.text: Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results
koap-u9ae50842e02d789fe0-1.locator: Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results

koap-ubca874b1f751e38720-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results
koap-ubca874b1f751e38720-1.locator: Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results

koap-ub3adc43e3ef269529e-1.text: Submission by a testing laboratory (centre), for the purposes of conformity assessment (confirmation), of inaccurate or non-objective results of research (tests) and/or measurements of products —
koap-ub3adc43e3ef269529e-1.locator: Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results

koap-uea56bb8b3d9084b00f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uea56bb8b3d9084b00f-1.locator: Article 14.48. Submission of inaccurate research (test) results

koap-u4364ac50ddc08625d5-1.text: Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions
koap-u4364ac50ddc08625d5-1.locator: Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions

koap-u340b2011e3ec2df296-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions
koap-u340b2011e3ec2df296-1.locator: Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions

koap-u8148f9b09de207057e-1.text: Failure, within the established periods when conducting foreign trade barter transactions, to fulfil the obligation to import goods of equivalent value into the Russian Federation, have foreign persons provide services or perform work of equivalent value, transfer exclusive intellectual property rights of equivalent value or grant rights to use intellectual property; or failure to fulfil the obligation to credit funds to accounts in authorised banks where the barter transaction provides for partial use of money and/or other means of payment or where goods are sold without being imported into the Russian Federation; or failure to confirm fulfilment of that obligation —
koap-u8148f9b09de207057e-1.locator: Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions

koap-u2348416df085ad65aa-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to the full value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u2348416df085ad65aa-1.locator: Article 14.50. Failure to fulfil obligations and requirements when conducting foreign trade barter transactions

koap-u10ecb93b2fd17931d4-1.text: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-u10ecb93b2fd17931d4-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u8e431d39625f169aad-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-u8e431d39625f169aad-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ua2baa12e5db8135865-1.text: 1. Conducting tour operator activities by a person whose information is absent from the unified federal register of tour operators —
koap-ua2baa12e5db8135865-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u3da01b841b43aded5f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year; for legal entities, five million to ten million roubles.
koap-u3da01b841b43aded5f-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u2a717c71b1b669f5a5-1.text: 2. Violation by a tour operator of the statutory procedure for determining the amount of financial security for the tour operator’s liability when conducting tour operator activities; or failure to submit information about the tour operator, or submission of inaccurate information, to the authorised federal executive body for tourism to amend the information about the tour operator in the unified federal register of tour operators —
koap-u2a717c71b1b669f5a5-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u3f39dd8201d17b8a68-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u3f39dd8201d17b8a68-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ue4fa101628a63b3111-1.text: 3. Conducting outbound tourism activities by a tour operator that is not a member of the association of tour operators in outbound tourism —
koap-ue4fa101628a63b3111-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u31bc76227886907886-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for six months to one year; for legal entities, one million to three million roubles.
koap-u31bc76227886907886-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u196f169d24ec811c62-1.text: 4. Violation by an organisation conducting classification in the tourism industry of the requirements established by the tourism legislation of the Russian Federation for organisations classifying accommodation establishments, ski slopes or beaches, or requirements of the regulations on classification of accommodation establishments, the rules for classifying accommodation establishments or the rules for classifying ski slopes or beaches, —
koap-u196f169d24ec811c62-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6c330c3ae5abd53a65-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u6c330c3ae5abd53a65-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ucaaeb680c1fbfb093e-1.text: 5. Failure by a tour operator to enter information about a travel agent promoting and selling a tourism product assembled by that tour operator in the unified federal register of travel agents and subagents (hereinafter, the travel agent register); entry of travel agent information in breach of the procedure prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation; or entry of inaccurate information in that register —
koap-ucaaeb680c1fbfb093e-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-3.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u690bdc88111233ee39-1.text: 6. Failure by a travel agent to enter information about a subagent promoting and selling a tourism product assembled by a tour operator in the travel agent register; entry of subagent information in breach of the procedure prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation; or entry of inaccurate information in that register —
koap-u690bdc88111233ee39-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-4.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ue270db9851dd934daa-1.text: 7. Conducting travel agent activities by a person whose information is absent from the travel agent register or a person not entitled to conduct travel agent activities —
koap-ue270db9851dd934daa-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u758f72849d788a9d4a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u758f72849d788a9d4a-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ucc984a41eb06df991f-1.text: 8. Promotion and sale of a tourism product by a travel agent where the travel agent register does not contain information that the agent and the tour operator that assembled the product concluded an agreement to promote and sell the tourism product assembled by the tour operator —
koap-ucc984a41eb06df991f-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-5.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u1067201d2fe9f19aa9-1.text: 9. Delegation by a travel agent of the performance of a tour operator’s instruction to promote and sell a tourism product where the agent is not entitled to make that delegation —
koap-u1067201d2fe9f19aa9-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-6.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u9955052ff0e513cb94-1.text: 10. Promotion and sale of a tourism product by a subagent where the travel agent register does not contain information about an agreement between the subagent and travel agent providing for delegation of the performance of a tour operator’s instruction to promote and sell the tourism product assembled by that tour operator —
koap-u9955052ff0e513cb94-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7be6fa565ee7e8f1ee-7.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6da09316a2a2df7a27-1.text: 11. Providing services to accompany tourists (excursionists) on a tourism route (part of a route) on which they require special accompaniment (hereinafter, a tourism route requiring special accompaniment), without engaging an instructor-guide where required by federal law; or providing services to accompany tourists (excursionists) on a route requiring special accompaniment by a person who is not a certified instructor-guide —
koap-u6da09316a2a2df7a27-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ud565bace31b590cf8c-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for officials, seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud565bace31b590cf8c-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u367e9a964340a5a5d6-1.text: 12. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 11 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order to remedy that violation of legislation issued by the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry or the body (official) exercising state supervision over the protection and use of specially protected natural areas, —
koap-u367e9a964340a5a5d6-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u0fd4a9ebf3addea3cb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u0fd4a9ebf3addea3cb-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u77fa5bd21aa96d52b9-1.text: 13. Providing services introducing tourists (excursionists) to sights, accompanying them and informing them along a tourism route without engaging a certified excursion guide (tour guide) or guide-interpreter, or providing those services by a person who is not a certified excursion guide (tour guide) or certified guide-interpreter, where the legislation of the Russian Federation requires engagement of such certified guides, —
koap-u77fa5bd21aa96d52b9-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ucbd89d45281488ce3c-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of seven thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ucbd89d45281488ce3c-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u4d24e3e321124a4595-1.text: 14. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 13 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order to remedy that violation of legislation issued by the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry or the body (official) exercising state supervision over the protection and use of specially protected natural areas, —
koap-u4d24e3e321124a4595-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ua4f250bdd98b715044-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ua4f250bdd98b715044-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6c72cd74ef6e5549d3-1.text: 15. Providing services introducing tourists (excursionists) to sights, accompanying them and informing them along a tourism route, or accompanying them on a route requiring special accompaniment, by a person who is not carrying the chest-worn identification card of an excursion guide (tour guide), guide-interpreter or instructor-guide, —
koap-u6c72cd74ef6e5549d3-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u0a4914ff8d2d56854a-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u0a4914ff8d2d56854a-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u96a9b8929bcdf8c7b0-1.text: 16. Failure by a legal entity, individual entrepreneur or instructor-guide planning to accompany tourists (excursionists) and ensure their safety on tourism routes requiring special accompaniment to provide, for the purpose of avoiding classification of the tourism route (part of a route) as requiring special accompaniment, information on obstacles on that route, including diving conditions (for underwater tourism routes), which are specified in the criteria for assigning tourism routes to the relevant difficulty category (including with regard to tourist safety) and whose presence on a route places it among routes requiring special accompaniment, —
koap-u96a9b8929bcdf8c7b0-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-uaacd6b4ccc3381007b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uaacd6b4ccc3381007b-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-uf91d4c24a549f5a447-2.text: 17. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 16 of this Article —
koap-uf91d4c24a549f5a447-2.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u593663114621ffb689-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, forty thousand to sixty thousand roubles.
koap-u593663114621ffb689-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u215225c43fdb14af17-1.text: 18. Failure by an instructor-guide to send notification of accompanying tourists (excursionists) on a tourism route requiring special accompaniment, before starting and after completing that route, to the territorial body of the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy on protecting the population and territories from natural and technological emergencies for the constituent entity of the Russian Federation through which the route passes, as well as to the executive body of that constituent entity authorised to exercise regional state control (supervision) over its tourism industry and to the organisation authorised to certify instructor-guides that certified the instructor-guide in question, —
koap-u215225c43fdb14af17-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6088a2a3f47069b0fc-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of seven thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u6088a2a3f47069b0fc-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6f08b9926c5da0a0f8-1.text: 19. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 18 of this Article, or failure to comply, within the prescribed period, with a lawful order of the body (official) exercising regional state control (supervision) over the tourism industry to remedy that violation of legislation, —
koap-u6f08b9926c5da0a0f8-1.locator: Article 14.51. Violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ub296737f43862e674e-1.text: 2. koap-u7c253e5ae3fe2d8532-1.locator: Article 14.52. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation of information disclosure obligations

koap-u88fc2d9c0e2578942f-1.locator: Article 14.52. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation of information disclosure obligations

koap-u99227c126da3247bc6-1.text: 4. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation membership of which is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation of the requirement to maintain an official website on the Internet —

koap-u013d692856c3e2e9d0-1.text: 1. Provision of consumer credits (loans) under consumer credit (loan) legislation, including those in which the borrower’s obligations are secured by a mortgage, by legal entities or individual entrepreneurs not entitled to conduct that activity —
koap-u013d692856c3e2e9d0-1.locator: Article 14.56. Unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those secured by a mortgage

koap-ud700ef900b297a4c95-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to fifteen days; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to fifteen days.
koap-ud700ef900b297a4c95-1.locator: Article 14.56. Unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those secured by a mortgage

koap-u39d212285675668651-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article, where that act does not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-u39d212285675668651-1.locator: Article 14.56. Unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those secured by a mortgage

koap-u01141f5dea66012776-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to two million roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days.
koap-u01141f5dea66012776-1.locator: Article 14.56. Unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those secured by a mortgage

koap-u86e3102cb507636f16-1.text: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
koap-u86e3102cb507636f16-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-uc03de6694905e862f0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals
koap-uc03de6694905e862f0-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-ud66724c1a8f4caeea5-1.text: 1. Providing services to solicit investments from individuals by a person not entitled to conduct that activity under legislation on protection of investors’ rights and legitimate interests in the securities market and restrictions on soliciting investments from individuals, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.62 of this Code, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-ud66724c1a8f4caeea5-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-u53a0fab6da4f322f2d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to sixty days.
koap-u53a0fab6da4f322f2d-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-uc070d5cb55a58776c5-1.text: 2. Soliciting investments from individuals in violation of the requirements of Clause 1 of Article 5.1 of Federal Law of 5 March 1999 No. 46-FZ “On Protection of the Rights and Legitimate Interests of Investors in the Securities Market”, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.62 of this Code, where those acts do not contain the elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-uc070d5cb55a58776c5-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-u3af7e17a280fd1ac3f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-u3af7e17a280fd1ac3f-1.locator: Article 14.56.1. Unlawful solicitation of investments from individuals

koap-u7649fe9ec2ebfffe70-1.text: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts
koap-u7649fe9ec2ebfffe70-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u597ca8b27b1eeac3ac-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts
koap-u597ca8b27b1eeac3ac-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u291abcd6f9be2884ec-1.text: 1. Violation by a creditor or creditor’s representative of the general rules for acts aimed at recovering individuals’ overdue debts established by Chapter 2 of Federal Law of 3 July 2016 No. 230-FZ “On Protection of the Rights and Legitimate Interests of Individuals in Activities to Recover Overdue Debts and on Amendments to the Federal Law ‘On Microfinance Activities and Microfinance Organisations’”, except in the cases provided for by Part 6 of this Article, where there are no elements of a criminal offence, —
koap-u291abcd6f9be2884ec-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u4b3aee2f495db58cae-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4b3aee2f495db58cae-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-ue2b67edd327305528f-1.text: 2. Failure by a professional debt collection organisation, or a credit institution or microfinance organisation included in the list of credit institutions and microfinance organisations recovering individuals’ overdue debts, to fulfil requirements and obligations imposed on such organisations by Clause 6 of Part 1 of Article 13 and Articles 17 and 17.1 of Federal Law of 3 July 2016 No. 230-FZ “On Protection of the Rights and Legitimate Interests of Individuals in Activities to Recover Overdue Debts and on Amendments to the Federal Law ‘On Microfinance Activities and Microfinance Organisations’” —
koap-ue2b67edd327305528f-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-udec3e73e2c9fb49917-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-udec3e73e2c9fb49917-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-ub3c58fbf4e1e04b2a8-1.text: 3. Violation by a founder (member), member of the board of directors (supervisory board), member of the collegial executive body or sole executive body of a professional debt collection organisation of the requirements and restrictions imposed on those persons by the legislation of the Russian Federation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts —
koap-ub3c58fbf4e1e04b2a8-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u4425710912e00edd81-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year.
koap-u4425710912e00edd81-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-ucc0187d88b9536251b-1.text: 4. Unlawful use by a legal entity of the phrase “professional debt collection organisation” in its name —
koap-ucc0187d88b9536251b-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u76c91009a6f32410d2-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u76c91009a6f32410d2-2.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u576ae0cc54b81a5be8-1.text: 5. Failure to comply with a decision restricting the use of one or more methods of interaction with a debtor issued by the federal executive body exercising federal state control (supervision) over professional debt collection organisations and credit institutions and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit institutions and microfinance organisations recovering individuals’ overdue debts —
koap-u576ae0cc54b81a5be8-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u15035454343ae7bcda-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u15035454343ae7bcda-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-ubfb56f4cbd44e99c80-1.text: 6. Interaction with a debtor aimed at recovering overdue debts by the methods provided for by Clauses 1 and 2 of Part 1 of Article 4 of Federal Law of 3 July 2016 No. 230-FZ “On Protection of the Rights and Legitimate Interests of Individuals in Activities to Recover Overdue Debts and on Amendments to the Federal Law ‘On Microfinance Activities and Microfinance Organisations’”, in violation of the restrictions established by Parts 1 and 2 of Article 5 of that Federal Law, —
koap-ubfb56f4cbd44e99c80-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-uf3f2a604635a5e89cb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to one million roubles, or disqualification for up to one year; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to two million roubles.
koap-uf3f2a604635a5e89cb-1.locator: Article 14.57. Violation of requirements of legislation protecting individuals’ rights and legitimate interests in activities to recover overdue debts

koap-u4fd65668c043d991b2-1.text: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate
koap-u4fd65668c043d991b2-1.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-u01f8cd71ae5b214d28-1.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-u4da6e9639277eb934b-1.text: 1. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate where federal law requires such a certificate, or violation of the method of using the film specified in the distribution certificate, —
koap-u4da6e9639277eb934b-1.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-uc2e6d17b48ab18dfa5-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc2e6d17b48ab18dfa5-2.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-27.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-27.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-ub657a4c4349fa44062-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, or administrative suspension of activity for up to ninety days.
koap-ub657a4c4349fa44062-1.locator: Article 14.58. Distribution and/or screening of a film without a distribution certificate

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-20.text: Note. Persons engaging in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities for the administrative offences provided for by this Article.

koap-u49015a9a8d0b8eb64d-1.locator: Article 14.59. Violation by an expert organisation of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system

koap-u2f4ff9d5cd41aa819a-1.text: Article 14.60. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system
koap-u2f4ff9d5cd41aa819a-1.locator: Article 14.60. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system

koap-uee8da29c93cfb84617-1.locator: Article 14.60. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system

koap-u593cd161a0cce14e0c-1.text: Issuance by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of certificates of conformity, research (test) or measurement reports, or other opinions and documents referring to accreditation in the national accreditation system where that accreditation is suspended or absent —
koap-u593cd161a0cce14e0c-1.locator: Article 14.60. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system

koap-u3195a523a550a1bd2e-2.locator: Article 14.60. Violation by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur of requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on accreditation in the national accreditation system

koap-ud1ca06aafbf979e9d4-1.text: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property
koap-ud1ca06aafbf979e9d4-1.locator: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property

koap-u078cb858612d1f89f8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property
koap-u078cb858612d1f89f8-1.locator: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property

koap-u2ecfb9c5449f241d34-1.text: 1. Organisation or conduct by a person of activities to raise funds and/or other property from individuals and/or legal entities whereby income is paid and/or another benefit is provided to persons whose funds and/or other property were raised earlier using funds and/or other property raised from other individuals and/or legal entities, in the absence of investment and/or other lawful entrepreneurial or other activity using the funds and/or other property raised on a scale comparable to the amount of funds and/or other property raised, where those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u2ecfb9c5449f241d34-1.locator: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property

koap-u51b4be9f2dadeb41e5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u51b4be9f2dadeb41e5-1.locator: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property

koap-u498677d90b2f3f2317-1.text: 2. Public dissemination of information about the attractiveness of participation in the activity specified in Part 1 of this Article and/or of providing funds or other property for that activity, and/or calls to participate in such activity, including through the mass media and/or information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, —
koap-u498677d90b2f3f2317-1.locator: Article 14.62. Activities to raise funds and/or other property

koap-u51b4be9f2dadeb41e5-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
