koap-u26552225de11f7db8a-1.text: 2. Violation of requirements for the amount, formation, placement and expenditure of the self-regulatory organisation’s compensation fund for harm and compensation fund securing contractual obligations, including payments from those funds, —
koap-u26552225de11f7db8a-1.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ub590777fe74ac15869-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub590777fe74ac15869-2.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ue627ae3c8d24c7c63e-1.text: 3. Violation of the established procedure, deadline or frequency for the self-regulatory organisation to inspect the activities of its members —
koap-ue627ae3c8d24c7c63e-1.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u9ecca84686b186a492-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9ecca84686b186a492-2.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u3787077cd27c406eb9-1.text: 4. Admission to the self-regulatory organisation of a person not meeting the established requirements, or failure to take measures to expel such a person from that organisation, —
koap-u3787077cd27c406eb9-1.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u6d6a843f6b46bd87b8-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6d6a843f6b46bd87b8-2.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u576f5ac0f4307afd91-1.text: 5. Violation of the established procedure for applying disciplinary measures to members of the self-regulatory organisation or considering cases concerning violations by its members of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation —
koap-u576f5ac0f4307afd91-1.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ud2e213bd181788e210-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ud2e213bd181788e210-2.locator: Article 14.64.1. Violation by a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, or the construction, reconstruction, capital repair or demolition of capital construction facilities and its officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-ua4b2921f20c34c3283-1.text: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation
koap-ua4b2921f20c34c3283-1.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u756be1dcb56b76cfce-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation
koap-u756be1dcb56b76cfce-1.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u9e3f47df871ec93e50-1.text: 1. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction (hereinafter in this Article, the national associations of self-regulatory organisations) of the procedure for assessing whether member self-regulatory organisations comply with requirements for a self-regulatory organisation and its activities —
koap-u9e3f47df871ec93e50-1.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-2.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u3963a7cdfbe3d2a43d-1.text: 2. Failure by the national associations of self-regulatory organisations to post on their official websites on the Internet information contained in the national register of engineering survey and architectural and construction design specialists or the national register of construction specialists; information about the amounts of compensation fund money of self-regulatory organisations removed from the state register of self-regulatory organisations credited to the national associations’ special bank accounts; information contained in the unified register of information about self-regulatory organisation members and their obligations; or self-regulation rules; or breach of deadlines for posting that information and those documents on their official websites on the Internet —
koap-u3963a7cdfbe3d2a43d-1.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-3.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-3.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u717b38ebfa0ce27d2d-1.text: 3. Violation by the national associations of self-regulatory organisations of the procedure for maintaining the national register of engineering survey and architectural and construction design specialists, the national register of construction specialists, or the unified register of information about self-regulatory organisation members and their obligations —
koap-u717b38ebfa0ce27d2d-1.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-4.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8e6864b55dda9d3cab-4.locator: Article 14.64.2. Violation by the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Engineering Surveys and Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Preparing Design Documentation, or the National Association of Self-Regulatory Organisations Based on Membership of Persons Performing Construction, and their officials of requirements of federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation

koap-u946fc1ba6e4ba19d92-1.text: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement
koap-u946fc1ba6e4ba19d92-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u26c52ad22d93deb265-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement
koap-u26c52ad22d93deb265-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u2c45cff0b040ae0e3c-1.text: Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement, consisting in the provision of services for children's recreation and health improvement by a children's recreation and health improvement organisation or an individual entrepreneur not included in the register of children's recreation and health improvement organisations, —
koap-u2c45cff0b040ae0e3c-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u843f75b342d988cf8f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u843f75b342d988cf8f-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-35.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-uc486f95b481cfd3d0c-1.text: 1. This Article shall not apply to organisations and individual entrepreneurs removed from the register of children's recreation and health improvement organisations, provided that those organisations and individual entrepreneurs are completing the performance of obligations they have assumed to provide children's recreation and health improvement, and there is no threat of harm to children's life or health.
koap-uc486f95b481cfd3d0c-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u7f62180f376a4822e9-1.text: 2. For the administrative offence under this Article, a person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as a legal entity.
koap-u7f62180f376a4822e9-1.locator: Article 14.65. Violation of legislation of the Russian Federation on the organisation of children's recreation and health improvement

koap-u7411dec0bbe1ae5fd6-1.text: Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them
koap-u7411dec0bbe1ae5fd6-1.locator: Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them

koap-u27c926e5822ac6491d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them
koap-u27c926e5822ac6491d-1.locator: Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them

koap-uf359b5b51700b1b3c4-1.text: Failure by a non-profit organisation whose constituent document provides for the right to conduct charitable activity to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes and/or the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through a charitable donation collection box, —
koap-uf359b5b51700b1b3c4-1.locator: Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them

koap-u4f1062d8ea22140dbc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; and on legal entities, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u4f1062d8ea22140dbc-1.locator: Article 14.66. Failure to comply with requirements for charitable donation collection boxes, the procedure for their installation and use and/or the rules for removing property collected through them

koap-u54e88dc31943d6cf49-1.text: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production
koap-u54e88dc31943d6cf49-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u5363e1dfe9df21e78d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production
koap-u5363e1dfe9df21e78d-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u90199b654860e207ec-1.text: 1. Production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production without the relevant licence, where such a licence is mandatory, if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u90199b654860e207ec-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u66795ca0fac31adf02-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one hundred and fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, or disqualification for two to three years, with or without confiscation of manufactured articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production; and on legal entities, three hundred thousand to one million roubles, with or without confiscation of manufactured articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production, or administrative suspension of activity for sixty to ninety days, with or without confiscation of manufactured articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production.
koap-u66795ca0fac31adf02-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-uafe56994ed0efac560-1.text: 2. Use and/or possession of principal technological equipment for the production of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production that has not been registered in accordance with the procedure established by legislation of the Russian Federation, —
koap-uafe56994ed0efac560-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u275ba0a9247dbc094f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment.
koap-u275ba0a9247dbc094f-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-ud16eaa648129514a8b-1.text: 3. Use and/or possession of principal technological equipment for the production of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production which is registered but has not been mothballed in accordance with the procedure established by legislation of the Russian Federation, in the absence of a licence for the production of tobacco products and/or raw materials and/or nicotine-containing products and/or nicotine raw materials, —
koap-ud16eaa648129514a8b-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u275ba0a9247dbc094f-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the principal technological equipment.
koap-u275ba0a9247dbc094f-2.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u311a9e48f2766929ad-1.text: 4. Unlawful production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production by an individual (other than an individual performing duties under an employment contract or providing services under a civil-law contract with an organisation holding the relevant licence or lawfully conducting retail sales of those products, or with an individual entrepreneur holding the relevant licence or lawfully conducting retail sales of those products), except in the cases provided for by Article 14.53.1 of this Code, if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u311a9e48f2766929ad-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u495ecb345eea4ef466-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production.
koap-u495ecb345eea4ef466-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-ue8c009bfa476ba24f3-1.text: 5. Failure to comply with prohibitions on the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production, laid down by legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for their production, except in the cases provided for by parts 1 - 4 of this Article, Article 14.53, parts 3, 4 of Article 15.12 and Article 15.12.1 of this Code, if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-ue8c009bfa476ba24f3-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u445d37a48d82c2d2d8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on individual entrepreneurs of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles with confiscation of articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of articles, products, equipment, raw materials, semi-finished products or other items used for the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production.
koap-u445d37a48d82c2d2d8-1.locator: Article 14.67. Violation of requirements for the production or circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production

koap-u89a8ff8814ed739194-1.text: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids
koap-u89a8ff8814ed739194-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u07ab7ba4ae183b4d28-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids
koap-u07ab7ba4ae183b4d28-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u29d3070950d13329a9-1.text: 1. Circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids by organisations and individual entrepreneurs whose information has not been included, in accordance with the prescribed procedure, in the Register of Organisations and Individual Entrepreneurs Engaged in the Circulation of Methanol and Methanol-containing Liquids (except where legislation of the Russian Federation on state regulation of the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids does not require inclusion of information about the organisation in that register), if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u29d3070950d13329a9-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u3ae494f47355c15704-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five hundred thousand to one million roubles or disqualification for two to three years; and on legal entities, no more than one fifth of the aggregate revenue from sales of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year preceding the date on which the administrative offence was detected, if the offender did not conduct sales of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year, but no less than three million roubles, with or without confiscation of methanol, methanol-containing liquids and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids, or administrative suspension of activity for sixty to ninety days, with or without confiscation of methanol, methanol-containing liquids and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u3ae494f47355c15704-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u216841b31d4718644b-1.text: 2. Sale of methanol and methanol-containing liquids without placing on the packaging (containers) a warning label indicating the presence of methanol in the chemical products and its danger to citizens' life and health, —
koap-u216841b31d4718644b-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u29a43355ec5ff93ee4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of methanol, methanol-containing liquids and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u29a43355ec5ff93ee4-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-uf7c3d6b410a9cd1a95-1.text: 3. Violation of requirements for storing methanol and methanol-containing liquids, except in the cases provided for by Article 6.3 of this Code, if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-uf7c3d6b410a9cd1a95-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u64da50d0575fddd9c0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u64da50d0575fddd9c0-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-ub1a6acf1e97a334e4b-1.text: 4. Violation of the procedure for destroying methanol and methanol-containing liquids, except in the cases provided for by Article 6.3 of this Code, —
koap-ub1a6acf1e97a334e4b-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u732404dd6e995cdcae-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u732404dd6e995cdcae-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u0cc34a055f4a1cc0fd-1.text: 5. Failure to comply with requirements for denaturing methanol and methanol-containing liquids and the procedure for denaturing methanol and methanol-containing liquids, where denaturing is mandatory under legislation of the Russian Federation on state regulation of the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids, except in the cases provided for by Article 6.3 of this Code, —
koap-u0cc34a055f4a1cc0fd-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u732404dd6e995cdcae-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u732404dd6e995cdcae-2.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-ue3db5ceed99bf7e2c8-1.text: 6. Circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids by an individual, except in the cases provided for by part 1 of this Article, if those acts do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-ue3db5ceed99bf7e2c8-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u50174dfe642da72c2f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of methanol, methanol-containing liquids and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids.
koap-u50174dfe642da72c2f-1.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-22.text: Note. For administrative offences under this Article, persons conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-22.locator: Article 14.68. Violation of requirements for the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids

koap-u984c9327240e6b18d1-1.text: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements
koap-u984c9327240e6b18d1-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u877340e90aa042f467-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements
koap-u877340e90aa042f467-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-uefdc1f23737308fa0b-1.text: 1. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation” and/or other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant to it, to provide a partner of the intermediary digital platform with the technical means to post information, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-uefdc1f23737308fa0b-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u9fcd4fd7c040392e2f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to forty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9fcd4fd7c040392e2f-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u211e1abec61071f2e5-1.text: 2. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duties, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, to enable legally significant messages to be sent and received electronically, and to provide and/or update a statement reconciling mutual accounts between that operator and a partner of the intermediary digital platform or the owner of an order acceptance and collection point (hereinafter in this Article, the order collection point owner), except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u211e1abec61071f2e5-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-uf253a0ec21782ed33d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf253a0ec21782ed33d-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u3fbb23e9f2cafe4c8c-1.text: 3. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation” and/or other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant to it, to post information on the intermediary digital platform in an offer by a partner of the intermediary digital platform to sell goods, perform work or provide a service, addressed to users of the intermediary digital platform (hereinafter in this Article, a product listing), and/or the duty to verify information contained in a product listing and to authorise the posting of the product listing on the intermediary digital platform, except in the cases provided for by part 1 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u3fbb23e9f2cafe4c8c-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u5ee1e473f78a01821a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5ee1e473f78a01821a-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ua2fe88ed51c5de8b24-1.text: 4. Restriction or termination of the posting of a product listing in violation of requirements established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, and/or failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty under that Federal Law to revoke measures restricting or terminating the posting of a product listing, other than restriction or termination of the posting of a product listing under the agreement between a partner of the intermediary digital platform and the operator of the intermediary digital platform, and except in the cases provided for by parts 8 and 12 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ua2fe88ed51c5de8b24-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u564e789ca3aeb8ce1c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u564e789ca3aeb8ce1c-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ubcbe9e419c207ee24c-1.text: 5. Violation by the operator of an intermediary digital platform of the procedure and conditions, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, for reducing the price of goods offered by a partner of the intermediary digital platform at that partner’s expense, except in the cases provided for by parts 7, 8 and 11 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ubcbe9e419c207ee24c-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u8993069c2658e768dd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8993069c2658e768dd-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ufcb6d9320dbe429c95-1.text: 6. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duties, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation” and/or other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant to it, when interacting with a partner performing work or services on the intermediary digital platform who is an individual, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ufcb6d9320dbe429c95-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u8993069c2658e768dd-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8993069c2658e768dd-2.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u410fb535fa2abb5a06-1.text: 7. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, to enable a partner of the intermediary digital platform to prohibit sales of the goods offered by that partner at a reduced price at that partner’s expense, or violation of such a prohibition where imposed, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u410fb535fa2abb5a06-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u17590ae0073221e8df-1.text: 8. Application by the operator of an intermediary digital platform, in respect of a partner of the intermediary digital platform, of measures restricting access to the personal account, terminating the posting of a product listing, reducing its rating, changing the position of a product listing in search results or otherwise impairing that partner’s interests, where that partner has not consented to a reduction in the price of the goods it offers at its own expense, except in the cases provided for by part 11 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u17590ae0073221e8df-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-2.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ueff0e09b6f284f44ba-1.text: 9. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation” and/or other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant to it, to verify information about a person intending to become a partner of the intermediary digital platform or an order collection point owner, and/or to comply with requirements for an agreement with a partner of the intermediary digital platform or an order collection point owner, its posting and/or the provision of access to it, or the duty to notify the partner of the intermediary digital platform or the order collection point owner when the operator of the intermediary digital platform unilaterally changes the terms of that agreement, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ueff0e09b6f284f44ba-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-3.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ufa6f80a00ec857c0b2-1.text: 10. Violation by the operator of an intermediary digital platform of requirements for search results established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ufa6f80a00ec857c0b2-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6987f3ef497a8f38f7-4.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u183706ff515f750ff8-1.text: 11. Restriction of access to the personal account of a partner of the intermediary digital platform or an order collection point owner in violation of requirements established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation”, and/or failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty under that Federal Law to revoke measures restricting access to the personal account of a partner of the intermediary digital platform or an order collection point owner, other than other restrictions on access to the personal account of such a partner or order collection point owner under the agreement between that partner or order collection point owner and the operator of the intermediary digital platform, and except in the cases provided for by part 12 of this Article and Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-u183706ff515f750ff8-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u37302a208eb4af8002-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u37302a208eb4af8002-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ue6dc86e70b29794c5c-1.text: 12. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to fulfil the duty, established by Federal Law of 31 July 2025 No. 289-FZ “On Certain Matters of Regulation of the Platform Economy in the Russian Federation” and/or other regulatory legal acts adopted pursuant to it, to consider complaints (resolve disputes) on the intermediary digital platform, except in the cases provided for by Article 14.31 of this Code, —
koap-ue6dc86e70b29794c5c-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-ufa4255deb3aaa5f65b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufa4255deb3aaa5f65b-1.locator: Article 14.69. Failure by the operator of an intermediary digital platform to comply with requirements

koap-u5339f7860df0d031c5-1.text: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
koap-u5339f7860df0d031c5-1.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-u80613a4dec2231cf04-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control
koap-u80613a4dec2231cf04-1.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-u34eb7a79ec86b4884d-1.text: 1. Failure to submit to tax authorities or customs authorities, within the time limit established by legislation on taxes and levies, duly completed documents and (or) other information necessary for tax control, or refusal to submit them, or submission of such information in an incomplete or distorted form, except in the cases provided for in Part 2 of this Article, —
koap-u34eb7a79ec86b4884d-1.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-u4fd3a1181304d7f66c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred roubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred roubles.
koap-u4fd3a1181304d7f66c-1.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-ue3ee2e24fb132f5600-1.text: 2. Violation by an official of a state body, local self-government body, organisation, diplomatic mission or consular institution, or by a notary, of the time limits prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation on taxes and levies for submitting (communicating) to tax authorities information relating to the registration of organisations and individuals, or submission of such information in an incomplete or distorted form —
koap-ue3ee2e24fb132f5600-1.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-5.locator: Article 15.6. Failure to submit (communicate) information necessary for tax control

koap-ue9d589af07b65c38ff-1.text: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer
koap-ue9d589af07b65c38ff-1.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u0667ed52914965a854-1.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u18992d54eba25613cb-1.text: 1. Opening by a bank or other credit institution of an account for an organisation or individual entrepreneur without their presenting a certificate of registration with a tax authority —
koap-u18992d54eba25613cb-1.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-u3a8f9370aa220eae1a-3.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u3d08197a80a6a3b73c-1.text: 2. Opening by a bank or other credit institution of an account for an organisation or individual entrepreneur when the bank or other credit institution has a decision of a tax authority or customs authority suspending transactions on that person's accounts —
koap-u3d08197a80a6a3b73c-1.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-4.locator: Article 15.7. Violation of the procedure for opening an account for a taxpayer

koap-u62af3fc87ce61957a8-1.locator: Article 15.8. Failure to meet the deadline for executing an instruction to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine

koap-u90f1e234e89f9b4442-1.locator: Article 15.8. Failure to meet the deadline for executing an instruction to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine

koap-u5097fede8f7aff91c8-1.text: Violation by a bank or other credit institution of the prescribed deadline for executing an instruction of a taxpayer (levy payer, insurance contribution payer) or tax agent to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine, or a collection instruction (order) of a tax authority or customs authority to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine to the budget —
koap-u5097fede8f7aff91c8-1.locator: Article 15.8. Failure to meet the deadline for executing an instruction to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine

koap-uf986f1064f72520635-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uf986f1064f72520635-2.locator: Article 15.8. Failure to meet the deadline for executing an instruction to transfer a tax (levy), insurance contribution, late-payment interest or fine

koap-ub92ceba815b7b8fb12-1.text: Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent
koap-ub92ceba815b7b8fb12-1.locator: Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent

koap-u69affa5c804c61fdc4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent
koap-u69affa5c804c61fdc4-1.locator: Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent

koap-u8e6b4efab1f6aeb5f1-1.text: Execution by a bank or other credit institution of debit transactions unrelated to fulfilling obligations to pay a tax (levy) or insurance contribution, or to executing another payment instruction which, under the legislation of the Russian Federation, has priority over payments to the budget, on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer, tax agent, collector of taxes and (or) levies or other persons, when the bank or other credit institution has a decision of a tax authority or customs authority suspending transactions on those accounts —
koap-u8e6b4efab1f6aeb5f1-1.locator: Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent

koap-u4c8c140e9c87d664d2-5.locator: Article 15.9. Failure by a bank to comply with a decision suspending transactions on the accounts of a taxpayer, levy payer, insurance contribution payer or tax agent

koap-u139a3715e1c26ff69d-1.text: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund
koap-u139a3715e1c26ff69d-1.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-u24bee9e977a47baed2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund
koap-u24bee9e977a47baed2-1.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-u54edd498866aab1ac8-1.text: 1. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund body to credit amounts of state pensions and (or) other payments to citizens' deposit accounts —
koap-u54edd498866aab1ac8-1.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-u753787ba379cb1ff77-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u753787ba379cb1ff77-3.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-u338f82176eccbbef13-1.text: 2. Violation by a bank or other credit institution of the prescribed deadline for executing an instruction of an insurance contribution payer to transfer insurance contributions, or an instruction of the body of a state extrabudgetary fund that monitors the correctness of calculation and the completeness and timeliness of payment (transfer) of compulsory social insurance contributions, to transfer insurance contributions, the corresponding late-payment interest and (or) fines to the budget of the relevant extrabudgetary fund —
koap-u338f82176eccbbef13-1.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-uf986f1064f72520635-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uf986f1064f72520635-3.locator: Article 15.10. Failure by a bank to execute an instruction of a state extrabudgetary fund

koap-u24d822d18a90043ae1-1.text: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements
koap-u24d822d18a90043ae1-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-ud3ae43bc16bc49f421-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements
koap-ud3ae43bc16bc49f421-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u86492c6780e662100a-1.text: 1. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements (except in the cases provided for in Article 15.15.6 of this Code), —
koap-u86492c6780e662100a-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u545c61e0747a1fa32e-5.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-29.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-29.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u7b4a5c7e5c2d7ed9af-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years.
koap-u7b4a5c7e5c2d7ed9af-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-36.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-uf05093f34c71557c9e-1.text: 1. A gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements (except in the cases provided for in Article 15.15.6 of this Code), means:
koap-uf05093f34c71557c9e-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u7d039dcf740d6d10a7-1.text: understatement of amounts of taxes and levies by at least 10 per cent as a result of distortion of accounting data;
koap-u7d039dcf740d6d10a7-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u288c081dc1bd3c26a3-1.text: distortion of any indicator in accounting (financial) statements expressed in monetary terms by at least 10 per cent;
koap-u288c081dc1bd3c26a3-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u2fb5cecb8fc7349cf3-1.text: recording in accounting registers a fictitious accounting item (including expenses not incurred, liabilities that do not exist, or economic events that did not occur) or a sham accounting item;
koap-u2fb5cecb8fc7349cf3-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u548548e91ed67cdb0b-1.text: maintaining accounting accounts outside the accounting registers in use;
koap-u548548e91ed67cdb0b-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-ua214266261670d6d36-1.text: preparing accounting (financial) statements otherwise than on the basis of data contained in the accounting registers;
koap-ua214266261670d6d36-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-udca1467cf7bba8861f-1.text: failure of an economic entity to retain primary accounting documents and (or) accounting registers and (or) accounting (financial) statements and (or) the auditor's report on the accounting (financial) statements (where an audit of the accounting (financial) statements is mandatory) for the prescribed retention periods for such documents.
koap-udca1467cf7bba8861f-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u897e35b09850802eaa-1.text: 1.1. The administrative liability for distortion of indicators in accounting (financial) statements provided for in this Article shall not apply to the person entrusted with maintaining the accounts or to the person with whom a contract for accounting services has been concluded where that distortion results from primary accounting documents prepared by other persons not corresponding to economic events that actually occurred and (or) from failure to transmit, or late transmission of, primary accounting documents for the data they contain to be entered in accounting registers.
koap-u897e35b09850802eaa-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u6281ccb803d6390152-1.text: 2. Officials shall be exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offences provided for in this Article in the following cases:
koap-u6281ccb803d6390152-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-uf377cd093c46cccef9-1.text: submission of an amended tax return (calculation) and payment, on the basis of that tax return (calculation), of the amount of tax (levy) unpaid as a result of distortion of accounting data, and payment of the corresponding late-payment interest, in compliance with the conditions provided for in Article 81 of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation;
koap-uf377cd093c46cccef9-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u552ae5f40331de3652-1.text: correction of the error in the prescribed manner (including submission of revised accounting (financial) statements) before the accounting (financial) statements are approved in the manner prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u552ae5f40331de3652-1.locator: Article 15.11. Gross violation of accounting requirements, including requirements for accounting (financial) statements

koap-u9c26f6805a329b0f0e-1.text: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information
koap-u9c26f6805a329b0f0e-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u01c235b542a7f262cb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information
koap-u01c235b542a7f262cb-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u1733586fcd75b70c74-1.text: 1. Production by a manufacturing organisation or individual entrepreneur, or placing into circulation, of goods and products without the marking and (or) information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for the relevant marking and (or) application of information, where such marking and (or) application of such information is mandatory, except in the cases provided for in Part 3 of this Article and Part 1 of Article 6.34 of this Code, —
koap-u1733586fcd75b70c74-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u24185c481104818ca0-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence.
koap-u24185c481104818ca0-2.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u630044ca6be9c85439-1.text: 2. Sale of goods and products without the marking and (or) information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, where such marking and (or) application of such information is mandatory, or storage, transportation or acquisition of such goods and products for the purpose of sale, except in the cases provided for in Part 4 of this Article and Part 1 of Article 6.34 of this Code, —
koap-u630044ca6be9c85439-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u4deb653e4673429a3e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence.
koap-u4deb653e4673429a3e-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u9d0cb16cabd094c18c-1.text: 3. Production of alcoholic products, or production or placing into circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products or nicotine-containing products without the marking and (or) information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for the relevant marking and (or) application of information —
koap-u9d0cb16cabd094c18c-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-uef581129ed44759bb6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence.
koap-uef581129ed44759bb6-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-uba4d381e245ba32665-1.text: 4. Circulation of alcoholic products or tobacco articles, tobacco products or nicotine-containing products without the marking and (or) information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation, where such marking and (or) application of such information is mandatory, —
koap-uba4d381e245ba32665-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u75c672dea5dad5764a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence; on legal entities, one million to one million five hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the items constituting the subject of the administrative offence.
koap-u75c672dea5dad5764a-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-u95932a80cb092a579c-1.text: Note. In this Article, goods, products or articles without marking mean goods, products or articles lacking the type of marking (means of identification, special (excise) stamp or other marking method) whose application is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u95932a80cb092a579c-1.locator: Article 15.12. Production, placing into circulation or sale of goods and products subject to marking and (or) information application requirements without the required marking and (or) information, or in violation of the prescribed procedure for applying such marking and (or) information

koap-uf146bb8e9704d6d600-1.text: Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system
koap-uf146bb8e9704d6d600-1.locator: Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system

koap-u1ec256657ebfc078fb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system
koap-u1ec256657ebfc078fb-1.locator: Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system

koap-u03b024c35d74e1594d-1.text: Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information prescribed by the rules for marking goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system, where submission of that information is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation (except for the administrative offences provided for in Articles 15.12.2 and 15.13 of this Code), —
koap-u03b024c35d74e1594d-1.locator: Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system

koap-u6b104389189a3f530d-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b104389189a3f530d-1.locator: Article 15.12.1. Failure to submit information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting information, or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information to the operator of the monitoring information system

koap-u08f6f5c293925b6d91-1.text: Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system
koap-u08f6f5c293925b6d91-1.locator: Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system

koap-u95f6c085d6c8dfc062-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system
koap-u95f6c085d6c8dfc062-1.locator: Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system

koap-u5db444b24dc19e52d6-1.text: Sale of tobacco products and (or) nicotine-containing products and (or) devices for consuming nicotine-containing products by a person who, under the legislation of the Russian Federation on mandatory marking of goods with means of identification, is entitled to sell such products and (or) devices and transmit information about this to the monitoring information system using cash-register equipment only if registered in the monitoring information system, where the sale is made without that registration and more than 10 units of such products and (or) devices have been sold in one calendar month using one item of cash-register equipment, —
koap-u5db444b24dc19e52d6-1.locator: Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system

koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ucd6f29918a6143936a-4.locator: Article 15.12.2. Sale of goods subject to mandatory marking with means of identification by a person not registered in the prescribed manner in the monitoring information system

koap-uebd130c66867f4534b-1.text: Article 15.13. Distortion of information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits when declaring the production, circulation and (or) use of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or the use of production capacity
koap-uebd130c66867f4534b-1.locator: Article 15.13. Distortion of information and (or) violation of the procedure and time limits when declaring the production, circulation and (or) use of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or the use of production capacity

koap-ube9829acb2c8db4793-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.13.
