koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-37.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u9ff95714d4ab718080-1.text: 1. The administrative liability provided for in this Article shall be imposed on officials of state (municipal) institutions, state bodies, local self-government bodies, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and governing bodies of territorial state extrabudgetary funds, and of other organisations exercising, in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, budgetary powers to maintain budget accounts and (or) prepare budget reports.
koap-u9ff95714d4ab718080-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u6e9f955e7c8cc50d68-1.text: 2. A minor distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements, including consolidated accounting (financial) statements, means:
koap-u6e9f955e7c8cc50d68-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-1.text: 1) distortion of an indicator in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements expressed in monetary terms that has led to distortion of information on assets and (or) liabilities and (or) the financial result:
koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u59b1e72111409eba81-1.text: by at least 1 per cent but not more than 10 per cent, and by an amount not exceeding one hundred thousand roubles;
koap-u59b1e72111409eba81-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u9c45e663e549f4c3e8-1.text: by not more than 1 per cent, and by an amount exceeding one hundred thousand roubles but not exceeding one million roubles;
koap-u9c45e663e549f4c3e8-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-uaa6259b8425639f479-1.text: 2) understatement of amounts of taxes and levies or insurance contributions by an amount not exceeding one hundred thousand roubles as a result of violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping) and (or) distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements.
koap-uaa6259b8425639f479-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u54c8cd6531806eaad5-1.text: 3. A significant distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements, including consolidated accounting (financial) statements, means:
koap-u54c8cd6531806eaad5-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-2.text: 1) distortion of an indicator in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements expressed in monetary terms that has led to distortion of information on assets and (or) liabilities and (or) the financial result:
koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-2.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u516ce71eb3c75d013f-1.text: by at least 1 per cent but not more than 10 per cent, and by an amount exceeding one hundred thousand roubles but not exceeding one million roubles;
koap-u516ce71eb3c75d013f-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-ue45102279a21966d56-1.text: by not more than 1 per cent, and by an amount exceeding one million roubles;
koap-ue45102279a21966d56-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u49d67e9003e51fbb08-1.text: 2) understatement of amounts of taxes and levies or insurance contributions by an amount exceeding one hundred thousand roubles but not exceeding one million roubles as a result of violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping) and (or) distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements.
koap-u49d67e9003e51fbb08-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u5a24e28c8efc646911-1.text: 4. A gross violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation or submission of budget reports or accounting (financial) statements, or a gross violation of the procedure for preparing (compiling) consolidated accounting (financial) statements, means:
koap-u5a24e28c8efc646911-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-3.text: 1) distortion of an indicator in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements expressed in monetary terms that has led to distortion of information on assets and (or) liabilities and (or) the financial result:
koap-u7b8ce6d3b8aeb89e9e-3.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u964bd7d96fdc5222d2-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u1c3f9e8e381667be94-1.text: by at least 1 per cent but not more than 10 per cent, and by an amount exceeding one million roubles;
koap-u1c3f9e8e381667be94-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u0577a0c57736ffb43f-1.text: 2) distortion of an indicator in budget reports expressed in monetary terms that has led to distortion of the indicator of the result of budget execution;
koap-u0577a0c57736ffb43f-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-ua66a3d98e81ae243ad-1.text: 3) understatement of amounts of taxes and levies or insurance contributions by an amount exceeding one million roubles as a result of violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping) and (or) distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements;
koap-ua66a3d98e81ae243ad-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-ud9b40d656004e61e82-1.text: 4) inclusion in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements of indicators characterising accounting items that are not supported by the corresponding accounting registers and (or) primary accounting documents;
koap-ud9b40d656004e61e82-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u20d45eedc73fd1facf-1.text: 5) recording in accounting registers a fictitious accounting item (including expenses not incurred, liabilities that do not exist, or economic events that did not occur) or a sham accounting item;
koap-u20d45eedc73fd1facf-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-uf09d43a5a09fdd34b2-1.text: 6) maintaining budget accounts (bookkeeping accounts) outside the accounting registers in use;
koap-uf09d43a5a09fdd34b2-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-ud735e85588251f8428-1.text: 7) failure to retain primary accounting documents and (or) accounting registers and (or) budget reports or accounting (financial) statements and (or) the auditor's report on the accounting (financial) statements (where an audit of the accounting (financial) statements is mandatory) for the prescribed retention periods for such documents.
koap-ud735e85588251f8428-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-uc76c72525ffa1cbe44-1.text: 5. Where distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements results from improper documentation of economic events in primary accounting documents and (or) failure to transmit, or late transmission of, primary accounting documents for the data they contain to be entered in accounting registers, the administrative liability provided for in this Article shall be imposed on the official responsible for documenting the economic event and shall not apply to the person entrusted with maintaining budget accounts (bookkeeping) or to the person with whom a contract for budget accounting (bookkeeping) services has been concluded.
koap-uc76c72525ffa1cbe44-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u15f6d7bb71771e222c-1.text: 6. Officials shall be exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offences provided for in this Article in the following cases:
koap-u15f6d7bb71771e222c-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u876dcebaf7ee3db8eb-1.text: 1) submission of an amended tax return (calculation) and payment, on the basis of that tax return (calculation), of the amount of tax (levy, insurance contribution) unpaid as a result of violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping) and (or) distortion of indicators in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements, and payment of the corresponding late-payment interest, in compliance with the conditions provided for in Article 81 of the Tax Code of the Russian Federation;
koap-u876dcebaf7ee3db8eb-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u1efddf941990fe7c4d-1.text: 2) submission of budget reports or accounting (financial) statements containing amended (corrected) indicators (including as a result of correction of errors identified in budget reports or accounting (financial) statements):
koap-u1efddf941990fe7c4d-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u5aa441b8be1e7eb5f2-1.text: before the budget reports or accounting (financial) statements are accepted by a financial authority, a chief administrator of budget funds, a body exercising the functions and powers of the founder in relation to a state (municipal) institution, or another person responsible for compiling consolidated accounting (financial) statements (hereinafter, the consolidated reporting entity);
koap-u5aa441b8be1e7eb5f2-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u6bd65fc2403f5898f6-1.text: after the budget reports or accounting (financial) statements have been accepted by the consolidated reporting entity, but before errors in the budget reports or accounting (financial) statements are discovered by a body authorised to draw up administrative offence records for the offences provided for in this Article;
koap-u6bd65fc2403f5898f6-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-ud04016b956d37c5634-1.text: after a body authorised to draw up administrative offence records for the offences provided for in this Article has audited the budget reports or accounting (financial) statements and that audit did not detect the errors subsequently corrected in the budget reports or accounting (financial) statements.
koap-ud04016b956d37c5634-1.locator: Article 15.15.6. Violation of requirements for budget accounting (bookkeeping), including the preparation and submission of budget reports and accounting (financial) statements

koap-u2709c25d26015fff66-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds to be credited to the accounts of budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation.

koap-uaa0855cd2e0b98a18d-1.text: 2. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to comply with a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body to suspend transactions on accounts opened for treasury institutions and budget-funded institutions in violation of the budget legislation of the Russian Federation and other normative legal acts governing budgetary legal relations, or on accounts denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation for recording funds of the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (municipal entities) opened for the financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (municipal entities), —
koap-uaa0855cd2e0b98a18d-1.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body

koap-u4fed93eb9f52eeb330-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds involved in the unlawfully executed transactions.
koap-u4fed93eb9f52eeb330-1.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body

koap-uc985b07159a31cfa7a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.17. Improper issuance of securities

koap-uecec84efc6b7576687-1.text: Violation by an issuer of the procedure for issuing securities established by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, where that action does not constitute a criminal offence, —

koap-u0f4961cbf7bb28508c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of the issuer of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u2d58d5bfe07b163667-1.text: Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities
koap-u2d58d5bfe07b163667-1.locator: Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities

koap-uc12d9de055263aef8d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities
koap-uc12d9de055263aef8d-1.locator: Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities

koap-u83c7e88cb0bc8845a9-1.text: Execution by a professional securities market participant of transactions involving the transfer of rights to issue-grade securities before registration of the report on the results of their issue (additional issue), where legislation requires registration of such a report and those actions do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u83c7e88cb0bc8845a9-1.locator: Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities

koap-ud0f6a10e96f6b95d9d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud0f6a10e96f6b95d9d-1.locator: Article 15.18. Unlawful transactions in issue-grade securities

koap-ua2b0b521d8af9203be-1.text: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
koap-ua2b0b521d8af9203be-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u62fe3c9909c5ca8c6a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
koap-u62fe3c9909c5ca8c6a-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u94a8ab6edae294817d-1.text: 1. Failure by an issuer, professional securities market participant, clearing organisation, joint-stock investment fund, management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or specialised depositary of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund to submit information (notifications) required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting such information (notifications), or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate and (or) misleading information, except in the cases provided for in Article 19.7.3 of this Code, where those actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u94a8ab6edae294817d-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-ua664762ad28b4c1012-1.text: 2. Failure by an issuer, professional securities market participant, clearing organisation, joint-stock investment fund, management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, specialised depositary of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or a person providing services for publicly presenting disclosed information to disclose information required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for disclosing such information, or disclosure of incomplete and (or) inaccurate and (or) misleading information —
koap-ua664762ad28b4c1012-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-4.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-uc8ca281b5f12e248c3-1.text: 3. Failure to submit (disclose) information required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting (disclosing) such information, except in the cases provided for in Article 19.7.3 of this Code, by persons who have provided security for issuers' bonds; persons who have acquired the right, directly or indirectly, independently or jointly with other persons, to dispose of a specified number of votes attached to voting shares (participation interests) constituting the charter capital of issuers or a clearing organisation; organisations controlled by issuers; members (shareholders) of business companies; persons who have acquired the powers necessary to convene and hold extraordinary general meetings of shareholders of joint-stock companies; persons acquiring issue-grade securities of open joint-stock companies pursuant to a voluntary offer, including a competing offer, or a mandatory offer provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on joint-stock companies; affiliated persons of joint-stock companies; and persons deemed under federal law to have an interest in a transaction entered into by a joint-stock company —
koap-uc8ca281b5f12e248c3-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u236f06b0789456b57d-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u236f06b0789456b57d-2.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-ua9a63999fea28c8879-1.text: 4. Violation by a party to a repurchase agreement, a contract constituting a derivative financial instrument, or a contract of another type specified in Bank of Russia regulations, entered into outside organised trading, of the procedure and (or) time limits established by federal law and (or) Bank of Russia regulations for providing information about those contracts and (or) the master agreement (single contract) to a trade repository or the Bank of Russia, or provision of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information —
koap-ua9a63999fea28c8879-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u341167b5b990a72856-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u341167b5b990a72856-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-udd874b9b9a98e34fcf-1.text: 5. Unlawful refusal or evasion by a trade repository to enter in the register of contracts a record of a repurchase agreement, a contract constituting a derivative financial instrument, or a contract of another type specified in Bank of Russia regulations, entered into outside organised trading, and (or) a master agreement (single contract); or making such an entry without grounds provided for by federal law and (or) Bank of Russia regulations; or entering inaccurate information in the register of contracts; or failure or improper performance by a trade repository of its duty to provide information from the register of contracts, including information to the Bank of Russia; or unlawful acquisition, use or disclosure of information and data included in the register of contracts —
koap-udd874b9b9a98e34fcf-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u6c37659ed03bca73ef-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u6c37659ed03bca73ef-2.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u9fe65b7291c8926019-1.text: 6. Other violation by a trade repository, in carrying on trade repository activities, of requirements for those activities established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for in Part 5 of this Article, —
koap-u9fe65b7291c8926019-1.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u256dcdf0be3a13ffc4-3.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

koap-ub1098ae872b21e8f3a-1.text: Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities
koap-ub1098ae872b21e8f3a-1.locator: Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities

koap-uc396d9ebc361afeb4a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities
koap-uc396d9ebc361afeb4a-1.locator: Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities

koap-u5ebb79d71b602b9e5d-1.text: Obstruction by an issuer, a joint-stock investment fund, a management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or a person maintaining the register of securities holders, of the exercise of rights certified by securities, except in the cases provided for in Parts 1, 2, 4, 5, 8 and 10 of Article 15.23.1 of this Code, —
koap-u5ebb79d71b602b9e5d-1.locator: Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities

koap-ubec7f26b1723bf95cd-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ubec7f26b1723bf95cd-1.locator: Article 15.20. Obstruction of the exercise of rights certified by securities

koap-uffe3be09a69abacee0-1.text: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
koap-uffe3be09a69abacee0-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uf4d6a9169c9e04397e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
koap-uf4d6a9169c9e04397e-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-u7f8eedeff2aa584e2e-1.text: Unlawful use of inside information, where that action does not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u7f8eedeff2aa584e2e-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uecc097a481e6cc1df2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, the amount of the excess income or the losses avoided by the citizen, official or legal entity as a result of the unlawful use of inside information, but not less than seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uecc097a481e6cc1df2-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-38.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-u2e1b5f572c27d5a300-1.text: 1. In this Article and Article 15.30 of this Code, excess income or the amount of losses a person has avoided as a result of unlawful use of inside information and (or) market manipulation shall be determined as the difference between the income obtained as a result of the unlawful actions and the income that would have arisen without taking into account the unlawful actions provided for in this Article.
koap-u2e1b5f572c27d5a300-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uf5a35aafa9ac1f0178-1.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings are being conducted for an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 15.30 of this Code shall be exempt from administrative liability if that person performs an agreement entered into with the Bank of Russia and provided for by Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 224-FZ "On Counteracting the Unlawful Use of Inside Information and Market Manipulation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation".
koap-uf5a35aafa9ac1f0178-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-u913d4a41d225b6949f-1.text: 3. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article may be entered into with the Bank of Russia before the day on which a ruling is issued in the case concerning an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 15.30 of this Code.
koap-u913d4a41d225b6949f-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-ub2bec5b63aed0a64b0-1.text: 4. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall be signed by the person who chaired the meeting of the Financial Supervision Committee of the Bank of Russia at which the decision to enter into that agreement was adopted. On behalf of a legal entity against which administrative offence proceedings are being conducted, the agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall be signed by the legal representative of the legal entity.
koap-ub2bec5b63aed0a64b0-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uf18e4340c950539cc6-1.text: 5. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall enter into force on the day on which the Financial Supervision Committee of the Bank of Russia adopts the decision to enter into it.
koap-uf18e4340c950539cc6-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uf50ebcfb25af1d8287-1.text: 6. An agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article may not be entered into with a person who has failed to perform an agreement previously entered into with that person.
koap-uf50ebcfb25af1d8287-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-u45b412e193fadef1c5-1.text: 7. When an administrative penalty is imposed for an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 15.30 of this Code, the following circumstances aggravating administrative liability shall be taken into account:
koap-u45b412e193fadef1c5-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-ub2e1329f477c8ab4c5-1.text: 1) failure by the person against whom administrative offence proceedings are being conducted to perform the agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article;
koap-ub2e1329f477c8ab4c5-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-ud28f57d0aa2e511999-1.text: 2) commission of an administrative offence by a person with whom such an agreement was previously entered into, where less than one year has elapsed since the date of performance of that agreement.
koap-ud28f57d0aa2e511999-1.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information

koap-uef77d10e182ca1d1e1-1.text: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders
koap-uef77d10e182ca1d1e1-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u2ee0364ed7ab879d56-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders
koap-u2ee0364ed7ab879d56-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u769dc6e3a27a1f1af9-1.text: 1. Unlawful refusal or evasion to make entries in the system for maintaining the register of securities holders, or making such entries without grounds provided for by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or entering inaccurate data in the register of securities holders, or failure or improper performance by the person maintaining the register of securities holders of a request by a securities holder, a person authorised by that holder, or a nominee holder of securities for an extract from the securities-holder register maintenance system concerning the personal account —
koap-u769dc6e3a27a1f1af9-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-5.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-ud4e2d711b1edb0199f-1.text: 2. Unlawful maintenance of the register of securities holders, or, where the person maintaining that register is replaced, evasion by that person to transfer the information, data and documents received that constitute the system for maintaining the register of securities holders, or violation of the procedure and time limits for transferring them prescribed by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them —
koap-ud4e2d711b1edb0199f-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-6.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-ud43cfb1ffe95681797-1.text: 2.1. Failure by a business company of strategic importance for the defence-industrial complex and security of the Russian Federation, or a company under that business company's direct or indirect control, to provide information necessary for maintaining the register of securities holders of those companies by a person licensed to maintain registers of securities holders and meeting the requirements established by Federal Law of 21 July 2014 No. 213-FZ "On the Opening of Bank Accounts and Letters of Credit and the Conclusion of Bank Deposit Agreements and Agreements for Maintaining Registers of Securities Holders by Business Companies of Strategic Importance for the Defence-Industrial Complex and Security of the Russian Federation, and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation" —
koap-ud43cfb1ffe95681797-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-7.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-ua722e8705a70103835-1.text: 3. Other violation by the person maintaining the register of securities holders of requirements for the procedure for maintaining that register established by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them —
koap-ua722e8705a70103835-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u21d865816f15a599d0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u21d865816f15a599d0-1.locator: Article 15.22. Violations in maintaining the register of securities holders

koap-u9c02fea31304d5d8fb-1.text: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds
koap-u9c02fea31304d5d8fb-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u3d5169d96c7c54933a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds
koap-u3d5169d96c7c54933a-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u3a57fe5ad664abb811-1.text: 1. Unlawful refusal or evasion to convene a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund), or unlawful refusal or evasion to include in the agenda of a general meeting of shareholders matters and (or) proposals nominating candidates to the board of directors (supervisory board), collective executive body, audit commission (as auditor) or counting commission of a joint-stock company, or a candidate for the position of its sole executive body —
koap-u3a57fe5ad664abb811-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ub5ee4c8f5eb8552398-1.text: 2. Violation of the procedure or time limit for sending (delivering, publishing) notice of a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund), or failure to provide, or late provision of, information (materials) required to be provided under federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them when preparing for a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) —
koap-ub5ee4c8f5eb8552398-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-2.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ue56065bfa15bfcf26d-1.text: 3. Violation of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them for compiling lists of persons entitled to participate in a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) —
koap-ue56065bfa15bfcf26d-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-3.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u19d9a161dd7098bbca-1.text: 4. Failure to send (deliver, publish), or failure to meet the deadline for sending (delivering, publishing), a voting ballot to a person included in the list of persons entitled to participate in a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) —
koap-u19d9a161dd7098bbca-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-4.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-uaa0e6787b1b2340eac-1.text: 5. Violation of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them for the form, timing or venue of a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund), or holding such a general meeting in violation of the form, date, time or venue determined by the body of the joint-stock company or by the persons convening the general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund), —
koap-uaa0e6787b1b2340eac-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-5.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u0f1bff0fbf4cb5c114-1.text: 6. Holding a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) without the quorum required to hold it, or considering individual agenda items without the required quorum, or changing the agenda of the general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) after notice of that general meeting has been sent (delivered, published), —
koap-u0f1bff0fbf4cb5c114-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-6.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u332729c999f7150f53-1.text: 7. Performance of the functions of the counting commission of a joint-stock company by an improper body (person), by persons elected to that counting commission in violation of federal law, or by persons whose term of office has expired, —
koap-u332729c999f7150f53-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u43c276e3ddbb5e774e-7.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u580b08c55eeddbfb30-1.text: 8. Unlawful refusal by a member of the counting commission of a joint-stock company (a person performing its functions) or by a person convening a general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund to register persons entitled to participate in the general meeting for participation in a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund); or violation by those persons of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them for counting votes cast at the general meeting to determine the voting results, or for the content, form or time limit for preparing the minutes of voting results at the general meeting; or evasion by those persons to sign those minutes; or violation by a member of the counting commission of a joint-stock company (a person performing its functions) of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them for the procedure for determining the quorum of a general meeting of shareholders —
koap-u580b08c55eeddbfb30-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-2.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u81276657c7d57504f5-1.text: 9. Violation by the chairperson or secretary of a general meeting of shareholders (general meeting of holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) of requirements for the content, form or time limit for preparing the minutes of that general meeting, or evasion by those persons to sign those minutes —
koap-u81276657c7d57504f5-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ud9193ca124fe870637-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months.
koap-ud9193ca124fe870637-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ud426c7fe658d5ab7cd-1.text: 10. Violation of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them for announcing or communicating to shareholders (holders of investment units in a closed-end unit investment fund) the decisions adopted by the general meeting or the voting results —
koap-ud426c7fe658d5ab7cd-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub38f1531a4d32b0add-3.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u8d9590d2d2db7d65ca-1.text: 11. Unlawful refusal or evasion to convene a general meeting of members of a limited (additional) liability company, or violation of the requirements of federal laws for the procedure for convening, preparing and holding general meetings of members of limited (additional) liability companies —
koap-u8d9590d2d2db7d65ca-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-ubec7f26b1723bf95cd-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ubec7f26b1723bf95cd-2.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u5dc71a0e4dd953344d-1.text: Note. A member of the board of directors (supervisory board), audit commission, counting commission or liquidation commission of a joint-stock company (limited (additional) liability company) who voted against a decision that led to a violation of the requirements of federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them shall not be held liable under this Article.
koap-u5dc71a0e4dd953344d-1.locator: Article 15.23.1. Violation of legislative requirements for the procedure for preparing and holding general meetings of shareholders, members of limited (additional) liability companies and holders of investment units in closed-end unit investment funds

koap-u68c80dc63326a908c4-1.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations

koap-u6e89941b6b0a374969-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations
koap-u6e89941b6b0a374969-1.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations

koap-uc4b8a250bd669d5a34-1.text: 1. Failure by persons who indirectly own shares (participation interests in the charter capital) of an economically significant organisation belonging to a foreign holding company and who are citizens of the Russian Federation and (or) residents of the Russian Federation to fulfil the obligation to submit an application containing the information necessary to acquire direct ownership of those shares (participation interests in the charter capital) in accordance with Federal Law of 4 August 2023 No. 470-FZ "On Special Rules for the Regulation of Corporate Relations in Business Companies That Are Economically Significant Organisations", after an order has been sent by the federal executive body authorised to take measures to counter the legalisation (laundering) of criminal proceeds, the financing of terrorism, extremist activities and the financing of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, —
koap-uc4b8a250bd669d5a34-1.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations

koap-u6c2d5cc8b144ce4e24-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6c2d5cc8b144ce4e24-1.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations

koap-uf6debe349c0eabc4ec-1.text: 2. koap-uf6debe349c0eabc4ec-1.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations

koap-u6c2d5cc8b144ce4e24-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles; on officials, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6c2d5cc8b144ce4e24-2.locator: Article 15.23.2. Violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation establishing special rules for the regulation of corporate relations in business companies that are economically significant organisations
