koap-ub1885fc67bc29cef08-1.text: Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations
koap-ub1885fc67bc29cef08-1.locator: Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations

koap-u6c3da07fcdb6335c64-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations
koap-u6c3da07fcdb6335c64-1.locator: Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations

koap-u2fe2f4cfb01b7f0eeb-1.text: Unlawful issuance or circulation of securities or of documents certifying monetary and other obligations that are not securities under the legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for in Articles 15.17 and 15.18 of this Code, where those actions do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u2fe2f4cfb01b7f0eeb-1.locator: Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations

koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u2e930efdf5730fe75b-8.locator: Article 15.24.1. Unlawful issuance or circulation of documents certifying monetary and other obligations

koap-u5530fa69e3ebdd7c67-1.text: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies
koap-u5530fa69e3ebdd7c67-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u5d94b398426946a01c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies
koap-u5d94b398426946a01c-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u97f9eea21e4485102f-1.text: 1. Conducting unlawful currency transactions, meaning currency transactions prohibited by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation or conducted in violation of that legislation, including purchasing or selling foreign currency and cheques (including travellers' cheques) denominated in foreign currency without going through authorised banks; or conducting currency transactions settled without using accounts with authorised banks or accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation; or conducting currency transactions settled using funds credited to accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation; or transferring funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation, —
koap-u97f9eea21e4485102f-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ub903e79374939aeff5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and legal entities of 20 to 40 per cent of the amount of the unlawful currency transaction or of the funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers; on officials, 20 to 40 per cent of the amount of the unlawful currency transaction or of the funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, but not more than thirty thousand roubles.
koap-ub903e79374939aeff5-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uae6af844de4c8315ff-1.text: 1.1. Failure by a resident to submit to a tax authority a report on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, where submission of such a report is mandatory, —
koap-uae6af844de4c8315ff-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8cedcf41655a5265c3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens, officials and legal entities of 20 to 40 per cent of the amount of funds credited during the reporting period to the electronic means of payment provided by a foreign payment service provider.
koap-u8cedcf41655a5265c3-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u793e533f6e51007e84-1.text: 2. Submission by a resident to a tax authority, after the prescribed deadline and (or) otherwise than in the prescribed form, of a notification of opening (closing) an account (deposit) or changing the particulars of an account (deposit) with a bank or other financial market organisation located outside the territory of the Russian Federation —
koap-u793e533f6e51007e84-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u9d66aba3481aee27ef-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9d66aba3481aee27ef-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u16d17d8b0a24e9d6b2-1.text: 2.1. Failure by a resident to submit to a tax authority a notification of opening (closing) an account (deposit) or changing the particulars of an account (deposit) with a bank or other financial market organisation located outside the territory of the Russian Federation —
koap-u16d17d8b0a24e9d6b2-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ua10488a922bf393c98-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-ua10488a922bf393c98-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u60586bf4f1f21685ba-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ue290d435f5900c968e-1.text: 4. Failure by a resident to fulfil within the prescribed time limit the obligation to receive, into its bank accounts with authorised banks, foreign currency and (or) currency of the Russian Federation due for goods transferred to non-residents, work performed for non-residents, services rendered to non-residents or information or results of intellectual activity, including exclusive rights to them, transferred to non-residents, and (or) into the bank account of a resident financial agent (factor) with an authorised bank where the resident financial agent (factor) is not an authorised bank, or into the correspondent account of the relevant authorised bank where the resident financial agent (factor) is an authorised bank, if a monetary claim for foreign currency and (or) currency of the Russian Federation due to the resident for goods transferred, work performed, services rendered or information or results of intellectual activity, including exclusive rights to them, transferred to a non-resident has been assigned to that resident financial agent (factor); or failure by a resident to fulfil within the prescribed time limit the obligation to receive, into its bank accounts with authorised banks, foreign currency and (or) currency of the Russian Federation due to the resident from a non-resident under a loan agreement —
koap-ue290d435f5900c968e-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u9fd0aff5e67a5500c6-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, and legal entities of one one-hundred-and-fiftieth of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, for each day of delay in crediting those funds; and (or) 3 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a foreign trade agreement (contract) has been entered into with a non-resident whose obligations are denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation and whose terms provide for payment in the currency of the Russian Federation, except for foreign trade agreements (contracts) providing for residents to transfer to non-residents goods included in the Common Commodity Nomenclature of Foreign Economic Activity of the Eurasian Economic Union under codes 4401–4403 99 000 9 and 4407; and (or) 3 to 10 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a foreign trade agreement (contract) has been entered into with a non-resident providing for residents to transfer to non-residents goods included in that Common Commodity Nomenclature under codes 4401–4403 99 000 9 and 4407, whose obligations are denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation and whose terms provide for payment in the currency of the Russian Federation; and (or) 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a foreign trade agreement (contract) providing for payment in foreign currency has been entered into with a non-resident; and (or) 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a loan agreement has been entered into with a non-resident; on officials, one one-hundred-and-fiftieth of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, for each day of delay in crediting those funds, and (or) 3 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a foreign trade agreement (contract) has been entered into with a non-resident, and (or) 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed time limit to bank accounts with authorised banks where a loan agreement has been entered into with a non-resident, but not more than thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u9fd0aff5e67a5500c6-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8ebad0332cc2776867-1.text: 4.1. Failure by a resident to fulfil within the prescribed time limit the obligation to ensure receipt, into its accounts opened with authorised banks and (or) into accounts opened with banks outside the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation, of currency of the Russian Federation under foreign trade contracts in the proportion determined by the Government of the Russian Federation —
koap-u8ebad0332cc2776867-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u78eb6d3bf9e8debe91-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity and on legal entities of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u78eb6d3bf9e8debe91-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8ce3e1acbbe925e66d-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u6308e1bf7886379d82-1.text: 4.3. Failure by a resident to fulfil within the prescribed time limit the obligation to perform or terminate, by methods permitted by the legislation of the Russian Federation, obligations under a foreign trade agreement (contract) concluded between a resident and a non-resident and subject to the requirements of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation and currency control bodies, except in the cases provided for in Parts 4 and 4.1 of this Article, —
koap-u6308e1bf7886379d82-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u0a2662aded61b2d3e0-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity and on legal entities of 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds due to the resident from the non-resident; on officials, 3 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds due to the resident from the non-resident, but not more than thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u0a2662aded61b2d3e0-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ubb73eec8c7355d808e-1.text: 5. Failure by a resident to fulfil within the prescribed time limit the obligation to return to the Russian Federation funds paid to non-residents for goods not imported into (not received in) the Russian Federation, work not performed, services not rendered or information or results of intellectual activity, including exclusive rights to them, not transferred —
koap-ubb73eec8c7355d808e-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ub94ec65bb8bc30925a-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity and on legal entities of one one-hundred-and-fiftieth of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds returned to the Russian Federation after the prescribed deadline, for each day of delay in returning those funds to the Russian Federation; and (or) 3 to 10 per cent of the amount of funds in the currency of the Russian Federation not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed time limit and paid to a non-resident under a foreign trade agreement (contract) whose obligations are denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation and whose terms provide for payment in the currency of the Russian Federation; and (or) 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed time limit and paid to a non-resident in foreign currency under a foreign trade agreement (contract); on officials, one one-hundred-and-fiftieth of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds returned to the Russian Federation after the prescribed deadline, for each day of delay in returning those funds to the Russian Federation, and (or) 3 to 10 per cent of the amount of funds in the currency of the Russian Federation not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed time limit and paid to a non-resident under a foreign trade agreement (contract) whose obligations are denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation and whose terms provide for payment in the currency of the Russian Federation, and (or) 5 to 30 per cent of the amount of funds not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed time limit and paid to a non-resident in foreign currency under a foreign trade agreement (contract), but not more than thirty thousand roubles.
koap-ub94ec65bb8bc30925a-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ufa8710542ae090ea7b-1.text: 5.1. Commission of the administrative offences provided for in Parts 1, 4, 4.1, 4.3 and 5 of this Article by an official who has previously been subjected to an administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine for a similar administrative offence —
koap-ufa8710542ae090ea7b-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u1f126d179b73a50cce-1.text: shall entail disqualification for a period of six months to three years.
koap-u1f126d179b73a50cce-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u07d8eec456bacfad4d-1.text: 5.2. Actions (inaction) provided for in Parts 4, 4.1, 4.3 and 5 of this Article, where the amount of funds in foreign currency or currency of the Russian Federation due under a foreign trade agreement (contract) or loan agreement with a non-resident in respect of currency transactions carried out once or repeatedly within one year, and credited after the prescribed deadline or not credited to accounts with authorised banks and (or) accounts opened with banks outside the territory of the Russian Federation, exceeds one hundred million roubles, and those actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminal offence, —
koap-u07d8eec456bacfad4d-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ua5df0247a5c710f51b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity and on legal entities of one one-hundred-and-fiftieth of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks and (or) accounts opened with banks outside the territory of the Russian Federation after the prescribed deadline, for each day of delay in crediting those funds, and (or) 75 to 100 per cent of the amount of funds not credited to accounts with authorised banks and (or) accounts opened with banks outside the territory of the Russian Federation; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of six months to three years.
koap-ua5df0247a5c710f51b-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8c818e118985fa1c2d-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u7d4ac9c073f8c5e31e-1.text: 6. Failure to comply with the prescribed procedure for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents; violation of the prescribed retention periods for accounting and reporting documents on currency transactions, supporting documents and information in the conduct of currency transactions; or failure by a resident financial agent (factor) to which a monetary claim has been assigned (including by subsequent assignment) to notify, within the prescribed time limit, the resident which, under a foreign trade agreement (contract) with a non-resident, transfers goods, performs work, renders services or transfers information or results of intellectual activity, including exclusive rights to them, to that non-resident, of the non-resident's performance (non-performance) of the obligations under that foreign trade agreement (contract), or of the subsequent assignment of the monetary claim under that foreign trade agreement (contract), with the relevant documents attached —
koap-u7d4ac9c073f8c5e31e-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u448c460663ae732cd3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u448c460663ae732cd3-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ue5f432c3a9a416d8ce-1.text: 6.1. Failure to meet the prescribed time limits for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents, by no more than ten days —
koap-ue5f432c3a9a416d8ce-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u25e1f03da2d65cae45-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred roubles; on officials, five hundred to one thousand roubles; on legal entities, five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles.
koap-u25e1f03da2d65cae45-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u490da3d569c0b90e09-1.text: 6.2. Failure to meet the prescribed time limits for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents, by more than ten but no more than thirty days —
koap-u490da3d569c0b90e09-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uf8040dcd4dc1643211-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; on officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles; on legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uf8040dcd4dc1643211-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u78bfc7b5bbbfe96ed0-1.text: 6.3. Failure to meet the prescribed time limits for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents, by more than thirty days —
koap-u78bfc7b5bbbfe96ed0-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u2597c1d26f0009fa62-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u2597c1d26f0009fa62-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u50d86c90eb3040bee7-1.text: 6.3-1. Failure by a resident to submit to an authorised bank accounting and reporting forms for currency transactions, supporting documents and information in the conduct of currency transactions, after ninety days have elapsed following expiry of the prescribed time limit —
koap-u50d86c90eb3040bee7-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uf684fbf637f24a0fec-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles; on officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uf684fbf637f24a0fec-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ued93eddea2f9fc1f58-1.text: 6.3-2. Failure by a resident that is a participant in the budget process at the federal level, other than the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, or a federal state budget-funded (autonomous) institution whose personal accounts are opened with the Federal Treasury in accordance with the budget legislation of the Russian Federation, to submit within the prescribed time limit to the Federal Treasury accounting and reporting forms for currency transactions carried out by that resident using federal budget funds, funds received for the temporary disposal of federal treasury institutions, funds of the budgets of state extrabudgetary funds of the Russian Federation or funds of federal state budget-funded (autonomous) institutions, and supporting documents and information in the conduct of those currency transactions —
koap-ued93eddea2f9fc1f58-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uf36ef525548b4ffa8b-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uf36ef525548b4ffa8b-6.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u0f300aa143cd4cadd8-1.text: 6.4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 6 of this Article, except for repeated commission of an administrative offence consisting in failure to comply with the prescribed procedure for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents, —
koap-u0f300aa143cd4cadd8-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uaedfd4094383e73e0b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand roubles; on officials, twelve thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred twenty thousand to one hundred fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uaedfd4094383e73e0b-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ud088bc4d57f457520c-1.text: 6.5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for in Part 6 of this Article, consisting in failure to comply with the prescribed procedure for submitting reports on movements of funds through accounts (deposits) with banks and other financial market organisations located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or on transfers of funds without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, and (or) supporting documents, —
koap-ud088bc4d57f457520c-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8ecd3509c2e377349b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8ecd3509c2e377349b-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u126b7817c47df4af82-1.text: 3. Foreign currency and the value of domestic and foreign securities shall be converted into the currency of the Russian Federation at the exchange rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in effect on the day the administrative offence was committed or detected.
koap-u126b7817c47df4af82-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uf1ffa671c9391bf255-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u3ff371e9b4db8fd6ae-1.text: 5. Where funds are credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, the administrative fine for administrative offences for which liability is established by Part 4 of this Article shall be calculated on the basis of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in effect during the period of delay.
koap-u3ff371e9b4db8fd6ae-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ube16527074c3b6a9e6-1.text: 6. Where the relevant funds are returned to the Russian Federation after the prescribed deadline, the administrative fine for administrative offences for which liability is established by Part 5 of this Article shall be calculated on the basis of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation in effect during the period of delay.
koap-ube16527074c3b6a9e6-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u8b2e5787804702b522-1.text: 7. The administrative liability established by Parts 1 and 4 of this Article for administrative offences involving currency transactions conducted without using accounts with authorised banks in cases not provided for by the currency legislation of the Russian Federation shall not apply to a resident that, within the prescribed time limits, credited funds to its account (deposit) opened with a bank located outside the territory of the Russian Federation and debited those funds from that account, subsequently crediting them in full to that resident's account (deposit) with an authorised bank no later than forty-five days after they were credited to the account (deposit) opened with the bank located outside the territory of the Russian Federation. Where such funds are partially debited from that account and transferred to that resident's account (deposit) with an authorised bank no later than forty-five days after they were credited to the account (deposit) opened with the bank located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, the administrative liability referred to in this Note shall not apply to the amount of funds so partially credited.
koap-u8b2e5787804702b522-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-uafe7b10a73a008d320-1.text: 8. The administrative liability established by Part 4 of this Article shall not apply to a resident that has entered into a foreign trade agreement (contract) with a non-resident where the amount of obligations under that foreign trade agreement (contract) is equal to or does not exceed two hundred thousand roubles, or is equal to or does not exceed an amount in foreign currency equivalent to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uafe7b10a73a008d320-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u7127122913da8d3659-1.text: 9. The administrative liability established by Parts 4, 4.1, 4.3, 5 and 5.2 of this Article shall apply after forty-five days have elapsed following the deadline for fulfilling the relevant obligation, if that obligation has not been fulfilled within that period.
koap-u7127122913da8d3659-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-u0b2e670d81bc22f27c-1.text: 10. The administrative liability established by Parts 1, 4, 4.1, 4.3, 5 and 5.2 of this Article shall not apply to a resident if failure to comply with the relevant requirement of currency legislation is due to restrictive measures imposed on citizens of the Russian Federation or Russian legal entities by foreign states (territories), associations and (or) unions of states and (or) state (interstate) institutions of foreign states or associations and (or) unions of states taking unfriendly actions against the Russian Federation.
koap-u0b2e670d81bc22f27c-1.locator: Article 15.25. Violation of the currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies

koap-ued953550f0d5154dcd-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u39f882f73f103f61ae-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of two hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to sixty days.
koap-u39f882f73f103f61ae-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u0e366687bf4a4d6f31-1.text: 2.1. Failure to comply with legislation concerning the blocking (freezing) of funds or other property or the suspension of a transaction with funds or other property —
koap-u0e366687bf4a4d6f31-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u6c4b7239bd03cab256-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to sixty days.
koap-u6c4b7239bd03cab256-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u840df72d2ca8dee6da-1.text: 2.2. koap-u840df72d2ca8dee6da-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u6c4b7239bd03cab256-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to sixty days.
koap-u6c4b7239bd03cab256-2.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-uea4201b9a74aee431e-1.text: 2.3. Failure to submit to the authorised body at its request information held by an organisation conducting transactions with funds or other property concerning clients' transactions and clients' beneficial owners, information on beneficiaries that became known to it when concluding an insurance contract for the benefit of a third party (without verifying its accuracy), or information on movements of funds in its clients' accounts (deposits) —
koap-uea4201b9a74aee431e-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-ufaccacb91e6550f7d5-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufaccacb91e6550f7d5-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u26ba9440c6a42e3729-1.text: 3. Obstruction by an organisation conducting transactions with funds or other property of inspections conducted by the authorised body or the relevant supervisory body, or failure to comply with orders issued by those bodies for the purpose of countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism, extremist activities or the financing of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, —
koap-u26ba9440c6a42e3729-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-uaeee3d72d6c666d6eb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to two years; and on legal entities, of seven hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-uaeee3d72d6c666d6eb-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-uc4fad889d0785ff7aa-1.text: 4. Failure by an organisation conducting transactions with funds or other property, or by its official, to comply with legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism, resulting in the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism or the financing of extremist activities established by a court conviction that has entered into legal force, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act, —
koap-uc4fad889d0785ff7aa-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u2487784c1db8228436-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years; and on legal entities, of five hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u2487784c1db8228436-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-40.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-11.text: 1. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, persons engaging in entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-11.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-u28af59df7a2cf3e93e-1.text: 2. For the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article, employees of an organisation conducting transactions with funds or other property whose duties include identifying and (or) submitting information on transactions subject to mandatory monitoring or on transactions suspected of being conducted for the purpose of legalising (laundering) proceeds of crime or financing terrorism shall bear liability as officials.
koap-u28af59df7a2cf3e93e-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-ua84cf71dd1e2f39d5f-1.text: 3. The administrative liability provided for by this Article shall not apply to credit institutions, except in the cases provided for by parts 1.1 and 4 of this Article.
koap-ua84cf71dd1e2f39d5f-1.locator: Article 15.27. Failure to comply with the requirements of legislation on countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism

koap-ub2533ec655473101ff-1.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-ufa44ba1230b860b72b-1.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-udf301fd821d89fff3e-1.text: 1. Provision or collection of funds or provision of financial services, where these are intended to finance the organisation, preparation or commission of at least one of the crimes provided for by Articles 205, 205.1, 205.2, 205.3, 205.4, 205.5, 206, 208, 211, 220, 221, 277, 278, 279, 360 and 361 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, or to finance or otherwise materially support a person for the purpose of that person's commission of at least one of those crimes, or to support an organised group, an illegal armed formation or a criminal community (criminal organisation) established or being established to commit at least one of those crimes, —
koap-udf301fd821d89fff3e-1.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-u01c88950f6b08a7e1b-1.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-ua647b1f92c5705e734-1.text: 2. Failure to apply coercive measures for freezing (blocking) funds and other property provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on special economic measures and coercive measures —
koap-ua647b1f92c5705e734-1.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-u4ee538a604cff99322-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u4ee538a604cff99322-2.locator: Article 15.27.1. Provision of financial support for terrorism or the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction

koap-u569b2ebcb8d90c7dd5-1.text: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts
koap-u569b2ebcb8d90c7dd5-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u977de4f0dcd6434d8e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts
koap-u977de4f0dcd6434d8e-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-uf74d105a878260ecef-1.text: 1. Failure by a financial market organisation to send to the authorised bodies, or sending in violation of the established procedure and time limits, information on a person subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts, or information on the receipt by the financial market organisation of a request (additional request) from a foreign tax authority and (or) a foreign tax agent authorised by a foreign tax authority to withhold foreign taxes and levies (hereinafter in this Article, a foreign tax authority) to provide information on a person subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts, —
koap-uf74d105a878260ecef-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u341167b5b990a72856-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u341167b5b990a72856-2.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u4ce06b6262eb0c7137-1.text: 2. Failure by a financial market organisation to send to the authorised bodies, or sending in violation of the established procedure and time limits, information on the registration of that financial market organisation with a foreign tax authority carried out for the purpose of providing information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts —
koap-u4ce06b6262eb0c7137-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-ue02913d503ba1adebb-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue02913d503ba1adebb-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u1d8cb1b065c55bb2e3-1.text: 3. Sending information on a person subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts to a foreign tax authority where a decision prohibiting the sending of that information exists or in other cases where provision of that information is prohibited by federal law —
koap-u1d8cb1b065c55bb2e3-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u364f723b5b760e4cf1-2.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u364f723b5b760e4cf1-2.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-41.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u941048a75868378424-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Article, a financial market organisation means a credit institution; an insurer engaging in voluntary life insurance activities; a professional participant in the securities market engaging in brokerage activities and (or) securities management activities and (or) depositary activities; a manager under a property trust management agreement; a non-state pension fund; a joint-stock investment fund; a management company of an investment fund, a unit investment fund and a non-state pension fund; or a clearing organisation.
koap-u941048a75868378424-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u4b99cf9733ba53cb24-1.text: 2. For the purposes of this Article, authorised bodies means the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, the federal executive body authorised to perform the function of countering the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism, extremist activities and the financing of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, and the federal executive body authorised to exercise control and supervision in the field of taxes and levies.
koap-u4b99cf9733ba53cb24-1.locator: Article 15.27.2. Failure to comply with requirements to provide information on persons subject to the legislation of a foreign state on taxation of foreign accounts

koap-u6e82a993f264d8057e-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u61435271e57a3f96dc-1.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of up to three times the amount of the funds or the value of the other property constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without confiscation of the funds or other property, or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days, with or without confiscation of the funds or other property.
koap-u61435271e57a3f96dc-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-42.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-ue91f157e1c6aeac22d-1.text: 1. A legal entity shall be found guilty of the administrative offence provided for by this Article and shall be subject to administrative liability where the administrative offence is committed by:
koap-ue91f157e1c6aeac22d-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u9bd46b3297f81b682c-1.text: an individual authorised by law, another legal act, a constituent document, a contract or a power of attorney to act on behalf of the legal entity;
koap-u9bd46b3297f81b682c-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u7cccbf925e6109af57-1.text: an individual holding a position in the management bodies of the legal entity or in bodies exercising control over the financial and economic activities of the legal entity;
koap-u7cccbf925e6109af57-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u08e9dd11dafd6d8c70-1.text: a beneficial owner of that legal entity within the meaning defined in paragraph 8 of Article 6.1 of Federal Law No. 115-FZ of 7 August 2001 "On Countering the Legalisation (Laundering) of Proceeds of Crime and the Financing of Terrorism".
koap-u08e9dd11dafd6d8c70-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-u8b1652c7a3679c9c0c-1.text: 2. A legal entity shall be exempted from administrative liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article if it assisted in detecting that offence, conducting an administrative investigation and (or) detecting, solving and investigating a crime connected with that offence.
koap-u8b1652c7a3679c9c0c-1.locator: Article 15.27.3. Conducting transactions or financial operations with property obtained through crime in the interests of a legal entity

koap-ue50abb1e5ffdd33a0e-1.text: 1. of the Russian Federation", or for a federal unitary enterprise of strategic importance to the defence industry and security of the Russian Federation or a business company under its direct or indirect control, as specified in Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 14 November 2002 "On State and Municipal Unitary Enterprises", or concluding a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement with such Accounts and Letters of Credit, the Conclusion of Bank Deposit Agreements and Agreements for Maintaining a Register of Securities Holders by Business Companies of Strategic Importance to the Defence Industry and Security of the Russian Federation, and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation" or the third, fourth or sixth subparagraph of paragraph 9 of Article 24.1 of Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 14 November 2002 "On State and Municipal Unitary Enterprises"), —

koap-uaa04e3928d7e86994a-1.locator: Article 15.39. koap-u05914add864b1799ff-1.text: 2. Opening an account or a covered (funded) letter of credit or concluding a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement by a business company of strategic importance to the defence industry and security of the Russian Federation or a company under its direct or indirect control, as specified in Federal Law No. 213-FZ of 21 July 2014 "On the Opening of Bank Accounts and Letters of Credit, the Conclusion of Bank Deposit Agreements and Agreements for Maintaining a Register of Securities Holders by Business Companies of Strategic Importance to the Defence Industry and Security of the Russian Federation, and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation", or by a federal unitary enterprise of strategic importance to the defence industry and security of the Russian Federation or a business company under its direct or indirect control, as specified in Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 14 November 2002 "On State and Municipal Unitary Enterprises", with a credit institution that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of credit institutions posted by the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws; or acquisition by such a company or enterprise of securities of a credit institution that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of credit institutions posted by the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws; or conduct by such a company or enterprise of those operations (transactions) with a foreign bank that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of foreign banks posted by the federal executive body responsible for developing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of banking on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws (except for the conduct of those operations (transactions) with a credit institution (securities of a credit institution) in the cases provided for by part 1.3, 1.4 or 1.6 of Article 2 of Federal Law No. 213-FZ of 21 July 2014 "On the Opening of Bank Accounts and Letters of Credit, the Conclusion of Bank Deposit Agreements and Agreements for Maintaining a Register of Securities Holders by Business Companies of Strategic Importance to the Defence Industry and Security of the Russian Federation, and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation" or the third, fourth or sixth subparagraph of paragraph 9 of Article 24.1 of Federal Law No. 161-FZ of 14 November 2002 "On State and Municipal Unitary Enterprises"); or failure by such a company or enterprise to comply with the time limits within which it must terminate a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement with a credit institution that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of credit institutions posted by the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws, and (or) the time limits within which it must terminate a bank account agreement or a bank deposit agreement with a foreign bank that does not meet the requirements established for those purposes by regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and is not included in the lists of foreign banks posted by the federal executive body responsible for developing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of banking on the Internet information and telecommunications network in accordance with the provisions of those federal laws; koap-u474357aecfa24f299d-1.text: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union
koap-u474357aecfa24f299d-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-udc9b4e8123c7f4dc01-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union
koap-udc9b4e8123c7f4dc01-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u595e0c524c18084db1-1.text: 1. Violation of the procedure for the arrival of goods and/or means of international transport in the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union by importing them through places other than the places for moving goods across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union or other places established by the legislation of the member states of the Eurasian Economic Union, or outside customs authorities’ operating hours; or acts directly aimed at the actual crossing of the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union by goods and/or means of international transport upon their departure from the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union through places other than the places for moving goods across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union or other places established by the legislation of its member states, or outside customs authorities’ operating hours, or without the customs authority’s permission —
koap-u595e0c524c18084db1-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u847cb58607b694b6e4-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens and legal entities of one half to three times the value of the goods and/or vehicles constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u847cb58607b694b6e4-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u999f42fb6b7098deb4-1.text: 2. Concealing goods from customs control by using hiding places or other methods that make the goods difficult to discover, or by disguising certain goods as other goods when moving them across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-u999f42fb6b7098deb4-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u9719b6577c4ac04a25-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens and legal entities of one half to three times the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, and confiscation of the goods and/or vehicles used as instruments of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u9719b6577c4ac04a25-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u789d77697228d4b1b8-1.text: 3. Providing a customs authority with inaccurate information on the number of cargo packages, their markings, or the description, gross weight and/or volume of goods upon arrival in the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union, departure from that territory, or placement of goods under the customs transit procedure or in a temporary storage warehouse, by submitting invalid documents; or using for these purposes a counterfeit means of identification or a genuine means of identification relating to other goods and/or vehicles —
koap-u789d77697228d4b1b8-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u62e148de5493826051-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u62e148de5493826051-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-uab8c85d66c1620bcc9-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-ua1c88ed96afc3c4b4b-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-u6288b03c6fd5095b0e-1.text: 2. For the purposes of this Chapter, invalid documents means forged documents, documents obtained unlawfully, documents containing inaccurate information, documents relating to other goods and/or vehicles, and other documents having no legal force.
koap-u6288b03c6fd5095b0e-1.locator: Article 16.1. Unlawful movement of goods and/or means of international transport across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union

koap-uddb0afe5e7d697d4e9-1.text: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods
koap-uddb0afe5e7d697d4e9-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-uf6145adfb0914fbcea-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods
koap-uf6145adfb0914fbcea-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u0b269f52727fd1928b-1.text: 1. Failure to declare goods subject to customs declaration, except in the cases provided for by Parts 1.1 and 1.2 of this Article and Article 16.4 of this Code, —
koap-u0b269f52727fd1928b-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u08c5491e674c9df9d1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than one thousand roubles, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, but not less than one thousand roubles, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u08c5491e674c9df9d1-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u2938020f023882f3d2-1.text: 1.1. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article by failing to declare cigarettes and/or alcoholic beverages whose quantities exceed the quantitative limits within which goods for personal use may be imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union free of customs duties and taxes by no more than 250 cigarettes and no more than 10 litres of alcoholic beverages —
koap-u2938020f023882f3d2-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u8bbde07914ebde6a60-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u8bbde07914ebde6a60-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u9b8deeaf9212bd1119-1.text: 1.2. Commission of the administrative offence provided for by Part 1 of this Article by failing to declare goods in respect of which no customs duties, taxes and/or special, anti-dumping or countervailing duties are payable and/or to which prohibitions and restrictions do not apply —
koap-u9b8deeaf9212bd1119-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u150b39727c4352f2a8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u150b39727c4352f2a8-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ud7e71b5aa2a52addcf-1.text: 2. A declarant or customs representative, when declaring goods to customs, stating inaccurate information on their classification code under the Common Commodity Nomenclature of Foreign Economic Activity of the Eurasian Economic Union, accompanied, in the description of the goods, by incomplete or inaccurate information on their quantity, properties and characteristics affecting their classification; or stating inaccurate information on their name, description, country of origin or customs value, or other information, where such information served or could have served as grounds for exemption from customs duties or taxes, or for understating them by an amount exceeding the equivalent of the amount established and calculated in accordance with point 4 of Article 55 of the Customs Code of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-ud7e71b5aa2a52addcf-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u0e827c54600116dc59-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens and legal entities of one half to twice the amount of customs duties and taxes payable, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u0e827c54600116dc59-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u8c93b2b3dcf2c0ec99-1.text: 3. A declarant or customs representative, when declaring goods to customs, stating inaccurate information about the goods or submitting invalid documents, where such information or documents served or could have served as grounds for failing to comply with prohibitions and restrictions, as well as domestic-market protection measures, established by international treaties of the member states of the Eurasian Economic Union, decisions of the Eurasian Economic Commission or normative legal acts of the Russian Federation —
koap-u8c93b2b3dcf2c0ec99-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-uff43c4752b52a0a373-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-uff43c4752b52a0a373-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u523ab2bc2b17562ac9-1.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 12.02.2015 No. 17-ФЗ.
koap-u523ab2bc2b17562ac9-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-44.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ueeff1c3b11c80d320d-1.text: 1. The administrative fine imposed on individuals under the sanction in Part 1 of this Article is calculated using the value of goods for personal use moved by individuals across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union. Where individuals fail to declare such goods whose value exceeds the value limits within which goods for personal use may be imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union free of customs duties and taxes, the value of the goods for personal use is used after deduction of those value limits. Where individuals fail to declare goods that are not goods for personal use, or goods in respect of which a decision has been taken that they are not goods for personal use, the administrative fine is calculated on the basis of their market value determined in accordance with Part 2 of Article 27.11 of this Code, without deducting the value limits within which goods for personal use may be imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union free of customs duties and taxes.
koap-ueeff1c3b11c80d320d-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u40f8b915e80d500aae-1.text: 2. Where the declarant and/or customs representative voluntarily informs the customs authority that released the goods of a failure to declare goods, simultaneously submitting a customs declaration or a document required to amend and/or supplement information in a previously submitted customs declaration and containing information on goods that were not declared to customs, together with the documents provided for by the law of the Eurasian Economic Union on the basis of which that customs declaration or document was completed, the person who committed the administrative offence established by Part 1 of this Article shall be exempt from administrative liability for that offence if, on the day preceding receipt of the notification and registration of the submitted documents, all of the following conditions are met:
koap-u40f8b915e80d500aae-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-uae75b0b2f784696b2f-1.text: 1) the customs authority has not detected, in accordance with legislation on administrative offences, an administrative offence whose subject matter comprises the goods specified in the notification;
koap-uae75b0b2f784696b2f-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ud15d6f7163885a3795-1.text: 2) the customs authority has not notified the declarant, customs representative, person authorised in respect of the goods after their release, or that person’s representative of post-release customs control, where such notification is provided for by the law of the Eurasian Economic Union and/or the customs regulation legislation of the Russian Federation, or has not commenced such control without notification where notification is not required;
koap-ud15d6f7163885a3795-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u3779e983c566c771f3-1.text: 3) the declarant or customs representative has no arrears of customs duties, taxes or late-payment interest remaining unpaid after expiry of the deadlines set in a demand for payment of customs charges.
koap-u3779e983c566c771f3-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ub2b2cf3f920b76edcb-1.text: 3. Note 2 to this Article does not apply to strategically important goods and resources whose list is approved by the Government of the Russian Federation for the purposes of Article 226.1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-ub2b2cf3f920b76edcb-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u5a0f78c85fba09e383-1.text: 4. Where the declarant and/or customs representative voluntarily submits to the customs authority that released the goods a request to amend and/or supplement the customs declaration after release of the goods, with the documents provided for by the law of the Eurasian Economic Union attached, the person who committed the administrative offence established by Part 2 of this Article shall be exempt from administrative liability for that offence if, on the day preceding registration of the request to amend and/or supplement the customs declaration, all the conditions specified in points 1–3 of note 2 to this Article are met.
koap-u5a0f78c85fba09e383-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ufeb527558e191a9f51-1.text: 5. Where the declarant and/or customs representative voluntarily submits to the customs authority with which the customs declaration was registered a request to amend (supplement) the information stated in the goods declaration before release of the goods, with the documents provided for by the law of the Eurasian Economic Union attached, the person who committed the administrative offence provided for by Part 2 of this Article shall be exempt from administrative liability for that administrative offence if, on the day preceding registration of that request, all of the following conditions are met:
koap-ufeb527558e191a9f51-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u8af254e9d63f4ecc55-1.text: 1) the customs authority has not requested documents and/or information in accordance with the law of the Eurasian Economic Union in connection with verification of customs or other documents and/or information commenced before release of the goods;
koap-u8af254e9d63f4ecc55-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ua3a0563c899ddeb983-1.text: 2) the customs authority has not notified the declarant and/or customs representative of the place and time of a physical customs examination, or has not decided to conduct a visual customs inspection and/or has not ordered a customs expert examination;
koap-ua3a0563c899ddeb983-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-u76d17ffc13e0e84776-1.text: 3) the customs authority has not detected, in accordance with legislation on administrative offences, an administrative offence whose subject matter comprises the goods specified in the request;
koap-u76d17ffc13e0e84776-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ufa1dbb78664c7c706f-1.text: 4) the declarant or customs representative has no arrears of customs duties, taxes or late-payment interest remaining unpaid after expiry of the deadlines set in a demand for payment of customs charges.
koap-ufa1dbb78664c7c706f-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

koap-ua052e83238d36eb900-1.text: 6. For the purposes of Part 1 of this Article, alcoholic beverages means beverages with an alcohol concentration exceeding 0.5 per cent of the beverage’s volume that fall within headings 2203 00–2206 00 and 2208 of the Common Commodity Nomenclature of Foreign Economic Activity of the Eurasian Economic Union, excluding ethyl alcohol and kvass.
koap-ua052e83238d36eb900-1.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods

Failure to comply with prohibitions and/or restrictions on importing goods into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union or the Russian Federation and/or exporting goods from the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union or the Russian Federation
koap-u1e488017d949fa1352-1.locator: Article 16.3.
