koap-ub5efeef51eefa0a510-1.text: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles
koap-ub5efeef51eefa0a510-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-u9438d61f7dd188fcf0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles
koap-u9438d61f7dd188fcf0-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-u1257e171b7c666ff9b-1.text: 1. Failure by individuals to export temporarily imported goods and/or vehicles from the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union within the prescribed temporary import periods —
koap-u1257e171b7c666ff9b-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-ue9e0660a03ba461d9c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods and/or vehicles constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-ue9e0660a03ba461d9c-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-uc2f94b4e54997c1308-1.text: 2. Failure by individuals to re-import into the Russian Federation temporarily exported goods whose re-importation is mandatory under the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-uc2f94b4e54997c1308-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-udd78f643356124e912-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens equal to the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-udd78f643356124e912-1.locator: Article 16.18. Failure by individuals to export or re-import goods and/or vehicles

koap-u5579ab71e4eee2051e-1.text: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
koap-u5579ab71e4eee2051e-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u1c5453c963d540b509-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure
koap-u1c5453c963d540b509-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u9c8cbe0bbf10db1fdb-1.text: 1. Stating inaccurate information about goods in a goods declaration or submitting invalid documents, where such information and documents could have served as grounds for placing the goods under a customs procedure providing for full or partial exemption from customs duties or taxes, or repayment of amounts paid, and/or non-application of non-tariff regulation measures, except in the cases provided for by Part 3 of Article 16.1, Parts 2 and 3 of Article 16.2 and Article 16.17 of this Code, —
koap-u9c8cbe0bbf10db1fdb-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u0ab00403f8d169a34f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u0ab00403f8d169a34f-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u0f9ff7c542d6743a5d-1.text: 2. Use or disposal of goods in breach of the customs procedure under which they have been placed, including transfer of the right to use the customs procedure by transferring rights of possession, use or disposal of the goods, where this is permitted under that customs procedure, to another person without the customs authority’s permission where such permission is mandatory —
koap-u0f9ff7c542d6743a5d-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u144a01dceebf25647c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u144a01dceebf25647c-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u3bd816563d622ceb5e-1.text: 3. Failure to complete within the prescribed period a customs procedure that is required to be completed —
koap-u3bd816563d622ceb5e-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-u3f84dc1dc2b34c437b-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u3f84dc1dc2b34c437b-1.locator: Article 16.19. Failure to comply with a customs procedure

koap-uc55dfea70344dd0ce1-1.text: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment
koap-uc55dfea70344dd0ce1-1.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u9d0dace8fa7a47748f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment
koap-u9d0dace8fa7a47748f-1.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u4ef15931f8c2d62da0-1.text: 1. Use of conditionally released goods, transfer of their possession or use, sale of conditionally released goods or their disposal in another manner in breach of established prohibitions and/or restrictions on the use and disposal of such goods, except in the cases provided for by Part 2 of Article 16.19 of this Code, —
koap-u4ef15931f8c2d62da0-1.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u33f2c2e94ea6e68f96-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u33f2c2e94ea6e68f96-1.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u04b28a94d1da9ad9b5-1.text: 2. Use of goods placed under attachment during customs control without the customs authority’s permission and/or transfer of such goods to other persons, their alienation or their disposal in another manner —
koap-u04b28a94d1da9ad9b5-1.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u4f1062d8ea22140dbc-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u4f1062d8ea22140dbc-2.locator: Article 16.20. Unlawful use or disposal of conditionally released goods or goods under attachment

koap-u6e18f010b03e23d740-1.text: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods
koap-u6e18f010b03e23d740-1.locator: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods

koap-u4dad984fd8a7abc6a2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods
koap-u4dad984fd8a7abc6a2-1.locator: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods

koap-ubaf2a8a0e33168964f-1.text: Use of goods unlawfully moved across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union in respect of which customs duties or taxes have not been paid or prohibitions and restrictions established by international treaties of the member states of the Eurasian Economic Union, decisions of the Eurasian Economic Commission or normative legal acts of the Russian Federation have not been complied with; or use of goods released, including conditionally, under a customs procedure, whose use, transfer into another’s possession or use, or disposal in other ways has taken place in breach of established prohibitions and/or restrictions; as well as acquisition, storage or transportation of such goods —
koap-ubaf2a8a0e33168964f-1.locator: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods

koap-u29eb9bc1a2a32cb6b7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one half to twice the value of the goods constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, with or without their confiscation, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u29eb9bc1a2a32cb6b7-1.locator: Article 16.21. Unlawful use, acquisition, storage or transportation of goods

koap-ua883893fd41673943f-1.text: Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges
koap-ua883893fd41673943f-1.locator: Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges

koap-uc901eff7d426cd37a8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges
koap-uc901eff7d426cd37a8-1.locator: Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges

koap-u800a3deedb91255415-1.text: Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs duties and taxes payable in connection with movement of goods across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-u800a3deedb91255415-1.locator: Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges

koap-u715d143aed8b2aa4aa-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u715d143aed8b2aa4aa-1.locator: Article 16.22. Failure to meet deadlines for payment of customs charges

koap-u8c9640c0ff86f92869-1.text: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
koap-u8c9640c0ff86f92869-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u454ae3463982e8c403-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters
koap-u454ae3463982e8c403-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-ude967e3bf8759bcf2f-1.text: 1. Carrying out customs operations on behalf of a declarant or other interested persons by a person not entered in the register of customs representatives, entered in that register on the basis of invalid documents, or removed from it, except where the obligation to carry out the customs operations arose before the customs representative was removed from that register, or where the law of the Eurasian Economic Union and/or the customs regulation legislation of the Russian Federation grants the right to carry out customs operations without requiring entry in the register of customs representatives, —
koap-ude967e3bf8759bcf2f-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u9d7e79b624353f612b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, two thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u9d7e79b624353f612b-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u024c50e34fe99ebc96-1.text: 2. Acting as customs carriers, authorised economic operators, owners of duty-free shops, temporary storage warehouses or customs warehouses by persons entered in the relevant register on the basis of invalid documents or removed from registers of persons engaged in customs-related activities, except where such activities involve completing customs operations which they became obliged to perform before removal from the relevant register, —
koap-u024c50e34fe99ebc96-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u8cc4b6f91d1aeb708d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of two thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8cc4b6f91d1aeb708d-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u503656ddb7b9bb6755-1.text: 3. Failure to notify a customs authority, or failure to meet the notification deadline, of changes in information stated in an application for entry in a register of persons engaged in customs-related activities, or of suspension of those persons’ activities —
koap-u503656ddb7b9bb6755-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-u8639ec7040c10fa964-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of one hundred to five hundred roubles; for legal entities, two thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u8639ec7040c10fa964-1.locator: Article 16.23. Unlawfully carrying on activities in customs matters

koap-uc8367548d47e6d2aea-1.text: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles
koap-uc8367548d47e6d2aea-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-uf4fee994d0f419d5c4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles
koap-uf4fee994d0f419d5c4-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-u8f58d1edc4e7d316d9-1.text: 1. Use of temporarily imported means of international transport for internal carriage within the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union, or transfer of their possession or use, sale or other disposal in breach of the established restrictions on the use and disposal of such vehicles —
koap-u8f58d1edc4e7d316d9-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-u005a5102f4e7981197-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u005a5102f4e7981197-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-ueea77f6a60e0580376-1.text: 2. Transfer of the right to use, or other disposal of, vehicles temporarily imported by individuals without complying with the conditions established by the law of the Eurasian Economic Union —
koap-ueea77f6a60e0580376-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-u8b021ca42b0d80b1cc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with or without confiscation of the vehicles constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence, or confiscation of the items constituting the subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u8b021ca42b0d80b1cc-1.locator: Article 16.24. Unlawful operations with temporarily imported vehicles

koap-ueaa48d53003db063d2-1.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-u420defb3a1fc15f57a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma
koap-u420defb3a1fc15f57a-1.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-u878b0fbe6238adfb65-1.text: 1. Failure by an official of a state body, local self-government body, organisation or public association to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma, or obstruction of their activities —
koap-u878b0fbe6238adfb65-1.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-7.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-uc87d4c5d84821767a4-1.text: 2. Failure by an official to meet prescribed deadlines for providing information (documents, materials or responses to requests) to a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma —
koap-uc87d4c5d84821767a4-1.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-6.locator: Article 17.1. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a senator of the Russian Federation or a deputy of the State Duma

koap-u5ab9c373185351eb11-1.text: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation
koap-u5ab9c373185351eb11-1.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-u5ff23997449363bb93-1.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand roubles.
koap-uf72921bfb3d14a3fdc-7.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-u68a671d7d8f2f7b31a-1.text: 2. Failure by officials to comply with lawful demands of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation, as well as failure by officials to fulfil duties established by Federal Constitutional Law of 26 February 1997 No. 1-ФКЗ ‘On the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation’, —

koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u93d1563ab485a21224-8.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-u333ff010b34d94a359-1.text: 3. Obstruction of the activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation in another form —
koap-u333ff010b34d94a359-1.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-2.locator: Article 17.2. Obstruction of the lawful activities of the Commissioner for Human Rights in the Russian Federation

koap-ucd8d5c2e26ccb3b98a-1.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-ud9604f096326060006-1.text: 1. Failure to comply with a judge’s lawful order to stop acts violating the rules established in court —

koap-ub7060f56bec72ee392-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-ub7060f56bec72ee392-1.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u02f6ea8e72b293fa9a-1.text: 2. Failure to comply with a lawful order of a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities to stop acts violating the rules established in court —
koap-u02f6ea8e72b293fa9a-1.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-4.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u452fb22810afdc6583-2.text: 3. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by Part 1 or 2 of this Article —
koap-u452fb22810afdc6583-2.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-uf20585e297b3ce918a-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-uf20585e297b3ce918a-1.locator: Article 17.3. Failure to comply with an order of a judge or a bailiff responsible for ensuring the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u8d780f1f7dde2dd2fd-1.text: Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission
koap-u8d780f1f7dde2dd2fd-1.locator: Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission

koap-uc82c2e5b0dacba81dd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission
koap-uc82c2e5b0dacba81dd-1.locator: Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission

koap-u2d88702459370811c0-1.text: Failure by an official to consider a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission, or failure to take measures to remedy the violations of law specified in the procedural order, ruling or submission —
koap-u2d88702459370811c0-1.locator: Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-6.locator: Article 17.4. Failure to take measures in response to a court’s special procedural order or ruling or a judge’s formal submission

koap-u7fea6fdc3503d3e5a6-1.text: Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court
koap-u7fea6fdc3503d3e5a6-1.locator: Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court

koap-u05df8609a0fa64c22e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court
koap-u05df8609a0fa64c22e-1.locator: Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court

koap-u7d5e8fd2bbfa5ccd2a-1.text: Preventing a juror from attending court to participate in a trial by an employer or the employer’s representative —
koap-u7d5e8fd2bbfa5ccd2a-1.locator: Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-7.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-7.locator: Article 17.5. Preventing a juror from attending court

koap-ua07d27bbee376df81d-1.text: Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors
koap-ua07d27bbee376df81d-1.locator: Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors

koap-u95fab020dfd808900a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors
koap-u95fab020dfd808900a-1.locator: Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors

koap-ue37167c117e9172b84-1.text: Failure to provide information required by a district, city, territory or regional administration to compile lists of jurors, or provision of knowingly false information by a person obliged to provide such information, —
koap-ue37167c117e9172b84-1.locator: Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors

koap-u64d7890a69fbf6b6e1-2.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u64d7890a69fbf6b6e1-2.locator: Article 17.6. Failure to provide information for compiling lists of jurors

koap-u9479a61b924f092fa2-1.text: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u9479a61b924f092fa2-1.locator: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u8a31165ca5c026ccb7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u8a31165ca5c026ccb7-1.locator: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u28a6d34bc761dfc595-1.text: Intentional failure to comply with a prosecutor’s demands arising from powers established by federal law, or with lawful demands of an investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case, —
koap-u28a6d34bc761dfc595-1.locator: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u76f2432b70ceea9820-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u76f2432b70ceea9820-1.locator: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ucacf39ca978d05f407-1.text: Note. This Article does not apply to relations regulated by the criminal procedure legislation of the Russian Federation concerning a prosecutor’s supervision of the procedural activities of bodies of inquiry and bodies of preliminary investigation.
koap-ucacf39ca978d05f407-1.locator: Article 17.7. Failure to comply with lawful demands of a prosecutor, investigator, inquiry officer or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u937f1c9df3e97af7ff-1.text: Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities
koap-u937f1c9df3e97af7ff-1.locator: Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u76b63b5704a86d17a4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities
koap-u76b63b5704a86d17a4-1.locator: Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u6fa20783a26b278c5a-1.text: Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities, while that official is performing official duties, —
koap-u6fa20783a26b278c5a-1.locator: Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u24e8b9e908b2cc2a12-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-u24e8b9e908b2cc2a12-1.locator: Article 17.8. Obstruction of the lawful activities of an official of the body authorised to perform compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the prescribed order of court activities

koap-u37bb0ff1e7ef8fe771-1.locator: Article 17.8.1. Unlawful use of the words «судебный пристав» (court bailiff), «пристав» (bailiff) and phrases formed from them

koap-uca7ae1e320dd4cc2fc-1.locator: Article 17.8.1. Unlawful use of the words «судебный пристав» (court bailiff), «пристав» (bailiff) and phrases formed from them

koap-u5dd2eda9199699c509-1.text: Unlawful use by a legal entity or individual entrepreneur in its name of the words «судебный пристав» (court bailiff) or «пристав» (bailiff) and phrases formed from them —
koap-u5dd2eda9199699c509-1.locator: Article 17.8.1. Unlawful use of the words «судебный пристав» (court bailiff), «пристав» (bailiff) and phrases formed from them

koap-u8e654de8f6a8b97231-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for an individual entrepreneur of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8e654de8f6a8b97231-1.locator: Article 17.8.1. Unlawful use of the words «судебный пристав» (court bailiff), «пристав» (bailiff) and phrases formed from them

koap-u88f3555dfbbfff63dc-1.text: Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation
koap-u88f3555dfbbfff63dc-1.locator: Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation

koap-ua8226b20c3acbb247f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation
koap-ua8226b20c3acbb247f-1.locator: Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation

koap-u1c06682d88cd521440-1.locator: Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation

koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-8.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-8.locator: Article 17.9. Knowingly false witness testimony, specialist explanation or expert opinion, or knowingly incorrect translation

koap-u70325c13a76eab1ec9-1.text: Article 17.10. Violation of the procedure for official use of state symbols of the Russian Federation

koap-u081f938461e5795f6c-1.locator: Article 17.10. Violation of the procedure for official use of state symbols of the Russian Federation

koap-u935b0b7b993ee9bf45-1.text: Violation of the procedure for official use of the State Flag, State Coat of Arms or State Anthem of the Russian Federation —
koap-u935b0b7b993ee9bf45-1.locator: Article 17.10. Violation of the procedure for official use of state symbols of the Russian Federation

koap-u3eb94d1598fb43c29b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to seven thousand roubles; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u3eb94d1598fb43c29b-1.locator: Article 17.10. Violation of the procedure for official use of state symbols of the Russian Federation

koap-u0bec975a3a73ef1139-1.text: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards
koap-u0bec975a3a73ef1139-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u9e1bcb726807c566c4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards
koap-u9e1bcb726807c566c4-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u1e3cc9a8d319ceefaa-1.text: 1. Wearing an order, medal, breast badge accompanying an honorary title, insignia of distinction of the Russian Federation, the RSFSR or the USSR, or order or medal ribbons on ribbon bars, by a person not entitled to do so —
koap-u1e3cc9a8d319ceefaa-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u4085f69fa1f9bcfc20-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the order, medal, breast badge accompanying an honorary title, insignia of distinction of the Russian Federation, the RSFSR or the USSR, or order or medal ribbons on ribbon bars.
koap-u4085f69fa1f9bcfc20-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u5f1da1645acae88ce6-1.text: 2. Establishing or manufacturing badges bearing names similar to, or resembling in appearance, state awards —
koap-u5f1da1645acae88ce6-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u4e50b9bd4ad490570c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles, with confiscation of the badges; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles, with confiscation of the badges; for legal entities, eighty-five thousand to one hundred thousand roubles, with confiscation of the badges.
koap-u4e50b9bd4ad490570c-1.locator: Article 17.11. Unlawful wearing of state awards

koap-u7822638fac33e9837a-1.text: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies
koap-u7822638fac33e9837a-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-uace623917466710cd5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies
koap-uace623917466710cd5-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-ucc37080da27c27d08c-1.text: 1. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies —
koap-ucc37080da27c27d08c-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-ubbfb987a9aae002fbf-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the uniform, insignia and symbols of the state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies.
koap-ubbfb987a9aae002fbf-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-u7a09f07a9af2605ce8-1.text: 2. The same acts committed by a person holding a special permit (licence) to conduct private detective or security activities in connection with the conduct of those activities —
koap-u7a09f07a9af2605ce8-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-u3ea06695dc0edd375d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles, with confiscation of the uniform, insignia and symbols of the state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies.
koap-u3ea06695dc0edd375d-1.locator: Article 17.12. Unlawful wearing of uniforms bearing insignia or symbols of state paramilitary organisations, law enforcement bodies or supervisory bodies

koap-ud7d634545299814c2e-1.text: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons
koap-ud7d634545299814c2e-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-u1525a7e728cbea9e03-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons
koap-u1525a7e728cbea9e03-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-u4110d62b25d094af20-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements laid down by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state protection for ensuring the confidentiality of information about protected persons and their property, where those acts (omissions) do not contain elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-u4110d62b25d094af20-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-u1aeb71ccb7a8ee1d6f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1aeb71ccb7a8ee1d6f-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-ua5e127275d0c1451b6-1.text: 2. Collection or transfer (dissemination, provision or access) of personal data of judges, prosecution staff, investigators, persons conducting inquiries, internal affairs officers, military personnel, personnel of federal security service bodies, state protection bodies, foreign intelligence bodies of the Russian Federation, the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, bodies or institutions of the penal enforcement system, customs authorities or compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, in connection with their official activities or performance of public duty, or of personal data of persons close to them, in violation of the requirements of the legislation of the Russian Federation on personal data, except in the cases provided for by Part 1 of this Article, where those acts do not contain elements of a criminally punishable act, —
koap-ua5e127275d0c1451b6-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-u8f355d008ad8b4cc22-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for up to three years; for individual entrepreneurs, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8f355d008ad8b4cc22-1.locator: Article 17.13. Unlawful dissemination of information about protected persons

koap-u4f82d7167003de18e0-1.text: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
koap-u4f82d7167003de18e0-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-ub47bd4c936720a624e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings
koap-ub47bd4c936720a624e-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u9256628aca6334793a-1.text: 1. A debtor’s violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings by failing to comply with an enforcement bailiff’s lawful demands, providing inaccurate information on the debtor’s rights to property, or failing to report termination of employment, a new place of work or study, the place of receipt of a pension or other income, or place of residence, except for the violation provided for by Article 17.17 of this Code, —
koap-u9256628aca6334793a-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u82607ac981b6cb54ba-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u82607ac981b6cb54ba-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-ub4e89a639e69f4ad1d-1.text: 2. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to comply with a requirement contained in an enforcement document to recover money from a debtor —
koap-ub4e89a639e69f4ad1d-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-ueb23b35c7c8e9f6ef8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for the bank or other credit institution of half the amount of money to be recovered from the debtor, but not more than one million roubles.
koap-ueb23b35c7c8e9f6ef8-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u3b21f94d45a79c639c-1.text: 2.1. Failure by an issuer independently maintaining the register of holders of securities issued in series, or by a professional securities market participant recording rights to such securities belonging to a debtor, to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to debit those securities from the debtor’s securities register account or custody account and credit them to the enforcing creditor’s securities register account or custody account, where securities are present in the debtor’s corresponding account, —
koap-u3b21f94d45a79c639c-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u01e1fba2fb19983d35-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one third of the value of the securities issued in series that are subject to recovery, but not more than one half of the value of those securities.
koap-u01e1fba2fb19983d35-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u92da4888b32dec9f44-1.text: 3. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings by a person other than the debtor, by failing to comply with an enforcement bailiff’s lawful demands, refusing to accept confiscated property, providing inaccurate information on the debtor’s financial position, losing an enforcement document, failing to send an enforcement document in time, or failing to comply with the requirements of an enforcement document, including one received from the enforcing creditor, —
koap-u92da4888b32dec9f44-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-udd7ad723ebd5b6c616-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-udd7ad723ebd5b6c616-1.locator: Article 17.14. Violation of legislation on enforcement proceedings

koap-u0d7e2118d9f9da5b97-1.text: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
koap-u0d7e2118d9f9da5b97-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u7bf12419cd68234ba8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document
koap-u7bf12419cd68234ba8-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-ua9f9291838da38064a-1.text: 1. A debtor’s failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
koap-ua9f9291838da38064a-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u2166b2c6d0cac1054f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u2166b2c6d0cac1054f-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-ubafe1deeca9f16ea52-1.text: 1.1. Failure by a debtor that operates a search engine to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to stop displaying links providing access to information about a citizen on the Internet information and telecommunications network, within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
koap-ubafe1deeca9f16ea52-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u48636dda4c1c12cb3d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u48636dda4c1c12cb3d-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-uebc874db32d0100b64-1.text: 1.2. A debtor’s failure to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to cease disseminating information and/or retract previously disseminated information, within the period set by an enforcement bailiff after a order imposing an enforcement fee has been issued —
koap-uebc874db32d0100b64-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u7cb816c05f08c6a211-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, ten thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7cb816c05f08c6a211-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-ue09ab34da2ebc36973-1.text: 1.3. Failure by a debtor that is a state authority (state body), local self-government body or state (municipal) treasury-funded institution to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within the period established by legislation on enforcement proceedings —
koap-ue09ab34da2ebc36973-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u30637eb14d14819e83-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-u30637eb14d14819e83-3.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u3094ea0bd21c1e0744-1.text: 2. A debtor’s failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
koap-u3094ea0bd21c1e0744-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u70ff863a55a2f13739-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles.
koap-u70ff863a55a2f13739-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u0cbd70992be98ba21e-1.text: 2.1. A debtor’s failure to comply with an enforcement document containing non-property requirements concerning fire safety, industrial safety or the safety of hydraulic structures, compliance with requirements in the field of construction and the use of construction materials (products), reconstruction, major repairs or commissioning of a capital construction facility, or ensuring the population’s sanitary and epidemiological well-being, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after a ruling imposing an administrative fine has been issued —
koap-u0cbd70992be98ba21e-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-ud1ab82bcb7a9e96770-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, two hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; for legal entities, one million to three million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ud1ab82bcb7a9e96770-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u10b2d2d00b9e77b47f-1.text: 3. Failure by a debtor that operates a search engine to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to stop displaying links providing access to information about a citizen on the Internet information and telecommunications network, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
koap-u10b2d2d00b9e77b47f-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u898603b8644b04ecbf-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u898603b8644b04ecbf-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-ua6b9143f04a09434f6-1.text: 4. A debtor’s failure to comply with requirements contained in an enforcement document to cease disseminating information and/or retract previously disseminated information, within a further period set by an enforcement bailiff after an administrative fine has been imposed —
koap-ua6b9143f04a09434f6-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u1f76e886718454a2ed-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, or administrative arrest for up to ten days, or compulsory work for up to one hundred and twenty hours; for officials, fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, or compulsory work for up to two hundred hours; for legal entities, fifty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u1f76e886718454a2ed-1.locator: Article 17.15. Failure to comply with non-property requirements contained in an enforcement document

koap-u24d79d934ab09b0a73-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. CHAPTER 18. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES CONCERNING PROTECTION OF THE STATE BORDER OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND ENFORCEMENT OF THE RULES GOVERNING THE STAY OF FOREIGN CITIZENS OR STATELESS PERSONS IN THE TERRITORY OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION
koap-u24d79d934ab09b0a73-1.locator: Chapter 18. Administrative offences concerning protection of the state border of the Russian Federation and enforcement of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens or stateless persons in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u6743d304f3e00c4b52-1.text: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
koap-u6743d304f3e00c4b52-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u4ce4f58d7c9ee3e6a4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation
koap-u4ce4f58d7c9ee3e6a4-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-ucf9755b730faee5eba-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for persons and/or vehicles crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation, or of the procedure for such persons and/or vehicles travelling from the State Border of the Russian Federation to crossing points through that border and in the opposite direction, as well as violation by such persons of the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation when undergoing border control, except in the cases provided for by Article 18.5 of this Code, —
koap-ucf9755b730faee5eba-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u5b3bef586a1e8156e8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for officials, one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, one million to two million five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5b3bef586a1e8156e8-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-3.text: 2. The same acts committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-3.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u0e37c3e2591dfbfc92-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u0e37c3e2591dfbfc92-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-uebf4df9ec8dcfadd34-1.text: 3. Conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities on or near the State Border of the Russian Federation without notifying the border authorities, or having notified those authorities but in breach of the established procedure for conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities on or near the State Border of the Russian Federation —
koap-uebf4df9ec8dcfadd34-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u74de4b0a5d7e3e01b4-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, ten thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-u74de4b0a5d7e3e01b4-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-45.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-ude18400fcc4015779b-1.text: 1. For administrative offences provided for by this Article and other articles of this Chapter, persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity bear administrative liability as legal entities in connection with those activities, except where the relevant articles of this Chapter establish special rules on administrative liability for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity that differ from those applicable to legal entities.
koap-ude18400fcc4015779b-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-ud31874a399897af891-1.text: 2. A stateless person who has applied for a temporary identity document for a stateless person in the Russian Federation, has received that document, or has submitted an application for identity establishment provided for by Article 10.1 of Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-ФЗ ‘On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation’, shall not be subject to administrative liability for violating the rules for entering the Russian Federation or the rules governing stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, unlawfully engaging in employment in the Russian Federation, or violating immigration rules, where such violations were detected upon submission of the relevant application.
koap-ud31874a399897af891-1.locator: Article 18.1. Violation of the rules governing the State Border of the Russian Federation or the rules for entering or leaving the Russian Federation

koap-u3545a998d84b6a4682-1.text: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone
koap-u3545a998d84b6a4682-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-uc2d24f185d0df548ff-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone
koap-uc2d24f185d0df548ff-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-uc6012e4e46720b8a0a-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for entry (passage) into the border zone, temporary stay, or movement of persons and/or vehicles within the border zone —
koap-uc6012e4e46720b8a0a-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-uf6c9b9c72753ba42f9-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles.
koap-uf6c9b9c72753ba42f9-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-ub987c1c12de2ff4a26-1.text: 1.1. The same acts committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-ub987c1c12de2ff4a26-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-u9d255e03bdf166f025-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u9d255e03bdf166f025-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-u2469417cb9c7b07931-1.text: 2. Conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities, or holding mass sociopolitical, cultural or other events in the border zone, as well as keeping or grazing livestock in the quarantine strip within the border zone, without permission from the border authorities, or with such permission but in breach of the established procedure for conducting economic, resource-harvesting or other activities; or violating the procedure for holding mass sociopolitical, cultural or other events in the border zone —
koap-u2469417cb9c7b07931-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-ue27954151e20073b84-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ue27954151e20073b84-1.locator: Article 18.2. Violation of border rules in the border zone

koap-uf4750d5cd746af54d1-1.text: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation
koap-uf4750d5cd746af54d1-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-ucf00ae8b9354eac05b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation
koap-ucf00ae8b9354eac05b-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-u506d7d373ddce39a0f-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules established in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation and in the Russian portions of border rivers, lakes and other water bodies for recording, storing, leaving and returning to bases, and presence on water bodies of Russian small self-propelled or non-self-propelled surface or underwater vessels (craft), or vehicles for travel on ice, —
koap-u506d7d373ddce39a0f-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-u38918ce071f610d244-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifteen thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u38918ce071f610d244-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-u120010e852c6300583-1.text: 2. Conducting resource-harvesting, research, survey or other activities in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation, or in the Russian portions of border rivers, lakes and other water bodies, without permission from (notification of) the border authorities, or with such permission (notification) but in breach of its conditions —
koap-u120010e852c6300583-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-ufabd0a28dc7e8ad84b-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence; for legal entities, twenty-five thousand to sixty thousand roubles, with or without confiscation of the instruments or subject matter of the administrative offence.
koap-ufabd0a28dc7e8ad84b-1.locator: Article 18.3. Violation of border rules in the territorial sea and internal sea waters of the Russian Federation

koap-u63ddbc13f2816cff43-1.text: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation
koap-u63ddbc13f2816cff43-1.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u619c1204254d102b54-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation
koap-u619c1204254d102b54-1.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u93704fd7efd56285a3-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation —
koap-u93704fd7efd56285a3-1.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-ua7fd37878bddad8442-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ua7fd37878bddad8442-1.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-4.text: 2. The same acts committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u2546308b362ae6b461-4.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u05e3001396843ea96d-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u05e3001396843ea96d-1.locator: Article 18.4. Violation of the rules at crossing points through the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u58892a70c6aaefb1b8-1.text: Article 18.5. Violation of the rules relating to innocent passage through the territorial sea of the Russian Federation or transit flight through the airspace of the Russian Federation

koap-u4c06932cd23be61648-1.locator: Article 18.5. Violation of the rules relating to innocent passage through the territorial sea of the Russian Federation or transit flight through the airspace of the Russian Federation

koap-ub801b2970ed75c8239-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of one hundred thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-ub801b2970ed75c8239-1.locator: Article 18.5. Violation of the rules relating to innocent passage through the territorial sea of the Russian Federation or transit flight through the airspace of the Russian Federation

koap-ud51aed756267f87ae0-1.locator: Article 18.6. Violation of the procedure for passing through designated control points (positions)

koap-uf502e909ed5ae160e0-1.locator: Article 18.6. Violation of the procedure for passing through designated control points (positions)

koap-u796595591d5e44da14-1.text: Violation by fishing-fleet vessels of the procedure for passing through designated control points (positions) when crossing the outer boundary of the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation —
koap-u796595591d5e44da14-1.locator: Article 18.6. Violation of the procedure for passing through designated control points (positions)

koap-u8f95002bcc28c9a0a3-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u8f95002bcc28c9a0a3-1.locator: Article 18.6. Violation of the procedure for passing through designated control points (positions)

koap-ueb2a2f9a01b390e3ed-1.text: Article 18.7. Disobedience to a lawful order or demand of a serviceman in connection with the performance of duties to protect the State Border of the Russian Federation
koap-ueb2a2f9a01b390e3ed-1.locator: Article 18.7. Disobedience to a lawful order or demand of a serviceman in connection with the performance of duties to protect the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u06a91cbf1810f73eca-1.locator: Article 18.7. Disobedience to a lawful order or demand of a serviceman in connection with the performance of duties to protect the State Border of the Russian Federation
