koap-u0c2ef8e35491a4a81a-1.text: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation
koap-u0c2ef8e35491a4a81a-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u19cc8fa4ff2d8aa030-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation
koap-u19cc8fa4ff2d8aa030-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-ufd3f0db7a5119e19dc-1.text: 1. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 18.1 of this Code, manifested in violation of the established rules for entry into the Russian Federation, the rules of migration registration, movement or the procedure for choosing a place of stay or residence, or transit through the territory of the Russian Federation, or in failure to fulfil the obligation to give notification confirming residence in the Russian Federation in cases established by federal law —
koap-ufd3f0db7a5119e19dc-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u693c1d6ed460057a50-1.text: 1.1. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, manifested in the absence of documents confirming the right to stay (reside) in the Russian Federation or, where such documents have been lost, failure to report their loss to the appropriate authority, or in evasion of departure from the Russian Federation upon expiry of the prescribed period of stay, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u693c1d6ed460057a50-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u354fed33eea6f32ef8-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u354fed33eea6f32ef8-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u3364ac466c390aa1e4-1.text: 2. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, manifested in a discrepancy between the declared purpose of entry into the Russian Federation and the activity or occupation actually pursued during the stay (residence) in the Russian Federation —
koap-u3364ac466c390aa1e4-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-2.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-ub9faa911dd6292691c-1.text: 3. The violations provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-ub9faa911dd6292691c-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u186b5dbb133077e6c7-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u186b5dbb133077e6c7-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u4271ca2bef194de6f8-1.text: 3.1. The violation provided for by part 1.1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-u4271ca2bef194de6f8-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u85ee23b12896f231a8-1.text: 4. Repeated commission within one year by a foreign citizen or stateless person of an administrative offence provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article —
koap-u85ee23b12896f231a8-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-2.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-uee1a425f87f208dbb9-1.text: 5. Repeated commission within one year by a foreign citizen or stateless person of an administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article —
koap-uee1a425f87f208dbb9-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u46c1ba7f8f8c9ae668-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of seven thousand to ten thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u46c1ba7f8f8c9ae668-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u2926d42a49b5db4e4e-1.text: Note. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation in the form of controlled independent departure from the Russian Federation shall not apply to foreign citizens and stateless persons held administratively liable for the administrative offence provided for by part 4 of this Article.
koap-u2926d42a49b5db4e4e-1.locator: Article 18.8. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the rules for entry into the Russian Federation or the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u943a076ac64f538af9-1.text: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation
koap-u943a076ac64f538af9-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u9464fd8f807cb463ed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation
koap-u9464fd8f807cb463ed-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u46e5d2251522ad70e1-1.text: 1. Violation by the inviting or receiving party, or by an official of a legal entity that provides services to a foreign citizen or stateless person or performs duties connected with compliance with the conditions of stay in the Russian Federation or transit through the territory of the Russian Federation by foreign citizens or stateless persons, of the established procedure for preparing documents for the right of foreign citizens and stateless persons to stay in the Russian Federation, their residence, movement, change of place of stay or residence in the Russian Federation and departure from it, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u46e5d2251522ad70e1-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u3ca54b499bcb0f896a-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3ca54b499bcb0f896a-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-uf0eeef1aa2565b5ff2-1.text: 2. Failure by the inviting party to take the prescribed measures to ensure that an invited foreign citizen or stateless person complies with the regime of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation as regards correspondence between their declared purpose of entry into the Russian Federation and the activity or occupation actually pursued during their stay (residence) in the Russian Federation, or failure by the inviting party to take the prescribed measures to ensure the timely departure of an invited foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation upon expiry of the prescribed period of their stay in the Russian Federation —
koap-uf0eeef1aa2565b5ff2-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u307c30e12637b0d606-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u307c30e12637b0d606-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-uc4f1eef1e2ec15da63-1.text: 3. Provision of residential premises or a vehicle, or the rendering of other services, to a foreign citizen or stateless person present in the Russian Federation in violation of the established procedure or the rules of transit through its territory, as well as the rendering to a foreign citizen included in the register of controlled persons provided for by the legislation on the legal status of foreign citizens in the Russian Federation of services whose provision is prohibited (restricted) under the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-uc4f1eef1e2ec15da63-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u94fd2748f2de8aa8ce-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u94fd2748f2de8aa8ce-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u8df6bac72579958c89-1.text: 4. Failure by the receiving party to fulfil duties connected with migration registration, except in the cases provided for by Article 18.9.1 of this Code, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u8df6bac72579958c89-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u26beaa4728b2424f60-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u26beaa4728b2424f60-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-udb4527e9d9e23c50bf-1.text: 5. Failure by the inviting party to take measures to provide material support, medical care and housing for an invited foreign citizen or stateless person during their stay in the Russian Federation —
koap-udb4527e9d9e23c50bf-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u3ca54b499bcb0f896a-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u3ca54b499bcb0f896a-2.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u2665f67fdddfb8a762-1.text: 6. Provision by the inviting party of knowingly false information concerning the purpose of the stay of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation when preparing documents for the entry into the Russian Federation of that foreign citizen or stateless person, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 19.23 of this Code —
koap-u2665f67fdddfb8a762-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-ua763af660606fc28bf-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of forty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua763af660606fc28bf-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-uf04094870c5394dc2a-1.text: Note. Where the inviting or receiving party, or an official of a legal entity that provides services to a foreign citizen or stateless person or performs duties connected with compliance with the conditions of stay in the Russian Federation or transit through the territory of the Russian Federation by foreign citizens or stateless persons, violates the established procedure for preparing documents for the right of foreign citizens and stateless persons to stay in the Russian Federation, their residence, movement, change of place of stay or residence in the Russian Federation and departure from it in respect of two or more invited or received foreign citizens and (or) stateless persons, the administrative liability established by this Article shall arise separately in respect of each foreign citizen or stateless person.
koap-uf04094870c5394dc2a-1.locator: Article 18.9. Violation of the rules governing the stay of foreign citizens and stateless persons in the Russian Federation

koap-u75613db01f0fc65a5a-1.text: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-u75613db01f0fc65a5a-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ue6778ebfa372278d6a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-ue6778ebfa372278d6a-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u8b33270ee5f29ad114-1.text: 1. Failure by a legal entity or a person conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities, to meet the prescribed deadline for submitting to the migration registration authority notification of the arrival of a foreign citizen or stateless person at the place of stay and (or) notification of the departure of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the place of stay, by no more than one working day —
koap-u8b33270ee5f29ad114-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6955c37d581853a9f8-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6955c37d581853a9f8-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-31.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-31.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u5f7c386e28687a6b2e-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundred and sixty thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u5f7c386e28687a6b2e-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u1f5fbd8b24308b21c1-1.text: 3. Exceeding the deadline specified in part 1 of this Article by more than one working day —
koap-u1f5fbd8b24308b21c1-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u77b8d2f32d9c9c5080-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u77b8d2f32d9c9c5080-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u6cab61a58a9def3a37-1.text: Note. Where a legal entity or a person conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities, fails to meet the prescribed deadline for submitting to the migration registration authority notification of the arrival of a foreign citizen or stateless person at the place of stay and (or) notification of the departure of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the place of stay in respect of two or more foreign citizens and (or) stateless persons, the administrative liability established by this Article shall arise separately in respect of each foreign citizen or stateless person.
koap-u6cab61a58a9def3a37-1.locator: Article 18.9.1. Violation of the rules for migration registration of foreign citizens and stateless persons at their place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u69d4179a81457ddb54-1.text: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation
koap-u69d4179a81457ddb54-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u14a94b88393d2307e3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation
koap-u14a94b88393d2307e3-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-ubd399e7efd3e273a5b-1.text: 1. A foreign citizen or stateless person conducting employment activities in the Russian Federation without a work permit or a patent, where such a permit or patent is required by federal law, or a foreign citizen or stateless person conducting employment activities in the Russian Federation in a profession (speciality, position, type of employment activity) not specified in the work permit or patent, where the work permit or patent contains information on the profession (speciality, position, type of employment activity), or a foreign citizen or stateless person conducting employment activities outside the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in whose territory that foreign citizen was issued a work permit or a patent or was permitted temporary residence —
koap-ubd399e7efd3e273a5b-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-3.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u6d2fd87f8dcb527204-1.text: 2. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-u6d2fd87f8dcb527204-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-3.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u0200c6682a76997588-1.text: 3. Repeated commission within one year by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u0200c6682a76997588-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-4.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u189d7d852aac839ffc-4.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-ud7e8d0906aa0838bf4-1.text: 4. Failure by a foreign citizen or stateless person to meet the deadline for applying to amend the information contained in a work permit or patent, or failure by a foreign citizen or stateless person to apply for such amendments, where such an application is required by federal law —
koap-ud7e8d0906aa0838bf4-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-4.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-4.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u66eb1ba9a2ba498527-1.text: Note. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation in the form of controlled independent departure from the Russian Federation shall not apply to foreign citizens and stateless persons held administratively liable for the administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article.
koap-u66eb1ba9a2ba498527-1.locator: Article 18.10. Unlawful employment activities of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation

koap-u222a89a66cc62fd35b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.11. Violation of immigration rules

koap-ua291153d5ca1ea3132-1.text: 1. Evasion by an immigrant of immigration control provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, identification of their identity, or residence in a temporary holding facility, an immigrant temporary accommodation centre or a place designated for temporary stay by the territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration, as well as violation of the rules of residence in those places or evasion of the provision of information or provision of inaccurate information during determination of the immigrant's status in the Russian Federation —

koap-u6fec33fd1751ce13ef-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.

koap-ud51f773649da1b0661-1.text: 2. Failure to provide, or late provision of, documents or information required by the legislation of the Russian Federation concerning foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to immigration control provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, at the request of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration or its territorial body —

koap-u26beaa4728b2424f60-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u6a9adf9ac6f5391d0c-1.text: Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination
koap-u6a9adf9ac6f5391d0c-1.locator: Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination

koap-uce3f80f3c8e6797fdc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination
koap-uce3f80f3c8e6797fdc-1.locator: Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination

koap-u8f64f2414075173b7d-1.text: Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation established by the legislation of the Russian Federation to undergo a medical examination, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u8f64f2414075173b7d-1.locator: Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination

koap-udf87f09f00340d5d01-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-udf87f09f00340d5d01-1.locator: Article 18.11.1. Refusal and (or) evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the obligation to undergo a medical examination

koap-u19d8511f9761110308-1.text: Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation
koap-u19d8511f9761110308-1.locator: Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u783f66ca4f9b04f108-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation
koap-u783f66ca4f9b04f108-1.locator: Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u2096de95fff003af1a-1.text: Failure by a refugee or forced migrant, when changing their place of stay or residence, to fulfil the obligation to deregister with the territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration to which they are assigned, as well as failure to fulfil the obligation to register in due time with the territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration at the new place of stay or residence, or failure by a refugee to report to the appropriate territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration a change of surname, first name, marital status or family composition, or acquisition of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of another state —
koap-u2096de95fff003af1a-1.locator: Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-u9d69b23b9d7f996e72-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to four thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-u9d69b23b9d7f996e72-1.locator: Article 18.12. Violation by a refugee or forced migrant of the rules of stay (residence) in the Russian Federation

koap-udf625ee793903bfaaa-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.13. Repealed
koap-udf625ee793903bfaaa-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.13. Repealed

koap-u8a63f15ce3af704ce2-1.text: Article 18.13. Repealed with effect from 1 March 2025. — Federal Law of 09.11.2024 No. 378-ФЗ.

koap-u1e3d81bff474da225a-1.text: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation
koap-u1e3d81bff474da225a-1.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-uff86971406b8adea71-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation
koap-uff86971406b8adea71-1.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u8046a0142357e99d0a-1.text: 1. Failure by a transport or other organisation performing international carriage to take measures within its duties to prevent persons from unlawfully gaining access to a means of transport and using it for unlawful entry into the Russian Federation or unlawful departure from the Russian Federation, resulting in unlawful crossing or an attempt to unlawfully cross the State Border of the Russian Federation by one or more offenders —
koap-u8046a0142357e99d0a-1.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u0f3ca11a109d41b5f0-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on the legal entity of one hundred and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u0f3ca11a109d41b5f0-1.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-ub50f5952c996545a67-1.text: 2. Failure by a person crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation on private business to take measures to prevent another person from using the means of transport under their control to unlawfully cross the State Border of the Russian Federation, resulting in unlawful crossing or an attempt to unlawfully cross the State Border of the Russian Federation by one or more offenders, where that act did not constitute aiding a crime —
koap-ub50f5952c996545a67-1.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-8.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u725114dc9afbd98a66-8.locator: Article 18.14. Unlawful transport of persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation

koap-uf74fc36b72ce06ed76-1.text: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation
koap-uf74fc36b72ce06ed76-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u770f5595ac02faea7c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation
koap-u770f5595ac02faea7c-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-uda6826de154f034f5c-1.text: 1. Engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation when that foreign citizen or stateless person has no work permit or patent, where such a permit or patent is required by federal law, or engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation in a profession (speciality, position, type of employment activity) not specified in the work permit or patent, where the work permit or patent contains information on the profession (speciality, position, type of employment activity), or engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities outside the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in whose territory that foreign citizen or stateless person was issued a work permit or patent or was permitted temporary residence —
koap-uda6826de154f034f5c-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-ua3edfa8ffcd83f509c-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-ua3edfa8ffcd83f509c-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-ufa626f76ad6e0be825-1.text: 2. Engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation without obtaining, in accordance with the established procedure, a permit to engage and use foreign workers, where such a permit is required by federal law —
koap-ufa626f76ad6e0be825-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-ua3edfa8ffcd83f509c-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-ua3edfa8ffcd83f509c-2.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-ufb1ffdbe5381f3fd34-1.text: 3. Failure to notify, or violation of the established procedure and (or) form for notifying, the territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration of the conclusion or termination (cancellation) of an employment contract or civil-law contract for the performance of work (provision of services) with a foreign citizen within a period not exceeding three working days from the date of conclusion or termination (cancellation) of the contract, where such notification is required by federal law —
koap-ufb1ffdbe5381f3fd34-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u7ee8f0e0e88bb475b1-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u7ee8f0e0e88bb475b1-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u765f18b73e63ccdef7-1.text: 4. The violations provided for by parts 1 - 3 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-u765f18b73e63ccdef7-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u645d7274c8beade6b3-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand to seven thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to seventy thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u645d7274c8beade6b3-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u021d20fd4f3f28cb52-1.text: 5. Failure by an employer or a customer of work (services) engaging highly qualified specialists to notify, or violation of the established procedure and (or) form for notifying, the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration or its authorised territorial body, in accordance with the list established by that federal executive authority, of fulfilment of obligations to pay salaries (remuneration) to highly qualified specialists, where such notification or provision of such information is required by federal law —
koap-u021d20fd4f3f28cb52-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-uabde97de43c1004e75-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty-five thousand to seventy thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uabde97de43c1004e75-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-46.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u4bc981dde120d4fb8f-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Article, engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation means admission in any form to the performance of work or provision of services, or other use of the labour of a foreign citizen or stateless person.
koap-u4bc981dde120d4fb8f-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u32c7bdc85dbbb41891-1.text: 2. In the event of unlawful engagement in employment activities in the Russian Federation of two or more foreign citizens and (or) stateless persons, the administrative liability established by this Article shall arise for violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons (including foreign workers) in employment activities in the Russian Federation separately in respect of each foreign citizen or stateless person.
koap-u32c7bdc85dbbb41891-1.locator: Article 18.15. Unlawful engagement of a foreign citizen or stateless person in employment activities in the Russian Federation

koap-u3a0df7ebc40a5da576-1.text: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets
koap-u3a0df7ebc40a5da576-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-udb388c472219b2ad0e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets
koap-udb388c472219b2ad0e-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-uf19da12b4b0ff4ca1d-1.text: 1. Provision within a retail market of a trading space, warehouse, ancillary, administrative and utility or other premises by the market management company, an official of the market management company or a person who has concluded an agreement with that company for the provision of a trading space or the said premises, to a foreign citizen or stateless person engaged in employment activities at that retail market in violation of the established rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in such activities (including where the permissible proportion of foreign workers used at markets established by the Government of the Russian Federation is exceeded) —
koap-uf19da12b4b0ff4ca1d-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-u13fbdc0b00d09f2661-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, three hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days; on legal entities, four hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u13fbdc0b00d09f2661-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-uf5d1045f2957fa0596-1.text: 2. Provision within a retail market of a trading space, warehouse, ancillary, administrative and utility or other premises by the market management company, an official of the market management company or a person who has concluded an agreement with that company for the provision of a trading space or the said premises, to another person who does not have a permit to engage and use foreign workers but actually uses the labour of foreign workers at that retail market, or who engages in employment activities at that retail market foreign citizens or stateless persons who do not have a work permit or patent, where such a permit or patent is required by federal law —
koap-uf5d1045f2957fa0596-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-u13fbdc0b00d09f2661-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, three hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days; on legal entities, four hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u13fbdc0b00d09f2661-2.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-ub9faa911dd6292691c-2.text: 3. The violations provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-ub9faa911dd6292691c-2.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-u2bde710e78ce47b55f-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of four thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, forty-five thousand to seventy thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred and fifty thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u2bde710e78ce47b55f-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-ub96c9e9039c7aa9fc3-1.text: Note. Where the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets are violated in respect of two or more foreign citizens and (or) stateless persons, the administrative liability provided for by parts 1 and 3 of this Article shall arise for violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets separately in respect of each foreign citizen or stateless person.
koap-ub96c9e9039c7aa9fc3-1.locator: Article 18.16. Violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in employment activities at retail markets

koap-u6c9b29a2ab30a7fdb9-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

koap-ud6c900b866295753c7-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

koap-u27a955e2b8da64e8cb-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, forty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, eight hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-u27a955e2b8da64e8cb-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

koap-ufabbf4641937d30dab-1.text: 2. Failure by a foreign citizen or stateless person to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens and stateless persons —
koap-ufabbf4641937d30dab-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

koap-u586e3e351991aee5f0-1.text: 3. Failure by a foreign legal entity, its branch or representative office to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign organisations —
koap-u586e3e351991aee5f0-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

koap-ua62d85dbf8b9866e47-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of eight hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for fourteen to ninety days.
koap-ua62d85dbf8b9866e47-1.locator: Article 18.17. Failure to comply with restrictions on certain types of activities established under federal law in respect of foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations

Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u74607b5288416024d8-1.text: 1. Unauthorised departure by a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission from a medical organisation, a special facility provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-ФЗ "On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation", or another facility in which that foreign citizen or stateless person has been placed (to which they have been brought) in connection with a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or in connection with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission, or unauthorised departure by a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission from a vehicle while being transported to the said organisation or facilities or during another movement connected with execution of a decision on administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation or with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission —
koap-u74607b5288416024d8-1.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-5.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-5.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-udafcc6a7e73de8706a-1.text: 2. Failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period —
koap-udafcc6a7e73de8706a-1.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-6.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u11f5ddfe01d9f448ce-6.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-ue5bc72183044ef46bc-1.text: 3. Failure to comply with the conditions and procedure for holding (stay of) a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special facility provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-ФЗ "On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation", resulting in violation of sanitary standards and rules or requirements for fire safety or preservation of the property of special facilities, or the commission of acts violating the rights and freedoms of other persons or degrading their human dignity, or acts threatening one's own life and health as well as the life and health of other persons —
koap-ue5bc72183044ef46bc-1.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u850ecab056320895fa-8.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u850ecab056320895fa-8.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-ud03c7fcd65c06719ae-1.text: 4. The same acts, accompanied by failure to comply with lawful demands of employees of special facilities or officials of territorial bodies of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration, or obstruction of the performance of official duties by those employees, officials or persons performing duties to maintain public order or suppressing a breach of public order —
koap-ud03c7fcd65c06719ae-1.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u2d55540c95078b96d9-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-u2d55540c95078b96d9-1.locator: Article 18.18. Violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of mandatory rules connected with execution of a decision on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation or deportation, or rules connected with implementation of an international treaty of the Russian Federation on readmission; failure of a foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom a decision has been taken to discontinue the readmission procedure to depart voluntarily from the Russian Federation within the prescribed period

koap-u1331fda4d72d8bfc3b-1.text: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations
koap-u1331fda4d72d8bfc3b-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-u3a559c93d4c455efa6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations
koap-u3a559c93d4c455efa6-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-u52aa34a6b7d1936fbc-1.text: 1. Failure by an educational or scientific organisation to notify the territorial body of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration of the granting of academic leave to a foreign citizen or stateless person, the completion or termination of study of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the educational or scientific organisation, or the unauthorised departure of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the educational or scientific organisation, where such notification is required by federal law, or violation by the educational or scientific organisation of the established procedure for submitting such notification —
koap-u52aa34a6b7d1936fbc-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-u1ac7e7585c5f7a0f56-1.text: 2. Failure by an educational or scientific organisation to notify the executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercising administration in the sphere of education of the arrival of a foreign citizen or stateless person at the educational or scientific organisation, the granting of academic leave to a foreign citizen or stateless person, the completion or termination of study of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the educational or scientific organisation, or the unauthorised departure of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the educational or scientific organisation, where such notification is required by federal law, or violation by the educational or scientific organisation of the established procedure for submitting such notification —
koap-u1ac7e7585c5f7a0f56-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-2.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-u50055316def38a3d8f-1.text: 3. Failure by an educational or scientific organisation to notify the territorial body of the federal executive authority authorised in the sphere of security of the Russian Federation of the unauthorised departure of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the educational or scientific organisation, where such notification is required by federal law, or violation by the educational or scientific organisation of the established procedure for submitting such notification —
koap-u50055316def38a3d8f-1.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf077b09bbe5031bb08-3.locator: Article 18.19. Violation of the rules for notifying authorised state bodies of the study or termination of study of foreign citizens and stateless persons in educational or scientific organisations

koap-ud8376dc8aab01868c0-1.locator: Article 18.21. Violation of the established procedure for conducting medical examinations of foreign citizens or stateless persons

koap-u2bf6d7b510146f7906-1.text: Violation of the established procedure for conducting medical examinations of foreign citizens or stateless persons for the presence or absence of the use by them of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor's prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances, infectious diseases posing a danger to others and included in the list approved by the federal executive authority authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation, and disease caused by the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV infection), if this action does not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-u010ff6b418bb54a433-1.locator: Article 18.21. Violation of the established procedure for conducting medical examinations of foreign citizens or stateless persons

koap-uc0f7ba77ef36a2328f-1.text: Note. koap-u6e1cbee2ea831dc3dd-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of five thousand to ten thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year.
koap-u6e1cbee2ea831dc3dd-1.locator: Article 19.6.1. Failure by officials of state control (supervision) bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal institutions, state corporations and public-law companies vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to comply with the requirements of legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control

koap-ue1a3c9f88d4b44bb44-1.text: 3. koap-ue1a3c9f88d4b44bb44-1.locator: Article 19.6.1. Failure by officials of state control (supervision) bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal institutions, state corporations and public-law companies vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to comply with the requirements of legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control

koap-udba335ace80a112eea-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one thousand to three thousand roubles.
koap-udba335ace80a112eea-1.locator: Article 19.6.1. Failure by officials of state control (supervision) bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal institutions, state corporations and public-law companies vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to comply with the requirements of legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control

koap-ueb0bb93c571e1a3d90-1.text: 4. Failure by officials of federal executive authorities, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, state corporations and public-law companies authorised to exercise state control (supervision), local self-government bodies authorised to exercise municipal control, or state or municipal institutions vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to fulfil the obligation, after preparing a report on a control (supervisory) measure or a report on an inspection conducted, to issue to the controlled person a compliance order to remedy identified violations and (or) take measures to prevent harm (damage) to legally protected values in the cases provided for by legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control, or the obligation to exercise control over compliance with that order, if these actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ueb0bb93c571e1a3d90-1.locator: Article 19.6.1. Failure by officials of state control (supervision) bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal institutions, state corporations and public-law companies vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to comply with the requirements of legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control

koap-ueed6f03a0d83937c6a-3.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-ueed6f03a0d83937c6a-3.locator: Article 19.6.1. Failure by officials of state control (supervision) bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal institutions, state corporations and public-law companies vested with powers to exercise state control (supervision) or municipal control to comply with the requirements of legislation on state control (supervision) and municipal control

koap-u5b9a1de12e49a60794-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.7. Failure to provide data (information)

koap-u2a6f4d0b57f944636e-1.text: Failure to provide, or late provision to a state body (official), a body (official) exercising state control (supervision) or state financial control, an organisation authorised under federal laws to exercise state supervision (its official), or a body (official) exercising municipal control or municipal financial control, of data (information) whose provision is required by law and is necessary for the lawful activities of that body (official), or provision to a state body (official), a body (official) exercising state control (supervision) or state financial control, an organisation authorised under federal laws to exercise state supervision (its official), or a body (official) exercising municipal control or municipal financial control, of such data (information) in incomplete or distorted form, except in the cases provided for by Article 6.16, part 2 of Article 6.31, parts 1, 2, 4, 10 and 11 of Article 8.28.1, Article 8.32.1, part 1 of Article 8.49, part 5 of Article 14.5, part 4 of Article 14.28, part 1 of Article 14.46.2, part 2 of Article 14.57, Articles 19.4.3, 19.7.1, 19.7.2, 19.7.3, 19.7.5, 19.7.5-1, 19.7.7, 19.7.8, 19.7.9, 19.7.12 - 19.7.16, 19.8 and 19.8.3, and parts 2, 7, 8 and 9 of Article 19.34 of this Code —

koap-u537d30b214b8162642-3.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred to three hundred roubles; on officials, three hundred to five hundred roubles; on legal entities, three thousand to five thousand roubles.

koap-ud4c683b8efce9a59b2-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud4c683b8efce9a59b2-1.locator: Article 19.7.1. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to a body exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of state-regulated prices (tariffs)

koap-uf9c6512d5eadd7f9a1-1.locator: Article 19.7.1. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to a body exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of state-regulated prices (tariffs)

koap-ub0a126229da8695332-1.locator: Article 19.7.1. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to a body exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of state-regulated prices (tariffs)

koap-ua30ff38d4cefc6c734-1.text: 3. Commission of the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article by an official previously subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence —

koap-u6473ebc8f9b993565b-1.locator: Article 19.7.3. Failure to provide information to the Bank of Russia

koap-u5d7337a25ae5e990ea-1.text: 1. Failure by a film exhibitor conducting paid film screenings in a cinema hall to provide information, or provision of incomplete information, to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information —
koap-u5d7337a25ae5e990ea-1.locator: Article 19.7.7. Failure to provide information to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls

koap-u013f94376720645fd7-1.text: entails the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of one thousandth to one hundredth of total revenue from the sale of all goods (work, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not carry out activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (work, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u013f94376720645fd7-1.locator: Article 19.7.7. Failure to provide information to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls

koap-u3bd2d8a905d74408bf-1.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article by a legal entity previously subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence —
koap-u3bd2d8a905d74408bf-1.locator: Article 19.7.7. Failure to provide information to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls

koap-ub1e5e69b922e7fa534-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one hundredth to one twenty-fifth of total revenue from the sale of all goods (work, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected preceding the date of its detection if the offender did not carry out activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (work, services) in the preceding calendar year, but not less than four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub1e5e69b922e7fa534-1.locator: Article 19.7.7. Failure to provide information to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-48.locator: Article 19.7.7. Failure to provide information to the unified federal automated information system of data on film screenings in cinema halls

koap-ub46588469aca2f93b6-12.text: 1. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.

koap-u1bfbd58ab0a1adc9aa-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-u0e004ef11af9c574ea-1.text: 1. Failure to provide, or late provision to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, of data enabling identification of the owner of a news aggregator, the owner of an audiovisual service, the owner of a social network or the owner of a classified-advertisement service and (or) other information necessary to maintain the register of news aggregators, register of audiovisual services, register of social networks or register of classified-advertisement services, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to that body —
koap-u0e004ef11af9c574ea-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-u2924a666338e1a27db-1.text: 1.1. Failure by a hosting provider or another person ensuring the hosting on the Internet of software and hardware tools for access to information resources or information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted to provide, or late provision to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, of data enabling identification of the owner of software and hardware tools for access to information resources or information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted, or information on notification of the owner of software and hardware tools for access to information resources or information and telecommunications networks to which access is restricted of the need to post data enabling identification of that owner —
koap-u2924a666338e1a27db-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-2.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-u94960b1328e562ec59-1.text: 1.2. Failure by a hosting provider or another person ensuring the hosting of an information resource on the Internet information and telecommunications network to provide, or late provision to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, of data enabling identification of the owner of an information resource of a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person operating on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to that body —
koap-u94960b1328e562ec59-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uc8d0d06855be0ec9cf-3.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-ua0a04c43cc96fe6762-1.text: 1.3. Failure by a foreign legal entity, a foreign organisation that is not a legal entity, a foreign citizen or a stateless person operating on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation to provide, or late provision to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, of information necessary to maintain the list of foreign persons operating on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to that body —
koap-ua0a04c43cc96fe6762-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-u1e5527d3f3b5b1f386-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ude68eaa10fde1d6fcb-1.text: 2. Repeated commission within a year of an administrative offence provided for by parts 1 - 1.2 of this Article —
koap-ude68eaa10fde1d6fcb-1.locator: Article 19.7.10. Failure to provide information or provision of knowingly inaccurate information to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications

koap-u1c470d4b77a2f6a291-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days.
