Failure by a communications operator, an owner or other holder of a technological communications network having a unique identifier for a set of communications equipment and other technical means on the Internet information and telecommunications network, an owner or other holder of communications lines crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation, another person using communications lines crossing the State Border of the Russian Federation, or another person having a unique identifier for a set of communications equipment and other technical means on the Internet information and telecommunications network, to provide to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications information whose provision is required by Federal Law of 7 July 2003 No. 126-ФЗ "On Communications", or violation by the listed persons of the requirements concerning the deadlines, procedure, content or format for providing that information, except in the cases provided for by part 1 of Article 13.43 of this Code —

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-8.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article —

Failure by a communications operator providing access services to the Internet information and telecommunications network and (or) services connecting to its data transmission network the data transmission network of another operator providing access services to the Internet information and telecommunications network, to provide to the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of mass media, mass communications, information technologies and communications information enabling identification of communications equipment and user equipment (terminal equipment) on the Internet information and telecommunications network in the territory of the Russian Federation, the territory of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or part of the territory of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or provision of inaccurate information, or provision of information in violation of the procedure, deadlines, content and format for providing such information —

koap-u52586ef84ae07ef873-1.locator: Article 19.8.2. Failure to submit petitions, notifications (information) or data (information) to the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control over foreign investment in the Russian Federation

koap-u88e3007a125334899b-1.locator: Article 19.8.2. Failure to submit petitions, notifications (information) or data (information) to the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control over foreign investment in the Russian Federation

koap-uf0cf9c0cc1f20831e0-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-uf0cf9c0cc1f20831e0-3.locator: Article 19.8.2. Failure to submit petitions, notifications (information) or data (information) to the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control over foreign investment in the Russian Federation

koap-u5b3e513a612d3ac08b-1.locator: Article 19.15. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation without a citizen's identity document (passport)

koap-u36a46792dbbf4d7243-1.locator: Article 19.15. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation without a citizen's identity document (passport)

koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-2.text: 2. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg —
koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-2.locator: Article 19.15. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation without a citizen's identity document (passport)

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-7.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-7.locator: Article 19.15. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation without a citizen's identity document (passport)

koap-u221d16ca2d229680d0-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on tenants or owners of the residential premises (individuals), five thousand to seven thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u221d16ca2d229680d0-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-u21a41f8a8ce861f9a0-1.text: Note. Citizens of the Russian Federation shall be exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article in the event of:
koap-u21a41f8a8ce861f9a0-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-ud358b00100b1eae6a2-1.text: residence without registration at the place of stay in residential premises located in the relevant settlement of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, if they are registered at the place of residence in other residential premises located in the same or another settlement of the same constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
koap-ud358b00100b1eae6a2-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-u931df7899c1fe2d073-1.text: residence without registration at the place of stay in residential premises located in the federal city of Moscow or in a settlement of Moscow Oblast, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of Moscow or in a settlement of Moscow Oblast;
koap-u931df7899c1fe2d073-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-u493d9fe57aed43b6a5-1.text: residence without registration at the place of stay in residential premises located in the federal city of St Petersburg or in a settlement of Leningrad Oblast, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of St Petersburg or in a settlement of Leningrad Oblast;
koap-u493d9fe57aed43b6a5-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-ubad46d80fc6316cdba-1.text: residence without registration at the place of stay in residential premises located in the federal city of Sevastopol or in a settlement of the Republic of Crimea, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of Sevastopol or in a settlement of the Republic of Crimea;
koap-ubad46d80fc6316cdba-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-uce09e3fd14eed2dce1-1.text: their being spouses, children (including adopted children), wards, spouses of children, parents, adoptive parents, guardians, curators, spouses of parents, brothers or sisters related by blood, grandmothers, grandfathers or grandchildren of the tenant (owner) of the residential premises who is registered at the place of residence in those residential premises;
koap-uce09e3fd14eed2dce1-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-u88157f784143b2a53c-1.text: the persons residing together with the tenant or owner of the residential premises being, in relation to that tenant or owner, spouses, children (including adopted children), wards, spouses of children, parents, adoptive parents, guardians, curators, spouses of parents, brothers or sisters related by blood, grandmothers, grandfathers or grandchildren.
koap-u88157f784143b2a53c-1.locator: Article 19.15.1. Residence of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence without registration

koap-u2c7ea8f44b83b3f78f-1.text: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence
koap-u2c7ea8f44b83b3f78f-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-uac794faead95a552a1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence
koap-uac794faead95a552a1-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u11c22f95862fce3025-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence, except in the cases provided for by Article 19.15.3 of this Code, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u11c22f95862fce3025-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u64488e9efb2bb5593d-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; on tenants or owners of the residential premises (individuals), two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred and fifty thousand to seven hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u64488e9efb2bb5593d-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-4.text: 2. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg —
koap-u275a02a812a96debc0-4.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-ucfcf9df60ca9724e0e-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on tenants or owners of the residential premises (individuals), five thousand to seven thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ucfcf9df60ca9724e0e-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u932db0f74b62aeebf3-1.text: 3. Failure without valid reasons by a tenant or owner who has provided residential premises to a citizen of the Russian Federation to meet the deadlines established by the legislation of the Russian Federation for notifying the registration authority that the citizen is residing in those residential premises without registration, or provision to the registration authority of knowingly inaccurate information on registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u932db0f74b62aeebf3-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-ud09c6a5e29312bde95-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to three thousand roubles; on legal entities, four thousand to seven thousand roubles.
koap-ud09c6a5e29312bde95-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u9518c759a5baefab0a-1.text: 4. The violation provided for by part 3 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg —
koap-u9518c759a5baefab0a-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-ud701e8abe66a163b92-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on legal entities, seven thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-ud701e8abe66a163b92-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u633a4f04aad6708697-1.text: 5. Failure by a person responsible for receiving and transmitting to the registration authority documents for registration and deregistration of a citizen of the Russian Federation at the place of stay and place of residence within the Russian Federation to meet the deadlines established by the legislation of the Russian Federation for submitting documents for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation to the registration authority, or submission to the registration authority of knowingly inaccurate documents for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u633a4f04aad6708697-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-8.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-8.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-50.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-ude3c6fe8aa1400a065-1.text: 1. Citizens of the Russian Federation shall be exempt from administrative liability for violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence if they provide documented information that they are spouses, children (including adopted children), wards, spouses of children, parents, adoptive parents, guardians, curators, spouses of parents, brothers or sisters related by blood, grandmothers, grandfathers or grandchildren of the tenant (owner) of the residential premises who is registered at the place of residence in those residential premises.
koap-ude3c6fe8aa1400a065-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u044868d2fbab15d12f-1.text: 2. The tenant (owner) of residential premises shall be exempt from administrative liability for failure to meet the deadlines established by the legislation of the Russian Federation for notifying the registration authority that a citizen of the Russian Federation is residing in those residential premises without registration in the event of:
koap-u044868d2fbab15d12f-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-ub7ba328ec2b6b225bc-1.text: that citizen providing documented information on their registration at the place of residence in other residential premises located in the same or another settlement of the same constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
koap-ub7ba328ec2b6b225bc-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u3f9c649e985d3bc5e1-1.text: a citizen of the Russian Federation residing in residential premises located in the federal city of Moscow or in a settlement of Moscow Oblast, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of Moscow or in a settlement of Moscow Oblast;
koap-u3f9c649e985d3bc5e1-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u773d2e2a69e7205190-1.text: a citizen of the Russian Federation residing in residential premises located in the federal city of St Petersburg or in a settlement of Leningrad Oblast, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of St Petersburg or in a settlement of Leningrad Oblast;
koap-u773d2e2a69e7205190-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u5e204dc5c116a56475-1.text: a citizen of the Russian Federation residing in residential premises located in the federal city of Sevastopol or in a settlement of the Republic of Crimea, if they are registered at the place of residence in residential premises located in the federal city of Sevastopol or in a settlement of the Republic of Crimea.
koap-u5e204dc5c116a56475-1.locator: Article 19.15.2. Violation of the rules for registration of a citizen of the Russian Federation in residential premises at the place of stay or place of residence

koap-u811b00152cda1f8380-1.text: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-u811b00152cda1f8380-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u446fced745a6f2ce66-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities
koap-u446fced745a6f2ce66-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u946eb3cbf47565930c-1.text: 1. Failure by a legal entity or a person conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities, to meet the prescribed deadline for submitting information on registration and deregistration of a citizen of the Russian Federation at the place of stay, by no more than one day —
koap-u946eb3cbf47565930c-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ueb958ec60ec9b0a257-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-ueb958ec60ec9b0a257-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-38.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-38.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-udd5d6612508685ed16-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of forty thousand to sixty thousand roubles.
koap-udd5d6612508685ed16-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-udcf4eac2602a2a4496-1.text: 3. Exceeding the deadline specified in part 1 of this Article by more than one day —
koap-udcf4eac2602a2a4496-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u968d1eed822fcecc9d-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two hundred and fifty thousand to seven hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u968d1eed822fcecc9d-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u883c766709123bdbce-1.text: 4. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg —
koap-u883c766709123bdbce-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u700884103a64d80620-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty-five thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-u700884103a64d80620-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-5.text: 5. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 4 of this Article —
koap-uf4a22a0916578d39eb-5.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u22a08eb8a8ab2f6374-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles.
koap-u22a08eb8a8ab2f6374-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-uc0674568993003e2e5-1.text: 6. Exceeding the deadline specified in part 1 of this Article by more than one day in the case of commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 4 of this Article —
koap-uc0674568993003e2e5-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u12e3678efe06348e33-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of three hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u12e3678efe06348e33-1.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-24.text: Note. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-ua9114ac4b54f4a2f89-24.locator: Article 19.15.3. Violation of the rules for registration of citizens of the Russian Federation at the place of stay when providing services of accommodation facilities classified under the legislation of the Russian Federation on tourism activities

koap-u03e71d0139ff627de5-1.text: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements
koap-u03e71d0139ff627de5-1.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u1f735c3b726ec26326-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements
koap-u1f735c3b726ec26326-1.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-udd0ef748d6243f8378-1.text: 1. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements as regards performing measurements falling within the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements without using certified measurement procedures (methods), or without complying with the requirements of certified measurement procedures (methods); failure to comply with the established procedure for notification of one's activities involving the manufacture of measurement standards of units of quantities, reference materials and (or) measuring instruments intended for use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements, or their import into the territory of the Russian Federation and sale; failure to comply with the procedure for testing reference materials or measuring instruments for type approval or the procedure for verification of measuring instruments; use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements of reference materials of an unapproved type or measuring instruments of an unapproved type and (or) not verified in accordance with the established procedure; failure to comply with mandatory metrological and technical requirements for measuring instruments and mandatory requirements for their operating conditions; failure to comply with the procedure for approval, maintenance, comparison and use of state primary measurement standards of units of quantities, the procedure for transferring units of quantities from state measurement standards, the procedure for establishing mandatory requirements for measurement standards of units of quantities used to ensure uniformity of measurements in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements, the procedure for assessing conformity with those requirements and the procedure for their use; or use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements of units of quantities not permitted for use in the Russian Federation —
koap-udd0ef748d6243f8378-1.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u59416291a77f14ff1a-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u59416291a77f14ff1a-3.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u58a9f3db3b3d478ff3-1.text: 2. Establishment by officials exercising state metrological supervision of requirements inconsistent with legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements as regards testing reference materials or measuring instruments for type approval, verification of measuring instruments, or certification of measurement procedures (methods) —
koap-u58a9f3db3b3d478ff3-1.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-ueb958ec60ec9b0a257-2.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-ueb958ec60ec9b0a257-2.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u21ae10a121fde66d8b-1.text: 3. Violation by officials performing functions of providing state services and managing state property in the sphere of ensuring uniformity of measurements of the deadlines for adopting a decision to classify technical devices as measuring instruments or to approve the type of reference materials and (or) the type of measuring instruments, or violation by officials performing accreditation functions in the sphere of ensuring uniformity of measurements of the deadlines for adopting a decision to accredit a legal entity or individual entrepreneur to perform work and (or) provide services in the sphere of ensuring uniformity of measurements —
koap-u21ae10a121fde66d8b-1.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-3.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

koap-u725841dc2b6e8bcb86-1.text: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)
koap-u725841dc2b6e8bcb86-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-u3f4cfcd3863e73b4e0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)
koap-u3f4cfcd3863e73b4e0-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-u9d382b89dda134b4f5-1.text: 1. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence), where such a permit (licence) is mandatory —
koap-u9d382b89dda134b4f5-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ufda5118530c6fc0243-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, one hundred and seventy thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ufda5118530c6fc0243-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ue4624c518540d2c780-1.text: 2. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit in violation of the requirements and conditions provided for by a special permit (licence), where such a permit (licence) is mandatory —
koap-ue4624c518540d2c780-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-u8d570ce56680d955ac-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of three hundred to five hundred roubles; on officials, fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to one hundred and fifty thousand roubles.
koap-u8d570ce56680d955ac-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ucdc6cd87535b2013f8-1.text: 3. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit in gross violation of the requirements and conditions provided for by a special permit (licence), where a special permit (licence) is mandatory —
koap-ucdc6cd87535b2013f8-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ue68f42d3674a959bf9-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; on legal entities, one hundred and fifty thousand to two hundred and fifty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ue68f42d3674a959bf9-1.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ud9edec47f4676a3476-2.text: Note. The concept of a gross violation shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation in respect of the particular licensed type of activity.
koap-ud9edec47f4676a3476-2.locator: Article 19.20. Conduct of activities not aimed at deriving profit without a special permit (licence)

koap-ud14f39ad471701912f-1.text: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it
koap-ud14f39ad471701912f-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-u8ab48068d341ccfbd0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it
koap-u8ab48068d341ccfbd0-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-u061df685b67cc7ad3d-1.text: 1. Failure by an owner, lessee or other user to comply with the established procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it —
koap-u061df685b67cc7ad3d-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-5.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-5.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-u37118f8de61db18f6c-1.text: 2. Violation by a lessor or tenant of residential premises of the requirements for submitting within the prescribed period to the body carrying out state registration of rights to immovable property and transactions involving it an application for state registration of a restriction (encumbrance) on ownership of residential premises arising from a residential tenancy agreement concluded for a term of at least one year or from a tenancy agreement for residential premises in the housing stock for social use —
koap-u37118f8de61db18f6c-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-ud9a8aa14d52f6c1c05-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of five thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud9a8aa14d52f6c1c05-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-u160a98136f3bec3388-1.text: 3. Violation by state authorities, local self-government bodies or other persons of the requirements for submitting within the prescribed period to the body carrying out state registration of rights to immovable property and transactions involving it an application for state registration of a restriction (encumbrance) on ownership of all premises in a rental building or of a residential house that is a rental building —
koap-u160a98136f3bec3388-1.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-ueb858d611eeecbdc5d-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one hundred thousand roubles; on officials, fifty thousand roubles; on persons conducting entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ueb858d611eeecbdc5d-2.locator: Article 19.21. Failure to comply with the procedure for state registration of rights to immovable property or transactions involving it

koap-ub506d34cc3f02ad872-1.text: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations
koap-ub506d34cc3f02ad872-1.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-u24fa30c086175e5dd4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations
koap-u24fa30c086175e5dd4-1.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-uf39e60f46a5101316c-1.text: 1. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles (except vessels under construction, seagoing vessels, mixed-navigation (river-sea) vessels and inland navigation vessels, including small craft), mechanisms and installations, where registration is mandatory —
koap-uf39e60f46a5101316c-1.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-u22bf94383773c3d8c4-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, two thousand to three thousand five hundred roubles; on legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-u22bf94383773c3d8c4-1.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-uf9227465968240e386-1.text: 2. Violation of the rules for state registration of vessels under construction, seagoing vessels, mixed-navigation (river-sea) vessels and inland navigation vessels, including small craft, and rights to them, or failure by the owner or charterer of the relevant vessel to fulfil within the period established by the legislation of the Russian Federation the obligation to register the vessel in one of the ship registers of the Russian Federation, where such a period is established, or the obligation to inform the body that carried out state registration of the vessel of changes to information to be entered in the ship register of the Russian Federation —
koap-uf9227465968240e386-1.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-6.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; on officials, three thousand to four thousand roubles; on legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-uc0bdf09cbd73bf06a1-6.locator: Article 19.22. Violation of the rules for state registration of all types of vehicles, mechanisms and installations

koap-u1e1dcfecf3ff5fb040-1.text: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal
koap-u1e1dcfecf3ff5fb040-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u64d6f46bd60a32bcd1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal
koap-u64d6f46bd60a32bcd1-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u412ae65aee57b0d1aa-1.text: 1. Forgery of a document certifying identity, confirming a person's right or release from an obligation, as well as forgery of a stamp, seal or form, or their use, transfer or disposal, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 4 of this Article —
koap-u412ae65aee57b0d1aa-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u1b8758509721a3291b-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of forty thousand to eighty thousand roubles with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-u1b8758509721a3291b-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-39.text: 2. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-39.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-ud932b026abd3ec89d1-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-ud932b026abd3ec89d1-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u154af61b713aba7a9c-1.text: 3. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, carried out for the purpose of organising illegal migration, including for the purpose of violation by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the established rules for entry into the Russian Federation, the rules of migration registration or movement of a foreign citizen or stateless person within the territory of the Russian Federation, the procedure for their choosing a place of stay or residence within the Russian Federation or for transit by a foreign citizen or stateless person through the territory of the Russian Federation, or for the purpose of their unlawful employment activities in the Russian Federation —
koap-u154af61b713aba7a9c-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u9b867d05857157b254-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of five million to ten million roubles with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-u9b867d05857157b254-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-9.text: 4. Repeated commission of the administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article —
koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-9.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-ub71794ed60a0955787-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on legal entities of ten million to sixty million roubles with confiscation of the instruments used to commit the administrative offence.
koap-ub71794ed60a0955787-1.locator: Article 19.23. Forgery of documents, stamps, seals or forms, or their use, transfer or disposal

koap-u97dd7082a35bf3d5cf-1.text: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
koap-u97dd7082a35bf3d5cf-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-ue588f18d39bda51964-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision
koap-ue588f18d39bda51964-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-uabea7be02120dacbf7-1.text: 1. Failure by a person placed under administrative supervision to comply with an administrative restriction or restrictions imposed on them by a court under federal law, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uabea7be02120dacbf7-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-uc4cee339694cf7b612-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-uc4cee339694cf7b612-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-ud645a67e24c3a15bf1-1.text: 2. Failure by a person placed under administrative supervision to fulfil duties provided for by federal law, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ud645a67e24c3a15bf1-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-u445522dc2bf6232cf6-2.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u445522dc2bf6232cf6-2.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-ud73a975b0ed95a0a1c-1.text: 3. Repeated commission within one year of the administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article, if these actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ud73a975b0ed95a0a1c-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-u8589ebff969387f7f6-1.text: entails compulsory work for up to forty hours or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles on persons to whom compulsory work or administrative arrest may not be applied under this Code.
koap-u8589ebff969387f7f6-1.locator: Article 19.24. Failure to comply with administrative restrictions and to fulfil duties imposed under administrative supervision

koap-u96aaf6ae4050de5098-1.text: Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations
koap-u96aaf6ae4050de5098-1.locator: Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations

koap-ue88ee13017ce0548d6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations
koap-ue88ee13017ce0548d6-1.locator: Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations

koap-u7ebf76e49615228a62-1.text: Failure to fulfil military transport obligations established by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u7ebf76e49615228a62-1.locator: Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations

koap-u9330d58bce3476ae8f-1.text: entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles; on officials, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred and fifty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u9330d58bce3476ae8f-1.locator: Article 19.25. Failure to fulfil military transport obligations

koap-ube0dfcfddf9df7b601-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.26. Knowingly false expert opinion

koap-ueb10588ab8c8a85ece-1.text: 1. Giving a knowingly false opinion by an expert in the course of state control (supervision) and municipal control —

koap-uad3a4880eff8f02ea8-6.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of one thousand to three thousand roubles.

koap-u88e8eedf492397c349-1.text: 2. Provision by an accreditation expert or technical expert of knowingly false and (or) inaccurate information contained in an expert opinion, an on-site examination report or an examination report —

koap-ud506c2339748aa74c3-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.

koap-u0b24b481bfd8a2d666-1.text: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
koap-u0b24b481bfd8a2d666-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-ua30d27580eb9c04069-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration
koap-ua30d27580eb9c04069-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-ub58211110f3692f267-1.text: 1. Provision by a foreign citizen or stateless person of knowingly false information or forged documents in the course of migration registration, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ub58211110f3692f267-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-5.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of two thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u156f21994fbf2bb491-5.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-u1d3a1fcff19acc76e7-1.text: 2. Provision by the receiving party of knowingly false information about a foreign citizen or stateless person or forged documents in the course of migration registration, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 19.23 of this Code, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u1d3a1fcff19acc76e7-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-ud4e7d110212b2bfdba-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty-five thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred and fifty thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud4e7d110212b2bfdba-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-ue7acf1f52f98dd7ef0-1.text: 3. The violation provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed in the federal city of Moscow or St Petersburg, or in Moscow Oblast or Leningrad Oblast —
koap-ue7acf1f52f98dd7ef0-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-ua8d62bf6f9c85adfad-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine of five thousand to seven thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-ua8d62bf6f9c85adfad-1.locator: Article 19.27. Provision of false information in the course of migration registration

koap-u7f6127ea1b9f914e92-1.text: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
koap-u7f6127ea1b9f914e92-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ub7f3326b4dcd79058a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity
koap-ub7f3326b4dcd79058a-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ufb537c93b019771b01-1.text: 1. Unlawful transfer, offer or promise, on behalf of or in the interests of a legal entity or in the interests of a legal entity associated with it, of money, securities or other property to an official, a person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, a foreign official or an official of a public international organisation, the provision to them of services of a property nature or the granting to them of property rights (including where, at the direction of the official, person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, foreign official or official of a public international organisation, money, securities or other property are transferred, offered or promised, services of a property nature are provided or property rights are granted to another individual or legal entity) in return for the performance by that official, person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation, foreign official or official of a public international organisation, in the interests of that legal entity or a legal entity associated with it, of an action (inaction) connected with their official position —
koap-ufb537c93b019771b01-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u540a0e933ed391b0dc-1.text: entails the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to three times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than one million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
koap-u540a0e933ed391b0dc-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u6e40f26b95352c144c-1.text: 2. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed on a large scale —
koap-u6e40f26b95352c144c-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u695a9e137cd02f17b1-1.text: entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to thirty times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than twenty million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
koap-u695a9e137cd02f17b1-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u6ea39493af5af64f06-1.text: 3. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed on an especially large scale —
koap-u6ea39493af5af64f06-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ua4a9ccb276f5e2f844-1.text: entail the imposition on legal entities of an administrative fine of up to one hundred times the amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of the legal entity, but not less than one hundred million roubles, with confiscation of the money, securities or other property or the value of the services of a property nature or other property rights.
koap-ua4a9ccb276f5e2f844-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-51.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ua22e28c27af0aca06d-1.text: 1. In this Article, an official means the persons specified in notes 1 - 3 to Article 285 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-ua22e28c27af0aca06d-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-uc75ac95d02ab9fbfaa-1.text: 2. In this Article, a person performing managerial functions in a commercial or other organisation means a person specified in note 1 to Article 201 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-uc75ac95d02ab9fbfaa-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ueafae2d81fce31a4a6-1.text: 3. In this Article, a foreign official means any appointed or elected person holding any office in a legislative, executive, administrative or judicial body of a foreign state and any person performing any public function for a foreign state, including for a public agency or public enterprise; an official of a public international organisation means an international civil servant or any person authorised by such an organisation to act on its behalf.
koap-ueafae2d81fce31a4a6-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-ua6d2f34113f11dad4f-1.text: 4. In this Article, a large scale means an amount of money or value of securities, other property, services of a property nature or other property rights exceeding one million roubles; an especially large scale means an amount or value exceeding twenty million roubles.
koap-ua6d2f34113f11dad4f-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u26e6dc783624abd078-1.text: 5. A legal entity shall be exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article if it assisted in the detection of that offence, the conduct of an administrative investigation and (or) the detection, solving and investigation of a crime connected with that offence, or if extortion took place against that legal entity.
koap-u26e6dc783624abd078-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-uab4eb90840a5485ff0-1.text: 6. The provision set out in note 5 to this Article shall not apply to administrative offences committed in relation to foreign officials and officials of public international organisations in the conduct of commercial transactions.
koap-uab4eb90840a5485ff0-1.locator: Article 19.28. Unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity

koap-u4216fe1e2493f7e8ae-1.text: Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services
koap-u4216fe1e2493f7e8ae-1.locator: Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services

koap-u85d8f67b793be2bf62-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services
koap-u85d8f67b793be2bf62-1.locator: Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services

koap-u558800c99806cf27c8-1.text: Engagement by an employer or customer of work (services), for employment activities under an employment contract or for the performance of work or provision of services under a civil-law contract, of a state or municipal servant holding a position included in a list established by normative legal acts, or a former state or municipal servant who held such a position, in violation of the requirements provided for by Federal Law of 25 December 2008 No. 273-ФЗ "On Combating Corruption" —
koap-u558800c99806cf27c8-1.locator: Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services

koap-ufbf80dcfcad09acaf6-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of two thousand to four thousand roubles; on officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ufbf80dcfcad09acaf6-1.locator: Article 19.29. Unlawful engagement of a state or municipal servant or a former state or municipal servant in employment activities or the performance of work or provision of services

koap-u19fc71930e922abea7-1.text: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
koap-u19fc71930e922abea7-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-uc68721621d36303613-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process
koap-uc68721621d36303613-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-u2e927956406a83b254-1.text: 1. Violation of the requirements for conducting educational activities established by education legislation, manifested in the conduct of educational activities by representative offices of educational organisations or violation of the rules for providing paid educational services —
koap-u2e927956406a83b254-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-4.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u117890e916f1bfeadd-4.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-u80af01aac9e6899214-1.text: 2. Failure to implement educational programmes in full in accordance with the curriculum, or unlawful refusal to issue documents on education and (or) qualifications —
koap-u80af01aac9e6899214-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-uf253a0ec21782ed33d-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf253a0ec21782ed33d-2.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-ua427b19aa157566425-1.text: 3. Issuance by an organisation conducting educational activities, in respect of educational programmes without state accreditation, of documents on education or documents on education and qualifications in the form established under education legislation —
koap-ua427b19aa157566425-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-ue77dfd014550ad8937-1.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; on legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ue77dfd014550ad8937-1.locator: Article 19.30. Violation of requirements for conducting educational activities and organising the educational process

koap-uffc067462a9dbaa6c4-1.text: 4. Intentional distortion of the results of state final assessment and school pupil olympiads provided for by education legislation, as well as violation of the procedure for conducting state final assessment established by education legislation —

koap-u19c3647471f7ce4073-1.text: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent
koap-u19c3647471f7ce4073-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u0aad8615148b86125f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent
koap-u0aad8615148b86125f-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u07f6e63ad9f695f209-1.text: 1. Conduct of activities as a foreign agent by a person not included in the register of foreign agents, if this action (inaction) does not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u07f6e63ad9f695f209-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-2.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-2.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-ufc334449faccc30bf6-1.text: 2. Failure by a foreign agent to provide, or late provision to the authorised body (official), of data (information) whose provision is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on foreign agents, or provision of such data (information) to the authorised body (official) in incomplete or distorted form, if these actions (inaction) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ufc334449faccc30bf6-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-3.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-3.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-ue0dc7704d6f2888471-1.text: 3. Failure by a foreign agent to fulfil the obligation to disclose that status in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on foreign agents —
koap-ue0dc7704d6f2888471-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-4.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-4.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u471d0029e4b4ab0eb5-1.text: 4. Production of materials and (or) their dissemination by a foreign agent in connection with their conduct of a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", including through the mass media and (or) using the Internet information and telecommunications network, of materials sent by a foreign agent to public authorities, educational organisations or other bodies or organisations in connection with their conduct of a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", or of information concerning a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", disseminated including through the mass media and (or) using the Internet information and telecommunications network, without an indication that these materials (information) were produced, disseminated and (or) sent by a foreign agent or concern the activities of a foreign agent, or with an indication that does not conform to the approved form —
koap-u471d0029e4b4ab0eb5-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u0ab988f05f2a1d9358-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the object of the administrative offence.
koap-u0ab988f05f2a1d9358-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-ub9172652e4ddafb276-1.text: 5. Production of materials and (or) their dissemination by a founder, member, participant or head of a public association operating without forming a legal entity or of another association of persons, by the head of a legal entity included in the register of foreign agents, or by a member of a body of such a person, when they conduct a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", of materials sent by those persons to public authorities, educational organisations or other bodies or organisations in connection with their conduct of a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", or of information concerning a type of activity established by Article 4 of Federal Law of 14 July 2022 No. 255-ФЗ "On Control over the Activities of Persons under Foreign Influence", disseminated including through the mass media and (or) using the Internet information and telecommunications network, without an indication that these materials (information) were produced, disseminated and (or) sent by a founder, member, participant or head of a public association operating without forming a legal entity or of another association of persons, by the head of a legal entity included in the register of foreign agents, or by a member of a body of such a person, or with an indication that does not conform to the approved form —
koap-ub9172652e4ddafb276-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-uca890b0ae28223c064-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uca890b0ae28223c064-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-ue9367965cb6e1713c7-1.text: 6. Violation by a foreign agent of the procedure and deadlines for posting a report on their activities on the Internet information and telecommunications network or providing it to the mass media for publication —
koap-ue9367965cb6e1713c7-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-5.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-5.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u5f6b7d04101a01e90b-1.text: 7. Failure or late fulfilment by a foreign agent of the obligation to establish a Russian legal entity and (or) violation of the procedure for notifying the authorised body thereof in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation —
koap-u5f6b7d04101a01e90b-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-ub54d8a87a9281008dc-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub54d8a87a9281008dc-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u678f86cd94d5c7d6d2-1.text: 8. Failure to comply with restrictions connected with foreign-agent status provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on foreign agents —
koap-u678f86cd94d5c7d6d2-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-6.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on officials, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u6b1420da47b71548a0-6.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-uc56380450eb1d20482-1.text: 9. The violations provided for by parts 1 - 8 of this Article, committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-uc56380450eb1d20482-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u3e17b858f0b8cddca1-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u3e17b858f0b8cddca1-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-52.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u2b5ad5441cf80670ba-1.text: 1. For the administrative offences provided for by this Article, foreign structures without legal personality, public associations operating without forming a legal entity and other associations of persons shall bear administrative liability as legal entities.
koap-u2b5ad5441cf80670ba-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u93dbee762ed30ea0e2-1.text: 2. Persons performing organisational and executive or administrative and economic functions in foreign structures without legal personality, public associations operating without forming a legal entity or other associations of persons who commit the administrative offences provided for by this Article shall bear administrative liability as officials.
koap-u93dbee762ed30ea0e2-1.locator: Article 19.34. Violation of the procedure governing the activities of a foreign agent

koap-u92b052ae38eee70b2f-1.locator: Article 19.34.2. Participation in activities in the territory of the Russian Federation of a foreign or international non-profit non-governmental organisation whose structural subdivisions are not recorded in the register of branches and representative offices of international organisations and foreign non-profit non-governmental organisations, or which has no structural subdivision in the form of a local division registered under the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on non-profit organisations

koap-uc63cbe514fbd65cb35-1.text: 2. The actions provided for by part 1 of this Article, committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person, if these actions do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —

koap-ue54ad5489042b2939a-1.text: entail the imposition of an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles, with or without administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-ue54ad5489042b2939a-1.locator: Article 19.34.2. Participation in activities in the territory of the Russian Federation of a foreign or international non-profit non-governmental organisation whose structural subdivisions are not recorded in the register of branches and representative offices of international organisations and foreign non-profit non-governmental organisations, or which has no structural subdivision in the form of a local division registered under the procedure provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on non-profit organisations

koap-u5af2854897947c6a00-1.text: Chapter 20. Administrative offences against public order and public safety
