koap-u4b6d4600cfc02a0f77-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. CHAPTER 20. ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC ORDER AND PUBLIC SAFETY
koap-u4b6d4600cfc02a0f77-1.locator: Chapter 20. Administrative offences against public order and public safety

koap-u7b8e9030cea72c116b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism

koap-u3ba36ae65ff3e479da-1.text: 1. Petty hooliganism, that is, a breach of public order expressing manifest disrespect for society and accompanied by obscene language in public places, offensive harassment of citizens, or the destruction of or damage to another person’s property —

koap-u98f2163a661f7bd8a1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.

koap-u373956ab7f3fe976ce-1.text: 2. The same acts involving disobedience to a lawful demand of a representative of the authorities or another person performing duties to protect public order or putting a stop to a breach of public order —

koap-u2ffde823a6fd933816-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.

koap-u2679d7bb197a08a70f-1.text: 3. Dissemination in information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, of information expressing, in an indecent form that offends human dignity and public morals, manifest disrespect for society, the state, the official state symbols of the Russian Federation, the Constitution of the Russian Federation or bodies exercising state power in the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 20.3.1 of this Code, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-u62f26ddd2235d000a1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.

koap-u97c149e23d7c60eccd-10.text: 4. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article —

koap-u39a98b30c2806bf50d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.

koap-u6ceaa4162f03a00990-1.text: 5. Acts provided for by part 3 of this Article committed by a person who has previously been subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence more than twice —

koap-u7776c508e0f6f58eba-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.

koap-ub8d4d64df31b9013ed-1.text: Note. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation shall be notified within twenty-four hours of every instance of initiation of proceedings concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 - 5 of this Article.

koap-uaf9955b29cd2f1af40-1.text: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
koap-uaf9955b29cd2f1af40-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u4819c7e8788ce1a5c0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
koap-u4819c7e8788ce1a5c0-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-uc4fca3c593b071c0bc-1.text: 1. Violation by the organizer of a public event of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 - 4 and 9 of this Article —
koap-uc4fca3c593b071c0bc-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ub7650831d1daebe8d3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to forty hours; for officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub7650831d1daebe8d3-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u250bf4e9580d2f35d1-1.text: 1.1. Involving a minor in participation in an unauthorized assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket, if this act does not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u250bf4e9580d2f35d1-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u60ea215b0888c86aa0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for twenty to one hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u60ea215b0888c86aa0-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u3cea1919a90fae4e20-1.text: 2. Organizing or conducting a public event without submitting notification of the public event in the established manner, except in the cases provided for by part 7 of this Article —
koap-u3cea1919a90fae4e20-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ub00e82f6d5046ab501-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to fifty hours, or administrative arrest for up to ten days; for officials, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seventy thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub00e82f6d5046ab501-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-udf485fa55bee06228d-1.text: 3. Acts (omissions) provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article that result in interference with the functioning of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure or communications, the movement of pedestrians and/or vehicles, or citizens’ access to residential premises or transport or social infrastructure facilities, or in exceeding the maximum permitted occupancy of an area (premises), if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-udf485fa55bee06228d-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u7b5f0d007b1754e6d2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to one hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u7b5f0d007b1754e6d2-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-udc447a1ee53aedec07-1.text: 4. Acts (omissions) provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-udc447a1ee53aedec07-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u5d5bd195dfb448bc8e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to two hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to twenty days; for officials, two hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u5d5bd195dfb448bc8e-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u4c9b798c38ef34d529-1.text: 5. Violation by a participant in a public event of the established procedure for conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket, except in the cases provided for by part 6 of this Article —
koap-u4c9b798c38ef34d529-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-uc00b53b01f423233eb-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to forty hours.
koap-uc00b53b01f423233eb-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ub29d662630a2f4dbdd-1.text: 6. Acts (omissions) provided for by part 5 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-ub29d662630a2f4dbdd-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u96f5126af4de9c8d85-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to two hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-u96f5126af4de9c8d85-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u90f8470deea9922b34-1.text: 6.1. Participation in an unauthorized assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket that results in interference with the functioning of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure or communications, the movement of pedestrians and/or vehicles, or citizens’ access to residential premises or transport or social infrastructure facilities —
koap-u90f8470deea9922b34-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ua82629f2c5d20042dc-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to one hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua82629f2c5d20042dc-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ub2655c75ca9ec5463c-1.text: 6.2. Use during a public event of the distinctive sign (attribute) of a media representative provided for by part 5 of Article 6 of Federal Law of 19 June 2004 No. 54-ФЗ ‘On Assemblies, Rallies, Demonstrations, Marches and Pickets’ by a person not entitled to use it —
koap-ub2655c75ca9ec5463c-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-4.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u1a2b39075b29202340-4.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-ua7cde58ac081358c1a-1.text: 7. Organizing or conducting an unauthorized assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket in the immediate vicinity of the territory of a nuclear installation, radiation source or storage facility for nuclear materials and radioactive substances, or actively participating in such public events, if this impedes the performance of official duties by employees of the installation, source or facility or creates a threat to the safety of the population and the environment —
koap-ua7cde58ac081358c1a-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u5f1f5fd2bd158df499-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, two hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u5f1f5fd2bd158df499-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-uc848889e73f94884d6-1.text: 8. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by parts 1 - 6.1 of this Article, if this act does not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-uc848889e73f94884d6-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u127603e36c35360388-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, or compulsory work for forty to two hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to thirty days; for officials, two hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
koap-u127603e36c35360388-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u0eead7f80248b05ed9-1.text: 9. Violation by the organizer of a public event of the established procedure for collecting, returning, transferring to federal budget revenue or spending funds for organizing and conducting the public event; failure to submit, or late submission to the authorized body of, a report on the use of money and/or other property collected for organizing and conducting the public event, or submission of an incomplete or distorted report —
koap-u0eead7f80248b05ed9-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-uaff9e7386560cefc27-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seventy thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uaff9e7386560cefc27-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u69a12bd849ce74d282-1.text: 10. Transferring (handing over) money and/or other property for organizing and conducting a public event by a person who, under federal law, is not entitled to transfer (hand over) money and/or other property for those purposes —

koap-u2075a941ad299d9dac-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u2075a941ad299d9dac-1.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

koap-u09aedfd225f33be02a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.2.2. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order
koap-u09aedfd225f33be02a-1.locator: Article 20.2.2. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order

koap-u7c21b9df7a413a388b-1.text: 1. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places that does not constitute a public event, publicly calling for the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places, or participating in the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places, where such mass presence and/or movement results in a breach of public order or sanitary standards and rules, disruption of the functioning and integrity of life-support or communications facilities, damage to green plantings, or interference with pedestrian or vehicle traffic or citizens’ access to residential premises or transport or social infrastructure facilities, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-ufe1bb3da4584a77916-1.locator: Article 20.2.2. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order

koap-uf57950331fee7779bc-1.text: 2. Acts provided for by part 1 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-ue9a27b6eb4c361d877-1.locator: Article 20.2.2. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order

koap-ue9a27b6eb4c361d877-2.locator: Article 20.2.2. Organizing the simultaneous mass presence and/or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order

koap-u6820883f949d52625e-1.locator: Article 20.3. Propaganda or public display of Nazi attributes or symbols, attributes or symbols of extremist organizations, or other attributes or symbols whose propaganda or public display is prohibited by federal laws

koap-u672a47a91540348e15-1.locator: Article 20.3.1. Incitement to hatred or enmity and humiliation of human dignity

koap-u18465ccbd35dd6cec2-1.text: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements
koap-u18465ccbd35dd6cec2-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u4870fa5afef538aab8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements
koap-u4870fa5afef538aab8-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u5518a1df166f6549e4-1.text: 1. Violation of fire safety requirements, except in the cases provided for by Articles 8.32 and 11.16 of this Code and parts 6, 6.1, 7, 10 and 11 of this Article —
koap-u5518a1df166f6549e4-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uaf86a8328c689c209d-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, forty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uaf86a8328c689c209d-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uefb596b25ea650c77c-1.text: 2. The same acts committed under a special fire prevention regime —
koap-uefb596b25ea650c77c-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-ua7cbd099b539130984-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ua7cbd099b539130984-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u1e1ab137c357fb793a-1.text: 2.1. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article at a protected facility classified as posing extremely high, high or significant risk, consisting in failure to ensure the operability or proper working condition of fire-fighting water supply sources, electrical installations or equipment, automatic or autonomous fire-extinguishing installations, fire alarm systems, technical means of warning people and managing their evacuation during a fire, or smoke protection systems, or in evacuation routes and emergency exits failing to meet fire safety requirements —
koap-u1e1ab137c357fb793a-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uc0f3b8c053c4987770-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twelve thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to sixty thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, sixty thousand to eighty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days.
koap-uc0f3b8c053c4987770-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u498c946b6594fb25fa-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-ub29a09017dfc1f54e6-1.text: 6. Violation of fire safety requirements that causes a fire and the destruction of or damage to another person’s property or minor or moderately serious harm to a person’s health —
koap-ub29a09017dfc1f54e6-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uf326dc4b3ab4ea2977-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials, eighty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, ninety thousand to one hundred ten thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days; for legal entities, seven hundred thousand to eight hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to thirty days.
koap-uf326dc4b3ab4ea2977-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uf74efee39d98d93b76-1.text: 6.1. Violation of fire safety requirements that causes a fire and grievous harm to a person’s health or the death of a person —
koap-uf74efee39d98d93b76-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-ud430194208c237be8e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for legal entities of one million to two million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-ud430194208c237be8e-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u7ccb96b57732ffa766-1.text: 7. Failure by a manufacturer (supplier) to fulfil the duty to include in the technical documentation for substances, materials, products and equipment information on their fire hazard indicators or on fire safety measures when handling them, where providing such information is mandatory —
koap-u7ccb96b57732ffa766-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u305314c0f0732352ad-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles; for legal entities, ninety thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u305314c0f0732352ad-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u112a4b7f498be615fe-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uf78cf004a9c686fef1-1.text: 9. Violation by an expert in fire risk assessment, when conducting an independent fire risk assessment (fire safety audit), of the procedure for assessing a protected facility’s compliance with fire safety requirements established by legislative and other legal acts of the Russian Federation, or signature by that expert of a knowingly false opinion on an independent fire risk assessment (fire safety audit) —
koap-uf78cf004a9c686fef1-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-ue81bba2045fd5838f6-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifteen thousand to twenty thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years.
koap-ue81bba2045fd5838f6-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u18b784ae808276d8be-1.text: 10. Violation of fire safety requirements when designing fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been put into operation, by a person certified in the manner established by the Government of the Russian Federation as entitled to design those systems —
koap-u18b784ae808276d8be-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u4e6ece14ae1042cab4-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine for officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-u4e6ece14ae1042cab4-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u789aa92ebf4da2f5dc-1.text: 11. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 10 of this Article —
koap-u789aa92ebf4da2f5dc-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-u06788871aca32a3400-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of ninety thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years.
koap-u06788871aca32a3400-1.locator: Article 20.4. Violation of fire safety requirements

koap-uf905969cd1e8fc0cf4-1.locator: Article 20.5.1. Violation of the martial law regime

Violation of provisions established in accordance with Federal Constitutional Law of 30 January 2002 No. 1-ФКЗ ‘On Martial Law’, federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation on martial law, if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-ua50c95b8f1dd0a1ed7-1.text: 1. A person who voluntarily surrenders weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition is exempt from administrative liability for the administrative offence provided for by this Article.
koap-ua50c95b8f1dd0a1ed7-1.locator: Article 20.10. Unlawful manufacture, acquisition, sale, transfer, storage, carriage, transportation, carrying or use of weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition

koap-u99c9fe6a0b1dc419c1-1.text: 2. Seizure of weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition when a person is detained, or when measures to secure proceedings in an administrative offence case are applied to discover and seize them, cannot be regarded as their voluntary surrender.
koap-u99c9fe6a0b1dc419c1-1.locator: Article 20.10. Unlawful manufacture, acquisition, sale, transfer, storage, carriage, transportation, carrying or use of weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition

koap-uf0a2e6406a040aaae8-1.text: 3. For the purposes of this Article, unlawful manufacture, acquisition, sale, transfer, storage, transportation, carriage, carrying or use of weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition means acts whose commission is not provided for or is prohibited by the legislation of the Russian Federation, and acts requiring a special permit (licence) where that permit (licence) has not been granted to the offender in the manner established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, or where the permit (licence) granted has ceased to be valid and the person has been notified of this by any means permitting confirmation of receipt of the notification.
koap-uf0a2e6406a040aaae8-1.locator: Article 20.10. Unlawful manufacture, acquisition, sale, transfer, storage, carriage, transportation, carrying or use of weapons, essential firearm components and ammunition
