koap-u9bd28efaee56153926-3.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records

koap-u0b86697a7f8f7509a4-1.text: 2. Failure by officials responsible for the storage and use of weapons to meet the deadlines for entering weapons in the records of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or its territorial body, or for renewing (re-registering) permits (open licences) to store and carry them —
koap-u0b86697a7f8f7509a4-1.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records

koap-u2abd022041bed42dc9-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u2abd022041bed42dc9-2.locator: Article 20.11. Failure to meet deadlines for registration (re-registration) of weapons or for entering them in the records

koap-u3d525d6b9ad85339e8-1.text: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
koap-u3d525d6b9ad85339e8-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u87dc9e8d8cf090f37a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition
koap-u87dc9e8d8cf090f37a-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u4f756dab01e6ef15c2-1.text: 1. Dispatch of weapons, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u4f756dab01e6ef15c2-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u798bb5c09ff9d30b33-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons.
koap-u798bb5c09ff9d30b33-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-ufc7a0aeddb4f5423c7-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for the carriage or transportation of weapons and ammunition, except in the cases provided for by part 4 of this Article —
koap-ufc7a0aeddb4f5423c7-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-10.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-10.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u41f94468c90b84d6bb-1.text: 3. Violation of rules for the use of weapons and ammunition —
koap-u41f94468c90b84d6bb-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u16a8287f963b01d36f-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to three thousand roubles or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one to two years.
koap-u16a8287f963b01d36f-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u6923fcd9a542d88826-1.text: 4. Violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons resulting in their loss, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u6923fcd9a542d88826-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-u41f6aa385c275c3c33-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one to three years with or without confiscation of the weapons; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or disqualification for six months to three years with or without confiscation of the weapons; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons, or administrative suspension of their activities for up to sixty days.
koap-u41f6aa385c275c3c33-1.locator: Article 20.12. Dispatch of weapons and violation of rules for the carriage, transportation or use of weapons and ammunition

koap-ueddda539fe251ece23-1.text: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
koap-ueddda539fe251ece23-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-ue8af1a5be703e66cef-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose
koap-ue8af1a5be703e66cef-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-u45fe639394f62cf28a-1.text: 1. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules —
koap-u45fe639394f62cf28a-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-u878788e2aed816883c-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
koap-u878788e2aed816883c-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-u7f1cb07216af354c48-1.text: 2. Discharging weapons in populated localities or other places not designated for that purpose —
koap-u7f1cb07216af354c48-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-u2a7df240cf1b46da5d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for one and a half to three years with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
koap-u2a7df240cf1b46da5d-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-uc598b58f0f3ab58902-1.text: 3. The act provided for by part 2 of this Article committed by a group of persons or by a person who is intoxicated —
koap-uc598b58f0f3ab58902-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-u2401a488be40173434-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition, or deprivation of the right to acquire and store, or to store and carry, weapons for three years with confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
koap-u2401a488be40173434-1.locator: Article 20.13. Discharging weapons in designated places in violation of established rules or in places not designated for that purpose

koap-ubf4841579aef937638-1.text: Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition
koap-ubf4841579aef937638-1.locator: Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition

koap-uf39e5d206f201fe90a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition
koap-uf39e5d206f201fe90a-1.locator: Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition

koap-ub0150ffc6f7b74cdcf-1.text: Violation of certification rules in the manufacture and circulation of weapons and ammunition —
koap-ub0150ffc6f7b74cdcf-1.locator: Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition

koap-ufc0ff70ece1cf476da-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons and ammunition; for officials, two thousand to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the weapons and ammunition.
koap-ufc0ff70ece1cf476da-1.locator: Article 20.14. Violation of rules for certification of weapons and ammunition

koap-u19ba63064b02603774-1.text: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers
koap-u19ba63064b02603774-1.locator: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers

koap-ue4b20c275349d2df4c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers
koap-ue4b20c275349d2df4c-1.locator: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers

koap-u67484efb981c453029-1.text: Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers —
koap-u67484efb981c453029-1.locator: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers

koap-u1119f6eb09bb726a95-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles with confiscation of the objects of the administrative offence; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of the objects of the administrative offence; for legal entities, forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles with confiscation of the objects of the administrative offence.
koap-u1119f6eb09bb726a95-1.locator: Article 20.15. Sale without the appropriate licence of mechanical sprayers, aerosol and other devices loaded with tear-inducing or irritant substances, electric shock devices or spark dischargers

koap-uc66bbc21294898664b-1.text: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
koap-uc66bbc21294898664b-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u58c59e327dbd156ee6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities
koap-u58c59e327dbd156ee6-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u89a2730232bbef1c8c-1.text: 1. Carrying on private security activities without a special permit (licence), or providing security services by a person who does not have the legal status of a private security guard —
koap-u89a2730232bbef1c8c-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-ub799230da8aebb0cb0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand five hundred to five thousand roubles; for officials, five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to sixty thousand roubles.
koap-ub799230da8aebb0cb0-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-8.text: 1.1. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u36fce87930f10afc0a-8.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u0b7b202e4781ce6793-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles or compulsory work for one hundred to two hundred hours; for officials, disqualification for six months to three years; for legal entities, sixty-five thousand to one hundred thirty thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u0b7b202e4781ce6793-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u8354cfe3d0cf9a4141-1.text: 2. Carrying on private detective (investigative) activities without a special permit (licence) —
koap-u8354cfe3d0cf9a4141-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u65978e5200421b64a8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles; for officials, four thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to forty thousand roubles.
koap-u65978e5200421b64a8-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u5bc9319f6a08c246e9-1.text: 3. Providing vocational training and additional professional education for personnel engaged in private detective or security activities without a special permit (licence) or in violation of statutory requirements —
koap-u5bc9319f6a08c246e9-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u795971106bf00b7485-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for the head of the institution of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u795971106bf00b7485-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-uc58f130c01d0c8ed18-1.text: 4. Providing private detective or security services not provided for by law, or providing such services in violation of statutory requirements —
koap-uc58f130c01d0c8ed18-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-udd2e941fd16d6753ff-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for private detectives (security guards) of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles; for heads of private security organizations, three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-udd2e941fd16d6753ff-1.locator: Article 20.16. Unlawful private detective or security activities

koap-u73a33e6cccc33ad67f-1.text: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
koap-u73a33e6cccc33ad67f-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-ud702c6d3f0a4a2cbed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility
koap-ud702c6d3f0a4a2cbed-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-u93e3b6e2bd805cffdf-1.text: 1. Unauthorized entry into a facility guarded in the established manner, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article —
koap-u93e3b6e2bd805cffdf-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-u2b57f0351d6dec0e6e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for up to forty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to five days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
koap-u2b57f0351d6dec0e6e-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-uf5215f1c63f64a3fb6-1.text: 2. Unauthorized entry into a facility guarded in the established manner belonging to the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the federal executive body authorized to perform tasks in civil defence and protection of the population and territories against natural and technological emergencies, the Foreign Intelligence Service of the Russian Federation, the bodies of the Federal Security Service, the system of the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, or institutions and bodies of the penal enforcement system of the Russian Federation, or into facilities under the jurisdiction of the federal executive body responsible for mobilization preparation and mobilization —
koap-uf5215f1c63f64a3fb6-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-u39a940e802e97f9608-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to ten thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for forty to sixty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to ten days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
koap-u39a940e802e97f9608-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-ue510963ac74d6bb14b-1.text: 3. Unauthorized entry into a facility of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation guarded in the established manner, a guarded facility protected by state protection bodies, an underground or underwater facility guarded in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on departmental security, a fuel and energy complex facility assigned a hazard category, or an important state facility or a structure on communications routes or networks, or access to special cargo, where that facility, structure or cargo is guarded by the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, if this act does not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-ue510963ac74d6bb14b-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-uae816c0bae7a5d9e11-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of seventy-five thousand to two hundred thousand roubles with or without confiscation of the instrument used to commit the administrative offence, or compulsory work for sixty to one hundred twenty hours with or without confiscation of that instrument, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with or without confiscation of that instrument.
koap-uae816c0bae7a5d9e11-1.locator: Article 20.17. Violation of the access control regime of a guarded facility

koap-u09df7652278e634547-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.18. Blocking transport routes

koap-u088ef85bfb56bc3c52-1.text: Organizing or actively participating in the blocking of transport routes, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 20.2 and Article 20.2.2 of this Code, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

koap-u7c3b03581314b064c0-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to one hundred hours; for officials, one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.

koap-ud8f6f06a6710fed43b-1.text: Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)
koap-ud8f6f06a6710fed43b-1.locator: Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)

koap-u64125c3b2b28c3c0a9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)
koap-u64125c3b2b28c3c0a9-1.locator: Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)

koap-u7ade8fc3315148b0f4-1.text: Violation of the special regime established by law in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO) —
koap-u7ade8fc3315148b0f4-1.locator: Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)

koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-9.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u5eb90f56d83837319d-9.locator: Article 20.19. Violation of the special regime in a closed administrative-territorial entity (ZATO)

koap-ub0c05c932e3663e439-1.text: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places
koap-ub0c05c932e3663e439-1.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-ud31fb30577341db01c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places
koap-ud31fb30577341db01c-1.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-uacf8d3338f5d202893-1.text: 1. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in places prohibited by federal law —
koap-uacf8d3338f5d202893-1.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-uae75a23604025382c6-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-uae75a23604025382c6-2.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-u7d80f75099ff8e1b68-1.text: 2. Consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in streets, stadiums, public gardens, parks, public transport vehicles or other public places, or failure to comply with a lawful demand of an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication by a citizen in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe that they consumed narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in a street, stadium, public garden, park, public transport vehicle or other public place —
koap-u7d80f75099ff8e1b68-1.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-u6f945f2cb9edf7d7eb-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-u6f945f2cb9edf7d7eb-2.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-u3d055a7d79bac7087c-1.text: 3. Acts specified in part 2 of this Article committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u3d055a7d79bac7087c-1.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-u6c1da9087f81749eec-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of four thousand to five thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u6c1da9087f81749eec-3.locator: Article 20.20. Consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products in prohibited places or consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances in public places

koap-u675e641cb3f1d62cd5-1.text: Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated
koap-u675e641cb3f1d62cd5-1.locator: Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated

koap-u898bd737762ffaf400-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated
koap-u898bd737762ffaf400-1.locator: Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated

koap-u152ad12cd736d699b5-1.text: Appearing in streets, stadiums, public gardens, parks, public transport vehicles or other public places in a state of intoxication that offends human dignity and public morals —
koap-u152ad12cd736d699b5-1.locator: Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated

koap-u263ec8ac15ff5849d8-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand five hundred roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-u263ec8ac15ff5849d8-1.locator: Article 20.21. Appearing in public places while intoxicated

koap-uf05aa2f25b3a841f6b-1.text: Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances
koap-uf05aa2f25b3a841f6b-1.locator: Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances

koap-uaf7da31f43f4bebc0d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances
koap-uaf7da31f43f4bebc0d-1.locator: Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances

koap-ud80afe382c63fc78b6-1.text: Intoxication of minors under sixteen years of age, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances —
koap-ud80afe382c63fc78b6-1.locator: Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances

koap-u7bc333272eb129c78e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for the minors’ parents or other legal representatives of one thousand five hundred to two thousand roubles.
koap-u7bc333272eb129c78e-1.locator: Article 20.22. Intoxication of minors, their consumption (drinking) of alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, or their consumption of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances or intoxicating substances

koap-u6f50d7cd78fb0d64a6-1.text: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information
koap-u6f50d7cd78fb0d64a6-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-uccbfa4ab7537e2772f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information
koap-uccbfa4ab7537e2772f-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-uba8038d58ffaf1af85-1.text: 1. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information while holding a special permit (licence) —
koap-uba8038d58ffaf1af85-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-uf986f1064f72520635-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of four thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uf986f1064f72520635-5.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-ucec6e7d259ea7c00e0-1.text: 2. Violation of rules for the development, import into the Russian Federation or export from the Russian Federation of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information, or of the procedure for their certification, registration and accounting —
koap-ucec6e7d259ea7c00e0-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-uac18bfa928949d9577-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of two thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles with confiscation of the special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information; for officials, three thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of the special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information.
koap-uac18bfa928949d9577-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-uc55ad50354e8724f93-1.text: Note. For the purposes of this Code, the concept of ‘special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information’ has the same meaning as in note 1 to Article 138.1 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-uc55ad50354e8724f93-1.locator: Article 20.23. Violation of rules for the manufacture, storage, sale and acquisition of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information

koap-u7532b467c546ca6473-1.text: Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities
koap-u7532b467c546ca6473-1.locator: Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities

koap-uf7c35fb0c92907054c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities
koap-uf7c35fb0c92907054c-1.locator: Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities

koap-ub0011cf2cc3d12b215-1.text: Use in private detective or security activities of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information and not included in the established lists —
koap-ub0011cf2cc3d12b215-1.locator: Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities

koap-ucfb4ed426bce6aaa93-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for private detectives (security guards) of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles with confiscation of the unlawfully used special technical means; for heads of private security organizations (unions, associations), one thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-ucfb4ed426bce6aaa93-1.locator: Article 20.24. Unlawful use of special technical means intended for covert acquisition of information in private detective or security activities

koap-u18b908eb5c2d06bff8-1.text: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty
koap-u18b908eb5c2d06bff8-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ue34663d1848ca023a3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty
koap-ue34663d1848ca023a3-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ue9a6ebc48a55a1fb9c-1.text: 1. Failure to pay an administrative fine within the period prescribed by this Code, except in the cases provided for by part 3.1 of this Article —
koap-ue9a6ebc48a55a1fb9c-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u90eb442e1add5c8cce-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine equal to twice the amount of the unpaid administrative fine, but not less than one thousand roubles, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, or compulsory work for up to fifty hours.
koap-u90eb442e1add5c8cce-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ueb505afbcdd8d67f74-1.text: 2. Leaving the place of serving administrative arrest without authorization or evading service of administrative arrest —
koap-ueb505afbcdd8d67f74-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u1a4f61315956e4f090-1.text: shall entail administrative arrest for up to fifteen days or compulsory work for up to fifty hours.
koap-u1a4f61315956e4f090-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ua781ced29a526382fc-1.text: 3. Evasion by a foreign citizen or stateless person of the execution of an administrative penalty of administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation —
koap-ua781ced29a526382fc-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u2566ca6475282d7954-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles and administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u2566ca6475282d7954-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ubbb59085cfcfc91587-1.text: 3.1. Failure to pay within the period prescribed by this Code an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 18.11.1 of this Code —
koap-ubbb59085cfcfc91587-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ud1ee58bff7673f9423-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine equal to twice the amount of the unpaid administrative fine with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-ud1ee58bff7673f9423-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u3bf082311ffeae8020-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ue956d520ba882f04d1-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
koap-ue956d520ba882f04d1-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ub5d4a04cd61f526ee9-1.text: 5. Violation of an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held —
koap-ub5d4a04cd61f526ee9-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u917b1fb166ade51c34-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days.
koap-u917b1fb166ade51c34-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u616af0ab3d773ae282-54.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u4aede9c150d8962dfc-1.text: 1. Foreign citizens and stateless persons are not held administratively liable for an administrative offence provided for by part 1 or 3.1 of this Article if they fail to pay on time an administrative fine imposed on them simultaneously with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u4aede9c150d8962dfc-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u8531bc2caea36013ac-1.text: 2. Administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation does not apply to foreign citizens and stateless persons held administratively liable for an administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article.
koap-u8531bc2caea36013ac-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-ub563b4f065922175a1-1.text: 3. Administrative arrest provided for by part 1 of this Article may not be applied to a person who failed to pay an administrative fine for an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code and recorded using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment.
koap-ub563b4f065922175a1-1.locator: Article 20.25. Evasion of the execution of an administrative penalty

koap-u0d6bbebd0adb0dc0e4-1.text: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute
koap-u0d6bbebd0adb0dc0e4-1.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-u98ebc5f7fbb174afa7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute
koap-u98ebc5f7fbb174afa7-1.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-uf2a0695e9dece75a90-1.text: 1. Unauthorized cessation of work or leaving the workplace as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute by a person responsible for ensuring that the relevant activity is safe for the population, where such acts (omissions) are prohibited by federal law —
koap-uf2a0695e9dece75a90-1.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-11.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to one thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-ub6e055fbd1f61f2ed3-11.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-u12fd9f4079e9e9b0fb-1.text: 2. Organizing the acts (omissions) provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u12fd9f4079e9e9b0fb-1.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-u34cdafd97b7e8281c8-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand five hundred to two thousand five hundred roubles.
koap-u34cdafd97b7e8281c8-2.locator: Article 20.26. Unauthorized cessation of work as a means of resolving a collective or individual labour dispute

koap-u372095c44a5bdaacd2-1.text: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation
koap-u372095c44a5bdaacd2-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-ua33a0b37dc8d3434eb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation
koap-ua33a0b37dc8d3434eb-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-u5a5e81f915a5f35ede-1.text: 1. Disobedience to a lawful demand of an official of a Federal Security Service body to comply with measures and temporary restrictions established in an area (facility) where the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation has been introduced —
koap-u5a5e81f915a5f35ede-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-uaa15e5078b0472aa94-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of up to five hundred roubles; for officials, one thousand to three thousand roubles; for legal entities, five thousand to ten thousand roubles.
koap-uaa15e5078b0472aa94-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-uf72cec9bb3d52e1219-1.text: 2. Unauthorized entry or attempted entry into an area (facility) where the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation has been introduced —
koap-uf72cec9bb3d52e1219-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-u523bccad57669f0ebe-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u523bccad57669f0ebe-2.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-u482e908fa2702fb740-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-udba0658db1feb35830-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, three thousand to five thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to thirty days; for legal entities, ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-udba0658db1feb35830-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-u5fa5e6d7ffabe3d6ba-1.text: 4. Violation by an editor-in-chief, a media editorial office, a television and/or radio broadcaster, or another organization producing or distributing mass media, of the conditions for coverage of a counter-terrorism operation established by media legislation —
koap-u5fa5e6d7ffabe3d6ba-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-ub3d20b10f8faf6db18-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five hundred to two thousand roubles; for officials, one thousand to five thousand roubles; for legal entities, thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ub3d20b10f8faf6db18-1.locator: Article 20.27. Violation of the legal regime of a counter-terrorism operation

koap-u0a6c31c99a48fc2f18-1.text: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended
koap-u0a6c31c99a48fc2f18-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-u0bb0ee6e1e843ef4bc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended
koap-u0bb0ee6e1e843ef4bc-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-ub7ebfa3096af24c876-1.text: 1. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association subject to a legally effective decision suspending its activities, or participating in such activities, except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article —
koap-ub7ebfa3096af24c876-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-u40205f128ee42249c3-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for organizers of one thousand to two thousand roubles; for participants, five hundred to one thousand roubles.
koap-u40205f128ee42249c3-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-u70467b16959058a1d7-1.text: 2. Organizing the activities of a non-profit organization included in the register of foreign agents whose activities have been ordered to be suspended, or participating in such activities —
koap-u70467b16959058a1d7-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-uaa0463ec90854e4775-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for organizers of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for participants, three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-uaa0463ec90854e4775-1.locator: Article 20.28. Organizing the activities of a public or religious association whose activities have been ordered to be suspended

koap-u9e4035f729edc7d6dc-1.text: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials
koap-u9e4035f729edc7d6dc-1.locator: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials

koap-u2afd35fc181ed9f9df-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials
koap-u2afd35fc181ed9f9df-1.locator: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials

koap-u1fe6b6448f6aa1b7ba-1.text: Mass dissemination of extremist materials included in the published federal list of extremist materials or other extremist materials specified in point 3 of Article 1 of Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 114-ФЗ ‘On Combating Extremist Activities’, or their production or storage for mass dissemination, except in the cases provided for by parts 4.1 and 6 of Article 13.15 and Articles 13.37, 20.3 and 20.3.2 of this Code, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u1fe6b6448f6aa1b7ba-1.locator: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials

koap-u80866b0af51482b5df-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one thousand to three thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them; for officials, two thousand to five thousand roubles with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to one million roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days, with confiscation of those materials and the equipment used to produce them.
koap-u80866b0af51482b5df-1.locator: Article 20.29. Production and dissemination of extremist materials

koap-u470ff381f9c2fe54f4-1.text: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities
koap-u470ff381f9c2fe54f4-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-ueb596ffd58520eab57-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities
koap-ueb596ffd58520eab57-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-uf439e987b09620647b-1.text: 1. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities classified as low-hazard facilities, or obstruction of compliance with those requirements by legal entities, officials, including heads of a fuel and energy complex entity, or citizens, if these acts (omissions) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-uf439e987b09620647b-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-u121a56537aa4b181a7-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u121a56537aa4b181a7-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-uf845f747935b8ffc39-1.text: 2. Commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article in respect of fuel and energy complex facilities classified as medium-hazard facilities, if these acts (omissions) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-uf845f747935b8ffc39-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-uf7c7fd7244a44fe0f2-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to ten thousand roubles; for officials, fifty thousand to seventy thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles.
koap-uf7c7fd7244a44fe0f2-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-u4d072a1386dc1d93ab-1.text: 3. Commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article in respect of fuel and energy complex facilities classified as high-hazard facilities, if these acts (omissions) do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u4d072a1386dc1d93ab-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-uc0084136881bc11d0e-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for officials, seventy thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or disqualification for one to three years; for legal entities, one hundred fifty thousand to four hundred fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uc0084136881bc11d0e-1.locator: Article 20.30. Violation of requirements for the safety and counter-terrorism protection of fuel and energy complex facilities

koap-ua684c9b0236c69ce69-1.text: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions
koap-ua684c9b0236c69ce69-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u23329cae9d850e4f77-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions
koap-u23329cae9d850e4f77-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u7942308fe156d50ef4-1.text: 1. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of this Article —
koap-u7942308fe156d50ef4-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u2efe903589e0c0a15d-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of three thousand to ten thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to one hundred sixty hours, with or without an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held for six months to three years.
koap-u2efe903589e0c0a15d-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-40.text: 2. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 1 of this Article —
koap-u5c4bd0982acfd98b2e-40.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u171dd87b2b3f573d95-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, with or without an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held for six months to seven years.
koap-u171dd87b2b3f573d95-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u1d4d6df3bf6a699677-1.text: 3. Gross violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u1d4d6df3bf6a699677-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u6b499dd963c85d6aca-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days, with an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held for one to seven years.
koap-u6b499dd963c85d6aca-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u63b93f4efca042ed8c-1.text: 4. Acts provided for by part 2 of this Article committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u63b93f4efca042ed8c-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u32bc8ff0298900c5ef-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to fifteen thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u32bc8ff0298900c5ef-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u3f94a7a6f1cbdaa82e-1.text: 5. Acts provided for by part 3 of this Article committed by a foreign citizen or stateless person —
koap-u3f94a7a6f1cbdaa82e-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u90a9bb1f599329f3a9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u90a9bb1f599329f3a9-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-ub45298f3a4c14a0247-1.text: Note. In this Article, gross violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions means:
koap-ub45298f3a4c14a0247-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-ue636895051490b5eae-1.text: 1) acts creating a threat to one’s own safety, life or health, or to the safety, life or health of other persons at the venue of an official sporting competition or in the adjacent area;
koap-ue636895051490b5eae-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u4ea11064639fab1ac8-1.text: 2) violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions resulting in suspension or termination of an official sporting competition.
koap-u4ea11064639fab1ac8-1.locator: Article 20.31. Violation of spectator conduct rules at official sporting competitions

koap-u28460dd868f0b8be12-1.text: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions
koap-u28460dd868f0b8be12-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-ue3b231ea1677c1dd14-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions
koap-ue3b231ea1677c1dd14-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-ubc33397996567a38b1-1.text: 1. Violation by the organizer of an official sporting competition or the owners or users of sports facilities of safety rules for official sporting competitions, or use of a sports facility not listed in the All-Russian Register of Sports Facilities to hold physical culture and sporting events included in the Unified Calendar Plan of Interregional, All-Russian and International Physical Culture and Sporting Events or in the physical culture and sporting event calendars of constituent entities of the Russian Federation —
koap-ubc33397996567a38b1-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-u1ad3252b00ed75af03-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u1ad3252b00ed75af03-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-u7e6a3e53ef32c4799d-1.text: 2. Acts provided for by part 1 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
koap-u7e6a3e53ef32c4799d-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-u6a22f99cb1c2ba9663-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles; for persons carrying on entrepreneurial activities without forming a legal entity, one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days; for legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles or administrative suspension of activities for up to ninety days.
koap-u6a22f99cb1c2ba9663-1.locator: Article 20.32. Violation of safety rules for official sporting competitions

koap-u38b1dbc612b6e0ddf1-1.text: Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u38b1dbc612b6e0ddf1-1.locator: Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u4806de520a45cce400-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u4806de520a45cce400-1.locator: Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u0d8a9f14e4fb9562fb-1.text: Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, or violation of prohibitions established by Federal Law of 28 December 2012 No. 272-ФЗ ‘On Measures against Persons Involved in Violations of Fundamental Human Rights and Freedoms and the Rights and Freedoms of Citizens of the Russian Federation’, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u0d8a9f14e4fb9562fb-1.locator: Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u72a758f5c16c38d278-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles; for officials, twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for officials who are staff members of election commissions, disqualification for one year; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u72a758f5c16c38d278-1.locator: Article 20.33. Participation in the activities of a foreign or international organization whose activities have been declared undesirable in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u0794e351993f7bf8fd-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-uc44b0b781522688b37-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)
koap-uc44b0b781522688b37-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-uf4058c2f3483cc930d-1.text: 1. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas), or obstruction of a person in performing their assigned duty to fulfil or ensure compliance with counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas), except in the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article and Articles 11.15.1 and 20.30 of this Code, if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-uf4058c2f3483cc930d-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-ud3dc488f2d860f5f3b-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for six months to three years; for legal entities, one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
koap-ud3dc488f2d860f5f3b-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-u61bc8f40765cd34e6b-1.text: 2. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for religious organizations’ facilities (areas), or obstruction of a person in performing their assigned duty to fulfil or ensure compliance with counter-terrorism protection requirements for religious organizations’ facilities (areas), if these acts do not contain the elements of a criminally punishable act —
koap-u61bc8f40765cd34e6b-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-u67756f8a5e8931b6b9-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; for officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u67756f8a5e8931b6b9-1.locator: Article 20.35. Violation of counter-terrorism protection requirements for facilities (areas) and for religious organizations’ facilities (areas)

koap-u3c6378b8390b97097b-1.text: Article 20.36. Violation of territorial defence requirements
koap-u3c6378b8390b97097b-1.locator: Article 20.36. Violation of territorial defence requirements

koap-uae6ba389db59e8de03-1.locator: Article 20.36. Violation of territorial defence requirements

koap-uee13e88e77317141a0-1.text: Failure or improper performance by an official of an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body, or by the head of an organization, of duties assigned to them under federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation to organize and implement territorial defence measures —
koap-uee13e88e77317141a0-1.locator: Article 20.36. Violation of territorial defence requirements

koap-uea64900189bf7b58f6-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles.
koap-uea64900189bf7b58f6-5.locator: Article 20.36. Violation of territorial defence requirements

koap-uad668f7e4cc3e87e2f-1.text: Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit
koap-uad668f7e4cc3e87e2f-1.locator: Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit

koap-u2b8ac3fdfcfa30bce2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit
koap-u2b8ac3fdfcfa30bce2-1.locator: Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit

koap-uba67cffa9a0841b311-1.text: Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit of an organization subordinate to the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, or failure to comply with a lawful demand of such a departmental security employee or official of a paramilitary and watch unit of an organization subordinate to that federal executive body —
koap-uba67cffa9a0841b311-1.locator: Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit

koap-uc28621cd57b2b2a887-3.locator: Article 20.37. Obstruction of the lawful activities of a departmental security employee or an official of a paramilitary and watch unit

koap-u50e79ea27777584edb-1.text: Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration
koap-u50e79ea27777584edb-1.locator: Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration

koap-u74909da6450233ca6f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration
koap-u74909da6450233ca6f-1.locator: Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration

koap-u1fa08f3473679d7fe9-1.text: Failure to submit within the established period to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration —
koap-u1fa08f3473679d7fe9-1.locator: Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration

koap-u20ca2df583b384e9b5-1.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of forty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; for legal entities, three hundred fifty thousand to four hundred thousand roubles.
koap-u20ca2df583b384e9b5-1.locator: Article 21.1. Failure to submit to a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration lists of citizens subject to initial military registration

koap-u71d6eea3d0600ff00c-1.text: Article 21.2. Failure to notify citizens that they have been summoned by a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration
koap-u71d6eea3d0600ff00c-1.locator: Article 21.2. Failure to notify citizens that they have been summoned by a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration

koap-u6df5380236bd5bfbed-1.locator: Article 21.2. Failure to notify citizens that they have been summoned by a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration

koap-u882854ada7804bdd05-1.text: Failure to notify citizens of a call (summons) from a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration upon receipt of such calls (summonses), including in electronic form, or failure to enable citizens to appear on time in response to a call (summons) from a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration —
koap-u882854ada7804bdd05-1.locator: Article 21.2. Failure to notify citizens that they have been summoned by a military commissariat or another body responsible for military registration

koap-u6e6cbf49118af8f253-1.text: Failure or delay by officials of state bodies or organizations in providing information necessary for maintaining military registration records in the manner established by federal law —
koap-u6e6cbf49118af8f253-1.locator: Article 21.4. Failure to provide information necessary for maintaining military registration records

koap-u83144ab7275f41ca22-1.text: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
koap-u83144ab7275f41ca22-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-ud95a186f53071279b6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties
koap-ud95a186f53071279b6-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-u0ff6539d536842b36b-1.text: 1. Failure by a citizen, without a valid reason, to appear at the time and place specified in a military commissariat’s summons or in response to a call from another body responsible for military registration —
koap-u0ff6539d536842b36b-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles.
koap-uabd95467ca95fa9ba8-3.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-uc5b2a79bb8127f2fc4-1.text: 2. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of a change in marital status, education, place of work (study) or position —
koap-uc5b2a79bb8127f2fc4-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-u2abd022041bed42dc9-3.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u2abd022041bed42dc9-3.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-uef8329b930738d1762-1.text: 2.1. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of moving to a new place of stay not confirmed by registration, or failure to appear at a military commissariat within the period established by federal law when moving to a new place of stay not confirmed by registration —
koap-uef8329b930738d1762-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-5.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-5.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-u028628fda6bb933f60-1.text: 3. Failure by a citizen to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of departure from the Russian Federation for more than six months or entry into the Russian Federation, or failure to appear at a military commissariat within the period established by federal law when those events occur —
koap-u028628fda6bb933f60-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-u9299c59b1c23d541d3-2.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five thousand to fifteen thousand roubles.
koap-u9299c59b1c23d541d3-2.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-uf58b745e0d16bdc62f-1.text: 4. Failure by a citizen subject to conscription for military service to notify a military commissariat or a body responsible for primary military registration, in the manner established by federal law, of departure for more than three months from their place of residence or place of stay, including where those places are not confirmed by registration at the place of residence and/or place of stay —
koap-uf58b745e0d16bdc62f-1.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-6.text: shall entail an administrative fine of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles.
koap-ubcc9f425d525ad69e0-6.locator: Article 21.5. Failure by citizens to fulfil military registration duties

koap-ub01ed0adc41fc740c1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 21.6. Evasion of medical examination

koap-u7316262f8a3e678d20-1.text: Evasion by a citizen of a medical fitness assessment or medical examination upon referral by a commission for citizens’ military registration, or of a medical examination upon referral by a conscription commission —

koap-u3a83a68534f42052fc-1.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of fifteen thousand to twenty-five thousand roubles.

koap-u978677bc8475c32986-1.text: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents
koap-u978677bc8475c32986-1.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents

koap-uf74f379292759fbaec-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents
koap-uf74f379292759fbaec-1.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents

koap-uc012380ee6242dddd8-1.text: Intentional damage to or destruction of a certificate of a citizen subject to conscription for military service, a military identity document (a temporary certificate issued in its place), a certificate in lieu of a military identity document or a personal electronic card, or negligent safekeeping of a certificate of a citizen subject to conscription for military service, a military identity document (a temporary certificate issued in its place), a certificate in lieu of a military identity document or a personal electronic card resulting in their loss —
koap-uc012380ee6242dddd8-1.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents

koap-u21eb64394680759750-3.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of three thousand to five thousand roubles.
koap-u21eb64394680759750-3.locator: Article 21.7. Intentional damage to or loss of military registration documents
