koap-u23d8c27e4b1efc37f0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. SECTION III. JUDGES, BODIES AND OFFICIALS AUTHORIZED TO CONSIDER ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES
koap-u23d8c27e4b1efc37f0-1.locator: Section III. Judges, bodies and officials authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-uf8da466f580039eef6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. CHAPTER 22. GENERAL PROVISIONS

koap-u2e95523d2dfbecab20-1.text: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
koap-u2e95523d2dfbecab20-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u5b2148e6fe5b3f3342-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases
koap-u5b2148e6fe5b3f3342-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u5aae4a238d8bf71cff-1.text: 1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code are considered, within the competence established by Chapter 23 of this Code, by:
koap-u5aae4a238d8bf71cff-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u4f035714bdc333ce2d-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u4bcc3f5510a749bceb-1.text: 2) commissions for minors’ affairs and the protection of their rights;
koap-u4bcc3f5510a749bceb-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u4b3e5561ce9d562deb-1.text: 3) federal executive bodies, their structural divisions, territorial bodies and the structural divisions of territorial bodies, and other state bodies in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to them by federal laws or normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
koap-u4b3e5561ce9d562deb-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u8b43337d3c99f49a54-1.text: 3.1) the Bank of Russia in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to it by federal laws;
koap-u8b43337d3c99f49a54-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u24a07ce9ea00ba55f3-1.text: 4) bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system;
koap-u24a07ce9ea00ba55f3-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u1c17d0864bfe616c71-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u5ff4fa0bc8d00dc926-1.text: 6) executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state supervision or transferred powers of federal state supervision, and financial bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support, as specified in Chapter 23 of this Code;
koap-u5ff4fa0bc8d00dc926-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u5820da8fd6cc6f20f8-1.text: 7) state institutions subordinate to federal executive bodies authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection), federal state fire supervision, state port control or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas of federal significance; state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection) or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas of regional significance; and state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry (where the exercise of regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry is assigned to such state institutions).
koap-u5820da8fd6cc6f20f8-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-ub7b3d7922c2235d7ef-1.text: 2. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation are considered, within the powers established by those laws, by:
koap-ub7b3d7922c2235d7ef-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u08ab395f496dc878ba-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u4bcc3f5510a749bceb-2.text: 2) commissions for minors’ affairs and the protection of their rights;
koap-u4bcc3f5510a749bceb-2.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u226d77bf12bab591ca-1.text: 3) authorized bodies and institutions of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
koap-u226d77bf12bab591ca-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-u0de4ee15750b5c5401-1.text: 4) administrative commissions and other collegial bodies established in accordance with laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or normative legal acts of the public authorities of a federal territory;
koap-u0de4ee15750b5c5401-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-ue51725344d18cc6a01-1.text: 5) state institutions subordinate to the respective executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized under federal laws to exercise federal state forest supervision (forest protection) or state supervision over the use and protection of specially protected natural areas in specially protected natural areas of regional significance.
koap-ue51725344d18cc6a01-1.locator: Article 22.1. Judges and bodies authorized to consider administrative offence cases

koap-ue160e30589ba9de12f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.2. Powers of officials

koap-u2264a05e5bdafc4f19-1.text: 1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code are considered by the officials specified in Chapter 23 of this Code within their powers.

koap-u6883f8f7c1d8c49dfc-1.text: 2. The following may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 3 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code:

koap-udbe988e78e0d9dd519-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive bodies and their deputies;

koap-u9024ee73b18eab1d06-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive bodies and their deputies;

koap-u5d9a93ac54a95b8cbb-1.text: 3) heads of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their deputies;

koap-u890af3a29fdb5d1d63-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial bodies of federal executive bodies and their deputies;

koap-uf6ddf9a773e44cd03f-1.text: 5) other officials exercising supervisory or control functions under federal laws or normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation.

koap-u160da84ae7cd8f3a33-1.text: 3. Heads of arrest houses, correctional institutions, pretrial detention centres and temporary detention facilities may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code.

koap-u9bc28999d778878665-1.text: 5. The following may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the bodies specified in point 6 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code:

koap-u557f44863e089c71ff-1.text: 1) heads of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;

koap-u782b8995ad28b62830-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of those executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;

koap-u052f5ae85a1aee2950-1.text: 3) other officials specified in Chapter 23 of this Code who are state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and are authorized to exercise federal state supervision (control).

koap-u509e3027de0e256a75-1.text: 5.1. Heads of state institutions and their deputies may consider administrative offence cases on behalf of the institutions specified in point 7 of part 1 of Article 22.1 of this Code. Other officials who are state fire supervision inspectors may also consider administrative offence cases on behalf of state institutions that are subordinate to the federal executive body authorized to perform fire safety tasks and that are themselves authorized to exercise federal state fire supervision.

koap-ub68bdc0a53624f1f57-1.text: 6. Authorized officials of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation consider cases concerning administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on behalf of the bodies specified in point 3 of part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code.

koap-u0fe20e24e8b8b2b60b-1.text: 7. Officials authorized to consider administrative offence cases possess those powers in full, unless otherwise established by Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.

koap-ue267fd9c14600ff923-1.text: 8. An official who directly participated in a control (supervision) measure or inspection and initiated an administrative offence case on the basis of indications of an administrative offence event identified during that measure or inspection may not consider that administrative offence case, except in the cases provided for by Article 28.6 of this Code.

koap-u9ed289abbb82545797-1.text: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
koap-u9ed289abbb82545797-1.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed

koap-u6fec836027ae652dc3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed
koap-u6fec836027ae652dc3-1.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed

koap-u753b4797a13ce5d1ea-1.text: 1. If a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies, or an official post specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is abolished, judges consider the administrative offence cases within its jurisdiction until the corresponding amendments and additions are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u753b4797a13ce5d1ea-1.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed

koap-uf098ea04fc5052fda9-1.text: 2. If a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation is transformed, otherwise reorganized or placed under different authority, the body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies to which those functions have been transferred consider the administrative offence cases within its jurisdiction until the corresponding amendments and additions are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-uf098ea04fc5052fda9-1.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed

koap-u7c36e5df04923425a1-1.text: 3. If the name of a body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies, or an official post specified in Chapter 23 of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation changes, the officials of that body, institution, its structural divisions or territorial bodies continue exercising their powers to consider administrative offence cases until the corresponding amendments are made to this Code or the law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u7c36e5df04923425a1-1.locator: Article 22.3. Jurisdiction over administrative offence cases when bodies (official posts) authorized to consider them are abolished, reorganized or renamed

koap-u7733d57f9d37cf08d3-1.text: 1. koap-u4fbc7be0d867c4268a-1.text: 1) heads of territorial internal affairs directorates (departments) and equivalent internal affairs authorities, their deputies, deputy chiefs of police (for the protection of public order), heads of territorial police departments (divisions, posts) and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 5 of Article 5.26, part 2 of Article 6.8, part 2 of Article 6.9, part 4 of Article 6.13, part 2 of Article 6.16.1, parts 5 - 8 of Article 6.21, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.1, parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21.2, Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), Articles 8.22, 8.23, 10.4 and 10.5, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), Article 13.24, parts 2 and 5 of Article 14.4.1, parts 2.1 and 3 of Article 14.16, Articles 14.16.1 and 14.26, part 2 of Article 14.53, part 1.1 of Article 18.2 (within their powers), Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.2, 19.8.3 and 19.15 - 19.18, part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads), parts 1 and 2 of Article 19.24, Article 19.27, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, Articles 20.20 and 20.21, and parts 4 and 5 of Article 20.31 of this Code;

koap-u6653011c5a181670b0-1.text: 2) heads of line transport police departments (directorates), their deputies and deputy chiefs of police (for the protection of public order) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17, Articles 13.24 and 14.26, part 2 of Article 14.53, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 18.8, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;

koap-u436abe546d6dc25366-1.text: 3) heads of duty shifts in the duty units of line transport police departments (directorates), and heads of line police divisions (posts) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1 (with respect to citizens' failure to comply with transport security requirements), parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17, Article 13.24, part 2 of Article 14.53, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, part 1 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;

koap-uabe3b82ba195e8cb10-1.text: 4) heads of duty shifts in the duty units of line transport police departments (directorates), heads of line police divisions (posts), and other police officers entrusted with supervising compliance with the relevant rules — concerning administrative offences committed on railway transport and provided for by Article 6.24 (for violations committed on railway transport), parts 1 and 3 - 5.1 of Article 11.1, part 3 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, parts 1 and 2 of Article 11.17 (for violations committed on railway transport), and part 2 of Article 14.53 (for violations committed on railway transport) of this Code;

koap-u29cdffa957f90c57c5-1.text: 5) the head of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate, his or her deputy, the head of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate centre for automated recording of administrative offences in the field of road traffic, his or her deputy, the commander of a road patrol service regiment (battalion, company), and his or her deputy — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23, 11.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1, 2 and 3.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, parts 2 - 6 and part 7 (where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions) of Article 12.9, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.10, Articles 12.11 - 12.14, parts 1 - 4 and part 5 (where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment) of Article 12.15, parts 1 - 3, part 3.1 (where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), part 4 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 23.79 of this Code), part 5 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1 of Article 23.79 of this Code) and parts 6 - 8 of Article 12.16, Articles 12.17 - 12.21, 12.21.2, 12.22 and 12.23, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, part 1 of Article 12.27, Articles 12.28 - 12.31, 12.31.1 (except passenger taxis), 12.32, 12.33, 12.36.1 and 12.37, part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads), and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code;

koap-ube39c9c4d99d65c216-1.text: 6) officers of the State Road Traffic Safety Inspectorate holding a special rank — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 12.1, part 1 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, parts 1, 1.1 and 3.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 2, 3 and 6 of Article 12.9, part 2 of Article 12.10, Article 12.11, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.12, Articles 12.13 and 12.14, parts 1 - 3 of Article 12.15, parts 1 and 2, part 4 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 23.79 of this Code), part 5 (except cases where these powers have been transferred in accordance with part 1 of Article 23.79 of this Code) and parts 6 - 8 of Article 12.16, parts 1 - 1.2 of Article 12.17, Articles 12.18 - 12.20, part 1 of Article 12.21, Articles 12.22, 12.23 and 12.28, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.29, part 1 of Article 12.30, Articles 12.36.1 and 12.37, and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code;

koap-u5ac9c1956605324d7d-1.text: 7) senior state road traffic safety inspectors and state road traffic safety inspectors — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22 and 8.23, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.31, Articles 12.32 and 12.32.1, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code;

koap-u76411e76eefc647bd4-1.text: 8) senior state road supervision inspectors and state road supervision inspectors — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 12.33 of this Code;

koap-u711d8378636163c9cd-1.text: 9) senior local police commissioners and local police commissioners — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to administrative offences committed in public places), Articles 10.4, 10.5 and 12.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, Articles 12.22, 12.23 and 12.28, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.29, part 1 of Article 12.30, Articles 19.2, 19.15, 19.15.1 and 19.15.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 19.24, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code;

koap-u7c1f8cf9f65c80bbe0-1.text: 10) the head of the migration division of the central administration of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1.1 of Article 18.2, Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.8.3, 19.15 - 19.18 and 19.27, and parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 20.25 of this Code;

koap-ufef87e7f0f2e68948c-1.text: 11) heads of structural migration divisions of territorial authorities and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1.1 of Article 18.2, Articles 18.8 - 18.12 and 18.15 - 18.18, part 1 of Article 18.19, Articles 18.20, 19.8.3, 19.15 - 19.18 and 19.27, and parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 20.25 of this Code;

koap-ud0ef335c4cb3c0b49f-1.text: 12) heads of structural drug control divisions of territorial authorities and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 6.8, part 2 of Article 6.9, part 4 of Article 6.13, Articles 10.4 and 10.5, and parts 2 and 3 of Article 20.20 of this Code.

koap-u24b57ca8c8c5690bb9-1.text: 3. The officials specified in item 3 of part 2 of this Article shall be entitled to impose administrative penalties on citizens and officials in the form of a warning or an administrative fine of up to five thousand roubles.

koap-u1e740188499471e9d1-1.text: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
koap-u1e740188499471e9d1-1.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities

koap-uef5f7fb35e91a91a75-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities
koap-uef5f7fb35e91a91a75-1.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities

koap-ud9718fde023bd5e79a-1.text: 1. Authorities and institutions of the penal enforcement system and pretrial detention facilities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 19.3 and Article 19.12 (with respect to administrative offences involving items withdrawn from circulation) of this Code.
koap-ud9718fde023bd5e79a-1.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities

koap-uab3fbb5ad73c07983d-1.text: 2. Heads of arrest houses, correctional institutions, pretrial detention facilities and temporary detention facilities shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities and institutions specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-uab3fbb5ad73c07983d-1.locator: Article 23.4. Authorities and Institutions of the Penal Enforcement System, Pretrial Detention Facilities

koap-ua99d0b0a8d7d43ea28-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.5. Tax Authorities

koap-u020a7bcccd4268dd6a-1.text: 1. Tax authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 4 - 17 of Article 14.5, part 5 of Article 14.13, Article 15.1, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 15.48 (within their powers), and Article 19.7.6 of this Code.

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-2.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u71a16ca75362f56f7f-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies and his or her deputies;

koap-ue7a55157d0463125a0-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies and their deputies;

koap-uc7c9748228d5c5084d-1.text: 3) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of taxes and levies.

koap-u02ee9711ae368c5cc2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.6. Repealed
koap-u02ee9711ae368c5cc2-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.6. Repealed

koap-u146625d3640f4916f3-1.text: Article 23.6. Repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ.
koap-u146625d3640f4916f3-1.locator: Article 23.6. Repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ.

koap-u49142cba4124da7111-1.text: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
koap-u49142cba4124da7111-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u075f37b5a7b5c1e3c3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
koap-u075f37b5a7b5c1e3c3-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-uea36bf18fc1f2b2a71-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1, parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (except violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), Articles 7.32.6, 13.19.7, 15.1 and 15.14 - 15.15.16, part 20 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.7.2 of this Code (within its powers).
koap-uea36bf18fc1f2b2a71-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-uaae07e44b5bb1dfc56-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and his or her deputies;
koap-uaae07e44b5bb1dfc56-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u2c6b7cd88b79a8f811-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
koap-u2c6b7cd88b79a8f811-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u26a9b6b006c3d13985-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
koap-u26a9b6b006c3d13985-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u8469f74c1636dae5f0-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1, Article 13.19.7, parts 3 and 4 of Article 15.15, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 15.15.1, Article 15.15.5-1, parts 1 - 6 of Article 15.15.6, and Articles 15.15.7, 15.15.11, 15.15.14 and 15.15.15 of this Code.
koap-u8469f74c1636dae5f0-1.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-uf2e70e34c8f1b23c3b-1.text: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
koap-uf2e70e34c8f1b23c3b-1.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u9811ac640a130a23e1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
koap-u9811ac640a130a23e1-1.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u903255f438efd445a0-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (except violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret) of this Code, except the cases provided for by part 1.7 of Article 23.1 of this Code, and by Articles 7.32.6, 13.19.7, 15.1, 15.14 - 15.15.16, 15.37.1 and 15.41, part 20 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.7.2 of this Code (within their powers).
koap-u903255f438efd445a0-1.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-3.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-3.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u129e2b4fabaa843088-1.text: 1) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
koap-u129e2b4fabaa843088-1.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-ubb0e5f9ea4982d4015-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies.
koap-ubb0e5f9ea4982d4015-1.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere

koap-u77098b256673fd7b4f-1.text: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
koap-u77098b256673fd7b4f-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-ufe05d73bf998c8a518-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
koap-ufe05d73bf998c8a518-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-u4a2fecc9adcc5050ff-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority providing treasury support shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.37.1 and 15.49 of this Code (within its powers).
koap-u4a2fecc9adcc5050ff-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-u0d3f961a5b6584b360-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.37.1 and 15.49 of this Code on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u0d3f961a5b6584b360-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-u3459479827d986e63b-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority providing treasury support and his or her deputies;
koap-u3459479827d986e63b-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-u5d987e238cb4b9cc05-1.text: 2) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority providing treasury support;
koap-u5d987e238cb4b9cc05-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-uec41c3d910e91f897c-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority providing treasury support and their deputies.
koap-uec41c3d910e91f897c-1.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support

koap-u68dca0aea9fa7a2c68-1.text: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
koap-u68dca0aea9fa7a2c68-1.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support

koap-u5dbb21d3e7f4fa7be2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
koap-u5dbb21d3e7f4fa7be2-1.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support

koap-ucc2e3ae670993483c1-1.text: 1. Financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code (within their powers).
koap-ucc2e3ae670993483c1-1.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support

koap-ua52a0511c530d95cf1-1.text: 2. Heads of financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-ua52a0511c530d95cf1-1.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support

koap-u30201362ce71a5bb54-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.8. Customs Authorities

koap-ub2702b82abd47c1d46-1.text: 1. A customs authority shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.27 (with respect to international road carriage of goods), Article 11.29 (with respect to international road carriage of goods), parts 1, 4 - 6, 12 and 13 of Article 12.21.1 (with respect to international road transport), part 1 of Article 12.21.2 (with respect to international road carriage of dangerous goods without a special permit), Article 12.21.5 (with respect to international road transport), parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, parts 1 and 3 of Article 16.1, Articles 16.2 - 16.24 and 19.7.13, and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.27 or 11.29, part 1, 4, 5, 6, 12 or 13 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2, Article 12.21.5, or part 2 or 4 of Article 12.25 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code.

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-4.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u9965a7b0ab6e5d6f5d-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs and his or her deputies;

koap-u8465ae60bfb5ef3ecc-1.text: 1.1) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs and his or her deputies;

koap-ueac701ee5d3e335ee8-1.text: 2) heads of regional customs directorates and their deputies;

koap-u43417a9f169adb24eb-1.text: 3) heads of customs offices and their deputies;

koap-u15f2b40c2292772f3f-1.text: 4) heads of customs posts and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed by natural persons;

koap-ueaa8d50e8587b6206a-1.text: 5) other customs officials authorised to conduct customs control, exercise other types of state control, detect and suppress administrative offences and conduct proceedings in administrative offence cases — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.27, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, part 3 of Article 16.1, Articles 16.3, 16.5, 16.6, 16.8, 16.10 and 16.11, part 4 of Article 16.12, Articles 16.13 - 16.15, part 1 of Article 16.18 and part 3 of Article 16.19 of this Code committed by natural persons, in the case provided for by part 1 of Article 28.6 of this Code.

koap-u76af35460f04f436b2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.9. Export Control Authorities

koap-u1d32149b3867e09551-1.text: 1. Authorities authorised in the field of export control shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.20, part 4 of Article 19.4, part 2 of Article 19.5 (with respect to violations of export control legislation), and part 2 of Article 19.8 (with respect to violations of export control legislation) of this Code.

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-5.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u040f4d9ee9e44d9a2f-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and his or her deputies;

koap-ub86804b6e2e161b3ec-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and their deputies;

koap-u301699fe3c4c865d96-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and their deputies.

koap-uc12b644415bfa86cc4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.10. Border Authorities

koap-u8d1a15f0c55cfcac90-1.text: 1. Border authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning the destruction of or damage to special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation, as well as signs installed by wildlife users or authorised state authorities for the protection, control and regulation of the use of wildlife and its habitats, and buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities), part 1 of Article 7.11, Articles 8.16 - 8.20, 8.33 and 8.35, part 2 of Article 8.37, Articles 8.38, 11.7 (with respect to violations of navigation rules in the waters of the Northern Sea Route), 18.1 - 18.7 and 18.14, part 2 of Article 19.4, and Article 19.12 (with respect to administrative offences involving items withdrawn from circulation) of this Code.

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-6.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u67d4f6c5cdddfb59f5-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority in the field of security and his or her deputies;

koap-u270e23232ea1809361-1.text: 2) heads of units authorised in the sphere of border protection and in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources within the structural division of the federal executive authority in the field of security, and their deputies;

koap-udc54eae45a385d4be1-1.text: 3) heads of directorates and their deputies;

koap-ubd55a5d5631457d17f-1.text: 4) heads of services and detachments and their deputies;

koap-ufe0d0efdf2f4dc1f9a-1.text: 5) heads of state marine inspectorates, state specialised inspectorates, state zonal (district) inspectorates and specialised departments (divisions), and their deputies;

koap-u0599a6b94d5e0ccf90-1.text: 6) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;

koap-u255bb29d9985467346-1.text: 7) heads of departments, commandants of border commandant's offices, heads of border control units and their deputies;

koap-uea518c450ac01e05da-1.text: 8) heads of state local inspectorates and state inspection posts;

koap-u069e49280cb61e5e20-1.text: 9) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;

koap-u8a25218dabe22bdf52-1.text: 10) commanders of border ships (boats) and captains of border patrol vessels (boats);

koap-u6e9ff1d888a1a1af8f-1.text: 11) heads of border outposts, divisions, radio-technical posts and border posts, and their deputies;

koap-uc3b9abb14ad8007329-1.text: 12) state local inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;

koap-ue04a7729a8d7bbf521-1.text: 13) heads of procedural activity units, their deputies, senior inquiry officers, inquiry officers, senior specialists and specialists in administrative proceedings.

koap-uaf25c0861c51ad0d81-1.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.17 - 8.20 and part 2 of Article 19.4 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 9, 12 and 13 of part 2 of this Article.

koap-u179e0101e22dd530b3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.11. Military Commissariats

koap-u9ff78b89b3e8ab5487-1.text: 1. Military commissariats shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 19.25, 19.38, 20.36 and 21.1 - 21.7 of this Code.

koap-u5ebdd48449316765d0-1.text: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-uadf82a1fe0b5e292da-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
koap-uadf82a1fe0b5e292da-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-ue1a1f889891600ded4-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision of compliance with labour legislation and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1, 3, 4 and 6 of Article 5.27, parts 1 - 4 of Article 5.27.1, Articles 5.27.2 and 5.28 - 5.34, part 1 of Article 14.54, part 2 of Article 15.33.2, and Article 15.34 of this Code.
koap-ue1a1f889891600ded4-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-2.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-2.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-ua91e244eb34ba1c619-1.text: 1) the Chief State Labour Inspector of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
koap-ua91e244eb34ba1c619-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-ue205a83ab4e64213eb-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision of compliance with labour legislation and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions — chief state labour inspectors — and their deputies;
koap-ue205a83ab4e64213eb-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-uf80da3ca5edebe63a4-1.text: 3) chief state labour inspectors in constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-uf80da3ca5edebe63a4-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-u4def35861d2d8dc68d-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of the respective state labour inspectorates — chief state labour inspectors — and their deputies;
koap-u4def35861d2d8dc68d-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-u1a096b25de864bfe70-1.text: 5) chief state labour inspectors of the respective state labour inspectorates;
koap-u1a096b25de864bfe70-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-ua08ed8de4a2fa12e98-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-u4c8f8a99302de64033-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-ub56fa69905d0acc74c-1.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions

koap-u8880714faecd0f2cf5-1.text: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
koap-u8880714faecd0f2cf5-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u0fe80872126318e15b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
koap-u0fe80872126318e15b-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u2f5dc1816fe6699bb8-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state sanitary and epidemiological supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.3, Articles 6.4 - 6.7, 6.24, 6.25 and 6.35, part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to signs of sanitary (mining-sanitary) zones and districts, health-improvement localities and resorts), Article 8.5 (with respect to information on the condition of atmospheric air, sources of drinking and household water supply, and the radiation situation), parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 8.42, parts 8 and 9 of Article 9.22, Article 10.8.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and parts 40 and 41 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-u2f5dc1816fe6699bb8-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-7.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-7.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u5f916860b531af7e2c-1.text: 1) the Chief State Sanitary Physician of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
koap-u5f916860b531af7e2c-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u879cdfe16145d8a73b-1.text: 2) chief state sanitary physicians for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-u879cdfe16145d8a73b-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u2b34c5e60e2d218fbe-1.text: 3) chief state sanitary physicians for cities, districts and transport and their deputies;
koap-u2b34c5e60e2d218fbe-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u0fcfa1e76e8ab4ae81-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-uc2e1ce8c79e0280b32-1.text: 6) chief state sanitary physicians of federal executive authorities in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, in the fields of internal affairs, defence, penal enforcement, mobilisation preparation and mobilisation, security, state protection, and the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of employees of organisations in certain industrial sectors with particularly hazardous working conditions and of the population of certain territories, and their deputies, and the chief state sanitary physician for facilities of the Administrative Directorate of the President of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in subordinate organisations and organisations served, as well as at subordinate facilities and facilities served and in territories served;
koap-uc2e1ce8c79e0280b32-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u3ad38280dc2cd2d0c5-1.text: 7) chief state sanitary physicians of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, in the fields of internal affairs, defence, penal enforcement, security, state protection, and the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of employees of organisations in certain industrial sectors with particularly hazardous working conditions and of the population of certain territories, and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in subordinate organisations and organisations served, as well as at subordinate facilities and facilities served and in territories served.
koap-u3ad38280dc2cd2d0c5-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u731d627cc54ae2e444-1.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 3 of part 2 of this Article.
koap-u731d627cc54ae2e444-1.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision

koap-u6de7910d7034e8cf2d-1.text: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
koap-u6de7910d7034e8cf2d-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-u41c41d63bd7336f70c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
koap-u41c41d63bd7336f70c-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-u1e84ad3cf1d96c0422-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.3.1 of this Code.
koap-u1e84ad3cf1d96c0422-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-8.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-8.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-ufa93ef20e2dad6310f-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and his or her deputies;
koap-ufa93ef20e2dad6310f-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-u448bf4f2f3edbf45b1-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and their deputies;
koap-u448bf4f2f3edbf45b1-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-ubd27c87a4b8d344dee-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and their deputies.
koap-ubd27c87a4b8d344dee-1.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment

koap-udc9d4902483b3ee0bb-1.text: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
koap-udc9d4902483b3ee0bb-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-u2674d8b4fffc9e91d9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
koap-u2674d8b4fffc9e91d9-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-ub031e2790f8dcf7efa-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state veterinary supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 8.52 (within their powers), Article 8.53 (within their powers), Articles 10.6 - 10.8.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and parts 8 and 8.1 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-ub031e2790f8dcf7efa-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-u319214ef696d2a5f81-1.text: 1) the Chief State Veterinary Inspector of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
koap-u319214ef696d2a5f81-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-ucc073d9d2828e8dc57-1.text: 2) chief state veterinary inspectors of the Russian Federation for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-ucc073d9d2828e8dc57-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-u6fba8b7f6591f203f2-1.text: 3) - 4) repealed as of 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 448-FZ;
koap-u6fba8b7f6591f203f2-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-u31f0a5aad7900d1179-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-ude95402b3003e3c5de-1.text: 6) chief state veterinary inspectors of federal executive authorities in the field of defence, in the spheres of internal affairs, activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, circulation of weapons, private security activities, extra-departmental security, enforcement of criminal penalties, state protection, and in the field of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, and of their territorial authorities, and their deputies.
koap-ude95402b3003e3c5de-1.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision

koap-u139f50ec1236ac1797-1.text: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
koap-u139f50ec1236ac1797-1.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-u19aded49538488fab6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
koap-u19aded49538488fab6-1.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-uaa4da20ddf9141a903-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 4 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code (with respect to the circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use).
koap-uaa4da20ddf9141a903-1.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-9.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-9.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-uec106ba91e3c6bde3c-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and his or her deputies;
koap-uec106ba91e3c6bde3c-1.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-ua20a57c9a3860fabca-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and their deputies.
koap-ua20a57c9a3860fabca-1.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use

koap-u11d5c5c69b8f398d5d-1.text: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
koap-u11d5c5c69b8f398d5d-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-ub2f7d3096cb2d84201-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
koap-ub2f7d3096cb2d84201-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u8840ca559c287cd9fb-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 7.18, Article 8.3 (with respect to administrative offences involving violations of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals during their storage and application), Article 8.6 (with respect to administrative offences committed in relation to agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), parts 1 and 2 of Article 8.7 (with respect to administrative offences committed in relation to agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), parts 2 and 2.1 of Article 8.8, Articles 10.1 - 10.3, Article 10.9, Article 10.10 (except navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 10.12 - 10.14, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code.
koap-u8840ca559c287cd9fb-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-10.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-10.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u0a114e00500a24eab7-1.text: 1) deputy heads of the federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land';
koap-u0a114e00500a24eab7-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u2fcabbb1efd2043298-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority who are authorised to exercise federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies;
koap-u2fcabbb1efd2043298-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u76ed77d98b09b0ed12-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies;
koap-u76ed77d98b09b0ed12-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-uc7bbac66b3355056b9-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of those territorial authorities who are authorised to exercise federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies.
koap-uc7bbac66b3355056b9-1.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)

koap-u1e50b1f6dbf07b5b36-1.text: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision
koap-u1e50b1f6dbf07b5b36-1.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision

koap-u73300baa6d9ab56c8f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision
koap-u73300baa6d9ab56c8f-1.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision

koap-ue424cd204140e42ce9-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state land supervision (except the authority exercising state land supervision over agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land') shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.1 and 7.34, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 8.8, Article 10.9, and Article 10.10 (except navigational hydraulic structures and agricultural land) of this Code.
koap-ue424cd204140e42ce9-1.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-11.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-11.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision

koap-u66776008c42b29218d-1.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Land Use and Protection and his or her deputies;
koap-u66776008c42b29218d-1.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision

koap-ue45afa6ca1935d45d1-1.text: 2) chief state inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for land use and protection and their deputies;

koap-ud8c4eec7297e29fb58-1.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-u2f39690c441ded8a39-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to forest inventory and forest management signs, within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.9 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.10 (with respect to unauthorised assignment of the right to use a forest plot or unauthorised exchange of a forest plot, within their powers under forest legislation), parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.5.2, Articles 8.24 - 8.27 (within their powers under forest legislation), parts 1 and 3 of Article 8.28 (within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 8.29 - 8.32 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.32.1, Article 8.32.3, Article 8.35 (within their powers under forest legislation with respect to rare and endangered plants), Article 8.45.1 (within their powers under forest legislation), and Article 19.7.14 of this Code.
koap-u2f39690c441ded8a39-1.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-12.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u7fbb034cb8e3963115-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and his or her deputies;

koap-ubde7d01d0c926e3c16-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;
koap-ubde7d01d0c926e3c16-1.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-u3536dc5fdbef809c56-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;
koap-u3536dc5fdbef809c56-1.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-ua6e6e9962c685a5598-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies.
koap-ua6e6e9962c685a5598-1.locator: Article 23.24. Authorities Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-u20137a4ba8cb6629f7-1.locator: Article 23.24.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Federal State Forest Supervision (Forest Protection)

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-13.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u54996a49b694c6e257-1.text: 1) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) and their deputies;

koap-u7822361d0914a39915-1.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas

koap-ud788890d6b31605e38-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state supervision in the field of protection and use of specially protected natural areas shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to signs installed by wildlife users, the authorised federal executive authority for the protection, control and regulation of the use of wildlife and its habitats, or the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources, and to buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities; destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to wells of the state reference observation network, monitoring cross-sections on water bodies, including underground water bodies, special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of water bodies, including coastal strips of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation, and signs informing citizens of restrictions on water use on public water bodies; destruction of or damage, within specially protected natural areas or their protection zones, to signs of specially protected natural areas, forest inventory signs or forest management signs), Article 7.4 (with respect to failure to ensure preservation of specially protected natural areas and environmental objects when using subsoil), Article 7.6 (with respect to water bodies located in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 7.7 - 7.10 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), part 1 of Article 7.11 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.5 - 8.9 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.12 - 8.14 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), part 1 of Article 8.16 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.17 and 8.18 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.21 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Articles 8.25 - 8.36 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), parts 1, 1.1, 2 and 3 of Article 8.37 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.38 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.39, Article 8.45.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas or their protection zones), Article 8.48 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas of federal significance), and parts 11 - 15, 20 and 21 of Article 14.51 (with respect to administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas) of this Code.
koap-ud788890d6b31605e38-1.locator: Article 23.25. Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Protection and Use of Specially Protected Natural Areas
