koap-ud219939a183452cd6e-1.locator: Article 23.41. Repealed. — Federal Law of 28.12.2009 No. 380-FZ.

koap-ub2bb0e4b50579c9315-1.text: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
koap-ub2bb0e4b50579c9315-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-u058245d7e08b946474-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
koap-u058245d7e08b946474-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-uc6329273776c71688a-1.text: 1. Authorities authorised in the field of aviation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.2, 8.2.1, 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 (with respect to violation of environmental requirements in air transport), Article 8.3 (with respect to violation of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals in air transport), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of civil aviation facilities and passenger transport services in civil aviation), parts 1 and 3 - 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, Article 11.5.1, part 1 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, Article 11.16, part 4 of Article 11.17 (with respect to violation of the rules for using radio communications equipment on board an aircraft), part 6 of Article 11.17, Articles 11.30 and 11.31, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, part 1 of Article 19.7.9, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to state registration of civil aircraft) of this Code.
koap-uc6329273776c71688a-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-17.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-17.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-u92ca174294080f2434-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport who are authorised to exercise control and supervision in the sphere of transport (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences committed in civil aviation and provided for by Articles 8.2, 8.2.1, 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 (with respect to violation of environmental requirements in air transport), Article 8.3 (with respect to violation of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals in air transport), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of civil aviation facilities and passenger transport services in civil aviation), parts 1 and 3 - 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, Article 11.5.1, part 1 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, Article 11.16, parts 4 and 6 of Article 11.17, Articles 11.30 and 11.31, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, part 1 of Article 19.7.9, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to state registration of civil aircraft) of this Code;
koap-u92ca174294080f2434-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-u82f07394eadd037b3c-1.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, their deputies, heads of inspection services of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, their deputies, and aviation flight safety inspectors — concerning administrative offences committed in state aviation and provided for by parts 1, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, part 1 of Article 11.14, and Articles 11.16 and 11.30 of this Code;
koap-u82f07394eadd037b3c-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-u2471e605ab898f8372-1.text: 3) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the sphere of the defence industry complex, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the sphere of the defence industry complex and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in experimental aviation and provided for by parts 1, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, part 1 of Article 11.14, and Articles 11.16 and 11.30 of this Code.
koap-u2471e605ab898f8372-1.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation

koap-ucfd0b040eaac1b213c-1.text: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
koap-ucfd0b040eaac1b213c-1.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use

koap-ucdd14415b141f338c9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
koap-ucdd14415b141f338c9-1.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use

koap-u57e36dcf69a1e25057-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.4, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 18.1 (with respect to violation of the airspace of the Russian Federation), and Article 19.7.5 of this Code.
koap-u57e36dcf69a1e25057-1.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use

koap-ua5a02ce90e207d6056-1.text: 2. The head of the authorised federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the authorised federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-ua5a02ce90e207d6056-1.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use

koap-u6f729808dfdffd6353-1.text: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
koap-u6f729808dfdffd6353-1.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u50dbe11c1e4ad710bc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
koap-u50dbe11c1e4ad710bc-1.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u68d222bb3fa43b4a65-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of communications facilities and services), Articles 13.2, 13.3, 13.4 and 13.6 - 13.9, part 1 of Article 13.18, Articles 13.27.1, 13.29 and 13.29.4, part 1 of Article 13.31, Articles 13.32 and 13.33.1, part 1 of Article 13.35, part 1 of Article 13.36, part 1 of Article 13.37, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 13.40, Article 13.40.1, part 2 of Article 13.43.1, part 1 of Article 13.50, Articles 13.55 and 13.56, parts 15 - 17 of Article 14.3, parts 2, 3 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 15.48 (within their powers), parts 1, 1.1, 2 - 4, 6 and 7 of Article 19.7.10, and Articles 19.7.10-1 and 19.7.10-2 of this Code.
koap-u68d222bb3fa43b4a65-1.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-18.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-18.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u0d63e0ad25b15bcb26-1.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Supervision in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications and his or her deputies;
koap-u0d63e0ad25b15bcb26-1.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u1c4101152355889f2c-1.text: 2) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for supervision in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications.
koap-u1c4101152355889f2c-1.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications

koap-u3013c3eec8e5edf540-1.text: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
koap-u3013c3eec8e5edf540-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-uf78b68b13f2a857701-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
koap-uf78b68b13f2a857701-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u675afa635aebf5e12d-1.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising control over the protection of state secrets shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3, 4 and 7 of Article 13.12 and part 2 of Article 13.13 of this Code.
koap-u675afa635aebf5e12d-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-19.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-19.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u913a13a7db9a81a1fc-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority;
koap-u913a13a7db9a81a1fc-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-ua5eac295270f2db383-1.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, his or her deputies, the head of the central military command authority responsible in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation for coordinating the main areas of activity for protecting restricted-access information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions for the protection of state secrets of large formations, formations and military units of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions for the protection of state secrets of organisations forming part of the services and branches of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and of troops not forming part of the services and branches of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, and their deputies;
koap-ua5eac295270f2db383-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u4dcdc0174d7f5300da-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u15f669a88e9898e613-1.text: 4) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of foreign intelligence and his or her deputies;
koap-u15f669a88e9898e613-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-u86e9365b3380423001-1.text: 5) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority;
koap-u86e9365b3380423001-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-ufc345270e9bca6f5ee-1.text: 6) heads of units of federal executive authorities authorised in the fields of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, defence of the Russian Federation, foreign intelligence, countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information that license types of activity involving the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, and their deputies.
koap-ufc345270e9bca6f5ee-1.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets

koap-ua399ec965b7cbe2317-1.text: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
koap-ua399ec965b7cbe2317-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u56d771456082ae39fb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
koap-u56d771456082ae39fb-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u3ef3f8346263092054-1.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising state control in the field of information circulation and protection shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5, Article 13.6, part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, part 1 of Article 13.13, and Articles 13.17, 13.22, 20.23 and 20.24 of this Code.
koap-u3ef3f8346263092054-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-20.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-20.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-ub22579296b3991174f-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-ud4c7f96be954ed76ae-1.text: 1.1) the head of the federal executive authority in the field of state protection, his or her deputies, heads of units of that federal executive authority and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5 of this Code;
koap-ud4c7f96be954ed76ae-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u8b7b7fbe01ec199443-1.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, and part 1 of Article 13.13 of this Code;
koap-u8b7b7fbe01ec199443-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u79d8c7c691a462933e-1.text: 3) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of security of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5, Article 13.6, part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, part 1 of Article 13.13, and Articles 13.17, 20.23 and 20.24 of this Code;
koap-u79d8c7c691a462933e-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u10be64861d20f117f5-1.text: 4) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.17 and 13.22 of this Code;
koap-u10be64861d20f117f5-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-u217bc82ae288aa1dfd-1.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection

koap-uca66882ae24f0d04ee-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.47. Repealed

koap-u4792f3598610375ef0-1.text: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
koap-u4792f3598610375ef0-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-ua9f806ea1ccdd272a0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
koap-ua9f806ea1ccdd272a0-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-uc19243cca43642a0be-1.text: 1. The federal antimonopoly authority and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.30.5 and 9.15, part 6, part 12 (except collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) meters for energy resources used in apartment buildings and residential houses) and part 13 (except collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) electricity meters in apartment buildings and residential houses) of Article 9.16, Article 9.21, parts 1 - 14 and 18 of Article 14.3, parts 4 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, part 1 of Article 14.9, Article 14.9.1, parts 6 and 10 of Article 14.24, Article 14.31, part 1 of Article 14.31.2, Articles 14.32 and 14.33, parts 1 and 3 - 5 of Article 14.38, Articles 14.40 - 14.42, parts 2 and 4 - 12 of Article 14.69, Article 19.4.3, parts 2.1 - 2.8 of Article 19.5, Article 19.8 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 19.8.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed by officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of state regulation of prices (tariffs) or officials of local self-government authorities regulating prices (tariffs), and Article 19.31 of this Code.
koap-uc19243cca43642a0be-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-21.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-21.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-u6268fb66023b5d9c74-1.text: 1) the head of the federal antimonopoly authority and his or her deputies;
koap-u6268fb66023b5d9c74-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-uc8186b885d0ba3b450-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal antimonopoly authority and their deputies, except cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 14 and 18 of Article 14.3, part 1 of Article 14.9, Article 14.31, part 1 of Article 14.31.2, and Articles 14.32 and 14.33 of this Code;
koap-uc8186b885d0ba3b450-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-u9ecee56e99b285995f-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal antimonopoly authority and their deputies.
koap-u9ecee56e99b285995f-1.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities

koap-ub319ff0d0a48953cc0-1.text: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
koap-ub319ff0d0a48953cc0-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u1e1598296b65c89421-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
koap-u1e1598296b65c89421-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u46adfd2d453648ba63-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 9.16, Article 10.8 (with respect to violation of the rules for storage and sale of livestock products), Article 14.2, parts 1 and 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, Article 14.4, part 1 of Article 14.5, Articles 14.6 - 14.8 and 14.15, parts 2.1 - 3 of Article 14.16, Article 14.17.3, parts 2 - 4 and 6 - 8 of Article 14.34, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, parts 6 - 10 of Article 14.51, Article 14.53, parts 1 and 3 of Article 14.69, Article 14.70, and part 1 of Article 15.46 (with respect to the sale of jewellery and other articles of precious metals and/or precious stones under a retail sale contract) of this Code.
koap-u46adfd2d453648ba63-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-10.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-10.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u65378da41e79bb2263-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection and his or her deputies;
koap-u65378da41e79bb2263-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-uf23a0984ab122d0222-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u3b56d26fb6a3233a34-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection and their deputies;
koap-u3b56d26fb6a3233a34-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u95391f772036f1f265-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection in cities, districts and transport, and their deputies.
koap-u95391f772036f1f265-1.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection

koap-u7c6ff2464c733bc5c4-1.text: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
koap-u7c6ff2464c733bc5c4-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-u9059bf8034a3bdbe43-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
koap-u9059bf8034a3bdbe43-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-ue5f073f081643c72f2-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 14.6 (with respect to regulation of prices for ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products), parts 2.1 and 3 of Article 14.16, Articles 14.17.3 and 14.19, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 15.13, part 6 of Article 19.4, and part 22 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-ue5f073f081643c72f2-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-6.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-6.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-u6415480cac90e3a356-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and his or her deputies;
koap-u6415480cac90e3a356-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-u040967bcb16e219815-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and their deputies;
koap-u040967bcb16e219815-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-u2a9996db17e8537a77-1.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products with respect to the retail sale of alcoholic products, and their deputies.
koap-u2a9996db17e8537a77-1.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products

koap-ufc07c8a60fdbd2ed1b-1.text: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)
koap-ufc07c8a60fdbd2ed1b-1.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)

koap-ufaec5e0262dc74b689-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)
koap-ufaec5e0262dc74b689-1.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)

koap-u35859c84ec92f3793b-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of sale of non-alcoholic tonic beverages (including energy drinks) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.16.1 of this Code.
koap-u35859c84ec92f3793b-1.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)

koap-u6d19d275ff55e1b84a-1.text: 2. Heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of sale of non-alcoholic tonic beverages (including energy drinks) and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u6d19d275ff55e1b84a-1.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)

koap-u7a822de4424f4e6eaf-1.text: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)
koap-u7a822de4424f4e6eaf-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-ub7bb507d26888aecf3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)
koap-ub7bb507d26888aecf3-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-u1fe7cdd5fda8809c38-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.15, part 10 (with respect to administrative offences committed by organisations carrying out regulated types of activity) of Article 9.16, part 4 of Article 14.4.2, Article 14.6, part 5 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.1, and part 1 of Article 19.8.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed by natural monopoly entities and/or municipal solid waste management operators, regional municipal solid waste management operators and/or heat supply organisations) of this Code.
koap-u1fe7cdd5fda8809c38-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-7.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-7.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-uac3b64b53d55a14bdb-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) and his or her deputies;
koap-uac3b64b53d55a14bdb-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-ud8db62402cd901daf6-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) and their deputies;
koap-ud8db62402cd901daf6-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-u9ba8e9a190a1e6e470-1.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) and their deputies.
koap-u9ba8e9a190a1e6e470-1.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

koap-u0d8a8369aa1418ee27-1.text: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision
koap-u0d8a8369aa1418ee27-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-ud1ba2bb159b2b498d8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision
koap-ud1ba2bb159b2b498d8-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-u4e7a911b08cc655951-1.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising state control (supervision) of compliance with mandatory product requirements and/or federal state metrological supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43.1, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and Article 19.19 of this Code.
koap-u4e7a911b08cc655951-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-8.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-8.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-udfb6c55397ed15921b-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising state control (supervision) of compliance with mandatory product requirements and/or federal state metrological supervision and their deputies;
koap-udfb6c55397ed15921b-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-uc2d01e71d4db530c71-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive authorities exercising state control (supervision) of compliance with mandatory product requirements and/or federal state metrological supervision and their deputies;
koap-uc2d01e71d4db530c71-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-ud7c07f45ab160e3c35-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising state control (supervision) of compliance with mandatory product requirements and/or federal state metrological supervision and their deputies;
koap-ud7c07f45ab160e3c35-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-uac17d4342f42f7033a-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising state control (supervision) of compliance with mandatory product requirements and/or federal state metrological supervision and their deputies.
koap-uac17d4342f42f7033a-1.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

koap-uc0cb7451b9e44e32d8-1.text: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording
koap-uc0cb7451b9e44e32d8-1.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-uc4fa5aaa49f3ab3646-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording
koap-uc4fa5aaa49f3ab3646-1.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-uebb7ac48f6847bb19f-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority carrying out official statistical recording and control in the sphere of official statistical recording and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 13.19 of this Code.
koap-uebb7ac48f6847bb19f-1.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-22.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-22.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-u0279365d833980380a-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority carrying out official statistical recording and control in the sphere of official statistical recording and his or her deputies;
koap-u0279365d833980380a-1.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-u20263d63f82ac336df-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority carrying out official statistical recording and control in the sphere of official statistical recording in constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and their deputies.
koap-u20263d63f82ac336df-1.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

koap-uc58dfa1f6718aa8be1-1.text: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
koap-uc58dfa1f6718aa8be1-1.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-ue5cb41e285dfe85657-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
koap-ue5cb41e285dfe85657-1.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-u30a2a9690723d6ee59-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state housing supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to tobacco smoking in lifts and common-use premises of apartment buildings), Articles 7.21 - 7.23, part 1 of Article 7.23.2, Articles 7.23.3 and 9.5.1, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of housing stock facilities), parts 4 and 5, part 12 (with respect to collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) meters for energy resources used in apartment buildings and residential houses) and part 13 (with respect to collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) electricity meters in apartment buildings and residential houses) of Article 9.16, parts 1 - 4 of Article 9.23, part 8 of Article 9.24, part 1 of Article 13.19.2 (except administrative offences committed by housing construction cooperatives constructing apartment buildings), and Article 14.1.3 of this Code.
koap-u30a2a9690723d6ee59-1.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-23.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-23.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-u3304e29d187a0d5d6b-1.text: 1) chief state housing inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-u3304e29d187a0d5d6b-1.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-u1ca5c56cb7d0102db5-1.text: 2) chief state housing inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for cities and districts and their deputies.
koap-u1ca5c56cb7d0102db5-1.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision

koap-u750e89a7c0956b9809-1.text: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision
koap-u750e89a7c0956b9809-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-uaea0843a01949ba1af-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision
koap-uaea0843a01949ba1af-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-u3ca1949e601c555375-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state construction supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 9.4 and 9.5, Article 9.5.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed by persons carrying out construction or reconstruction of capital construction facilities), part 3 of Article 9.16, and Article 14.44 of this Code.
koap-u3ca1949e601c555375-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-9.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-9.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-u47d85b9f189c44f4cf-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state construction supervision and his or her deputies;
koap-u47d85b9f189c44f4cf-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-u989de631c91436de90-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state construction supervision and their deputies;
koap-u989de631c91436de90-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-u9a996a06fa35cdec38-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state construction supervision and their deputies;
koap-u9a996a06fa35cdec38-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-u2a26c1864307f1c046-1.text: 4) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state construction supervision and their deputies;
koap-u2a26c1864307f1c046-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-ue63843d82cce5fe502-1.locator: Article 23.56. Authorities Exercising State Construction Supervision

koap-ubfd9a47ae55590b7c4-1.text: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites
koap-ubfd9a47ae55590b7c4-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-ue8835909ac92165801-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites
koap-ue8835909ac92165801-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-ube04cf030399d2745a-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state supervision of the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, popularisation and state protection of cultural heritage sites shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 7.33 of this Code.
koap-ube04cf030399d2745a-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-10.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-10.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-uc008ee8e8aa536a5ae-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state supervision of the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, popularisation and state protection of cultural heritage sites and his or her deputies;
koap-uc008ee8e8aa536a5ae-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-u7abc183245b062fed3-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising state supervision of the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, popularisation and state protection of cultural heritage sites and their deputies;
koap-u7abc183245b062fed3-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-uefc62739b5d0030715-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state supervision of the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, popularisation and state protection of cultural heritage sites and their deputies;
koap-uefc62739b5d0030715-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-ude74416699f2923c4d-1.text: 4) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising state supervision of the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, popularisation and state protection of cultural heritage sites and their deputies.
koap-ude74416699f2923c4d-1.locator: Article 23.57. Authorities Exercising State Supervision of the Condition, Maintenance, Preservation, Use, Popularisation and State Protection of Cultural Heritage Sites

koap-u993244e8a0ed6bc101-1.text: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
koap-u993244e8a0ed6bc101-1.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-u00202d14fcc448dcd5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
koap-u00202d14fcc448dcd5-1.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-u998cc756fcff642877-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of geodesy and cartography shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to points of state geodetic networks, failure to give notice of their destruction or damage, and refusal to provide vehicular or pedestrian access to them), and Articles 7.25, 7.26 and 19.10 of this Code.
koap-u998cc756fcff642877-1.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-11.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-11.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-u90fc67a501a8d60691-1.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography and his or her deputies;
koap-u90fc67a501a8d60691-1.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-u07748a3b9fe11dda3e-1.text: 2) chief state inspectors for supervision in the field of geodesy and cartography for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies.
koap-u07748a3b9fe11dda3e-1.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography

koap-ub03424915e567a5aa6-1.text: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
koap-ub03424915e567a5aa6-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-u511fb680dbc95a1713-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies
koap-u511fb680dbc95a1713-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-u0aa414aa45180fb834-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 3 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.8 (within their powers) of this Code.
koap-u0aa414aa45180fb834-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-11.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-ub57849df72c65b11ce-11.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-ub8d8c86ee617534f30-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies;
koap-ub8d8c86ee617534f30-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-u863aec7cdb58389b6b-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies;
koap-u863aec7cdb58389b6b-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-u4eb4dee01be70e5732-1.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of natural monopolies and their deputies.
koap-u4eb4dee01be70e5732-1.locator: Article 23.59. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Natural Monopolies

koap-uac93667e89b6f7ebf1-1.text: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
koap-uac93667e89b6f7ebf1-1.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control

koap-u15fe6da3dec59a8194-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control
koap-u15fe6da3dec59a8194-1.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control

koap-u6e2d9062ff146f9056-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 2.1, 4 - 5 and 6 - 6.5 of Article 15.25 of this Code.
koap-u6e2d9062ff146f9056-1.locator: Article 23.60. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Currency Control

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-12.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:

koap-u129989c2c9df601b5c-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of currency control and his or her deputies;

koap-u855a6740921e9f7af3-1.locator: Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate

koap-u585ae14a7ccbefdfb7-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of shared-participation construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 13.19.2 (with respect to administrative offences committed by housing construction cooperatives constructing apartment buildings), Article 13.19.3 (with respect to administrative offences committed by a developer or a developer's officials), parts 1 - 5 of Article 14.28, Article 14.28.1 and part 4 of Article 19.5 of this Code.

koap-u7f8e271f8a10c3966f-1.text: 2. Heads and deputy heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the field of shared-participation construction of apartment buildings and/or other real estate shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u7f8e271f8a10c3966f-1.locator: Article 23.64. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Shared-Participation Construction of Apartment Buildings and/or Other Real Estate

koap-uf9686dad9edb9c031e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement
koap-uf9686dad9edb9c031e-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-ud18841b83a95dee149-1.text: 1. Procurement control authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1, parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2, Articles 7.30.6 and 7.32.6 (within their powers, except the sphere of the state defence order), part 11 of Article 9.16 (except the spheres of the state defence order and state secrets), part 7 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.2 (except the spheres of the state defence order and state secrets) of this Code.
koap-ud18841b83a95dee149-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u20cf9be96f013a277a-1.text: 1.1. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1, parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2, and Article 19.7.2 of this Code shall be heard by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in procurement where the case concerning such an administrative offence was initiated by an official of a local self-government authority authorised to exercise control in procurement.
koap-u20cf9be96f013a277a-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u4923d1b8ff9be322dc-1.text: 1.2. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code committed during procurement of goods, works or services for municipal needs shall be heard by the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in procurement where the case concerning such an administrative offence was initiated by a prosecutor.
koap-u4923d1b8ff9be322dc-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u228ee8479efcd5fdb5-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u228ee8479efcd5fdb5-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-udd40c5e459fb022732-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
koap-udd40c5e459fb022732-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u24b5b16779c68706ad-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
koap-u24b5b16779c68706ad-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u0e56866a472ffa598b-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
koap-u0e56866a472ffa598b-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u2170e721784121fc13-1.text: 4) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the sphere of procurement and their deputies;
koap-u2170e721784121fc13-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-u15bdc50c9744c31e92-1.text: 5) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the sphere of procurement and their deputies.
koap-u15bdc50c9744c31e92-1.locator: Article 23.66. Procurement Control Authorities under the Legislation of the Russian Federation on the Contract System in Procurement

koap-uebdd8eac7694afa6f3-1.locator: Article 23.71. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise State Control over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations in the Field of Energy Audits

koap-u541cc43502397d6015-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.74. Bank of Russia

koap-u9e1ab0e5cddbfff855-1.text: 1. The Bank of Russia shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 10 and 14 of Article 7.30.3, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within its powers), parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29 and 14.30, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2 and 15.17 - 15.22, parts 1 - 10 of Article 15.23.1, Article 15.24.1, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, part 1 of Article 15.26.2 (except restrictions on operating hours), Articles 15.26.3 - 15.26.5, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within its powers), Articles 15.28 - 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35 and 15.38, parts 1, 3 and 5 of Article 15.39, Article 15.48 (within its powers), parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.3 of this Code.

koap-ua1ad22037a2d1a142f-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the Bank of Russia:

koap-uc9c65c3b54b7edc104-1.text: 1) the Chairperson of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, the head of a territorial institution of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of this Article;

koap-ue5f8b7f7d787e97a21-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation and their deputies whose competence includes matters of supervision and control in financial markets (except banking activities) — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29 and 14.30, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2 and 15.17 - 15.22, parts 1 - 10 of Article 15.23.1, Article 15.24.1, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, part 1 of Article 15.26.2 (except restrictions on operating hours), Articles 15.26.3 - 15.26.5, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (except administrative offences committed by credit institutions, officials of credit institutions and employees of credit institutions specified in note 2 to Article 15.27), Articles 15.28 - 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35 and 15.38, Article 15.48 (within their powers), parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.3 of this Code;
