koap-u9a95e32fafe15d4826-1.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons

koap-ua23902705fe83e0e83-1.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising state supervision in the field of destruction of chemical weapons shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.20 of this Code.
koap-ua23902705fe83e0e83-1.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-24.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-24.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons

koap-uee59d4738b894fcce6-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising state supervision in the field of destruction of chemical weapons and their deputies;
koap-uee59d4738b894fcce6-1.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons

koap-ue27b00211bc775a770-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising state supervision in the field of destruction of chemical weapons and their deputies.
koap-ue27b00211bc775a770-1.locator: Article 23.76. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Supervision in the Field of Destruction of Chemical Weapons

koap-u9b06a5173c129132d4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.77. Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate

koap-u3f31bcc1f3707c2ac1-1.text: 1. Officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1 and 2 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, Article 12.21.1 (except cases where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), Article 12.21.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31, 12.32 and 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code in relation to an official of a military unit responsible for the technical condition and operation of vehicles and the driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, or rescue military formations of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence.

koap-uf69e48be25654cef0d-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the military motor vehicle inspectorate in relation to an official of a military unit responsible for the technical condition and operation of vehicles and the driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, or rescue military formations of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence:

koap-ud07e4c5647b312ba1a-1.text: 1) the head of the Military Motor Vehicle Inspectorate of the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate (regional), his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate (territorial), his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of an operational-territorial large formation (formation) of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, his or her deputy, the head of the military motor vehicle inspectorate of the federal executive authority authorised to perform tasks in the field of civil defence and his or her deputy — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22, 8.23 and 12.1, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, part 3 of Article 12.4 (except cases of unlawful application of a passenger taxi colour and graphic scheme), parts 1, 1.1 and 2 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.7, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, Article 12.21.1 (except cases where an administrative offence is recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, cinematographic or video-recording functions, or by photographic, cinematographic or video-recording equipment), Article 12.21.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31, 12.32 and 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code;

koap-u38a04c6646f3c94860-1.text: 2) the head of a department (division, group, laboratory), his or her deputy, a senior assistant (assistant) to the head of a division, a chief inspector, a senior officer, a senior inspector (inspector), a senior inspector (inspector) of the road patrol service, a senior instructor, or a senior technician (technician) of the military motor vehicle inspectorate — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 12.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.2, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 12.3, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 12.5, Article 12.6, Article 12.12 (except cases of proceeding against a prohibiting traffic light signal or failure to comply with the Road Traffic Rules requirement to stop before a stop line indicated by road signs or road surface markings when the traffic light signal prohibits movement), Article 12.21, parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.23, part 3 of Article 12.25, Articles 12.31 and 12.32, part 1 of Article 12.37, and Article 19.22 (with respect to the registration of motor vehicles with an engine displacement exceeding fifty cubic centimetres and a maximum design speed exceeding fifty kilometres per hour, and trailers for them, intended for use on public roads) of this Code.

koap-ufd7b891a222005a458-1.text: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
koap-ufd7b891a222005a458-1.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation

koap-ub275a3795504dd314f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation
koap-ub275a3795504dd314f-1.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation

koap-ue557a0b4b014001df9-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to perform control functions over foreign investment in the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 19.8.2 of this Code.
koap-ue557a0b4b014001df9-1.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation

koap-u2f9f9685520e3e66d7-1.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised to perform control functions over foreign investment in the Russian Federation and his or her deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u2f9f9685520e3e66d7-1.locator: Article 23.78. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Perform Control Functions over Foreign Investment in the Russian Federation

koap-u3bc0ea1f26a1344166-1.text: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
koap-u3bc0ea1f26a1344166-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-u9f39e13dbc76e20f35-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast
koap-u9f39e13dbc76e20f35-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-uc2055363257bec2176-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of the constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are the cities of federal significance Moscow and Saint Petersburg shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 5 of Article 12.16 of this Code where the transfer of those powers is provided for by agreements between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers.
koap-uc2055363257bec2176-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-u31d0abb2bca40b7262-1.text: 1.1. Executive authorities of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and of Moscow Oblast shall hear cases concerning administrative offences committed in the territories of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and Moscow Oblast and provided for by part 4 of Article 12.16 of this Code where the transfer of those powers is provided for by agreements between the federal executive authority and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers, and officials of executive authorities of the city of federal significance Sevastopol and of Moscow Oblast directly discover indications of administrative offences.
koap-u31d0abb2bca40b7262-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-ue4eeb16f72b9ff296a-1.text: 2. Heads and deputy heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article.
koap-ue4eeb16f72b9ff296a-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-u21d9b1061dfe7a5461-1.text: 3. Executive authorities of the constituent entities of the Russian Federation that are the cities of federal significance Moscow, Saint Petersburg and Sevastopol exercising the powers provided for by Article 19 of Federal Law of 13 March 2006 No. 38-FZ 'On Advertising' shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.37 of this Code.
koap-u21d9b1061dfe7a5461-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-ua2897aaa7a8264639a-1.text: 4. Officials of the respective authorities who are included in lists approved by regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 3 of this Article.
koap-ua2897aaa7a8264639a-1.locator: Article 23.79. Executive Authorities of Cities of Federal Significance and of Moscow Oblast

koap-u2614dd9ee2da1b4ffb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79.1. Repealed
koap-u2614dd9ee2da1b4ffb-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79.1. Repealed

koap-u63293bd234c489696f-1.text: Article 23.79.1. Repealed as of 1 January 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 514-FZ.
koap-u63293bd234c489696f-1.locator: Article 23.79.1. Repealed as of 1 January 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 514-FZ.

koap-u143cf1d76418a9acc5-1.text: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
koap-u143cf1d76418a9acc5-1.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

koap-ucc8f59792abd89cd41-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation
koap-ucc8f59792abd89cd41-1.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

koap-u0ecd68feba7e369e7b-1.text: 1. In addition to the cases provided for by this Chapter, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by this Code and committed in their territories where this is provided for by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation on the transfer of powers of federal executive authorities for exercise by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, adopted in accordance with federal laws, or by agreements concluded in accordance with federal law between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on the transfer of the exercise of part of their powers, except powers to hear cases concerning administrative offences in the field of road traffic provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code.
koap-u0ecd68feba7e369e7b-1.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

koap-u0dd6e50c9800bcc040-1.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u0dd6e50c9800bcc040-1.locator: Article 23.79.2. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation

koap-u2dba611292726a5f76-1.text: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
koap-u2dba611292726a5f76-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u59023f49c7338fd7f3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations
koap-u59023f49c7338fd7f3-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-ud5faaaea912db46af0-1.text: 1. Federal executive authorities authorised to exercise state supervision over the activities of self-regulatory organisations shall, within their powers, hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.52 of this Code.
koap-ud5faaaea912db46af0-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u0d720bfa913de1a5c9-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in this Article:
koap-u0d720bfa913de1a5c9-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u94e5e5fcfbb125b2f8-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities authorised to exercise state supervision over the activities of self-regulatory organisations and their deputies;
koap-u94e5e5fcfbb125b2f8-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u3b7d36b2e1e8e91e6c-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of those authorities and their deputies;
koap-u3b7d36b2e1e8e91e6c-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u3ff0a77f5e21282081-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of those authorities and their deputies.
koap-u3ff0a77f5e21282081-1.locator: Article 23.80. Federal Executive Authorities Authorised to Exercise State Supervision over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations

koap-u406e8a7e3c9b5469f2-1.text: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
koap-u406e8a7e3c9b5469f2-1.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-u9a66e39a764cd4a0c3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare
koap-u9a66e39a764cd4a0c3-1.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-uf27fec5d94098fb727-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.28, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 6.29, Articles 6.30 and 6.32, part 2 of Article 6.34, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of facilities of organisations carrying out medical and pharmaceutical activities and the services they provide), Article 14.4.2 (except the circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use), parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 and 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 18.21, part 5 of Article 19.4, part 21 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.8 of this Code.
koap-uf27fec5d94098fb727-1.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-25.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-25.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-u044749d48fc8f630b0-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and his or her deputies;
koap-u044749d48fc8f630b0-1.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-u456f6c2b58e825886b-1.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in healthcare and their deputies.
koap-u456f6c2b58e825886b-1.locator: Article 23.81. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in Healthcare

koap-u3050debfa6a03c9217-1.text: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
koap-u3050debfa6a03c9217-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-ubafa6dcdc6d533178c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order
koap-ubafa6dcdc6d533178c-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-u5357d0f5b55ffa4605-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 7.30.1 (with respect to violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (with respect to violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), parts 1 - 9, 11 - 13, 15 and 16 of Article 7.30.3, Article 7.32.6 (with respect to the state defence order), part 11 of Article 9.16 (with respect to the state defence order and state secrets), Article 15.14 (with respect to budget appropriations allocated for fulfilment of the state defence order), Article 19.4.2, part 7.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7.2 (with respect to the state defence order and state secrets) of this Code.
koap-u5357d0f5b55ffa4605-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-17.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-17.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-ue21cbd5877d26e9be7-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and his or her deputies;
koap-ue21cbd5877d26e9be7-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-u728e364293461803f6-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and their deputies;
koap-u728e364293461803f6-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-u513488fffc4241d9d7-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of the state defence order and their deputies.
koap-u513488fffc4241d9d7-1.locator: Article 23.82. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of the State Defence Order

koap-ud9266096b3609c39c6-1.text: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
koap-ud9266096b3609c39c6-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u5f747ad1d605a7dbae-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities
koap-u5f747ad1d605a7dbae-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u9cd9ae89301abab949-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 7.30.4 and part 7.2 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-u9cd9ae89301abab949-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-26.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-26.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u1213af31c6b5944d56-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and his or her deputies;
koap-u1213af31c6b5944d56-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u401a78ddf9ca825c9c-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and their deputies;
koap-u401a78ddf9ca825c9c-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-uc59acf985e2f8b4995-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised to exercise control in the sphere of procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities and their deputies.
koap-uc59acf985e2f8b4995-1.locator: Article 23.83. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Exercise Control in the Sphere of Procurement of Goods, Works and Services by Certain Types of Legal Entities

koap-u2229ba92e1002e2609-1.text: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
koap-u2229ba92e1002e2609-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u7571bfcaceadd0cfe5-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components
koap-u7571bfcaceadd0cfe5-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u5089239e8d5c0808ce-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.31 of this Code.
koap-u5089239e8d5c0808ce-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-18.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-18.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u4b8a88ea4d9327ab0a-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and his or her deputies;
koap-u4b8a88ea4d9327ab0a-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u8c2dc28742a930707e-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and their deputies;
koap-u8c2dc28742a930707e-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u21d76d6ef635c4a045-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control functions over ensuring the safety of donated blood and its components and their deputies.
koap-u21d76d6ef635c4a045-1.locator: Article 23.84. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control Functions over Ensuring the Safety of Donated Blood and Its Components

koap-u398b2cf106cca4690b-1.text: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
koap-u398b2cf106cca4690b-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u8fac0d70faced630b0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation
koap-u8fac0d70faced630b0-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u4d8384d73d8c9efd9d-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 36 of Article 19.5, parts 1, 3, 4, 4.1, 5 and 6 of Article 20.8, Article 20.11, parts 1 - 3 of Article 20.12, Article 20.14, parts 1 and 2 - 4 of Article 20.16, part 1 of Article 20.23, and Article 20.24 of this Code.
koap-u4d8384d73d8c9efd9d-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-19.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-19.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-uea28c464273e4d4fc0-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
koap-uea28c464273e4d4fc0-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u50378a2f0f1d8449b9-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-u50378a2f0f1d8449b9-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u49a6ebf4c52b95c2a9-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-u49a6ebf4c52b95c2a9-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u82e73f4387d56120c3-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-u82e73f4387d56120c3-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-ude3ad145ef7252925c-1.text: 4.1) heads of extra-departmental security units of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
koap-ude3ad145ef7252925c-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u1764d2ca1e5f0d369e-1.text: 5) officials of the federal executive authority performing functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation and its territorial authorities who are authorised to exercise state control (supervision).
koap-u1764d2ca1e5f0d369e-1.locator: Article 23.85. Federal Executive Authority Performing Functions in the Sphere of Activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation

koap-u64c34626eb7d3ae592-1.text: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
koap-u64c34626eb7d3ae592-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-ubfb8f65632450fc4f1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners
koap-ubfb8f65632450fc4f1-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-u2ab56efed190260c25-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 6 and 7 of Article 14.25, Article 14.52 (where those offences are committed by self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners), Article 14.52.1, and part 29 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-u2ab56efed190260c25-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-u17d87c47237ebc47e9-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners:
koap-u17d87c47237ebc47e9-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-ua9b1de894111636c4f-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and his or her deputies;
koap-ua9b1de894111636c4f-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-uf4930f2fa2d7050200-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and their deputies;
koap-uf4930f2fa2d7050200-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-u03e6e5dc3938a83f47-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control (supervision) functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of insolvency practitioners and their deputies.
koap-u03e6e5dc3938a83f47-1.locator: Article 23.86. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Insolvency Practitioners

koap-ucc3d260f4f018e994a-1.text: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
koap-ucc3d260f4f018e994a-1.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-u067e9d49ac89d90efe-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply
koap-u067e9d49ac89d90efe-1.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-u503d41e2ccfcd8a57a-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 5 of Article 9.24 and parts 34 and 35 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-u503d41e2ccfcd8a57a-1.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-20.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-20.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-u472d7190ace06da48d-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply and his or her deputies;
koap-u472d7190ace06da48d-1.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-uf7f103186b90e500db-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised to implement state policy in the sphere of heat supply and their deputies.
koap-uf7f103186b90e500db-1.locator: Article 23.87. Federal Executive Authority Authorised to Implement State Policy in the Sphere of Heat Supply

koap-u8fab675784ed771c9b-1.text: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
koap-u8fab675784ed771c9b-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-u77925b9b4ac2cdca84-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation
koap-u77925b9b4ac2cdca84-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-u3046d3f0b0df3e3e70-1.text: 1. Military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24, parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.20, and Article 20.21 of this Code in relation to service members of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and citizens called up for military training in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, as well as civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation where they commit administrative offences within the territories of military units or in connection with the performance of official duties.
koap-u3046d3f0b0df3e3e70-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-uf45dc6442b93dc0af7-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation:
koap-uf45dc6442b93dc0af7-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-u0e7700c2f2ed0d20bf-1.text: 1) the head of the central military police authority of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies and heads of structural divisions of the central military police authority of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
koap-u0e7700c2f2ed0d20bf-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-u78011a558b5812aaaa-1.text: 2) heads of regional military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies and heads of structural divisions of regional military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
koap-u78011a558b5812aaaa-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-u9ee8e00f4572ec71e4-1.text: 3) heads of territorial military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies and heads of structural divisions of territorial military police authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.
koap-u9ee8e00f4572ec71e4-1.locator: Article 23.88. Military Police Authorities of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

koap-ua0b5e3da29033aeea9-1.text: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
koap-ua0b5e3da29033aeea9-1.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services

koap-uf57e83a786e06522e1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services
koap-uf57e83a786e06522e1-1.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services

koap-u6622db56dd78e63ba7-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of social services shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of social service facilities and services provided in the sphere of social services) of this Code.
koap-u6622db56dd78e63ba7-1.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services

koap-u9fb0502bef5588356a-1.text: 2. Heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of social services and their deputies shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u9fb0502bef5588356a-1.locator: Article 23.89. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Social Services

koap-uda4f16ce38cfb6a7c0-1.text: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-uda4f16ce38cfb6a7c0-1.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-ue78efbb7ecea7bdaa7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation
koap-ue78efbb7ecea7bdaa7-1.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u5fff11b5cc832610cf-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 13.12.1 and parts 1 and 3 of Article 19.7.15 of this Code.
koap-u5fff11b5cc832610cf-1.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-uba97167b836ea00d22-1.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-uba97167b836ea00d22-1.locator: Article 23.90. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Security of the Critical Information Infrastructure of the Russian Federation

koap-u54206116a09c6741e2-1.text: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation
koap-u54206116a09c6741e2-1.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation

koap-ue7664182481fe852c9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation
koap-ue7664182481fe852c9-1.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation

koap-u70c6cfc5c6d652beab-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the operation of the state system for detecting, preventing and eliminating the consequences of computer attacks on the information resources of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 13.12.1, Article 13.12.2, and part 2 of Article 19.7.15 of this Code.
koap-u70c6cfc5c6d652beab-1.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation

koap-u199185173eef933eae-1.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the operation of the state system for detecting, preventing and eliminating the consequences of computer attacks on the information resources of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u199185173eef933eae-1.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation

koap-u3fb1e32e7778bb11ce-1.text: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
koap-u3fb1e32e7778bb11ce-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
koap-uf4bfce43ce5fdd6e36-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-u7fa711167eac7c1eca-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.57 of this Code.
koap-u7fa711167eac7c1eca-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-21.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-21.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-ud0c50a7f4707ffadf3-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and his or her deputies;
koap-ud0c50a7f4707ffadf3-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-uce652dfd100dabd6df-1.text: 2) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and his or her deputies;
koap-uce652dfd100dabd6df-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-uc3edaa8fc8c39939c7-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and their deputies.
koap-uc3edaa8fc8c39939c7-1.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

koap-u346a73f67832108f66-1.text: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
koap-u346a73f67832108f66-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-u0c5fef5891d45589f6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
koap-u0c5fef5891d45589f6-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ubacd8a4892b65286af-1.text: 1. Authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.12.1 and 15.12.2 of this Code.
koap-ubacd8a4892b65286af-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-27.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u177262d2d0a614becb-27.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ue8a37dbb8724d0ae80-1.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
koap-ue8a37dbb8724d0ae80-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ud1ede798512f15f3fd-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
koap-ud1ede798512f15f3fd-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ud74e8502c4c95d8697-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
koap-ud74e8502c4c95d8697-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ue4144ea89343d8cd5a-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
koap-ue4144ea89343d8cd5a-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-u2d8e1be4adf0be2e58-1.text: 5) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies.
koap-u2d8e1be4adf0be2e58-1.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System

koap-ucf65ecd849b138d10b-1.text: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
koap-ucf65ecd849b138d10b-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-u6bed0f2ee4cd5bc132-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
koap-u6bed0f2ee4cd5bc132-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-u30fe954802f52287c4-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 15.27 (within its powers), Article 15.43, parts 2 and 3 of Article 15.44, Articles 15.46 and 15.47, part 8 of Article 19.4 and part 43 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
koap-u30fe954802f52287c4-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-22.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-22.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-u80a4566f0211e47c06-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and his or her deputies;
koap-u80a4566f0211e47c06-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-u2c3cf4da7d18d88b6a-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and their deputies;
koap-u2c3cf4da7d18d88b6a-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-u45b5ff52ecf7233ec9-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and their deputies.
koap-u45b5ff52ecf7233ec9-1.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

koap-ud8db0e2c67ddb7520b-1.text: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
koap-ud8db0e2c67ddb7520b-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u1967ff3c4b454ff0f8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
koap-u1967ff3c4b454ff0f8-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u36ce3eb75f77953aa7-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 8.52 (within its powers) and part 1 of Article 8.54 (within its powers) of this Code.
koap-u36ce3eb75f77953aa7-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u2ed690f11552c26649-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-u2ed690f11552c26649-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u1728a9ecbfa8f48e9b-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and his or her deputies;
koap-u1728a9ecbfa8f48e9b-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u0bdfe50c17d16425ca-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and their deputies;
koap-u0bdfe50c17d16425ca-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u1ba6f52191dab01686-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and their deputies;
koap-u1ba6f52191dab01686-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u42c8c75a87254be11b-1.text: 4) heads of departments, deputy heads of departments and other officials of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use.
koap-u42c8c75a87254be11b-1.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use

koap-u137f85f535c4b5c6f7-1.text: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals
koap-u137f85f535c4b5c6f7-1.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals

koap-ucc18af1893f0be2b5e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals
koap-ucc18af1893f0be2b5e-1.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals

koap-u86007fe993ef5b1ef8-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of treatment of animals shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1, part 2 (within their powers) and part 3 of Article 8.52, and Article 8.54 of this Code.
koap-u86007fe993ef5b1ef8-1.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals

koap-u6c6c52c176b794dfd4-1.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u6c6c52c176b794dfd4-1.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals

koap-u545610d4cd3816f917-1.text: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
koap-u545610d4cd3816f917-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-ud033a8cc873dc01400-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
koap-ud033a8cc873dc01400-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-ube8b925017c481c698-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43 and Articles 14.44, 14.45 and 14.46 of this Code where those offences involve violation of the requirements of the technical regulation of the Eurasian Economic Union 'On the Safety of Products Intended for Civil Defence and Protection against Natural and Man-Made Emergencies' (TR EAEU 050/2021), and by parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code (with respect to products intended for civil defence and protection against natural and man-made emergencies).
koap-ube8b925017c481c698-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-23.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
koap-uef75d37926b13fb5ae-23.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u564c01c1a87576d08e-1.text: 1) the deputy head — Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Fire Supervision — of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies;
koap-u564c01c1a87576d08e-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u52fa0123503b2713b3-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
koap-u52fa0123503b2713b3-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u53921343c46363b75a-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
koap-u53921343c46363b75a-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u4e76dbe0e4458b2898-1.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
koap-u4e76dbe0e4458b2898-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-ufb80100f17d5dc1eee-1.text: 5) heads of territorial departments (divisions, inspectorates) of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
koap-ufb80100f17d5dc1eee-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u0fde0d5630c852a4eb-1.text: 6) officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies, and of its territorial authorities, who are authorised to exercise federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies.
koap-u0fde0d5630c852a4eb-1.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies

koap-u176cd26daba0d714b8-1.text: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
koap-u176cd26daba0d714b8-1.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry

koap-ua51b72f166b3bb4d36-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
koap-ua51b72f166b3bb4d36-1.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry

koap-uaca2f5fc0a3fdc3974-1.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.39, parts 11 - 15 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), parts 16 - 19 and parts 20 and 21 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas) of Article 14.51, and part 1 of Article 19.5 (within their powers) of this Code.
koap-uaca2f5fc0a3fdc3974-1.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry

koap-u2ab31a94c5f95821a9-1.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, and heads of state institutions subordinate to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry (where the exercise of regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry is entrusted to such state institutions) shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u2ab31a94c5f95821a9-1.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry

koap-u042ca2e723b83dc877-1.text: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
koap-u042ca2e723b83dc877-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-uf9c75243ed6b9b64fb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
koap-uf9c75243ed6b9b64fb-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-ue5431308daf2c3d292-1.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.71 of this Code.
koap-ue5431308daf2c3d292-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-ub0b2014a3bdd7af124-1.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers:
koap-ub0b2014a3bdd7af124-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-ua769897a803a2af405-1.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and his or her deputies;
koap-ua769897a803a2af405-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-u2b7d145b8ca6ffdb8e-1.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and their deputies;
koap-u2b7d145b8ca6ffdb8e-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-u902073177906ddafba-1.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and their deputies.
koap-u902073177906ddafba-1.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

koap-u5f352e1471c0ef6780-1.text: Section IV. Proceedings in Administrative Offence Cases
koap-u5f352e1471c0ef6780-1.locator: Section IV. Proceedings in Administrative Offence Cases

koap-u0c22778d1b57274fac-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. SECTION IV. PROCEEDINGS IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES
koap-u0c22778d1b57274fac-1.locator: Section IV. Proceedings in Administrative Offence Cases

koap-ue90420da35ae7fc860-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 24. GENERAL PROVISIONS

koap-u3efada473911df1138-1.text: Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases
koap-u3efada473911df1138-1.locator: Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases

koap-uabc875aaf8a8ceef1d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases
koap-uabc875aaf8a8ceef1d-1.locator: Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases

koap-u3ed0c93440ae62931f-1.text: The objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases are the comprehensive, complete, objective and timely establishment of the circumstances of each case, its resolution in accordance with law, ensuring enforcement of the ruling issued, and identifying the causes and conditions that contributed to the commission of administrative offences.
koap-u3ed0c93440ae62931f-1.locator: Article 24.1. Objectives of proceedings in administrative offence cases

koap-u36161e99fd9e2ab8a7-1.text: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
koap-u36161e99fd9e2ab8a7-1.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
