koap-ue3579ad23e9f5c278e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted
koap-ue3579ad23e9f5c278e-1.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted

koap-ud193120c60914a6f9e-1.text: 1. Proceedings in administrative offence cases shall be conducted in Russian, the state language of the Russian Federation. Alongside the state language of the Russian Federation, proceedings in administrative offence cases may be conducted in the state language of the republic in whose territory the judge, body or official authorised to consider administrative offence cases is located.
koap-ud193120c60914a6f9e-1.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted

koap-ub3a45b27bb3fcea2a4-1.text: 2. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case who do not know the language in which the proceedings are conducted shall be guaranteed the right to speak and give explanations, submit motions and challenges, and lodge complaints in their native language or another language of communication freely chosen by them, and to use the services of an interpreter.
koap-ub3a45b27bb3fcea2a4-1.locator: Article 24.2. Language in which proceedings in administrative offence cases are conducted

koap-u8b1105ff98c2526035-1.text: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
koap-u8b1105ff98c2526035-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u4fc831bc11aac70086-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases
koap-u4fc831bc11aac70086-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u79b1a475e3bdc61fac-1.text: 1. Administrative offence cases shall be considered publicly, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where this could result in disclosure of state, military, commercial or other secrets protected by law, or where required by the interests of ensuring the safety of persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case, their family members and close persons, or protecting the honour and dignity of those persons.
koap-u79b1a475e3bdc61fac-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u6c8c925b51555fe5c8-1.text: 2. A decision to consider an administrative offence case in closed session shall be made, in the form of a procedural order, by the judge, body or official considering the case.
koap-u6c8c925b51555fe5c8-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u997a1af8328deb955c-1.text: 2.1. Use of videoconferencing systems and a web-conferencing system in the closed consideration of an administrative offence case shall not be permitted.
koap-u997a1af8328deb955c-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u089354ed026f821e57-1.text: 3. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case and citizens present at its public consideration shall have the right to record the course of consideration in writing and by audio recording. Photography, video recording and broadcasting of the public consideration of an administrative offence case on radio, television and the Internet information and telecommunications network shall be permitted with the authorisation of the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case.
koap-u089354ed026f821e57-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-u5fa341ac80b2d4b327-1.text: 4. The actions of citizens present at the consideration of a case who, with the authorisation of the judge, body or official considering that case, take photographs, make video recordings or broadcast the public consideration of the administrative offence case on radio, television and the Internet information and telecommunications network must not interfere with the proper conduct of consideration of the administrative offence case. Such actions may be limited in time by the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case and must be carried out taking into account the views of the participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases and in locations designated by the judge, body or official considering that case.
koap-u5fa341ac80b2d4b327-1.locator: Article 24.3. Public consideration of administrative offence cases

koap-ude5311bbb9b52f4da8-1.text: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
koap-ude5311bbb9b52f4da8-1.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge

koap-ua3d86db5dd961d3a6e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge
koap-ua3d86db5dd961d3a6e-1.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge

koap-u7a981c5f02275ab79b-1.text: 1. Extraprocedural communications addressed to a judge handling an administrative offence case, or to the president of the court, the deputy president, the presiding judge of a judicial panel or the president of a judicial division in relation to administrative offence cases pending before the court, shall not be permitted.
koap-u7a981c5f02275ab79b-1.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge

koap-ua6ad71e8f5d451215c-1.text: 2. Information about extraprocedural communications from state bodies, local self-government bodies, other bodies, organisations, officials or citizens received by a judge handling an administrative offence case, or by the president of the court, the deputy president, the presiding judge of a judicial panel or the president of a judicial division in relation to administrative offence cases pending before the court, shall be made public and brought to the attention of participants in the proceedings by posting that information on the court’s official website on the Internet. Such communications shall not constitute grounds for procedural actions or procedural decisions in administrative offence cases.
koap-ua6ad71e8f5d451215c-1.locator: Article 24.3.1. Informing participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case of extraprocedural communications received by a judge

koap-u3d0d4ec061f7607d3b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.4. Motions

koap-u07bff75aa2cdf00c6e-1.text: 1. Persons participating in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall have the right to submit motions, which must be considered by the judge, body or official handling the case.

koap-u9c335ac0e47a9f53b9-1.text: 2. A motion shall be submitted in writing and shall be considered immediately. A decision refusing to grant a motion shall be made, in the form of a procedural order, by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.

koap-u611de0c664187b1254-1.text: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u611de0c664187b1254-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ua5d981c917797cbc15-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-ua5d981c917797cbc15-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uda5207c86536f40719-1.text: 1. Proceedings in an administrative offence case may not be initiated, and proceedings already initiated shall be terminated, where at least one of the following circumstances exists:
koap-uda5207c86536f40719-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue3c858ceb76f275fe3-1.text: 1) absence of the event of an administrative offence;
koap-ue3c858ceb76f275fe3-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u4beb70411b37bb7744-1.text: 2) absence of the constituent elements of an administrative offence, including where an individual had not, at the time of the unlawful action or omission, attained the age specified by this Code for administrative liability (except in the case provided for by part 3 of this Article), or where the individual who committed the unlawful action or omission was legally insane;
koap-u4beb70411b37bb7744-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uc61a29aa5ef01fc4b1-1.text: 3) action by a person in a state of extreme necessity;
koap-uc61a29aa5ef01fc4b1-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ub67f9a4727e4d19970-1.text: 4) issuance of an amnesty act, if that act removes the application of an administrative penalty;
koap-ub67f9a4727e4d19970-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ua0e76dcc8d198a039e-1.text: 5) repeal of a law or provision thereof establishing administrative liability for the act, except where provisions of a law abolishing administrative liability for the act and establishing criminal liability for the same act enter into force simultaneously;
koap-ua0e76dcc8d198a039e-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue76d9f17d9e729c160-1.text: 5.1) commission of an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements contained in regulatory legal acts, where, under parts 3, 4 and 7 of Article 15 of Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 247-FZ “On Mandatory Requirements in the Russian Federation”, such non-compliance cannot constitute grounds for administrative liability;
koap-ue76d9f17d9e729c160-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u821c909f0a8a19d843-1.text: 5.2) recognition of the agreement referred to in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code as performed;
koap-u821c909f0a8a19d843-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ucb88a847d5d4e4b115-1.text: 6) expiry of the limitation periods for imposing administrative liability;
koap-ucb88a847d5d4e4b115-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u747b28cee52cbdf22b-1.text: 7) existence, in respect of the same instance of unlawful action or omission by the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, a ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case under the same article or the same part of an article of this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or a decision to initiate a criminal case;
koap-u747b28cee52cbdf22b-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uc5ab3c9ab07e773cd1-1.text: 8) death of the individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted;
koap-uc5ab3c9ab07e773cd1-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u02c1f867fa5377d0de-1.text: 8.1) entry in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities of a record of liquidation of the legal entity against which proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, based on a commercial court procedural order concluding liquidation bankruptcy proceedings under insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation;
koap-u02c1f867fa5377d0de-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u6f18e1d592292d649a-1.text: 9) other circumstances provided for by this Code under which a person who has committed an action or omission containing the constituent elements of an administrative offence is exempted from administrative liability.
koap-u6f18e1d592292d649a-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u59e1d378f64457573f-1.text: 2. Where an administrative offence has been committed by a person referred to in part 1 of Article 2.5 of this Code, except where that person bears administrative liability on general grounds for that administrative offence, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall, after all circumstances of its commission have been established, be terminated so that the person may be subjected to disciplinary liability.
koap-u59e1d378f64457573f-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ud7de09addcc361042e-1.text: 3. Where an administrative offence connected with driving a vehicle is detected and the individual had not, at the time of the unlawful action, attained the age specified by this Code for administrative liability, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be terminated after the measures securing proceedings that are necessary to stop the unlawful action have been applied.
koap-ud7de09addcc361042e-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u8a6aedaa242a5468ed-1.text: 4. If, during proceedings in an administrative offence case concerning failure to exercise or improper exercise of the powers of a state authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a local self-government body, or failure by a state or municipal institution to perform its statutory tasks or its improper performance thereof, it is established that the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, the chair of its highest executive body, another official of its executive body, the head of a municipal entity heading the local administration, another local self-government official, or the head of a state or municipal institution submitted or sent, in accordance with the procedure and deadlines for preparing the draft budget of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the relevant local budget, a proposal to allocate budget appropriations for the exercise of those powers of the state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or local self-government body, or for the performance of the relevant statutory tasks by the state or municipal institution, and appropriations for those purposes were not allocated or were allocated in an amount insufficient to exercise those powers or perform those statutory tasks, resulting in non-exercise or improper exercise of the powers or non-performance or improper performance of the statutory tasks, proceedings in the administrative offence case against those bodies, institutions and their officials shall be terminated.
koap-u8a6aedaa242a5468ed-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u95716cc51d88c3b7ce-1.text: 5. If, during proceedings in an administrative offence case concerning failure to exercise or improper exercise of state powers delegated to state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation or local self-government bodies, it is established that subventions for the exercise of those powers were allocated in an amount insufficient for their exercise, resulting in non-exercise or improper exercise of those powers, proceedings in that administrative offence case against those bodies and their officials shall be terminated.
koap-u95716cc51d88c3b7ce-1.locator: Article 24.5. Circumstances precluding proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u2d4aabdd773ffd9093-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.6. Prosecutorial supervision

koap-u8f065375128242e550-1.text: The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and prosecutors appointed by the Prosecutor General shall, within their competence, supervise compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and the implementation of laws in force in the Russian Federation during proceedings in administrative offence cases, except cases pending before a court.

koap-u6cdcf37fee375f1c93-1.text: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
koap-u6cdcf37fee375f1c93-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-ueb59806a870339d888-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case
koap-ueb59806a870339d888-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-ua3509d03a547e70726-1.text: 1. Costs in an administrative offence case shall consist of:
koap-ua3509d03a547e70726-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-uf132777c2209f62336-1.text: 1) amounts paid to witnesses, victims, their legal representatives, attesting witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters, including amounts paid to cover travel, accommodation rental and additional expenses associated with living away from the permanent place of residence (daily allowances);
koap-uf132777c2209f62336-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u49219792a18fa8467d-1.text: 2) amounts spent on dismantling, storing, transporting (forwarding) and examining physical evidence, the instrument used to commit an administrative offence or the object of the administrative offence;
koap-u49219792a18fa8467d-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u525e6f9c71d8ce2fd7-1.text: 3) amounts paid for legal assistance to defence counsel appointed by the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case in accordance with part 6 of Article 25.5 of this Code, including amounts paid to cover travel, accommodation rental and additional expenses associated with living away from the permanent place of residence (daily allowances).
koap-u525e6f9c71d8ce2fd7-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u18747000688cd876f1-1.text: 2. Costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by an individual and provided for by this Code shall be charged to the federal budget, and costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by an individual and provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be charged to the budget of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of this Article.
koap-u18747000688cd876f1-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u41bbd5ea2c50302503-1.text: 3. Costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur shall be charged to those persons, except amounts paid to an interpreter. Amounts paid to an interpreter in connection with consideration of a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur and provided for by this Code shall be charged to the federal budget, and costs in a case concerning an administrative offence committed by a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur and provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be charged to the budget of that constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u41bbd5ea2c50302503-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u6895924483ce4e31a1-1.text: Where proceedings in an administrative offence case against a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur are terminated on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, the costs of the administrative offence case shall be charged to the federal budget; and where proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation are terminated against a legal entity or an individual entrepreneur on those grounds, the costs shall be charged to the budget of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u6895924483ce4e31a1-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-uc1c2a3705c1b22dd0b-1.text: 3.1. Costs in an administrative offence case specified in point 3 of part 1 of this Article shall be charged to the person held administratively liable, except where proceedings against that person are terminated on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
koap-uc1c2a3705c1b22dd0b-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-ue60da3ecc83a36996b-1.text: Where proceedings are terminated, on the grounds provided for by points 1 - 3, 5, 7, 8 and 8.1 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, against a person who is outside the Russian Federation at the time the administrative offence case is considered, in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, the costs in the administrative offence case shall be charged to the federal budget.
koap-ue60da3ecc83a36996b-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-uaa588cee67b43c5b08-1.text: 4. The amount of costs in an administrative offence case shall be determined on the basis of documents included in the case file evidencing the existence and amount of expenses classified as costs.
koap-uaa588cee67b43c5b08-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-ue0c85d2468ea3cc933-1.text: The decision on costs in an administrative offence case shall be reflected in the ruling imposing an administrative penalty or the ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case.
koap-ue0c85d2468ea3cc933-1.locator: Article 24.7. Costs in an administrative offence case

koap-u593de44eb642a99331-1.text: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u593de44eb642a99331-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u04294aba6197ce6e89-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u04294aba6197ce6e89-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue02dab417af0c84e57-1.text: 1. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents may be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case on paper or, where the court, body or official handling the case has the technical capability, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document. Where applications, motions, complaints, protests or other documents are submitted electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, their attachments must also be submitted electronically, including in the form of an electronic document.
koap-ue02dab417af0c84e57-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u8572aaddf748b9ceb7-1.text: 2. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and their attachments may be submitted to a court by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case through the federal state information system “Unified Portal of State and Municipal Services (Functions)” (hereinafter, the Unified Portal), through an information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
koap-u8572aaddf748b9ceb7-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u1fe45c751313dd6693-1.text: 3. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to a court through the Unified Portal or an information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
koap-u1fe45c751313dd6693-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ub7b3199df9767fe0a3-1.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to a court through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases must be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
koap-ub7b3199df9767fe0a3-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u13d912baa89c661b1d-1.text: 4. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and their attachments may be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case to the body or official handling the case through the Unified Portal, through the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur located on the official website of a state body, the monitoring information system operator or the Bank of Russia on the Internet information and telecommunications network (hereinafter, the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur), or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
koap-u13d912baa89c661b1d-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u3a89ef0520f528ee8f-1.text: The documents referred to in the first paragraph of this part may also be submitted by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case, through regional portals of state and municipal services (functions) (hereinafter, regional portals), to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, commissions on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commissions, other collegial bodies established under the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, state institutions subordinate to executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, local self-government bodies and their officials handling the case.
koap-u3a89ef0520f528ee8f-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u90ba374065d42bae72-1.text: 5. Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted through the Unified Portal to the body or official handling an administrative offence case may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
koap-u90ba374065d42bae72-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u77cfc947d90d1fa6d7-1.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted through a regional portal to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, an administrative commission, another collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case may be signed with a simple electronic signature unless this Code requires them to be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
koap-u77cfc947d90d1fa6d7-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u00ddc58d59a98e3a14-1.text: Applications, motions, complaints, protests and other documents submitted to the body or official handling an administrative offence case through the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur, or through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction, must be signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature.
koap-u00ddc58d59a98e3a14-1.locator: Article 24.8. Submission of procedural documents by participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ud2bdd0a850cc4501a8-1.text: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
koap-ud2bdd0a850cc4501a8-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ue36dc450adf18891c6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents
koap-ue36dc450adf18891c6-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u5f2fd2c7562c98372c-1.text: 1. The rulings, decisions, procedural orders, records and other procedural documents provided for by this Code shall be prepared on paper or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, where the court, body or official handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability.
koap-u5f2fd2c7562c98372c-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u242eaac9589cb9fe04-1.text: Where a procedural document is prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, an additional paper copy shall be prepared in accordance with the procedure and in the cases established by this Code and acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation and the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation adopted within their powers, including upon a motion by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case.
koap-u242eaac9589cb9fe04-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uffaa0533457d791b2d-1.text: 2. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall, where the court handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability, be sent to participants in the proceedings by the following means:
koap-uffaa0533457d791b2d-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u23e97a35743f9c29da-1.text: 1) through the Unified Portal, where the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
koap-u23e97a35743f9c29da-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-1.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-1.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u1c195b3f655605fa03-1.text: 2) through the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation;
koap-u1c195b3f655605fa03-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u7d8809f10529485614-1.text: 3) by the means specified in part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, provided that the person has consented, in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, to notices being sent by those means;
koap-u7d8809f10529485614-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u9c115cd8d797b6c668-1.text: 4) through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
koap-u9c115cd8d797b6c668-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ud9ec29e5b6cc4e2f6b-1.text: 3. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall, where the body or official handling the administrative offence case has the technical capability, be sent to participants in the proceedings by the following means:
koap-ud9ec29e5b6cc4e2f6b-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u049ad5b1e690e1efd9-1.text: 1) to the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur;
koap-u049ad5b1e690e1efd9-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u3681e55119f361deb0-1.text: 2) through the Unified Portal, where the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
koap-u3681e55119f361deb0-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-2.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-2.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-2.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-2.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u7d8809f10529485614-2.text: 3) by the means specified in part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, provided that the person has consented, in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, to notices being sent by those means;
koap-u7d8809f10529485614-2.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u9c115cd8d797b6c668-2.text: 4) through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
koap-u9c115cd8d797b6c668-2.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u37f8387d3431d0c8cb-1.text: 4. Procedural documents prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, may be sent to participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case by the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commission, other collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case, simultaneously through the Unified Portal and a regional portal, subject to the following conditions:
koap-u37f8387d3431d0c8cb-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u7aacb981707bd2302d-1.text: 1) the participant in proceedings in the administrative offence case has completed registration on the regional portal and has consented on that portal to those documents being sent through the regional portal;
koap-u7aacb981707bd2302d-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u242e8f2ca960b67e98-1.text: 2) the participant in proceedings in the administrative offence case has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and:
koap-u242e8f2ca960b67e98-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-3.text: а) the participant has consented on the Unified Portal to those documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the case provided for by subpoint “б” of this point;
koap-ue8e0259e38248cc4eb-3.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-3.text: б) the participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in respect of whom a ruling has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code has not opted out on the Unified Portal of those documents being sent through the Unified Portal;
koap-u52c6218894a4e9d29c-3.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u32bc0b322b651c5141-1.text: 3) the executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights, administrative commission, other collegial body established under a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, state institution subordinate to an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, local self-government body or their officials handling the administrative offence case have the technical capability to send those documents through the Unified Portal and a regional portal.
koap-u32bc0b322b651c5141-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u353314cc2d6854b847-1.text: 5. A judge’s rulings, procedural orders and decisions provided for by Articles 29.9, 30.7 and 30.17 of this Code, prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, shall be sent to participants in proceedings in the administrative offence case by posting them in the prescribed manner in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation no later than the day following the day they are issued, unless other time limits are established by this Code.
koap-u353314cc2d6854b847-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u03bd9f31c452a1fbc3-1.text: 6. A person shall be deemed to have received a procedural document (a copy thereof) if:
koap-u03bd9f31c452a1fbc3-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uc389ecc8bc12edebd2-1.text: 1) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served personally against a signed receipt or sent by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt, and the postal service provider has recorded its delivery to the addressee in the prescribed manner;
koap-uc389ecc8bc12edebd2-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uf4048c5f4e2a4db102-1.text: 2) the addressee refused to receive the procedural document (a copy thereof), and that refusal has been recorded by the postal service provider or the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;
koap-uf4048c5f4e2a4db102-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u21e0684cecc11cf57d-1.text: 3) despite a postal notification, the addressee did not collect the procedural document (a copy thereof) sent in the prescribed manner, and the postal service provider has notified the judge, body or official that sent the document;
koap-u21e0684cecc11cf57d-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ueef22ed1f4ab1673cc-1.text: 4) the procedural document (a copy thereof) was not delivered because the addressee was absent from the address indicated by the addressee, and the postal service provider has notified the judge, body or official that sent the document, indicating the source of that information;
koap-ueef22ed1f4ab1673cc-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ubb8100e520386d725a-1.text: 5) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served on an authorised employee of a branch or representative office of a legal entity where the administrative offence was committed by the legal entity in the territory in which its branch or representative office operates;
koap-ubb8100e520386d725a-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u2384e9f6b848642619-1.text: 6) the procedural document (a copy thereof) has been served on the legal representative of an individual, the legal representative of a legal entity, defence counsel or a representative where they participate in proceedings in the administrative offence case;
koap-u2384e9f6b848642619-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uf3a5e4cd1d5241f40b-1.text: 7) a judge’s rulings, procedural orders and decisions provided for by Articles 29.9, 30.7 and 30.17 of this Code have been posted in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 5 of this Article;
koap-uf3a5e4cd1d5241f40b-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u5c09e61f43c009a0f0-1.text: 8) the procedural document has been delivered to the personal account of a legal entity or individual entrepreneur;
koap-u5c09e61f43c009a0f0-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u656bf5c87a506d6fe0-1.text: 9) a person in respect of whom a ruling in an administrative offence case has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, who has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and has not opted out of procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, has logged into the personal account on the Unified Portal within seven days from the day the procedural document was posted in that personal account;
koap-u656bf5c87a506d6fe0-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u595ec177fd72596279-1.text: 10) the procedural document has been posted in the person’s personal account on the Unified Portal with that person’s consent to procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, except in the cases provided for by point 9 of this part;
koap-u595ec177fd72596279-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uc5cee59a9d8cf67fb3-1.text: 11) a person who has completed registration on a regional portal and consented on that portal to procedural documents being sent through the regional portal has logged into the personal account on the regional portal within seven days from the day the procedural document was posted in that personal account;
koap-uc5cee59a9d8cf67fb3-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u29956131258d2fed47-1.text: 12) the procedural document has been delivered by electronic means of communication where the person has submitted a request for notices to be sent by electronic means of communication;
koap-u29956131258d2fed47-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uf20d0002a04d841fe7-1.text: 13) the procedural document has been delivered through the electronic document management systems of participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction.
koap-uf20d0002a04d841fe7-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ud9784d523e85153590-1.text: 7. A procedural document (a copy thereof) shall be deemed received:
koap-ud9784d523e85153590-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-uf859155c9514804b2c-1.text: 1) in the cases provided for by points 1, 5 and 6 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the procedural document is served on the persons referred to in those points;
koap-uf859155c9514804b2c-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u1b8a2cf9638f4f6686-1.text: 2) in the case provided for by point 2 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the judge, body or official receives notification from the postal service provider, or from the day the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case records refusal to receive the procedural document;
koap-u1b8a2cf9638f4f6686-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ua4932ae8973cd68442-1.text: 3) in the cases provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the judge, body or official receives notification from the postal service provider;
koap-ua4932ae8973cd68442-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u889e6494f2aefcc8d0-1.text: 4) in the cases provided for by points 7 and 10 of part 6 of this Article, from the day following the day the procedural document is posted in the prescribed manner in the information system designated by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or the Judicial Department at the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation or in the person’s personal account on the Unified Portal;
koap-u889e6494f2aefcc8d0-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u7d27cda0315cc90efa-1.text: 5) in the cases provided for by points 8, 12 and 13 of part 6 of this Article, from the day following the day the procedural document is delivered;
koap-u7d27cda0315cc90efa-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u32f65973bdad6f2a6e-1.text: 6) in the cases provided for by points 9 and 11 of part 6 of this Article, from the day the person logs into the personal account on the Unified Portal or regional portal.
koap-u32f65973bdad6f2a6e-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u132d7bfc6084bc369c-1.text: 8. If a person in respect of whom a ruling in an administrative offence case has been issued under the procedure provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, who has completed registration in the unified identification and authentication system and has not opted out of procedural documents being sent through the Unified Portal, does not log into the personal account on the Unified Portal within seven days from the day the procedural document is posted there, and that person has not consented or has withdrawn consent to receiving procedural documents exclusively through the personal account on the Unified Portal, a copy of the procedural document prepared under part 9 of this Article shall be sent to that person in the prescribed manner by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt.
koap-u132d7bfc6084bc369c-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u25cdd4f04acde4dfcd-1.text: If a person who has completed registration on a regional portal and consented on that portal to procedural documents being sent through the regional portal does not log into the personal account on the regional portal within seven days from the day the procedural document is posted there, a copy of the procedural document prepared under part 9 of this Article shall be sent to that person in the prescribed manner by registered mail with acknowledgement of receipt.
koap-u25cdd4f04acde4dfcd-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u3ca04c3b5b176494fa-1.text: 9. Where a procedural document prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, must be sent by post or a copy thereof served against a signed receipt, a copy shall be made by converting the electronic document into a paper document and shall be certified in the prescribed manner.
koap-u3ca04c3b5b176494fa-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u2fbf90d48f22bfe93a-1.text: 10. Where a procedural document that must be signed by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case is prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, that participant shall, no later than the next working day after receiving it, send to the body or official that sent the procedural document, in accordance with Article 24.8 of this Code, an acknowledgement of receipt referring to its identifying particulars and stating agreement or disagreement with its content.
koap-u2fbf90d48f22bfe93a-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-ua10f7cb3354e79f8e8-1.text: If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case receives the procedural document referred to in the first paragraph of this part and does not send the relevant acknowledgement within the prescribed period, that participant shall be deemed to have refused to sign the procedural document. The refusal by a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case to sign a procedural document prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, shall be recorded by the body or official that sent the document.
koap-ua10f7cb3354e79f8e8-1.locator: Article 24.9. Preparation, service and sending of procedural documents

koap-u28320eba506a94dcb9-1.text: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
koap-u28320eba506a94dcb9-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-uc4fce1ab74aa40e1f0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case
koap-uc4fce1ab74aa40e1f0-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-u63ad546e3a8f99136e-1.text: 1. A judge handling an administrative offence case under Article 12.24 of this Code who has information that another judge, body or official is conducting proceedings against the same person in a case concerning an administrative offence under Chapter 12 of this Code arising from the same instance of unlawful action or omission, or that a ruling imposing an administrative penalty has been issued against the same person under an article (part of an article) of Chapter 12 of this Code arising from the same instance of unlawful action or omission, shall issue a procedural order requisitioning the materials of the administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code.
koap-u63ad546e3a8f99136e-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-uba68a4682aec72bc04-1.text: 2. The procedural order requisitioning materials of an administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code shall specify information about the person against whom the case was initiated, the article (part of an article) of this Code establishing administrative liability for the offence, the date and place where the administrative offence record was drawn up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, or the position, surname, first name and patronymic of the judge or official who issued the ruling in the administrative offence case, the addresses of that person and judge, and the date and place of consideration of the case. Other information enabling identification of the administrative offence case may also be specified.
koap-uba68a4682aec72bc04-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-u1a0c4448698d93ad8a-1.text: 3. Materials of the administrative offence case referred to in part 2 of this Article shall be sent to the judge who issued the procedural order requisitioning them no later than three days from receipt of that order.
koap-u1a0c4448698d93ad8a-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-u4a884abaca3c394fa1-1.text: 4. An administrative offence case under Chapter 12 of this Code whose materials have been requisitioned in accordance with part 1 of this Article shall be considered (reviewed) by the judge who issued the procedural order requisitioning those materials.
koap-u4a884abaca3c394fa1-1.locator: Article 24.10. Requisition of materials of an administrative offence case

koap-ub7824138e75fcb4c48-1.text: Chapter 25. Participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases, their rights and duties
koap-ub7824138e75fcb4c48-1.locator: Chapter 25. Participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases, their rights and duties

koap-u71946c3525a14bafc2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 25. PARTICIPANTS IN PROCEEDINGS IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES, THEIR RIGHTS AND DUTIES
koap-u71946c3525a14bafc2-1.locator: Chapter 25. Participants in proceedings in administrative offence cases, their rights and duties

koap-ub093e5200366092fb8-1.text: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
koap-ub093e5200366092fb8-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-ue12ef75257262cb6c1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted
koap-ue12ef75257262cb6c1-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-uf4efd6aa777be5f2c9-1.text: 1. A person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted shall have the right to examine all case materials and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the materials of the administrative offence case; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; give explanations; submit evidence, motions and challenges; use the legal assistance of defence counsel; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.
koap-uf4efd6aa777be5f2c9-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-u7c1d17e6169e187307-1.text: 2. An administrative offence case shall be considered with the participation of the person against whom proceedings are conducted. In that person’s absence, the case may be considered only in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where there is information confirming that the person was duly notified of the place and time of consideration and the person has not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.
koap-u7c1d17e6169e187307-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-u1346998b867b2b2e8a-1.text: 3. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case may declare the presence of the person against whom proceedings are conducted mandatory at the consideration of the case.
koap-u1346998b867b2b2e8a-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-ubd690ad7d06c6db305-1.text: When a case concerning an administrative offence punishable by administrative arrest, administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, or compulsory work is considered, the presence of the person against whom proceedings are conducted shall be mandatory, except when considering a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.48, part 9 of Article 19.34, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence under Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code.
koap-ubd690ad7d06c6db305-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-ueafed2ab571b650805-1.text: 4. A minor against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted may be removed during consideration of circumstances whose discussion could have an adverse effect on that minor.
koap-ueafed2ab571b650805-1.locator: Article 25.1. Person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted

koap-u53cbde544ab8c4ac85-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.2. Victim

koap-u2bd1b638fb1deeae02-1.text: 1. A victim is an individual or legal entity that has suffered physical, property or moral harm as a result of an administrative offence.

koap-u7f9eff3cc61601f3d8-1.text: 2. A victim shall have the right to examine all materials of the administrative offence case and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the case materials; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; give explanations; submit evidence, motions and challenges; use the legal assistance of a representative; appeal the ruling in the case; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.

koap-uc4274ce1c4eeb07cb2-1.text: 3. An administrative offence case shall be considered with the participation of the victim. In the victim’s absence, the case may be considered only where there is information confirming that the victim was duly notified of the place and time of consideration and the victim has not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.

koap-ua8dcc98cf397ab3a53-1.text: 4. The victim may be questioned in accordance with Article 25.6 of this Code.

koap-u9903c586b320a98347-1.text: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
koap-u9903c586b320a98347-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-ua53ce765c4a3093a21-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual
koap-ua53ce765c4a3093a21-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-u2f8577d51330e1fc95-1.text: 1. The rights and legitimate interests of an individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or of a victim, who is a minor or is unable to exercise their rights independently owing to their physical or mental condition, shall be protected by their legal representatives.
koap-u2f8577d51330e1fc95-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-u671e68235b2f413867-1.text: 2. The legal representatives of an individual are their parents, adoptive parents, guardians or trustees.
koap-u671e68235b2f413867-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-ue87343e5aefc8a8dda-1.text: 3. Family relationships or the relevant authority of persons who are legal representatives of an individual shall be certified by the documents provided for by law.
koap-ue87343e5aefc8a8dda-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-ucbc6fc8ae5ea76de53-1.text: 4. Legal representatives of an individual against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and of a victim shall have the rights and bear the duties provided for by this Code for the persons they represent.
koap-ucbc6fc8ae5ea76de53-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-ue13c9539aa9324297c-1.text: 5. When considering an administrative offence case involving a person under eighteen years of age, the judge, body or official considering the case may declare the presence of that person’s legal representative mandatory.
koap-ue13c9539aa9324297c-1.locator: Article 25.3. Legal representatives of an individual

koap-u6490d60f3b66959318-1.text: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
koap-u6490d60f3b66959318-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-ud0b45221c593f6c5ed-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity
koap-ud0b45221c593f6c5ed-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-u953f6f4003c8a01818-1.text: 1. The rights and legitimate interests of a legal entity against which proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or of a legal entity that is a victim, shall be protected by its legal representatives.
koap-u953f6f4003c8a01818-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-u28f2a8edaba3153252-1.text: 2. Under this Code, the legal representatives of a legal entity are its head and any other person recognised by law or the constituent documents as an organ of the legal entity. The authority of a legal representative of a legal entity shall be confirmed by documents certifying their official position.
koap-u28f2a8edaba3153252-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-uc226028c8993a1d3b7-1.text: 3. An administrative offence case concerning an offence committed by a legal entity shall be considered with the participation of its legal representative or defence counsel. In their absence, the case may be considered only in the cases provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code, or where there is information confirming that those persons were duly notified of the place and time of consideration and they have not requested postponement of consideration or such a request has been refused.
koap-uc226028c8993a1d3b7-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-u5055e784272a5a3b54-1.text: 4. When considering an administrative offence case concerning an offence committed by a legal entity, the judge, body or official handling the case may declare the presence of the legal entity’s legal representative mandatory.
koap-u5055e784272a5a3b54-1.locator: Article 25.4. Legal representatives of a legal entity

koap-udc9a161f067cbd9fc6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.5. Defence counsel and representative

koap-u9a830246e2e850aa01-1.text: 1. Defence counsel may participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case to provide legal assistance to the person against whom proceedings are conducted, and a representative may participate to provide legal assistance to the victim.

koap-u2f55428100e09f0c0f-1.text: 2. An advocate or another person may be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel or representative.

koap-u63604cbec73b9c58d1-1.text: 3. An advocate’s authority shall be certified by a warrant issued by the relevant advocates’ practice organisation. The authority of another person providing legal assistance shall be certified by a power of attorney executed in accordance with law.

koap-uaf9f9ae895299aa193-1.text: 4. Defence counsel and a representative shall be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case from the moment the case is initiated.

koap-u1c4d55cf885ac4b765-1.text: 5. Defence counsel and representatives admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall have the right to examine all case materials and audio and video recordings; make extracts from the case materials; make copies of those materials at their own expense, including by technical means; submit evidence, motions and challenges; participate in consideration of the case; appeal the application of measures securing proceedings and the ruling in the case; and exercise other procedural rights under this Code.

koap-ud725463a33541266ea-1.text: 6. Participation of defence counsel in proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for such an administrative offence, shall be mandatory if, at the time the relevant administrative offence case is considered, the person against whom proceedings are conducted is outside the Russian Federation and there is no possibility of duly notifying that person in accordance with this Code. The judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall take measures to appoint defence counsel. Requirements for defence counsel, the appointment procedure and the procedure for determining the amount payable to defence counsel shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.

koap-ub0f1880e5067f3cd6c-1.text: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
koap-ub0f1880e5067f3cd6c-1.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation

koap-u3cc9bc4e2d4975dd46-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
koap-u3cc9bc4e2d4975dd46-1.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation

koap-u84a65e46571e943a2d-1.text: The Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and the commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may, upon the motion of a person against whom proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence in the field of entrepreneurial activity are conducted, be admitted to participate in the case as defence counsel.
koap-u84a65e46571e943a2d-1.locator: Article 25.5.1. Presidential Commissioner for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation and commissioner for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation

koap-ubb6884ff7008180f27-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.6. Witness

koap-u58dd6ba1717fa2aaf8-1.text: 1. A person who may know circumstances of an administrative offence case that are to be established may be summoned as a witness in the case.

koap-u199be9a0ba4237d917-1.text: 2. A witness shall appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case and give truthful testimony: disclose everything known to the witness concerning the case, answer the questions asked and certify by signing the relevant record that the testimony has been recorded correctly.

koap-ue7703f3e4f81cc886a-1.text: 3. A witness shall have the right:

koap-ue02c29fdd4806bce47-1.text: 1) not to testify against themselves, their spouse or close relatives;

koap-u867813f11d4e566452-1.text: 2) to testify in their native language or a language they know;

koap-udaff82c4fd25c6d11b-1.text: 3) to receive the free assistance of an interpreter;

koap-u859c6e38ccd118d30f-1.text: 4) to make comments on the accuracy with which their testimony has been entered in the record.

koap-u9d74eef8b8bf5b8429-1.text: 4. A teacher or psychologist must be present when a minor witness under fourteen years of age is questioned. Where necessary, questioning shall take place in the presence of the minor witness’s legal representative.

koap-u1234e948065bfa73e6-1.text: 5. A witness shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving false testimony.

koap-u24c338e427c591decd-1.text: 6. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, a witness shall bear administrative liability under this Code.

koap-u824de055e0391741a0-1.text: Note. In this Article, close relatives means parents, children, adoptive parents, adopted children, siblings, grandparents and grandchildren.

koap-u98e615830e3c714980-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.7. Attesting witness

koap-uf3622771f45d29e920-1.text: 1. In the cases provided for by this Code, the official handling an administrative offence case may engage as an attesting witness any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case. There must be at least two attesting witnesses.

koap-u64e7f861bc560f6ed2-1.text: 2. In the cases provided for by part 12 of Article 12.21.1 (in respect of administrative offences whose consideration falls within the competence of the federal executive body exercising federal state transport supervision), Chapter 27 and Article 28.1.1 of this Code, the presence of attesting witnesses or the use of video recording shall be mandatory. An attesting witness shall certify by signing the record that procedural actions were carried out in their presence, their content and their results.

koap-ub22b1eca3332fecf13-1.text: 3. The participation of attesting witnesses in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be entered in the record.

koap-u0b4bab9f1f0193cdfb-1.text: 4. An attesting witness may make comments on the procedural actions being carried out. Those comments shall be entered in the record.

koap-u8ab41816fb309cc451-1.text: 5. Where necessary, an attesting witness may be questioned as a witness in accordance with Article 25.6 of this Code.

koap-u748a2e3e3aec5c4100-1.text: 6. Where video recording is used to record procedural actions, other than a personal search, those actions shall be carried out without attesting witnesses, and this shall be entered in the relevant record or alcohol intoxication examination certificate. Materials obtained during procedural actions using video recording shall be attached to the relevant record or alcohol intoxication examination certificate.

koap-uc4b5f7e00cc5b198f1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.8. Specialist

koap-u543aa4983968e1f498-1.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case and possessing the knowledge necessary to assist in detecting, securing and seizing evidence and in using technical means may be engaged as a specialist in proceedings in an administrative offence case.

koap-u7cf879c3394e198d2e-1.text: 1) appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;

koap-u5ac21cf11a375a676c-1.text: 2) participate in actions requiring specialised knowledge for the purpose of detecting, securing and seizing evidence, and give explanations concerning the actions they perform;

koap-ua3c1af6f188356f90a-1.text: 3) certify by their signature that those actions were performed, their content and their results.

koap-u25a563ac39d876c464-1.text: 3. A specialist shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving false explanations.

koap-udb5b2d11f1df760c9e-1.text: 4. A specialist shall have the right:

koap-u1decee8130ce5dc39a-1.text: 1) to examine materials of the administrative offence case relating to the subject matter of actions carried out with their participation;

koap-u961b077fcdfc426f01-1.text: 2) with the permission of the judge, official or person presiding over the meeting of the collegial body handling the administrative offence case, to ask the person against whom proceedings are conducted, the victim and witnesses questions relating to the subject matter of those actions;

koap-u5372f3b1dff1983520-1.text: 3) to make statements and comments concerning the actions they perform. Those statements and comments shall be entered in the record.

koap-u0db582d1a14028d22d-1.text: 5. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, a specialist shall bear administrative liability under this Code.

koap-ufa5666879d42246bbe-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.9. Expert

koap-u253ad140d3764d384e-1.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case and possessing specialised knowledge in science, technology, art or a craft sufficient to conduct an expert examination and give an expert opinion may be engaged as an expert.

koap-u7cf879c3394e198d2e-2.text: 1) appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case;

koap-ub72ed795a8f5e0e177-1.text: 2) give an objective opinion on the questions put to them and the explanations required in connection with the content of that opinion.

koap-u1710d977cc88a47f73-1.text: 3. An expert shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving a false opinion.

koap-udecdc36acab2b24edb-1.text: 4. An expert may refuse to give an opinion if the questions put to them fall outside their specialised knowledge or if the materials provided are insufficient to give an opinion.

koap-u635a6d121c41d814d8-1.text: 5. An expert shall have the right:

koap-u6b67374f4369bcc178-1.text: 1) to examine materials of the administrative offence case relating to the subject matter of the expert examination and submit motions for additional materials necessary to give an opinion;

koap-u54dd5a4120d051d3b7-1.text: 2) with the permission of the judge, official or person presiding over the meeting of the collegial body handling the administrative offence case, to ask the person against whom proceedings are conducted, the victim and witnesses questions relating to the subject matter of the expert examination;

koap-ueb86654e373cef7ce4-1.text: 3) to state in their opinion circumstances relevant to the case that were established during the expert examination and about which no questions were put to them.

koap-ueaab128a78f50be0b3-1.text: 6. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 2 of this Article, an expert shall bear administrative liability under this Code.

koap-u248c970304d41c1d07-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.10. Interpreter

koap-ubb4c94f3b3da2985da-1.text: 1. Any adult with no interest in the outcome of the case who knows the languages or has the sign-language interpreting skills (providing sign-language or deafblind interpreting) necessary for translation or sign-language interpreting during proceedings in an administrative offence case may be engaged as an interpreter.

koap-u3e5b3ce201f1c9ce49-1.text: 2. An interpreter shall be appointed by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.

koap-u168b53b734d021444c-1.text: 3. An interpreter shall appear when summoned by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case, carry out the assigned translation fully and accurately and certify its accuracy by their signature.

koap-u3e7d5e9e38878af38e-1.text: 4. An interpreter shall be warned of administrative liability for knowingly providing an incorrect translation.

koap-u8c388521324814c0b1-1.text: 5. For refusal or evasion of the duties provided for by part 3 of this Article, an interpreter shall bear administrative liability under this Code.

koap-u34d12232e2da2e7d09-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.11. Prosecutor

koap-uae727801a8d336c05f-1.text: 1. A prosecutor shall, within their powers, have the right:

koap-u4282edba063904e907-1.text: 1) to initiate proceedings in an administrative offence case;

koap-u2cdb0629eea9853884-1.text: 2) to participate in consideration of an administrative offence case, submit evidence and motions, and give opinions on matters arising during consideration of the case;

koap-u2798d6dd1e1bc033e5-1.text: 3) to lodge a protest against the ruling in an administrative offence case irrespective of participation in the case, and to perform other actions provided for by federal law.

koap-u3aa652141a1cf76c97-1.text: 2. A prosecutor shall be notified of the place and time of consideration of an administrative offence case involving an offence committed by a minor and of an administrative offence case initiated by a prosecutor.

koap-u91fa51593c9516b12e-1.text: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u91fa51593c9516b12e-1.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u332cc2ce33fe53d5b9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u332cc2ce33fe53d5b9-1.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u7dff9ad5c21b799dbf-1.text: 1. Persons shall not be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel or representatives if they are employees of bodies exercising state supervision and control or municipal control over compliance with the rules whose violation gave rise to the case, or if they previously participated in that case in another capacity.
koap-u7dff9ad5c21b799dbf-1.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue8d4acfa7d5a52e4b2-1.text: 2.
