Persons shall not be admitted to participate in proceedings in an administrative offence case as specialists, experts or interpreters if they are related to the person being held administratively liable, the victim, their legal representatives, defence counsel, a representative, the prosecutor, the judge, a member of the collegial body or the official handling the case; if they previously participated in that case in another capacity; or if there are grounds to believe they have a direct or indirect personal interest in the outcome of the case.
koap-ue8d4acfa7d5a52e4b2-1.locator: Article 25.12. Circumstances precluding participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u40829ba5c96b826e74-1.text: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
koap-u40829ba5c96b826e74-1.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted

koap-ufd2598af8eae137db8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted
koap-ufd2598af8eae137db8-1.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted

koap-udaf0e94047fe902f38-1.text: 1. Where the circumstances provided for by Article 25.12 of this Code precluding a person’s participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case as defence counsel, representative, specialist, expert or interpreter exist, that person shall be disqualified from participation.
koap-udaf0e94047fe902f38-1.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted

koap-u5380d6cb833d595b98-1.text: 2. A declaration of self-recusal or an application for disqualification shall be submitted to the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
koap-u5380d6cb833d595b98-1.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted

koap-u45f69d3d4e5ca38b69-1.text: 3. After considering a declaration of self-recusal or an application for disqualification, the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall issue a procedural order granting or refusing it. If an application for disqualification is refused, the same person may not submit a repeated application for disqualification on the same grounds.
koap-u45f69d3d4e5ca38b69-1.locator: Article 25.13. Challenges to persons whose participation in proceedings in an administrative offence case is not permitted

koap-u9f0cc5196b96ee43fb-1.text: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
koap-u9f0cc5196b96ee43fb-1.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness

koap-ua0668ac259af423743-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness
koap-ua0668ac259af423743-1.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness

koap-u06e301452a5e974051-1.text: 1. A victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness shall, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be reimbursed for expenses incurred in connection with appearing before the court, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
koap-u06e301452a5e974051-1.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness

koap-ue35816acc84b71ee01-1.text: 2. The work of specialists, experts and interpreters shall be remunerated in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-ue35816acc84b71ee01-1.locator: Article 25.14. Reimbursement of expenses to a victim, their legal representatives, a witness, specialist, expert, interpreter and attesting witness

koap-u50a763bd57d50628c1-1.text: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u50a763bd57d50628c1-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u94907f3105495d094f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u94907f3105495d094f-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue50e0a683390e3be02-1.text: 1. Participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be notified or summoned to appear before the judge, body or official handling the case by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt, a summons with acknowledgement of receipt, telegram, telephone message, fax or other means of communication that record the notification or summons and delivery of the notice to the addressee, including by text message or email (where the person consents to receive notices at the mobile phone number or email address they specify).
koap-ue50e0a683390e3be02-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u0bd4e00daaa1d208cd-1.text: A participant’s consent to notification by text message or email may be expressed in a separate statement specifying, in addition to the person’s details and consent to notification by those means, the mobile phone number or email address to which the notice is to be sent; or in an administrative offence record, another record provided for by this Code, a motion, complaint or protest, by specifying the participant’s mobile phone number or email address.
koap-u0bd4e00daaa1d208cd-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ua806d7bf0319e19449-1.text: 2. A notice addressed to an individual, including an individual entrepreneur or official, shall be sent to their place of residence. An individual entrepreneur’s place of residence shall be determined from information in the Unified State Register of Individual Entrepreneurs.
koap-ua806d7bf0319e19449-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uacee80af2b352cba82-1.text: A notice addressed to a legal entity shall be sent to its address. If the administrative offence was committed by a legal entity in the territory in which its branch or representative office operates, the notice shall be sent to the address of the legal entity or the address of the branch or representative office. The address of the legal entity, branch or representative office shall be determined from information in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities.
koap-uacee80af2b352cba82-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u6f9c666476903b982a-1.text: 3. If defence counsel for the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, or a representative of the victim, participates in the proceedings, a notice addressed to that person or the victim may be served on (sent to) defence counsel or the representative.
koap-u6f9c666476903b982a-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u1e02cbd3895d7afc04-1.text: 4. If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case has requested that notices be sent to another address, the judge, body or official handling the case shall send the notice to that address.
koap-u1e02cbd3895d7afc04-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uf7c0db17edd3e3110f-1.text: 5. If a participant’s address or place of residence is unknown, sending the notice to the last known address or place of residence shall constitute due notification.
koap-uf7c0db17edd3e3110f-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ua52ce31383c3f4e3e0-1.text: 6. Notices prepared electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, may be sent to a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case in accordance with Article 24.9 of this Code. Where such a notice is sent, the participant shall be deemed to have received it in the cases specified in points 7 - 13 of part 6 of Article 24.9 of this Code.
koap-ua52ce31383c3f4e3e0-1.locator: Article 25.15. Notification of participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u3cd4cd4c5cea2acdf2-1.text: Chapter 26. Matters to be proved. Evidence. Assessment of evidence
koap-u3cd4cd4c5cea2acdf2-1.locator: Chapter 26. Matters to be proved. Evidence. Assessment of evidence

koap-u7d6e8496bc5f194dc8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 26. MATTERS TO BE PROVED. EVIDENCE. ASSESSMENT OF EVIDENCE
koap-u7d6e8496bc5f194dc8-1.locator: Chapter 26. Matters to be proved. Evidence. Assessment of evidence

koap-uce3e8bdd04a3bd37d3-1.text: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
koap-uce3e8bdd04a3bd37d3-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ub353f79b270ea336e7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case
koap-ub353f79b270ea336e7-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-uc20bf6c5b82143154e-1.text: The following shall be established in an administrative offence case:
koap-uc20bf6c5b82143154e-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ufd65fa37ad71ab9300-1.text: 1) whether the event of an administrative offence occurred;
koap-ufd65fa37ad71ab9300-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ubb57d34a43a2dc9d0e-1.text: 2) the person who committed the unlawful action or omission for which this Code or a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation provides administrative liability;
koap-ubb57d34a43a2dc9d0e-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-u2cff4570bd7ecb2b48-1.text: 3) the person’s guilt in committing the administrative offence;
koap-u2cff4570bd7ecb2b48-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ua6c9ccb551def5e6fe-1.text: 4) circumstances mitigating administrative liability and circumstances aggravating administrative liability;
koap-ua6c9ccb551def5e6fe-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ue09000c736a57ee598-1.text: 5) the nature and amount of damage caused by the administrative offence;
koap-ue09000c736a57ee598-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-u1861a25fd6e2829b70-1.text: 6) circumstances precluding proceedings in the administrative offence case;
koap-u1861a25fd6e2829b70-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-ud60a6e673e6d6d8567-1.text: 7) other circumstances relevant to the proper resolution of the case, and the causes and conditions of commission of the administrative offence.
koap-ud60a6e673e6d6d8567-1.locator: Article 26.1. Circumstances to be established in an administrative offence case

koap-u6ab063b00a0139fa35-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.2. Evidence

koap-uad57a435d20d1d1421-1.text: 1. Evidence in an administrative offence case is any factual information on the basis of which the judge, body or official handling the case establishes whether the event of an administrative offence occurred, the guilt of the person being held administratively liable, and other circumstances relevant to the proper resolution of the case.

koap-u49729c23dbe373be44-1.text: 2. Such information shall be established by the administrative offence record, other records provided for by this Code, explanations of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted, testimony of the victim and witnesses, expert opinions, other documents, readings of special technical devices and physical evidence.

koap-u958b6cbefad3fb056b-1.text: 3. Evidence in an administrative offence case, including the results of an inspection carried out in the course of state control (supervision) and municipal control, shall not be used if it was obtained in violation of law.

koap-ud83c650352dabfc912-1.text: 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.

koap-ua814a124be2ba4c006-1.text: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
koap-ua814a124be2ba4c006-1.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses

koap-u00a8584bfdce62d920-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses
koap-u00a8584bfdce62d920-1.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses

koap-u40c7141f5ffcd54012-1.text: 1. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses are information relevant to the case provided by those persons orally or in writing.
koap-u40c7141f5ffcd54012-1.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses

koap-ue5845a9593883a1e4e-1.text: 2. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses shall be reflected in the administrative offence record, the record of application of a measure securing proceedings in the administrative offence case, and the record of consideration of the administrative offence case; where necessary, they shall also be separately recorded and included in the case file.
koap-ue5845a9593883a1e4e-1.locator: Article 26.3. Explanations of the person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted and testimony of the victim and witnesses

koap-u3835bf6c08504b889e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.4. Expert examination

koap-u4d731908b8d5694598-1.text: 1. Where the use of specialised knowledge in science, technology, art or a craft becomes necessary during proceedings in an administrative offence case, the judge, body or official handling the case shall issue a procedural order ordering an expert examination. The order shall be binding on the experts or institutions entrusted with conducting the examination.

koap-u3c789de1010a510734-1.text: 1) the grounds for ordering the expert examination;

koap-u15924495bf270bc3c3-1.text: 2) the surname, first name and patronymic of the expert or the name of the institution where the expert examination is to be conducted;

koap-uf38296e310f619370f-1.text: 3) the questions put to the expert;

koap-u48e239206d67f5e587-1.text: 4) the list of materials made available to the expert.

koap-u4c21aa398966ece777-1.text: In addition, the order shall contain entries confirming that the expert’s rights and duties have been explained and that the expert has been warned of administrative liability for knowingly giving a false opinion.

koap-u034bc6d55e6ad3c8fe-1.text: 3. The questions put to the expert and the expert’s opinion may not go beyond the expert’s specialised knowledge.

koap-u788a7dc3315f35541c-1.text: 4. Before sending the order for execution, the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall acquaint the person against whom proceedings are conducted and the victim with it and explain their rights, including the right to challenge the expert, request that persons they name be engaged as experts, and put questions to be answered in the expert opinion.

koap-ue8a38db95e9deddc4e-1.text: 5. The expert shall give a written opinion in their own name. The opinion may be prepared on paper or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document signed with the expert’s enhanced qualified signature in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation.

koap-u5cdddcdd00f12c50ba-1.text: The expert opinion shall state who conducted the examinations and on what grounds, describe their content, provide reasoned answers to the questions put to the expert, and set out conclusions.

koap-u74912e9dcdb5cee0eb-1.text: 6. An expert opinion shall not be binding on the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case, but disagreement with it must be reasoned.

koap-uf898a9a17dad82ba30-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.5. Taking samples and specimens

koap-ud5c9047f63e16c6833-1.text: 1. An official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case may take handwriting specimens and samples and specimens of goods and other objects necessary for an expert examination.

koap-u71439edcf871d82b72-1.text: 2. Where necessary, photography, cinematography, video recording and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used when taking samples and specimens.

koap-u431bb668d6fcef6e4d-1.text: 3. A record under Article 27.10 of this Code shall be drawn up when samples and specimens are taken.

koap-u8830b25a84f4e982e4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.6. Physical evidence

koap-u41e31fdd6d0799a3b0-1.text: 1. Physical evidence in an administrative offence case means the instruments used to commit an administrative offence or the objects of that offence, including instruments or objects that retain traces of it.

koap-u6d1e423ffe275e4b0f-1.text: 2. Where necessary, physical evidence shall be photographed or recorded by another prescribed method and included in the administrative offence case file. The existence of physical evidence shall be entered in the administrative offence record or another record provided for by this Code.

koap-u8c1debb128c9cc7dde-1.text: 3. The judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall take the measures necessary to preserve physical evidence until the case is resolved on its merits and shall decide its disposition upon completion of consideration of the case.

koap-u9dd2da8d2ddeebe62f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.7. Documents

koap-u94415bc9495d101e01-1.text: 1. Documents shall be recognised as evidence if the information set out or certified in them by organisations, their associations, officials or citizens is relevant to proceedings in an administrative offence case.

koap-u5e17520d37e19eaf7a-1.text: 2. Documents may contain information recorded in writing or in another form. Documents include photographic and cinematographic materials, sound and video recordings, information databases and data banks, and other information media.

koap-uabfd930db6dbd34567-1.text: 3. The judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case shall take the measures necessary to preserve documents until the case is resolved on its merits and shall decide their disposition upon completion of consideration of the case.

koap-ubb135cfc5ce335bfcb-1.text: 4. Where documents have the characteristics specified in Article 26.6 of this Code, those documents shall constitute physical evidence.

koap-uc7794378271921c56f-1.text: 5. Documents may be obtained directly from participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case, through postal or telecommunications services, including through the Internet information and telecommunications network (where the technical capability to submit and receive documents and materials by that means exists), or by another means that identifies the sender of the documents or materials and preserves them unchanged until received by the judge or body authorised to consider the case.

koap-u399bfce2118c1b922f-1.text: If a participant in proceedings in an administrative offence case submits copies of documents, including electronically, the judge, body or official handling the case may require the originals to be submitted.

koap-uf13706849f63e81a24-1.text: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
koap-uf13706849f63e81a24-1.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices

koap-udcac7e5edb6aea2b6d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices
koap-udcac7e5edb6aea2b6d-1.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices

koap-u8f7a9b21930ce6022e-1.text: 1. Special technical devices means measuring instruments approved as measuring devices in the prescribed manner, holding the relevant certificates and having undergone metrological verification.
koap-u8f7a9b21930ce6022e-1.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices

koap-u8df136f24e782627cf-1.text: 2. Readings of special technical devices shall be reflected in the administrative offence record or the ruling in the administrative offence case issued in the circumstances provided for by parts 3 and 3.1 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
koap-u8df136f24e782627cf-1.locator: Article 26.8. Readings of special technical devices

koap-u383ba62fd8eba1a7ea-1.text: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
koap-u383ba62fd8eba1a7ea-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-udce46a2fa94df96872-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case
koap-udce46a2fa94df96872-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-ub9b3b44a51ef68151f-1.text: 1. To obtain evidence in an administrative offence case, the official conducting proceedings may send requests to territorial bodies of the relevant executive body and its subordinate institutions or to other executive bodies, or instructions to an official of the territorial body or institution to perform individual actions provided for by this Code.
koap-ub9b3b44a51ef68151f-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-u0275d8f481b688865a-1.text: 2. An instruction or request in an administrative offence case shall be executed no later than five days from receipt.
koap-u0275d8f481b688865a-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-u885f16ba7d3db9d1ba-1.text: 3. Interaction between bodies conducting proceedings in administrative offence cases and the competent authorities of foreign states and international organisations shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u885f16ba7d3db9d1ba-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-uf671f193bfbc505ec6-1.text: 4. If a judge considering an administrative offence case cannot obtain evidence located in territory under another court’s jurisdiction, the judge may instruct a judge (court) of the same or a lower level to perform specified procedural actions (a judicial instruction), and shall issue a procedural order to that effect.
koap-uf671f193bfbc505ec6-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-ue097b6cf03b6db1182-1.text: The order on a judicial instruction shall briefly set out the substance of the administrative offence case under consideration and specify information about the participants in the proceedings, their places of residence or location, the circumstances to be established, and the evidence to be collected by the judge executing the judicial instruction. A copy of the order shall be sent to the court whose judge has been given the instruction no later than the next working day after it is issued.
koap-ue097b6cf03b6db1182-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-u74642b8c407305e20e-1.text: 5. The order on a judicial instruction shall be binding on the judge to whom it is addressed and shall be executed no later than five working days from receipt of its copy, unless the order establishes another time limit.
koap-u74642b8c407305e20e-1.locator: Article 26.9. Instructions and requests in an administrative offence case

koap-u79b81d23af6d67fe3c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.10. Requisition of information

koap-u2eea772eb932c790fb-1.text: 1. The judge, body or official handling an administrative offence case may issue a procedural order requisitioning information necessary to resolve the case, including information necessary to calculate the administrative fine. The requested information shall be sent within three days from receipt of the order, or immediately where the administrative offence is punishable by administrative arrest or administrative expulsion. If the information cannot be supplied, the organisation shall notify the judge, body or official that issued the order in writing within three days.

koap-u6defb162a53644da41-1.text: 2 - 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.

koap-u9105b30b120ee04a39-1.text: 5. A body or official authorised to issue rulings under part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code may, where the ground for initiating an administrative offence case provided for by point 4 of part 1 of Article 28.1 of this Code exists and the body or official lacks information about the owner (possessor) of the relevant vehicle necessary to issue a ruling, issue a procedural order requisitioning information about the owner (possessor) of that vehicle.

koap-u6a09967af76e78e414-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 26.11. Assessment of evidence

koap-ue86855d10912802058-1.text: The judge, members of the collegial body or official conducting proceedings in an administrative offence case shall assess evidence according to their inner conviction based on a comprehensive, complete and objective examination of all circumstances of the case taken together. No evidence may have predetermined force.

koap-u10440052a75ae8f81a-1.text: Chapter 27. Application of measures securing proceedings in administrative offence cases
koap-u10440052a75ae8f81a-1.locator: Chapter 27. Application of measures securing proceedings in administrative offence cases

koap-udad4e8e1f9262b7380-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 27. APPLICATION OF MEASURES SECURING PROCEEDINGS IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES
koap-udad4e8e1f9262b7380-1.locator: Chapter 27. Application of measures securing proceedings in administrative offence cases

koap-u8e93e872b1397257d0-1.text: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u8e93e872b1397257d0-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u1b89a940001d27eb39-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u1b89a940001d27eb39-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u111f95d86349b6e7a4-1.text: 1. To stop an administrative offence, establish the offender’s identity, draw up an administrative offence record where it cannot be drawn up at the place where the offence was detected, ensure the timely and proper consideration of the administrative offence case and enforcement of the ruling adopted in it, an authorised person may, within their powers, apply the following measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case:
koap-u111f95d86349b6e7a4-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u226e611370ba253d77-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ub2f164dda039aa5b4d-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uc3db92cd77329de83a-1.text: 3) a personal search, inspection of things and inspection of a vehicle in an individual’s possession; inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity and of things and documents located there;
koap-uc3db92cd77329de83a-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u9a6bde6496c04df079-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u4a415b427de362966b-1.text: 5) removal from driving a vehicle of the relevant type;
koap-u4a415b427de362966b-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ub206112cb1fc3055ef-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u629afcd41173201292-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u0f039e245ebd429d00-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uc1ebae09b51726572a-1.text: 8) attachment of goods, vehicles and other things;
koap-uc1ebae09b51726572a-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ufc60d28af8510dc114-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u4c012f1709d7b7aeb8-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-uae4c62d4f3c6a44e58-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u9e4232a2fd7c1ed0fc-1.text: 12) placement of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of compulsory expulsion in the special institutions provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”;
koap-u9e4232a2fd7c1ed0fc-1.locator: Article 27.1. Measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u5482eb40fd78dae2bd-1.text: 2. Harm caused by the unlawful application of measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be compensated in accordance with civil legislation.

koap-u0e53e87f34a13b0c87-1.text: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
koap-u0e53e87f34a13b0c87-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u4d307fefedb777d8aa-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority
koap-u4d307fefedb777d8aa-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-ub8b513d2b70078f79e-1.text: 1. Conveyance, meaning the compulsory escort of an individual and, in the cases provided for by points 3, 8 and 10.1 of this part, of a vessel and other instruments used to commit an administrative offence, for the purpose of drawing up an administrative offence record where it cannot be drawn up at the place where the offence was detected and drawing up such a record is mandatory, shall be carried out:
koap-ub8b513d2b70078f79e-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u522ecc7925c79a6eb8-1.text: 1) by officials of internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by internal affairs bodies (police) under Article 23.3 of this Code, or administrative offences for which internal affairs bodies (police) draw up records under Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement;
koap-u522ecc7925c79a6eb8-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u809cc4eeb07d409e2e-1.text: 2) by military personnel and employees of the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, officials of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), security service or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation;
koap-u809cc4eeb07d409e2e-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u085a4e76fbec38cd72-1.text: 2.1) by officials of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of an administrative offence under Article 20.37 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or security service;
koap-u085a4e76fbec38cd72-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-uaab89e876a90f5e398-1.text: 3) by military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 7.27 (where directly detected or reported by citizens or organisations), parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 8.37, Article 11.7 (as regards violation of the boundaries of areas closed to navigation or temporarily dangerous for navigation and the rules established for those areas), Article 14.1 (as regards compliance with legislation on weapons, private detective (investigative) activity and private security activity), Article 14.2 (as regards compliance with legislation on weapons), Article 14.15 (as regards violation of the rules for sales of weapons and ammunition), Articles 17.7, 17.9 - 17.13, 18.2 - 18.4, 19.3, 19.7, 19.13, 19.20, 20.1 - 20.3, 20.5, 20.8 - 20.24, parts 1, 2 and 5 of Article 20.25, and Articles 20.30 - 20.32 and 20.34 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the official premises of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises. Vessels and instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters or the territorial sea shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels) or a specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area);
koap-uaab89e876a90f5e398-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-uff3dd325235b4f7c62-1.text: 4) by officials of bodies responsible for supervision or control over compliance with rules for the use of transport, upon detection of administrative offences involving transport, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or other official premises;
koap-uff3dd325235b4f7c62-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u5d24020b77e33671f4-1.text: 5) by officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate, upon detection of road traffic rule violations by a driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, to the premises of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or a military unit;
koap-u5d24020b77e33671f4-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u23d4f920780451c74b-1.text: 6) by officials of bodies exercising state environmental supervision, federal state supervision over the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats, federal state forest supervision (forest protection), or federal state control (supervision) over fisheries and conservation of aquatic biological resources, upon detection of administrative offences in the relevant field, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises;
koap-u23d4f920780451c74b-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u7c8500e0df6919bd34-1.text: 7) by officials of border authorities, military personnel, officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and other persons performing duties to protect the State Border of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences concerning defence and protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation, to the official premises of a border authority, internal affairs body (police) or military unit, or the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement;
koap-u7c8500e0df6919bd34-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u7fcd810e642a223f15-1.text: 8) by officials of border authorities, upon detection of administrative offences in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, to the official premises of a border authority, internal affairs body (police) or military unit located in a port of the Russian Federation. Vessels and instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels);
koap-u7fcd810e642a223f15-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u15afa702adab0db033-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u73398d7f3b2b801bad-1.text: 10) by officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations, to the official premises of a customs authority;
koap-u73398d7f3b2b801bad-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u1c06ab457504ee5495-1.text: 10.1) by officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations in internal sea waters or the territorial sea, to the official premises of a customs authority located in a port of the Russian Federation. Vessels and other instruments used to commit an administrative offence that are used for unlawful activity in internal sea waters or the territorial sea shall be taken to a port of the Russian Federation (foreign vessels, to a port of the Russian Federation open to foreign vessels);
koap-u1c06ab457504ee5495-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u800c1e825bd5ec89bb-1.text: 11) by military personnel and employees of bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system and bodies of the Federal Security Service, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 19.12 and parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an institution of the penal enforcement system, a body of the Federal Security Service or an internal affairs body (police);
koap-u800c1e825bd5ec89bb-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-ua6eab926f1024a93b1-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u1a1d38b4b474202cc8-1.text: 13) by officials conducting a counter-terrorism operation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.27 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or another body conducting the counter-terrorism operation;
koap-u1a1d38b4b474202cc8-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u6bc4a2cc94a5cbebd8-1.text: 14) by officials of the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 5.35.1, 13.26, 17.3, 17.8, 17.8.1, 17.9, 17.14 and 17.15 and parts 1 and 4 of Article 20.25 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence committed in a court building (court premises), to the official premises of the court or an internal affairs body (police);
koap-u6bc4a2cc94a5cbebd8-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u2e1770c5e2d9380616-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u39049f4a1404ad2f43-1.text: 16) by officials of the federal executive body responsible for state protection, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the premises of a municipal body, or other official premises;
koap-u39049f4a1404ad2f43-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u030454d8c7bf018a69-1.text: 17) by officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by military police bodies of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation under Article 23.88 of this Code, or offences for which officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation draw up records under point 109 of part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed by civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation referred to in part 1 of Article 23.88 of this Code, when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences, to the official premises of a military police body of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or a military unit;
koap-u030454d8c7bf018a69-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-ud20d384169560e82bf-1.text: 18) by military personnel of the federal executive body responsible for mobilisation preparedness and mobilisation, upon detection of administrative offences under parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or military unit;
koap-ud20d384169560e82bf-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-uf856c9f7bccad545cd-1.text: 19) by military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under part 3 of Article 20.17 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police) or military unit (military police body of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation);
koap-uf856c9f7bccad545cd-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u137d04c7b2d6f48551-1.text: 20) by officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and border authorities, military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.5.1 of this Code, to the official premises of an internal affairs body (police), the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, a military unit, a state authority or military command body enforcing the martial law regime, the premises of a local self-government body of a rural settlement, or other official premises.
koap-u137d04c7b2d6f48551-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u3a511a5c98924db0e0-1.text: 2. Conveyance shall be carried out within the shortest possible time.
koap-u3a511a5c98924db0e0-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-udd9f3945fe78caf7f5-1.text: 3. A record of conveyance shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry made in the administrative offence record or administrative detention record. A copy of the conveyance record shall be given to the person conveyed upon request.
koap-udd9f3945fe78caf7f5-1.locator: Article 27.2. Conveyance to the competent authority

koap-u4d8dac7d518946ab88-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.3. Administrative detention

koap-u15dde5da282f1d4801-1.text: 1. Administrative detention, meaning a short-term restriction of an individual’s liberty, may be applied in exceptional cases where necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration of an administrative offence case or enforcement of the ruling in the case. Administrative detention may be carried out by:

koap-u60e5fe131e2d23748b-1.text: 1) officials of internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by internal affairs bodies (police) under Article 23.3 of this Code, or administrative offences for which internal affairs bodies (police) draw up records under Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offence when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences;

koap-u7e08707912c5130717-1.text: 2) the senior officials at the sites of protected facilities of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection;

koap-ue63e2f9be39f7e3dab-1.text: 2.1) the senior officials at the sites of protected facilities of departmental security services of federal executive bodies, of the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation—the federal city of Moscow—and of organisations entitled to establish departmental security services, and of militarised and guard units of an organisation subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for matters concerning the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, upon detection of an administrative offence under Article 20.37 of this Code;

koap-u9306f4672651280bca-1.text: 3) officials of the military motor vehicle inspectorate, upon detection of road traffic rule violations by a driver of a vehicle of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks;

koap-ua431b6d27ba6eb96c7-1.text: 4) officials of border authorities and internal affairs bodies (police), upon detection of administrative offences concerning defence and protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation or administrative offences in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation;

koap-u1773f64a3cd02bb4c5-1.text: 6) officials of customs authorities, upon detection of customs rule violations;

koap-u2cb2044e9a7a1c8d58-1.text: 7) military personnel and officials of bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system and bodies of the Federal Security Service, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 19.3 and 19.12 of this Code and administrative offences involving damage to or encroachment upon a facility or things under their protection, or entry into a zone under their protection;

koap-u9b955ae95002606df0-1.text: 9) officials conducting a counter-terrorism operation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.27 of this Code;

koap-u5d1082de96f3af1895-1.text: 10) officials of the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, upon detection of administrative offences under Articles 5.35.1, 13.26, 17.3, 17.8, 17.8.1, 17.9, 17.14 and 17.15 and parts 1 and 4 of Article 20.25 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed in a court building (court premises);

koap-uf688bf1d7e23006e14-1.text: 11) officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences whose cases are considered by military police bodies of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation under Article 23.88 of this Code, or offences for which officials of the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation draw up records under point 109 of part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, and upon detection of any administrative offences committed by civilian personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation referred to in part 1 of Article 23.88 of this Code, when requested by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant offences;

koap-u32634edfd370d84025-1.text: 12) military personnel of the federal executive body responsible for mobilisation preparedness and mobilisation, upon detection of administrative offences under parts 1 and 2 of Article 20.17 of this Code;

koap-u9023bf07b9916990d4-1.text: 13) military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under part 3 of Article 20.17 of this Code;

koap-u04a857cf211baa5917-1.text: 14) officials of internal affairs bodies (police) and border authorities, military personnel and employees of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, and military personnel of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, upon detection of administrative offences under Article 20.5.1 of this Code.

koap-uabd74434de64c89820-1.text: 2. The list of persons authorised to carry out administrative detention under part 1 of this Article shall be established by the relevant federal executive body.

koap-u1dbc28280349eba01a-1.text: 3. At the detained person’s request, their relatives, the administration at their place of work (study), and defence counsel shall be notified of their whereabouts as soon as possible.

koap-u8994cf6d8864550cb4-1.text: 4. The parents or other legal representatives of a minor must be notified of the minor’s administrative detention.

koap-u2a37aa448bd54fceed-1.text: 4.1. In the event of administrative detention of a service member or a citizen called up for military training, the military police of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the military unit where the person performs military service (military training) shall be notified immediately; in the event of administrative detention of another person referred to in part 1 of Article 2.5 of this Code, the body or institution where that person serves shall be notified immediately.

koap-ue13c7b7cbdf441cde3-1.text: 4.2. In the event of administrative detention of a member of a public monitoring commission established under legislation of the Russian Federation, the Secretary of the Civic Chamber of the Russian Federation and the relevant public monitoring commission shall be notified immediately.

koap-u49590e295a7d940b6c-1.text: 5. The detained person’s rights and duties under this Code shall be explained to them, and a corresponding entry shall be made in the administrative detention record.

koap-u6d05b777e0315b84ee-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.4. Administrative detention record

koap-u2442aef0fea8d2bd66-1.text: 1. An administrative detention record shall be drawn up specifying the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the detained person, and the time, place and reasons for detention.

koap-u287780a7f75c510ace-1.text: 2. The administrative detention record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the detained person. If the detained person refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the administrative detention record shall be given to the detained person upon request.

koap-u7e808a76ce9a6df471-1.text: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
koap-u7e808a76ce9a6df471-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-uf0050b1e3246a06d23-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention
koap-uf0050b1e3246a06d23-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-uf53439100885d23868-1.text: 1. Administrative detention shall not exceed three hours, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 - 3.1 of this Article.
koap-uf53439100885d23868-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-u91c0fbcadae4e67809-1.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence infringing the established State Border regime of the Russian Federation or the rules for staying in the Russian Federation, an administrative offence committed in internal sea waters, the territorial sea, the continental shelf or the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation, or a violation of customs rules, may be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours where necessary to establish identity or ascertain the circumstances of the administrative offence.
koap-u91c0fbcadae4e67809-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-u2c00964b59d464def5-1.text: 3. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence punishable by administrative arrest or administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation as one of the available administrative penalties may be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours.
koap-u2c00964b59d464def5-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-uf413a721f063f040da-1.text: 3.1. A person against whom proceedings are conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence under Article 20.5.1 of this Code may, where necessary to establish identity or ascertain the circumstances of the offence, be subjected to administrative detention for no more than 48 hours, unless otherwise established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation under Federal Constitutional Law of 30 January 2002 No. 1-FKZ “On Martial Law”.
koap-uf413a721f063f040da-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-u16b945bbf40ceab26d-1.text: 4. The period of administrative detention shall run from the moment the person is conveyed under Article 27.2 of this Code. For an intoxicated person, the period of administrative detention shall run from the moment they become sober. The combined duration of sobering-up time from the moment the intoxicated person is conveyed under Article 27.2 of this Code and their administrative detention under part 2 or 3 of this Article may not exceed 48 hours.
koap-u16b945bbf40ceab26d-1.locator: Article 27.5. Time limits for administrative detention

koap-u7d65c17a52f6ab0684-1.text: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
koap-u7d65c17a52f6ab0684-1.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons

koap-ud41c2f5f084105a6ae-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons
koap-ud41c2f5f084105a6ae-1.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons

koap-u131a4dc4510081c18d-1.text: 1. Detained persons shall be held in specially designated premises of the bodies specified in Article 27.3 of this Code or in special institutions established in the prescribed manner by executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. Those premises must meet sanitary requirements and prevent unauthorised departure.
koap-u131a4dc4510081c18d-1.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons

koap-u763fef9674d317d47f-1.text: 2. The conditions for holding detained persons, food allowances and the procedure for providing medical care to them shall be determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u763fef9674d317d47f-1.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons

koap-u58a66aa57815bedcb7-1.text: 3. Minors subjected to administrative detention shall be held separately from adults.
koap-u58a66aa57815bedcb7-1.locator: Article 27.6. Place and procedure for holding detained persons

koap-uccf3c7e093d7563b2d-1.text: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
koap-uccf3c7e093d7563b2d-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-ud9312ee4f8ff60f45c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession
koap-ud9312ee4f8ff60f45c-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-ue3b119cde67ba05980-1.text: 1. A personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession, meaning examination of things without impairing their structural integrity, shall be carried out where necessary to discover instruments used to commit an administrative offence or objects of the offence.
koap-ue3b119cde67ba05980-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u4976dce178fb83c800-1.text: 2. A personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession shall be carried out by the officials specified in Articles 27.2 and 27.3 of this Code.
koap-u4976dce178fb83c800-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u8e9bf644b70b2c7451-1.text: 3. A personal search shall be conducted by a person of the same sex as the person searched, in the presence of two attesting witnesses of the same sex.
koap-u8e9bf644b70b2c7451-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u3539ae751a7075efc7-1.text: Inspection of things in an individual’s possession (hand luggage, baggage, hunting and fishing equipment, products obtained and other objects) shall be conducted by authorised officials in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-u3539ae751a7075efc7-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u6e6df2f9987bacc952-1.text: 4. In exceptional cases, where there are sufficient grounds to believe that an individual has weapons or other objects used as weapons in their possession, a personal search and inspection of things in the individual’s possession may be conducted without attesting witnesses.
koap-u6e6df2f9987bacc952-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-ub0327b9338c1a616e8-1.text: 5. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
koap-ub0327b9338c1a616e8-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u555104cb358ce1c628-1.text: 6. A record of the personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the conveyance record or administrative detention record. The search and inspection record shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the individual searched, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, the kind and quantity of ammunition, and the type and identifying particulars of documents found during the search or inspection in the individual’s possession.
koap-u555104cb358ce1c628-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u135e00ac6c25b45eb6-1.text: 7. The personal search and inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained using those methods during the personal search and inspection of things in the individual’s possession shall be attached to the relevant record.
koap-u135e00ac6c25b45eb6-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u7d8eda4f3e2b4af8d1-1.text: 8. The personal search and inspection record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted or the possessor of the things inspected, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person against whom proceedings are conducted or the possessor of the things inspected refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the personal search and inspection record shall be given to the possessor of the things inspected upon request.
koap-u7d8eda4f3e2b4af8d1-1.locator: Article 27.7. Personal search and inspection of things in an individual’s possession

koap-u9d2bcc796d5972bd1e-1.text: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
koap-u9d2bcc796d5972bd1e-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u12906602365bb75459-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there
koap-u12906602365bb75459-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-ua62d7c7015b73f52bb-1.text: 1. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and used for entrepreneurial activity, and of things and documents located there, shall be carried out by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records under Article 28.3 of this Code.
koap-ua62d7c7015b73f52bb-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-uc83740908501180e4e-1.text: 2. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there shall be carried out in the presence of a representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative, and in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-uc83740908501180e4e-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u62479cc1e7f9e78157-1.text: 3. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
koap-u62479cc1e7f9e78157-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u9cc298044f2311ff6b-1.text: 4. A record shall be drawn up of the inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there. It shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the legal entity and its legal representative or other representative, the individual entrepreneur or their representative, the land and premises inspected, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, and the type and identifying particulars of documents.
koap-u9cc298044f2311ff6b-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u4b990f169d1afd8334-1.text: 5. The inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using those methods shall be attached to the relevant record.
koap-u4b990f169d1afd8334-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u1e2f737de5f7a72229-1.text: 6. The record of inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the legal representative of the legal entity or the individual entrepreneur, or, in urgent cases, another representative of the legal entity or a representative of the individual entrepreneur, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the legal representative or another representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the inspection record shall be given to the legal representative or another representative of the legal entity, the individual entrepreneur or their representative.
koap-u1e2f737de5f7a72229-1.locator: Article 27.8. Inspection of premises and land belonging to a legal entity or individual entrepreneur and of things and documents located there

koap-u7012b02cc78acfba33-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.9. Inspection of a vehicle

koap-ue12c3ae70c8bac3d01-1.text: 1. Inspection of a vehicle of any type, meaning examination without impairing its structural integrity, shall be carried out to discover instruments used to commit an administrative offence or objects of the offence.

koap-u1181e632500a301535-1.text: 2. A vehicle shall be inspected by the persons specified in Articles 27.2 and 27.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.

koap-u71d563c8d50d2214a2-1.text: 3. A vehicle shall be inspected in the presence of the person possessing it. In urgent cases, the vehicle may be inspected in that person’s absence.

koap-u3966b84d18b0a6d4e7-1.text: 4. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.

koap-u7b0bb9e09b23aa7f59-1.text: 5. A vehicle inspection record shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the administrative detention record.

koap-u512af2564227171edd-1.text: 6. The vehicle inspection record shall specify the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the person possessing the vehicle inspected, the type, make, model, state registration number and other identifying characteristics of the vehicle, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, the kind and quantity of ammunition, and the type and identifying particulars of documents found during inspection of the vehicle.

koap-u0902daae89040e9344-1.text: 7. The vehicle inspection record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using those methods shall be attached to the relevant record.

koap-u5637623867280c8df9-1.text: 8. The vehicle inspection record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted and/or the person possessing the vehicle inspected, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person against whom proceedings are conducted and/or the person possessing the vehicle inspected refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy of the vehicle inspection record shall be given to the person possessing the vehicle inspected.

koap-ud005b51ed57a13f68c-1.text: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
koap-ud005b51ed57a13f68c-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u148779babeb7f5c48e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
koap-u148779babeb7f5c48e-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u0869c3a8255e23a3b8-1.text: 1. Things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects, and documents having evidentiary value in an administrative offence case, found at the scene of the offence or during a personal search, inspection of things in an individual’s possession or vehicle inspection, shall be seized by the persons specified in Articles 27.2, 27.3 and 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-u0869c3a8255e23a3b8-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u8aba3e30697b067104-1.text: 2. Things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects, and documents having evidentiary value in an administrative offence case, found during inspection of land and premises belonging to a legal entity and of goods, vehicles and other property in its possession and the relevant documents, shall be seized by the persons specified in Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-u8aba3e30697b067104-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-ud8fab1eb5952c10d56-1.text: 3. Repealed from 1 September 2013. — Federal Law of 23.07.2013 No. 196-FZ.
koap-ud8fab1eb5952c10d56-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u9096dd5ea125905c9a-1.text: 4. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used when seizing things and documents.
koap-u9096dd5ea125905c9a-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-ua2247dca418e7b58a1-1.text: 5. A record of seizure of things and documents shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry shall be made in the conveyance record, the record of inspection of the scene of the administrative offence or the administrative detention record. Seizure of a driving licence, tractor driver-operator (tractor driver) certificate, vessel operator certificate or pilot certificate shall be entered in the administrative offence record or the record of inspection of the scene of the administrative offence.
koap-ua2247dca418e7b58a1-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-ue185e46aae24e97a75-1.text: 5.1. Where documents are seized, copies shall be made, certified by the official seizing them and given to the person from whom they are seized, and this shall be entered in the record. If copies cannot be made or handed over at the same time as seizure, that official shall give certified copies to the person from whom the documents were seized within five days after seizure, and this shall be entered in the record. If certified copies have not been given to that person by the expiry of five days after seizure, they shall be sent by registered mail within three days, and an entry specifying the postal item number shall be made in the record. Copies shall be sent to the legal entity’s address or the individual’s residential address specified in the record.
koap-ue185e46aae24e97a75-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u0db06b0449201b0b45-1.text: 6. The seizure record shall specify the type and identifying particulars of the documents seized, the kind, quantity and other identifying characteristics of things seized, including the type, make, model, calibre, series, number and other identifying characteristics of weapons, and the kind and quantity of ammunition.
koap-u0db06b0449201b0b45-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u815c12554f40a1934d-1.text: 7. The seizure record shall contain an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording documents. Materials obtained during seizure using photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be attached to the relevant record.
koap-u815c12554f40a1934d-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u9cc585cbfab79aba92-1.text: 8. The seizure record shall be signed by the official who drew it up, the person from whom things and documents were seized, except where that person is outside the Russian Federation and their signature cannot be obtained under part 10 of Article 24.9 of this Code, and attesting witnesses if they participated. If the person from whom things and documents were seized refuses to sign, or is outside the Russian Federation and their signature cannot be obtained under part 10 of Article 24.9 of this Code, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record. A copy shall be given to the person from whom things and documents were seized or their legal representative.
koap-u9cc585cbfab79aba92-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u4ad2c0bf573391ecd3-1.text: 9. Where necessary, things and documents seized shall be packaged and sealed at the place of seizure. Until consideration of the administrative offence case, they shall be stored at places determined by the person who seized them, in accordance with the procedure established by the relevant federal executive body.
koap-u4ad2c0bf573391ecd3-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u842c44269241bcc356-1.text: 10. Firearms and ammunition for them, other weapons and munitions seized shall be stored in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation on weapons.
koap-u842c44269241bcc356-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u858e80270baa736ff7-1.text: 11. Perishable things seized shall, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be handed over to the relevant organisations for sale or, where sale is impossible, destroyed.
koap-u858e80270baa736ff7-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u31780ba64ec9a5f7fd-1.text: 12. Narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances seized shall be sent for processing or destruction in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products subject to destruction shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-u31780ba64ec9a5f7fd-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-uaf02f93500144ae61b-1.text: 13. Ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products withdrawn from unlawful circulation under legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products and on restricting consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products, and items used for the unlawful production and/or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of that ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products and those items shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-uaf02f93500144ae61b-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u4cca63dfca95ae656b-1.text: 14. Timber and/or products derived from it in the form of unprocessed timber, seized during proceedings in administrative offence cases under Article 8.28 of this Code, shall be transferred for storage, sale, recycling or destruction in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. The procedure and conditions for storing, selling, recycling or destroying such timber and/or derived products in the form of unprocessed timber shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-u4cca63dfca95ae656b-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-u8c6b63ac448ccc3cc8-1.text: 15. Tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production withdrawn from unlawful circulation under legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for their production, and items used for unlawful production and/or circulation of those articles and products, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of those products, items and raw materials shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-u8c6b63ac448ccc3cc8-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents

koap-ubb348d68b1bc5c61e3-1.text: 16. Methanol and methanol-containing liquids seized under legislation on state regulation of their circulation, and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of that methanol and those methanol-containing liquids shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-ubb348d68b1bc5c61e3-1.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
