koap-u3cfb9de5e588a4ee0d-1.text: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
koap-u3cfb9de5e588a4ee0d-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-u369bb4ec4430376806-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
koap-u369bb4ec4430376806-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-ud6f6d05c3ac340adfd-1.text: 1. Things seized shall be valued if:
koap-ud6f6d05c3ac340adfd-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-u667eff07b70bf80622-1.text: the provision establishing liability for the administrative offence prescribes an administrative fine calculated as a multiple of the value of the things seized;
koap-u667eff07b70bf80622-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-ue8a80d0fdc247ab3e9-1.text: the things seized are perishable and are being sent for sale or destruction;
koap-ue8a80d0fdc247ab3e9-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-ubf3ed7502bd1d614d9-1.text: ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products withdrawn from circulation under legislation of the Russian Federation are subject to destruction;
koap-ubf3ed7502bd1d614d9-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-ue701038f1aca1ece5f-1.text: timber and/or derived products in the form of unprocessed timber seized during proceedings in administrative offence cases under Article 8.28 of this Code are transferred for storage, sale, recycling or destruction.
koap-ue701038f1aca1ece5f-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-u1ec0098eac583001f9-1.text: 2. The value of things seized shall be determined using state-regulated prices where such prices are established. In other cases, their market value shall be used, except for seized goods for personal use carried by individuals across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union, for which the customs value determined under Chapter 37 of the Customs Code of the Eurasian Economic Union shall be used. Where necessary, the value of things seized shall be determined on the basis of an expert opinion.
koap-u1ec0098eac583001f9-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-u7d0503e0307d8feaf3-1.text: 3. Foreign currency seized as the object of an administrative offence shall be converted into the currency of the Russian Federation at the Central Bank of the Russian Federation exchange rate in force on the day the administrative offence was committed.
koap-u7d0503e0307d8feaf3-1.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized

koap-ud37fb972b064bedcd9-1.text: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
koap-ud37fb972b064bedcd9-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u7e2de4172d9e3a7e64-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
koap-u7e2de4172d9e3a7e64-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-ua6c166abcd47268a1b-1.text: 1. A person driving a vehicle of the relevant type in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, and persons who have committed administrative offences under parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.8, part 1 of Article 11.8.1, part 1 of Article 12.3, part 2 of Article 12.5 and parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.7 of this Code, shall be removed from driving until the reason for removal is eliminated.
koap-ua6c166abcd47268a1b-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-ua7982eada749f9daf6-1.text: 1.1. A person driving a vehicle of the relevant type in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, or a person in respect of whom a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case under Article 12.24 of this Code has been issued, shall undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication under part 6 of this Article. If the person refuses that examination or disagrees with its results, or if there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated despite a negative alcohol intoxication examination result, they shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication.
koap-ua7982eada749f9daf6-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-ud9e43492b5fd104a83-1.text: 2. Removal from driving a vehicle of the relevant type, examination for alcohol intoxication and referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be carried out by officials authorised to exercise state supervision and control over traffic safety and safe operation of the relevant vehicle type; for drivers of vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, they may also be carried out by military motor vehicle inspectorate officials. All these actions shall be carried out in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-ud9e43492b5fd104a83-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u7a68d850bc14df4589-1.text: 3. A record of removal from driving shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry specifying the date, time, place and grounds for removal, the position, surname and initials of the person applying that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case, and information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure, shall be made in the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication, the vehicle impoundment record, the administrative offence record, the procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or the ruling in the case, where those procedural documents lack that information. A copy of the removal-from-driving record shall be given to the person subject to the measure.
koap-u7a68d850bc14df4589-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u31602d89c2c6b35002-1.text: 3.1. Referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be recorded in a record, a copy of which shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
koap-u31602d89c2c6b35002-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u2226cfdd85e0a8b263-1.text: 4. The removal-from-driving record and the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for removal or referral, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing up the record, and information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
koap-u2226cfdd85e0a8b263-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u5607b3f9a552b4c1da-1.text: 5. The removal-from-driving record and the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be signed by the official drawing them up and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
koap-u5607b3f9a552b4c1da-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u64c52473300def3473-1.text: If the person subject to that measure refuses to sign the relevant record, a corresponding entry shall be made in it.
koap-u64c52473300def3473-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u096b5a8932a125af78-1.text: 6. Examination for alcohol intoxication, documentation of its results and referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u096b5a8932a125af78-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-uefb5ae17a9ebbc3c8d-1.text: 6.1. The criteria providing sufficient grounds to believe that a person is intoxicated and must be referred for a medical examination, and the procedure for conducting a medical examination for intoxication, shall be established by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal governance in healthcare.
koap-uefb5ae17a9ebbc3c8d-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u7899e15a557d075e0d-1.text: 7. The alcohol intoxication examination certificate or medical examination certificate shall be attached to the relevant record, procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or ruling in the case. Copies of the alcohol intoxication examination certificate and/or medical examination certificate shall be given to the person in respect of whom they were drawn up.
koap-u7899e15a557d075e0d-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u8490ccade0be93504e-1.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 169-FZ.
koap-u8490ccade0be93504e-1.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication

koap-u76feb89542dd57d85a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication

koap-u161c0fabbdd7e6fe9a-1.text: 1. Persons who have committed administrative offences, other than those referred to in parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 27.12 of this Code, and in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication.

koap-uebad74e4e3711f5fc1-1.text: 2. The persons referred to in part 1 of this Article shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records under Article 28.3 of this Code.

koap-u61a49a6fa40e822b5f-1.text: 3. A record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be drawn up, a copy of which shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.

koap-ude3d97443986c79282-1.text: 4. The referral record shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for referral, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, and information about the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.

koap-u58485ab21050d4ff5f-1.text: 5. The referral record shall be signed by the official drawing it up and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case. If that person refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record.

koap-u9688ca07338c30fef4-1.text: 6. The criteria providing sufficient grounds to believe that a person is intoxicated and must be referred for a medical examination, and the procedure for conducting a medical examination for intoxication, shall be established by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal governance in healthcare.

koap-u1df49e87bd43fcc7b4-1.text: 7. The medical examination certificate shall be attached to the relevant record. A copy shall be given to the person in respect of whom it was drawn up.

koap-u7ebbc21365953f2ce9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle

koap-ue97c77465d5f424f70-1.text: 1. To stop violations of the rules for operating, using and driving vehicles of the relevant type under parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.8, part 1 of Article 11.8.1, Articles 11.9, 11.26 and 11.29, part 4 of Article 11.33, part 1 of Article 12.3, part 2 of Article 12.5, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.7, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.8, parts 4 and 5 of Article 12.16 (as regards failure to comply with no-stopping or no-parking signs used together with an additional-information plate indicating that vehicles are impounded within the signs’ area of operation), parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 12.19, parts 1, 4 - 6 and 12 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2, parts 1 - 4 of Article 12.21.5, Article 12.26, part 3 of Article 12.27 and part 2 of Article 14.38 of this Code, a vehicle shall be impounded, meaning its removal from the carriage of passengers and goods by transporting it using another vehicle to the nearest specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area), and stored there until the reason for impoundment is eliminated; for violations under Articles 11.26 and 11.29 of this Code, it shall also be held until the administrative fine is paid if the vehicle used to commit the violation is leaving the Russian Federation. If, because of its technical characteristics, the vehicle cannot be transported to and placed in a specialised parking area in the event of an administrative offence under parts 1, 4 - 6 and 12 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2 or parts 1 - 4 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code, it shall be impounded by immobilisation using blocking devices. If a vehicle in respect of which an impoundment decision has been made would obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians, its driver or the persons specified in part 3 of this Article may, before impoundment begins, drive it to the nearest place where it will not cause such obstruction. For administrative offences under Articles 11.26 and 11.29, part 4 of Article 11.33 and part 1 of Article 20.25 (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code, impoundment may be carried out by the driver of the impounded vehicle or the persons specified in part 3 of this Article moving it to the nearest specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area), or by immobilisation using blocking devices. For an administrative offence under part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state), impoundment shall last until the administrative fine is paid.

koap-u77369b694e8d37e4e5-1.text: 1.1. Impoundment shall be terminated directly at the place of impoundment in the presence of a person entitled to drive the vehicle under the Road Traffic Rules if the reason for impoundment is eliminated before the vehicle intended to transport the impounded vehicle to the specialised parking area starts moving.

koap-u9629fee62c0775383f-1.text: 3. A decision to impound a vehicle of the relevant type, terminate impoundment or return the vehicle shall be made by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant administrative offences; for vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, it may also be made by military motor vehicle inspectorate officials. Those officials shall draw up an impoundment record or enter the impoundment in the administrative offence record, procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or ruling in the case, where those procedural documents lack the following information: the date, time, place and grounds for the impoundment decision; the position, surname and initials of the person applying that measure securing proceedings; information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure; and the name of the body (institution, organisation), position, surname, first name and patronymic (if any) of the person who will execute the impoundment decision. Those officials shall then remain at the place of impoundment until the vehicle intended to transport the impounded vehicle to the specialised parking area starts moving.

koap-u2823ba3954a1ce6556-1.text: 4. The impoundment record shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for the impoundment decision, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing up the record, information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings, and the name of the body (institution, organisation), position, surname, first name and patronymic of the person who will execute the impoundment decision.

koap-u7290706e74a6a7ef6c-1.text: 5. The impoundment record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.

koap-uc836d5f090ecf33e05-1.text: 6. If the person whose vehicle is impounded refuses to sign the record, a corresponding entry shall be made in it.

koap-u08dcc1d7da2a989548-1.text: 7. A copy of the vehicle impoundment record shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings and to the person who will execute the impoundment decision.

koap-u8ac0010b8bd11f0f3f-1.text: 8. An impoundment record drawn up in the driver’s absence shall be prepared in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording. A copy of that record, together with the official’s decision to return the impounded vehicle, shall be given to its possessor, the possessor’s representative or a person carrying the documents necessary to drive it, immediately after the reason for impoundment is eliminated.

koap-ue5fcc759c94c7f60f9-1.text: 9. Transport of vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks to a specialised parking area, their storage, payment of transport and storage costs and their return shall be governed by the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.

koap-uf0fcd81e3faabc4412-1.text: 10. Transport of vehicles other than those specified in part 9 of this Article to a specialised parking area, their storage and return to possessors, possessors’ representatives or persons carrying the documents necessary to drive them, and payment of transport and storage costs by persons held administratively liable for offences resulting in impoundment shall be governed by the procedure established by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. Impounded vehicles shall be returned to possessors, their representatives or persons carrying the necessary driving documents immediately after the reason for impoundment is eliminated.

koap-u7b2db63e1b98b540ea-1.text: 11. Except in the cases specified in part 9 of this Article, a person held administratively liable for an offence resulting in impoundment shall pay the transport and storage costs within the time limits and at the rates set by the authorised executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with methodological guidelines approved by the authorised federal executive body responsible for adopting regulatory legal acts and monitoring compliance with legislation on state regulation of prices (tariffs) for goods (services). The person’s duty to pay the transport and storage costs shall be reflected in the ruling imposing an administrative penalty.

koap-ue3a5bb1cfc85f36df5-1.text: 12. Where proceedings in an administrative offence case are terminated on the grounds provided for by point 1, point 2 (other than where an individual had not attained the age for administrative liability under this Code at the time of the unlawful action or omission, or the case materials are referred to a prosecutor, preliminary investigation body or inquiry body because the unlawful action or omission contains indications of a crime), or points 3, 8, 8.1 and 9 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, the transport and storage costs shall be charged to the federal budget, or, where the case was handled by an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to that constituent entity’s budget. If proceedings are terminated on other grounds, the person who committed the unlawful action or omission resulting in impoundment, their parents or other legal representatives shall bear the transport and storage costs. The decision to charge those costs to the federal budget or the budget of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or to impose the duty to pay them on the person who committed the unlawful action or omission resulting in impoundment, their parents or other legal representatives, shall be reflected in the ruling terminating proceedings.

koap-ub134b3f6c5defaf496-1.text: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
koap-ub134b3f6c5defaf496-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-ue8e22fda5d06b740d6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
koap-ue8e22fda5d06b740d6-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u19caa8908d88a5b7f4-1.text: 1. A vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation by the officials specified in points 8 and 10.1 of part 1 of Article 27.2 of this Code may be detained to establish the circumstances of an administrative offence and ensure proper and timely consideration of a case concerning an offence for which administrative liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code.
koap-u19caa8908d88a5b7f4-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-uac847ff425f84bbc12-1.text: 2. A vessel shall be detained by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant administrative offences.
koap-uac847ff425f84bbc12-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-uaf4316e76e333980af-1.text: 3. A vessel detention record shall be drawn up. A copy shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
koap-uaf4316e76e333980af-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-udaeefab019e11fa6be-1.text: 4. The period of vessel detention shall run from the moment the detention record is drawn up and may not exceed 72 hours. Upon expiry, the vessel shall be released or placed under attachment in accordance with Article 27.14.1 of this Code.
koap-udaeefab019e11fa6be-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u86300ced2082ea76d4-1.text: 5. In the event of detention of a foreign vessel, the federal executive body responsible for foreign affairs shall immediately notify the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the vessel’s flag state in the Russian Federation.
koap-u86300ced2082ea76d4-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-uae1aa918516574d7ef-1.text: 6. The procedure for storage, upkeep, safe berthing and return of detained vessels, and reimbursement to port infrastructure possessors of expenses associated with storage of the vessel and provision for its crew’s subsistence, shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-uae1aa918516574d7ef-1.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u5b30dfa22b402e7c69-1.text: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
koap-u5b30dfa22b402e7c69-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u29a821f20896f2e739-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things
koap-u29a821f20896f2e739-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-uf8efc66a53dc3122e8-1.text: 1. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things used as instruments to commit an administrative offence or constituting its objects consists in drawing up an inventory and informing the person subject to that measure securing proceedings, or their legal representative, that disposal of those things (and, where necessary, their use) is prohibited. It shall be applied where seizure is impossible and/or preservation can be ensured without seizure. Things under attachment may be placed in the responsible custody of other persons designated by the official imposing attachment.
koap-uf8efc66a53dc3122e8-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-ud828e20d0e23e6ae29-1.text: 2. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things shall be carried out by the officials specified in Article 27.3 and part 2 of Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of the possessor and either in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-ud828e20d0e23e6ae29-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u60696647292ccd3837-1.text: In urgent cases, things may be placed under attachment in their possessor’s absence.
koap-u60696647292ccd3837-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u62479cc1e7f9e78157-2.text: 3. Where necessary, photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence shall be used.
koap-u62479cc1e7f9e78157-2.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-udd93c3e88aa9b7f2a8-1.text: 4. An attachment record shall be drawn up specifying the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, information about the person subject to the measure securing proceedings and the person possessing the goods, vehicles and other things attached, their inventory and identifying characteristics, and an entry on the use of photography, cinematography and other prescribed methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during attachment using those methods shall be attached to the record.
koap-udd93c3e88aa9b7f2a8-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-uc299c474b3fa10edc1-1.text: 5. Where necessary, goods, vehicles and other things under attachment shall be packaged and/or sealed.
koap-uc299c474b3fa10edc1-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u359f4a0f263afd5ff5-1.text: 6. A copy of the attachment record shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case or their legal representative.
koap-u359f4a0f263afd5ff5-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u083103852e1d5c62f3-1.text: 7. If goods, vehicles or other things under attachment are alienated or concealed, the person subject to that measure securing proceedings or the custodian shall be liable under legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u083103852e1d5c62f3-1.locator: Article 27.14. Attachment of goods, vehicles and other things

koap-u506d8bdb1fa4f0c0e8-1.text: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
koap-u506d8bdb1fa4f0c0e8-1.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u43f1333e1a5da5b3f7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
koap-u43f1333e1a5da5b3f7-1.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u0731856c21f99f55f4-1.text: 1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation by the officials specified in points 8 and 10.1 of part 1 of Article 27.2 of this Code shall be carried out under Article 27.14 of this Code, taking into account this Article.
koap-u0731856c21f99f55f4-1.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-ubccb6d35f610b280f2-1.text: 2. The procedure for storage, upkeep, safe berthing and return of vessels under attachment, and reimbursement to port infrastructure possessors of expenses associated with storage of the vessel and provision for its crew’s subsistence, shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-ubccb6d35f610b280f2-1.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-u9e44d72e596dc5a45c-1.text: 3. A vessel used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code shall be released immediately after security is deposited under Article 27.18 of this Code.
koap-u9e44d72e596dc5a45c-1.locator: Article 27.14.1. Attachment of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation

koap-uc4e9d79fd636bca20b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.15. Compulsory appearance

koap-ub878e63e61a154618a-1.text: 1. In the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 29.4 and point 8 of part 1 of Article 29.7 of this Code, compulsory appearance shall be applied to an individual or the legal representative of a legal entity against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are conducted, the legal representative of a minor being held administratively liable, or a witness.

koap-uf8658bdd3951d9ae46-1.text: 2. Compulsory appearance shall be carried out:

koap-u12267eabd6e5f512ee-1.text: 1) by the body authorised to enforce enforcement documents and maintain the established order of court activities, on the basis of a procedural order by the judge or a ruling by an official of that body considering the administrative offence case, in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive body responsible for regulatory legal governance of maintaining the established order of court activities and enforcement of judicial acts and acts of other bodies;

koap-u3c6e0a3ebb618a175a-1.text: 2) by an internal affairs body (police), on the basis of a procedural order by that body, another body or an official considering the administrative offence case, in accordance with the procedure established by the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs.

koap-ua3f4aef611ee370113-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.16. Temporary prohibition of activity

koap-udb67e94c5632b8ae33-1.text: 1. Temporary prohibition of activity consists in a short-term cessation, until the case is considered by a court or the officials specified in points 1 and 4 of part 2 of Article 23.31 of this Code, of the activities of branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular activities (works), or the provision of services. It may be applied if the administrative offence may be punished by administrative suspension of activity. It may be applied only in exceptional cases where necessary to prevent an immediate threat to human life or health, an epidemic, an epizootic, infestation (contamination) of objects subject to quarantine by quarantine pests, a radiation accident or an industrial disaster, or substantial harm to the condition or quality of the environment; to eliminate violations consisting in unlawful employment of a foreign citizen or stateless person in the Russian Federation, non-compliance with restrictions on particular activities imposed under federal law on foreign citizens, stateless persons and foreign organisations, violation of the rules for engaging foreign citizens and stateless persons in work at retail markets, or repeated failure to use cash register equipment where required by federal laws; or to prevent further unlawful provision of consumer credits (loans), including those for which the borrower’s obligations are secured by a mortgage; and where those circumstances cannot be prevented by other means.

koap-udb33a3ad5b54d242f3-1.text: Temporary prohibition of activity shall not apply to violations of legislation of the Russian Federation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of criminal proceeds and terrorist financing. Transactions on the accounts of an organisation conducting transactions with money or other property shall be suspended under that legislation.

koap-ua1a701ca8393f8751b-1.text: 2. Temporary prohibition of activity shall be imposed by an official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up a record of an administrative offence punishable by administrative suspension of activity.

koap-u736c5022c281f41053-1.text: 3. A temporary prohibition record shall be drawn up specifying the grounds for applying that measure securing proceedings, the date and place of preparation, the position, surname and initials of the official drawing it up, information about the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are conducted, the activity object subject to the prohibition, the time activity actually ceased, and explanations of the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity.

koap-u30c42030d708f0448e-1.text: 4. The temporary prohibition record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity. If any of those persons does not sign, the official shall make a corresponding entry in the record.

koap-ucf990eb3f3faf6d119-1.text: 5. A copy of the temporary prohibition record shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal representative of the legal entity.

koap-uc35177f5e4a4809791-1.text: 6. When temporarily prohibiting activity, the official who drew up the record shall apply seals, seal premises, storage places for goods and other material valuables and cash offices, and take other measures to ensure that the legal entity’s official, the person conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity’s legal representative implements the measures specified in the record that are necessary for the temporary prohibition of activity.

koap-ue600683b070da4424e-1.text: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
koap-ue600683b070da4424e-1.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity

koap-u4ff2804d92f10e9c9d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity
koap-u4ff2804d92f10e9c9d-1.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity

koap-u93829af7441569c32e-1.text: 1. Repealed from 1 January 2011. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 171-FZ.
koap-u93829af7441569c32e-1.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity

koap-u6931164f505eda720f-1.text: 2. The period of temporary prohibition of activity shall run from the actual cessation of the activities of branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, the operation of machinery, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of particular activities (works), or the provision of services.
koap-u6931164f505eda720f-1.locator: Article 27.17. Period of temporary prohibition of activity

koap-u086c94853e16cbc6e1-1.text: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
koap-u086c94853e16cbc6e1-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u22899100dcbf7b7b86-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment
koap-u22899100dcbf7b7b86-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u3da561a87ed4959f8e-1.text: 1. Security for a vessel under attachment consists in the deposit of money with the court selecting that measure securing proceedings by the individual or legal entity against whom a case has been initiated concerning an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, the shipowner, the insurer or the competent authority of the vessel’s flag state.
koap-u3da561a87ed4959f8e-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u97d1cdf8e462780ef4-1.text: 2. Security may be applied to Russian and foreign vessels registered in the Russian Federation or a foreign state and used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code.
koap-u97d1cdf8e462780ef4-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u5d015591d2b14da815-1.text: 3. Security shall be mandatory for foreign vessels used as an instrument to commit an administrative offence on the continental shelf and/or in the exclusive economic zone of the Russian Federation for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, upon a motion by any person referred to in part 1 of this Article.
koap-u5d015591d2b14da815-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u1588aceebaed1068ee-1.text: 4. A written motion for security for a vessel under attachment shall be sent to the court or official handling the administrative offence case. On receiving it, the official shall immediately, or within three days if further clarification of the circumstances is necessary, send the motion and all case materials to the court authorised to consider the administrative offence case.
koap-u1588aceebaed1068ee-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u94f767004c5e89faef-1.text: 5. The court shall decide whether to apply security and determine its amount within no more than ten days from receiving the motion referred to in part 4 of this Article from any person referred to in part 1 of this Article. Where such a motion is received from participants in the proceedings or further clarification of the case circumstances is necessary, except in the cases referred to in part 3 of this Article, the decision period may be extended by no more than fifteen days.
koap-u94f767004c5e89faef-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-ua4991ae4e737fd6d06-1.text: 6. The amount of security shall be determined by the court taking into account the administrative fine specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code and/or the following amounts determined on the basis of an expert opinion: the value of the vessel and other instruments used to commit the offence and/or the amount of damage caused by the administrative offence. The circumstances specified in parts 2 and 3 of Article 4.1 of this Code shall be taken into account.
koap-ua4991ae4e737fd6d06-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u412996a48fb85a058c-1.text: 7. The amount of security may not be less than the damage caused by the administrative offence and the maximum administrative fine specified in the sanction of the applicable article of the Special Part of this Code.
koap-u412996a48fb85a058c-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u0b203eb113fdc1a9cd-1.text: 8. The judge’s decision to apply security shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
koap-u0b203eb113fdc1a9cd-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u5aee313cabba0fe104-1.text: 9. Copies of the order applying security shall be given to the official handling the administrative offence case, the person depositing security or their legal representative, the individual or legal entity against whom proceedings are conducted, the legal representative of that legal entity or defence counsel. The procedure for returning security and forfeiting it to the state shall be explained to the person depositing it or their legal representative.
koap-u5aee313cabba0fe104-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-ub4abd28cb0f6c6db8b-1.text: 10. Money constituting security shall be paid into the deposit account of the court selecting that measure securing proceedings. The court shall draw up a record of acceptance of security, a copy of which shall be given to the person depositing it.
koap-ub4abd28cb0f6c6db8b-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-uab41c89bee05c74233-1.text: 11. The federal executive body responsible for foreign affairs shall immediately notify the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the foreign vessel’s flag state in the Russian Federation of the application of security.
koap-uab41c89bee05c74233-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-u65add24fe7c22c09b3-1.text: 12. If a vessel for which security has been applied as a measure securing proceedings is used to commit an administrative offence for which liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code, that security shall be forfeited to the state by court decision.
koap-u65add24fe7c22c09b3-1.locator: Article 27.18. Security for a vessel under attachment

koap-uab0da61baefb480539-1.text: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
koap-uab0da61baefb480539-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u73e80ddaecf3c4287a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation
koap-u73e80ddaecf3c4287a-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ue4740bf00e95c0ab0c-1.text: 1. Placement of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions consists in escorting them to the special institutions provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”, or to specially designated premises of border authorities, and temporarily holding them in such special institutions until compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, revocation of the administrative expulsion ruling, or amendment of that ruling in the cases provided for by part 1 of Article 30.7 of this Code.
koap-ue4740bf00e95c0ab0c-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u17e7f4216c5eabfc87-1.text: 2. Holding foreign citizens or stateless persons in special institutions under conditions preventing unauthorised departure shall be applied to ensure enforcement of the ruling imposing compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation issued by the judge or official who considered the administrative offence case, or a decision by a border authority official concerning those persons for administrative offences in the field of protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation.
koap-u17e7f4216c5eabfc87-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u582e07294c0a64c69f-1.text: 3. A foreign citizen or stateless person shall be placed in a special institution provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation” on the basis of a decision by the head or deputy head of the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, the head or deputy head of its territorial body, the head or deputy head of the federal executive body responsible for security, or the head or deputy head of a border authority, for a period not exceeding 48 hours, or on the basis of a judge’s ruling.
koap-u582e07294c0a64c69f-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ufc476fca32bfd22653-1.text: 3.1. The period specified in part 3 of this Article may be extended by a judge upon a motion by an authorised official of an internal affairs body or an executive body responsible for security, for the period provided for by part 1 of Article 27.19.1 of this Code.
koap-ufc476fca32bfd22653-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-uc2fad1eeaaae41a624-1.text: 3.2. The motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution, provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, shall be submitted to the court at the location of that institution within 48 hours from placement of the foreign citizen or stateless person in it.
koap-uc2fad1eeaaae41a624-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u216e8152bff21e4acc-1.text: 3.3. The motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article shall be accompanied by documents confirming the circumstances stated in it.
koap-u216e8152bff21e4acc-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u11f23cd64aedda1467-1.text: 3.4. Upon receiving the motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, the judge shall immediately issue a procedural order setting the time and place of its consideration and decide whether to extend the person’s stay in the special institution for the time necessary to consider the motion.
koap-u11f23cd64aedda1467-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ua82351c00f45a380da-1.text: 3.5. The motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt.
koap-ua82351c00f45a380da-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u5ef5bd0ce0bd5ce1fe-1.text: 3.6. In preparation for considering the motion provided for by part 3.1 of this Article, matters shall be resolved on which, where necessary, one of the following procedural orders shall be issued:
koap-u5ef5bd0ce0bd5ce1fe-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u134eefe5913de3b07d-1.text: 1) summoning the foreign citizen or stateless person in respect of whom the motion has been submitted;
koap-u134eefe5913de3b07d-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u0bf688047bdcd34b12-1.text: 2) summoning the authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion;
koap-u0bf688047bdcd34b12-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ufbf434e17df13daa90-1.text: 3) requisitioning, under Article 26.10 of this Code, materials (information) necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration and resolution of the question of extending the person’s stay in the special institution.
koap-ufbf434e17df13daa90-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ue5be96b64db927df37-1.text: 3.7. Following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution, the judge shall issue a procedural order specifying one of the following decisions:
koap-ue5be96b64db927df37-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ua40003a2364fcc4dab-1.text: 1) to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person in the special institution;
koap-ua40003a2364fcc4dab-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ub2bfb833ec2ee96f7f-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u64d3f2ec25fa01d76c-1.text: 3.8. A judge’s decision to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution shall take the form of a procedural order specifying the particular period of stay.
koap-u64d3f2ec25fa01d76c-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u7e23b9752c00e9b98c-1.text: 3.9. At a court hearing, the motion shall be considered with the participation of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion, their legal representatives and/or defence counsel, and the person who submitted the motion, if the judge declares those persons’ presence at the hearing mandatory.
koap-u7e23b9752c00e9b98c-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-ub13b7208064b602d54-1.text: 3.10. Failure to appear at the court hearing by the duly notified authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion shall not prevent its consideration and resolution where documents confirming the circumstances stated in the motion are available.
koap-ub13b7208064b602d54-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u1c6d45d47e02c0f211-1.text: 3.11. A copy of the judge’s order referred to in part 3.7 of this Article shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued (their legal representative), or sent to that person by registered mail on the day it is issued. A copy of the judge’s order referred to in part 3.7 of this Article shall also be sent on that day to the authorised official of the internal affairs body or executive body responsible for security who submitted the motion to extend the period of stay.
koap-u1c6d45d47e02c0f211-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u3cac2f628d924985aa-1.text: 3.12. The judge’s decision following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
koap-u3cac2f628d924985aa-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u3ecc9c4152d9b297eb-1.text: 3.13. Further extension of the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in a special institution shall be carried out under Article 27.19.1 of this Code.
koap-u3ecc9c4152d9b297eb-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u93317b36879342bef5-1.text: 4. A foreign citizen or stateless person who has committed an administrative offence concerning protection of the State Border of the Russian Federation shall be placed in specially designated premises of a border authority on the basis of a judge’s ruling or a decision of the relevant border authority official.
koap-u93317b36879342bef5-1.locator: Article 27.19. Placement in special institutions of foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation

koap-u37a54bb939ce1299ef-1.text: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
koap-u37a54bb939ce1299ef-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u9c43e858257a8c674e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions
koap-u9c43e858257a8c674e-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u306d6cf3c15127337e-1.text: 1. The period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation in a special institution provided for by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation” shall not exceed ninety days, except where extended under part 2 of this Article.
koap-u306d6cf3c15127337e-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-uf08e5f9c61a36aac6e-1.text: 2. If there is no practical possibility of enforcing the ruling imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation on a foreign citizen or stateless person within the period specified in part 1 of this Article, a judge may, upon a motion by the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case or an authorised internal affairs official, extend the period for holding that person in a special institution by no more than ninety days.
koap-uf08e5f9c61a36aac6e-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-ue12b42cf42541246b5-1.text: 3. A motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall be submitted to the court at the institution’s location no later than fifteen days before expiry of the period established by the judge’s ruling referred to in part 3 of Article 27.19 of this Code. It shall state why extension is necessary and the period by which the stay should be extended.
koap-ue12b42cf42541246b5-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u501e414c4a0fc5d466-1.text: 4. The motion shall be accompanied by documents confirming the circumstances stated in it. If the person subject to administrative expulsion has no identity document, the motion shall be accompanied by an internal affairs body’s identity-establishment report prepared under federal law.
koap-u501e414c4a0fc5d466-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u6c061e67487c9961bb-1.text: 5. Within one day from receiving the motion, the judge shall issue a procedural order setting its time and place of consideration and extending the persons’ stay in the special institution for the time necessary to consider it.
koap-u6c061e67487c9961bb-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-ue143cb9f9d55bb4087-1.text: 6. The motion shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt.
koap-ue143cb9f9d55bb4087-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-uf62000353e6e6fdba8-1.text: 7. In preparation for considering the motion, matters shall be resolved on which, where necessary, one of the following procedural orders shall be issued:
koap-uf62000353e6e6fdba8-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-ucf51688e7e4f6a4a59-1.text: 1) summoning the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in respect of whom the motion to extend their stay in the special institution has been submitted;
koap-ucf51688e7e4f6a4a59-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u4dd96b209886ca66b6-1.text: 2) summoning the person who submitted to the court the motion to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in the special institution, whether the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case or the authorised internal affairs official;
koap-u4dd96b209886ca66b6-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u7fe49a265b4ee82bb5-1.text: 3) requisitioning, under Article 26.10 of this Code, materials (information) necessary to ensure proper and timely consideration and resolution of the question of extending the stay of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in the special institution.
koap-u7fe49a265b4ee82bb5-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u968dc6b8a6a9aec37e-1.text: 8. Following consideration of the motion, the judge shall issue a procedural order specifying one of the following decisions:
koap-u968dc6b8a6a9aec37e-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u52555576447e717b5b-1.text: 1) to extend the period for holding the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion in the special institution;
koap-u52555576447e717b5b-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u77361a174bf6fd44ad-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-uab60ec4b597c3f76e6-1.text: 9. The judge’s decision extending the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall take the form of a procedural order specifying the particular period of stay, not exceeding ninety days.
koap-uab60ec4b597c3f76e6-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u1bb430cc3661c863fb-1.text: 10. At a court hearing, the motion shall be considered with the participation of the foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion, their legal representatives and/or defence counsel, and the person who submitted the motion, if the judge declares those persons’ presence at the hearing mandatory.
koap-u1bb430cc3661c863fb-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u0cc444f092129bd689-1.text: 11. Failure to appear at the court hearing by the authorised internal affairs official who submitted the motion or by the enforcement bailiff executing the ruling in the administrative offence case, provided that the person failing to appear has been duly notified, shall not prevent consideration and resolution of the motion where documents confirming the circumstances stated in it are available.
koap-u0cc444f092129bd689-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-uad09a239f54e6f152d-1.text: 12. A copy of the judge’s order extending the stay shall be handed against a signed receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued (their legal representative), or sent to those persons by registered mail or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, under the procedure and in the cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, on the day the order is issued.
koap-uad09a239f54e6f152d-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u6151dba4c63955ec5e-1.text: 13. A copy of the judge’s order extending the stay shall be sent on the day it is issued to the enforcement bailiff and authorised internal affairs official who submitted the relevant motion.
koap-u6151dba4c63955ec5e-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-uc6fadc27f14e9e9646-1.text: 14. The judge’s decision following consideration of the motion to extend the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to administrative expulsion in a special institution may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
koap-uc6fadc27f14e9e9646-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u334a75c48ffafdeb7c-1.text: 15. Further extension of the period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall be carried out under this Article.
koap-u334a75c48ffafdeb7c-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u56ce69baed1184633f-1.text: 16. The period for holding a foreign citizen or stateless person subject to compulsory expulsion in a special institution shall run from the day the administrative expulsion ruling is issued, or, where the stay is extended, from the day the judge issues the procedural order extending it.
koap-u56ce69baed1184633f-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u2446d0bb933a6e16cd-1.text: 17. Before compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, a foreign citizen or stateless person placed in a special institution as a measure securing proceedings for the purpose of compulsory expulsion may, where circumstances indicate that there is no practical possibility of expulsion, but no earlier than one month after the ruling imposing that penalty enters into legal force under this Code, apply to a court to review the lawfulness and justification of continued detention in the special institution.
koap-u2446d0bb933a6e16cd-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-u8fefa3d2cb47a4ac67-1.text: 18. The motion shall be submitted to the court at the location of the special institution where the foreign citizen or stateless person is held and considered by a judge within five days from receipt. The judge shall issue a procedural order granting the motion and terminating the person’s detention in the special institution or refusing the motion.
koap-u8fefa3d2cb47a4ac67-1.locator: Article 27.19.1. Periods for holding foreign citizens or stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in special institutions

koap-ucbe0846dada1880001-1.text: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-ucbe0846dada1880001-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u36ac15b3fcbcb1ad85-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u36ac15b3fcbcb1ad85-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u7ebbfd46ceaa18e085-1.text: 1. To secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code, or for an offence committed outside the Russian Federation under Article 13.14.1 or 13.15, part 2 of Article 13.36, part 2 of Article 13.37, Article 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an offence consisting in failure to pay within the period specified by this Code an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, attachment shall be applied to property of the person against whom proceedings in the relevant case are conducted.
koap-u7ebbfd46ceaa18e085-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ud2c94005feb51bff96-1.text: 2. The value of property attached to secure enforcement of a penalty ruling for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code shall not exceed the maximum administrative fine for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or the relevant part of Article 19.28 of this Code. For another offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the value of property attached shall not be limited by the administrative fine prescribed for that offence.
koap-ud2c94005feb51bff96-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ud58042db9385152985-1.text: 3. Attachment consists in prohibiting the person against whom proceedings are conducted for an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article from disposing of the attached property and, where necessary, imposing restrictions on possession and use of it.
koap-ud58042db9385152985-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u31225c50b53b3e32c7-1.text: 4. To secure enforcement of a penalty ruling for an offence under Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code, money in deposits and accounts at banks or other credit institutions shall be attached where the legal entity has no other property. For another offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, money in deposits and accounts at banks or other credit institutions shall be attached, and other property shall be attached if the person has no such money.
koap-u31225c50b53b3e32c7-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u5f2faa3d290a883825-1.text: 5. The judge handling a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article shall decide on attachment on the basis of a reasoned motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate such a case, received together with the ruling initiating the case or the administrative offence record. The judge shall specify the particular factual circumstances supporting the decision and impose restrictions on disposal of the attached property and, where necessary, on possession and use of it.
koap-u5f2faa3d290a883825-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u5ee7df14f85b7168a3-1.text: 6. Where an administrative investigation is conducted, the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article may submit an attachment motion to the court simultaneously with issuing, under part 2 of Article 28.7 of this Code, the ruling initiating the case and conducting an administrative investigation.
koap-u5ee7df14f85b7168a3-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u2286444f702699c963-1.text: 7. The motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, provided for by parts 5 and 6 of this Article, shall be considered by a judge no later than the day following its receipt by the court, without notifying the prosecutor or authorised person or the person against whom proceedings are conducted.
koap-u2286444f702699c963-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ubae3d7aeff66006228-1.text: 8. The judge’s decision granting or refusing an attachment motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
koap-ubae3d7aeff66006228-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u3943b6fc36aa9c888c-1.text: 9. If the judge issues an attachment order, a copy shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person against whom proceedings are conducted, their defence counsel and/or legal representative, and, where necessary, state bodies registering property or rights to it. If the judge refuses attachment, a copy of that order shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate the relevant administrative offence case.
koap-u3943b6fc36aa9c888c-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ueb5ac3dc2e7e59bea0-1.text: 10. An attachment order constitutes an enforcement document and shall be enforced under legislation on enforcement proceedings.
koap-ueb5ac3dc2e7e59bea0-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6e1d2f7e01a965bbc6-1.text: 11. The judge who issued the attachment order may lift attachment upon a motion from the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, an enforcement bailiff, or upon a reasoned application from the person whose property is subject to that measure securing proceedings, their defence counsel and/or legal representative.
koap-u6e1d2f7e01a965bbc6-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uc97fc4608d6f15834f-1.text: 12. Deferral or payment by instalments of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall not constitute grounds for lifting attachment of property, including money.
koap-uc97fc4608d6f15834f-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ub622fc80338bd3af71-1.text: 13. The motions and applications referred to in part 11 of this Article shall be considered by a judge within five days from receipt, with notification of the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person whose property is attached, their defence counsel and/or legal representative.
koap-ub622fc80338bd3af71-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u382d4f3f3b68b461df-1.text: 14. The judge’s decision granting or refusing a motion or application referred to in part 11 of this Article shall take the form of a procedural order, which may be appealed under the rules established by Chapter 30 of this Code.
koap-u382d4f3f3b68b461df-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u3e94d3421ada58b09c-1.text: 15. If the judge issues a order lifting attachment, a copy shall immediately be sent to the prosecutor or person authorised to initiate a case concerning an offence referred to in part 1 of this Article, the enforcement bailiff, the person whose property was subject to that measure securing proceedings, their defence counsel and/or legal representative, and, where necessary, state bodies registering property or rights to it.
koap-u3e94d3421ada58b09c-1.locator: Article 27.20. Attachment of property to secure enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6578d4baeef2e90bd8-1.text: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case
koap-u6578d4baeef2e90bd8-1.locator: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u4fcccb3dcef29dea44-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 28. INITIATION OF AN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASE
koap-u4fcccb3dcef29dea44-1.locator: Chapter 28. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ud1a70942215393dc7e-1.text: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
koap-ud1a70942215393dc7e-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u3e65add38a0866810e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case
koap-u3e65add38a0866810e-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u2a47f3071cc20293a1-1.text: 1. The reasons for initiating an administrative offence case are:
koap-u2a47f3071cc20293a1-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-uc9bb80d366f7c52e6b-1.text: 1) direct discovery by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records of sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred;
koap-uc9bb80d366f7c52e6b-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ud77eeb4829b1662c64-1.text: 2) materials received from law enforcement bodies, and from other state bodies, local self-government bodies or public associations, containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred;
koap-ud77eeb4829b1662c64-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-udc0d95e42d5f1b2a8b-1.text: 3) reports and applications from individuals and legal entities, and reports in the mass media, containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred (except for the administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 5.27 and Article 14.52 of this Code);
koap-udc0d95e42d5f1b2a8b-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u55f5a01fe18d914dc0-1.text: 4) recording, by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, of an administrative offence in the sphere of environmental protection and use of natural resources (as regards the administrative offences provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 of this Code), in the sphere of road traffic, or an administrative offence in the sphere of territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in failure to comply with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property, and recording, using the monitoring information system, of an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code;
koap-u55f5a01fe18d914dc0-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ub735b98639e3afd54c-1.text: 5) confirmation of data contained in a report or application by the owner (holder) of a vehicle that, in the cases provided for by point 4 of this part, the vehicle was in the possession or use of another person.
koap-ub735b98639e3afd54c-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u40fc813da797bafeb8-1.text: 1.1.
