The reasons for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.12, 14.13 and 14.23 of this Code are the reasons specified in points 1, 2 and 3 of part 1 of this Article, as well as applications by persons participating in a bankruptcy case and persons participating in commercial-court proceedings in a bankruptcy case, the management bodies of a debtor that is a legal entity, or a self-regulatory organisation of insolvency administrators, containing sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
koap-u40fc813da797bafeb8-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u4d33cb625e7c528438-1.text: 1.2. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.9, 14.31, 14.32, 14.33 and 14.40 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the antimonopoly authority of a decision establishing a violation of the antimonopoly legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u4d33cb625e7c528438-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u3308bec57b63f07f63-1.text: 1.2-1. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.9.1 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the antimonopoly authority of a decision establishing a violation of the procedure for carrying out measures in the implementation of a construction project by a federal executive authority, a state authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, a local self-government body, another body or organisation performing the functions of those bodies, or an organisation participating in the provision of state or municipal services.
koap-u3308bec57b63f07f63-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u7bda2230c76b9d846a-1.text: 1.2-2. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.3 of this Code is the adoption by a commission of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) functions in the sphere of the state defence order of a decision establishing a violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the sphere of the state defence order.
koap-u7bda2230c76b9d846a-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u59c2813039abdd72ec-1.text: 1.2-3. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 15 of Article 7.30.3 of this Code is failure to comply within the prescribed period with a demand of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) functions in the sphere of the state defence order to cease actions (inaction) containing indications of a violation of legislation in the sphere of the state defence order.
koap-u59c2813039abdd72ec-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u8eec7c889ef016d1b3-1.text: 1.3. The reason for initiating cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.35 and 8.37 of this Code is a report on the presence of indications of an administrative offence or crime connected with violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation in the sphere of hunting and conservation of hunting resources, drawn up by an in-house hunting inspector in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u8eec7c889ef016d1b3-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ub481f3af92060e05dd-1.text: 2. The materials, reports and applications specified in parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article shall be considered by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records.
koap-ub481f3af92060e05dd-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ud1f6d026d3427bc098-1.text: 3. An administrative offence case may be initiated by an official authorised to draw up administrative offence records only where there is at least one of the reasons provided for by parts 1, 1.1 and 1.3 of this Article and sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, except in the cases provided for by part 3.1 of this Article.
koap-ud1f6d026d3427bc098-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ua5adeed041645e52af-1.text: 3.1. A case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements whose observance is assessed as part of state control (supervision) or municipal control, where one of the reasons for initiating a case provided for by points 1 - 3 of part 1 of this Article exists, may be initiated only after conducting a control (supervisory) measure involving interaction with the controlled person, an inspection, or a control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol, and documenting their results, except in the cases provided for by parts 3.2 - 3.9 of this Article and Article 28.6 of this Code.
koap-ua5adeed041645e52af-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ua14849fcac63e7cbdf-1.text: 3.2. An administrative offence case may be initiated before documenting the results of a control (supervisory) measure, inspection or control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol where it is necessary to apply measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case provided for by Articles 27.10, 27.14 and 27.16 of this Code. In all cases where administrative offence cases are initiated before documenting the results of a control (supervisory) measure, inspection or control (supervisory) action within permanent state control (supervision) or a permanent inspection patrol, the official who drew up the record of application of a measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case shall notify the prosecutor within twenty-four hours.
koap-ua14849fcac63e7cbdf-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u22097891ee5e60b7bd-1.text: 3.3. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 9.21 of this Code may be initiated by the federal antimonopoly authority or its territorial body without conducting control (supervisory) measures if the materials, reports or applications received by the federal antimonopoly authority or its territorial body contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
koap-u22097891ee5e60b7bd-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u58246323586af1cf42-1.text: 3.4. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 9.1 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures where information on the organisation of in-house control over compliance with industrial safety requirements has not been submitted to the executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the sphere of industrial safety.
koap-u58246323586af1cf42-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u1e98223e4372b63409-1.text: 3.5. Without conducting control (supervisory) measures involving interaction with the controlled person, the body exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications may initiate cases concerning administrative offences:
koap-u1e98223e4372b63409-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ueda72d0f07aeda522a-1.text: 1) provided for by parts 1 - 2.1, 4 and 10 - 18 of Article 13.11 (where data confirming that an administrative offence has occurred are received from the individual or legal entity that committed the administrative offence), parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 13.11.3 (where data confirming that an administrative offence has occurred are received from the legal entity that committed the administrative offence), part 1 of Article 13.21 (where data confirming the production or distribution of products of a mass media outlet whose registration entry has not been amended to reflect a change of founder or a change in the composition of co-founders are received from the mass media outlet that committed the administrative offence) of this Code, and also in the cases provided for by Article 6.13 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), parts 3 and 4 of Article 6.21 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), part 2 of Article 6.21.1 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), part 2 of Article 6.21.2 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), Articles 13.2.1 and 13.4, parts 3, 5 and 5.1 of Article 13.11, Article 13.11.2, parts 2 - 11 of Article 13.15 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets), Article 13.15.1 (as regards late provision by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher of information on the receipt of funds, the provision of which is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media), part 1 of Article 13.21 (as regards administrative offences committed by mass media outlets, except for the production or distribution of products of a mass media outlet whose registration entry has not been amended to reflect a change of founder or a change in the composition of co-founders), parts 2, 2.1 and 3 of Article 13.21 (as regards administrative offences committed using mass media), Article 13.22, parts 1 - 3, 5 and 6 of Article 13.29, Article 13.29.4, parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 13.31, Articles 13.34 and 13.40, Article 13.42 (in cases of violation of the procedure for operating, in a communications operator’s communications network, technical means for countering threats to the stability, security and integrity of the functioning in the territory of the Russian Federation of the Internet information and telecommunications network and the public communications network, and violation of legislative requirements for the operation of technical means for monitoring compliance with legislative requirements providing for restriction of access to information), Articles 13.42.1, 13.43.1 and 13.44, parts 1 and 3 of Article 13.45, parts 1 and 5 of Article 13.54, parts 2, 3 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, and parts 6 and 7 of Article 19.7.10 of this Code;
koap-ueda72d0f07aeda522a-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u1629251a5454608fb1-1.text: 2) provided for by part 6 of Article 13.11, Article 13.15.1 (as regards failure by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher to provide information on the receipt of funds, the provision of which is required by the legislation of the Russian Federation on mass media), part 1 of Article 13.21 (as regards the production or distribution of products of unregistered mass media outlets), part 4 of Article 13.29, parts 2 - 4 of Article 13.31, Article 13.38, and part 4 of Article 14.1 (as regards a gross violation of licensing requirements consisting in failure by a communications operator to comply with requirements for communications networks and facilities for conducting operational-search activities) of this Code, in the case provided for by point 2 of part 1 of this Article.
koap-u1629251a5454608fb1-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u44ed957a7b6ab65181-1.text: 3.6. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.5.1, 8.41 and 8.41.1 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures where materials held by or received by the body exercising state environmental supervision contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
koap-u44ed957a7b6ab65181-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u9b3140ce93829c2ebd-1.text: 3.7. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 11.16, parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 14.1, and Articles 19.20 and 20.4 of this Code may be initiated by the body exercising federal state fire supervision without conducting control (supervisory) measures where materials, reports or applications, including those concerning fire-related crimes and incidents, held by or received by the body exercising federal state fire supervision contain sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred.
koap-u9b3140ce93829c2ebd-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u557f65d526f6ce0524-1.text: 3.8. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 14.1 and parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.20 of this Code may be initiated without conducting control (supervisory) measures in relation to licensees engaged in the installation, maintenance and repair of fire safety equipment for buildings and structures where sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred have been established as a result of control (supervisory) measures conducted within federal state fire supervision.
koap-u557f65d526f6ce0524-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-uac82c14efb43e39f03-1.text: 3.9. A case concerning an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with any of the mandatory requirements specified in the second paragraph of this part may be initiated by an official authorised to draw up records of such administrative offences upon discovery of sufficient data indicating that the relevant administrative offence has occurred, where such data were obtained during a control (supervisory) measure without interaction with the controlled person or during implementation of a special regime of state control (supervision) — monitoring, in the course of which, during the experiment provided for by Article 14 of Law of the Russian Federation of 15 April 1993 No. 4802-I ‘On the Status of the Capital of the Russian Federation’, technical and/or software tools with functions for photography and motion-picture recording, audio and video recording, detection, recognition, analysis and identification of objects, measurement of quantitative and qualitative indicators, including weighing, as well as state information systems were used.
koap-uac82c14efb43e39f03-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u69f2170e6e4388336a-1.text: In accordance with the first paragraph of this part, an administrative offence case may be initiated in the federal city of Moscow in the event of non-compliance with any mandatory requirement whose observance is assessed as part of regional state control (supervision) over the condition, maintenance, preservation, use, promotion and state protection of cultural heritage sites, regional state construction supervision, regional state environmental control (supervision), regional state geological control (supervision), regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of protection and use of specially protected natural areas, regional state control (supervision) over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure, regional state housing control (supervision), regional state control (supervision) in the sphere of protection and rational use of urban soils, regional state control (supervision) over compliance with requirements for the protection of green plantings, municipal control over road transport, urban surface electric transport and road infrastructure, municipal land control, or municipal control in the sphere of territorial improvement.
koap-u69f2170e6e4388336a-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ud693ebd4824cea3f63-1.text: 4. An administrative offence case is deemed initiated from the moment of:
koap-ud693ebd4824cea3f63-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u897ee7fd8e65b7c2af-1.text: 1) drawing up a record of inspection of the place where the administrative offence was committed;
koap-u897ee7fd8e65b7c2af-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u083b4b681f477d2220-1.text: 2) drawing up the first record of application of measures securing proceedings in an administrative offence case provided for by Article 27.1 of this Code;
koap-u083b4b681f477d2220-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u798a886b45fd9bee50-1.text: 3) drawing up an administrative offence record or issuance by a prosecutor of a ruling initiating an administrative offence case;
koap-u798a886b45fd9bee50-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u173b5c248f51887dab-1.text: 4) issuing a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case where an administrative investigation provided for by Article 28.7 of this Code is necessary;
koap-u173b5c248f51887dab-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ud524133dd932287b22-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u28f116dbc089f8c3a6-1.text: 6) issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case in the case provided for by part 1, 3 or 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code;
koap-u28f116dbc089f8c3a6-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-uf7a1f7246b171249e0-1.text: 7) issuing a procedural order requesting information in accordance with part 5 of Article 26.10 of this Code in the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
koap-uf7a1f7246b171249e0-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u457b9b2d8fbfdf52f8-1.text: 5. Where initiation of an administrative offence case is refused despite the existence of materials, reports or applications specified in points 2 and 3 of part 1 of this Article, the official who considered those materials, reports or applications shall issue a reasoned procedural order refusing to initiate an administrative offence case.
koap-u457b9b2d8fbfdf52f8-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-u476fd8ffe30b48879f-1.text: Note. The provisions of parts 3.1 and 3.2 of this Article apply to the initiation of cases concerning administrative offences consisting in non-compliance with mandatory requirements whose observance is assessed as part of state control (supervision) or municipal control, the organisation and implementation of which are governed by Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-ФЗ ‘On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation’ or Federal Law of 26 December 2008 No. 294-ФЗ ‘On the Protection of the Rights of Legal Entities and Individual Entrepreneurs in the Exercise of State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control’.
koap-u476fd8ffe30b48879f-1.locator: Article 28.1. Initiation of an administrative offence case

koap-ubb2e3f81ef4b13aac6-1.text: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
koap-ubb2e3f81ef4b13aac6-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u2a7532994dcf957c8a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed
koap-u2a7532994dcf957c8a-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u76f8757bd12e2bbaa8-1.text: 1. Where an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 or part 2 of Article 12.30 of this Code is committed, a record of inspection of the place where the administrative offence was committed shall be drawn up.
koap-u76f8757bd12e2bbaa8-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u8661251f921ee58157-1.text: 2. A record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be drawn up immediately after the commission of the administrative offence is detected.
koap-u8661251f921ee58157-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u710c9ae00e442dc8f1-1.text: 3. Inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be conducted by persons authorised to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with part 1 of Article 28.3 of this Code, in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
koap-u710c9ae00e442dc8f1-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-ue3e69e3e5193c76f71-1.text: 4. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew up the record, particulars of the person who was directly driving the vehicle at the time the administrative offence was committed, the vehicle’s type, make, model and state registration plate, and the surnames, first names, patronymics and residential addresses of attesting witnesses (if participating), witnesses and victims, where there are witnesses and victims, the place and time of commission and the occurrence of the administrative offence, the Article of this Code providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence, and other information necessary to resolve the case.
koap-ue3e69e3e5193c76f71-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-ue690a568791a8002df-1.text: 5. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall describe:
koap-ue690a568791a8002df-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-ue9834953d1d1a2ffa3-1.text: 1) the actions of the officials specified in part 3 of Article 28.1.1 of this Code, in the order in which they were performed;
koap-ue9834953d1d1a2ffa3-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-uf383edd66ea5c1830a-1.text: 2) the condition and quality of the road surface, the presence or absence of road markings, and the degree of illumination of the section of road where the administrative offence was committed;
koap-uf383edd66ea5c1830a-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u67498f063f1d49208a-1.text: 3) the type of intersection (controlled or uncontrolled) where the administrative offence was committed, whether the traffic lights were functioning or defective, and the presence or absence of priority signs;
koap-u67498f063f1d49208a-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u379737b6f6e2abee18-1.text: 4) other circumstances material to the case.
koap-u379737b6f6e2abee18-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-ue4dbd4a4628e07412d-1.text: 6. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall also set out statements made by persons who participated in the inspection.
koap-ue4dbd4a4628e07412d-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u1ac6c102a8f96d9557-1.text: 7. When drawing up a record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed, persons participating in the inspection shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the record.
koap-u1ac6c102a8f96d9557-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-uacade869b34bfbc069-1.text: 8. An entry shall be made in the record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed concerning the use of photography and motion-picture recording and other established methods of recording physical evidence. Materials obtained during the inspection using photography and motion-picture recording or other established methods of recording physical evidence shall be attached to the relevant record.
koap-uacade869b34bfbc069-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-u6b5456da94276d9947-1.text: 9. The record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be signed by the official who drew it up and by the persons who participated in the inspection. Copies of the record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed shall be handed to the persons who were directly driving the vehicles at the time the administrative offence was committed.
koap-u6b5456da94276d9947-1.locator: Article 28.1.1. Record of inspection of the place where an administrative offence was committed

koap-udfbdcb2a3e00ee8c4a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.2. Administrative offence record

koap-u98ed18b1112f488276-1.text: 1. A record shall be drawn up concerning the commission of an administrative offence, except in the cases provided for by Article 28.4 and parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 28.6 of this Code.

koap-u05c5a297090fae1a6c-1.text: 1.1. Where, for objective reasons, the individual against whom a case concerning such an offence is being initiated, that individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of a legal entity against which an administrative offence case is being initiated cannot be present when the administrative offence record is drawn up, their presence may be ensured through videoconferencing systems if the body or official has the technical capability, or through a web-conferencing system if the body, official, that individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of that legal entity has the technical capability.

koap-ud054b248eeeee36388-1.text: The question of ensuring the presence of the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part when an administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system shall be decided by the official authorised to draw up the administrative offence record, at the request of those persons or on the official’s own initiative.

koap-u145172a161d2e514ce-1.text: The official authorised to draw up an administrative offence record shall notify the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part of the date, time and place of the videoconference arrangements or the date and time of the web conference no later than ten working days before the day on which the administrative offence record is to be drawn up.

koap-u6c8bf2be8f7851d8d7-1.text: 1.2. Where videoconferencing systems are used when drawing up an administrative offence record, the official authorised to draw it up shall establish a connection with a structural subdivision of the body, a territorial body or a structural subdivision of a territorial body in which videoconferencing systems are used, to ensure the presence of the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article when the record is drawn up. The person arranging the videoconference shall assist the official authorised to draw up the administrative offence record in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing.

koap-u17ece84628cfe79698-1.text: 1.3. The identity of the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article, when an administrative offence record is drawn up through a web-conferencing system, shall be established using information technology tools enabling identification of a person without their physical presence (the unified identification and authentication system and the unified biometric system).

koap-u1eef2699b110900f51-1.text: 1.4. Where an individual against whom an administrative offence case is being initiated, that individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of a legal entity against which an administrative offence case is being initiated is present when the administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system, the record shall be drawn up no later than the working day following the day on which the videoconference was arranged or the web conference was held.

koap-ufcd16820889fcff805-1.text: 2. An administrative offence record shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew up the record, particulars of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, the surnames, first names, patronymics and residential addresses of witnesses and victims, where there are witnesses and victims, the place and time of commission and the occurrence of the administrative offence, the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence, the explanation of the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the case has been initiated, and other information necessary to resolve the case.

koap-uedc69a874f82ba555d-1.text: 3. When an administrative offence record is drawn up, the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, and other participants in the proceedings, shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the record.

koap-u5213d9160ed8a10537-1.text: 4. The individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated shall be given the opportunity to inspect the administrative offence record, or, where they are present when the administrative offence record is drawn up through videoconferencing systems, a copy of that record sent in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 5.1 of this Article.

koap-ua8411864866998521b-1.text: The persons specified in the first paragraph of this part may submit explanations and comments concerning the contents of the record, which shall be attached to the record.

koap-u6a69426a78ae832221-1.text: 4.1. Where the individual, the individual’s legal representative, or the legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted fails to appear, provided that they have been duly notified, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up in their absence. A copy of the administrative offence record shall be sent to the person in respect of whom it was drawn up within three days from the day it was drawn up.

koap-u7b3886c0f2e4041c31-1.text: 5. The administrative offence record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and by the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, except in the cases provided for by part 5.1 of this Article.

koap-uee661c0dcef82b7674-1.text: Where persons refuse to sign the record (a copy of the record), and in the case provided for by part 4.1 of this Article, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record.

koap-u3d95272e5d9e3b6fd5-1.text: 5.1. Where an administrative offence record is drawn up using videoconferencing systems, the record shall be signed on paper by the official who drew it up, after which that official shall send a copy of the record to the structural subdivision of the body, territorial body or structural subdivision of the territorial body where the videoconference is arranged, for that copy to be signed by the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article.

koap-uab3e0812f7fae44675-1.text: In addition to their handwritten signatures, the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article shall mark their receipt on the paper copy of the record.

koap-u4a07270bc265ce8b58-1.text: The copy of the record signed by the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article and bearing their acknowledgement of receipt of that copy shall be sent by the person arranging the videoconference to the official who drew up the administrative offence record immediately, but no later than the end of the working day.

koap-u534954861e52b9874b-1.text: Where the persons specified in the first paragraph of part 1.1 of this Article refuse to sign the copy of the record, the person arranging the videoconference shall make a corresponding entry on that copy and send it to the official who drew up the administrative offence record within the period provided for by the third paragraph of this part.

koap-u87eec349f94149645e-1.text: 6. A copy of the administrative offence record shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated, and to the victim, except where those persons are present when the record is drawn up using a web-conferencing system.

koap-u1a557158a7d6aca87f-1.text: 1. Records of administrative offences provided for by this Code shall be drawn up by officials of bodies authorised to consider administrative offence cases in accordance with Chapter 23 of this Code, within the competence of the relevant body.

koap-ufeb712f650e95473da-1.text: 3. In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies licensing certain types of activity and monitoring compliance with the requirements and conditions provided for by a special permit (licence), may, within the competence of the relevant body, draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 14.1, Article 19.20 and part 1 of Article 20.8 of this Code.
koap-ufeb712f650e95473da-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u800108d37e63e17684-1.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies authorised to conduct proceedings in administrative offence cases in accordance with this Code may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Articles 17.7 and 17.9 of this Code.
koap-u800108d37e63e17684-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u1032e41f246f1a44a3-1.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of federal executive authorities, their structural subdivisions and territorial bodies, and other state bodies authorised to exercise state control (supervision) and state financial control may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 19.4.1, part 20.1 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.26 of this Code.
koap-u1032e41f246f1a44a3-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u48f8e0e1f36cc666c2-1.text: Alongside the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 14.1 of this Code, provided that the transfer of those powers is stipulated in agreements between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
koap-u48f8e0e1f36cc666c2-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u90796cbde9d0647dce-1.text: In addition to the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, the Chief State Housing Inspector of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 19.6.2 of this Code.
koap-u90796cbde9d0647dce-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u87de511d5144de389b-1.text: 4. The list of officials entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with parts 1, 2, 3 and 6.2 of this Article shall be established, respectively, by authorised federal executive authorities, authorised executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and the Bank of Russia, in accordance with the tasks and functions assigned to those bodies by federal legislation.
koap-u87de511d5144de389b-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u3770a7cbb129b7dce9-1.text: The list of officials entitled to draw up records of administrative offences whose consideration is assigned by this Code to the powers of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be established by authorised executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
koap-u3770a7cbb129b7dce9-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u00e6eeca35358da4fd-1.text: The list of officials of departmental security bodies and organisations entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with point 7 of part 5 of this Article shall be established, respectively, by federal executive authorities, the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is the federal city of Moscow, and organisations entitled to establish departmental security services.
koap-u00e6eeca35358da4fd-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u8bc5546f52cb9eceac-1.text: The list of officials of militarised and guard subdivisions of the organisation subordinate to the federal executive authority exercising functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with point 7 of part 5 of this Article, shall be established by that federal executive authority.
koap-u8bc5546f52cb9eceac-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-ucc8fbf8a005c012162-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u5da97043434a05f48e-1.text: 18) officials of the management bodies and forces of the unified state system for prevention and elimination of emergencies — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.6.1 of this Code. koap-ua533ae87ffbc444115-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u4f3770d51da4e64dc3-1.text: Records of administrative offences against public order and public safety provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be drawn up by officials of internal affairs bodies (police) where transfer of those powers is stipulated in agreements between the federal executive authority exercising functions for developing and implementing state policy and legal regulation in internal affairs and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
koap-u4f3770d51da4e64dc3-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u196757eec6aa8a076a-1.text: 6.1. Officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, whose list is established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 1 and 20.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7 of this Code when exercising regional state control (supervision), state financial control, and powers in federal state control (supervision) transferred to them.
koap-u196757eec6aa8a076a-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u898ba5e77ab84d0432-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u2c73e31281dbf2d996-1.text: 6.3. Alongside the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of the respective constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of administrative offences provided for by this Code and committed in the territories of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where this is provided for by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation on transferring powers of federal executive authorities for exercise by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, adopted in accordance with federal laws, or by agreements concluded in accordance with federal law between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
koap-u2c73e31281dbf2d996-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-udc3c2fe48cfc70ce5c-1.text: 6.4. In addition to the cases provided for by point 18 of part 5 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.6.1 of this Code. The list of those bodies and their officials shall be approved by the highest official (head of the highest executive state authority) of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-udc3c2fe48cfc70ce5c-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-ub9d5448789fce2f40a-1.text: 6.5. In addition to the cases provided for by point 11 of part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code, on the basis of materials received from municipal financial control bodies containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, in relation to procurement carried out for municipal needs.
koap-ub9d5448789fce2f40a-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-u6b318af2260de806fc-1.text: 7. Officials of local self-government bodies, whose list is established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and officials of public authorities of a federal territory, whose list is established by regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the federal territory, may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 1, 31 and 32 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7 of this Code when exercising municipal control; concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.21, 7.32.6, 15.1, 15.14 - 15.15.16 and 15.37.1, part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 20 and 20.1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code when exercising municipal financial control; concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code when exercising procurement control; and concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code when providing treasury support.
koap-u6b318af2260de806fc-1.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records

koap-uf4ca207a0ddf6f8311-1.text: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
koap-uf4ca207a0ddf6f8311-1.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor

koap-ucf6ed5467c289e338e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
koap-ucf6ed5467c289e338e-1.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor

koap-u9d42362479139a2301-1.text: 1. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.1, 5.6, 5.7, 5.21, 5.23 - 5.25, 5.39, 5.45, 5.46, 5.48, 5.52, 5.58 - 5.63.2, 6.19, 6.20 and 7.24, part 10 of Article 7.30.1, Articles 7.35 and 8.32.2, part 2 of Article 8.49, Articles 12.35, 13.14 and 13.19.1, Article 13.19.3 (except for administrative offences committed by a developer or the developer’s officials), parts 7 and 8 of Article 13.19.5, parts 7 and 8 of Article 13.19.6, Articles 13.27 and 13.28, parts 1 - 4.1, 6 and 7 of Article 14.13 (except where those offences were committed by insolvency administrators), parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.25, part 6 of Article 14.28, parts 1 - 5 of Article 14.35, Article 14.56, part 1 of Article 15.10, part 4 of Article 15.27, Article 15.33.1, part 3 of Article 19.4, Articles 19.5.4 and 19.6.1, Article 19.8.1 (as regards administrative offences committed by officials of the federal executive authority in state tariff regulation), and Articles 19.9, 19.28, 19.29, 19.32, 19.34.2, 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.4, 20.26, 20.28 and 20.29 of this Code shall be initiated by a prosecutor. When supervising compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and enforcement of laws in force in the territory of the Russian Federation, a prosecutor may also initiate a case concerning any other administrative offence for which liability is provided for by this Code or by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
koap-u9d42362479139a2301-1.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor

koap-ua6193cd42818b3fe3b-1.text: 2. A prosecutor shall issue a ruling initiating an administrative offence case, which shall contain the information provided for by Article 28.2 of this Code. That ruling shall be issued within the periods established by Article 28.5 of this Code.
koap-ua6193cd42818b3fe3b-1.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor

koap-u99b39d7e04c6848bd9-1.text: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
koap-u99b39d7e04c6848bd9-1.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record

koap-u31f188951b1c198f1a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
koap-u31f188951b1c198f1a-1.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record

koap-u8f3631d9b79fce0501-1.text: 1. An administrative offence record shall be drawn up immediately after the commission of an administrative offence is detected, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article, part 3.1 of Article 28.1 and part 1.4 of Article 28.2 of this Code.
koap-u8f3631d9b79fce0501-1.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record

koap-u4c29b68721771fdd4a-1.text: 2. Where additional clarification of the circumstances of the case or of particulars of the individual or information about the legal entity against whom an administrative offence case is being initiated is required, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up within two days from the moment the administrative offence is detected.
koap-u4c29b68721771fdd4a-1.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record

koap-u1df66d27e75ef49efd-1.text: 3. Where an administrative investigation is conducted, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up upon completion of the investigation within the periods provided for by Article 28.7 of this Code.
koap-u1df66d27e75ef49efd-1.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record

koap-uc89e982eb766b00bd8-1.text: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
koap-uc89e982eb766b00bd8-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u548db02a23487ea015-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
koap-u548db02a23487ea015-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u31f6482ba1789ef57b-1.text: 1. Where an authorised official imposes an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine directly at the place where an individual committed an administrative offence, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued and, upon request, to the victim. If receipt of a copy of the ruling is refused, it shall be sent to the person in respect of whom the ruling was issued by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-u31f6482ba1789ef57b-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-ue3e7da64110ac67a1a-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-uf394139f684b828bbf-1.text: 1.2. Where administrative offences consisting in exceeding prices (tariffs) for goods and/or maximum levels of those prices (tariffs) established by regulatory legal acts of the Donetsk People’s Republic, the Lugansk People’s Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast or Kherson Oblast are detected in the territories of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, an authorised official shall impose an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine on a citizen, official, individual entrepreneur or legal entity directly at the place where the administrative offence was committed; no administrative offence record shall be drawn up, and a ruling in the administrative offence case shall instead be issued in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
koap-uf394139f684b828bbf-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-ue130f1ade95cf03b9a-1.text: A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued and, upon request, to the victim. If receipt of a copy of the ruling is refused, it shall be sent to the person in respect of whom the ruling was issued by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-ue130f1ade95cf03b9a-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u526a1704ac4976ce4d-1.text: Where the person against whom an administrative offence case has been initiated disputes that the administrative offence occurred and/or the administrative penalty imposed on that person, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and attached to the ruling issued in accordance with this part.
koap-u526a1704ac4976ce4d-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-ua517073a3c44fc2647-1.text: 2. Where the person against whom an administrative offence case has been initiated disputes that the administrative offence occurred and/or the administrative penalty imposed on that person, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and attached to the ruling issued in accordance with part 1 of this Article.
koap-ua517073a3c44fc2647-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-ub1e807e3cbffa5325c-1.text: 3. Where an administrative offence provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 or Chapter 12 of this Code, or an administrative offence in territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property and recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, is detected, or where data contained in a report or application by the owner (holder) of a vehicle that the vehicle was in the possession or use of another person when the administrative offence was recorded are confirmed in accordance with part 2 of Article 2.6.1 of this Code, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without the participation of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. Copies of the ruling in the administrative offence case and of materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment shall be sent to the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated by registered post in the form of a paper copy of the ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-ub1e807e3cbffa5325c-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u7719943e4c0b871f15-1.text: 3.1. Where an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system is detected, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without the participation of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. The ruling in such an administrative offence case shall be produced only in the form of an electronic document using the monitoring information system. Copies of the ruling in such an administrative offence case and of materials obtained using the monitoring information system shall be sent to the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated by registered post in the form of a paper copy of that ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or in the form of an electronic document in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-u7719943e4c0b871f15-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u9edd1500405d26710c-1.text: 4. Where the tax authorities’ automated information system checks reports and applications received from individuals and legal entities concerning data indicating that a person has committed actions (inaction) containing the constituent elements of an administrative offence for which administrative liability is provided for by parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code, if that person has acknowledged that the alleged administrative offence occurred and, before a ruling in the administrative offence case is issued, voluntarily performed the duty for whose non-performance or improper performance the person is being held administratively liable, or where an administrative offence for which liability is provided for by part 2, 4 or 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code is committed by a person whose administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine may be replaced with a warning in accordance with part 1 of Article 4.1.1 of this Code, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without that person’s participation and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be sent to that person by registered post in the form of a paper copy of the ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature of an authorised official in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-u9edd1500405d26710c-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u570207c6816f32b75e-1.text: 5. Where the person specified in part 4 of this Article has not acknowledged that the alleged administrative offence occurred, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and the administrative offence case shall be considered in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.7 of this Code.
koap-u570207c6816f32b75e-1.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record

koap-u0b3197d17937121b9d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.7. Administrative investigation

koap-u6540b1a7a65a63fd86-1.text: 1. An administrative investigation shall be conducted where, after detection of an administrative offence in the sphere of antimonopoly or patent legislation, legislation of the Russian Federation on communications (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 13.2.1, parts 2, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 13.29 and Article 13.29.4 of this Code), legislation on personal data (as regards the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 2.1 and 12 - 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code), legislation on ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.12.1, 13.12.2 and 19.7.15 of this Code), legislation on mass media (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 13.15 of this Code), legislation on natural monopolies, legislation on advertising, legislation on joint-stock companies, the securities market and investment funds, insurance legislation, legislation on protecting the rights and legitimate interests of individuals in activities for recovery of overdue debts, legislation on elections and referendums, legislation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism, legislation on investment activity (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.56.1 of this Code), legislation of the Russian Federation on countering terrorism (as regards the administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.1 of this Code), legislation on countering extremist activities (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Articles 20.3.1 and 20.3.2 of this Code), legislation on combating corruption, labour legislation, legislation on countering misuse of insider information and market manipulation, legislation on narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors, legislation on physical culture and sport as regards preventing and combating doping in sport and violation of requirements for rules (regulations) on official sporting competitions, legislation on state regulation of the organisation and conduct of gambling as regards violation of requirements for organisers of gambling in bookmakers’ offices and totalisators when accepting bets on official sporting competitions and conducting other gambling, migration legislation, currency legislation of the Russian Federation and acts of currency regulation bodies, legislation on consumer protection, technical regulation, accreditation in the national accreditation system, the organisation and conduct of gambling, protection of citizens’ health, copyright and related rights, trademarks, service marks and appellations of origin of goods, budget legislation of the Russian Federation and regulatory legal acts governing budgetary legal relations, legislation on taxes and levies, sanitary and epidemiological welfare of the population, veterinary matters, plant quarantine, public morals, customs affairs, export control, state regulation of prices (tariffs) for goods (services), the fundamentals of tariff regulation for utility-sector organisations, environmental protection and use of natural resources, the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for their production, the circulation of methanol and methanol-containing liquids, the fundamentals of state regulation of trade (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 15.12 of this Code), the circulation of medicinal products, fire safety, industrial safety, the safety of hydraulic structures, the use of atomic energy, the electric power industry, heat supply, water supply and wastewater disposal, gas supply, urban-planning activities, road traffic and transport, technical inspection of vehicles, insolvency (bankruptcy), legislation of the Russian Federation on the state defence order, the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services for state and municipal needs, procurement of goods, works and services by certain types of legal entities, protection of cultural heritage sites (historical and cultural monuments) of the peoples of the Russian Federation, state support for cinematography of the Russian Federation (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 14.58 of this Code), state registration of legal entities and individual entrepreneurs, or the use of cash-register equipment, or after detection of an administrative offence against the order of administration (as regards failure or incomplete provision by a film exhibitor showing films in a cinema hall for a fee of information to the unified federal automated information system of information on film screenings in cinema halls, or provision of knowingly inaccurate information), or in the sphere of property protection (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.3 and 7.5 of this Code), an expert examination or other procedural actions requiring a substantial amount of time are carried out, and also where the administrative offences provided for by Articles 6.1.1, 7.27, 13.41, 19.34 and 20.6.1 of this Code are committed.

koap-uf199d51393222ebd26-1.text: 2. The decision to initiate an administrative offence case and conduct an administrative investigation shall be taken by an official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up an administrative offence record in the form of a procedural order, and by a prosecutor in the form of a ruling, immediately after the fact that an administrative offence has been committed is detected.

koap-u93703b44ac6a4205cf-1.text: 3. The procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, the reason for initiating the administrative offence case, data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, and the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence. When a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation is issued, the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it is issued, and other participants in the administrative offence proceedings, shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the procedural order.

koap-u8fd7b3e58afa3ceeb3-1.text: 3.1. A copy of the procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation shall, within twenty-four hours, be handed against acknowledgement of receipt or sent to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it is issued, and to the victim.

koap-u0097ca043e700b349d-1.text: 4. An administrative investigation shall be conducted at the place where the administrative offence was committed or detected. An administrative investigation in an administrative offence case initiated by an official authorised to draw up administrative offence records shall be conducted by that official or, by decision of the head of the body handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy, by another official of that body authorised to draw up administrative offence records.

koap-uc738cb7597e388df81-1.text: 5. The period for conducting an administrative investigation may not exceed one month from the moment an administrative offence case is initiated. In exceptional cases, upon a written motion by the official handling the case, that period may be extended:

koap-ucda8d7effb6a649fb9-1.text: 1) by decision of the head of the body handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy — by no more than one month;

koap-u14db289d86aa05b084-1.text: 2) by decision of the head of the higher customs authority or the head’s deputy, or by decision of the head of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs that is handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy — for a period of up to six months;

koap-u1079f2073eb43758e8-1.text: 3) by decision of the head of the higher body in cases concerning violation of the Road Traffic Rules or vehicle operation rules resulting in minor or moderate harm to the victim’s health — for a period of up to six months;

koap-u232faa10f84a58d687-1.text: 4) by decision of the head of the higher body in cases concerning unlawful organisation and conduct of gambling — for a period of up to six months;

koap-u0773786fcc857aa6d1-1.text: 5) by decision of the head of the higher prosecutor’s office in cases concerning unlawful remuneration on behalf of a legal entity — for a period of up to twelve months in cases connected with execution of a request for legal assistance sent in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.1.1 of this Code.

koap-u9c380a699a2a73f40e-1.text: 5.1. The decision to extend the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall be taken in the form of a procedural order. The procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, the grounds for extending the period for conducting the administrative investigation, and the date until which the administrative investigation is extended. The procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall be signed by the head or deputy head who issued it in accordance with part 5 of this Article.

koap-u3fbdc200f2229340f6-1.text: 5.2. A copy of the procedural order extending the period for conducting an administrative investigation shall, within twenty-four hours, be handed against acknowledgement of receipt or sent to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom the administrative investigation is being conducted, and to the victim.

koap-ua9ef05012259d4808c-1.text: 6. Upon completion of an administrative investigation, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up or a ruling terminating the administrative offence case shall be issued.

koap-u08363fb9fabd6e7dc0-1.text: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u08363fb9fabd6e7dc0-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u4d06f69574e76a12b6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u4d06f69574e76a12b6-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u385788d851c65d6b17-1.text: 1. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case shall be sent to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case within three days from the moment the administrative offence record is drawn up (the ruling is issued).
koap-u385788d851c65d6b17-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u7244a5c0ab5b61a4f2-1.text: 1.1. An administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) concerning an offence for which an administrative fine is provided, sent to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case, shall be accompanied by the information required under the rules for completing payment documents for transfer of the amount of an administrative fine provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the national payment system, indicating the unique charge identifier.
koap-u7244a5c0ab5b61a4f2-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud200b4be075a17f1f3-1.text: 1.2. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case, together with an application to impose administrative liability signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature, shall be sent to the court through the electronic document management system of the body whose official is specified in part 1.5 of this Article, in the form of electronic documents, including in machine-readable form, where the judge and body have the technical capability.
koap-ud200b4be075a17f1f3-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u6ca8140971d128d720-1.text: 1.3. The application to impose administrative liability shall specify:
koap-u6ca8140971d128d720-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u195486a224eba5ec21-1.text: 1) the name of the court to which the application to impose administrative liability is sent;
koap-u195486a224eba5ec21-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u0215506999ddd91a50-1.text: 2) the position, surname and initials of the official sending the application to impose administrative liability to the court;
koap-u0215506999ddd91a50-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ucbf2882cb66261da2e-1.text: 3) the postal address for sending documents to the body whose official sends the application to impose administrative liability, and information on the possibility of sending documents to that body using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction;
koap-ucbf2882cb66261da2e-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uc9d97a09525e2ccc29-1.text: 4) the telephone numbers of the official and body specified in points 2 and 3 of this part, and their fax numbers and email addresses (if available);
koap-uc9d97a09525e2ccc29-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u21bbf8786c206e4780-1.text: 5) the position, surname and initials of the official (prosecutor) who drew up the administrative offence record (issued the ruling);
koap-u21bbf8786c206e4780-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua91085125ebf211037-1.text: 6) the postal address for sending documents to the body whose official initiated the administrative offence case, and information on the possibility of sending documents using the unified system of interdepartmental electronic interaction;
koap-ua91085125ebf211037-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uef8193c6c9e10213a1-1.text: 7) the telephone numbers of the official and body specified in points 5 and 6 of this part, and their fax numbers and email addresses (if available);
koap-uef8193c6c9e10213a1-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uded09cc9a4ca00eb6c-1.text: 8) particulars of the person in respect of whom the administrative offence record was drawn up (the prosecutor’s ruling was issued):
koap-uded09cc9a4ca00eb6c-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u7ed4afff2fb8254e11-1.text: а) for citizens and officials — surname, first name and patronymic (if any), date of birth, place of residence or stay, information on the possibility of sending that person notices and documents by the methods specified in part 2 of Article 24.9 and part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, and, in the absence of such information, the postal address for sending notices and documents if it differs from the address of the place of residence or stay;
koap-u7ed4afff2fb8254e11-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u52a4da98a13946bc79-1.text: б) for legal entities — name, address specified in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities, date of state registration as a legal entity, primary state registration number, information on the possibility of sending that entity notices and documents by the methods specified in part 2 of Article 24.9 and part 1 of Article 25.15 of this Code, and, in the absence of such information, the postal address for sending notices and documents if it differs from the address specified in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities;
koap-u52a4da98a13946bc79-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u4cad52c545445bb065-1.text: 9) the date, time and place of the actions (inaction) that served as grounds for drawing up the administrative offence record;
koap-u4cad52c545445bb065-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uf652f2f18b7f472de7-1.text: 10) the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for commission of the administrative offence;
koap-uf652f2f18b7f472de7-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ubdc4bfb6c9982ffc77-1.text: 11) other information material to resolving the case;
koap-ubdc4bfb6c9982ffc77-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-udbf53665226e6df93f-1.text: 12) the demand to impose administrative liability on the person in respect of whom the administrative offence record was drawn up (the prosecutor’s ruling was issued);
koap-udbf53665226e6df93f-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u97b62502b3ddf5c6ad-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uc244f68c90db39e2b6-1.text: 1.4. The information provided for by points 6 and 7 of part 1.3 of this Article shall be stated in the application to impose administrative liability where it differs from the information provided for by points 3 and 4 of part 1.3 of this Article.
koap-uc244f68c90db39e2b6-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u31e8e0f93a0f8afa6c-1.text: 1.5. The application to impose administrative liability shall be signed and sent by the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up an administrative offence record.
koap-u31e8e0f93a0f8afa6c-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1e18fddcea93c839b4-1.text: 1.6. Where the technical capability is absent, the administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) and other materials of the administrative offence case, together with the application to impose administrative liability, shall be sent to the court by post or handed to authorised court staff against acknowledgement of receipt.
koap-u1e18fddcea93c839b4-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u2b72cc3e3c034ac54b-1.text: Copies of the procedural documents specified in part 1 of Article 24.9 of this Code that are produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, and form part of the materials of the administrative offence case shall be made by converting those electronic documents into paper documents and certified in the established manner.
koap-u2b72cc3e3c034ac54b-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case
