koap-u1989ece999e94e6524-1.text: 1.7. The following, if available, shall be attached to a record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code sent to the judge authorised to consider the administrative offence case:
koap-u1989ece999e94e6524-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u664fc40f7da597e7e6-1.text: 1) materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code, initiated against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction) by the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part, except in the cases provided for by points 2 and 3 of this part;
koap-u664fc40f7da597e7e6-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1a1cfd0b807bfaeb0e-1.text: 2) materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in which the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction);
koap-u1a1cfd0b807bfaeb0e-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1cead1457d36d00244-1.text: 3) information on forwarding to another judge the materials of a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code, initiated against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction) by the body whose official drew up the record specified in the first paragraph of this part, or on a judge’s issuance of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty for commission of that administrative offence.
koap-u1cead1457d36d00244-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-udc13b004f0f02e5692-1.text: 2. The administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) concerning an offence entailing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be forwarded for consideration to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case immediately after it is drawn up (issued).
koap-udc13b004f0f02e5692-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u575e114033bf90cc9a-1.text: 3. Where an administrative offence record has been drawn up by an unauthorised person, and in other cases provided for by point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, deficiencies in the record and other materials of the administrative offence case shall be remedied within no more than three days from the day they arrive (are received) from the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case. The materials of the administrative offence case, with amendments and additions made to them, shall be returned to that judge, body or official within twenty-four hours from the day the relevant deficiencies are remedied.
koap-u575e114033bf90cc9a-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8d10331b13390b8da7-1.text: 4. Where a measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case in the form of a temporary prohibition of activity has been applied, the administrative offence record concerning an offence for which an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity may be imposed, and the record of temporary prohibition of activity, shall be forwarded for consideration to the judge, body or official authorised to consider the administrative offence case immediately after they are drawn up.
koap-u8d10331b13390b8da7-1.locator: Article 28.8. Forwarding an administrative offence record (prosecutor’s ruling) for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u35243b8996edc07d99-1.text: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u35243b8996edc07d99-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u42cb38b8ba5c053a86-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u42cb38b8ba5c053a86-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ue65a07a0071c5fd6e6-1.text: 1. Where at least one of the circumstances listed in Article 24.5 of this Code exists, the body or official handling the administrative offence case shall issue a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case in compliance with the requirements provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
koap-ue65a07a0071c5fd6e6-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ubd3eec6dfd16bcad7c-1.text: 2. A ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case on the ground provided for by part 2 of Article 24.5 of this Code, together with all case materials, shall, within twenty-four hours from the moment the ruling is issued, be sent to the military unit, body or institution at the place of military service (service) or military training of the person who committed the administrative offence, so that the person may be held disciplinarily liable.
koap-ubd3eec6dfd16bcad7c-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-ud03bc93f5576199761-1.text: 3. Proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code shall be terminated by the Bank of Russia no later than five days after the day on which the Bank of Russia adopts a decision recognising the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code as fulfilled.
koap-ud03bc93f5576199761-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u3c378b1d2ffad56c82-1.text: 4. The body or official handling an administrative offence case that was suspended on the basis of a motion by the command of a military unit (institution) shall, upon receipt from authorised bodies of information on the circumstances provided for by part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, issue a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case in compliance with the requirements provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
koap-u3c378b1d2ffad56c82-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u89231560543dee01ad-1.text: 5. In the case provided for by point 5.2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be terminated by the body or official handling the administrative offence case no later than five days after the day on which a decision is adopted recognising the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code as fulfilled.
koap-u89231560543dee01ad-1.locator: Article 28.9. Termination of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u9696fdefa347e98b96-1.text: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u9696fdefa347e98b96-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u2dca76e3dcd0852f35-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case
koap-u2dca76e3dcd0852f35-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u162067d905a8c28225-1.text: 1. Where a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code concludes the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code, proceedings in that administrative offence case shall be suspended from the day following the day that agreement enters into force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
koap-u162067d905a8c28225-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u1a041478e901978303-1.text: 2. Where a person fails to perform the agreement specified in note 2 to Article 15.21 of this Code, the Bank of Russia shall resume proceedings in the administrative offence case from the day following the day a decision is adopted recognising that agreement with the Bank of Russia as unfulfilled, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
koap-u1a041478e901978303-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u2fd3643546334f9227-1.text: 3. Upon receipt of a motion by the command of a military unit (institution), proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, where the sanction of the applicable Article provides for deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle of the relevant type or other types of equipment, shall be suspended in relation to a service member performing military service during mobilisation, martial law or wartime, or a person in a volunteer formation, who is engaged to carry out tasks of the special military operation, from the day that motion is received, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued. The procedure for interaction on suspension of proceedings in that case shall be determined in accordance with part 6 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
koap-u2fd3643546334f9227-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u8bec9a842c664ac0de-1.text: 4. If, during a person’s military service or presence in a volunteer formation, a new ruling imposing an administrative penalty on that person in the form of deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle of the relevant type or other types of equipment, provided for by Article 9.3 or Chapter 12 of this Code, enters into legal force, proceedings in the administrative offence case shall resume from the day following the day the new ruling enters into legal force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
koap-u8bec9a842c664ac0de-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u056bcc03c3a66c7441-1.text: 5. Where a person against whom proceedings in an administrative offence case are being conducted concludes the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code, proceedings in that administrative offence case shall be suspended from the day following the day that agreement enters into force, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
koap-u056bcc03c3a66c7441-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u7a808212327045afce-1.text: 6. Where a person fails to perform the agreement specified in part 1 of Article 2.9.1 of this Code, the body or official shall resume proceedings in the administrative offence case from the day following the day a decision is adopted recognising that agreement as unfulfilled, and a procedural order to that effect shall be issued.
koap-u7a808212327045afce-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u70060fc5af736883d5-1.text: 7. A copy of the procedural order provided for by part 5 or 6 of this Article shall be sent to the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted within three days from the day the procedural order is issued.
koap-u70060fc5af736883d5-1.locator: Article 28.10. Suspension and resumption of proceedings in an administrative offence case

koap-u1472d172ace9913186-1.text: Chapter 29. Consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u1472d172ace9913186-1.locator: Chapter 29. Consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud311f7595072980a08-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 29. CONSIDERATION OF AN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASE
koap-ud311f7595072980a08-1.locator: Chapter 29. Consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uae74ad36b73a14b5c1-1.text: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-uae74ad36b73a14b5c1-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud69ad9d19ec3742d95-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-ud69ad9d19ec3742d95-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u9e3500e3ce3975b088-1.text: In preparing to consider an administrative offence case, the judge, body or official shall ascertain the following:
koap-u9e3500e3ce3975b088-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uecc3a79339089719fd-1.text: 1) whether consideration of the case falls within their competence;
koap-uecc3a79339089719fd-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u116e8e9dc89b2f1456-1.text: 2) whether there are circumstances precluding consideration of the case by the judge, a member of the collegial body or the official;
koap-u116e8e9dc89b2f1456-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u51ad851b5f18908bd2-1.text: 3) whether the administrative offence record and other records provided for by this Code have been correctly drawn up, and whether the other case materials have been properly prepared;
koap-u51ad851b5f18908bd2-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u956c63e1267ed02d5f-1.text: 4) whether there are circumstances precluding proceedings in the case;
koap-u956c63e1267ed02d5f-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u3b10a519364eab5e66-1.text: 5) whether the available case materials are sufficient to consider it on the merits;
koap-u3b10a519364eab5e66-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ucd8db781cffaa5212f-1.text: 6) whether there are motions or applications for recusal;
koap-ucd8db781cffaa5212f-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u6c1792cf176b48363c-1.text: 7) whether there are grounds for participation in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system;
koap-u6c1792cf176b48363c-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u66212c6707ec50bc55-1.text: 8) whether a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or concerning an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, is in the territory of the Russian Federation, and, if it is established that the person is outside the Russian Federation, whether it was possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code.
koap-u66212c6707ec50bc55-1.locator: Article 29.1. Preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uc1fda505bd53d252d9-1.text: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
koap-uc1fda505bd53d252d9-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u663b50ee18714e7301-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official
koap-u663b50ee18714e7301-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u1f83dd5fc98ea9d39f-1.text: 1. A judge, member of a collegial body or official to whom an administrative offence case has been referred for consideration may not consider the case if that person:
koap-u1f83dd5fc98ea9d39f-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-uccee715236aa26f640-1.text: 1) is a relative of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the victim, a legal representative of an individual or legal entity, defence counsel or a representative;
koap-uccee715236aa26f640-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u8dd019d2d16d69876d-1.text: 2) has a personal, direct or indirect interest in the outcome of the case.
koap-u8dd019d2d16d69876d-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u1e254c18087c7c13b7-1.text: 2. The existence of information about an extra-procedural communication received by a judge concerning an administrative offence case being handled by that judge may not in itself be regarded as grounds for the judge’s recusal.
koap-u1e254c18087c7c13b7-1.locator: Article 29.2. Circumstances precluding consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u4a194df54548c845ae-1.text: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
koap-u4a194df54548c845ae-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u5f40f74954c419e7cd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official
koap-u5f40f74954c419e7cd-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-uaba5155971f714cf04-1.text: 1. Where the circumstances provided for by part 1 of Article 29.2 of this Code exist, the judge, member of a collegial body or official shall declare self-recusal. The declaration of self-recusal shall be submitted to the president of the relevant court, the head of the collegial body or the superior official.
koap-uaba5155971f714cf04-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u55c79b0e855b527435-1.text: 2. Where the circumstances provided for by part 1 of Article 29.2 of this Code exist, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the victim, a legal representative of an individual or legal entity, defence counsel, a representative or the prosecutor may apply for recusal of the judge, member of the collegial body or official.
koap-u55c79b0e855b527435-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-ue2ac24d504c93a31c8-1.text: 3. An application for recusal shall be considered by the judge, body or official handling the administrative offence case.
koap-ue2ac24d504c93a31c8-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-uf6bc542b98a1d72669-1.text: 4. Following consideration of a declaration of self-recusal or an application for recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official considering an administrative offence case, a procedural order granting or refusing the declaration or application shall be issued. If an application for recusal is refused, a repeat application for recusal by the same person on the same grounds shall not be permitted.
koap-uf6bc542b98a1d72669-1.locator: Article 29.3. Self-recusal and recusal of a judge, member of a collegial body or official

koap-u5b9dd1859a07b5462f-1.text: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u5b9dd1859a07b5462f-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub70362c77a63f7d81e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-ub70362c77a63f7d81e-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua73a0ca0b6ae8fb51e-1.text: 1. In preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case, the following questions shall be resolved and, where necessary, a procedural order shall be issued on them:
koap-ua73a0ca0b6ae8fb51e-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u97ff9afaef7974d208-1.text: 1) setting the time and place for consideration of the case;
koap-u97ff9afaef7974d208-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u558aebcea6b20ee2ec-1.text: 2) summoning the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.10 of this Code, requesting necessary additional case materials, and ordering an expert examination;
koap-u558aebcea6b20ee2ec-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u6f8e3b0af21aa765f8-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u150fbf5be56d80e3fc-1.text: 4) returning the administrative offence record and other case materials to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, where the record was drawn up and other case materials prepared by unauthorised persons, the record was incorrectly drawn up and other case materials improperly prepared, or the submitted materials are incomplete and that incompleteness cannot be remedied during consideration of the case;
koap-u150fbf5be56d80e3fc-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u0cb446e679b43f7df5-1.text: 5) forwarding the administrative offence record and other case materials for consideration by the competent authority, if consideration of the case does not fall within the competence of the judge, body or official to whom the administrative offence record and other case materials were submitted for consideration, or if a procedural order recusing the judge, the membership of the collegial body or the official has been issued;
koap-u0cb446e679b43f7df5-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u506b5e91e09b73b48e-1.text: 6) attaching property, refusing attachment of property or lifting an attachment imposed on property, in accordance with Article 27.20 of this Code;
koap-u506b5e91e09b73b48e-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8d0668aa30d518d514-1.text: 7) participation of the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.10 of this Code in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system in the cases provided for by Articles 29.14 - 29.16 of this Code;
koap-u8d0668aa30d518d514-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8fa6371c3e04092391-1.text: 8) appointing defence counsel for a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or concerning an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, if, at the time the relevant administrative offence case is considered, that person is outside the Russian Federation and it is not possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code;
koap-u8fa6371c3e04092391-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u2590f97e077db771a3-1.text: 9) returning the materials of an administrative offence case to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code, where that case concerns another person and/or another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or where, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against another person or in respect of another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
koap-u2590f97e077db771a3-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u9b88fc327fbff81562-1.text: 1.1. The procedural orders specified in points 3 and 7 of part 1 of this Article may also be issued during consideration of an administrative offence case.
koap-u9b88fc327fbff81562-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ufb9c2b18d80d0aa3e2-1.text: 2. Where the circumstances provided for by Article 24.5 of this Code exist, a ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case shall be issued.
koap-ufb9c2b18d80d0aa3e2-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub24ecd587926de16a0-1.text: 3. Where consideration of an administrative offence case has been adjourned because the persons specified in part 1 of Article 27.15 of this Code failed to appear without a valid reason, and their absence prevents a comprehensive, full, objective and timely ascertainment of the circumstances of the case and its resolution in accordance with the law, the judge, body or official considering the case shall issue a procedural order for compulsory appearance of those persons.
koap-ub24ecd587926de16a0-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud83c650352dabfc912-2.text: 4. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-ФЗ.
koap-ud83c650352dabfc912-2.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uce96de0ec3d707d456-1.text: 5. A copy of the procedural order specified in point 4 of part 1 of this Article, together with the case materials, shall be sent on the day that procedural order is issued to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and also the victim and prosecutor if participating.
koap-uce96de0ec3d707d456-1.locator: Article 29.4. Procedural orders and rulings issued in preparation for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u86dea7459707513d62-1.text: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u86dea7459707513d62-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u3ed40d0344fd6ca6fc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u3ed40d0344fd6ca6fc-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua902152a51eb2a37a0-1.text: 1. An administrative offence case shall be considered at the place where the offence was committed. Upon a motion by the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, the case may be considered at that person’s place of residence.
koap-ua902152a51eb2a37a0-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ube4941059e63b94a1c-1.text: 1.1. In cases provided for by an international treaty, an administrative offence case shall be considered at the place where the administrative offence was detected if it was committed in the territory of another state, except in the cases provided for by part 1.3 of this Article.
koap-ube4941059e63b94a1c-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u9b29f7dc18b76c9cc4-1.text: 1.2. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 19.3, 20.2 and 20.2.2 and part 1 of Article 20.25 (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code shall be considered at the place where the administrative offence was detected.
koap-u9b29f7dc18b76c9cc4-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u06b770e8d6d8960bd5-1.text: 1.3. Cases concerning administrative offences committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Articles 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 15.27.3, 17.13, 19.28 and 19.34, parts 3, 4 and 5 of Article 20.1, and Articles 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 and 20.33 of this Code, and concerning administrative offences consisting in failure to pay administrative fines imposed for commission of administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 and 19.34, parts 3, 4 and 5 of Article 20.1, and Articles 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 and 20.33 of this Code within the period provided for by this Code, shall be considered at the location of the bodies that initiated those cases.
koap-u06b770e8d6d8960bd5-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uc6236088b364931778-1.text: 2. An administrative offence case in which an administrative investigation was conducted shall be considered at the location of the body that conducted the administrative investigation.
koap-uc6236088b364931778-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua7e834d17c4ca266af-1.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences committed by minors, and administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.35, 6.10 and 20.22 of this Code, shall be considered at the place of residence of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted.
koap-ua7e834d17c4ca266af-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u75d72025f4acb67f17-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u4facf857f6732f6736-1.text: 5. A case concerning an administrative offence provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 or Chapter 12 of this Code, or an administrative offence in territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property and recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, and also a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system, shall be considered at the location of the body that received the materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, or the monitoring information system.
koap-u4facf857f6732f6736-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8f30d9fe73f77f8676-1.text: 6. A case concerning an administrative offence committed in Antarctica shall be considered at the place of residence of the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted.
koap-u8f30d9fe73f77f8676-1.locator: Article 29.5. Place of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u5ed125f9ff0a8d5ac7-1.text: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u5ed125f9ff0a8d5ac7-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u7b0b85170c796cb941-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u7b0b85170c796cb941-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-udf63cf997af671aeee-1.text: 1. An administrative offence case shall be considered within fifteen days from the day the body or official competent to consider the case receives the administrative offence record and other case materials, or materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions, photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, or the monitoring information system.
koap-udf63cf997af671aeee-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u77ec1148340afdebb1-1.text: 1.1. An administrative offence case shall be considered within two months from the day the judge competent to consider the case receives the administrative offence record and other case materials.
koap-u77ec1148340afdebb1-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-udbdc8f815134080a85-1.text: 2. Where motions are received from participants in proceedings in an administrative offence case or further clarification of the circumstances of the case is necessary, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the judge, body or official considering the case, but by no more than one month. Where a motion is received from the person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.21 or 15.30 of this Code, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the official considering it by no more than two months. Where a motion is received from the person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by part 15 or 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code, the period for consideration of the case may be extended by the judge considering it by no more than three months. The judge, body or official considering the case shall issue a reasoned procedural order extending that period.
koap-udbdc8f815134080a85-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8e88092204d86f86a8-1.text: 3. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code shall be considered within five days from the day the judge receives the administrative offence record and other case materials. Extension of that period shall not be permitted.
koap-u8e88092204d86f86a8-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud0bb5b57e132309326-1.text: 4. A case concerning an administrative offence entailing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be considered on the day the administrative offence record and other case materials are received, and, in relation to a person subjected to administrative detention, no later than 48 hours from the moment of detention, except for consideration of a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.48, part 9 of Article 19.34, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the period provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for commission of an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, initiated against a person who is outside the Russian Federation at the time the administrative offence case is considered.
koap-ud0bb5b57e132309326-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u3212aa84820197d71a-1.text: 5. A case concerning an administrative offence for which an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity may be imposed and a temporary prohibition of activity has been applied shall be considered no later than seven days from the actual cessation of the activities of branches, representative offices or structural subdivisions of a legal entity or production sites, and of the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of certain types of activity (work), or the provision of services. The period of temporary prohibition of activity shall be credited towards the period of administrative suspension of activity.
koap-u3212aa84820197d71a-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u203d71537c96b7938c-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u59ab705b5694ccdc22-1.text: 7. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 14.15.2 and 14.15.3 of this Code shall be considered within ten days from the day the judge receives the administrative offence record and other case materials. Extension of that period shall not be permitted.
koap-u59ab705b5694ccdc22-1.locator: Article 29.6. Time limits for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ucf4a87d1bc6eee0958-1.text: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-ucf4a87d1bc6eee0958-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u2cbe4cc516c4fd94fa-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u2cbe4cc516c4fd94fa-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua122ab9c199c00ec02-1.text: 1. When an administrative offence case is considered:
koap-ua122ab9c199c00ec02-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub7018f334f02e69fe9-1.text: 1) it shall be announced who is considering the case, which case is to be considered, and who is being held administratively liable and under which law;
koap-ub7018f334f02e69fe9-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua49bdc0645c87a2acc-1.text: 2) the attendance of the individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted shall be established, except in the cases provided for by part 3 of Article 28.6 of this Code, as shall the attendance of other persons participating in consideration of the case;
koap-ua49bdc0645c87a2acc-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u5e464b1c0c2ad8d9a6-1.text: 3) the powers of the legal representatives of the individual or legal entity, defence counsel and the representative shall be verified;
koap-u5e464b1c0c2ad8d9a6-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ua978b220b5d8e32dff-1.text: 4) it shall be ascertained whether participants in the proceedings have been duly notified, the reasons for participants’ failure to appear shall be established, and a decision shall be made to consider the case in their absence or to adjourn its consideration;
koap-ua978b220b5d8e32dff-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1f5dda2dde1f66f25e-1.text: 5) persons participating in consideration of the case shall have their rights and duties explained to them;
koap-u1f5dda2dde1f66f25e-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ufecc98a290e2e1d41e-1.text: 6) submitted applications for recusal and motions shall be considered;
koap-ufecc98a290e2e1d41e-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ue7d3448912afac16d2-1.text: 7) a procedural order adjourning consideration of the case shall be issued where:
koap-ue7d3448912afac16d2-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub71526339e26418df8-1.text: а) a declaration of self-recusal or an application for recusal of the judge, member of the collegial body or official considering the case is received, if their recusal prevents consideration of the case on the merits;
koap-ub71526339e26418df8-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u6526628dd444461479-1.text: б) a specialist, expert or interpreter is recused, if that recusal prevents consideration of the case on the merits;
koap-u6526628dd444461479-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub70802fd0ffbfd3f0b-1.text: в) it is necessary for a person participating in consideration of the case to appear, to request additional case materials or to order an expert examination;
koap-ub70802fd0ffbfd3f0b-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ue92a22057c4155b2c9-1.text: г) malfunctions arise when using videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system;
koap-ue92a22057c4155b2c9-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u3e5aac382fe99a6e8e-1.text: д) the judge, body or official considering the case has reasonable doubts as to whether the person participating in consideration of the case is the person who underwent identification or authentication, or concerning that person’s expression of will;
koap-u3e5aac382fe99a6e8e-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u60c5e292f8a893d7ae-1.text: 8) a procedural order shall be issued for compulsory appearance of a person whose participation in consideration of the case is recognised as mandatory, in accordance with part 3 of Article 29.4 of this Code;
koap-u60c5e292f8a893d7ae-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u42d31a98752279a766-1.text: 9) a procedural order shall be issued transferring the case for consideration by the competent authority in accordance with Article 29.5 of this Code;
koap-u42d31a98752279a766-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uf3f67cfc61d09d8e2e-1.text: 10) a procedural order shall be issued appointing defence counsel for a person against whom proceedings are being conducted in a case concerning an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for commission of such an administrative offence within the period provided for by this Code, if, at the time the administrative offence case is considered, that person is outside the Russian Federation and it is not possible to duly notify that person in accordance with the procedure provided for by this Code.
koap-uf3f67cfc61d09d8e2e-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ud82a2aa590aec9632a-1.text: 2. When consideration of the administrative offence case continues, the administrative offence record and, where necessary, other case materials shall be read out. The explanations of the individual or legal representative of the legal entity against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, testimony of other persons participating in the proceedings, explanations of the specialist and the expert’s opinion shall be heard, other evidence shall be examined, and, where the prosecutor participates in consideration of the case, the prosecutor’s opinion shall be heard.
koap-ud82a2aa590aec9632a-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u6e298e7e410c6ec647-1.text: 3. Where necessary, other procedural actions shall be performed in accordance with this Code.
koap-u6e298e7e410c6ec647-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ubb59cc4d918250ae0a-1.text: 4. An administrative offence case whose materials are attached to a record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code in accordance with the procedure provided for by part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code shall be considered by the judge to whom that record was sent, where that case concerns the same person and the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or where, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
koap-ubb59cc4d918250ae0a-1.locator: Article 29.7. Procedure for consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-uee7b8226aefb7200b9-1.text: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-uee7b8226aefb7200b9-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u9559c77c86c4dc4fae-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case
koap-u9559c77c86c4dc4fae-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-ub675c714803cbba1b8-1.text: 1. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall be drawn up when the case is considered by a collegial body.
koap-ub675c714803cbba1b8-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u04e3bade5f5e355a79-1.text: 2. The minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall specify:
koap-u04e3bade5f5e355a79-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u8973e47eeaf664000d-1.text: 1) the date and place of consideration of the case;
koap-u8973e47eeaf664000d-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u4faec25eb9abc68553-1.text: 2) the name and membership of the collegial body considering the case;
koap-u4faec25eb9abc68553-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u861220a13f8daf8317-1.text: 3) the occurrence of the administrative offence under consideration;
koap-u861220a13f8daf8317-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u5d77deb99bdd3b3d5e-1.text: 4) information on the attendance of persons participating in consideration of the case and on due notification of absent persons;
koap-u5d77deb99bdd3b3d5e-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1ee3d3ceef3d79d28e-1.text: 5) applications for recusal, motions and the results of their consideration;
koap-u1ee3d3ceef3d79d28e-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u446a275013c24796d7-1.text: 6) explanations, testimony, clarifications and opinions of the relevant persons participating in consideration of the case;
koap-u446a275013c24796d7-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u1c57d5cc590d5a9ece-1.text: 7) documents examined during consideration of the case.
koap-u1c57d5cc590d5a9ece-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u2d08b63f19d2eefff7-1.text: 3. The minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case shall be signed by the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body and the secretary of that meeting.
koap-u2d08b63f19d2eefff7-1.locator: Article 29.8. Minutes of consideration of an administrative offence case

koap-u0e612ff64462f1bb63-1.text: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
koap-u0e612ff64462f1bb63-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u18ae14292f025faa2e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
koap-u18ae14292f025faa2e-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u4994c1dc3afab5f376-1.text: 1. Following consideration of an administrative offence case, a ruling may be issued:
koap-u4994c1dc3afab5f376-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u6a139d7894d377ae88-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uc30bd2e1e96de575fc-1.text: 2) terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case;
koap-uc30bd2e1e96de575fc-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u9c98af53b978ed8ccc-1.text: 3) imposing an administrative penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code and terminating proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by another Article (part of an Article) of Chapter 12 of this Code, proceedings in which are being conducted against the same person in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction);
koap-u9c98af53b978ed8ccc-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uec338bb5af1b11ccc9-1.text: 4) imposing an administrative penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code, and also quashing a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), in which proceedings were conducted against the same person, and terminating proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code;
koap-uec338bb5af1b11ccc9-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u9de328658dc7c20fe4-1.text: 5) terminating proceedings in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, and also leaving unchanged a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence provided for by Chapter 12 of this Code in respect of the same occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), in which proceedings were conducted against the same person.
koap-u9de328658dc7c20fe4-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u9d3498d91331c9dc36-1.text: 1.1. A ruling terminating proceedings in an administrative offence case shall be issued where:
koap-u9d3498d91331c9dc36-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ucc1a6f5a2fee9c93c9-1.text: 1) at least one of the circumstances provided for by Article 24.5 of this Code exists;
koap-ucc1a6f5a2fee9c93c9-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u27d8848eee5836bb22-1.text: 2) an oral admonition is given in accordance with Article 2.9 of this Code;
koap-u27d8848eee5836bb22-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ubb91c49dbfb048a6c2-1.text: 3) proceedings in the case are terminated and the case materials are transferred to the prosecutor, a preliminary investigation body or an inquiry body where the actions (inaction) contain indications of a crime;
koap-ubb91c49dbfb048a6c2-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ue078c43d06465e7d8c-1.text: 4) a person is exempted from administrative liability for the administrative offences provided for by Articles 6.8 and 6.9, parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5, Articles 14.32, 15.11, 15.15.6, 15.21, 15.27.3 and 15.30, parts 1 and 2 of Article 16.2, Articles 19.7.13, 19.15.1, 19.15.2 and 19.28, and part 2 of Article 20.20 of this Code, in accordance with the notes to those Articles.
koap-ue078c43d06465e7d8c-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u4564967aa8734dccf2-1.text: 2. Following consideration of an administrative offence case, a procedural order shall be issued:
koap-u4564967aa8734dccf2-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u0e6652abc9f43a796e-1.text: 1) transferring the case to a judge, body or official authorised to impose administrative penalties of a different type or amount or to apply other measures in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
koap-u0e6652abc9f43a796e-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u180024c84bb0e072d0-1.text: 2) transferring the case for consideration by the competent authority if it is established that consideration of the case does not fall within the competence of the judge, body or official that considered it;
koap-u180024c84bb0e072d0-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u4c62aba10489a55e71-1.text: 3) returning the administrative offence record and other case materials to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, where the record was drawn up and other case materials prepared by unauthorised persons, the record was incorrectly drawn up and other case materials improperly prepared, or the submitted materials are incomplete and that incompleteness cannot be remedied during consideration of the case;
koap-u4c62aba10489a55e71-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u673201410ffa8d8d7a-1.text: 4) returning the administrative offence case to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code, if it is established that the case concerns another person and/or another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction), or that, in proceedings in that case, a ruling imposing an administrative penalty was issued against another person or in respect of another occurrence of unlawful actions (inaction).
koap-u673201410ffa8d8d7a-1.locator: Article 29.9. Types of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u04c15bb97d9d562354-1.text: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u04c15bb97d9d562354-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u9a552583fb83198b39-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u9a552583fb83198b39-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u472922f1ba76c20bb6-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall specify:
koap-u472922f1ba76c20bb6-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uba58ffbc56659adb1f-1.text: 1) the position, surname, first name and patronymic of the judge or official, or the name and membership of the collegial body, that issued the ruling, and their address;
koap-uba58ffbc56659adb1f-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u922cb5e00c636289b0-1.text: 2) the date and place of consideration of the case;
koap-u922cb5e00c636289b0-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud5caafd6ad00924ddd-1.text: 3) particulars of the person in respect of whom the case was considered;
koap-ud5caafd6ad00924ddd-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uea060ed72f298f6fe4-1.text: 4) the circumstances established during consideration of the case;
koap-uea060ed72f298f6fe4-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2fdb92ef861195a759-1.text: 5) the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for commission of the administrative offence, or the grounds for terminating proceedings in the case;
koap-u2fdb92ef861195a759-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud166dba45be64ae676-1.text: 6) a reasoned decision in the case;
koap-ud166dba45be64ae676-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf8806d8b536379b359-1.text: 7) the time limit and procedure for appealing the ruling.
koap-uf8806d8b536379b359-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u98b068ff06dd8ccbfe-1.text: 1.1. Where an administrative fine is imposed, in addition to the information specified in part 1 of this Article, the ruling in the administrative offence case shall contain the information required under the rules for completing payment documents for transfer of the amount of an administrative fine provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the national payment system, and information on the amount of the administrative fine that may be paid in accordance with parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, indicating the unique charge identifier.
koap-u98b068ff06dd8ccbfe-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud538a7315c800aea1a-1.text: 2. If, when a judge decides whether to impose an administrative penalty for an administrative offence, the question of compensation for property damage is also decided, the ruling in the administrative offence case shall specify the amount of damage to be compensated and the time limits and procedure for compensation.
koap-ud538a7315c800aea1a-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u9d41ca3ac7a4a79f56-1.text: When a judge imposes an administrative penalty in the form of administrative suspension of activity, the question shall be decided of measures necessary to ensure enforcement of that administrative penalty and consisting in prohibiting the activities of persons conducting entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, legal entities and their branches, representative offices, structural subdivisions and production sites, and the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the performance of certain types of activity (work), or the provision of services; and, where administrative suspension of activity is imposed as an administrative penalty for violation of the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating the legalisation (laundering) of proceeds of crime and the financing of terrorism, the question of measures necessary to suspend transactions on accounts shall also be decided.
koap-u9d41ca3ac7a4a79f56-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf3de55da06f785f6f6-1.text: When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case, the judge shall decide whether to return the security for an arrested vessel to the person who provided it or to forfeit that security to the state, and this shall be stated in the ruling in the administrative offence case.
koap-uf3de55da06f785f6f6-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u5c949309815ba094ad-1.text: When issuing a ruling in an administrative offence case concerning a foreign citizen or stateless person, the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall decide whether to place the foreign citizen or stateless person in a special institution if imposing on that person an administrative penalty in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-u5c949309815ba094ad-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc64b5d1332e5720eb0-1.text: When imposing an administrative penalty with an obligation to undergo diagnostics, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and/or medical and/or social rehabilitation in connection with consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription or new potentially dangerous psychoactive substances, the judge shall specify in the ruling in the administrative offence case the period within which the person must apply to the relevant medical organisation or social rehabilitation institution. That period shall be calculated from the day the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-uc64b5d1332e5720eb0-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u26c8cb123a14854096-1.text: 3. The ruling in an administrative offence case shall resolve questions concerning seized things and documents, things under attachment if an administrative penalty in the form of confiscation has not been or cannot be applied to them, and the security deposited for an arrested vessel. In this connection:
koap-u26c8cb123a14854096-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u4474c940b5f056f1e7-1.text: 1) things and documents not withdrawn from circulation shall be returned to their lawful owner or holder, and, if that person cannot be identified, transferred into state ownership in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
koap-u4474c940b5f056f1e7-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u729d85767c45f13b52-1.text: 2) things withdrawn from circulation shall be transferred to the appropriate organisations or destroyed;
koap-u729d85767c45f13b52-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u717b837daa53d68337-1.text: 2.1) light-industry goods seized from illegal circulation, the list of which is established by the Government of the Russian Federation, shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation;
koap-u717b837daa53d68337-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u3a034afcecc827c3ba-1.text: 3) documents constituting physical evidence shall remain in the case file throughout its retention period or be transferred to interested persons in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation;
koap-u3a034afcecc827c3ba-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u86ddb3534b81d7cce1-1.text: 4) seized orders, medals and badges accompanying honorary titles of the Russian Federation, the RSFSR and the USSR shall be returned to their lawful owner or holder or, if that person is unknown, sent to the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation;
koap-u86ddb3534b81d7cce1-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc4247a6b7ef120199f-1.text: 5) restrictions relating to possession, use and disposal of attached property established in accordance with Article 27.20 of this Code shall remain in force until the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is enforced.
koap-uc4247a6b7ef120199f-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue33253c885b8e0c76b-1.text: 4. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegial body shall be adopted by a simple majority of the votes of members of the collegial body present at the meeting.
koap-ue33253c885b8e0c76b-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub61c1e7002009cb879-1.text: 5. The ruling in an administrative offence case shall be signed by the judge, the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body, or the official who issued the ruling.
koap-ub61c1e7002009cb879-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-udd63decaa01d6941f0-1.text: 5.1 - 8. Repealed from 1 July 2025. — Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-ФЗ.
koap-udd63decaa01d6941f0-1.locator: Article 29.10. Ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue8e2d7b39a1bffd479-1.text: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
koap-ue8e2d7b39a1bffd479-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uc3f0c5fb83e5b3cfcd-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case
koap-uc3f0c5fb83e5b3cfcd-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ue80dc2502326a85554-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be announced immediately upon completion of consideration of the case. In exceptional cases, by decision of the person (body) considering the administrative offence case, preparation of a reasoned ruling may be deferred for no more than three days from the day the hearing ends, except in administrative offence cases specified in parts 3 - 5 of Article 29.6 of this Code; the operative part of the ruling shall nevertheless be announced immediately upon completion of consideration of the case. The day the ruling is prepared in full shall be the day it is issued.
koap-ue80dc2502326a85554-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uc8c278747583bb3363-1.text: 2. A copy of the ruling in an administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the individual, the individual’s legal representative or the legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it was issued, and also to the victim upon request, or sent to those persons by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-uc8c278747583bb3363-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ub955768d1a79508138-1.text: A copy of a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
koap-ub955768d1a79508138-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u22ada1e590792ef13b-1.text: 2.1. A copy of the procedural order specified in point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, together with the case materials, shall be sent on the day that procedural order is issued to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and also the victim and prosecutor if participating.
koap-u22ada1e590792ef13b-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ue06ac8b4692302da78-1.text: 3. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 20.8, 20.9 and 20.12 of this Code against a person to whom firearms and ammunition (cartridges) have been entrusted in connection with the performance of official duties or provided for temporary use by an organisation, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to the relevant organisation.
koap-ue06ac8b4692302da78-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u022e48c9b04234f708-1.text: 4. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 18.9, 18.15 and 18.17 of this Code against an organisation that is a member of a self-regulatory organisation in engineering surveys, architectural and construction design, construction, reconstruction or major repair of capital construction facilities, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to that self-regulatory organisation.
koap-u022e48c9b04234f708-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uc0fad4c6a07de4c9f1-1.text: 5. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 6.9 and part 2 of Article 20.20 of this Code, a copy of the ruling terminating proceedings in the administrative offence case on the ground provided for by the note to Article 6.9 of this Code, or imposing an administrative penalty with an obligation to undergo diagnostics, preventive measures, treatment for drug addiction and/or medical and/or social rehabilitation in connection with consumption of narcotic drugs or psychotropic substances without a doctor’s prescription, shall be sent to the relevant medical organisation or social rehabilitation institution.
koap-uc0fad4c6a07de4c9f1-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ua4defc045316529d5c-1.text: 6. In cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 6 of Article 11.17 of this Code, a copy of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be sent to the carrier on board whose aircraft the relevant administrative offence was committed.
koap-ua4defc045316529d5c-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-uee5a2ced0911b2ffd1-1.text: 7. Copies of the rulings provided for by points 3 - 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall, no later than the day following the day those rulings enter into legal force, be sent to the judge (body) to whom the procedural order requesting materials of the administrative offence case specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code was sent, and to the body whose official sent the record of an administrative offence provided for by Article 12.24 of this Code and the attached materials specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
koap-uee5a2ced0911b2ffd1-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-u9b492c9d56bef58c0c-1.text: 8. A copy of the ruling provided for by point 4 or 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall, no later than one day after the day the relevant ruling enters into legal force, be sent to the body or official authorised to enforce the ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the administrative offence case in which proceedings have been terminated in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
koap-u9b492c9d56bef58c0c-1.locator: Article 29.11. Announcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case and sending (delivery) of copies of rulings and procedural orders in an administrative offence case

koap-ucc263a3dd3d3496c38-1.text: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
koap-ucc263a3dd3d3496c38-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-ua033bc49f26c13ec03-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case
koap-ua033bc49f26c13ec03-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-uf82e199ddeb3a92ea1-1.text: 1. A procedural order in an administrative offence case shall specify:
koap-uf82e199ddeb3a92ea1-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-ufdb0b339adf5807140-1.text: 1) the position, surname and initials of the judge or official, or the name and membership of the collegial body, that issued the procedural order;
koap-ufdb0b339adf5807140-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-ue23bf7558d85dd1517-1.text: 2) the date and place of consideration of the application, motion or case materials;
koap-ue23bf7558d85dd1517-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-u162a9af83302d9cae0-1.text: 3) particulars of the person who submitted the application or motion or in respect of whom the case materials were considered;
koap-u162a9af83302d9cae0-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-u7c4d37a94365943c8c-1.text: 4) the content of the application or motion;
koap-u7c4d37a94365943c8c-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-uc56f77876144e80d04-1.text: 5) the circumstances established during consideration of the application, motion or case materials;
koap-uc56f77876144e80d04-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-uccd4d8f9a90207b5ec-1.text: 6) the decision adopted following consideration of the application, motion or case materials.
koap-uccd4d8f9a90207b5ec-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-u2c0e2a5355cdd5e0c1-1.text: 2. A procedural order in an administrative offence case issued by a collegial body shall be adopted by a simple majority of the votes of members of the collegial body present at the meeting.
koap-u2c0e2a5355cdd5e0c1-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-u79cc7ee52b2d5a5d8b-1.text: 3. The procedural order in an administrative offence case shall be signed by the judge, the person presiding at the meeting of the collegial body, or the official who issued the procedural order.
koap-u79cc7ee52b2d5a5d8b-1.locator: Article 29.12. Procedural order in an administrative offence case

koap-u875f1899a22dd80eb7-1.text: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
koap-u875f1899a22dd80eb7-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-u02fe7c7f235f3d1ae0-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors
koap-u02fe7c7f235f3d1ae0-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-u1e9f41fa607b3618b1-1.text: 1. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case may, upon an application by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 and 25.11 of this Code, an enforcement bailiff, or a body or official enforcing the ruling or procedural order in the administrative offence case, or on their own initiative, correct clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors in the ruling or procedural order without changing its content.
koap-u1e9f41fa607b3618b1-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-ubfb8a7716d928f3d5c-1.text: 2. Clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors in a ruling or decision adopted following consideration of appeals or protests against a ruling or decision in an administrative offence case shall be corrected in accordance with the procedure established by this Article.
koap-ubfb8a7716d928f3d5c-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-u5892d657e43297f908-1.text: 3. A clerical error, typographical error or arithmetic error shall be corrected by a procedural order.
koap-u5892d657e43297f908-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-ue996ce9af76d59d260-1.text: 4.
