A copy of the procedural order concerning corrections made to a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case, and a copy of the procedural order concerning corrections made to a ruling or decision adopted following consideration of appeals or protests against a ruling or decision in an administrative offence case, shall, within three days from the day the relevant procedural order is issued, be sent to the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 and 25.11 of this Code, the enforcement bailiff, or the body or official enforcing the ruling or procedural order in the administrative offence case, if they submitted the relevant application.
koap-ue996ce9af76d59d260-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-u83928fc76d8419def0-1.text: 5. A copy of a procedural order issued by a judge concerning corrections made to a ruling in an administrative offence case or to the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record or to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up that record, within three days from the day the relevant procedural order is issued.
koap-u83928fc76d8419def0-1.locator: Article 29.12.1. Correction of clerical errors, typographical errors and arithmetic errors

koap-u79aaf6a970155059cb-1.text: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
koap-u79aaf6a970155059cb-1.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence

koap-u8b23ba53993e157c2d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence
koap-u8b23ba53993e157c2d-1.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence

koap-u507370d0ea44828876-1.text: 1. Upon establishing the causes of an administrative offence and the conditions contributing to its commission, the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case shall submit a formal submission to the relevant organisations and officials to take measures to eliminate those causes and conditions.
koap-u507370d0ea44828876-1.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence

koap-ua6fb54ecbef63ffdf9-1.text: 2. Organisations and officials shall consider a formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence within one month from the day it is received and inform the judge, body or official that submitted it of the measures taken.
koap-ua6fb54ecbef63ffdf9-1.locator: Article 29.13. Formal submission to eliminate the causes and conditions contributing to commission of an administrative offence

koap-u98f3f39e960bd29477-1.text: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
koap-u98f3f39e960bd29477-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-ub7d119acd56904e914-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge
koap-ub7d119acd56904e914-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u24e11864b87bd0a0b4-1.text: 1. Where a judge has recognised as mandatory the presence of a participant in administrative offence proceedings during consideration of the administrative offence case, but that participant cannot be present for objective reasons, the judge shall, upon a motion by the participant or on the judge’s own initiative, decide on that person’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems, where technically possible.
koap-u24e11864b87bd0a0b4-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u4ab8e891ca13fb29cf-1.text: 2. Courts’ videoconferencing systems may be used in the court at the place of residence, stay or location of a participant in administrative offence proceedings whose presence has been recognised as mandatory but who cannot attend consideration of the administrative offence case. To ensure participation in consideration of an administrative offence case of persons in places of custody or imprisonment, places where administrative arrest is served, special institutions for holding foreign citizens and stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission, or places of compulsory confinement of bodies authorised to carry out administrative detention, the videoconferencing systems of the relevant bodies and institutions shall be used.
koap-u4ab8e891ca13fb29cf-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u96456ab47184ee8e45-1.text: 3. The judge shall issue a procedural order on participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by persons whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. Copies of that procedural order shall, no later than the working day following the day it is issued, be sent to the relevant participants in the administrative offence proceedings and to the relevant court, body or institution instructed to ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
koap-u96456ab47184ee8e45-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u9010b3361c66f227f0-1.text: 4. The judge considering an administrative offence case shall establish a connection with the court, body or institution ensuring participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by a person whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. A judge, an official authorised to consider administrative offence cases, or an employee of the institution shall ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
koap-u9010b3361c66f227f0-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u3e6da1b3c4aa1aa2e5-1.text: The judge, official or employee of the institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall assist the judge considering the administrative offence case in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing, and in performing other procedural actions, in particular obtaining from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters written acknowledgements that the judge considering the administrative offence case has explained their rights and duties and warned them of liability for failure to perform them, and receiving written materials from participants in the administrative offence proceedings.
koap-u3e6da1b3c4aa1aa2e5-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u2bf62e8d89e4e1bbef-1.text: 5. All documents received at the court, body or institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall be sent to the court considering that case no later than the working day following the day the administrative offence case was considered.
koap-u2bf62e8d89e4e1bbef-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u6b702bc5309e10313c-1.text: 6. The judge considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems where:
koap-u6b702bc5309e10313c-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u05eaca4fcdba408eb4-1.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems;
koap-u05eaca4fcdba408eb4-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-1.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u2919ebfa9235f34b00-1.text: 7. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a judge considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
koap-u2919ebfa9235f34b00-1.locator: Article 29.14. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a judge

koap-u9985ef20bb953ae7f8-1.text: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
koap-u9985ef20bb953ae7f8-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u5ec183e1203b806652-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official
koap-u5ec183e1203b806652-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u9ab27aff4fa349c7fa-1.text: 1. Where a body or official has recognised as mandatory the presence of a participant in administrative offence proceedings during consideration of the administrative offence case, but that participant cannot be present for objective reasons, the body or official shall, upon a motion by the participant in that case or on their own initiative, decide on that person’s participation in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems, where technically possible.
koap-u9ab27aff4fa349c7fa-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u6f894e195959c95542-1.text: 2. Videoconferencing systems of bodies whose officials are authorised to consider administrative offence cases may be used at the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body or structural subdivision of the territorial body at the place of residence, stay or location of a participant in administrative offence proceedings whose presence has been recognised as mandatory but who cannot attend consideration of the case. To ensure participation in consideration of an administrative offence case of persons in places of custody or imprisonment, places where administrative arrest is served, special institutions for holding foreign citizens and stateless persons subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, deportation or readmission, or places of compulsory confinement of bodies authorised to carry out administrative detention, the videoconferencing systems of the relevant bodies and institutions shall be used.
koap-u6f894e195959c95542-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u24d83b64d359294db2-1.text: 3. The body or official shall issue a procedural order on participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the administrative offence case by persons whose presence has been recognised as mandatory. Copies of that procedural order shall, no later than the working day following the day it is issued, be sent to the relevant participants in the administrative offence proceedings and to the relevant body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution instructed to ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
koap-u24d83b64d359294db2-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-ub70cc80ccd62413421-1.text: 4. The body or official considering an administrative offence case shall establish a connection with the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution ensuring participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of the case by a person whose presence during consideration of that case has been recognised as mandatory. An official authorised to consider administrative offence cases or an employee of the institution shall ensure a participant’s participation in consideration of that administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems.
koap-ub70cc80ccd62413421-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u37c122fa23dca395f8-1.text: The official or employee of the institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall assist the body or official considering the case in checking attendance and establishing the identity of the persons appearing, and in performing other procedural actions, in particular obtaining from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters written acknowledgements that the body or official considering the case has explained their rights and duties and warned them of liability for failure to perform them, and receiving written materials from participants in the administrative offence proceedings.
koap-u37c122fa23dca395f8-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u4fdf5791b41012e1c1-1.text: 5. All documents received at the body, structural subdivision of the body, territorial body, structural subdivision of the territorial body or institution ensuring participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems shall be sent to the body or official considering that case no later than the working day following the day the administrative offence case was considered.
koap-u4fdf5791b41012e1c1-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-uded659e2d8d5167b36-1.text: 6. The body or official considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the case through videoconferencing systems where:
koap-uded659e2d8d5167b36-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u05eaca4fcdba408eb4-2.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through videoconferencing systems;
koap-u05eaca4fcdba408eb4-2.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-2.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-2.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-ub09920dfa81c9429ba-1.text: 7. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a body or official considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
koap-ub09920dfa81c9429ba-1.locator: Article 29.15. Participation through videoconferencing systems in consideration of an administrative offence case by a body or official

koap-u18cbdd837739d18313-1.text: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
koap-u18cbdd837739d18313-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u86c6cc9fced76cbd21-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system
koap-u86c6cc9fced76cbd21-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-udfd055b1fe61cc0f7d-1.text: 1. Participants in administrative offence proceedings may participate in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system upon their motion or on the initiative of the judge, body or official considering the case, provided that the participants in that case have the technical capability, where proper consideration and resolution of the case require the participation of a person who cannot participate for objective reasons, and provided that the court, body or official has the technical capability to conduct a web conference.
koap-udfd055b1fe61cc0f7d-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u4b9b494bff0b6c5134-1.text: The judge, body or official shall issue a procedural order on participation of the persons specified in the first paragraph of this part in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system, stating the time of consideration of the case. The information necessary for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system shall be sent to the relevant participants in the proceedings in advance in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 25.15 of this Code.
koap-u4b9b494bff0b6c5134-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-ubba75e9f28b1cf8602-1.text: The identity of a participant in administrative offence proceedings participating in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system shall be established using information technology tools enabling identification of a person without their physical presence (the unified identification and authentication system and the unified biometric system).
koap-ubba75e9f28b1cf8602-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u93cd13a5c14d7aedd0-1.text: 2. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case shall obtain from the victim, witnesses, specialists, experts and interpreters participating in consideration of the case through the Unified Portal a written acknowledgement that their rights and duties have been explained and that they have been warned of liability for failure to perform them, which shall be submitted to the court, body or official electronically, including in the form of an electronic document. Such an acknowledgement produced in the form of an electronic document shall be signed with a simple electronic signature.
koap-u93cd13a5c14d7aedd0-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-udc569997ddce107fa1-1.text: 3. The judge, body or official considering an administrative offence case shall refuse a motion to participate in consideration of the case through a web-conferencing system where:
koap-udc569997ddce107fa1-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u77b69906a08cd001cd-1.text: 1) there is no technical capability for participation in consideration of the administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system;
koap-u77b69906a08cd001cd-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-3.text: 2) a decision has been adopted to consider the administrative offence case in a closed hearing.
koap-u61117420088bdf7a90-3.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-u29d32439b74b360eea-1.text: 4. The rules established by this Article shall apply when a judge, body or official considers an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
koap-u29d32439b74b360eea-1.locator: Article 29.16. Participation in consideration of an administrative offence case through a web-conferencing system

koap-uf7b815bb9f8899b3fe-1.text: Chapter 29.1. Legal assistance in administrative offence cases
koap-uf7b815bb9f8899b3fe-1.locator: Chapter 29.1. Legal assistance in administrative offence cases

koap-u09b935ebaaa7b47c2b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 29.1. LEGAL ASSISTANCE IN ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCE CASES
koap-u09b935ebaaa7b47c2b-1.locator: Chapter 29.1. Legal assistance in administrative offence cases

koap-u461a76f3b59fb451d4-1.text: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
koap-u461a76f3b59fb451d4-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u0b84a0938c51083b2f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance
koap-u0b84a0938c51083b2f-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u17eb6848162bb42200-1.text: 1. Where procedural actions provided for by this Code need to be performed in the territory of a foreign state, the official conducting proceedings in the administrative offence case shall send a request for legal assistance to the relevant official or body of the foreign state in accordance with an international treaty of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, which shall be presumed unless proved otherwise.
koap-u17eb6848162bb42200-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u4f13d6ccf988bb497f-1.text: 2. A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases shall be sent through:
koap-u4f13d6ccf988bb497f-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-uf82921ec4f7fffe792-1.text: 1) the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation — on matters concerning the judicial activities of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation;
koap-uf82921ec4f7fffe792-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u031b74964cfb8ec1f5-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-ub86b74123966d00c19-1.text: 3) the Ministry of Justice of the Russian Federation — on matters connected with the judicial activities of courts, except in the cases specified in point 1 of this part;
koap-ub86b74123966d00c19-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u89f867e941ffd6c870-1.text: 4) the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation and the Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation — in relation to procedural actions concerning their administrative activities;
koap-u89f867e941ffd6c870-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-ub511c2340d983d5ed0-1.text: 5) the body authorised under an international treaty of the Russian Federation on legal assistance to send and receive requests connected with implementation of the relevant international treaty;
koap-ub511c2340d983d5ed0-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u69f4b9325d615a7aa8-1.text: 6) the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation — in other cases.
koap-u69f4b9325d615a7aa8-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-ua19e9367798e90da75-1.text: 3. A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases and the documents attached to it shall be accompanied by a certified translation into the official language of the requested state, unless otherwise provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation.
koap-ua19e9367798e90da75-1.locator: Article 29.1.1. Sending a request for legal assistance

koap-u413ed818682069c3c4-1.text: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
koap-u413ed818682069c3c4-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-ua65f08ca707b647f27-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance
koap-ua65f08ca707b647f27-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-u5978649505a9325424-1.text: A request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases shall be drawn up in writing, signed by the official sending it, certified with the official seal bearing the coat of arms of the relevant body, and shall contain:
koap-u5978649505a9325424-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-u26f1e8f6fcc089bc3e-1.text: 1) the name of the body issuing the request for legal assistance;
koap-u26f1e8f6fcc089bc3e-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-u433bf7ba10de686145-1.text: 2) the name and location of the body to which the request for legal assistance is sent;
koap-u433bf7ba10de686145-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-u0e72208170b128d86d-1.text: 3) the designation of the administrative offence case and the nature of the request for legal assistance;
koap-u0e72208170b128d86d-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-u76fbe9b92d16348401-1.text: 4) particulars of the persons in respect of whom the request for legal assistance is sent, including their date and place of birth, citizenship, occupation, place of residence or stay, and, for legal entities, their name and location;
koap-u76fbe9b92d16348401-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-ue8ef80b27bad198e17-1.text: 5) a statement of the circumstances to be clarified and a list of the documents, physical evidence and other evidence requested;
koap-ue8ef80b27bad198e17-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-ud14c191cc7f1dc104a-1.text: 6) information on the factual circumstances of the administrative offence committed, its legal classification, the text of the relevant Article of this Code, and, where necessary, information on the amount of harm caused by that offence.
koap-ud14c191cc7f1dc104a-1.locator: Article 29.1.2. Content and form of a request for legal assistance

koap-uc8b06754915184b0bf-1.text: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
koap-uc8b06754915184b0bf-1.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state

koap-u1f5eb6f79179944765-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state
koap-u1f5eb6f79179944765-1.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state

koap-udcd8c29672f608302d-1.text: Evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state by its officials while executing a request for legal assistance in administrative offence cases, or sent to the Russian Federation as an attachment to a request to undertake administrative prosecution in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, certified and transmitted in the established manner, shall have the same legal force as if it had been obtained in the territory of the Russian Federation in accordance with the requirements of this Code.
koap-udcd8c29672f608302d-1.locator: Article 29.1.3. Legal force of evidence obtained in the territory of a foreign state

koap-u5ce6e7f8c18033416b-1.text: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u5ce6e7f8c18033416b-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u5efde7754b80cd3572-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u5efde7754b80cd3572-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u03ddb1ce050628d0c3-1.text: 1. A witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation may, with their consent, be summoned by the official handling the administrative offence case to participate in procedural actions in the territory of the Russian Federation.
koap-u03ddb1ce050628d0c3-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u16dcc400e8df310bb4-1.text: 2. A request to summon a person shall be sent in accordance with the procedure established by part 2 of Article 29.1.1 of this Code.
koap-u16dcc400e8df310bb4-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u7415f1ee2fe984397c-1.text: 3. Procedural actions involving persons specified in part 1 of this Article who have appeared in response to a summons shall be performed in accordance with the procedure established by this Code.
koap-u7415f1ee2fe984397c-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u42c1fbf85c0ad29bef-1.text: 4. Persons specified in part 1 of this Article who have appeared in response to a summons may not, in the territory of the Russian Federation, be charged as accused persons, taken into custody or subjected to other restrictions on personal liberty for acts committed or on the basis of judgments delivered before those persons crossed the State Border of the Russian Federation. That guarantee shall cease to apply if a person who has appeared in response to a summons, having had the opportunity to leave the territory of the Russian Federation before expiry of a continuous period of 15 days from the moment they were officially notified that their presence was no longer required by the official who summoned them, remains in that territory or returns to the Russian Federation after leaving.
koap-u42c1fbf85c0ad29bef-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u17c242336385e0d2b3-1.text: 5. A person held in custody in the territory of a foreign state shall be summoned in accordance with the procedure established by this Article provided that the person is temporarily transferred to the territory of the Russian Federation by the competent body or official of the foreign state to perform the actions specified in the request to summon the person. That person shall remain in custody throughout their stay in the territory of the Russian Federation, with the relevant decision of the competent body of the foreign state serving as the basis for custody. The person shall be returned to the territory of the relevant foreign state within the periods specified in the response to the request to summon the person. The conditions for transfer or refusal of transfer shall be determined by international treaties of the Russian Federation or written undertakings concerning cooperation on the basis of reciprocity.
koap-u17c242336385e0d2b3-1.locator: Article 29.1.4. Summoning a witness, victim, their representatives or an expert located outside the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ud93ac4dba1b308383e-1.text: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
koap-ud93ac4dba1b308383e-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u2435c95a05d8a5dc8c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation
koap-u2435c95a05d8a5dc8c-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u1c9f1b15e1db534876-1.text: 1. A court and officials of federal executive authorities shall execute requests for legal assistance in administrative offence cases received from the relevant competent bodies and officials of foreign states and transmitted to them in the established manner, in accordance with international treaties of the Russian Federation or on the basis of reciprocity, which shall be presumed unless proved otherwise.
koap-u1c9f1b15e1db534876-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u915437cd6149d378bf-1.text: 2. The provisions of this Code shall apply when executing a request for legal assistance. Where the request asks for application of procedural provisions of the legislation of a foreign state, the official executing the request shall apply the legislation of that foreign state provided that its application does not conflict with the legislation of the Russian Federation and is practicable.
koap-u915437cd6149d378bf-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-uc5053b1b0849d43a75-1.text: 3. Representatives of a foreign state may be present during execution of a request for legal assistance if this is provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation or written undertakings concerning cooperation on the basis of reciprocity.
koap-uc5053b1b0849d43a75-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u4783b9a185a2ed3a75-1.text: 4. If a request for legal assistance cannot be executed in full or in any part, the documents received shall be returned, stating the reasons that prevented its execution, through the body that received it or through diplomatic channels to the competent body of the foreign state from which the request originated.
koap-u4783b9a185a2ed3a75-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u35e3ab952f89975048-1.text: 5. A request for legal assistance shall be returned in full or in any part where:
koap-u35e3ab952f89975048-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-u7fb10bcf36e8bc522d-1.text: 1) it conflicts in full or in any part with the legislation of the Russian Federation or the international treaty of the Russian Federation under which it was sent;
koap-u7fb10bcf36e8bc522d-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-ua0b8ac5adc58c52237-1.text: 2) execution of the request in full or in any part may prejudice the sovereignty or security of the Russian Federation;
koap-ua0b8ac5adc58c52237-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-ufee8997ee31ba9a462-1.text: 3) similar requests from state bodies of the Russian Federation are not executed in the foreign state on the basis of reciprocity.
koap-ufee8997ee31ba9a462-1.locator: Article 29.1.5. Execution of a request for legal assistance in the Russian Federation

koap-ue726179d196786f431-1.text: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
koap-ue726179d196786f431-1.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution

koap-u3607751588e7d0c867-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution
koap-u3607751588e7d0c867-1.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution

koap-u180371235c1389bc22-1.text: Where an administrative offence is committed in the territory of the Russian Federation by a foreign legal entity or a foreign citizen who subsequently leaves that territory, and procedural actions involving that entity or person cannot be performed in the territory of the Russian Federation, all materials of the initiated administrative offence case under investigation shall be transferred to the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation, which shall decide whether to forward them to the competent bodies of the foreign state for administrative prosecution.
koap-u180371235c1389bc22-1.locator: Article 29.1.6. Forwarding materials of an administrative offence case for administrative prosecution

koap-uc14db3b5cfd3259e79-1.text: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-uc14db3b5cfd3259e79-1.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u5ae562b5d93fe0718b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation
koap-u5ae562b5d93fe0718b-1.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-ueae7a9a18967e6f654-1.text: A request from a competent body of a foreign state for administrative prosecution of a citizen of the Russian Federation who committed an administrative offence in the territory of the foreign state and returned to the Russian Federation, or of a Russian legal entity that committed an administrative offence outside the territory of the Russian Federation, shall be considered by the Prosecutor General’s Office of the Russian Federation. Proceedings in the administrative offence case and consideration of the case in such circumstances shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure established by this Code.
koap-ueae7a9a18967e6f654-1.locator: Article 29.1.7. Execution of a request for administrative prosecution or initiation of an administrative offence case in the territory of the Russian Federation

koap-u6ba940fd2a486fed56-1.text: Chapter 30. Review of rulings and decisions in administrative offence cases
koap-u6ba940fd2a486fed56-1.locator: Chapter 30. Review of rulings and decisions in administrative offence cases

koap-u443492779fbf5356c2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 30. Review of rulings and decisions in administrative offence cases
koap-u443492779fbf5356c2-1.locator: Chapter 30. Review of rulings and decisions in administrative offence cases

koap-ubb7b6719b6a46e04c3-1.text: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-ubb7b6719b6a46e04c3-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ucf80613a84588c271a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-ucf80613a84588c271a-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uad7f6bdc77a9e547d7-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case may be appealed against by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code:
koap-uad7f6bdc77a9e547d7-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u99dca321f9da7b258e-1.text: 1) if issued by a judge, to a higher court;
koap-u99dca321f9da7b258e-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u490ee11cadc77bfcc6-1.text: 2) if issued by a collegiate body, to the district court at the location of that collegiate body;
koap-u490ee11cadc77bfcc6-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue91af5e69a4a6323c9-1.text: 3) if issued by an official, to a higher body, a higher-ranking official or the district court at the place where the case was considered;
koap-ue91af5e69a4a6323c9-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub494102a6c1e513a04-1.text: 3.1) if issued by an official specified in part 2 of Article 23.79, part 2 of Article 23.79.1 or part 2 of Article 23.79.2 of this Code, to a higher body, a higher-ranking official, the federal executive body authorised by the relevant regulatory legal act of the President of the Russian Federation, the Government of the Russian Federation or an agreement on the transfer of the exercise of certain powers, or the district court at the place where the case was considered;
koap-ub494102a6c1e513a04-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ueb8bc96f253bf6d69e-1.text: 4) if issued by another body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to the district court at the place where the case was considered.
koap-ueb8bc96f253bf6d69e-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub8a859b0ef8f567290-1.text: 1.1. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge may also be appealed against to a higher court by the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, or by the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record.
koap-ub8a859b0ef8f567290-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u289cf4c550748d5154-1.text: 1.2. The issue of a temporary identity document for a stateless person in the Russian Federation to a stateless person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, the recognition of a person as a refugee, the receipt by a person of a certificate confirming consideration on the merits of an application for recognition as a refugee in the Russian Federation, or the grant of temporary asylum to that person in the Russian Federation entails review of the ruling in the administrative offence case imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, upon a prosecutor’s protest or that person’s appeal, and (or) substitution of the penalty in the cases specified in parts 3.6 - 3.8 of Article 4.1 of this Code.
koap-u289cf4c550748d5154-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf7ac0142372fa32d8d-1.text: Review of a ruling in an administrative offence case imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation is conducted in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by this chapter.
koap-uf7ac0142372fa32d8d-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue7b9c6e9a2a7d5de09-1.text: 2. If an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is received both by a court and by a higher body or a higher-ranking official, the appeal shall be considered by the court.
koap-ue7b9c6e9a2a7d5de09-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u1ca947152d3ea2d5c5-1.text: A decision shall be issued following consideration of the appeal.
koap-u1ca947152d3ea2d5c5-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u68f5af1caad1b02556-1.text: 3. A ruling in an administrative offence case connected with entrepreneurial or other economic activity by a legal entity or a person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall be appealed against to an arbitrazh court in accordance with arbitrazh procedural legislation.
koap-u68f5af1caad1b02556-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ubaaae12b61bc3634ec-1.text: 4. A procedural order refusing to initiate an administrative offence case, and the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, shall be appealed against in accordance with the rules established by this chapter.
koap-ubaaae12b61bc3634ec-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uaff47612a3b0451a05-1.text: 5. The procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code may be appealed against by the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record (except where the procedural order was issued by that body), the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record, the prosecutor, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and the victim if participating in the case.
koap-uaff47612a3b0451a05-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ubba28eff2e7a3b0d50-1.text: 6. The list of officials authorised to appeal, on behalf of the bodies specified in parts 1.1 and 5 of this article, part 5 of Article 30.9 and parts 4 and 5 of Article 30.12 of this Code, against a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case or a decision on an appeal against such a ruling or procedural order shall be established by the respective bodies.
koap-ubba28eff2e7a3b0d50-1.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf119bcee6cd003d70e-1.text: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-uf119bcee6cd003d70e-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub10f01da58f8831dd3-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-ub10f01da58f8831dd3-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u6db3a515187cd9b58f-1.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be lodged with the judge, body or official that issued the ruling and that must, within three days of receipt of the appeal, forward it together with all case materials to the appropriate court, higher body or higher-ranking official.
koap-u6db3a515187cd9b58f-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u32b620f37162f0f446-1.text: 1.1. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be lodged with the judge, body or official that issued the relevant procedural order and that must, on the day such an appeal is received, forward it together with all case materials to the appropriate court, higher body or higher-ranking official.
koap-u32b620f37162f0f446-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u61706b46a3f9c9a646-1.text: 2. An appeal against a judge’s ruling imposing administrative arrest shall be forwarded to the higher court on the day the appeal is received.
koap-u61706b46a3f9c9a646-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u744b07afe71778afa8-1.text: 2.1. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation shall be forwarded to the higher court, higher body or higher-ranking official on the day it is received.
koap-u744b07afe71778afa8-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u82c122a08310f78429-1.text: 3. An appeal may be lodged directly with the court, higher body or higher-ranking official authorised to consider it.
koap-u82c122a08310f78429-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uea3a39d97352d8ed98-1.text: 3.1. Repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. - Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
koap-uea3a39d97352d8ed98-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue1459ddec99a08493f-1.text: 3.2. Appeals to a higher body or a higher-ranking official against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system shall be lodged electronically, including in the form of an electronic document.
koap-ue1459ddec99a08493f-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u4462c12a76c5b9a1f9-1.text: 4. If consideration of an appeal is outside the competence of the judge or official to whom the ruling in the administrative offence case has been appealed, the appeal shall be forwarded within three days for consideration by the competent authority.
koap-u4462c12a76c5b9a1f9-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u4ecc5df9871084d3c9-1.text: 5. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is not subject to a state fee.
koap-u4ecc5df9871084d3c9-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue42e3cdef310666553-1.text: 6. An appeal against a judge’s ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities shall be forwarded to the higher court on the day the appeal is received.
koap-ue42e3cdef310666553-1.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u504cb5b4db7ccac870-1.text: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u504cb5b4db7ccac870-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u249b50c581506c4168-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u249b50c581506c4168-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ua2fd689b738d7e97ab-1.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case may be lodged within ten days of service or receipt of a copy of the ruling.
koap-ua2fd689b738d7e97ab-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub5a8924a2ea06c0b7b-1.text: 1.1. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code may be lodged within one day of the arrival (receipt) of the relevant procedural order from the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case.
koap-ub5a8924a2ea06c0b7b-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u836025e60d28ad1aa4-1.text: 2. If the time limit specified in part 1 or 1.1 of this article has been missed, it may, upon an application by the appellant, be restored by the judge or official authorised to consider the appeal.
koap-u836025e60d28ad1aa4-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u35ef8620171e5b014d-1.text: 3. Appeals against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code may be lodged within five days of service or receipt of copies of the rulings.
koap-u35ef8620171e5b014d-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u4104e9573d1e0185a2-1.text: 4. A procedural order shall be issued rejecting an application to restore the time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
koap-u4104e9573d1e0185a2-1.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u15367bda8172c24de1-1.text: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u15367bda8172c24de1-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u8a394dd83918c79d49-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u8a394dd83918c79d49-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u9d64176b9f7c0a33de-1.text: 1. In preparing to consider an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, the judge or official shall:
koap-u9d64176b9f7c0a33de-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud095f67681f3a46004-1.text: 1) establish whether there are circumstances precluding consideration of the appeal by that judge or official, and circumstances precluding proceedings in the case;
koap-ud095f67681f3a46004-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2dee3cc244e2d542a3-1.text: 2) decide applications and, where necessary, order an expert examination, request additional materials and summon persons whose participation in consideration of the appeal is deemed necessary;
koap-u2dee3cc244e2d542a3-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u331da984523f68f21f-1.text: 3) forward the appeal together with all case materials for consideration by the competent authority if its consideration falls outside the competence of the judge or official concerned.
koap-u331da984523f68f21f-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u908276c52233cf2ee6-1.text: 2. In preparing to consider an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, and during its consideration, the judge, body or official shall decide on participation, through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system, by persons whose presence is necessary when the appeal against the ruling in the administrative offence case is considered.
koap-u908276c52233cf2ee6-1.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u97aa58ae7f38c06d14-1.text: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u97aa58ae7f38c06d14-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud35086ebbad59bf514-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-ud35086ebbad59bf514-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uce4334d84761bfe609-1.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered within ten days of its receipt, together with all case materials, by the body or official authorised to consider the appeal.
koap-uce4334d84761bfe609-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u3bbc405578bb8fd17a-1.text: 1.1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered within two months of its receipt, together with all case materials, by the court authorised to consider the appeal.
koap-u3bbc405578bb8fd17a-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2315f5744da977d2e7-1.text: 2. Appeals against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code shall be considered within five days of their receipt, together with all materials, by the court authorised to consider the appeals.
koap-u2315f5744da977d2e7-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u275a39a74c2a2173b6-1.text: 3. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be considered within one day of lodging the appeal if the person held administratively liable is serving administrative arrest or is subject to administrative expulsion.
koap-u275a39a74c2a2173b6-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u9b2760276921a8d0ae-1.text: 4. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities shall be considered within five days of its receipt, together with all materials, by the higher court authorised to consider the appeal concerned.
koap-u9b2760276921a8d0ae-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u97c163231489e7f811-1.text: 5. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be considered within one day of lodging such an appeal.
koap-u97c163231489e7f811-1.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u38ef72502bbf18ca26-1.text: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u38ef72502bbf18ca26-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u72a2c9ba073c0a5aba-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u72a2c9ba073c0a5aba-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u4d5dd8ea1a7bf35748-1.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered by a judge or official sitting alone.
koap-u4d5dd8ea1a7bf35748-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2833fb797b82a21dd0-1.text: 2. When an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is considered:
koap-u2833fb797b82a21dd0-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u19ca513d39971a38ab-1.text: 1) it shall be announced who is considering the appeal, which appeal is to be considered and who lodged the appeal;
koap-u19ca513d39971a38ab-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u949656f092fa08602d-1.text: 2) the attendance of the individual, the individual’s statutory representative or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the case was issued, and of persons summoned to participate in consideration of the appeal, shall be established;
koap-u949656f092fa08602d-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u5e464b1c0c2ad8d9a6-2.text: 3) the authority of the statutory representatives of the individual or legal entity, defence counsel and representative shall be verified;
koap-u5e464b1c0c2ad8d9a6-2.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf4671d37afec1b72b9-1.text: 4) the reasons for the failure of participants in the proceedings to appear shall be ascertained, and a decision shall be taken to consider the appeal in their absence or to adjourn consideration of the appeal;
koap-uf4671d37afec1b72b9-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uef44f85d6cd0e7ac62-1.text: 5) the rights and duties of persons participating in consideration of the appeal shall be explained;
koap-uef44f85d6cd0e7ac62-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc2b841319391b73234-1.text: 6) challenges and applications submitted shall be decided;
koap-uc2b841319391b73234-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ucff457e8071a2131e4-1.text: 7) the appeal against the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be read out;
koap-ucff457e8071a2131e4-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue4657410305e3b621b-1.text: 8) the lawfulness and justification of the ruling issued shall be checked on the basis of the materials in the case and additional materials submitted; in particular, explanations shall be heard from the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the administrative offence case was issued; where necessary, testimony from other persons participating in consideration of the appeal, explanations from a specialist and an expert’s opinion shall be heard, other evidence shall be examined and other procedural actions shall be carried out in accordance with this Code;
koap-ue4657410305e3b621b-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u14f2f1a29a578e6835-1.text: 9) if a prosecutor participates in consideration of the case, the prosecutor’s opinion shall be heard.
koap-u14f2f1a29a578e6835-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u1b5f3aca273e2fe150-1.text: 3. The judge or higher-ranking official shall not be bound by the arguments of the appeal and shall examine the case in full.
koap-u1b5f3aca273e2fe150-1.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u54dd0c48658e843f8b-1.text: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u54dd0c48658e843f8b-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u132ed821374c38809c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u132ed821374c38809c-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u7d98cf34096b9671a5-1.text: 1. Following consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, one of the following decisions shall be issued:
koap-u7d98cf34096b9671a5-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u7de41a3bc3f49da19a-1.text: 1) to leave the ruling unchanged and dismiss the appeal;
koap-u7de41a3bc3f49da19a-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc42ba93e0b92b8717c-1.text: 2) to amend the ruling, provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom the ruling was issued;
koap-uc42ba93e0b92b8717c-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uac2eb8b11dca87d893-1.text: 3) to quash the ruling and terminate proceedings in the case where at least one of the circumstances specified in Articles 2.9 and 24.5 of this Code exists, or where the circumstances on which the ruling was based have not been proved;
koap-uac2eb8b11dca87d893-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u5f23029dc522e6c94e-1.text: 4) to quash the ruling and remit the case for fresh consideration to a judge, body or official authorised to consider it, where a substantial breach of the procedural requirements of this Code prevented a comprehensive, full and objective consideration of the case, or where it is necessary to apply a law on an administrative offence entailing a more severe administrative penalty if the victim in the case has appealed against the leniency of the administrative penalty imposed;
koap-u5f23029dc522e6c94e-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u546ff512ca24ea1768-1.text: 5) to quash the ruling and refer the case to the competent authority for consideration if, during consideration of the appeal, it is established that the ruling was issued by a judge, body or official lacking the requisite authority;
koap-u546ff512ca24ea1768-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u064897f7750a65a960-1.text: 6) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to replace the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation imposed with another type of administrative penalty in accordance with the procedure specified in part 1.2 of Article 30.1 of this Code;
koap-u064897f7750a65a960-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u912ddc5fc351309457-1.text: 7) to leave unchanged the ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, or to amend that ruling provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom it was issued, and also to quash a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in another article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code concerning the same instance of unlawful actions (inaction), proceedings in which were conducted against the same person, and to terminate proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
koap-u912ddc5fc351309457-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ud7e2bb4ae6e60265ce-1.text: 2. A decision resulting from consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case must contain the information specified in part 1 of Article 29.10 of this Code.
koap-ud7e2bb4ae6e60265ce-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ubeb0a3fcf7b5f5572e-1.text: 3. When an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is considered, a procedural order referring the appeal to the competent authority for consideration shall be issued if it is established that its consideration falls outside the competence of that judge or official.
koap-ubeb0a3fcf7b5f5572e-1.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf43a361e415363b51f-1.text: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-uf43a361e415363b51f-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u18822d380b48801752-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u18822d380b48801752-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u7711709af665941a1e-1.text: 1. A decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be announced immediately after it is issued.
koap-u7711709af665941a1e-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ub93bfeb63e8e59d3ce-1.text: 1.1. A decision on an appeal against a ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code, considered by a higher body or higher-ranking official under the rules established by this chapter, shall be produced only as an electronic document using the information system (subsystem of a state information system) for pre-trial appeals used for information support of state control (supervision) and municipal control, established in accordance with Federal Law of 31 July 2020 No. 248-FZ “On State Control (Supervision) and Municipal Control in the Russian Federation”.
koap-ub93bfeb63e8e59d3ce-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u5aeb3f12b8eadd33b5-1.text: 2. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be served on or sent to the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the case was issued, and to the victim if the victim lodged an appeal, or to the prosecutor at the prosecutor’s request.
koap-u5aeb3f12b8eadd33b5-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u00cfadcb066ee0d041-1.text: This paragraph was repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. - Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
koap-u00cfadcb066ee0d041-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2701b429c9469aa094-1.text: 2.1. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a judge’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case considered by a judge shall be sent to the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record and to the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record.
koap-u2701b429c9469aa094-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uca3f9fd6ae04cb8f36-1.text: 2.2. Within three days after it is issued, a copy of a judge’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case considered by a body or official shall be sent to the body or official that issued the ruling.
koap-uca3f9fd6ae04cb8f36-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf5b9a09b43bfdde71f-1.text: 3. A decision on an appeal against a ruling imposing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be communicated to the body or official enforcing the ruling, as well as to the person in respect of whom the decision was issued and to the victim, on the day the decision is issued.
koap-uf5b9a09b43bfdde71f-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u87f981c9c664e91c70-1.text: 4. Copies of the decision specified in point 7 of part 1 of Article 30.7 of this Code and of a decision amending or quashing a ruling in an administrative offence case specified in part 7 of Article 29.11 of this Code shall, no later than the day following the day the relevant decision enters into legal force, be sent to the judge or body to which the procedural order requesting the administrative offence case materials specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code was sent, and to the body whose official forwarded the record of the administrative offence specified in Article 12.24 of this Code and the materials attached to it specified in point 1 or 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
koap-u87f981c9c664e91c70-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uf53c3eb77f31bcf785-1.text: 5. The rule established by part 4 of this article shall apply when considering an appeal (protest) against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, or against a decision on an appeal (protest) against such a ruling.
koap-uf53c3eb77f31bcf785-1.locator: Article 30.8. Announcement of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u68607fb6e2d9c0153a-1.text: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u68607fb6e2d9c0153a-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u659ee42da833d9e86a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u659ee42da833d9e86a-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2c481e0e6a5769583f-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by an official and (or) a higher-ranking official’s decision on an appeal against that ruling may be appealed against to the court at the place where the appeal was considered, and then to a higher court.
koap-u2c481e0e6a5769583f-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc690074ba51abb1ac3-1.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegiate body or a body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation and (or) a judge’s decision on an appeal against that ruling may be appealed against to a higher court.
koap-uc690074ba51abb1ac3-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ue59e4a6fe60c985307-1.text: 3. Subsequent appeals against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) decisions on an appeal against that ruling shall be lodged, considered and determined in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.2 - 30.8 of this Code.
koap-ue59e4a6fe60c985307-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u01c0ae4e17e0df7d65-1.text: 4. Copies of decisions shall be sent to the persons specified in Article 30.8 of this Code within three days of the decision being issued.
koap-u01c0ae4e17e0df7d65-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u6ca5a017e8ea4ae85c-1.text: 5. In addition to the persons specified in part 1 of Article 30.1 of this Code, a court’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by an official may be appealed against by the body whose official issued that ruling.
koap-u6ca5a017e8ea4ae85c-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uc1982f6152bcddf8bc-1.text: 6. In addition to the persons specified in part 1 of Article 30.1 of this Code, a court’s decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a collegiate body or a body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation may be appealed against by the head of the collegiate body or body established in accordance with a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation that issued that ruling.
koap-uc1982f6152bcddf8bc-1.locator: Article 30.9. Review of a decision issued on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u5d5bc803670fffc61c-1.text: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
koap-u5d5bc803670fffc61c-1.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions

koap-ua5987183edf94a841e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions
koap-ua5987183edf94a841e-1.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions

koap-uf9b690cb63cfa097a5-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and (or) subsequent decisions of higher authorities on appeals against that ruling may be protested by a prosecutor in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.1 and 30.2 and parts 1 and 3 of Article 30.3 of this Code.
koap-uf9b690cb63cfa097a5-1.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions

koap-ua1091633beafc413c0-1.text: 2. A prosecutor’s protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) subsequent decisions on appeals against that ruling shall be considered in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by Articles 30.4 - 30.8 of this Code.
koap-ua1091633beafc413c0-1.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions

koap-ua5d389fe2693131c18-1.text: 3.
