A copy of the decision on a prosecutor’s protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be sent to the prosecutor who lodged the protest and to the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code within three days after the decision is issued.
koap-ua5d389fe2693131c18-1.locator: Article 30.10. Lodging a protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case that has not entered into legal force and against subsequent decisions

koap-u420165f686cfe46c47-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.11. Repealed
koap-u420165f686cfe46c47-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.11. Repealed

koap-ud07d6bc5902eeb2afc-1.text: Article 30.11. Repealed. - Federal Law of 03.12.2008 No. 240-FZ.
koap-ud07d6bc5902eeb2afc-1.locator: Article 30.11. Repealed. - Federal Law of 03.12.2008 No. 240-FZ.

koap-ua86f80e300d3dd7773-1.text: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-ua86f80e300d3dd7773-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u93dad438a263e6fdc4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u93dad438a263e6fdc4-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ue844e6737798eaf760-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force may be appealed against by the persons specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.5.1 of this Code.
koap-ue844e6737798eaf760-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ud0c5151ee7db71d9f2-1.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force may be protested by a prosecutor.
koap-ud0c5151ee7db71d9f2-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ud1bc7a11d02e46fe12-1.text: 3. The right to lodge a protest belongs to prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation and the Prosecutor General’s deputies, and, in respect of service members and citizens called up for military training, to prosecutors of military districts and fleets and equivalent prosecutors, the Chief Military Prosecutor and their deputies.
koap-ud1bc7a11d02e46fe12-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ubb1ff7c98c274cb78b-1.text: 4. A decision that has entered into legal force and results from consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case may be appealed against by the head of the collegiate body that issued the ruling or by the body whose official issued the ruling in the administrative offence case.
koap-ubb1ff7c98c274cb78b-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u196dbf9108e108968a-1.text: 5. A decision that has entered into legal force and results from consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge may be appealed against by the body whose official referred that case to the judge for consideration.
koap-u196dbf9108e108968a-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u3928496b44d3e7d7a7-1.text: 6. A ruling that has entered into legal force in a case concerning an administrative offence in customs matters (a breach of customs rules) specified in chapter 16 of this Code, insofar as it imposes the administrative penalty of confiscation of the instrument used to commit or the object of the administrative offence (except where the administrative offence involves unlawful movement of goods across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union), and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests, may be appealed against by a person who owns that instrument or object, has not been held administratively liable for that administrative offence and has not been found guilty of committing it by a court, within ten days of the entry into legal force of the ruling in the administrative offence case or the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests.
koap-u3928496b44d3e7d7a7-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u9fcd1ccd40c15e9999-1.text: 7. If the time limit specified in part 6 of this article has been missed, it may, upon an application by the appellant, be restored by the judge authorised to consider the appeal. A procedural order shall be issued if that application is rejected.
koap-u9fcd1ccd40c15e9999-1.locator: Article 30.12. Right to appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u9c1cc5fa48e0b753f7-1.text: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u9c1cc5fa48e0b753f7-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u8e3c645c5081c1ba0e-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u8e3c645c5081c1ba0e-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u25de0c19e1fee44a14-1.text: 1. Appeals and protests shall be lodged with cassation courts of general jurisdiction, including the military cassation court, and with the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, except in the cases specified in part 1.1 of this article.
koap-u25de0c19e1fee44a14-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u676de2db4574411b7d-1.text: 1.1. Appeals and protests against a ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a justice of the peace that has entered into legal force, or a district court judge’s decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest against such a ruling, shall be lodged with the supreme courts of republics, territory and regional courts, courts of federal cities, the court of the autonomous region and courts of autonomous districts.
koap-u676de2db4574411b7d-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u66975c0adfc68769f4-1.text: 2. The presidents of cassation courts of general jurisdiction, including the military cassation court, their deputies, or judges of those courts acting on the instructions of the president or the president’s deputies are authorised to review rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force and have been appealed or protested against in accordance with part 1 of this article.
koap-u66975c0adfc68769f4-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ua86dea0e0b1406f3bb-1.text: 2.1. The presidents of the supreme courts of republics, territory and regional courts, courts of federal cities, the court of the autonomous region and courts of autonomous districts, their deputies, or judges of those courts acting on the instructions of the president or the president’s deputies are authorised to review rulings in administrative offence cases issued by justices of the peace and district court judges’ decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests against such rulings that have entered into legal force and have been appealed or protested against in accordance with part 1.1 of this article.
koap-ua86dea0e0b1406f3bb-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u29f812a10c46552ad9-1.text: 3. The President of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, the President’s deputies, or judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation acting on the instructions of its President or the President’s deputies shall consider appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, if they have been considered in accordance with the procedure specified in part 2 or 2.1 of this article.
koap-u29f812a10c46552ad9-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uc4d823401b818f83d4-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u340080ab6eadce331f-1.text: 4.1. Decisions of arbitrazh courts in administrative offence cases and decisions adopted by them following consideration of appeals or protests (submissions) that have entered into legal force shall be reviewed by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation if all means of appealing against them in arbitrazh courts provided for by arbitrazh procedural legislation have been exhausted. Those decisions shall be reviewed by the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation in accordance with the rules established by the Arbitrazh Procedure Code of the Russian Federation.
koap-u340080ab6eadce331f-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u6d8aea72b00de90743-1.locator: Article 30.13. Courts considering appeals or protests against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u66e982f06672163cf4-1.text: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u66e982f06672163cf4-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u4449a317efd2faeb61-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u4449a317efd2faeb61-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u56687fbffa53d0fb2e-1.text: 1. An appeal or protest shall be lodged with the court authorised to review such appeals or protests.
koap-u56687fbffa53d0fb2e-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uad195e544a62d93988-1.text: 2. An appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force must contain:
koap-uad195e544a62d93988-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u42cec88742270c297b-1.text: 1) the name of the court with which the appeal or protest is lodged;
koap-u42cec88742270c297b-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uc296ebf917ebcf3b6d-1.text: 2) information about the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest;
koap-uc296ebf917ebcf3b6d-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u4f3c3f793f7ec46911-1.text: 3) information about the other participants in the administrative offence proceedings;
koap-u4f3c3f793f7ec46911-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u0da6a6942046a51a3b-1.text: 4) identification of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests;
koap-u0da6a6942046a51a3b-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u035f1dc493b76a7577-1.text: 5) the arguments of the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest, specifying the grounds for reviewing the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force;
koap-u035f1dc493b76a7577-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u18ce1b3e2450d06f1f-1.text: 6) a list of the materials attached to the appeal or protest;
koap-u18ce1b3e2450d06f1f-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u1214fd1134250c300b-1.text: 7) the signature of the appellant or the prosecutor lodging the protest.
koap-u1214fd1134250c300b-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ued61cfeb4600f3f2d2-1.text: 3. The following must be attached to the appeal or protest:
koap-ued61cfeb4600f3f2d2-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u2d0c01c882478eda60-1.text: 1) a copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case;
koap-u2d0c01c882478eda60-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u18f0b438c25b400b5e-1.text: 2) copies of the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests, if such decisions have been issued;
koap-u18f0b438c25b400b5e-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uafdd6dd69ddd58ccec-1.text: 3) a copy of the document certifying the authority of the individual’s or legal entity’s statutory representative, a copy of the power of attorney or the warrant issued by the relevant lawyers’ organisation certifying the authority of defence counsel or the representative, if the appeal is signed by such persons;
koap-uafdd6dd69ddd58ccec-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u06bb21004e695b15c8-1.text: 4) copies of the appeal or protest corresponding in number to the other participants in the administrative offence proceedings specified in Articles 25.1 - 25.4 and 25.11 of this Code.
koap-u06bb21004e695b15c8-1.locator: Article 30.14. Lodging an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u234257b3d5d47c0032-1.text: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u234257b3d5d47c0032-1.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u40e6c5cca6bf463cdc-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u40e6c5cca6bf463cdc-1.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u9d6ac290ee322f2ada-1.text: 1. The judge shall issue a procedural order accepting for consideration an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force.
koap-u9d6ac290ee322f2ada-1.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ubf091d640154f82190-1.text: 2. A judge who has accepted for consideration an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force must notify the person against whom the administrative offence proceedings are being conducted and the victim that an appeal or protest has been lodged, and provide those persons with an opportunity to acquaint themselves with the appeal or protest and submit objections to it.
koap-ubf091d640154f82190-1.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ubd6a0a6b2febdfa9a6-1.text: 3. If an appeal or protest is lodged in breach of the requirements specified in Article 30.14 and part 4 of Article 30.16 of this Code, it shall be returned to the appellant or the prosecutor who lodged the protest.
koap-ubd6a0a6b2febdfa9a6-1.locator: Article 30.15. Acceptance for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u24eea480903353a752-1.text: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u24eea480903353a752-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u59aac0392cb414b766-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u59aac0392cb414b766-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u387fb9ca5e7f3786d1-1.text: 1. When an appeal or protest has been accepted for consideration, the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests shall be examined on the basis of the arguments set out in the appeal or protest and the objections contained in the response to the appeal or protest.
koap-u387fb9ca5e7f3786d1-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u9d1135eb7582a6a037-1.text: 2. A judge who has accepted an appeal or protest for consideration has the right, in the interests of legality, to examine the administrative offence case in full.
koap-u9d1135eb7582a6a037-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u5d57ad53bef048ac97-1.text: 3. A decision on an appeal or protest shall be issued no later than two months from the day the appeal or protest is received by the court, or, if the administrative offence case file is requested, no later than one month from the day the case file is received by the court.
koap-u5d57ad53bef048ac97-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ueb876e89c67491520a-1.text: 4. Repeated appeals or protests on the same grounds to a court that has previously considered the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions on appeals or protests against that ruling that have entered into legal force are not permitted.
koap-ueb876e89c67491520a-1.locator: Article 30.16. Scope and time limits for consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u22912c2aa8dcf2d1cd-1.text: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u22912c2aa8dcf2d1cd-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u7db4801946b0d1b876-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u7db4801946b0d1b876-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u7636a7f8d587a8d90f-1.text: 1. A decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall be adopted in the form of a ruling.
koap-u7636a7f8d587a8d90f-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u621beb97d7fe4a5e5d-1.text: 2. Following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, one of the following decisions shall be issued:
koap-u621beb97d7fe4a5e5d-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u5faa8558d475417c9a-1.text: 1) to leave unchanged the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to dismiss the appeal or protest against the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force;
koap-u5faa8558d475417c9a-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ud1feaeb32a663b6d9e-1.text: 2) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest if the breaches of this Code and (or) the law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences can be remedied without remitting the case for fresh consideration, provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom those ruling and decision were issued;
koap-ud1feaeb32a663b6d9e-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u9efa5271833b82219b-1.text: 3) to quash the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest and remit the case for fresh consideration where a substantial breach of the procedural requirements of this Code prevented a comprehensive, full and objective consideration of the case;
koap-u9efa5271833b82219b-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u4b6db2a15ad1fdb7f4-1.text: 4) to quash the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest and terminate proceedings in the case where at least one of the circumstances specified in Articles 2.9 and 24.5 of this Code exists, or where the circumstances on which those ruling and decision were based have not been proved;
koap-u4b6db2a15ad1fdb7f4-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u0c5b2f1ec87c737d70-1.text: 5) to amend the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of an appeal or protest, and to replace the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation imposed with another type of administrative penalty in accordance with the procedure specified in part 1.2 of Article 30.1 of this Code;
koap-u0c5b2f1ec87c737d70-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u323010a714af650e8b-1.text: 6) to leave unchanged the ruling in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, or to amend that ruling provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom it was issued, and also to quash a ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in another article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code concerning the same instance of unlawful actions (inaction), proceedings in which were conducted against the same person, and to terminate proceedings in that case in accordance with point 2 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code.
koap-u323010a714af650e8b-1.locator: Article 30.17. Types of rulings adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uce084895f353ce1afe-1.text: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-uce084895f353ce1afe-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u05f01d824c57232a3d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u05f01d824c57232a3d-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u2c66be50e1b4399762-1.text: 1. A ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall state:
koap-u2c66be50e1b4399762-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u1b4eb0c82713fda81e-1.text: 1) the name of the court that considered the appeal or protest;
koap-u1b4eb0c82713fda81e-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u4ff40db994faf74440-1.text: 2) the case number and the date and place of adoption of the ruling;
koap-u4ff40db994faf74440-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uad63f886d3d73ab9a3-1.text: 3) the surname and initials of the judge who considered the appeal or protest;
koap-uad63f886d3d73ab9a3-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u7f9d95be817414ae05-1.text: 4) the name of the appellant or the prosecutor who lodged the protest;
koap-u7f9d95be817414ae05-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ucd60fcb6ecc1a8d594-1.text: 5) identification of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests being appealed or protested against;
koap-ucd60fcb6ecc1a8d594-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uac047a977d979a66ca-1.text: 6) a brief account of the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests being appealed or protested against;
koap-uac047a977d979a66ca-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ub589758091d5ef8c07-1.text: 7) the arguments and requests contained in the appeal or protest;
koap-ub589758091d5ef8c07-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u6af117e9ed4b1297fe-1.text: 8) the objections contained in the response to the appeal or protest;
koap-u6af117e9ed4b1297fe-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u54c85365a62b8ff5d5-1.text: 9) the reasons and grounds for leaving unchanged, amending or quashing the ruling in the administrative offence case and the decision resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force, with references to the articles of this Code and (or) the law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation on administrative offences;
koap-u54c85365a62b8ff5d5-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-ud51f93f8e15dcadcb8-1.text: 10) the decision resulting from consideration of the appeal or protest.
koap-ud51f93f8e15dcadcb8-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u80db708d6d388150d0-1.text: 2. The ruling specified in part 1 of this article shall be signed by the judge who adopted it.
koap-u80db708d6d388150d0-1.locator: Article 30.18. Content of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-uaf7196fa1fda4e25a7-1.text: Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-uaf7196fa1fda4e25a7-1.locator: Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u585157f0421e21dbde-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force
koap-u585157f0421e21dbde-1.locator: Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u107426b720ac7e5bc8-1.text: A ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force shall enter into legal force on the day it is adopted.
koap-u107426b720ac7e5bc8-1.locator: Article 30.19. Entry into legal force of a ruling adopted following consideration of an appeal or protest against rulings in administrative offence cases and decisions resulting from consideration of appeals or protests that have entered into legal force

koap-u57d7aec9fc9f62ce4e-1.text: Section V. Enforcement of rulings in administrative offence cases
koap-u57d7aec9fc9f62ce4e-1.locator: Section V. Enforcement of rulings in administrative offence cases

koap-ue4f6ca37ee7cf56fb4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Section V. Enforcement of rulings in administrative offence cases
koap-ue4f6ca37ee7cf56fb4-1.locator: Section V. Enforcement of rulings in administrative offence cases

koap-u8bbc3594927a7c046f-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 31. General provisions

koap-u8b532248226a436d63-1.text: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u8b532248226a436d63-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u73b69b2fd604a7b5e6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u73b69b2fd604a7b5e6-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-udd8aa57108dc7ab96e-1.text: A ruling in an administrative offence case shall enter into legal force:
koap-udd8aa57108dc7ab96e-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u520518fcda3da7c321-1.text: 1) upon expiry of the time limit established for appealing against the ruling in the administrative offence case, if that ruling has not been appealed or protested against, except in the cases established by point 4 of this article;
koap-u520518fcda3da7c321-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u6b9da9623f8abbd213-1.text: 2) upon expiry of the time limit established for appealing against a decision on an appeal or protest, if that decision has not been appealed or protested against, except where the decision quashes the ruling issued;
koap-u6b9da9623f8abbd213-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u460ca29730580fb19c-1.text: 3) immediately after the issue of a decision on an appeal or protest that is not subject to appeal, except where the decision quashes the ruling issued;
koap-u460ca29730580fb19c-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u332014e3b313c2ea40-1.text: 4) on the day the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is issued in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code, where it was committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in a case imposing an administrative penalty for an administrative offence committed outside the Russian Federation and specified in Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1, or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting of failure to pay, within the time limit specified by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for committing such an administrative offence.
koap-u332014e3b313c2ea40-1.locator: Article 31.1. Entry into legal force of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u1a2714ac4a7df6eafd-1.text: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u1a2714ac4a7df6eafd-1.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ua0dcdc7ad597affaf8-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-ua0dcdc7ad597affaf8-1.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u269784331482a693aa-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case is binding and must be complied with by all state authorities, local self-government bodies, officials, citizens and their associations, and legal entities.
koap-u269784331482a693aa-1.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-uecdd77bbcd5bf77d62-1.text: 2. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be enforced in full from the moment it enters into legal force, except in the cases specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code.
koap-uecdd77bbcd5bf77d62-1.locator: Article 31.2. Binding effect of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u2a211e3b928ab88e74-1.text: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
koap-u2a211e3b928ab88e74-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-u462e4ff730e363a328-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement
koap-u462e4ff730e363a328-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-uf6eab736446f44146c-1.text: 1. Responsibility for referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement rests with the judge, body or official that issued it.
koap-uf6eab736446f44146c-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-u5924f82c6c89b2de9e-1.text: 2. Where an appeal or protest against a ruling in an administrative offence case and (or) against a subsequent decision on an appeal or protest has been considered, the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force shall be sent to the judge, body or official authorised to refer it for enforcement within three days of its entry into legal force.
koap-u5924f82c6c89b2de9e-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-uca92af1ab1dca65110-1.text: 3. If a ruling in an administrative offence case has not been appealed or protested against within the established time limits, it shall be sent to the body or official authorised to enforce it within three days of its entry into legal force; where an appeal or protest has been considered, this period shall run from the day the decision on the appeal or protest is received from the court or official that issued it.
koap-uca92af1ab1dca65110-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-u90c54dd25bdea7d3b2-1.text: 3.1. A copy of a ruling (information from such a ruling) imposing an administrative fine issued by a justice of the peace or a commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights shall be sent by them, within the time limits specified in part 3 of this article, to the budget revenue administrator whose details must be included in the ruling imposing the administrative fine in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 29.10 of this Code, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, or on paper where the technical means are unavailable.
koap-u90c54dd25bdea7d3b2-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-ubb523460d0ec06f20b-1.text: 4. When sending a ruling in an administrative offence case to the body or official authorised to enforce it, the judge, body or official shall endorse that ruling with the date of its entry into legal force or an indication that it is subject to immediate enforcement.
koap-ubb523460d0ec06f20b-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-ua9e90a7479f32f0939-1.text: 5. If a ruling in an administrative offence case imposed a principal and an additional administrative penalty, or measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings were taken or cancelled, duly certified copies of the ruling shall be sent to the bodies or officials authorised to enforce the penalties imposed, apply measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings or release persons from such measures, specifying the part of the ruling in the administrative offence case to be enforced by each respective body or official.
koap-ua9e90a7479f32f0939-1.locator: Article 31.3. Referring a ruling in an administrative offence case for enforcement

koap-u3e71e2cdfcdb09967f-1.text: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u3e71e2cdfcdb09967f-1.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u623b7144e54010f0e6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case
koap-u623b7144e54010f0e6-1.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u07c63cca40886204d4-1.text: 1. A ruling in an administrative offence case shall be enforced by the authorised body or official in accordance with the procedure established by this Code, other federal laws and resolutions of the Government of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them.
koap-u07c63cca40886204d4-1.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u75b65aac55f76c87d0-1.text: 2. If several rulings imposing administrative penalties have been issued against one person, each ruling shall be enforced separately.
koap-u75b65aac55f76c87d0-1.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-ua2643f95078936cea0-1.text: 3. If the method or procedure for enforcing a ruling in an administrative offence case is unclear, the body or official enforcing that ruling, as well as the person against whom it was issued, has the right to apply to the court, body or official that issued the ruling for clarification of the method and procedure for its enforcement.
koap-ua2643f95078936cea0-1.locator: Article 31.4. Enforcement of a ruling in an administrative offence case

koap-u958388c05092245a34-1.text: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u958388c05092245a34-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6c2bfc0deb509fb697-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u6c2bfc0deb509fb697-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u4a7afd526ddf67d993-1.text: 1. Where circumstances make it impossible to enforce, within the established time limits, a ruling imposing administrative arrest, deprivation of a special right, forced expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, or an administrative fine, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling may defer its enforcement for up to six months.
koap-u4a7afd526ddf67d993-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u2610caa52491878ffe-1.text: 2. Taking account of the financial situation of the person held administratively liable, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling may permit payment of the administrative fine in instalments over a period of up to three months.
koap-u2610caa52491878ffe-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ub466c4606e638a29f6-1.text: 3. Deferral or instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine shall not apply to foreign citizens or stateless persons on whom an administrative fine has been imposed together with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or to persons on whom an administrative fine has been imposed for administrative offences specified in Articles 11.23, 11.26, 11.27, 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (insofar as it concerns failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state).
koap-ub466c4606e638a29f6-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ua5e880fdeb8bc42010-1.text: 4. When granting deferral or instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, the court, body or official that issued it shall specify in the ruling the time from which enforcement of the administrative penalty begins.
koap-ua5e880fdeb8bc42010-1.locator: Article 31.5. Deferral and instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uafe5e26f83c9229a5b-1.text: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-uafe5e26f83c9229a5b-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u9c2e7108d42be18fbb-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u9c2e7108d42be18fbb-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uc0fef0e2177be63eb3-1.text: 1. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall suspend its enforcement if a protest is lodged against the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, until the protest has been considered, and in other cases specified by this Code. A procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling shall be issued and, where necessary, immediately sent to the body or official enforcing that procedural order.
koap-uc0fef0e2177be63eb3-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6b23e89929e206eba1-1.text: 2. Lodging a protest against a ruling imposing administrative arrest, administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, compulsory work or administrative suspension of activities shall not suspend enforcement of that ruling.
koap-u6b23e89929e206eba1-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u9f9258194e52a58e6e-1.text: 3. The judge who issued a ruling imposing confiscation of the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence shall suspend its enforcement if the person specified in part 6 of Article 30.12 of this Code appeals against the ruling in the administrative offence case that has entered into legal force, until the appeal has been considered. A procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling shall be issued and immediately sent to the body or official enforcing that procedural order.
koap-u9f9258194e52a58e6e-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u43effdcecc18c2261a-1.text: 4. The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall suspend its enforcement upon receipt of the procedural order requesting the administrative offence case materials specified in part 1 of Article 24.10 of this Code.
koap-u43effdcecc18c2261a-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ud4e6e347d4a7b0c26f-1.text: 5. The body whose official forwarded the record of the administrative offence specified in Article 12.24 of this Code and the materials attached to it specified in point 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code shall suspend enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in point 2 of part 1.7 of Article 28.8 of this Code.
koap-ud4e6e347d4a7b0c26f-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u4629005b088c34611e-1.text: 6. A procedural order suspending enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued and, where necessary, sent immediately, but no later than one day after the day it is issued, to the body or official enforcing the ruling imposing the administrative penalty. A copy of that procedural order shall be sent to the person against whom the ruling imposing the administrative penalty was issued within one day after the day the procedural order is issued.
koap-u4629005b088c34611e-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u4731008865e19287e5-1.text: 7. A judge who has issued the ruling specified in point 5 of part 1 of Article 29.9 of this Code, a decision on an appeal (protest) against such a ruling leaving it unchanged and dismissing the appeal, or a ruling resulting from consideration of an appeal (protest) against those ruling and decision leaving them unchanged and dismissing the appeal against them, shall immediately resume enforcement of the unchanged ruling imposing a penalty in a case concerning an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code.
koap-u4731008865e19287e5-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uacdbea198eac24d3fc-1.text: 8. A procedural order resuming enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued. A copy shall be sent, no later than two days after the day it is issued, to the body or official enforcing the ruling imposing the administrative penalty and to the person against whom that ruling was issued.
koap-uacdbea198eac24d3fc-1.locator: Article 31.6. Suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u9cf15a1f3fc2e256c1-1.text: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u9cf15a1f3fc2e256c1-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uf959c2766177e9287b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-uf959c2766177e9287b-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u7019638d529b2f4121-1.text: The judge, body or official that issued a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall terminate its enforcement if:
koap-u7019638d529b2f4121-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u14b8b4d2b75f8e522f-1.text: 1) an amnesty act is issued that eliminates application of the administrative penalty;
koap-u14b8b4d2b75f8e522f-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u4f28e6a6e5af82ad09-1.text: 2) the law or provision establishing administrative liability for the act committed is repealed, except where provisions repealing administrative liability for the act and establishing criminal liability for the same act enter into force simultaneously;
koap-u4f28e6a6e5af82ad09-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6bbb4624cd387086a3-1.text: 3) the person held administratively liable dies or is declared dead in accordance with the procedure established by law;
koap-u6bbb4624cd387086a3-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u475e4c43d767604dec-1.text: 3.1) an entry concerning liquidation of the legal entity held administratively liable is made in the Unified State Register of Legal Entities on the basis of an arbitrazh court’s procedural order completing liquidation proceedings in accordance with insolvency (bankruptcy) legislation;
koap-u475e4c43d767604dec-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u65149eaddc02ad6ec7-1.text: 3.2) an entry concerning removal of the legal entity held administratively liable from the Unified State Register of Legal Entities is made in that register;
koap-u65149eaddc02ad6ec7-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ueb50135d8da0648070-1.text: 4) the limitation periods for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty established by Article 31.9 of this Code expire;
koap-ueb50135d8da0648070-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uf82b97e93d6825c0e0-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u5d60bf049d2bc06ca2-1.text: 6) a ruling terminating enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty is issued in the cases specified by this Code;
koap-u5d60bf049d2bc06ca2-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ub9505152e91dba4f50-1.text: 7) the circumstances specified in part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code arise.
koap-ub9505152e91dba4f50-1.locator: Article 31.7. Termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uf83f3d7c586300ef62-1.text: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-uf83f3d7c586300ef62-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u7cfe07696405c5ea9a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u7cfe07696405c5ea9a-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u7ee162e04f622bf4f0-1.text: 1. Matters concerning clarification of the method and procedure of enforcement, deferral, instalment enforcement, suspension or termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, restoration of the time limit specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, and recovery of an administrative fine imposed on a minor from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives shall be considered by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling within three days of the ground for resolving the matter concerned arising.
koap-u7ee162e04f622bf4f0-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u067fbc667b0935fd68-1.text: 2. Persons interested in the resolution of the matters specified in part 1 of this article shall be notified of the place and time of their consideration. Failure of interested persons to appear without a valid reason shall not prevent resolution of the matters concerned.
koap-u067fbc667b0935fd68-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u08adc36d16dcedd3bd-1.text: 3. A decision on clarification of the method and procedure of enforcement, deferral, instalment enforcement or suspension of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty, restoration of the time limit specified in parts 1.3 - 1.3-3 of Article 32.2 of this Code, and recovery of an administrative fine imposed on a minor from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives shall be issued in the form of a procedural order. A copy of the procedural order shall be served against acknowledgement of receipt on the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative in respect of whom it was issued, and on the victim. If those persons are absent, copies of the procedural order shall be sent to them within three days of its issue, and a corresponding entry shall be made in the case file.
koap-u08adc36d16dcedd3bd-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u850ab8b9edc21f30cb-1.text: 4. A decision on termination of enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall be issued in the form of a ruling.
koap-u850ab8b9edc21f30cb-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u5b3e4922801b822212-1.text: 5. A copy of a procedural order deferring, permitting instalment enforcement of or suspending enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine, and a copy of a ruling terminating enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine, shall be sent by the justice of the peace or commission on minors’ affairs and protection of their rights that issued it, within three days of issue, to the budget revenue administrator whose details must be included in the ruling imposing the administrative fine in accordance with part 1.1 of Article 29.10 of this Code, electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, or on paper where the technical means are unavailable.
koap-u5b3e4922801b822212-1.locator: Article 31.8. Resolution of matters relating to enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uc5f991055375ef0b3a-1.text: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-uc5f991055375ef0b3a-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u94aa08444f44bfd859-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u94aa08444f44bfd859-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ufe470d54ec86fbf804-1.text: 1. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall not be enforced if it has not been enforced within two years of its entry into legal force.
koap-ufe470d54ec86fbf804-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u3934cc3179ca2e4dca-1.text: 2. The limitation period specified in part 1 of this article shall be interrupted if the person held administratively liable evades enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative penalty. In that event, calculation of the limitation period shall resume on the day that person is located or the person’s belongings or income against which administrative recovery may be directed under the ruling imposing the administrative penalty are discovered.
koap-u3934cc3179ca2e4dca-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u6c9907213b6af8c5b6-1.text: 3. Where enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty is deferred or suspended in accordance with Articles 31.5, 31.6 and 31.8 of this Code, the limitation period shall be suspended until expiry of the deferral or suspension period.
koap-u6c9907213b6af8c5b6-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ufa047428a0d29faa59-1.text: 4. Where instalment enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty is permitted, the limitation period shall be extended by the instalment period.
koap-ufa047428a0d29faa59-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u4b38c62d5287142f34-1.text: 5. The limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall be suspended from the day the procedural order suspending enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in part 4 or 5 of Article 31.6 of this Code is issued. The limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty under an article (part of an article) of chapter 12 of this Code shall resume if the procedural order resuming enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in part 8 of Article 31.6 of this Code is issued.
koap-u4b38c62d5287142f34-1.locator: Article 31.9. Limitation period for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uf6640760af5248f6ab-1.text: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-uf6640760af5248f6ab-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u14f886c11351e803ab-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty
koap-u14f886c11351e803ab-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-ua0b36f001478b7d35e-1.text: 1. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty that has been enforced in full, bearing an endorsement that the administrative penalty has been executed, shall be returned by the body or official that enforced it to the judge, body or official that issued it.
koap-ua0b36f001478b7d35e-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uf8efebe267598db1ba-1.text: 2. A ruling imposing an administrative penalty that has not been enforced or has been enforced only in part shall be returned by the body or official enforcing it to the judge, body or official that issued it if:
koap-uf8efebe267598db1ba-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uc202c2717c6e95a3ad-1.text: 1) the individual held administratively liable does not reside, work or study at the address specified by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling, the legal entity held administratively liable is not located there, or the property of those persons against which administrative recovery may be directed is not located there;
koap-uc202c2717c6e95a3ad-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u11efafdbea1383ffcd-1.text: 2) the person held administratively liable has no property or income against which administrative recovery may be directed, and measures to locate that person’s property have been unsuccessful;
koap-u11efafdbea1383ffcd-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u3dbafba5caed50a10e-1.text: 3) the limitation period for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty specified in Article 31.9 of this Code has expired;
koap-u3dbafba5caed50a10e-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-udd7bcfefdf315f82b1-1.text: 4) the circumstances specified in part 4 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code have arisen.
koap-udd7bcfefdf315f82b1-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u2f96fd29b5be344567-1.text: 3. In the cases specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this article, the official responsible for enforcement of the ruling imposing an administrative penalty shall draw up an appropriate statement, to be approved by a higher-ranking official.
koap-u2f96fd29b5be344567-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-uc06ae72f81a174f2d8-1.text: 4. Return of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on the grounds specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of this article shall not prevent that ruling being referred for enforcement again within the time limit specified in Article 31.9 of this Code.
koap-uc06ae72f81a174f2d8-1.locator: Article 31.10. Completion of proceedings for enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty

koap-u0702a5abdef66a0297-1.text: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
koap-u0702a5abdef66a0297-1.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation

koap-ua2803d022ba9cfd9b4-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation
koap-ua2803d022ba9cfd9b4-1.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation

koap-ud105063aa5f0b85ca4-1.text: A ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation shall be enforced in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and international treaties of the Russian Federation with the state in which that person resides or is located, and with the state in which the property of the person held administratively liable is located.
koap-ud105063aa5f0b85ca4-1.locator: Article 31.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty on a person residing or located outside the Russian Federation and having no property in the Russian Federation

koap-u58a9404bd2d54186da-1.text: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
koap-u58a9404bd2d54186da-1.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties

koap-u93362abb53719c324b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties
koap-u93362abb53719c324b-1.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties

koap-ue5dc56d3023f2d4501-1.text: Documents submitted to a body or official enforcing rulings imposing administrative penalties, or sent by such a body or official during execution of administrative penalties, may be produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, under the rules specified in Articles 24.8 and 24.9 of this Code.
koap-ue5dc56d3023f2d4501-1.locator: Article 31.12. Procedure for using documents produced electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the execution of administrative penalties

koap-u3bb20956f77994c1c2-1.text: Chapter 32. Procedure for the execution of particular types of administrative penalties
koap-u3bb20956f77994c1c2-1.locator: Chapter 32. Procedure for the execution of particular types of administrative penalties

koap-udfd53747933903b9b7-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Chapter 32. Procedure for the execution of particular types of administrative penalties
koap-udfd53747933903b9b7-1.locator: Chapter 32. Procedure for the execution of particular types of administrative penalties

koap-uebe9bf1c0977488531-1.text: Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning
koap-uebe9bf1c0977488531-1.locator: Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning

koap-ua6749df9d7c3039375-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning
koap-ua6749df9d7c3039375-1.locator: Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning

koap-u18a450228009e0b03a-1.text: A ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning shall be enforced by the judge, body or official that issued it by serving or sending a copy of the ruling in accordance with Article 29.11 of this Code.
koap-u18a450228009e0b03a-1.locator: Article 32.1. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative penalty in the form of a warning

koap-u6667189ed955463e64-1.text: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
koap-u6667189ed955463e64-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-uf45b7ae933897f4df6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine
koap-uf45b7ae933897f4df6-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u4f5f98f6e863607a14-1.text: 1. An administrative fine must be paid in full by the person held administratively liable no later than sixty days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force, except in the cases specified in parts 1.1, 1.3 - 1.3-3 and 1.4 of this article, or from the day the deferral or instalment period specified in Article 31.5 of this Code expires. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in chapter 16 or Article 19.7.13 of this Code may also be paid by another individual or legal entity.
koap-u4f5f98f6e863607a14-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-ub8b6030df71bda5095-1.text: 1.1. An administrative fine imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person together with administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation must be paid no later than the day following the day the relevant ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
koap-ub8b6030df71bda5095-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-uf299cecc6efbb1ea58-1.text: 1.2. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state, or in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (insofar as it concerns failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state), must be paid before that vehicle leaves the territory of the Russian Federation, but no later than the time limit specified in part 1 of this article.
koap-uf299cecc6efbb1ea58-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-ua8aa24b66ef311029e-1.text: 1.3. Where a person held administratively liable for an administrative offence specified in chapter 12 of this Code, except the administrative offences specified in part 1.1 of Article 12.1, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.7, Article 12.8, parts 6 and 7 of Article 12.9, Article 12.10, part 3 of Article 12.12, part 5 of Article 12.15, part 3.1 of Article 12.16, parts 4 - 6 of Article 12.23, Articles 12.24 and 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code, or for an administrative offence specified by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation consisting of failure to comply with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, pays the administrative fine no later than thirty days from the day the ruling imposing it is issued, the fine may be paid at 75 per cent of the amount imposed.
