If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after thirty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
koap-ua8aa24b66ef311029e-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-uc11c5ec5dc6a9dd4b4-1.text: 1.3-1. Where an administrative fine for an administrative offence specified in Articles 5.53 - 5.55, parts 10 and 14 of Article 7.30.3, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 13.25, part 1 of Article 14.4.1, parts 1 - 5 and 7 - 9 of Article 14.24, Articles 14.29, 14.30 and 14.36, parts 1 - 3 of Article 14.52 (in respect of self-regulatory organisations in the financial market), Articles 14.52.2, 15.17 - 15.20, 15.22, 15.23.1, 15.24.1 and 15.26, parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 15.26.1, Articles 15.26.2 - 15.26.5, 15.28, 15.29, 15.31, 15.34.1, 15.35, 15.36, 15.38 and 15.39, part 9 of Article 19.5 and Article 19.7.3 of this Code is paid by the person held administratively liable for that administrative offence or by another individual or legal entity no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing the fine is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
koap-uc11c5ec5dc6a9dd4b4-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u61218507fb34f6389b-1.text: 1.3-2. Where a legal entity that is a small or medium-sized enterprise and has been held administratively liable for an administrative offence specified in parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.32 of this Code pays the administrative fine no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing it is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the legal entity held administratively liable arrives at its address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the legal entity held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
koap-u61218507fb34f6389b-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-uf7b4bf4b93550904d0-1.text: 1.3-3. Where an administrative fine for an administrative offence detected during state control (supervision) or municipal control is paid by the person held administratively liable for that administrative offence or by another individual or legal entity no later than twenty days from the day the ruling imposing the fine is issued, the fine may be paid at half the amount imposed, except for administrative offences specified in Articles 13.4, 13.11, 13.15, 13.29, 13.29.4, 13.37, 14.31 and 14.31.2, parts 5 - 7 of Article 14.32, Articles 14.33, 14.56, 15.21, 15.30 and 19.3, parts 1 - 5, 6 - 8.1 and 9.1 - 39 of Article 19.5, Articles 19.5.1, 19.6, 19.8 - 19.8.2 and 19.23, parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.27, Articles 19.28, 19.29, 19.30, 19.33, 19.34 and 20.3 and part 2 of Article 20.28 of this Code. If a copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine sent by registered post to the person held administratively liable arrives at that person’s address after twenty days have elapsed from the day the ruling was issued, that time limit shall be restored by the judge, body or official that issued the ruling upon an application by the person held administratively liable. A procedural order rejecting that application may be appealed against under the rules established by chapter 30 of this Code. If enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative fine has been deferred or payment in instalments has been permitted by the judge, body or official that issued it, the administrative fine shall be paid in full.
koap-uf7b4bf4b93550904d0-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u93d22c7d886eb5e9fd-1.text: 1.4. An administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence specified in Article 15.27.3 or 19.28 of this Code must be paid no later than seven days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force.
koap-u93d22c7d886eb5e9fd-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-udf82bedaefbddbf25f-1.text: 1.5. An administrative fine specified in parts 1 - 1.4 of this article may be paid in the corresponding amount before the day the ruling imposing the administrative fine enters into legal force by the person held administratively liable, and, for an administrative offence specified in chapter 16 or Article 19.7.13 of this Code or part 1.3-1 or 1.3-3 of this article, also by another individual or legal entity.
koap-udf82bedaefbddbf25f-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u3fb777adbcb72ea7fe-1.text: 2. If a minor has no independent earnings, the administrative fine shall be recovered from the minor’s parents or other statutory representatives.
koap-u3fb777adbcb72ea7fe-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-ue85f68b2d0cbf27023-1.text: 3. The amount of an administrative fine shall be deposited or transferred by the person held administratively liable or by another individual or legal entity to a credit institution, including through a bank payment agent or bank payment subagent operating in accordance with the Federal Law “On the National Payment System”, to a federal postal service organisation, or to a payment agent operating in accordance with Federal Law of 3 June 2009 No. 103-FZ “On Activities for Accepting Payments from Individuals Carried Out by Payment Agents”.
koap-ue85f68b2d0cbf27023-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u05f6d236961d0bc91b-1.text: 4. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2008. - Federal Law of 24.07.2007 No. 210-FZ.
koap-u05f6d236961d0bc91b-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u7eb38eb074a4294748-1.text: 5. If, after expiry of the time limit specified in part 1, 1.1 or 1.4 of this article, there is no document evidencing payment of the administrative fine and no information on its payment in the State Information System on State and Municipal Payments, the judge, body or official that issued the ruling shall produce a second copy and send it within ten days, or within one day in the cases specified in parts 1.1 and 1.4 of this article, to a bailiff for enforcement in accordance with the procedure specified by federal legislation. If the second copy of the ruling imposing the administrative fine is produced as an electronic document whose legal validity is confirmed by an enhanced qualified electronic signature in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, that second copy shall be sent electronically to the bailiff over information and telecommunications networks. In addition, an official of the federal executive body, structural subdivision or territorial body, or other state body that considered the administrative offence case, or an authorised person of the collegiate body that considered the case, shall draw up a record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code against the person who failed to pay the administrative fine. A record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code against a person who failed to pay an administrative fine in an administrative offence case considered by a judge shall be drawn up by a bailiff. No record of the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code shall be drawn up in the case specified in note 1 to Article 20.25 of this Code.
koap-u7eb38eb074a4294748-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-udd82bb4012a84fa2bc-1.text: Parts six - seven have been repealed. - Federal Law of 08.12.2003 No. 161-FZ.
koap-udd82bb4012a84fa2bc-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u7caab056892745d46b-1.text: 8. A bank or other credit institution, a federal postal service organisation, a payment agent accepting payments from individuals, or a bank payment agent (subagent) operating in accordance with the Federal Law “On the National Payment System”, to which the amount of an administrative fine is paid, must send information on payment of the fine to the State Information System on State and Municipal Payments in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified by Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 210-FZ “On the Organisation of the Provision of State and Municipal Services”.
koap-u7caab056892745d46b-1.locator: Article 32.2. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative fine

koap-u7dc465049479ce7d7a-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.3. Repealed
koap-u7dc465049479ce7d7a-1.locator: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.3. Repealed

koap-u735101915c246cfcbc-1.text: Article 32.3. Repealed. - Federal Law of 09.11.2009 No. 249-FZ.
koap-u735101915c246cfcbc-1.locator: Article 32.3. Repealed. - Federal Law of 09.11.2009 No. 249-FZ.

koap-u5c9f86119def4a1b24-1.text: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
koap-u5c9f86119def4a1b24-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-ua7fc5f1a6d08fee1ab-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence
koap-ua7fc5f1a6d08fee1ab-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-ue2d3b8b7bedfb4c5e8-1.text: 1. A judge’s ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence shall be enforced by a bailiff in accordance with the procedure specified by federal legislation; a ruling confiscating weapons and ammunition shall be enforced by the territorial bodies of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation.
koap-ue2d3b8b7bedfb4c5e8-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u52cf77c5ebc562f7ba-1.text: 1.1. A judge’s ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence for which liability is established by Article 14.10 or chapter 16 of this Code shall be enforced by the customs body that seized the item, by transferring it to the body (organisation) authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation to dispose of goods that have become federal property, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u52cf77c5ebc562f7ba-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u0df780f7f17be38a31-1.text: 2. Confiscated items that were instruments used to commit or objects of an administrative offence shall be sold in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u0df780f7f17be38a31-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u5e5ee3f95069848e7e-1.text: 3. Confiscated copies of works and phonograms, materials and equipment used to reproduce them, and other instruments used to commit the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 7.12 of this Code shall be destroyed, except where confiscated copies of works or phonograms are transferred to the copyright or related rights holder at that holder’s request. If those instruments or objects were seized in accordance with Article 27.10 of this Code or attached in accordance with Article 27.14 of this Code, their destruction or transfer shall be carried out by the judge or, on the judge’s instructions, by the body whose official carried out the seizure or attachment.
koap-u5e5ee3f95069848e7e-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u1a8cba162afccc6b5b-1.text: 3.1. If weapons or ammunition were seized in accordance with Article 27.10 of this Code or attached in accordance with Article 27.14 of this Code, they shall be transferred to the territorial body of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, on the judge’s instructions, by the body whose official carried out the seizure or attachment. Confiscated weapons and (or) ammunition for them shall be destroyed in accordance with the weapons legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u1a8cba162afccc6b5b-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u0cdef9a6ba5083ce31-1.text: 4. Confiscated light industry goods on a list established by the Government of the Russian Federation shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, except for their transfer free of charge in cases where the legislation of the Russian Federation allows such transfer, and their transfer free of charge to the federal executive body authorised in the field of defence, or for emergency humanitarian response measures to the federal executive body authorised to address tasks concerning protection of the population and territories from emergencies, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u0cdef9a6ba5083ce31-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-ue8debd8d94223fa43e-1.text: 4.1. Confiscated property that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence, on a list approved by the Government of the Russian Federation, shall become the property of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in which it is located, except for property subject to confiscation under Article 14.10 or chapter 16 of this Code. The procedure for disposal of property becoming the property of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be determined by that entity’s highest executive body.
koap-ue8debd8d94223fa43e-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u80d0e6847fdc27d08f-1.text: 5. Confiscated gaming equipment used for the unlawful organisation or conduct of gambling, confiscated devices preventing identification of state registration plates or enabling them to be altered or concealed, and instruments used to commit the administrative offence specified in part 1 of Article 14.27 of this Code shall be destroyed in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u80d0e6847fdc27d08f-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-u9a4ac6184206590725-1.text: 6. Confiscated goods and products subject to labelling and (or) information-marking requirements established by the legislation of the Russian Federation that were instruments used to commit or objects of administrative offences specified in Article 15.12 of this Code (except for alcohol-containing medicinal products for medical use, alcohol-containing perfumery and cosmetic products, alcoholic products, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products, food products and light industry goods disposed of in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation) shall, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure for disposal of property that has become state property established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be sent for processing (recycling) or destruction, or may be transferred free of charge, in the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, to federal executive bodies and (or) organisations designated by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-u9a4ac6184206590725-1.locator: Article 32.4. Enforcement of a ruling confiscating an item that was the instrument used to commit or the object of an administrative offence

koap-ua5074dd544d1860df5-1.text: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
koap-ua5074dd544d1860df5-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-uabe10be5c575b1a127-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right
koap-uabe10be5c575b1a127-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-u62fb8030061c299267-1.text: 1. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to drive a vehicle, other than a tractor, self-propelled machine or other types of machinery, shall be enforced by officials of internal affairs bodies.
koap-u62fb8030061c299267-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-u948a6c65eeaba8f3e0-1.text: 2. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate a tractor, self-propelled machine or other types of machinery shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising regional state supervision over the technical condition of self-propelled machines and other types of machinery.
koap-u948a6c65eeaba8f3e0-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-ud65f8f0460130df620-1.text: 3. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate a vessel (including a small vessel) shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising state supervision over compliance with the rules for the use of vessels (including small vessels).
koap-ud65f8f0460130df620-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-u2f7116db76b952cca9-1.text: 4. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising state supervision over communications.
koap-u2f7116db76b952cca9-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-uc000393ca89242a55c-1.text: 5. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to hunt shall be enforced by officials of bodies exercising federal state supervision over the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife classified as hunting resources and their habitats.
koap-uc000393ca89242a55c-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-u6f33239104ba12a3b5-1.text: 6. A judge’s ruling depriving a person of the right to acquire and store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them shall be enforced by officials of the territorial bodies of the federal executive body performing functions in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation.
koap-u6f33239104ba12a3b5-1.locator: Article 32.5. Bodies enforcing rulings depriving a person of a special right

koap-ub11fdc9b11ea6cf5ae-1.text: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
koap-ub11fdc9b11ea6cf5ae-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u9210dcd41ade0f91c9-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right
koap-u9210dcd41ade0f91c9-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-uaf2f9d6ed19b8003a4-1.text: 1. A ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall be enforced by withdrawing and retaining, for the duration of deprivation of that special right, the driving licence, licence to operate vessels (including small vessels) or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate, respectively, if the driver, vessel operator or tractor driver-operator (tractor driver) has been deprived of the right to drive or operate all types of vehicles, vessels (including small vessels) and other machinery.
koap-uaf2f9d6ed19b8003a4-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u3986a6ec2ffaebf8db-1.text: 2. A ruling depriving a person of the right to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be enforced by withdrawing and retaining the special permit to operate such equipment or devices for the duration of deprivation of that special right. The procedure for withdrawing the special permit to operate radio-electronic equipment or high-frequency devices shall be established by the federal executive body exercising state supervision over communications in the Russian Federation.
koap-u3986a6ec2ffaebf8db-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u39444a1813b9c35b7f-1.text: 3. A ruling depriving a person of the right to hunt shall be enforced by cancelling the hunting permit.
koap-u39444a1813b9c35b7f-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u8094d80b4c80ce5bc6-1.text: 3.1. A ruling depriving a person of the right to acquire and store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them shall be enforced by cancelling the licence to acquire weapons and (or) the permit to store, or store and carry, weapons and ammunition for them, and by seizing the weapons and ammunition.
koap-u8094d80b4c80ce5bc6-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u68b81a36be1167dd39-1.text: 4. Upon expiry of the period of deprivation of a special right, documents withdrawn from the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty shall be returned, except in the cases specified in part 4.1 of this article and Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
koap-u68b81a36be1167dd39-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-u94cb0c99e983aaea40-1.text: 4.1. Upon expiry of the period of deprivation of a special right for administrative offences specified in Article 9.3 and chapter 12 of this Code, the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate withdrawn from the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty shall be returned after that person’s knowledge of the Road Traffic Rules has been tested and the administrative fines imposed on that person for road traffic offences have been paid in accordance with the established procedure; for administrative offences specified in part 1 of Article 12.8, part 1 of Article 12.26 and part 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code, a medical examination of that person for medical contraindications to driving a vehicle shall also be required, except in the cases specified in Article 32.6.1 of this Code.
koap-u94cb0c99e983aaea40-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-ue8f6c2f93584df00e9-1.text: 5. Unclaimed documents shall be retained for three years. Upon expiry of that period, unclaimed documents shall be destroyed.
koap-ue8f6c2f93584df00e9-1.locator: Article 32.6. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of a special right

koap-udd15455794c2380a9c-1.text: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
koap-udd15455794c2380a9c-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u15a7634de4d3f19c6b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime
koap-u15a7634de4d3f19c6b-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-uc3f893b4c4c19fb774-1.text: 1. During mobilisation, martial law or wartime, enforcement of a ruling depriving a person of a special right for an administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code shall be suspended if the person subjected to that type of administrative penalty is called up for military service upon mobilisation or during wartime, or concludes a military service contract or a contract to serve in a volunteer formation (to provide voluntary assistance in carrying out tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation) during mobilisation, martial law or wartime, and is engaged in carrying out tasks of the special military operation. The driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate shall be returned to that person; the period of deprivation of the special right shall not be interrupted.
koap-uc3f893b4c4c19fb774-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-uf41b31235c37930198-1.text: 2. Enforcement of the ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall resume from the day the person specified in part 1 of this article is discharged from military service or removed from the volunteer formation, except in the cases specified in parts 3 and 4 of this article.
koap-uf41b31235c37930198-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u210e112d526fe5eb71-1.text: 3. If, while performing military service or serving in a volunteer formation, the person specified in part 1 of this article commits a new administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code, enforcement of the ruling depriving that person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall resume from the day a new ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant right enters into legal force.
koap-u210e112d526fe5eb71-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u4bfa8f1a629a745234-1.text: 4. Enforcement of a ruling depriving the person specified in part 1 of this article of a special right for an administrative offence specified in Article 9.3 or chapter 12 of this Code shall terminate, and the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate withdrawn from that person shall be returned without the test of knowledge of the Road Traffic Rules and medical examination for medical contraindications to driving a vehicle specified in part 4.1 of Article 32.6 of this Code:
koap-u4bfa8f1a629a745234-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u19e25a5b29aeed054e-1.text: 1) from the day the person receives a state award conferred during military service or service in a volunteer formation;
koap-u19e25a5b29aeed054e-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-uaf3609394cce3b7157-1.text: 2) from the day of discharge from military service on a ground specified in subpoint “а”, “в” or “г” of point 1 of Article 51 of Federal Law of 28 March 1998 No. 53-FZ “On Military Duty and Military Service”;
koap-uaf3609394cce3b7157-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u5cee09d3dd64bcdc94-1.text: 3) from the day of removal from a volunteer formation on a ground specified in subpoint 1, 2 or 5 of point 7 of Article 22.1 of Federal Law of 31 May 1996 No. 61-FZ “On Defence”.
koap-u5cee09d3dd64bcdc94-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-u5bbdc3a571cc5f135b-1.text: 5. Upon receipt from authorised bodies of information on the circumstances specified in part 4 of this article, a ruling terminating enforcement of the ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery shall be issued in compliance with the requirements specified in Article 31.7 of this Code.
koap-u5bbdc3a571cc5f135b-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-udf6bfe4c4aed67d5fe-1.text: 6. The procedure for cooperation on matters concerning enforcement of a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery and return of the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in respect of the person specified in part 1 of this article shall be determined by joint decisions of the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of defence, the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the sphere of the activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in internal affairs, and the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation concerning the technical condition and operation of self-propelled machines and other types of machinery.
koap-udf6bfe4c4aed67d5fe-1.locator: Article 32.6.1. Procedure for enforcing a ruling depriving a person of the right to drive the relevant type of vehicle or operate other types of machinery during mobilisation, martial law or wartime

koap-ue9a872dc91c6c7eaed-1.text: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
koap-ue9a872dc91c6c7eaed-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-uff972c36341d7bda05-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right
koap-uff972c36341d7bda05-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-ubad5b111c1b1540ec9-1.text: 1. The period of deprivation of a special right shall begin on the day the ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of that special right enters into legal force.
koap-ubad5b111c1b1540ec9-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-u4582922d61816510bc-1.text: 1.1. Within three working days from the day the ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant special right enters into legal force, the person deprived of the special right must surrender the documents specified in parts 1 - 3.1 of Article 32.6 of this Code to the body executing that type of administrative penalty or, if those documents have been lost, report the loss to that body within the same period.
koap-u4582922d61816510bc-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-u86145522631eeb4137-1.text: 1.2. In the case specified in part 2 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, the person deprived of the relevant special right must surrender the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified in part 1.1 of this article, calculated from the day enforcement of the ruling depriving that person of the relevant special right is resumed.
koap-u86145522631eeb4137-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-u8e625e28437cd033e2-1.text: 1.3. In the case specified in part 3 of Article 32.6.1 of this Code, the person deprived of the relevant special right must surrender the driving licence or tractor driver-operator’s (tractor driver’s) certificate in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits specified in part 1.1 of this article, calculated from the day the new ruling imposing the administrative penalty of deprivation of the relevant special right enters into force.
koap-u8e625e28437cd033e2-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-udc493fa7d8988fbf31-1.text: 2. If a person deprived of a special right evades surrender of the relevant licence (special permit) or other documents, the period of deprivation of the special right shall be interrupted. The interrupted period of deprivation of the special right shall continue from the day the person surrenders, or has withdrawn from them, the relevant licence (special permit) or other documents, or the day the body executing that type of administrative penalty receives the person’s statement that those documents have been lost.
koap-udc493fa7d8988fbf31-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-u50796e6dec5a69f6b1-1.text: 3. If a person deprived of a special right is subjected to an administrative penalty depriving them of the same special right, the period of deprivation shall begin on the day following the day the previously imposed administrative penalty expires.
koap-u50796e6dec5a69f6b1-1.locator: Article 32.7. Calculation of the period of deprivation of a special right

koap-u167e02b041eaef36aa-1.text: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
koap-u167e02b041eaef36aa-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-ub6983b068dfd6337f6-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest
koap-ub6983b068dfd6337f6-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-u5c955f9b5719e16aab-1.text: 1. A judge’s ruling imposing administrative arrest shall be enforced by internal affairs bodies immediately after it is issued.
koap-u5c955f9b5719e16aab-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-u10bcea6c50a277eb1e-1.text: 2. A person subjected to administrative arrest shall be held in custody at a place determined by internal affairs bodies. A personal search of the person subjected to administrative arrest shall be conducted when the ruling imposing administrative arrest is enforced.
koap-u10bcea6c50a277eb1e-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-ufc618be789648ad4fb-1.text: 3. The period of administrative detention shall count towards the period of administrative arrest.
koap-ufc618be789648ad4fb-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-u810db6deb7fb21c8c2-1.text: 4. Administrative arrest shall be served in accordance with the procedure specified by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
koap-u810db6deb7fb21c8c2-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-u1bf65d9e87c572f818-1.text: 5. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest may be suspended for up to seven days or terminated by a judge upon a written application by the person subjected to administrative arrest if exceptional personal circumstances arise (serious illness (state of health), the death of a close relative or close person, or an emergency causing significant material damage to the person subjected to administrative arrest or that person’s family), or on the basis of a medical opinion that the person has an illness, injury or disability preventing service of administrative arrest. The period of suspension of administrative arrest shall not count towards the period of administrative arrest served.
koap-u1bf65d9e87c572f818-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-ua7c2c5a117669da922-1.text: 6. If a person in respect of whom enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest was suspended evades returning to the place of administrative arrest within the prescribed period, the police shall detain that person until they are delivered to the place of administrative arrest.
koap-ua7c2c5a117669da922-1.locator: Article 32.8. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative arrest

koap-u60e1aef882c53ffb9d-1.text: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
koap-u60e1aef882c53ffb9d-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-uf85e261b6c35eccc88-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
koap-uf85e261b6c35eccc88-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u107e946d825125cef3-1.text: 1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation shall be enforced:
koap-u107e946d825125cef3-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u43742317b205b585c2-1.text: 1) by border authorities, for the administrative offences specified in part 2 of Article 18.1, part 1.1 of Article 18.2 and part 2 of Article 18.4 of this Code;
koap-u43742317b205b585c2-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u0bae6b0651923c902d-1.text: 2) by the federal executive body authorised to ensure the established procedure for the operation of courts and to enforce judicial acts and acts of other bodies and officials, where a judge, body or official imposes on a foreign citizen or stateless person the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation, except for the administrative offences specified in part 2 of Article 18.1 and part 2 of Article 18.4 of this Code.
koap-u0bae6b0651923c902d-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-uc6a7421aca65b3ae58-1.text: 2. A ruling on administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation may be enforced immediately if the foreign citizen has identity documents and funds to purchase travel documents, and has applied for immediate enforcement of the ruling.
koap-uc6a7421aca65b3ae58-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-ub70874c178f4985661-1.text: 3. The application shall be lodged with the court at the location of the special institution in which the foreign citizen has been placed and considered by a judge within five days of its receipt. Following consideration of the application, the judge shall issue a procedural order granting the application and directing immediate enforcement of the ruling, or refusing the application.
koap-ub70874c178f4985661-1.locator: Article 32.9. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-ua284eb28b5b4110449-1.text: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
koap-ua284eb28b5b4110449-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u6b9ebc371af8a5efe1-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation
koap-u6b9ebc371af8a5efe1-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-ud9d04bef7504957242-1.text: 1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation shall be enforced by officially handing the person over to a representative of the authorities of the foreign state to which the person is expelled, or by the supervised independent departure of the person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation.
koap-ud9d04bef7504957242-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u7d04de3f187bd68bf6-1.text: 1.1. A ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation in the form of forced expulsion from the Russian Federation shall be enforced immediately after it is issued, by placing those foreign citizens or stateless persons in the special institutions specified by Federal Law of 25 July 2002 No. 115-FZ “On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation”, followed by administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, or by directly carrying out administrative expulsion of those persons from the Russian Federation.
koap-u7d04de3f187bd68bf6-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-ub44879034a7672b8aa-1.text: 1.2. Failure by a foreign citizen or stateless person to pay an administrative fine imposed on them and (or) the existence of obligations imposed on that person by a judge in accordance with this Code shall not prevent execution of the administrative penalty of expulsion.
koap-ub44879034a7672b8aa-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u21270a1f71d3e250ae-1.text: 2. The authorities of the foreign state to whose territory or through whose territory a foreign citizen or stateless person is expelled shall be notified of administrative expulsion of that person from a crossing point at the State Border of the Russian Federation if administrative expulsion is provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation with that state.
koap-u21270a1f71d3e250ae-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-uce55b792d7065d7dcd-1.text: 3. If handing over a person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation to a representative of the authorities of the foreign state is not provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation with that state, administrative expulsion of the person shall take place at a location determined by the border authorities.
koap-uce55b792d7065d7dcd-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-ue714bf72dfbe9d3d66-1.text: 4. Enforcement of a ruling on administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation shall be documented by a bilateral or unilateral statement, which shall be attached to the ruling or the enforcement proceedings materials.
koap-ue714bf72dfbe9d3d66-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u6439d692d9005fc1f9-1.text: 5. Repealed with effect from 1 January 2012. - Federal Law of 06.12.2011 No. 410-FZ.
koap-u6439d692d9005fc1f9-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u1eb06987f53dc9106a-1.text: 6. Foreign citizens or stateless persons subjected to the administrative penalty of expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation must leave the Russian Federation within five days after the day the ruling imposing the relevant administrative penalty enters into force.
koap-u1eb06987f53dc9106a-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-uc06ac977dc9e996b59-1.text: 7. The federal executive body exercising federal state control (supervision) in the sphere of migration shall monitor compliance by a foreign citizen or stateless person with the ruling on their administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation.
koap-uc06ac977dc9e996b59-1.locator: Article 32.10. Procedure for enforcing a ruling on administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation

koap-u675b873639aa395143-1.text: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
koap-u675b873639aa395143-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u1d275376e996a8c1e2-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification
koap-u1d275376e996a8c1e2-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-uca4126bb58526a7c2a-1.text: 1. A ruling imposing disqualification must be complied with by the person held administratively liable immediately after the ruling enters into legal force.
koap-uca4126bb58526a7c2a-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-uca42700500445dc786-1.text: 2. A ruling imposing disqualification shall be enforced by terminating the agreement (contract) with the disqualified person.
koap-uca42700500445dc786-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-ucb8d3c51ac2bf56e58-1.text: When concluding an agreement (contract), the person authorised to conclude it must request information on whether the individual is disqualified from the body maintaining the register of disqualified persons.
koap-ucb8d3c51ac2bf56e58-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-ucc38fb640608f4244f-1.text: 3. A register of disqualified persons shall be formed to keep records of persons in respect of whom rulings imposing disqualification have entered into legal force. The register shall be maintained by a federal executive body authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation.
koap-ucc38fb640608f4244f-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u800d7279b00c8e99f4-1.text: The register of disqualified persons shall contain the following information: surname, given name, patronymic, date and place of birth; the full name and taxpayer identification number of the organisation in which the disqualified person worked when committing the administrative offence, and the position held by that person in the organisation; the article of this Code establishing administrative liability for the offence; the name of the body that drew up the administrative offence record; the position, surname, given name and patronymic of the judge who issued the ruling imposing disqualification; the period of disqualification; the dates on which disqualification begins and expires; and information on review of the ruling imposing disqualification.
koap-u800d7279b00c8e99f4-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u2760f785fbdeda872d-1.text: A person shall be deemed removed from the register of disqualified persons upon expiry of the disqualification period, or when the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register has received a judicial act that has entered into force quashing the ruling imposing disqualification.
koap-u2760f785fbdeda872d-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-uece0b274ffdb942af9-1.text: The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons shall enter information in the register no later than three working days from the day it receives a copy of a ruling imposing disqualification that has entered into force or a judicial act reviewing the ruling imposing disqualification.
koap-uece0b274ffdb942af9-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u164c8b390c03893067-1.text: The information contained in the register of disqualified persons shall be open to public inspection.
koap-u164c8b390c03893067-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-ud348847a458d873013-1.text: The federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons shall publish the information contained in it on its official website on the Internet. No charge shall be made for access to the information in the register published by the authorised federal executive body on its official website on the Internet.
koap-ud348847a458d873013-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u19f281dcf41cc6a89d-1.text: Interested persons have the right, for a fee, to obtain information contained in the register of disqualified persons in the form of an extract concerning a particular disqualified person or a certificate stating that the requested information is absent. The period for providing the extract or certificate may not exceed five working days from the day the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register receives the relevant request. The amount of the fee for the extract or certificate shall be determined by the Government of the Russian Federation. The form of the extract or certificate provided to interested persons and the procedure for providing it shall be determined by the federal executive body authorised to maintain the register of disqualified persons.
koap-u19f281dcf41cc6a89d-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-ue92a3fa571ec1bce84-1.text: 4. A copy of a ruling imposing disqualification that has entered into force shall be sent by the court that issued it to the body authorised by the Government of the Russian Federation or its territorial body.
koap-ue92a3fa571ec1bce84-1.locator: Article 32.11. Enforcement of a ruling imposing disqualification

koap-u6225ab00ba6ec37ec3-1.text: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
koap-u6225ab00ba6ec37ec3-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u297974e0d20b88eb2c-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities
koap-u297974e0d20b88eb2c-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u4327af791013172f82-1.text: 1. A ruling issued by a judge, body or official imposing the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall be enforced by a bailiff immediately after it is issued.
koap-u4327af791013172f82-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-ua64579436bd174be0f-1.text: 2. During administrative suspension of activities, security seals shall be affixed, premises, places for storing goods and other material valuables, and cash offices shall be sealed, and other measures shall be applied to carry out the actions specified in the ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities that are necessary to execute that administrative penalty.
koap-ua64579436bd174be0f-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u262dd07c93761042dd-1.text: During administrative suspension of activities, measures that may cause irreversible consequences for the production process or for the functioning and preservation of life-support facilities are prohibited.
koap-u262dd07c93761042dd-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u7c458bab8be388f8b5-1.text: 3. Administrative suspension of activities shall be terminated early by the judge, body or official that imposed that administrative penalty upon an application by a person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity, a legal entity, the Presidential Commissioner for Entrepreneurs’ Rights of the Russian Federation or a commissioner for entrepreneurs’ rights in a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, if it is established that the circumstances forming the grounds for the penalty have been eliminated. The judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities must request an opinion from the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record. Upon receipt of the judge’s request, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record shall, for the purpose of preparing the opinion, check whether the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have been eliminated. The opinion shall be given in writing, specifying the facts showing whether the person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity has eliminated those circumstances. The opinion shall not be binding on the judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities and shall be assessed under the rules established by Article 26.11 of this Code. Any disagreement by the judge, body or official with the opinion must be reasoned. The application shall be considered by the judge, body or official that imposed administrative suspension of activities within five days of its receipt, in accordance with the procedure specified by chapter 29 of this Code, taking account of the particular provisions of this article. The person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or the legal entity’s statutory representative shall be summoned to participate in consideration of the application and shall have the right to give explanations and submit documents.
koap-u7c458bab8be388f8b5-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u578c08e374f95e5996-1.text: 4. After examining the documents submitted, the judge, body or official that imposed the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall issue a ruling terminating execution of that administrative penalty or refusing the application.
koap-u578c08e374f95e5996-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-ud0668af2608d676e3a-1.text: A ruling on early termination of execution of the administrative penalty of suspension of activities shall state the information specified in Article 29.10 of this Code and the date of resumption of activities by the person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity or by the legal entity, its branch, representative office, structural subdivision or production site, and of the operation of units, facilities, buildings or structures, the conduct of particular types of activities (work) or the provision of services.
koap-ud0668af2608d676e3a-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u26bfd9b80cb300cac6-1.text: 5. Upon expiry of the period established in the ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities, if execution of the penalty has not been terminated early on the grounds and in accordance with the procedure specified in parts 3 and 4 of this article, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record shall check whether the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have been eliminated.
koap-u26bfd9b80cb300cac6-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u3699d4fd0b466d0a59-1.text: If the check establishes that the circumstances forming the grounds for administrative suspension of activities have not been eliminated, the official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up the administrative offence record may draw up a new administrative offence record, and measures to secure the administrative offence proceedings may be applied in accordance with the procedure specified by chapter 27 of this Code.
koap-u3699d4fd0b466d0a59-1.locator: Article 32.12. Enforcement of a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities

koap-u7b5c92730cfaf9676c-1.text: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
koap-u7b5c92730cfaf9676c-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u5fb9be724b471d7d5b-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work
koap-u5fb9be724b471d7d5b-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-ua1330d4e2631c59f4f-1.text: 1. A judge’s ruling imposing compulsory work shall be enforced by a bailiff in accordance with the procedure established by federal legislation.
koap-ua1330d4e2631c59f4f-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u19366cf92a5d802aaf-1.text: 2. The types of compulsory work and the list of organisations in which persons subjected to that administrative penalty serve their compulsory work shall be determined by local self-government bodies in agreement with the territorial bodies of the federal executive body authorised to carry out compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensure the established procedure for the operation of courts. Types of compulsory work requiring special skills or knowledge may not be assigned to persons who lack those skills or knowledge.
koap-u19366cf92a5d802aaf-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u1c12862eb08a459601-1.text: 3. A person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work shall begin serving it no later than ten days from the day a bailiff initiates enforcement proceedings.
koap-u1c12862eb08a459601-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u17b8f24f05fbb2b7fc-1.text: 4. Bailiffs shall keep records of persons subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work, explain to them the procedure and conditions for serving compulsory work, agree with local self-government bodies the list of organisations in which those persons serve compulsory work, monitor their conduct and keep a cumulative record of the time they have worked.
koap-u17b8f24f05fbb2b7fc-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-uecaefd4586b9ab080f-1.text: 5. Persons subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work must comply with the internal rules of the organisations in which they serve compulsory work, work conscientiously at the sites assigned to them for the compulsory work period established by the court, notify the bailiff of a change of residence and appear when summoned by the bailiff.
koap-uecaefd4586b9ab080f-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u028e5b3b1169bcb2b5-1.text: 6. Granting a person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work annual paid leave at their principal place of employment shall not suspend execution of that administrative penalty.
koap-u028e5b3b1169bcb2b5-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-uec483aa5883c4d148a-1.text: 7. Women with children under three years of age and (or) children with disabilities, or who are adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children, and men who are single parents with children under three years of age and (or) children with disabilities, or who are the sole adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children, who have been subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work, as well as a person subjected to that penalty who is recognised as having a group I or II disability, becomes pregnant or develops a serious illness preventing service of compulsory work, have the right to apply to a court for release from further service of compulsory work. A bailiff also has the right to submit such an application to the court in respect of the persons listed. If the application is granted, the judge shall issue a ruling terminating enforcement of the ruling imposing the administrative penalty of compulsory work.
koap-uec483aa5883c4d148a-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u9465d01fd807ab026a-1.text: 8. A person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work shall perform that work without remuneration.
koap-u9465d01fd807ab026a-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u07489473aade232e29-1.text: 9. The period of compulsory work shall be calculated in the hours during which the person subjected to that administrative penalty actually served compulsory work.
koap-u07489473aade232e29-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-ub43310ce764f26232a-1.text: 10. Compulsory work may not exceed four hours on days off and on days when the person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work is not engaged in their principal work, service or studies, or two hours after work, service or studies on working days. Upon a written application by the person subjected to that administrative penalty, the bailiff may increase the maximum compulsory work time to eight hours on days off and on days when the person is not engaged in their principal work, service or studies, and to four hours after work, service or studies on working days. As a rule, compulsory work may not amount to less than twelve hours per week. Where there are valid reasons, the bailiff may permit the person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work to work fewer hours during a week.
koap-ub43310ce764f26232a-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-u377eb6639d3f4efd2d-1.text: 11. The management of the organisation in which a person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work serves that work shall be responsible for monitoring performance of the work assigned to the person and notifying the bailiff of the number of hours worked or the person’s evasion of compulsory work.
koap-u377eb6639d3f4efd2d-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-ub399f7e79db2654c2d-1.text: 12. If a person subjected to the administrative penalty of compulsory work evades serving it through repeated refusal to perform work, and (or) repeated failure to report for compulsory work without valid reasons, and (or) repeated breaches of labour discipline, as confirmed by documents of the organisation in which the person serves compulsory work, the bailiff shall draw up an administrative offence record under part 4 of Article 20.25 of this Code.
koap-ub399f7e79db2654c2d-1.locator: Article 32.13. Enforcement of a ruling imposing compulsory work

koap-ua710ea1096ba21978c-1.text: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held
koap-ua710ea1096ba21978c-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u94a386532fd40df15d-1.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held
koap-u94a386532fd40df15d-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u183a2f442b06e7416e-1.text: 1. A ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held must be complied with by the person held administratively liable.
koap-u183a2f442b06e7416e-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u4df6d684d447a708ab-1.text: 2. The federal executive body responsible for internal affairs shall maintain a list of persons subjected to the type of administrative penalty specified in part 1 of this article, to ensure enforcement of rulings imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held (hereinafter, the list of persons).
koap-u4df6d684d447a708ab-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u795f82ef8c0781125a-1.text: 3. The federal executive body responsible for internal affairs shall enter information in the list of persons no later than three working days from the day it receives a copy of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held that has entered into force.
koap-u795f82ef8c0781125a-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-uec6f68c638ede2304a-1.text: 4. A person shall be deemed removed from the list of persons upon expiry of the administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held, or when the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs has received a judicial act that has entered into force quashing the ruling imposing that administrative ban.
koap-uec6f68c638ede2304a-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u80e2c55cb289cbb572-1.text: 5. The federal executive body responsible for internal affairs shall remove information from the list of persons no later than three working days following the day the administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held expires, or no later than three working days from the day it receives a copy of a judicial act that has entered into force quashing the ruling imposing that administrative ban.
koap-u80e2c55cb289cbb572-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-ue970c9a739d5467252-1.text: 6. The information contained in the list of persons (the surname, given name, patronymic (if any), date and place of birth of the person in respect of whom the court’s decision imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held has entered into legal force; the date and number of that court decision; and the dates on which the administrative penalty begins and expires) shall be open to public inspection.
koap-ue970c9a739d5467252-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held

koap-u332946d44c5a9f10a1-1.text: 7. Access to the information contained in the list of persons shall be provided through the official website of the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs on the Internet information and telecommunications network. No charge shall be made for access to the information contained in the list of persons published by that body on its official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network.
koap-u332946d44c5a9f10a1-1.locator: Article 32.14. Enforcement of a ruling imposing an administrative ban on attending venues of official sporting competitions on the days they are held
